articles.concepts: ask for reviews, request reviews, review link, customer reviews, build reputation, review requests
articles.fullText:
Como solicitar avaliações (português)
[Image: Pill Pro]
Antes de um cliente decidir contratá-lo, ele quer saber como é trabalhar com você. E as avaliações dão a eles a oportunidade de ler a opinião de alguns de seus clientes anteriores.
Comece com as avaliações
[Video: Add credibility with reviews (1:54)]
As avaliações são geralmente a primeira coisa que os clientes procuram no seu perfil. É por isso que, quando você cria sua conta na Thumbtack, você pode ser solicitado a obter pelo menos uma avaliação antes de poder começar a conhecer os clientes.
Existem duas maneiras de solicitar avaliações: solicitar avaliações dos seus clientes da Thumbtack ou enviar seu link de avaliação para clientes fora da Thumbtack.
Tip
Construa sua reputação mais rapidamente ao importar avaliações de outros sites diretamente para o seu perfil da Thumbtack.
Solicite avaliações de clientes que você conheceu por meio da Thumbtack
Você pode agendar pedidos de avaliação para qualquer cliente Thumbtack com quem estiver trabalhando ou solicitar uma avaliação depois de concluir o trabalho. As avaliações de clientes Thumbtack são rotuladas como "Hired on Thumbtack" (Contratado na Thumbtack), e você pode ter um número ilimitado de avaliações de clientes Thumbtack.
Veja como solicitar ou agendar uma solicitação de avaliação do seu cliente Thumbtack:
Aplicativo
Abra o aplicativo Thumbtack para profissionais.
Toque Messages (Mensagens) (no menu principal na parte inferior).
Selecione de qual cliente você deseja solicitar uma avaliação.
Toque no menu de três pontos (no canto superior direito).
Selecione a opção para solicitar uma avaliação.
Selecione On a future date (Em uma data futura) para agendar a solicitação de avaliação ou selecione Now (Agora) se o trabalho estiver concluído.
Escreva sua mensagem.
Toque em Send review request (Enviar pedido de avaliação) ou Send review (Enviar avaliação).
Computador
Acesse sua conta Thumbtack.
Vá para suas Messages (Mensagens).
Selecione a mensagem do cliente.
Clique no menu de três pontos (no canto direito acima das mensagens).
Clique em Request a review (Solicitar uma avaliação).
Selecione On a future date (Em uma data futura) para agendar a solicitação de avaliação ou selecione Now (Agora) se o trabalho estiver concluído.
Escreva sua mensagem.
Toque em Send review request (Enviar pedido de avaliação) ou Send review (Enviar avaliação).
Tip
Seus clientes estão tendo algum problema ao postar a avaliação? Certifique-se de que eles estejam usando o próprio dispositivo e tenham uma conexão de internet para enviar a avaliação.
Compartilhe seu link de avaliação com clientes fora da Thumbtack
Você também pode obter avaliações de clientes que conheceu fora da Thumbtack, e ficará visível em seu perfil. Tudo o que você precisa é do seu link de avaliação. Seu link leva os clientes diretamente para sua página de avaliações, onde eles podem deixar uma.
Seu perfil pode exibir até 10 avaliações de clientes que você conheceu fora da Thumbtack quando eles usarem o seu link de avaliação.
Para encontrar e compartilhar seu link de avaliação, siga estas etapas:
Aplicativo
Abra o aplicativo Thumbtack para profissionais.
Toque em Profile (Perfil) (no menu principal na parte inferior).
Role até a seção “Reviews” (Avaliações). (Se você já tiver avaliações, toque na opção abaixo para ver todas as suas avaliações.)
Toque em Get reviews (Obter avaliações).
Escolha como você gostaria de compartilhar seu link.
Computador
Acesse sua conta Thumbtack.
Clique em Perfil (no menu principal acima)
Role até a seção “Reviews” (Avaliações).
Clique em Copy shareable link (Copiar link compartilhável) e compartilhe com seus clientes.
Tip
Quer mostrar ainda mais as suas conquistas? Você pode exibir as avaliações que recebeu na Thumbtack adicionando um widget ao site do seu negócio. Vá em Widgets em Settings (Configurações) para começar.
Concluiu recentemente um trabalho do qual se orgulha?
[Button: Peça uma avaliação]

Perguntas frequentes
Como minha classificação por estrelas é calculada?
Sua classificação por estrelas é a média das avaliações e notas no seu perfil. Ela é calculada com base em:
Avaliações verificadas que você recebeu na Thumbtack.
Avaliações do Google que você importou.

articles.fullText:
Esse é o seu guia para as suas preferências de trabalho (português)
[Image: Pill Pro]
Tudo está nos detalhes. Com as preferências de trabalho (também conhecido como público-alvo), você nos diz que tipo de serviços está procurando. E quando esses clientes entrarem em contato, você receberá o nosso Compromisso de Qualidade.
Que tipo de trabalho chama a sua atenção?
Pare para pensar no seu trabalho perfeito. Aquele tipo de trabalho que você está sempre procurando e não pensaria duas vezes antes de aceitar. O que vem à mente?
Agora que você sabe quais trabalhos deseja, é importante nos informar também.
[Image: Exact match lead ]
Você decide quais trabalhos são ideais.
Quando você se cadastra na Thumbtack, você nos informa o básico. Mas se você está em busca do trabalho perfeito — e quer aparecer nos resultados de busca — é hora de configurar suas preferências de trabalho adicionar um serviço.
Com as preferências de público-alvo, você nos informa:
Onde: Não quer trabalhar no centro? Sem problemas. Você escolhe sua própria distância de deslocamento e áreas, até mesmo o bairro.
Quando: É como escolher seu próprio horário. Você define os dias e horários, e novos trabalhos se encaixam na sua agenda.
O que: Aqui é onde você especifica os tipos de trabalhos que sempre quer (e os que não quer).
Se um cliente entrar em contato com você e o trabalho corresponder ao onde, quando e o que definidos, você paga automaticamente por esse prospecto. Depois que o cliente entra em contato, cabe a você responder rapidamente e conquistar o trabalho. Saiba mais sobre como ser contratado com suas mensagens.
Por que suas preferências de trabalho são importantes.
Com suas preferências de trabalho, você nos diz quais trabalhos deseja. É assim que sabemos quais clientes são uma boa escolha para você. Quando um cliente estiver interessado em trabalhar com você, ele entrará em contato.
Você paga automaticamente por prospectos que entram em contato com você com detalhes de projeto que correspondem às suas preferências. Por isso, é importante que suas preferências de trabalho reflitam com precisão o seu negócio e seus objetivos.
Você aparece nos resultados de busca depois de receber avaliações e configurar suas preferências de trabalho. Os detalhes que você compartilha nos informam exatamente quais trabalhos você sempre quer.
Tip
Quando suas preferências de trabalho não conseguem filtrar todos os detalhes do trabalho que você precisa, use o seu perfil para definir expectativas claras. Informe quaisquer limitações ou especialidades específicas para economizar tempo e garantir que apenas os clientes certos entrem em contato.
Ajude os clientes certos a encontrarem você.
No fim, o mais importante é ser visto pelos clientes certos.
Configurar preferências de trabalho significa que você aparecerá nos resultados de busca. As preferências de trabalho também ajudam seus clientes ideais a encontrarem você. Sabe aqueles filtros que os clientes usam quando estão procurando profissionais? Eles são baseados nos detalhes e preferências que você nos informou do seu negócio.
[Image: Customer search demo]
Agora é a sua vez.
Configure suas preferências de trabalho. Vá para sua aba de Services (Serviços) e nos diga quais trabalhos você sempre quer. Assim que soubermos o que você está procurando, garantimos que você apareça nos resultados de busca.
Já configurou suas preferências de público-alvo? Talvez seja um bom momento para revisá-las.
Em seguida, aprenda sobre a experiência do cliente na Thumbtack.
[Button: Veja aqui o guia de como os clientes encontram você.]

articles.fullText:
Quanto pago por prospectos e agendamentos? (português)
[Image: Pill Pro]
Na Thumbtack, você paga por prospectos — que são novos clientes que entram em contato ou agendam você diretamente.
O que determina o custo de prospectos
Nosso objetivo é fazer com que o custo corresponda ao valor do trabalho. Os preços variam, pois o valor de um trabalho pode mudar com base em fatores como o tipo e o tamanho do trabalho, quantos profissionais estão disponíveis e seu mercado.
Como configurar seus preços de prospectos
Quando um cliente entra em contato com você diretamente dos resultados da pesquisa e o trabalho dele corresponde às suas preferências de trabalho, você paga automaticamente pelo prospecto.
Você está no controle. Você decide o quão competitivo quer ser ao definir seus preços por prospecto. Esse é o valor exato que você pagará por cada prospecto. Veja como:
Aplicativo
Abra o aplicativo da Thumbtack para profissionais.
Toque em Services (Serviços) (no menu principal na parte inferior).
Toque em Manage lead prices (Gerenciar preços de prospectos).
Se você tiver mais de um serviço, selecione o serviço que deseja atualizar.
Mova o controle deslizante para ajustar seu preço de prospecto.
Salve suas alterações.
Repita essas etapas para cada serviço que você oferece.
Computador
Acesse sua conta Thumbtack.
Vá para Services (Serviços).
Se você tiver mais de um serviço, selecione o serviço que deseja atualizar.
Clique em Manage lead prices (Gerenciar Preços de prospecto).
Mova o controle deslizante para ajustar seu preço de prospecto.
Salve suas alterações.
Repita essas etapas para cada serviço que você oferece.
Veja o preço das Oportunidades
Todas as Oportunidades (também chamadas de “prospectos em aberto”) mostram os preços antecipadamente. Quando se trata de oportunidades, você é quem entra em contato com o cliente primeiro se estiver interessado naquele trabalho. Você só paga o preço mostrado se o cliente responder a você.
Você pode verificar o preço de uma oportunidade seguindo estas etapas:
Aplicativo
Abra o aplicativo da Thumbtack para profissionais.
Toque em Jobs (Trabalhos) (no menu principal na parte inferior).
Toque em Opportunities (Oportunidades).
Selecione View details (ver detalhes) para um prospecto em aberto no qual você esteja interessado.
Encontre a taxa do prospecto no banner abaixo do nome e da localização do cliente.
Computador
Acesse sua conta Thumbtack.
Vá para a aba Jobs (Trabalhos).
Selecione Opportunities (Oportunidades) (no lado esquerdo).
Selecione View details (ver detalhes) para um prospecto em aberto no qual você esteja interessado.
Encontre a taxa do prospecto no banner abaixo do nome e da localização do cliente.
Acompanhe quanto você pagou por cada prospecto
Você pode ver quanto pagou por prospectos anteriores em dois lugares: seu histórico de pagamentos e sua aba Mensagens.
Seu histórico de pagamentos mostrará um registro detalhado de cada prospecto e Oportunidade que você pagou ao longo do tempo.
Sua aba Mensagens mostrará quanto você pagou por um prospecto específico.
Veja quanto você pagou por um prospecto específico na sua aba Mensagens:
Aplicativo
Abra o aplicativo da Thumbtack para profissionais.
Toque em Messages (Mensagens) (no menu principal na parte inferior).
Toque no prospecto que você deseja verificar.
Toque na seção que mostra os detalhes do prospecto (como o tipo de serviço e a localização), encontrada logo abaixo do nome do cliente.
Procure onde diz "Paid" (Pago) para ver o custo.
Computadora
Acesse sua conta Thumbtack.
Vá para a aba Messages (Mensagens).
Seleccione el prospecto que desea verificar.
Debajo de los detalles del trabajo del cliente, busque donde dice "Paid" (Pago) para ver el costo.
Aprenda a fazer valer ao máximo cada dólar.
[Button: Guia de como investir na Thumbtack.]

articles.fullText:
Como funciona a Thumbtack (português)
[Image: Pill Pro]
Apresentamos o seu negócio aos clientes, de graça.
Milhares de clientes vêm à Thumbtack todos os dias para encontrar profissionais como você. Os clientes veem os resultados da pesquisa em tempo real com perfis, classificações e muito mais. Eles podem filtrar os resultados para encontrar os profissionais que são uma boa combinação.
Você pode começar a aparecer nos resultados da pesquisa depois de fazer duas coisas:
Obter pelo menos uma avaliação de um cliente anterior.
Configurar preferências de trabalho para sabermos os tipos de trabalhos que você deseja.
Os clientes escolhem os profissionais que mais gostam.
Crie um perfil cativante para se destacar nos resultados de pesquisa. Você pode começar:
Adicionando detalhes úteis sobre seu negócio.
Mostrando fotos deslumbrantes do seu trabalho.
Obtendo avaliações de seus clientes anteriores.
Quando um cliente acha que você pode ser uma boa opção para um trabalho, ele entra em contato. Saiba mais sobre como obter prospectos.
Pro Tip 
Busque pelo seu negócio na Thumbtack para saber como os clientes encontram você. Observe como você se compara a outros profissionais nos resultados de pesquisa – o que mais você poderia adicionar ao seu perfil para se destacar melhor?
Você também escolhe seus clientes.
Ao definir suas preferências de trabalho, você nos diz os tipos de trabalho que deseja. Suas preferências também nos informam onde e quando você deseja trabalhar.
Enviaremos prospectos que correspondem às suas preferências de trabalho e você fecha o negócio com o cliente. Como esses prospectos correspondem às suas preferências, você paga por eles automaticamente.
Sua empresa não aparece nos resultados de pesquisa até que você defina suas preferências, por isso é importante começar imediatamente.
Oportunidades para conhecer mais clientes.
Você também pode navegar pelas Opportunities (Oportunidades) na Thumbtack (é uma seção dentro da sua aba Jobs (trabalhos). Se você vir uma oportunidade na qual esteja interessado, envie uma mensagem ao cliente. Você só paga se ele responder. O preço, caso o cliente responda, é mostrado antecipadamente.
Pro Tip 
Responda primeiro aos prospectos (já que você paga automaticamente por eles). Confira as oportunidades quando estiver procurando por trabalhos extras.
Responda rapidamente e seja contratado.
Depois de obter um prospecto e o cliente iniciar uma conversa com você, cabe a você fechar o negócio. Revise os detalhes do trabalho e responda rapidamente. Quanto mais rápido você responder, maiores serão suas chances de ser contratado.
Saiba mais sobre como responder a prospectos. Além disso, confira nosso guia sobre como responder clientes para outras dicas de mensagens.

articles.concepts: background check, criminal background check, safety screening, identity verification, pro vetting, screening results
articles.fullText:
Como fazer uma verificação de antecedentes criminais (português)
[Image: Pill Pro]
Encontrar um profissional em quem possam confiar está no topo da lista de tarefas de todo cliente ao iniciar um novo projeto. E verificações de antecedentes criminais constroem essa confiança e segurança ao contratar.
Aplicativo
Abra o aplicativo Thumbtack para profissionais.
Toque em Profile (Perfil) (no menu principal na parte inferior).
Role para baixo até a seção Credentials (Credenciais).
Ao lado de “Background Check” (Verificação de antecedentes), selecione Start (Iniciar).
Envie suas informações.
Computador
Acesse sua conta Thumbtack.
Vá para seu Profile (Perfil).
Role para baixo até a seção Credentials (Credenciais).
Ao lado de “Background Check” (Verificação de antecedentes), selecione Start (Iniciar).
Envie suas informações.
Não é necessário um SSN para fazer uma verificação de antecedentes na Thumbtack. Você pode enviar suas informações usando um passaporte, carteira de motorista ou uma identidade emitida pelo governo de outro país.
Pro Tip
Todas as verificações de antecedentes criminais devem ser enviadas pelo proprietário da conta. Se o nome da verificação de antecedentes não corresponder ao nome da conta, a verificação de antecedentes não será processada.
Obtendo resultados
Os resultados normalmente levam de 5 a 7 dias úteis para serem concluídos (embora alguns possam levar mais tempo). Para verificar o status da sua verificação de antecedentes criminais, volte para a seção Credentials (Credenciais) do seu perfil.
Enviaremos um e-mail quando terminarmos de processar seus resultados. Depois que os resultados forem processados e você for aprovado na verificação de antecedentes, pode levar de 1 a 3 dias úteis adicionais para que o selo de verificação de antecedentes apareça no seu perfil. Os clientes poderão ver esse selo exibido no seu perfil.
Por que as verificações de antecedentes criminais são importantes?
As verificações de antecedentes são gratuitas e fáceis de fazer, e nós cuidamos de tudo para você. Tudo o que você precisa é do seu Número de Seguro Social (SSN) ou de um documento de identificação com foto, como passaporte ou carteira de motorista. Aqui está uma lista completa de documentos válidos (melhor visualizados no seu desktop).
Pro Tip
Para se qualificar para o Thumbtack Pro Rewards, você precisa fazer uma verificação de antecedentes criminais.
Frequently asked questions
Vocês exigem que os profissionais façam verificações de antecedentes criminais?
Sim. Todos os proprietários de conta devem realizar e ser aprovados em uma verificação de antecedentes criminais feita por um provedor terceirizado nacionalmente credenciado ao criar uma conta na Thumbtack.
O proprietário da conta é responsável por garantir que seus funcionários, contratados e trabalhadores cumpram nossos Termos de Uso e todas as leis federais, estaduais e locais aplicáveis (incluindo os requisitos locais de licenciamento).
Também realizamos verificações contínuas anuais, que monitoram fontes de dados em tempo real para identificar mudanças nos registros de uma pessoa e nos ajudar a encontrar informações recentes que possam ser relatadas.
O que acontece se eu não passar?
Se sua ficha de antecedentes criminais não for limpa, seus resultados podem afetar sua elegibilidade para estar na Thumbtack. Analisamos isso caso a caso.
E se o resultado da minha verificação de antecedentes não estiver correto?
Se você tiver dúvidas sobre seus resultados, entre em contato conosco.
Já se passaram mais de sete dias úteis e ainda não recebi meu resultado. O que devo fazer?
Se você enviou suas informações e já se passaram mais de sete dias úteis, entre em contato conosco.
Pronto para aumentar sua credibilidade?

articles.fullText:
How to use quote templates
[Image: Pill Pro]
Quote templates are a quick and convenient way to reach out to Opportunities. When you see an Opportunity you’re interested in, simply select (or edit) a template that fits the job.
Tip
Quote templates are only used for Opportunities. For other leads and communicating with customers in your Messages tab, you'll use quick replies.
Create your first quote template
Set up your first quote template to respond to customers faster. These steps are only for your very first template — if you’ve already made one, see how to edit quote templates instead.
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Profile (from the main menu below).
Tap the gear icon (in the top right corner).
Tap Quote templates.
Tap Create one.
Give your quote template a title, select your quote price, and type your message (we’ll automatically input the customer’s name into “_first_name_”). You can even attach files to your quote by tapping the paperclip icon.
Tap Done.
Tap Save.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Click your profile photo (in the top right corner).
Select Settings from the drop-down menu.
Click Quote templates.
Click Create one.
Create your template.
Click Save.
Use quote templates
After you’ve created at least one quote template, follow these steps to use it:
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Jobs (from the main menu below).
Tap Opportunities (at the top).
Tap View details on an opportunity.
Tap the option to send the customer a quote.
Choose the template that best fits the job (swipe to browse through them). Or tap the Plus sign + above to create a new one.
Tap Send.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Jobs.
Select Opportunities.
Select the job you want to quote.
Select the quote template you want to use. If you have multiple templates, use the arrows on the side to switch between them.To make changes to the template, select Edit.If you need a completely new template, click Create a new one.
Click Send.
Edit or delete quote templates
After a while, you may need to change or delete a template. Here’s how:
How to edit quote templates
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Profile (from the main menu below).
Tap the gear icon (in the top right corner).
Tap Quote templates.
Choose the template you’d like to edit (or tap the plus sign + at the top to create a new one).
Edit the title, price, message, or attachments as needed.
Tap Save.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Click your profile photo (in the top right corner).
Select Settings from the drop-down menu.
Select Quote templates.
Choose the template you’d like to edit (or select the plus sign + at the top to create a new one).
Click Edit.
Edit the title, price, message, or attachments as needed.
Click Save.
How to delete quote templates
iOS app
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Profile (from the main menu below).
Tap the gear icon (in the top right corner).
Tap Quote templates.
Choose the template you’d like to delete.
Tap the three-dot menu (in the top right corner).
Tap Delete Template.
Android app
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Profile (from the main menu below).
Tap the gear icon (in the top right corner).
Tap Quote templates.
Choose the template you’d like to delete.
Tap the Trash icon (in the top right corner).
Tap OK to confirm.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Click your profile photo (in the top right corner).
Select Settings from the drop-down menu.
Select Quote templates.
Choose the template you’d like to delete.
Click Delete below the template.
Click Delete again to confirm.
Tips for using quote templates
Use appropriate greetings and closings: If your quote template includes a greeting or closing that’s tied to a time of day (“Good morning!”) or a time of year (“Happy holidays!”), be sure to edit that text before you send your quote.
Update your price estimate: If your prices change for different types of jobs, be sure to update the price estimate in your quote template.
Keep your messages current: Periodically update the language in your quote, such as a reference to “Summer business hours” or “holiday prices.”
Check your attachments: Make sure you don’t accidentally send attachments that include the names or custom-proposals for previous customers.
Try out different templates: Go back to see which templates have helped you get hired most often.

articles.fullText:
Thumbtack Budget, Fees, Payments, and Taxes Terms
[Image: Pill Customer]
[Image: Pill Pro]
Last Updated: May 19, 2026
These Budget, Fees, Payments, and Taxes Terms explain how Thumbtack charges for services, how your budget works, and your tax responsibilities. Review this information carefully to understand your financial obligations when using the platform.
Thumbtack’s Terms of Use and Privacy Policy apply fully and completely to these Terms. Undefined capitalized terms used herein shall have the definitions as set forth in our Terms of Use.
Fees
In connection with the use of the Platform, Thumbtack charges Fees, which may change or be updated by Thumbtack from time to time. Service Professionals pay Fees to Thumbtack in order to receive certain services on the Platform, including receiving contacts, bookings/appointments, or payments from Consumers or other individuals.
If You are a Service Professional, Thumbtack may automatically charge Your stored payment method when Consumers or other individuals contact or make a booking with You concerning a Pro Service that Thumbtack has basis (e.g., through their actions or preferences set on the Platform) to believe You can perform. These charges may be disputed in adherence to our Refund Policy. Thumbtack may also charge other types of Fees that You have previously agreed to (e.g., cancellation fees or fees for services/features offered through Thumbtack) to Your stored payment method or as a deduction from Your Thumbtack balance. Fees may also be deducted from the total amount a Consumer pays for a particular Pro Service.
In order to use Thumbtack, You must have at least one valid payment method stored on Your Account and the storage of such payment method is subject to our Stored Payment Terms and Conditions. To the extent Thumbtack stores Your payment method for future charges, You authorize Thumbtack to charge that payment method for Fees as described herein. You may update or remove a stored payment method at any time through Your Account settings, subject to any outstanding balance or commitment owed to Thumbtack.
Budget for Service Professionals
As a Service Professional, Thumbtack may require You to set one or more spending limits (“Budgets”) for how much You are willing to spend on certain Fees over a specific period (“Budget Period”). The types of leads or other Fees that count against Your Budget will be disclosed to You at the time You set Your Budget. You understand that Thumbtack may charge Your stored payment method in excess of Your Budgets if such charges relate to Fees not covered by Your Budget (including for “opportunities” contacts or for commission-based Fees), or if You otherwise give Thumbtack permission to do so.
You will not be charged the Budget amount upfront or automatically - Your Budget is not a subscription. Rather, You will be charged Fees (as further described below) and the sum of Fees covered by a Budget will not exceed Your specified Budget for a set Budget Period without Your permission. Note that any refunds You receive during a Budget Period may be deducted from Your spend. For example, if You have spent $60 of Your $100 budget and then receive a $20 refund, Your spend so far will effectively have been $40 and You may incur up to $60 of additional Fees in that Budget Period.
While Thumbtack may provide an estimate for the number of Consumers who may contact you if You set a particular Budget for a particular Budget Period, or if You otherwise set a certain spending preference, You acknowledge and agree that any such estimate is not a guarantee, and that Thumbtack does not and cannot control any Consumer or other individual's interest in contacting or hiring You, and that actual results will vary.
We will identify the length of the Budget Period when You set Your Budget. Once a Budget Period begins, the length of the Budget Period may not be changed for that Budget Period, but may be changed for any subsequent Budget Periods. If a Budget Period length changes, You can adjust Your Budget. If You do not do so, Thumbtack will automatically pro-rate Your then-current Budget to the length of the new period. You can change Your Budget for a Budget Period at any time, including in the middle of a Budget Period, subject to the terms of this paragraph and what You have already spent or incurred. Thumbtack may limit the number of times You can change Your Budget during a given Budget Period in its sole and absolute discretion. If You do not change Your Budget in advance of a subsequent Budget Period, Your Budget from the then-current Budget Period will automatically be used for that subsequent Budget Period.
Timing of Charges for Service Professionals on Thumbtack
As a Service Professional using Thumbtack, there are different points at which Your payment method may be charged:
If You Lack Sufficient Purchasing History on Thumbtack: If You are new to Thumbtack or do not have a sufficient purchasing history on the Platform as determined in Thumbtack's sole and absolute discretion, Your payment method may be charged each time You are contacted or booked by a Consumer or other individual and You do not have an adequate Thumbtack balance to cover the cost of that contact.
If You Have a Sufficient Purchasing History On Thumbtack: Once Thumbtack determines, in our sole and absolute discretion, that You have sufficient purchasing history on Thumbtack, Thumbtack may charge Your payment method periodically for the total Fees accrued when Consumers or other individuals contact You. Specifically, Thumbtack may charge Your payment method each time (a) a specific time period has passed ; and/or (b) within that time period, each time the total Fees accrued hit a certain dollar threshold.
The frequency of charges may not match the Budget Period described above. Thumbtack may adjust both the specific time period and the dollar threshold that trigger charges in our sole and absolute discretion. Thumbtack may also, in our sole and absolute discretion, revert to charging Your payment method each time You are contacted by a Consumer or other individual.
Thumbtack may offer certain services or features with payment timing that differs from, or is not applicable to, the above. Please be sure to read any additional terms and conditions that may apply to such services or features.
Default Payment Method
For ordinary charges, Thumbtack will first attempt to charge the User's default payment method. In the event that Thumbtack is unable to charge that payment method for any reason—including, but not limited to: exceeding a payment method's credit limit, payment method cancellation, a payment method being out of date, or payment method details being incorrect—You agree that Thumbtack may charge any other payment method associated with Your account and take any other action to collect payment from You.
If Your payment details change, Your card provider may provide us with updated card details. We may use these new details in order to help prevent any interruption to services purchased. If Thumbtack is unable to charge the default payment method, Thumbtack may attempt to charge any other payment methods associated with Your Account in any order.
Prepaid Packages
Thumbtack may from time to time provide Service Professionals the opportunity to purchase from Thumbtack a package of prepaid lead generation fee credits (“Prepaid Packages”). Prepaid Packages may only be used toward the payment of Fees, other than penalty Fees (as described below). All sales of Prepaid Packages are final. You agree any unused portion of a Prepaid Package is not refundable and is not redeemable for cash. Prepaid Packages do not expire and may be redeemed by a Service Professional for as long as You have an active Account that is in good standing, as determined by Thumbtack in its sole discretion.
If Fees paid with a Prepaid Package credit are subject to refund in accordance with our Refund Policy, You will receive the refund in the form of additional Prepaid Package credits. When Your Account has both Prepaid Package Credits and credits provided to You as part of a Promotion (defined below), any lead purchase will automatically be split in proportion to those credit balances. For example, if 60% of Your total credits are prepaid and 40% are promotional, we’ll charge 60% of the lead’s cost to Your prepaid credits and 40% to Your promotional credits.
Penalty Fees for All Users
Thumbtack may charge penalty Fees for fraud, misconduct, late payment, cancellation, certain Fees disclosed in the Platform, or other violations of these Terms, as determined in our sole discretion. Information about current penalty Fees is available in the help center and may be updated by Thumbtack from time to time with reasonable notice.
You agree to pay all applicable Fees or charges based on the Fee and billing terms then in effect, regardless of whether You have an active Account. Charges will be made to the payment method designated as default at the time You accrue a Fee. If You do not pay on time or if Thumbtack cannot charge a payment method for any reason, Thumbtack reserves all rights permissible under law to recover payment plus all costs and expenses incurred, including reasonable attorneys' fees, in our pursuit of payment. If any Fee is not paid in a timely manner, or we are unable to process Your transaction using the payment method provided, we reserve the right to terminate or suspend Your Account.
Communications About Delinquent Accounts
You explicitly agree that all communication in relation to delinquent accounts or Fees due will be made by email or by phone. You agree that all notices, disclosures, and other communications that we provide to You electronically satisfy any legal requirement that such communications be in writing. Such communication may be made by Thumbtack or by anyone on our behalf, including but not limited to a third-party collection agent. By providing an email address and phone number, You consent to receive communications, including debt collection communications, at those contact points. You represent that You are the subscriber or customary user of any phone number You provide. Thumbtack and its collection agents will comply with all applicable federal and state debt collection laws, and applicable state equivalents, in connection with any collection activity.
Effect of Account Cancellation
If Your Account is canceled by You or Thumbtack, any Promotion credits will be forfeited and will no longer be available for use or redemption, except where prohibited by applicable law. Such Promotional credits are issued without payment by You, are not deposits or stored value, and have no cash value. Any credits from a Prepaid Package or other amounts purchased or paid for by You will be handled in accordance with applicable law and any applicable terms.
Nothing in these Terms limits any rights You may have under applicable law with respect to redemption, refund, or payment of funds owed to You. Thumbtack may withhold, offset, or decline to pay amounts only to the extent permitted by these Terms and applicable law. If You have a balance due on Your Account, You agree that Thumbtack may charge such unpaid Fees to Your default payment method, or, if that payment method fails, any back-up payment method saved to Your Account, or otherwise bill You for such unpaid Fees.
Taxes
Payments under these Terms do not include applicable taxes, duties, or assessments (collectively, “Taxes”) unless required by law to be included. If we are required to collect or remit any Taxes in connection with the Pro Services, You will be responsible for and bear those Taxes and agree to pay all such amounts invoiced to You. You hereby confirm that Thumbtack can determine Your appropriate jurisdiction for tax purposes however it deems appropriate or as required by law, and You agree to pay taxes to Thumbtack when Thumbtack includes taxes on any invoice. You understand and agree that You are solely responsible for determining Your own tax reporting, filing, and payment obligations, in consultation with Your own tax advisers, and that we cannot and do not offer specific tax advice to either Service Professionals or Consumers.
Frequently Asked Questions
What happens to my Budget if my Budget Period length changes and I don't manually adjust it?
If You do not manually adjust Your Budget after a Budget Period length change, Thumbtack will automatically pro-rate Your then-current Budget to match the length of the new period. For example, if You indicate You are willing to spend $100 for a one-week Budget Period, the Budget Period shifts to two weeks, and You do not make changes manually, Your Budget will automatically be adjusted to $200 for the two-week Budget Period.

Marketplace Payments Terms
[Image: Pill Customer]

Last Updated: June 30, 2026
These Marketplace Payments Terms outline the rules and guidelines for processing payments on Thumbtack. Please review these terms carefully to understand your rights and responsibilities.
Marketplace Payments Terms
Thumbtack’s Terms of Use and Privacy Policy apply fully and completely to these Terms. Undefined capitalized terms used herein shall have the definitions as set forth in our Terms of Use.
By agreeing to the Terms of Use or continuing to operate as a Service Professional, You hereby appoint Thumbtack to act as Your agent for the limited purpose of facilitating receipt of Marketplace Payments on Your behalf. Subject to any rights relating to applicable Payment Disputes, a payment made by a payor User through the Platform is deemed received by the payee User when received by Thumbtack or its payment processor, and payor User’s payment obligation to payee User is satisfied at that time. Consumer contracts directly with the Service Professional for the applicable Pro Services. Thumbtack does not provide, sell, offer, perform, or subcontract any Pro Services, and Thumbtack is not responsible or liable for any Pro Services, except as expressly stated in a separate agreement to which Thumbtack is a direct party or as otherwise expressly set forth in the Thumbtack Guarantee. Use of Marketplace Payments is subject to our Budget, Fees, Payments and Taxes Supplemental Terms, including any applicable terms of our third-party payment processing partner.
Stripe Connected Account Agreement
Service Professionals who receive Marketplace Payments from Consumers on Thumbtack via Stripe must agree to the Stripe Connected Account Agreement, which includes the Stripe Services Agreement (collectively, “Stripe Agreement”). Service Professionals will need a Social Security Number or Employer Identification Number in order to receive Marketplace Payments. As a Service Professional, by agreeing to these Terms or continuing to operate as a Service Professional on Thumbtack, You agree to be bound by the Stripe Agreement, as may be modified by Stripe from time to time.
As a condition of receiving payment processing services through Stripe, you agree to provide Thumbtack with accurate and complete information about You and Your business, and You hereby authorize and direct Thumbtack to disclose this information and transaction information related to Your use of the payment processing services provided by Stripe, to Stripe.
Service Professionals also agree that Thumbtack may debit their Stripe account in connection with disputes with Consumers. Thumbtack reserves the right to process such debits and to withhold final payments until Thumbtack has investigated disputes. Thumbtack may make a final decision on disputes in their sole and absolute discretion and, as a Service Professional, You understand that all Marketplace Payments You may earn on the Platform are subject to such decisions. Additionally, Service Professionals agree that Thumbtack may reverse payments that have been made to a Service Professional’s Stripe account when a customer refund or guarantee payout is warranted, including in connection with such Service Professional’s actions or inactions that are prohibited by these Terms.
Consumer Payment Obligations
As a Consumer making a Marketplace Payment through Stripe, You agree to pay all amounts You owe when due using Your preferred payment method. You further authorize Stripe to charge Your preferred payment method for amounts You owe when they are due. You must keep all payment information You provide us up-to-date, accurate and complete. When You store a payment method with us, You agree to our Stored Payment Terms and Conditions. Do not share your payment card, bank account or other financial information with any other User. We take reasonable and appropriate steps designed to secure all payment methods and other personal financial information, but we expressly disclaim any liability to you, and you agree to hold us harmless for any damages you may suffer as a result of the disclosure of your personal financial information to any unintended recipients. Thumbtack may enable You to make Marketplace Payments using credit, debit, or prepaid cards, by linking Your bank account, or by any other payment method we support. We reserve the right to cancel Your ability to make payments with one or more of the payment methods You have authorized in our sole and absolute discretion.
ACH and Bank Account Withdrawals
If You choose Your bank account as Your Marketplace Payment method, You authorize Stripe to make Automated Clearing House (“ACH”) withdrawals from Your bank account, and to make any inquiries we consider necessary to validate any dispute involving payments You make to us or to a User, which may include ordering a credit report and performing other credit checks or verifying the information You provide us against third-party databases.
You authorize Thumbtack or our third-party provider to initiate one or more ACH debit entries (withdrawals) or the creation of an equivalent bank draft for the specified amount(s) from Your bank account, and You authorize the financial institution that holds Your bank account to deduct such payments. You also authorize the bank that holds Your bank account to deduct any such payments in the amounts and frequency designated in Your Account. Your authorization will remain in effect until canceled in writing by you. You agree to notify us of any changes to Your account information or termination of Your authorization at least five days prior to Your next payment.
If Your full payment is not processed by us at the same time, You hereby authorize partial debits from Your bank account, not to exceed the total amount of Your order. You agree to pay any ACH fees or fines You or we incur associated with transactions You authorize. This return fee will vary based on which state You are located in. The return fee may be added to Your payment amount and debited from Your bank account if we resubmit an ACH debit due to insufficient funds. We may initiate a collection process or legal action to collect any money owed to us. You agree to pay all our costs for such action, including any reasonable attorneys' fees.
Federal law limits Your liability for any fraudulent, erroneous, or unauthorized transactions from Your bank account based on how quickly You report it to Your financial institution. You must report any fraudulent, erroneous or unauthorized transactions to Your bank no more than 60 days after the disputed transaction appeared on your bank account statement. Please contact your bank for more information about the policies and procedures that apply to unauthorized transactions and the limits on Your liability.
Marketplace Payment Disputes
All requests for Marketplace Payment chargebacks, errors, claims, refunds and disputes (“Payment Disputes”) will be subject to review by Thumbtack in accordance with the rules applicable to the payment method You used to make the Marketplace Payment and will be in Thumbtack’s absolute discretion. Thumbtack is not liable to You under any circumstances for Payment Disputes we are unable to resolve in Your favor. We will process a valid written Payment Dispute request within 30 days after we receive it, unless a shorter period is required by law. You may file a Payment Dispute by emailing it to Thumbtack support at support@thumbtack.com.
If You close or deactivate Your Account before we adjudicate Your Payment Dispute, we will not be able to issue You any amounts You are owed. We will attempt to pay You any Payment Disputed amounts You are owed using the method with which You made the disputed payment, but we cannot guarantee that we will be able to do so if Your payment method information is inaccurate, incomplete, or has been canceled. Thumbtack’s Payment Disputes resolution process does not limit Your right to file a complaint with Your card issuer or bank, or seek relief through applicable consumer protection agencies.
Withholding, Offsets, and Collections
If Your actions result in, or are likely to result in, a Payment Dispute, a violation of these Terms or the creation of other risks to Thumbtack or our third-party payment processing partners, or if we determine that Your Account has been used to engage in deceptive, fraudulent, or illegal activity, then we may, to the extent legally permitted, withhold any amounts owed to You in our sole and absolute discretion.
If You have a past due balance due on any Account, or for any additional amounts that we determine You owe us, we may, without limiting any other rights or remedies:
(a) charge one or more of Your payment methods;
(b) offset any amounts You owe us against amounts You may be owed;
(c) invoice You for amounts due to us, which such amounts will be due upon receipt;
(d) reverse or block any credits to Your bank account;
or (e) collect payment from You by any other lawful means.
If You fail to make Marketplace Payments You owe when due, or if Thumbtack is unable to charge one of Your payment methods for any reason, Thumbtack reserves all rights permissible under law to recover payment and all costs and expenses incurred, including reasonable attorneys' fees and related costs, in our pursuit of payment. You explicitly agree that all communication in relation to delinquent accounts or overdue payments will be made by electronic mail or by phone. Such communication may be made by Thumbtack or by anyone on our behalf, including but not limited to a third-party collections agent. Thumbtack may, from time to time, place a hold on any of Your payment methods in order to prevent failed payments or in order to reverse a booking or other purchase.

articles.fullText:
How to import reviews to my Thumbtack profile
[Image: Pill Pro]
Reviews help customers decide who to hire. If you already have reviews on Google or other sites, you can import them to your Thumbtack profile so customers can see your track record right away.
Tip
You can also get reviews by asking Thumbtack customers for a review or by sending your review link to past customers. Learn more.
Import reviews from Google
We display up to 100 of the most recent reviews from your Google Business Profile. And, once imported, they can’t be individually edited or deleted (unless a review violates the Content and Review Policy). But you can do a refresh in order to show your most current Google reviews — we'll get into that later.
Here’s how to import your Google reviews:
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Profile (from the main menu below).
Scroll to the "Reviews" section.
Tap Get reviews.
Tap Import from Google.
Follow the prompts and log in to Google.
Choose the page you want to import reviews from.
Preview the reviews you're adding, then tap Add reviews.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Click Profile (in the main menu).
Click Reviews from the drop-down menu.
Click Ask for reviews.
Choose Add reviews from Google.
Follow the prompts and log in to Google.
Choose the page you want to import reviews from.
Preview the reviews you're adding, then click Add reviews.
Tip
We only import (and update) Google reviews that have the reviewer’s name, the date, rating, and review text.
Import review ratings from other sites
If you’ve already built an online reputation with other public reviews, you can also import your average star rating from those sites.
Imported reviews count toward your overall star rating and can't be removed.
To import your star rating, follow these steps from the Android app (not currently available on the iOS app) or a desktop browser:
Android app
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Profile (from the main menu below).
Scroll to the "Reviews" section.
Tap Get reviews.
Tap Import from other sites.
Select the business that matches your information. If your business isn't listed, tap My business isn't shown here to enter your details manually.
Preview the review rating you're adding, then tap Add rating.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Click Profile (in the main menu above).
Scroll to the “Reviews” section.
Click Import reviews from other sites.
Select the business that matches your information. If your business isn't listed, click My business isn't shown here to enter your details manually.
Preview the reviews you're adding, then click Add rating.
Tip
Only the star rating from imported reviews shows up on your profile — the written text won’t be included.
Update to your most recent Google reviews
If it’s been a while since you imported your reviews, you may want to refresh your import so your more recent reviews appear on Thumbtack. When you refresh your reviews, we remove the last import and replace it with up to 100 of your most recent Google reviews.
Here’s how to update your Google reviews:
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Profile (from the main menu below).
Scroll to the "Reviews" section.
Tap Get reviews.
Next to “Update Google Reviews,” tap Update.
Sign in to your Google account.
Preview the reviews you're adding, then confirm the update.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Click your profile photo in the top right corner.
Click Reviews from the drop-down menu.
Click Ask for reviews.
Next to “Update Google Reviews,” click Update.
Sign in to your Google account.
Preview the reviews you're adding, then confirm the update.
Frequently asked questions
Will I be able to pick which Google reviews I want to add to my Thumbtack profile?
Since we automatically display the 100 most recent reviews from your Google Business Profile, you won’t be able to pick which reviews you want to import. And we only import (and update) Google reviews that have the reviewer’s name, the date, rating, and review text.
Can I choose which site my star rating is imported from? 
No, your imported star rating is meant to reflect your reviews from across the internet. We only pull from reputable sites where your business is listed. You can always preview the rating before adding it.
How is my star rating calculated? 
Your star rating is the average of the reviews and ratings on your profile. It’s calculated using:
Verified reviews you’ve received on Thumbtack.
Google reviews you’ve imported.
Imported ratings from other sites.
Your 10 most recent unverified reviews from customers you met outside of Thumbtack.
Why wasn’t a star rating found for my business? 
We couldn’t find any public reviews for your business online. You can still build your reputation by importing Google reviews or asking for reviews.
Can I update reviews from a different Google account?
Yes, you can update reviews from a different Google account — as long as it’s not already associated with another Thumbtack profile. Each Google account can only be connected to one Thumbtack profile at a time.

How to find a pro on Thumbtack 
[Image: Pill Customer]
Have a project on your to-do list? You’ve come to the right place! In the last year alone, Thumbtack has helped millions of customers nationwide find the right professionals for their home projects.
Steps to find a pro on Thumbtack
To start, we’ll ask you a few questions about your project. Add as many details as possible to help pros understand what you need so you can find the best pro for your project. We’ll also ask you for your phone number — your number is only shared with pros who you’ve decided to contact directly.
Follow these steps to find a pro in your area:
App
Open the Thumbtack app.
Tap into the “How can we help?” text box on the Home tab.
Describe your project. You can type, tap Use voice, or Add a photo.
Tap the arrow.
Answer a few quick questions, tapping Next between each one.
Confirm or edit your zip code.
Review your project details and tap Looks good.
Tap any pro to view their full profile.
Contact the pros you like.
Some answers may already be filled in based on what you shared — just confirm or change them. If you don’t know an answer, choose Not sure or Skip for now.
Desktop 
Go to the Thumbtack homepage.
Describe your project in the search bar.
Confirm or edit your zip code.
Click Find a pro.
Confirm the service that matches your project.
Answer a few questions about your project.
Use the filters to narrow your results.
Click any pro you’re interested in to view their full profile.
Contact the pros you like.
Customers can only contact up to five pros in the first four hours of their search. We want to make sure you find the right pro, so if it doesn’t work out with those pros in those first four hours, you can contact more pros afterward.
Tip
Need help staying on top of your to-do list? Create your home profile to get a personalized plan for your home. With your plan and our recommended guides, you’ll keep your home running smoothly throughout the year.
How Thumbtack chooses the pros you see
Pros let us know which types of jobs they want by setting up their account preferences. We compare your project details with each pro’s preferences and experience, then show you the pros who fit best. To see why a pro is a match, tap Learn how we matched you.
Three things for you to keep in mind:
We may feature your three best matches at the top of your results. Tap Get 3 quotes to contact all three at once, or scroll down and select View all matches to see the full list.
The order that pros appear in your search results is based on a couple of other factors, such as how well a pro matches your project details, their review rating, how quickly they respond to customers, and how engaging their profile is.
Other pros who are interested in your project may message you about your project too. This way, you have plenty of options. These other pros won’t see your phone number unless you decide to respond back to them. Only respond if you want to.
Tip
For eligible services, Thumbtack can match you with a pro at a set price and schedule the work for you with an On-Demand booking.
Comparing pros for your project
Here are a few things to keep in mind as you’re browsing pro’s profiles and deciding on the right pro for your project.
Reviews: Take a look at their review rating and read through some of their recent reviews. This is a great way to understand what type of experiences customers have had with this pro.
Photos: This is a great way for you to see examples of a pro’s work quality. Before-and-after photos are especially helpful in seeing the transformation of a finished project.
Credentials: For pros who’ve verified their license with us, you’ll see their license information in this section of their profile. We’ll also show you any background check details here. Select See more details to learn more, like their license number and who holds it. You can also ask the pro about their credentials when you message them.
Other details: Pros can give you more insight into their business using their introduction, overview, and FAQs on their profile. Also, you can check if the pro has a Top Pro badge.
Tip
If you have other specific project details that we didn’t ask about, check the pro's profile. Pros often explain more about what they specialize in — and what they don't do — to help you find the best match.
[Image: Pro Comparison]
Managing your projects
Here's how to manage your projects on Thumbtack:
Plan: View your planned, in progress, and completed projects. This is where you can plan your next home project and find the right pro to help.
Inbox: Your new and old conversations. Check here first for replies from pros or to send a new message.
Team: We’ll add pros you've contacted to the Past pros tab. And you can favorite pros to add them to Your team — your trusted group of pros you can rely on.
Tip
Looking for recommendations or tips for your home? Check out the Home tab of the Thumbtack app for all the information you need to get started.
Thumbtack is the all-in-one app to care for your home with ease.
[Button: Get the app]
Frequently asked questions
What can I do if there are no pros who match my project?
It’s rare, but there may not always be a pro who matches all of your project details perfectly. When this happens, we’ll show you a few other pros to consider. We’ll let you know what part of your project falls outside the scope of what these other pros offer — just in case you have flexibility with your project and would like to contact them.
How can I get the contact information for a specific pro?
On Thumbtack, a pro’s contact information is only provided after you’ve reached out to them directly and connected with the pro.
If you came to Thumbtack looking for a specific pro but you don’t see them in your search results, then it's possible that the pro is currently taking a break from Thumbtack or their job preferences don't match up with your project details.
Does it cost me anything to use Thumbtack?
Using Thumbtack to find, contact, and hire a pro is free. You only pay the pro directly for any services rendered.
I chose the date for when I needed a pro, but it says they’re no longer available?
When this happens, it’s most likely that this pro has those dates blocked off on their calendar. This means they indicated that they aren’t able to accept any jobs for those dates.
If you are flexible with your dates, you can try other dates that still work for you. Otherwise, you’ll want to reach out to a different pro who will be available for your dates.

articles.fullText:
How to manage my business license
[Image: Pill Pro]
Showcase your professional license on your profile to help customers feel confident hiring you.
Add a license to your profile
Follow these steps to add (or update) a license to your profile.
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Profile (from the main menu below).
Scroll down to your “Credentials,” and tap the option to add or update your license.
Select the state and the exact or closest license type in the list. For the license number field, type in the exact license number only.
Tap Submit.
Desktop 
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Profile.
Scroll down to your “Credentials,” and tap the option to add or update your license.
Select the state and the exact or closest license type in the list. For the license number field, type in the exact license number only.
Click Submit.
We’ll send you an email with the results of your license verification request. The process of verifying your license usually takes 1 - 2 business days. If your license is verified, it’ll show up as "Verified" in the Credentials section of your profile.
Keep in mind, submitting your license for verification multiple times before it has been reviewed may result in processing delays. Also, database maintenance may delay results in some cases.
Licenses we verify
We verify many licenses, but requirements change depending on your location. To see exactly what we approve in your area, check the list when you add a license to your profile.
Here are some examples of which licenses we may verify:
Accounting or tax professions
Architecture
Attorney
Carpentry
Concrete and foundation work
Drywall
Electrical work
Engineers
Financial professions
Flooring and carpet
General contracting
Home improvement and home building
HVAC work
Insulation
Landscaping
Masonry
Metalworking
Moving
Painting
Paving
Pest control applicators
Plumbing
Pool and spa
Roofing
Tiling
All licenses must be government-issued and searchable on the state licensing board’s public databases (which is what allows us to verify your information). If your license type isn’t listed when you try to add it to your profile, we’re unable to verify it for pros in your state.
License rules and regulations vary from state to state. We recommend researching what your state or city requires to comply with local laws. We’re not responsible for any issues arising from working without a required license.
Pro Tip
If you have a license or certification we can’t verify, you can still let customers know about it. Upload a photo of the license to your profile, or mention it somewhere on your profile or in your messages with the customer.
Have a new license or need to update an old one?
[Button: Verify your license]
Frequently asked questions
What if my name or business name on Thumbtack doesn’t match my license?
If the name or business name you listed on Thumbtack doesn’t match what’s on your license or you’re authorized to work under someone else’s license, fill out this form to update your Thumbtack account details.
Keep in mind, your license will take longer to process since we’ll need additional documents. We’ll follow up with you within 2 - 3 business days.
What if I have more than one license?
A maximum of two licenses will be displayed on your profile, so we recommend uploading the two most relevant to your services. However, you can mention the other licenses in your business introduction or in your messages to customers.
Why can’t I see my business license on my profile?
We don’t list business licenses on profiles because they don’t indicate specific skills or knowledge. However, we do share how long you’ve been in business to help customers get a better sense of your experience.
What happens when my license expires?
We’ll send you an email reminder when your license is about to expire. When your license expires, your license will be deleted from your profile on the expiration date, and we will attempt to re-verify it once. If we can re-verify it, then we’ll add your license to your profile again with the updated verification date.
If your license doesn’t have an expiration date, we’ll email you every two years to renew your license information. You can renew your license information by following the steps above.

articles.fullText:
Your guide to your first two weeks on Thumbtack
[Image: Pill Pro]
[Image: Neighborly Pro Banner]
Welcome to Thumbtack! In this guide, you’ll learn all about how Thumbtack works, hear our best tips, and see them in action through videos and activities.
You’ll learn all about:
How Thumbtack works
Attracting the types of jobs you want
Managing your leads
Managing your money
Responding to your first lead
Ready to dig in? If you don’t have time to do it all today — no sweat! Bookmark this guide on your web browser to make it easier to come back to.
Let’s get started.
SECTION 1
How Thumbtack works
Customers come to Thumbtack every day looking for pros to help them complete their jobs. Pros like you!
In this video, you’ll learn the basics of Thumbtack and how to get your business in front of the right customers.
[Video: Get to know Thumbtack (2:52)]
The rest of this guide will walk you through what to do in your first two weeks on Thumbtack. And we’ll share tips and resources to support you along the way.
SECTION 2
Attracting the types of jobs you want
Getting the right leads can mean a lot of different things. Firstly, do you know what your target market is? Think about what your ideal jobs are — the kind of jobs you really want. Who are those customers?
Then, learn how you can attract those customers to your Thumbtack profile.
Identify your target market
What kind of jobs would be best for your business right now? We’ve listed some questions to help you think through your target market and get your business goals down on paper.
After you decide which jobs you want on Thumbtack, you’ll use your job preferences to let us know which customers you want to be shown to.
With job preferences, you tell us:
The kind of jobs you always want.
Where you work.
Your availability.
Anytime you add a new service, we’ll walk you through setting your job preferences for it. You can always adjust your job preferences in your Services: select the service you want to check on, then scroll down and select travel areas, job types, or availability. All of these preferences create a complete picture and directly impact getting the best leads for your business.
When you get a lead matching your job preferences, you’ll be automatically charged (more about this in the next section).
Attract your ideal customers
Now that your preferences are set, how will you draw your ideal customer in? Answer: your profile.
Your profile is how you show customers you’re the best pro for their job. Build an engaging profile and let customers know all about your business. Think about how you talk about your services and how your photos look from a customer’s perspective — what would those customers want to see or read?
Get reviews Before a customer decides to hire you, they want to know what it’s like to work with you. That’s where reviews come in.
Since you’re new to Thumbtack you can get up to 10 reviews from any past customers by sharing your review link. Once Thumbtack customers start hiring you, they can leave you verified reviews. There’s no limit to how many verified reviews you can get.
Or get a head start by adding up to 100 reviews on your Thumbtack profile by importing them over from your Google Business Profile. Learn more about adding Google reviews.
Upload photos Think about the jobs you want and add photos of those types of jobs to your profile. Be sure to write helpful captions for each photo. If a customer sees a photo on your profile similar to what they’re looking to get done, they’ll know they can trust you to do their job. And get creative. Who doesn’t love a before-and-after photo?
[Interactive: Profile Walkthrough Activity — https://xd.adobe.com/embed/2d3cf6df-c9b4-4891-9d9a-dcc8707ec79b-786f/?hints=off]
[Interactive: Attracting the types of jobs - Checklist - Section 2 — https://xd.adobe.com/embed/ce0c821b-3625-4d36-8348-6fa01bfb8062-9b5f/?hints=off]
SECTION 3
Managing your leads
Let’s dive into the reason you’re on Thumbtack right now — jobs.
Customers come to Thumbtack with work to be done. They answer a few questions and then browse pros in their area. If a customer is interested in learning more about you or hiring you right away, they’ll reach out.
Here are the ways you can connect with customers on Thumbtack:
Leads
What are they?
Leads are customers who saw your profile in their search results and reached out to you. These leads match your job preferences. Most of these leads match your job preferences, but with smart matching, you may also get leads outside your usual preferences when our AI predicts they're a strong fit for your business.
Pricing and payments
Whether they match your preferences or come from Smart Match, you pay for these leads automatically. Prices will vary since a job's value can change based on things like the type and size of the job, how many pros are available, and your market. You choose exactly how much you pay for leads by setting your lead prices. We’ll cover lead prices in the next section.
Preset jobs
What are they?
Preset jobs are ready to go — they match your preferences, and the customer already scheduled the date and time. All you need to do is claim it.
These jobs are available to pros who offer specific service types and meet certain criteria (like having 3 or more reviews). You’ll find them in the For you tab on your Jobs page, where you can browse the details and claim the jobs that are a good fit for you.
Pricing and payments
Thumbtack takes a percentage of the customer's payment, rather than having you pay for the lead upfront. You'll be able to see how much you'll earn for the job before you claim it.
Once you let us know you've completed the job (and set up direct deposit), you’ll get paid. It can take 3-4 business days to show up in your bank account (or, for a 1% fee, earnings can be deposited instantly).
Opportunities
What are they?
Opportunities are customers who haven’t hired a pro yet — they’re still looking for quotes.
You can reach out to these customers to let them know you’re interested in their job, and they can hire you if they think you’re a good fit.
Opportunities are a great way to fill gaps in your schedule. They can be found in the Opportunities tab of your Jobs page.
Pricing and payments
Opportunities have separate pricing from other leads. You’ll see the cost of the Opportunity upfront, and you’re only charged if you decide to reach out and the customer responds to your message.
Take a look at the interactive tool below to see the different leads and get a better understanding of where you’ll find them on your account.
[Interactive: Leads Tour Activity [New pro asset] — https://xd.adobe.com/embed/2cbc659c-e604-4e31-bbc8-4716be03ec01-79ef/?hints=off]
Pro tip
When you first sign up, you can purchase a credit package to get started. When you purchase a package, you get extra credit on your account for free to use on future leads.
SECTION 4
Managing your money
In this section, we'll talk about what you pay for on Thumbtack and how to manage your money. To keep track of your spending and stay within your goals, you’ll set lead prices, and a weekly budget, and then preload your account balance.
Lead prices
You choose how much you pay for each lead by setting your lead prices. If a lead matching your job preferences comes in, your lead price is the exact amount you spend on that lead. This makes your costs predictable, so you always know your expenses upfront.
As you adjust your lead prices, we’ll show you an estimate of how many leads you can expect. The higher your price, the more likely you'll get leads. We recommend setting higher prices for the leads that are most important to you. This tells us to prioritize those leads for your business.
Budget
Based on your lead price, we’ll recommend a budget. Your budget is a weekly spending limit for leads. It controls how much you can spend in a week. Whenever you get a lead, the cost of that lead counts toward your budget. Once you reach your budget for the week, you’ll stop receiving new leads until your budget resets the following Monday.
Pro tip
If you reach your budget amount for the week but want more leads, you can increase your budget amount. Or you can look into Opportunities since these don’t count toward your budget.
Account balance
Next, let’s talk about your account balance. Preloading your account balance is optional, but it makes payments simpler. As for leads, you'll pay for them using your balance until it runs out.
The amount you preload to your balance is up to you. You could deposit enough to get you through a month, or you could decide to refill your balance weekly — whatever makes the most sense for you.
If you leave auto-refill turned on, your account balance is automatically refilled whenever it runs out.
Tip
Your payment history will show a breakdown of all your charges. You’ll see the cost of each lead and any discounts that were applied.
[Interactive: Paid checklist — https://xd.adobe.com/embed/7753e7bb-32c5-4712-968c-8b6bee73d77e-2200/]
SECTION 5
Responding to your first lead
You’re all set up and ready to go, and you just received your first lead on Thumbtack. Now what? Let’s go over how responding thoughtfully (and quickly!) can help you make the most out of each message — and get your first of many hires.
Send a great message
How should you respond? Before jumping in, read through the customer’s job details and message to understand their unique needs. Then, follow these tips:
Personalize your message. For example, greet the customer by their name.
Provide them with helpful details about their specific job.
Mention your skills and credentials to show you’re qualified for the job.
Give the customer clear next steps so they know how to move forward with you.
Do a last-minute spell check and make sure your message covers everything you want to say before you send it off.
Respond quickly to new leads
Each minute counts. Try to respond or call as quickly as possible — you might catch the customer online and when they’re motivated to hire. But if you can’t get to it right away, aim to respond within an hour. You can always track your performance through our app.
Here’s why responsiveness matters:
You're more likely to hear back from customers.
It affects your rank in search results.
It helps you qualify for Gold and Platinum Pro Rewards.
Responding thoughtfully and quickly? Sounds like a tall order. Luckily we’ve got a few tools that can help:
Download our pro app to be notified of new leads while you’re on the go.
Create quick replies to make responding to customers faster and easier.
Let our Front Desk team manage your messages for you — so you can stay focused on the job at hand.
Follow up with customers
If you don’t hear back from a customer, try sending them a follow-up message to reconnect and move things forward. We recommend sending a follow-up message after about 24 - 48 hours.
[Interactive: Messaging Activity [New pro asset] — https://xd.adobe.com/embed/6cb39d34-ac1d-454d-a28b-53520fb40795-39e0/?hints=off]
[Interactive: Messaging - Checklist - Section 4 — https://xd.adobe.com/embed/23595f5e-9c6e-4d5d-8379-2201e973f3b5-760a/?hints=off]
IN CONCLUSION
One last note
Congrats! You’ve learned the basics of Thumbtack. And if you apply what you learned as you read, you’re set up and ready to start meeting new customers.
Over time, you’ll learn what works best for your business and what Thumbtack customers look for in a pro. So revisit your job preferences, tweak your messages, and change up your profile regularly.
As you get comfortable on Thumbtack, we’ll be here for you along the way. Check out Thumbtack Help any time you have a question or want to learn more.
Eager to keep learning? Don’t stop here, check out these resources.
Build your brand: In this course, learn the basics of building your brand for online audiences.
Get ready to grow: Learn how the tools on Thumbtack can help you grow and expand your business.
Connect with the Thumbtack Community: Built by pros for pros, it’s a place to network, share resources, and exchange ideas and advice.
