articles.fullText:
How Lowe's jobs work
[Image: Pill Pro]
Thumbtack and Lowe’s have teamed up to connect customers with local pros who can complete their home projects. When a customer buys a product at Lowe's — like a sink, toilet, fan, or light fixture — they can book a qualified pro like you to install it during checkout. With no lead fees, these preset jobs are a guaranteed way to connect with new customers and grow your business.
Benefits
These jobs are a great way to keep your schedule full and get more work on Thumbtack.
No bidding and no lead fees: Lowe’s customers have already bought their product and requested installation. You just have to claim the job and it’s yours.
Steady stream of installation jobs: Access Lowe’s installation jobs to help keep your schedule full and your business growing.
Guaranteed, transparent earnings: Know exactly what you’ll make before you accept the job, with payouts ranging from $50 – $500 depending on the job details. Job pricing may not include additional paid add-ons.
Flexible schedule: You only claim the jobs that fit your existing schedule. There’s no pressure to accept a job if it doesn’t fit.
How to become eligible
Before you claim your first Lowe's job, make sure you're ready:
Keep a four-star rating: To see and accept Lowe’s jobs, you need to keep a rating of four stars or higher.
Upload your business license: If your state or local area requires a license, upload it to Thumbtack to be eligible for these jobs.
Set up direct deposit: You don't need direct deposit to claim jobs, but you need to set it up to get paid once the work is done.
How it works
Ready to grow your business with Lowe's jobs? Keep reading to see how these jobs work.
1. Claim a Lowe's job
Check for available Lowe’s jobs in the For you tab (under "Preset jobs") to claim them directly. We might also call you when a job is open. When claiming a job, you’ll agree to our cancellation, no-show, and background check policies, and sign the Lowe’s contract.
2. Prepare for the job
Add background check details: Provide background check details for the team members who will be on site. While you don't need to do this to claim a job, you need to do it to get paid.
Coordinate with the customer: Once you claim a job, reach out to make sure their Lowe's product has arrived. Let them know when you'll arrive within the three-hour window, and confirm the job details before you start.
Pick up products from Lowe’s (if needed): Some jobs will require you to pick up the product being installed (toilets, for example) ahead of the job. Details of the pick-up will be included in your confirmation email. For more information, check out the “Picking up products from Lowe's” section below.
Tip
Turn on your app notifications for new jobs and messages. It’s the fastest way to hear about — and be the first pro to claim — new jobs.
3. Complete the work and get paid
Follow these steps to complete the job and receive your earnings:
Complete the installation: Perform the work according to the job details. Make sure you (and anyone else on your team) have their government-issued ID on site. You’re responsible for hauling away the old item (like a toilet or light) if the customer asks. Separate dump fees apply and vary by county.
Mark the job complete: Update the job status in Thumbtack as soon as the installation is complete. This lets us know the work is done so we can process your earnings. Once you meet all payout requirements, your earnings will arrive via direct deposit within 4 – 5 business days.
All pros are expected to follow Lowe's Vendor Code of Conduct and Thumbtack and Lowe’s Data Privacy Policy to maintain a high standard of service and ethics. For more details on maintaining professional standards during these jobs, review the Lowe’s PROvider Reference Guide.
Tip
Never miss a job. Turn on New preset jobs and Preset job reminders in your notification settings to get alerts.
Picking up products from Lowe's
For some jobs, like toilet installations, you’ll be required to pick up the product from a Lowe’s store before heading to the customer’s home. Your payout fee already includes the pick-up from Lowe's. Follow these steps for a smooth pickup:
Call ahead: Call the store 30 minutes before you arrive to make sure the product is ready.
Head to Lowe’s: If you’re arriving between 7am and 4pm (Monday – Friday), go straight to Receiving. Outside of those hours, go to the Customer Service desk instead.
Check-in: A manager or clerk will help you. Have your photo ID and your job confirmation email ready.
Inspect the product: Carefully check that you have the right item and that it isn’t damaged. If the product is damaged: Take photos of the damage and let a Lowe’s associate know right away or call Lowe’s Support at (888) 516-1010.
Sign and save: Sign the loading ticket and take a copy for your records.
Tip
You must pick up and install the product on the same day. Plan your schedule to ensure you have enough time to complete both.
Handling additional work or fees
These jobs have a pre-set price based on the project details provided. If you find that a job requires extra labor or materials once you’re on-site:
Get approval: If you need extra labor or materials for the job you’re currently working on, you’ll need to have the order updated. Call Lowe’s at (888) 516-1010 to get approval and add those services to the project so your earnings can be adjusted. Don't start the extra work until you receive confirmation from Lowe's.
Unrelated work: If a customer asks for a repair that isn't part of the original installation (like a new upgrade or a different repair), you don't need to go through an approval process. These separate jobs are handled entirely by you, so you can manage the details and payment directly with the customer.
Cancellations and fees
Because these are scheduled bookings, there are specific rules for cancellations:
Cancellations: If you cancel within 48 hours of the job start time, you’ll be charged $15.
No-shows: If you don’t show up for a job you claimed, you’ll be charged $15.
Customer no-shows: If you arrive and the customer isn't home, wait for at least 15 minutes. If they still don't show, contact us at (628) 266-0562. The job will be canceled, and you'll receive a courtesy credit of $15.
Tip
You can’t reschedule Lowe’s jobs. Only customers can reschedule them. If you need to change the time, message the customer and ask them to update the job.
Get support
Still have questions? We’re here to help. Depending on what you need, you can reach out to Thumbtack or Lowe’s directly:
For questions about a specific job: Call Thumbtack Support at (628) 266-0562.
For issues with installation pricing or the product itself: Contact Lowe’s Support at (888) 516-1010.

articles.concepts: home installation, booking management, reschedule service, cancel service, retail partnership, customer support
articles.fullText:
Lowe's installation through Thumbtack
[Image: Pill Customer]
Thumbtack and Lowe’s have teamed up to help you finish your home projects faster. When you buy certain items online or in-store — like sinks, toilets, fans, and light fixtures — you can add professional installation right at checkout. Thumbtack then matches you with a highly-rated, licensed pro to complete the job.
Here’s what to expect
From checkout to completion, here's what you can expect during your installation journey:
Purchase your installation: Add the installation service to your order when you checkout at Lowe’s.
Receive your scheduling link: Look for an email from Thumbtack with a link to share your scheduling preference and accept Thumbtack’s Terms of Use.
Get matched with a pro: We’ll find a pro for your project and send you an email with their details once they're confirmed (at least 24 hours before your job).
Tip
We already created your Thumbtack account using the email you shared with Lowe's. Check your inbox for a password link from us, or sign in with your email to set your password. Once logged in, you can track your project details and message your pro.
How to reschedule or cancel
Have a change of plans? Here’s how you can reschedule or cancel your installation:
Reschedule: You can reschedule the job through confirmation emails we sent you or through your Thumbtack account.
Cancel: Lowe’s collects all payments from and refunds to customers for these services. If you need to cancel your installation or request a refund, please call Lowe’s Support at (888) 516-1010.
What’s included in your installation
It’s important to know what your service covers to ensure your project goes smoothly:
Specific products: Your service only includes the installation of the specific item you purchased through Lowe’s.
Additional project requirements: If your installation requires additional fees or work to be completed, your pro will notify Lowe's. Lowe’s will then reach out to you to confirm the additional work and any updated costs before they are added to your order. This will happen on site with you.
Tip
Lowe’s will handle payments for any add-ons related to the job — please don’t pay the pro directly for these add-ons. But if you ask the pro for any extra work that is not directly related to the installation purchase from Lowe's, you’re responsible for working with the pro to pay them the amount requested.
Get support
Still have questions? We’re here to help. Depending on what you need, you can reach out to Thumbtack or Lowe’s directly:
For questions about your pro or the Thumbtack app: Call Thumbtack Support at (628) 266-0562.
For questions about your product or payment: Call Lowe’s Support at (888) 516-1010.

articles.fullText:
What are Smart Match leads?
With smart matching, we're helping you get more jobs. You may receive leads outside your usual preferences when our AI predicts they’re a strong fit for your business.
How it works
Smarter matching. We look beyond your checkboxes to find more jobs that are still a strong fit for you.
Easy refunds. If you get a lead for a job type you don’t do, decline it and tell us why. When you tell us why the job type wasn’t a fit, we’ll refund you.
Improves with your feedback. We use your feedback to improve future matches. The more you share, the better your leads will be.
No budget or pricing changes. Your weekly budget and max lead prices will stay the same.
How to request a refund
If you get a lead for a job you don’t do, don't worry. Let us know by declining the lead, telling us why it wasn’t a fit, and we’ll refund you.
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Jobs (from the main menu below).
Open the lead.
Select Decline.
Tap Yes, decline.
Select Not what I do and explain why.
Answer a few questions to help us understand the jobs you want.
Confirm the new preference is correct.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Jobs.
Open the lead.
Select Decline.
Click Yes, decline.
Select Not what I do and explain why.
Answer a few questions to help us understand the jobs you want.
Confirm the new preference is correct.
We’ll apply this feedback to your future leads and refund the one you just declined.
Tip
Be careful when declining a lead: selecting Not what I do impacts the types of leads you get in the future. If you still want those types of jobs in the future, select another reason that fits, like Location or Not available.
How to opt out
If you want to return to only receiving exact match leads, you can opt out any time from your Services page.
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Services (from the main menu below).
Tap the toggle next to Smart matching. Smart matches are on when the toggle is blue and off when the toggle is gray.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Services.
Tap the toggle next to Smart matching. Smart matches are on when the toggle is blue and off when the toggle is gray.
Frequently asked questions
Why am I getting charged for leads outside of my job preferences?
You’re receiving these leads because you’re part of our Smart Match program. To help you get more of the jobs you want, our AI looks beyond your job preferences to find customers that we believe are still a strong fit for your business.
You’re charged automatically for these smart match leads, but we’ve designed this program to be low-risk for you. If we get a match wrong, decline the lead and tell us why. We’ll refund you and use your feedback to find the right jobs for your business.
Can I still request a refund for a lead I didn’t decline?
Yes. If you’ve already accepted a lead, follow these steps to request a refund.

articles.fullText:
How to resolve issues with a pro
[Image: Pill Customer]
It's frustrating when a project doesn't go as planned, but most issues can be resolved quickly through clear communication and a willingness to find a solution.
Tips for resolving issues
If things aren't going as expected with a pro, keep the project on track and address any concerns with these tips:
Communicate clearly. Discuss your concerns openly and professionally. Often adjustments can still be made if you pause and take the time to talk it out.
Put it in writing. A contract or signed agreement sets clear expectations and removes confusion. Even if you didn’t start out with one, it’s not too late. Work together to come up with a plan and put it in writing.
Tip
You can find more ways to hire with confidence on our Safety page.
How to report a problem
We provide a free, online solution center where you can discuss concerns, expectations, and a preferred resolution in a neutral environment. Here’s how to get started:
If you have a Thumbtack account and experienced the issue on a recent project, fill out this form.
Use this form if you don’t have a Thumbtack account or if your issue isn’t related to a recent project. If you don’t have an account, enter your preferred email address instead in the field labeled “The email address on your Thumbtack account.”
If you'd prefer we don’t contact the pro about this issue, let us know in the form. We’ll review your report and follow up with you usually within 2–3 business days.
Feeling unsafe, threatened, or harassed
Your safety is our top priority. If you feel unsafe, threatened, or harassed, contact your local law enforcement first and then contact us. Please have any information about the situation on hand (emails, texts, police reports, etc.). Once we have all the details, we’ll investigate and take appropriate action.

articles.fullText:
How to find and reply to pro messages
[Image: Pill Customer]
When you're trying to get a project done, communication with your pro is key. This article will help you find your messages and make sure your replies are seen.
Where to find your messages
Depending on your project’s status, your messages might be in a few different spots.
Inbox: Your new and old conversations. Check here first for replies from pros or to send a new message.
Plan: Your planned, in progress, and completed projects. If a pro declines your request, that notification will appear here. Check here if you’re missing a reply you expected.
Team: This tab (only on the Thumbtack app) shows the pros you’ve worked with, making it easy to find and hire them again.
Tip
Turn on push notifications for the Thumbtack app. You’ll get an alert on your phone as soon as you have a new message and can reply right away.
Tips for replying to pros
Clear communication keeps your project moving forward. Remember these key tips when messaging pros:
Avoid a message mix-up: When a pro sends you a message, you'll receive an email notification. It's important that you don’t reply directly to the email. Instead, reply to the pro either directly through Thumbtack or an existing conversation thread you have with the pro.
Stay organized: If you’re already talking through text, continue the conversation there. It’s helpful to keep your conversation in one place so nothing gets lost.
Close the loop: Pros invest time and effort when you reach out to them. If you decide not to hire a pro or your project plans change, sending a quick update is an appreciated step. Letting them know you've gone a different route allows them to focus on other potential customers.
You can use this quick template if you've hired another pro or decided to cancel your project:
Example
Hey there, I've decided to go a different route. But thank you for reaching out and offering to help, I appreciate your time.
By communicating clearly, you can ensure a smooth process and get your home project done faster.
Ready to continue the conversation?
[Button: Go to my Inbox]

articles.fullText:
How to turn your job preferences on or off
[Image: Pill Pro]
Job preferences (also called “targeting”) cover everything from where you work, when you're available, the types of jobs you want, and your budget. These settings tell us which jobs you want and how you'd like to pay for leads. Set your preferences to start appearing in search results so the right customers can find you.
Tip
We’ll walk you through setting up job preferences whenever you add a new service. Once they’re set, use the steps below to pause or turn your preferences back on at any time.
Turn on your job preferences
Turning on your job preferences makes your business visible in search results so you can start getting leads. Since you pay for leads that match your preferences, double-check your job types, travel areas, availability, and other settings before you turn them on.
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Services (from the main menu below).
Choose a service.
If you haven’t finished your setup, tap Set up targeting. If you’re resuming after a pause, tap Turn on.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Services.
Choose a service.
If you haven’t finished your setup, click Set up targeting. If you’re resuming after a pause, select Turn on.
Pro Tip 
We remember your job preferences even if you take a break, so it’s easy to turn them back on when you’re ready.
Turn off your job preferences
Pause your preferences to stop receiving leads for a specific service at any time. If you just need a temporary break from new leads, consider hiding your business instead.
App 
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Services (from the main menu below).
Select the service you want to turn off.
Under "Job preferences," tap Pause.
Let us know why you're turning it off.
Tap Continue.
Tap Turn off.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Services.
Select the service you want to turn off.
Under "Job preferences," select Pause this service.
Let us know why you're turning it off.
Select Continue.
Click Turn off.

articles.fullText:
How to sign in to my account
[Image: Pill Customer]
[Image: Pill Pro]
Logging in to your account is the first step to getting things done, whether you’re a pro looking for your next lead or a customer starting a new project. Use the steps below to sign in to your Thumbtack account.
Sign in on the app
Whether you’re a pro or a customer, here’s how to sign in on the Thumbtack app:
App for customers
Open the Thumbtack app.
Tap the profile photo icon (in the top right corner).
Tap Sign up or log in.
Type your ten-digit phone number (including area code) for SMS-verified login. You can also log in with your email, Google, Apple (iOS only), or Facebook account.
Follow the prompts to log in.
App for pros
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Log in.
Log in with your email and password, or use an account like Google, Facebook, or Apple.
Follow the prompts to log in.
Tip
If you need help resetting your password, select Forgot password?
Tips for SMS-verified login
Keep these things in mind when signing in to the customer app with your phone number:
The verification code we’ll send you expires after 10 minutes.
If you haven’t received a code after 30 seconds, click Resend to receive another.
If you've clicked Resend more than once and it's still not working, take a 15-minute break and then try again.
If there are issues logging in with your phone number (if the number isn’t valid or there are multiple accounts with the phone number), you’ll be redirected to the login screen to try another option.
Sign in on the website
Whether you’re using a computer or your phone’s browser, here’s how to sign in:
Mobile
Open your mobile browser and go to www.thumbtack.com.
Tap the three-bar menu (at the top right).
Tap Log in. (If you’re redirected to the Thumbtack app instead, try opening the sign-in page in a new tab.)
Enter your email address and password. Or choose another log in method: Continue with magic link — Enter your email to get a login link.Continue with Facebook, Google, or Apple — Sign in with another account.
Follow the prompts to log in.
Desktop
Go to www.thumbtack.com.
Tap Log in (at the top right).
Enter your email address and password. Or choose another log in method: Continue with magic link — Enter your email to get a login link.Continue with Facebook, Google, or Apple — Sign in with another account.
Follow the prompts to log in.
Tip
Having trouble signing in to an account you closed? Learn how to reactivate your account.
Frequently asked questions
Why do I need a phone number to log into the customer app?
This helps us verify that the person logging in is a real person. It also lets us use the phone number as a secondary contact method.
What is a magic link?
A magic link allows you to log in without a password. It's a secure link we'll send to your email.
Magic links expire after 30 minutes. If yours expires, go to the login page to get a new one.
I tried logging into the customer app with my phone number, why didn't it work?
Some phone numbers aren’t eligible, often due to:
Geographic or mobile carrier issues.
The number isn’t valid.
Multiple accounts are using that phone number.
I have both a pro and a customer account, how do I switch between the two?
Here’s how to navigate between your customer and pro accounts on the app and desktop site:
App
We have two different apps — one for pros and one for customers. Open the app that matches what you need to do.
Thumbtack Pro app: Use this to manage your business, see your leads, and talk with customers. This app has a black Thumbtack logo.
Thumbtack app: Use this to find and hire pros for your own projects. This app has a blue Thumbtack logo.
Desktop
If you use the same email address for your accounts, you can seamlessly switch between them on our website.
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Select your profile photo (at the top right corner).
From the drop-down menu, select either Switch to business or Switch to customer.

articles.fullText:
How to set my lead prices
[Image: Pill Pro]
To make your costs more predictable, Thumbtack uses exact lead prices. This means the price you set for a lead is the exact amount you’ll pay.
You’re in control of your spending. You can choose how much you pay for each lead by setting your lead prices for every service you offer.
How it works
With exact lead prices, you get more transparency and consistency in your business:
Predictable costs: You'll always pay exactly the amount you set for a lead, unless a discount or promotion is applied.
Targeted spending: Set higher prices for the leads that are most important to you to be more competitive for those jobs.
Complete control: You can adjust your lead prices at any time to match your business needs.
Put your money where it matters most
Your lead prices tell us which jobs are your top priority. Setting a higher price for a specific service makes you more competitive for those leads.
For example, imagine an interior designer who also offers home staging. If they prefer interior design jobs because they pay better, they can set a higher lead price for that service. This tells Thumbtack to prioritize interior design leads for their business.
How to set your lead prices
As you adjust your lead prices, we’ll show you an estimate of how many leads you can expect to get for that service.
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Services (from the main menu below).
Tap Manage lead prices. (At least one service must have job preferences turned on to see this option.)
Move the slider to adjust your lead prices.
Save your changes.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to Services.
Click Manage lead prices. (At least one service must have job preferences turned on to see this option.)
Move the slider to adjust your lead prices.
Save your changes.
If you’re not seeing the right trends for your business, adjust your lead prices until you’re getting the right ratio of leads across your services.
Pro tip
As you’re setting up your lead prices, we’ll give you personalized tips for getting more leads.
Your budget still controls your total spending
Your lead prices tell us how much you’re willing to spend per lead, but your budget controls your total weekly spending.
Every lead you pay for comes out of your weekly budget. Once you reach your limit, you’ll stop getting leads until the next week. So when you set your lead prices, check your budget too. You may need to increase your budget to make sure you can still get the number of leads you want.
Frequently asked questions
Do lead prices impact my ranking?
Your lead prices are one of several factors that determine how many leads you get. It’s also impacted by things like:
Your profile
Your star rating and reviews
How quickly you respond to new leads
Local demand for your services
What’s the difference between my budget and lead price?
Your lead price is what you pay for one lead. And your budget is the most you’ll spend on all your leads for the whole week. They work together to help you control your costs.
Lead prices: This is the exact amount you pay for each lead. You set a price for every service you offer.
Weekly budget: This is the limit for your total spending across all your services.
For example, let’s say your lead price is $10, and your weekly budget is $90. You’d pay $10 for every lead you get. If you received 9 leads (totalling $90), you’d reach your budget and stop getting leads until next week (unless you increase your budget to continue getting leads in the current week).
Will the minimum prices for leads change?
We may occasionally adjust the minimum prices that pros pay. If your lead prices are at or near the minimum, they may increase automatically when the minimums change.
We’ll always let you know if this happens. You can check your current prices in your account.

articles.fullText:
How to create estimates and invoices on Thumbtack
[Image: Pill Pro]
Estimates and invoices help you manage your finances so you can get back to what you do best. Estimates give your customer a detailed preview of pricing before you start work. And invoices request a payment for the work.
Customize your estimate or invoice to fit your business needs by adding:
Custom line items, with unit and price
Discounts and taxes
A message to the customer
Your terms and conditions
Due date (invoice only)
Accepted payment methods (invoice only)
How to create an estimate
Sending an estimate shows customers what your pricing includes. That way, there’s no surprise when it’s time to send an invoice.
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Messages (from the main menu below).
Open your messages with the customer.
Tap the three-dot menu next to the customer’s name (at the top right).
Tap Create estimate or invoice from the drop-down menu.
For “Choose type,” select Estimate.
Fill out the estimate’s details and preview it, as needed.
Tap Send.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Messages.
Open your messages with the customer.
Click the three-dot menu next to the customer’s name (above your messages).
Select Create estimate or invoice from the drop-down menu.
For “Choose type,” select Estimate.
Fill out the estimate’s details and preview it, as needed.
Click Send.
Tip
You can’t edit a sent estimate or invoice. Instead, you’ll select Duplicate to create a new one. Once you’ve made your changes, select Send as new.
How to create an invoice
Follow these steps when you're ready to request payment from your customer.
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Messages (from the main menu below).
Open your messages with the customer.
Tap the three-dot menu next to the customer’s name (at the top right).
Tap Create estimate or invoice from the drop-down menu.
For “Choose type,” select Invoice.
Fill out the invoice details and preview it, as needed.
Tap Send.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Messages.
Open your messages with the customer.
Click the three-dot menu next to the customer’s name (above your messages).
Select Create estimate or invoice from the drop-down menu.
For “Choose type,” select Invoice.
Fill out the invoice details and preview it, as needed.
Click Send.
Keep track of which invoices have been paid by selecting Mark as paid at the bottom of the invoice. After it’s been marked as paid, we’ll send both you and your customer a receipt.
Tip
Find all your sent estimates and invoices by selecting Invoices & estimates in your Messages tab.
How to update an estimate or invoice
To change a sent estimate or invoice, duplicate the original. You can make your edits on the new copy and send it to your customer. We’ll notify them when the new version is ready.
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Messages (from the main menu below).
Open your messages with the customer.
Find the estimate or invoice (in your messages with that customer), and tap View details.
Tap Duplicate at the bottom.
Make your changes.
Tap Send as new.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Messages.
Open your messages with the customer.
Find the estimate or invoice (in your messages with that customer), and click View details.
Click Duplicate at the bottom.
Make your changes.
Click Send as new.
Frequently asked questions
Can I add, edit, or delete a line item?
Yes. Before the estimate or invoice has been sent to the customer, you can add, edit, or delete line items.
Add: Click Add item while on the main estimate or invoice page.
Edit: Click into the line item to open the pop-up window. Make your changes, then tap Save.
Delete: Hover over the line item to select the trash icon. Or click into the line item to open the pop-up window, and select Delete.
After your estimate or invoice has been sent, it can’t be edited. Instead, you’ll select Duplicate to create a new one. Once you’ve made your changes, select Send as new.
Can I cancel an invoice? 
Yes, if a customer hasn't paid, you can cancel it. Here’s how:
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Messages (from the main menu below).
Open your messages with the customer.
Find the invoice (in your messages with that customer), and tap View details.
Select Cancel invoice at the top.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Messages.
Open your messages with the customer.
Find the invoice (in your messages with that customer), and click View details.
Select Cancel invoice at the top.
Can I cancel an estimate?
No. You’re not able to cancel an estimate, but you can duplicate it in order to send a new, updated one. Here’s how:
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Messages (from the main menu below).
Open your messages with the customer.
Find the estimate or invoice (in your messages with that customer), and tap View details.
Tap Duplicate at the bottom.
Make your changes.
Tap Send as new.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Messages.
Open your messages with the customer.
Find the estimate or invoice (in your messages with that customer), and click View details.
Click Duplicate at the bottom.
Make your changes.
Click Send as new.
Can I change my estimate into an invoice?
Yes. Open your estimate and select Convert to invoice.
Where can I find all of my sent estimates and invoices?
Find all your sent estimates and invoices by selecting Invoices & estimates in your Messages tab.
How do I find an estimate or invoice I started but didn’t finish?
We’ll save your draft if you need to finish it later. To find your draft:
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Messages (from the main menu below).
Open your messages with the customer.
Tap the three-dot menu next to the customer’s name (at the top right).
Select Resume estimate or invoice.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Messages.
Open your messages with the customer.
Click the three-dot menu next to the customer’s name (at the top right).
Select Resume estimate or invoice.

articles.fullText:
What to do when a customer doesn't respond
[Image: Pill Pro]
It can be frustrating when you pay for a new lead and don’t hear back from the customer. It's a common concern we hear from pros, and we factor it into any changes we make. Here are the most common reasons why a customer might not see your message and what you can do to encourage a response.
Understanding unread messages
While some customers may have hired someone else, we've found that unread messages are sometimes due to simple communication mix-ups, like these:
Missing notifications: Many customers are using Thumbtack for the first time. Some may not have downloaded the app and missed the notifications. This is why it's always a good idea to send a follow-up message to the customer.
A message mix-up: When you message a customer, they receive an email notification. It’s possible a customer responded to one of our notifications instead of the message itself, making them seem unresponsive even though they think they replied. This is another reason it’s always a good idea to follow-up with the customer.
Tips for better communication
To avoid these mix-ups, try these tips:
Use the customer’s preferred method: We've found that customers are often more responsive when pros contact them on their preferred communication method (like text, for example). If you have the customer's phone number, consider sending a text message.
Confirm they received your message: If you haven't heard back, send a friendly follow-up asking if they saw your last message and provide a next step.
How to write a follow-up message
Sending follow-up messages encourages customers to take the next step or to give you an update if they went another route. Here are some tips for writing a follow-up message:
Greet them warmly.
Remind them of their project.
Let them know you’re still available.
Ask for an update, or invite them to take the next step.
This example message can give you a starting point, but remember to tailor it to the specifics of their project.
Example message:
“Hi! I reached out a few days ago about your project. Are you still looking for a pro? If so, I’m still available and would be happy to help! Let me know when you’re free for a consultation. Or, if you’ve already hired someone else, I’d appreciate any feedback about why you went a different route so I can improve. Looking forward to hearing from you — and thanks for your time!”
Tip
You can always send a follow-up message if a customer doesn't respond. However, to help keep customers responsive from the start, check out our guide on getting hired with your messages.
How lead costs compare to advertising
It helps to think of buying leads like digital advertising — but with higher customer intent.
Traditional advertising: When you pay for ads (like flyers, billboards, or online clicks), you’re paying just to get noticed. You pay for people to see your business name, even if they never contact you.
Thumbtack leads: With Thumbtack, you don’t pay when a customer just sees your profile in search results. You only pay when a customer reaches out to you directly and shares their project details with you. Even if they don’t reply immediately, the connection has value: They chose you: The customer saw your profile, reviews, and sometimes pricing before reaching out. It’s an informed open door.The lead never expires: You can reach out now and in the future.You have the choice to follow up: You can use the connection to send follow-up messages and show the customer why you’re the right pro for the job.
Even if a customer doesn't reply right away, paying for the lead covers the marketing cost of bringing a real, interested customer to your "front door." Unlike a passive ad view, a lead is a tangible connection you can follow up with and nurture over time.
We're here to support you
We only succeed if our pros can succeed. We verify customer phone numbers and have safeguards to prevent low-intent leads. If you receive a lead you believe is suspicious, report it so we can take a look. We review these reports to help protect your business, and if the lead doesn't meet our standards, we'll credit the cost back to your account.
Feedback from our pros guide improvements and new features on Thumbtack, and helps bridge communication gaps and improve customer responsiveness. If you have any feedback you’d like to share, contact us.
Frequently asked questions
Can I get a refund for unresponsive customers?
As part of our refund policy, we don’t provide refunds solely because a customer doesn’t reply. When you pay for a lead, you’re paying for the introduction and the chance to win the job. The lead is yours to keep, and it never expires. However, if the lead is suspicious (for example, they’re asking for unnecessary personal information, like your social security number or banking information), report it so we can take a closer look.

Cómo vincular su cuenta de Thumbtack con las plataformas asociadas
[Image: Pill Pro (Spanish)]
Thumbtack se ha asociado con varias plataformas de negocios en línea para brindarle un fácil acceso a las herramientas que pueden ayudarle a hacer crecer su negocio. Estas plataformas hacen una variedad de cosas, incluyendo la gestión de sus contactos, la respuesta más rápida y la optimización de sus operaciones diarias.
Beneficios de vincular su cuenta
Registrarse con herramientas y servicios de socios puede ayudarle a aumentar sus posibilidades de ser contratado y brindar experiencias perfectas a sus clientes. Cuando conecta su cuenta de Thumbtack con los servicios de socios, puede simplificar y optimizar la forma en que gestiona los mensajes de los clientes y/o los prospectos.
Nuestros socios ofrecen diferentes tipos de integraciones para ayudarle a administrar su negocio. Todas las integraciones de nuestros socios permiten que los prospectos de Thumbtack se envíen a su cuenta vinculada, pero no todos los socios incluyen la función de mensajería.
Prospectos: Obtenga la información de contacto de sus clientes y los detalles sobre el trabajo en la plataforma de su socio cada vez que reciba un prospecto.
Mensajería: Usted recibe los mensajes en la plataforma de su socio. Cómo responda a los mensajes depende del tipo de integración del socio: Mensajería unidireccional: Vea los mensajes nuevos en su herramienta de socio. Para responder, tendrá que ir a su cuenta de Thumbtack.Mensajería bidireccional: Envíe y reciba mensajes con los clientes de Thumbtack directamente desde la plataforma de su socio.
Tip
Actualmente, solo GoSite, Housecall Pro, y Workiz ofrecen mensajería de doble vía. Todos los demás socios solo admiten la mensajería de una sola vía.

Seleccione el servicio o herramienta para socios a continuación para aprender a vincularlo a su cuenta de Thumbtack.
Tip
Una vez que haya conectado una integración, puede administrarla desde su pestaña Apps (“Aplicaciones”).
ContractorPlus
ContractorPlus se conecta con sus prospectos. Para integrar sus cuentas de ContractorPlus y Thumbtack, siga estos pasos.
FieldPulse
Importe automáticamente sus nuevos prospectos de Thumbtack a FieldPulse, sin necesidad de ingresar los datos manualmente.
Para integrar sus cuentas de FieldPulse y Thumbtack, siga estos pasos.

Para integrar sus cuentas de GoSite y Thumbtack, siga estos pasos.

Para integrar sus cuentas de Hatch y Thumbtack, siga estos pasos:
Inicie sesión en Hatch.
En el menú del lado izquierdo, seleccione el ícono del Marketplace de aplicaciones.

Haga clic en Activate “Activar” en el formulario de configuración.
Cuando haya terminado con el formulario, haga clic en Finish “Finalizar”.
Housecall Pro
Housecall Pro se conecta con sus prospectos y mensajes.
Para integrar su cuenta de Housecall Pro, siga estos pasos:
Inicie sesión en Housecall Pro.
Vaya a la tienda de aplicaciones (esquina superior derecha, junto a la configuración).

Abajo de Job Partners "Socios de trabajos" (a la derecha), active la palanca de Thumbtack.

Haga clic en Job Inbox “Bandeja de entrada de trabajos” a la izquierda.

Haga clic en Iniciar sesión. Se le pedirá que inicie sesión en su cuenta de Thumbtack.
Haga clic en Volver a Housecall Pro para regresar a su bandeja de entrada de HCP.
Si ya ha conectado su cuenta, puede actualizar su integración siguiendo estos pasos. O puede obtener más información sobre cómo funciona nuestra integración.
Jobber
Jobber se conecta con sus prospectos.
Para integrar sus cuentas de Jobber y Thumbtack, inicie sesión en su cuenta de Jobber y siga estos pasos.
Podium
Podium se conecta con sus prospectos.
Para integrar sus cuentas de Podium y Thumbtack, siga estos pasos.
Scorpion
Scorpion se conecta con sus prospectos y mensajes
Para integrar sus cuentas de Scorpion y Thumbtack, regístrese aquí.
Serviceminder
Serviceminder se conecta con sus prospectos.
Para integrar su cuenta de Serviceminder, siga estos pasos:
Inicie sesión en Serviceminder.
Haga clic en Control Panel “Panel de control”.
Haga clic en Integrations. “Integraciones”.
Haga clic en Marketing “Marketing”.
Haga clic en Connect to Thumbtack “Conectar con Thumbtack”.
ServiceTitan
ServiceTitan se conecta con sus prospectos.
Dado que ServiceTitan no admite la mensajería en este momento, para los prospectos directos deberá ponerse en contacto con el cliente utilizando la información de contacto proporcionada en ServiceTitan para finalizar los detalles. Si no consigue el trabajo, rechace el prospecto para actualizar su estado y mantener sus prospectos organizados.
Para integrar sus cuentas de ServiceTitan y Thumbtack, siga estos pasos. O puede obtener más información sobre cómo funciona nuestra integración.
Signpost
Signpost se conecta con sus prospectos y mensajes.

Haga clic en Settings “Configuración” en la parte superior de la página.

Haga clic en Connect “Conectar” junto a Thumbtack.

Se le pedirá que inicie sesión en su cuenta de Thumbtack.
Seleccione el servicio que desea conectar con Signpost.
Haga clic en Confirm connection “Confirmar conexión”.

[Video: Set up Thumbtack Instant Response]

Tip
Si la herramienta que desea conectar a su cuenta de Thumbtack no aparece en la lista anterior, es posible que pueda configurar una integración de webhook.
Preguntas frecuentes
¿Cómo agrego una integración a mi cuenta de Thumbtack si tengo múltiples negocios?
Deberá integrar cada negocio, uno a la vez.

articles.fullText:
What is smarter lead matching?
Smarter lead matching uses AI to learn your job preferences based on your Thumbtack activity. It has a deeper understanding of the work you do, so we can connect you with higher-quality leads and the right customers. As you give feedback on the leads you get, you teach us how to give you better matches over time.
How it works
Here are the key details of how smarter lead matching works:
AI-powered matching: At the start, we use your profile and job history to find your initial matches. As you interact with leads (we’ll explain what this means below), our AI learns your specific preferences. This ensures that we can connect you with more of the right customers.
Refine your preferences: View and manage what our AI has learned about your business anytime. You can adjust your job types to better match the kinds of jobs you want.
Simplified pricing: You no longer need to set different lead prices for every individual job type. Instead, you set one price range for an entire trade. We use the estimated job value to determine the final cost of the lead — ensuring a fair price for high-value jobs versus smaller, simpler ones.
Stronger protections and refunds: If you receive a lead that isn't a fit for your skills, select Can’t do it and choose Not what I do as the reason. We’ll issue a refund, and our lead matching system will learn from what you shared — leading to higher quality leads over time.
Tip
We’ve set default lead price ranges to get you started. Adjust your prices for each trade to stay in control of what you pay. Keep in mind that a higher maximum lead price helps you stay competitive for the jobs you want most.
How to enroll in smarter lead matching
When it’s available to you, you’ll see a full-screen introduction in your Thumbtack account. Complete your enrollment by following these steps:
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Jobs (from the main menu below).
In the Leads tab, tap Learn more (look for the banner introducing smarter lead matching).
Tap Get started.
Tap Edit trades to make changes or tap Looks good to confirm your trades.
Review your preferences, and remove any that don’t apply.
Tap Next.
Tap Done.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Jobs.
In the Leads tab, click Learn more (look for the banner introducing smarter lead matching).
Select Get started.
Click Edit trades to make changes or select Looks good to confirm your trades.
Review your preferences, and remove any that don’t apply.
Click Next.
Select Done.
How to improve my matched leads
With each new lead, you can either reply to the customer or tell us that you can’t do the job (and why). Providing this feedback is the best way to get better leads faster.
Receiving a new lead
If you receive a lead that doesn't fit your skills, follow these steps to decline it:
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Jobs (from the main menu below).
Open the lead.
Select Can’t do it.
Tap Yes, decline.
Let us know why you declined the job by selecting Not what I do and explain why.
Answer a few clarifying questions to help us understand the types of jobs you want.
Confirm if the new preference is correct.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Jobs.
Open the lead.
Select Can’t do it.
Click Yes, decline.
Let us know why you declined the job by selecting Not what I do and explain why.
Answer a few clarifying questions to help us understand the types of jobs you want.
Confirm if the new preference is correct.
When you confirm the new preference is correct, we'll apply it to your future leads and refund the lead you just declined.
Tip
The Can’t do it option is available only if you haven’t already chosen to reply to the customer. If you already replied to the customer but realize it’s a job you can’t do, request a refund through the typical process instead.
Want more detail on how these refunds work? Check out our Refund policy for smarter lead matching.
Adjusting learned matches
You can adjust your learned matches by following these steps:
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Services (from the main menu below).
Scroll down to the trade you want to edit and select the option to Refine your matches.
Tap Add to search for types of jobs you want to see more (or less) of. Or tap X to remove a job from either list.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Services.
Scroll down to the trade you want to edit and select the option to Refine your matches.
Tap Add to search for types of jobs you want to see more (or less) of. Or tap X to remove a job from either list.
Tune up your lead matches periodically
In addition to refining your lead matches anytime, we'll check in periodically to see how your recent leads are going. Reviewing your recent leads helps us keep your matches up to date and improve the types of jobs you're matched with. We may also credit your account for sharing your feedback.
For each job type, use the slider to tell us whether you want more or fewer leads like it — you don't need to change every one, just the ones that feel off. If you're active in more than one trade, you'll go through them one at a time. We'll use your answers to improve the leads you get.
Enhanced protections
You have extra protections to ensure you only pay for the jobs you want.
Skill mismatch refund: If a job doesn't match your skills, let us know by declining the new lead and selecting Not what I do. We'll make it right by refunding you.
Duplicate customer refund: If the same customer contacts you, you can request a refund (regardless of whether it's for the same job or not).
See our Refund policy for smarter lead matching for full eligibility details and timing.
What's next
Here’s how to set yourself up for success with smarter lead matching:
Update your lead prices: Lead price ranges for trades are initially set at a default amount, make sure to update them.
Refine your lead matches: To get better tailored leads faster, review and add job types you want more (or less) of.
Adjust your travel areas: Travel areas now apply to all of your trades and you’ll now find the option to edit them on your business profile instead.
Frequently asked questions
How do lead prices work with smarter matching?
Your lead price is the most you’re willing to pay for one lead in a specific trade. You’ll set a price range (minimum and maximum) and receive guidance to help you stay competitive.
While this controls individual lead costs, your weekly budget still limits your total spending for the week.
To edit your lead prices:
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Services (from the main menu below).
Tap Lead prices.
Adjust the sliders for each trade.
Tap Save.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Services.
Tap Lead prices.
Adjust the sliders for each trade.
Click Save.
How do I adjust my travel areas?
Travel areas now apply to all of your trades. You can edit your travel preferences from your business profile.
How do I add a new trade to my account?
You can add a new trade to your profile from your Services page:
App
Open theThumbtack Pro app.
Tap Services (from the main menu below).
Tap the three-dot menu (on the top right corner).
Select Add a trade.
In the search bar, type the trade you want to provide (we'll suggest a few based on what you enter).
Choose the trade you want to add from the drop-down menu.
Tap Add trade.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Services.
Click the three-dot menu (on the top right corner).
Select Add a trade.
In the search bar, type the trade you want to provide (we'll suggest a few based on what you enter).
Choose the trade you want to add from the drop-down menu.
Click Next below.
Click Add trade.
After adding a new trade, be sure to:
Refine your matches: Add job types you’ll likely want (or don’t want) for the new trade. You'll be matched with leads based on those job types, so set it up for the work you always want to do.
Review your lead prices: Check and set your price range for the new trade.
Review your budget: Your weekly budget covers leads across all of your trades — so make sure it's still enough to get the leads you want.
I can't find the type of job I do. What can I do?
If you don't see the job type you're looking for when refining your matches, let us know:
App
Open theThumbtack Pro app.
Tap Services (from the main menu below).
Scroll down to the trade you want to edit and select the option to Refine your matches.
Tap Add to search for types of jobs you want to see more.
If it's not listed, select Can't find the job type you need? Tell us and describe what you're looking for.
Tap Submit feedback.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Services.
Scroll down to the trade you want to edit and select the option to Refine your matches.
Tap Add to search for types of jobs you want to see more (or less) of.
If it's not listed, select Can't find the job type you need? Tell us and describe what you're looking for.
Click Submit feedback.
Your suggestion will be reviewed by our team, though it won't be added right away.
When your job types can't capture every detail about the work you do, use your business profile to set clear expectations. State any specific limitations or specialties to save time and make sure the right customers reach out.
Can I opt out of this experience? 
Yes. You can return to the previous targeting preferences experience at any time:
Go to your Services.
Scroll down and tap final feedback (look for the message “Not loving the new lead system?”).
Let us know why you’re opting out.
Select Continue.
Confirm that you’d like to opt out.
Can I try smarter lead matching again if I opted out?
Yes. You can re-enroll to start receiving AI-powered matches again. Go to Services and select Try it again.

articles.fullText:
How to request a refund
[Image: Pill Pro]
Requesting a refund
First, check out our refund policy to see if a lead qualifies. And if it does, you can request a refund. We’ll initiate a refund to your Thumbtack balance if the request is approved. Here’s how you can request a refund:
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Profile (from the main menu below).
Tap the gear icon (in the top right corner).
Select Payments.
Tap View your balance and charges.
Select the lead you want to dispute.
Tap Request a refund (at the bottom of the pop-up).
Follow the prompts to share more details.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Click your profile photo (in the top right corner).
Click Payments in the drop-down menu.
Below "Activity," select the lead you want to dispute.
Click Request a refund (at the bottom of the pop-up).
Follow the prompts to share more details.
Tip
You can also request a refund from your messages. Tap the three-dot menu (above your messages with that customer), and select Request a refund.
You’ll usually get an answer within 24 – 48 hours. If the situation needs further review, it could take up to four days.
If the lead qualifies, the amount will be refunded to your Thumbtack balance to use toward future leads.
How to check on a refund request status
You can track the status of your refund requests all in one place. Simply follow these steps on your device:
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Profile (from the main menu below).
Tap the gear icon (in the top right corner).
Tap Payments.
Tap View your balance and charges.
Tap a charge to view the refund request status.
We’ll let you know the status of each refund request you’ve submitted:
Pending: The refund request was submitted but is still pending approval. You’ll usually get an answer within 24 – 48 hours. If the situation needs further review, it could take up to four days.
Refunded: Your refund request was approved and credited back to your Thumbtack account.
Credited: We granted you a courtesy credit to your Thumbtack account.
Denied: The refund request was denied so you’re still charged for the lead. Take a look at our refund policy to learn more.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Click your profile photo (in the top right corner).
Click Payments in the drop-down menu.
Under “Activity,” select a charge to view the refund request status.
We’ll let you know the status of each refund request you’ve submitted:
Pending: The payment is still processing so you haven’t been charged for the contact yet.
Credited: We granted you a courtesy credit to your Thumbtack account.
Refund requested: The refund request was submitted but is still pending approval. You’ll usually get an answer within 24 – 48 hours. If the situation needs further review, it could take up to four days.
Refunded: We approved the request and refunded the amount to you.
Refund denied: The refund request was denied so you’re still charged for the lead. Take a look at our refund policy to learn more.
Refunds to your original form of payment
By default, your refund will be sent to your Thumbtack account balance so you can get more leads on Thumbtack. However, if you’d like your refund to be sent back to your original form of payment (such as your credit card on file), contact us within 10 business days of your original refund request approval and let us know.
Courtesy credits, prepaid packages, and promotional balances aren’t eligible to be refunded to your payment method. For example, if you prepaid for leads by purchasing a credit package, the credit package isn’t refundable. So let’s say you used that package to pay for a lead, and that lead ends up qualifying for a refund – in that case, you’d get the cost of the lead refunded to your Thumbtack balance to use on future leads.
For the refund to be sent back to your original payment method:
If you requested the refund: You must have already submitted the refund request.Your refund request must be received within 10 business days from when you’re notified of the refund approval.Your refund must have been approved and refunded to your Thumbtack account balance (see the section above on how to check on a refund request status).The account balance must not be zero or negative.
If the refund was automatically refunded to you: Your refund request must be received within 10 business days from when you’re notified of the refund.The amount must be refunded to your Thumbtack account balance (see the section above on how to check on a refund request status).The account balance must not be zero or negative.
Pro tip
We can’t send refunds to a different card than your original payment method. It must be the original card used to pay.
Once your request for a refund back to your original payment method is approved, it can take up to 5 - 7 business days for the refund to be processed and sent back to your bank account. If you pay for a new lead while your refund is processing, we’ll use part of your refund to pay for that new lead, and you’ll receive the remaining amount back to your card.
Need to request a refund to your original form of payment?
[Button: Contact us]
Frequently asked questions
When should I contact you for a refund?
In some circumstances, we automatically issue the refund to your account. But if the charge falls under the "case-by-case refunds" category of our refund policy, you should request a refund within 45 days by following the steps above in this article.
Can I attach screenshots to my refund request?
Yes, as you’re going through the process to request a refund, you’ll see an Upload image option. You can attach up to six screenshots of conversations or any other relevant images with helpful information. We only accept uploads of image files (JPG, GIF, and PNG). If you have a PDF or another document type, try taking a screenshot of it and uploading it as an image file instead.
If you want to remove an image you added, tap the trash icon in the image’s right corner.
How do I know when I’ve received a refund? 
We’ll email you when the process is complete. You can also check the status of your refund requests in your account. To do so on a desktop browser, go to your Payments page and look under the Activity tab. Or on the Thumbtack Pro App, follow the steps in this article under “How to check on a refund request status.”
Why didn’t I receive a refund?
Although we want you to be successful overall, we can’t guarantee each lead or booking will result in a hire. We only issue refunds in certain situations included in our refund policy. Often, many pros request refunds because they weren’t hired. In that case, we’re unable to guarantee the lead outcome or return on investment. Learn more about what you can do if you don’t qualify for a refund.

articles.fullText:
Refund policy for pros
[Image: Pill Pro]
If you’re running into issues with a lead and would like a refund, we’re here to help. This article will walk you through what qualifies for a refund, and what doesn’t.
To learn how to request a refund, check out our article on how to request a refund.
What qualifies for a refund
We understand that sometimes things don't go as planned. And if you're wondering if you qualify for a refund, you're in the right place. Some of these situations will be refunded automatically and some will be on a case-by-case basis depending on the circumstances of the particular situation. All refunds are made at our sole discretion. We may issue a courtesy credit for situations outside of the refund policy.
Let’s break it down:
Automatic refunds
In some situations, we will automatically refund an amount back to your Thumbtack balance. You don’t have to submit a request for these refunds — we handle the work for you. For example, if a lead is flagged by our Trust and Safety department, or if you decline a Smart Match lead and tell us it wasn't a fit.
Case-by-case refunds
For all other situations, you can request a refund within 45 days of the charge. We’ll review the details you share and let you know whether your situation qualifies for a refund. Our decisions about refunds are made on a case-case basis and depend on the circumstances of the particular situation. All refunds are made at our sole discretion.
Here are some situations that will most likely qualify for a refund:
The job changed significantly
If a customer contacts you about a job that’s drastically different from the original lead (for example, the customer changes the job location, and it's now outside of the travel area you’ve set up in your job preferences), you can request a refund.
Make sure to include which job details changed when submitting your request. When you're chatting with the customer about changes to the job, use the Thumbtack messenger. That helps our team resolve your refund request much faster. But if the conversation happened outside of Thumbtack regarding changes to the job, you can attach screenshots of your conversation when requesting the refund.
The customer's first contact is "no thanks."
This only applies to customers you meet through the Opportunities tab of your Jobs page. If the customer’s first message to you is a clear no, you can request a refund and we'll look into it. Learn more about Opportunities.
A lead violates our Terms of Use
We do our best to make sure all leads meet our Terms of Use, but if you get a lead that doesn’t, please report the customer to request a refund.
The job takes place outside of your calendar availability
Let's say a customer contacts you with a job for a specific date that isn’t flexible. If you've blocked off that date in your calendar and business hours, you can request a refund for that lead. This only applies to leads that indicate a specific date that isn’t flexible, like planned celebrations such as a wedding or deadline-specific projects such as a move.
Leads that are flexible on dates or don't specify an exact date wouldn't qualify for a refund. This includes when customers indicate they're "open to other dates suggested by the pro.” However, in these situations, we recommend reaching out to the customer to suggest other dates that may work for both of you. If you’ve tried this but were unable to reach a resolution, request a refund and we’ll look into it.
To make sure that you don't get any leads when you're not available or on vacation, you can hide your business. You can also learn more about managing your availability and how to turn your job preferences on or off.
The customer provided an invalid phone number
As part of our Quality Commitment, we use an identity-matching process to verify all customers’ phone numbers. But if you get a disconnected or invalid phone number, request a refund and we’ll look into it. In your request, let us know why you believe the phone number is invalid. While we work to ensure that customer contact information is verified, we can’t guarantee that customers will answer when you call.
You receive duplicate leads or you were charged twice
If you happen to receive a lead from the same customer for an identical job within 45 days, you can request a refund. We try to screen for this, but sometimes customers use different Thumbtack accounts to submit the same request.
Please note that if a customer reaches out twice in 45 days about different (not identical) jobs, that is not a duplicate lead.
Promotional credits
Promotional credits are credits that you’ve received as an incentive in exchange for a purchase, such as a credit package. If you’ve received promotional credits and the lead you paid for with those credits ends up falling under one of the above situations, you can request a refund.
Thumbtack reserves the right to provide courtesy credit for circumstances not listed above.
Tip
When you request a refund, add as much detail about the situation as possible to help our team find a resolution for you faster. You can also attach up to six screenshots of conversations or any other relevant images with helpful examples of your refund request.
What happens next
Once you submit your request, we’ll look into the details and any images you shared, then we’ll email you to let you know if you qualify for a refund or not. You’ll usually get an answer within 24 – 48 hours. If the situation needs further review, it could take up to four days.
You can also check the status of a refund by opening your messages with the customer. You’ll see “Refunded” right next to your charge amount in the project details, located to the right of your messages.
If you qualify for a refund, we will issue that refund back to your Thumbtack balance once we approve your request.
How to check on a refund request status
You can track the status of your refund requests all in one place. Simply follow these steps on your device:
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Profile (from the main menu below).
Tap the gear icon (in the top right corner).
Tap Payments.
Tap View your balance and charges.
Tap a charge to view the refund request status.
We’ll let you know the status of each refund request you’ve submitted:
Pending: The refund request was submitted but is still pending approval. You’ll usually get an answer within 24 – 48 hours. If the situation needs further review, it could take up to four days.
Refunded: Your refund request was approved and credited back to your Thumbtack account.
Credited: We granted you a courtesy credit to your Thumbtack account.
Denied: The refund request was denied so you’re still charged for the lead. Take a look at our refund policy to learn more.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Click your profile photo (in the top right corner).
Click Payments in the drop-down menu.
Under “Activity,” select a charge to view the refund request status.
We’ll let you know the status of each refund request you’ve submitted:
Pending: The payment is still processing so you haven’t been charged for the contact yet.
Credited: We granted you a courtesy credit to your Thumbtack account.
Refund requested: The refund request was submitted but is still pending approval. You’ll usually get an answer within 24 – 48 hours. If the situation needs further review, it could take up to four days.
Refunded: We approved the request and refunded the amount to you.
Refund denied: The refund request was denied so you’re still charged for the lead. Take a look at our refund policy to learn more.
Refunds to your original form of payment
By default, your refund will be sent to your Thumbtack account balance so you can get more leads on Thumbtack. However, if you’d like your refund to be sent back to your original form of payment (such as your credit card on file), contact us within 10 business days of your original refund request approval and let us know.
Courtesy credits, prepaid packages, and promotional balances aren’t eligible to be refunded to your payment method. For example, if you prepaid for leads by purchasing a credit package, the credit package isn’t refundable. So let’s say you used that package to pay for a lead, and that lead ends up qualifying for a refund – in that case, you’d get the cost of the lead refunded to your Thumbtack balance to use on future leads.
For the refund to be sent back to your original payment method:
If you requested the refund: You must have already submitted the refund request.You must reach out to us within 10 business days of the refund being approved.Your refund must have been approved and refunded to your Thumbtack account balance (see the section above on how to check on a refund request status).The account balance must not be zero or negative.
If the refund was automatically refunded to you: You must reach out to us within 10 business days of the refund being approved.The amount must be refunded to your Thumbtack account balance (see the section above on how to check on a refund request status).The account balance must not be zero or negative.
Pro tip
We can’t send refunds to a different card than your original payment method. It must be the original card used to pay.
Once your request for a refund back to your original payment method is approved, it can take up to 5 - 7 business days for the refund to be processed and sent back to your bank account. If you pay for a new lead while your refund is processing, we’ll use part of your refund to pay for that new lead, and you’ll receive the remaining amount back to your card.
Learn more about how to request a refund.
What to do if you don’t qualify for a refund
There may be a few reasons you didn’t qualify for a refund. Some reasons could be:
You submitted the request after 45 days from the charge.
You weren’t charged since it was a free lead.
There wasn’t enough evidence to support a refund.
We found your preferences and account settings weren’t set up to get the jobs you want.
The situation was outside of our refund policy.
Even though some leads may not pan out and we aren’t able to refund in every situation, we want you to be successful on Thumbtack. If you’re not seeing the results you want with your leads, there are a few things you can do to improve your chances of getting hired.
Adjust your messages to customers
Your first impression is really important and sometimes the key to getting hired. How you communicate with customers impacts your overall success. Here’s a guide to responding to customers and standing out.
Most customers want to hear from you right away, so it’s important to respond to customers as quickly as possible. Many customers end up hiring the quickest and most helpful pro.
If you haven’t heard back from a customer, try sending a follow-up message. This strategy can bring customers back and encourage them to continue moving forward.
Improve your profile
Your profile sets you apart from your competition and helps customers decide if you’re the right pro for the job. Check out our tips for improving your profile, and watch our video about how to complete your profile.
It’s important to have a complete profile, a professional profile picture, and at least five positive reviews. The more your profile and reviews grow, the more trust you build with customers and the easier success tends to come.
Review your job preferences
If you’re receiving unwanted leads, revisit your service areas, job types, and availability preferences. Refine these job preferences to confirm they’re set for the kinds of jobs that you always want. Remember, any changes you make to your preferences could reduce the number of leads you receive.
Remember, you can change your job preferences as much as you’d like, even for one little change. For example, if there’s a type of smaller job or a location that isn’t worth traveling to, you can remove it from your preferences. You can also remove any “Other” options from your job preferences if you feel like jobs with that option selected don’t work out enough.
Tip
It’s important to stay competitive. See how you compare to your market in your Performance dashboard.
If you’re a new pro on Thumbtack and not sure how everything works, we’re here to help you succeed. Check out Thumbtack Help for articles on everything Thumbtack. You can also become a part of the Thumbtack Pro Community and learn tips for success from the pros working right alongside you.
Frequently asked questions
The customer hired a different pro. Can I get a refund?
We know it can be frustrating not getting hired, but we don’t provide refunds in these situations. If you’re a new pro on Thumbtack and not sure how everything works, we’re here to help you succeed. Check out Thumbtack Help for articles on everything Thumbtack. You can also become a part of the Thumbtack Pro Community and learn from the pros working right alongside you.
Can I get a refund for the credit package I purchased?
If you prepaid for leads by purchasing a credit package, the credit package isn’t refundable. But if you use that package to pay for a lead, and that lead qualifies for a refund, you’ll get the cost of the lead refunded to your Thumbtack balance to use on future leads.
I'm closing my Thumbtack account, can I get a refund?
As part of our Terms of Use, all sales and fees on Thumbtack are final and non-refundable. If you cancel your account at any time, you won't receive any refund.

How to link your Thumbtack account with partner platforms
[Image: Pill Pro]
Thumbtack has partnered with several online business platforms to bring you easy access to the tools that can help grow your business. These platforms do a variety of things; including, managing your contacts, responding more quickly, and optimizing your daily operations.
Benefits of linking your account
Signing up with partner tools and services can help increase your chances of getting hired and provide seamless experiences for your customers. When you connect your Thumbtack account with partner services, you can streamline and optimize the way you manage customer messages and/or leads.
Our partners offer different types of integrations to help you manage your business. All of our partner integrations allow Thumbtack leads to be sent to your connected account, but not all partners include messaging.
Leads: Get your customers’ contact information and details about the job in your partner platform each time you get a lead.
Messaging: You receive messages on your partner platform. How you respond to messages depends on the partner’s integration type: 1-way messaging: See new messages in your partner tool. To respond, you’ll need to go to your Thumbtack account.2-way messaging: Send and receive messages with Thumbtack customers directly from your partner platform.
Tip
Currently, only GoSite, Housecall Pro, and Workiz offer 2-way messaging. All other partners only support 1-way messaging.
How to add an integration
Select the partner service or tool below to learn how to link it to your Thumbtack account.
Tip
Once you’ve connected an integration, you can manage it from your Apps tab.
ContractorPlus
ContractorPlus connects with your leads.
To integrate your ContractorPlus and Thumbtack accounts, follow these steps.
FieldPulse
Automatically bring new Thumbtack leads into FieldPulse — no manual data entry required.
To integrate your FieldPulse and Thumbtack accounts, follow these steps.
GoSite
GoSite connects with your leads and messages.
To integrate your GoSite and Thumbtack accounts, follow these steps.
[Video: GoSite (00:16)]
Hatch
Hatch connects with your leads and messages.
To integrate your Hatch and Thumbtack accounts, follow these steps:
Log in to Hatch.
From the menu on the left-hand side, select the App Marketplace icon.
Select the Lead sources tab (in the top right corner).
Next to “Thumbtack,” click Connect.
Under “Thumbtack oauth2 connection,” select Connect.
Follow the authentication process and “Allow Access”.
Click Activate in the setup form.
When you’re done with the form, click Finish.
Housecall Pro
Housecall Pro connects with your leads and messages.
To integrate your Housecall Pro account follow these steps:
Log in to Housecall Pro.

Learn more about how our integration works.

Jobber
Jobber connects with your leads.
To integrate your Jobber and Thumbtack accounts, log in to your Jobber account, then follow these steps.

Podium
Podium connects with your leads.
To integrate your Podium and Thumbtack accounts, follow these steps.
Scorpion
Scorpion connects with your leads and messages.
To integrate your Scorpion and Thumbtack accounts, sign up here.
Serviceminder
Serviceminder connects with your leads.
Follow these steps to integrate your Serviceminder account:
Log in to Serviceminder.
Click Control Panel.
Click Integrations.
Click Marketing.
Click Connect to Thumbtack.
ServiceTitan
ServiceTitan connects with your leads.
Since ServiceTitan doesn’t support messaging at this time, for direct leads you’ll want to reach out to the customer using their contact information provided in ServiceTitan to finalize the details. If you don’t land the job, decline the lead to update its status and keep your leads organized.
To integrate your ServiceTitan and Thumbtack accounts, follow these steps. Or you can learn more about how our integration works.

Signpost
Signpost connects with your leads and messages.

Log in to Signpost.
Click Settings at the top of the page.
Click Instant Responders from the menu on the left of the page.
Click Connect next to Thumbtack.
Click Get Started.
You’ll be prompted to log into your Thumbtack account.
Select the service you would like to connect with Signpost.
Click Confirm connection.
For more help, watch this video about setting up Thumbtack Instant Response:
[Video: Set up Thumbtack Instant Response]
Workiz
Workiz connects with your leads and messages.

[Video: Workiz (00:17)]
Tip
Check out the Marketplace to find special offers and discounts for our partners.
Integrations that you'll need help to add
For these tools, you’ll need to contact their support team or your account manager and also contact us at teampartnerships@thumbtack.com to complete the integration:
Alivo (leads)

If the tool you want to connect to your Thumbtack account isn’t listed above, you may be able to set up a webhook integration.

How do I add an integration to my Thumbtack account if I have multiple businesses?
You’ll need to integrate each business, one at a time.
