articles.fullText:
Here’s a guide to your job preferences.
[Image: Pill Pro]
It’s all in the details. With job preferences (also called "targeting"), you tell us what kind of jobs you’re looking for. And when those customers reach out, you get our Quality Commitment.
What kind of jobs catch your eye?
Take a minute to think about your ideal job. The kind you’re always on the lookout for and wouldn’t think twice about paying for. What comes to mind?
Now that you know what jobs you want, it’s important to tell us too.
[Image: Exact match lead ]
You decide which jobs fit.
When you sign up on Thumbtack, you tell us the basics. But if you’re looking for that perfect job — and want to show up in search results — it’s time to set up your job preferences by adding a service.
Tip
Before you turn on your job preferences, make sure you’ve finished setting up your pro account. That includes finishing your profile, setting up your preferences, and adding a payment method.
With job preferences, you tell us:
Where: Don’t want to work downtown? Not a problem. You pick your own travel radius and areas, even down to the zip code.
When: You’re in control of your schedule. You decide which days you’re available, and we’ll send you jobs that fit.
What: This is where you get really specific about the jobs you always want (and the jobs you don’t want).
If a customer reaches out to you and their job matches that where, when, and what, you automatically pay for that lead. Once a customer reaches out, it’s up to you to respond quickly to them and win the job. Learn more about getting hired with your messages.
Why your job preferences matter.
You tell us what jobs you want with your job preferences. That’s how we know which customers are a good fit. When a customer is interested in working with you, they’ll reach out.
You automatically pay for leads from customers who reach out to you with project details that match your preferences. This is why it’s important that your job preferences accurately reflect your business and goals.
In some markets, you’ll also need at least one review before you show up in search results. Your job preferences help us connect you with the right customers.
Tip
When your job preferences can't filter every job detail you need, use your business profile to set clear expectations. State any specific limitations or specialties to save time and ensure only the right customers reach out.
Help the right customers find you.
It’s all about getting seen by the right customers.
Setting job preferences means you show up in search results. Job preferences also help your ideal customers find you too. You know those filters customers use when they’re searching for pros? Those go back to your business details and preferences.
[Image: Customer search demo]
Now it’s your turn.
Set up those job preferences. Go to your Services and tell us what jobs you always want. Once we know what you’re looking for, we’ll make sure you show up in search results.
Already set job preferences? It might be a good time to review them.
Next, learn about the customer side of Thumbtack.
[Button: Guide to how customers find you ]

articles.fullText:
Cómo crear un webhook
[Image: Pill Pro]
Algunos profesionales usan una herramienta adicional para administrar sus prospectos, mensajes y reseñas en Thumbtack. Si quiere que sus prospectos de Thumbtack se envíen automáticamente a otra herramienta, y esa herramienta aún no se integra con Thumbtack, pruebe nuestro webhook gratuito, una conexión web que envía esa información automáticamente.
Antes de comenzar
Configurar un webhook es un proceso técnico. Si no se siente cómodo con las configuraciones técnicas o con el manejo de datos sin procesar, es posible que esta opción no sea la adecuada para usted. Para una experiencia más sencilla, pruebe una de nuestras herramientas de socios.
Para comenzar a configurar un webhook, asegúrese de lo siguiente:
Usa una herramienta de terceros que sea compatible con webhooks y que no sea una de nuestras herramientas de socios actuales.
Puede crear una URL para conectar el webhook.
Tip
Muchos profesionales usan Zapier para generar la URL de su webhook. Aunque es una opción popular, tenga en cuenta que Zapier es una herramienta independiente y no es un socio de Thumbtack. Conozca cómo configurar una URL de webhook en Zapier.
Cosas importantes que debe saber:
Cada configuración de webhook está vinculada a un perfil de negocio: Si tiene más de un perfil de negocio, tendrá que configurar un webhook por separado para cada uno.
Es una conexión en un solo sentido: Thumbtack envía información a su herramienta, pero su herramienta no puede enviar información de vuelta. Aun así, tendrá que iniciar sesión en Thumbtack para responder a mensajes o reseñas.
Usted elige qué recibirá: Puede elegir recibir datos de prospectos, incluidos los nombres y números de teléfono de los clientes, además de mensajes y reseñas de clientes.
Puede usarlo con otras herramientas: Si ya usa una herramienta de socios, pero quiere recibir datos adicionales, como reseñas, puede configurar un webhook para cubrir esa necesidad.
Puede probar su configuración: Cuando pruebe su conexión, cualquier dato de prueba aparecerá claramente marcado como "test lead" (“prospecto de prueba”) en su registro de entregas para que pueda identificarlo fácilmente.
Cómo crear un webhook
Puede enviar los detalles de sus prospectos, mensajes y reseñas de clientes directamente a sus aplicaciones de negocio favoritas. Recomendamos configurar primero el webhook en su otro servicio, como Zapier, para que tenga su URL lista.
Una vez que tenga su URL lista, puede crear el nuevo webhook en su cuenta de Thumbtack. Si tiene más de un perfil de negocio, tendrá que configurar un webhook por separado para cada uno. Siga estos pasos en una computadora:
Inicie sesión en su cuenta de Thumbtack.
Seleccione su foto de perfil (en la parte superior derecha)
Seleccione Integrations (“Integraciones”) en el menú desplegable.
Seleccione Manage webhooks (“Administrar webhooks”).
Si tiene varios perfiles de negocio, elija el perfil correcto en el menú desplegable.
Seleccione Create webhook (“Crear webhook”).
Complete la información solicitada.
Haga clic en Create webhook (“Crear webhook”).
Tip
Le proporcionamos el nombre y el número de teléfono del cliente en todos los prospectos. (No proporcionamos direcciones de correo electrónico.) Puede enviar mensajes o llamar a los clientes para obtener información de contacto adicional según lo necesite.
Cómo administrar un webhook
Puede actualizar la configuración de su webhook, como su URL o los tipos de datos que recibe, en cualquier momento. Siga estos pasos en una computadora para editar una conexión existente:
Inicie sesión en su cuenta de Thumbtack.
Seleccione su foto de perfil (en la parte superior derecha).
Seleccione Integrations (“Integraciones”) en el menú desplegable.
Seleccione Manage webhooks (“Administrar webhooks”).
Si tiene varios perfiles de negocio, elija el perfil correcto en el menú desplegable.
Seleccione el webhook que quiere administrar.
Haga los cambios necesarios.
Seleccione Save changes (“Guardar cambios”).
Cómo probar un webhook
Una vez que su webhook esté configurado, es buena idea asegurarse de que su información esté llegando al lugar correcto. Siga estos pasos para enviar un prospecto de prueba y verificar que su conexión funcione correctamente.
Cada webhook activado en el perfil de negocio seleccionado recibirá el prospecto de prueba. Si tiene varios webhooks configurados en un mismo perfil de negocio, todos recibirán los datos de prueba. Siga estos pasos en una computadora para probar un webhook:
Inicie sesión en su cuenta de Thumbtack.
Seleccione su foto de perfil (en la parte superior derecha).
Seleccione Integrations (“Integraciones”) en el menú desplegable.
Seleccione Manage webhooks (“Administrar webhooks”).
Si tiene varios perfiles de negocio, elija el perfil correcto en el menú desplegable.
Seleccione Test this webhook (“Probar este webhook”).
Seleccione el webhook que quiere administrar.
Seleccione la pestaña Recent deliveries (“Entregas recientes”) en la parte superior de la página para ver si se entregó el “prospecto de prueba”.
Solución de problemas de un webhook
Aprenda cómo solucionar errores comunes de configuración, encontrar códigos de error en su registro de entregas y obtener ayuda adicional si la necesita.
Tip
Si su webhook no funciona, pruebe esta solución común: desactívelo y vuelva a activarlo. Luego, envíe otro prospecto de prueba para ver si eso restablece la conexión.
Razones comunes por las que fallan los webhooks
Si su webhook no está entregando información y aparece con el estado “Failure” (“Falla”), por lo general se debe a uno de estos errores comunes de configuración:
La URL está incompleta. Una URL de webhook válida debe incluir su ID único, que es la serie de números y letras al final. Aquí tiene un ejemplo: Correcto: https://hooks.zapier.com/hooks/catch/1234567/abcde/Incorrecto: https://hooks.zapier.com/hooks/catch/
La URL fue editada. Si se cambia, elimina o agrega accidentalmente aunque sea un solo carácter, la conexión fallará. Recomendamos copiar y pegar la URL directamente sin hacer cambios.
Cómo revisar los detalles del error
Si ya verificó su URL y todavía falla, puede encontrar el código de error específico en su registro de entregas. Siga estos pasos en una computadora para encontrar el código de error:
Inicie sesiónen su cuenta de Thumbtack.
Seleccione su foto de perfil (en la parte superior derecha).
Seleccione Integrations (“Integraciones”) en el menú desplegable.
Seleccione Manage webhooks (“Administrar webhooks”).
Si tiene varios perfiles de negocio, elija el perfil correcto en el menú desplegable.
Seleccione el webhook que quiere administrar.
Vaya a la pestaña Recent deliveries (“Entregas recientes”).
Haga clic en una entrega con el estado “Failure” (“Falla”).
En la ventana emergente, vaya a la pestaña Responses (“Respuestas”).
Busque el código de estado y la explicación en los detalles de entrega de su webhook para ver qué salió mal.
¿Todavía tiene problemas? Si su configuración es correcta y aun así sigue apareciendo un error, contáctenos.
Cómo eliminar un webhook
Si deja de usar un servicio o quiere terminar una conexión, puede eliminar su webhook en cualquier momento. Una vez que lo elimine, Thumbtack dejará de enviar su información a esa dirección de inmediato. Siga estos pasos en una computadora para eliminar un webhook:
Inicie sesiónen su cuenta de Thumbtack.
Seleccione su foto de perfil (en la parte superior derecha).
Seleccione Integrations (“Integraciones”) en el menú desplegable.
Seleccione Manage webhooks (“Administrar webhooks”).
Si tiene varios perfiles de negocio, elija el perfil correcto en el menú desplegable.
Seleccione el webhook que quiere administrar.
Seleccione Delete webhook (“Eliminar webhook”) en la parte inferior izquierda.
Preguntas frecuentes
¿Qué significan los diferentes estados del webhook?
Estos son los significados de los diferentes estados:
Enabled (“Activado”): el webhook está activado y envía la información correspondiente de forma activa.
Disabled (“Desactivado”): el webhook está desactivado y no envía información.
Error: hay un problema con la configuración del webhook, por lo que la información no se envió correctamente.
¿Qué es una endpoint URL (“URL de destino”)?
Una endpoint URL es como una dirección digital para sus prospectos. Permite que Thumbtack envíe automáticamente la información de los prospectos a sus otras herramientas para que no tenga que copiar y pegar los detalles manualmente.
¿Debería agregar un tipo de autorización?
Lo mejor es agregar un Authorization type (“Tipo de autorización”) solo si ya entiende para qué sirve. De lo contrario, recomendamos dejarlo como None (“Ninguno”).
¿Puedo responder a los mensajes a través de mi otra herramienta?
No. Las conexiones de webhook funcionan en un solo sentido. Thumbtack envía información a su herramienta, pero su herramienta no puede enviar información de vuelta. Para responder a un cliente, aun así necesita iniciar sesión en su cuenta de Thumbtack.
¿Qué sucede una vez que mi webhook está configurado?
Enviaremos datos automáticamente a su URL cada vez que ocurra un evento seleccionado en su perfil de negocio designado, como recibir un nuevo prospecto. Puede rastrear todo lo que hemos enviado en la pestaña Recent deliveries (“Entregas recientes”).

articles.fullText:
Cómo configurar un webhook en Zapier
Zapier le permite conectar Thumbtack con muchas otras aplicaciones para que sus prospectos se envíen automáticamente a ellas. Muchos profesionales usan Zapier para automatizar su trabajo, pero es solo una de las muchas opciones disponibles.
Aunque es una opción popular, tenga en cuenta que Zapier es una herramienta independiente y no es una herramienta de socios de Thumbtack. Esta puede ser una buena opción si usted ya conoce Zapier y lo prefiere en lugar de nuestras herramientas de socios actuales.
Tip
Antes de configurar Zapier, asegúrese de que funcione con su aplicación buscándola aquí. Si no es compatible o si quiere explorar otras opciones, puede buscar alternativas a Zapier en internet.
Para configurar Zapier, debe crear una URL de webhook, crear el webhook en Thumbtack y crear un Zap para completar la integración. Le guiaremos en los siguientes pasos.
Primero, cree la URL de su webhook
Inicie sesión en su cuenta de Zapier.
Seleccione Create a Zap (“Crear un Zap”) en la esquina superior izquierda.
En la esquina superior izquierda, asigne a su Zap el nombre "Thumbtack Incoming Lead".
Seleccione Webhook para crear un disparador.
En Choose Trigger Event (“Elegir evento disparador”), haga clic en Catch Hook. Asegúrese de seleccionar Catch Hook y no Catch Raw Hook.
Seleccione Continue (“Continuar”).
Deje la sección Pick off a Child Key en blanco y seleccione Continue (“Continuar”).
Tip
Copie la URL de su webhook. Para hacerlo, busque la sección Test (“Probar”) en Zapier y haga clic en Copy (“Copiar”).
Segundo, cree el webhook en Thumbtack
Cuando tenga lista la URL de su webhook, puede crear el nuevo webhook en su cuenta de Thumbtack.
Tercero, pruebe el webhook
Una vez que su webhook esté configurado, es buena idea asegurarse de que la información esté llegando al lugar correcto. Siga estos pasos desde su computadora para enviar un prospecto de prueba y verificar que su conexión funcione correctamente.
Inicie sesión en su cuenta de Thumbtack.
Seleccione su foto de perfil en la parte superior derecha.
Seleccione Integrations (“Integraciones”) en el menú desplegable.
Seleccione Manage webhooks (“Administrar webhooks”).
Si tiene varios perfiles de negocio, elija el perfil correcto en el menú desplegable.
Seleccione Test this webhook (“Probar este webhook”).
Seleccione el webhook que quiere administrar.
Seleccione la pestaña Recent deliveries (“Entregas recientes”) en la parte superior de la página para ver si se entregó el “prospecto de prueba”.
Cuarto, pruebe un prospecto de Thumbtack
Siga estos pasos para configurar los detalles del prospecto en Zapier:
Inicie sesión en su cuenta de Zapier. en su cuenta de Zapier.
Seleccione el Zap Thumbtack Incoming Lead.
Seleccione 1. Catch Hook en Webhooks by Zapier.
Seleccione Test (“Probar”)
Seleccione una solicitud reciente y haga clic en Continue with Selected Record (“Continuar con el registro seleccionado”).
Por último, termine la configuración siguiendo estos pasos
Inicie sesión en su cuenta de Zapier.
Seleccione el Zap Thumbtack Incoming Lead.
Seleccione Action (“Acción”).
Busque la aplicación que quiere vincular.
Seleccione Set up Action (“Configurar acción”).
Seleccione los datos que quiere incluir, por ejemplo: Customer Name (“Nombre del cliente”), Customer Phone (“Teléfono del cliente”), City (“Ciudad”), State (“Estado”) y Zip (“Código ZIP”). Si necesita separar el nombre y el apellido, siga estos pasos de Zapier.
Haga clic en Close (“Cerrar”).
Use el interruptor en la esquina superior derecha para activar el Zap.
Cuando termine estos pasos, sus prospectos de Thumbtack comenzarán a llegar a través de Zapier.
Al configurar una integración, tendrá acceso a todos los campos de datos incluidos en nuestros prospectos. Puede ver qué campos están disponibles aquí.
Tip
Le proporcionamos el nombre y el número de teléfono del cliente en todos los prospectos. (No proporcionamos direcciones de correo electrónico.) Puede enviar mensajes o llamar a los clientes para obtener más información de contacto si es necesario.
Preguntas frecuentes
¿Puedo conectar mi negocio a varias herramientas?
Sí, puede integrar su negocio con varias herramientas.
Puede crear varios Zaps o un flujo de trabajo más complejo. Si crea varios Zaps, tendrá que configurar un webhook diferente para cada uno.

articles.fullText:
Como suscribirse a nuestras herramientas y servicios para socios
[Image: Pill Pro]
¿Está buscando formas de optimizar sus operaciones comerciales diarias? Está en el lugar correcto. Nos asociamos con servicios y herramientas seleccionados para ayudarle a responder más rápido, crecer a su propio ritmo y optimizar sus operaciones diarias. Encontrará estas herramientas (y más) en nuestro mercado, junto con ofertas exclusivas solo para los profesionales de Thumbtack.
Conozca nuestros socios
Mire dentro Nuestro Mercado para leer un resumen de cada servicio y herramienta de los socios. Y si desea obtener más detalles antes de registrarse en uno, visite su sitio web para obtener más información.
Socios de gestión de clientes que ofrecen apoyo en español:
Oncue
Socios de gestión comercial que ofrecen apoyo en español:
TurboTax
Wisetack
Herramientas y más que ofrecen apoyo en español:
Everlance
Consejo profesional
Algunos socios tienen ofertas especiales para nuevos usuarios. Tenga en cuenta que estas ofertas sólo están disponibles para los profesionales de Thumbtack, por lo que debe registrarse utilizando el enlace en el mercado para obtener la oferta.
Cómo Suscribirse
Una vez que haya encontrado una <herramienta o servicio de socio> en la que esté interesado, haga clic en Registrarse (Sign Up). Accederá al sitio web de ese socio, donde podrá seguir las indicaciones para completar el proceso de registro.
Preguntas Frecuentes
Si tengo preguntas sobre unos de los socios, ¿a quién podré contactar?
Para preguntas sobre uno de los servicios o herramientas, podrá comunicarse directamente con su equipo de apoyo. Para encontrar la información de contacto, oprima el enlace de registro (Sign Up) de nuestro mercado y busque la opción para ponerse en contacto con el equipo de apoyo.
¿Cómo obtengo la oferta de Thumbtack con un socio? 
Para aprovechar una oferta para los profesionales de Thumbtack, debe registrarse con un socio a través de nuestro mercado. Es todo!
Ya me he registrado con unos de los socios. Todavía podré obtener la nueva oferta? 
No. Está oferta solamente está disponible para profesionales de Thumbtack que se registren cuando la oferta esté disponible.
Hay un descuento disponible para cada socio en el mercado? 
No. Solo algunos socios ofrecen descuentos en este momento. Cada socio en nuestro mercado ofrece un servicio o herramienta que creemos que podría ser valioso para nuestros profesionales, pero no todos los socios ofrecen una oferta especial para los profesionales de Thumbtack.
Thumbtack está ofreciendo estas ofertas? 
No. Thumbtack los está conectando con nuestros socios, pero cada socio maneja su propio negocio de forma independiente. Una vez que se registre o cree una cuenta con su socio, tratara con él directamente, incluso para consultas de servicio al cliente relacionadas con los productos.
¿Listo para ver a nuestros socios?
[Button: Vaya a nuestro mercado]

articles.fullText:
¿Qué es Front Desk?
[Image: Pill Pro (Spanish)]
Como dueño de un negocio, gran parte de su tiempo se dedica a responder preguntas de los clientes y programar citas. Front Desk quita parte de ese trabajo de su carga y le devuelve su tiempo.
Cómo funciona
[Video: Introducción a Front Desk (2:35)]
Front Desk es el servicio automatizado de respuesta a prospectos de Thumbtack. Está diseñado para ayudarlo a gestionar sus mensajes, de modo que su primer mensaje a sus clientes sea rápido y automático.
Usted decide cómo desea que su negocio sea representado personalizando su primer mensaje a sus clientes. Ese primer mensaje es el que Front Desk enviará cada vez que reciba un prospecto. Usted puede comenzar preguntándoles más detalles sobre su proyecto, destacando las promociones que tiene en marcha o delineando sus próximos pasos. Lo que elija, este primer mensaje es la introducción a su negocio. A medida que conozca más sobre las necesidades de sus clientes, puede ajustar su mensaje cuando lo desee.
Los clientes prefieren una respuesta rápida. En promedio, Front Desk responde en dos minutos. Día o noche, sus clientes obtienen respuestas rápidas, cada vez.
Elija entre dos planes diferentes, según la opción que mejor se adapte a sus necesidades. Para obtener más información sobre costos y lo que está incluido, programe una llamada con un miembro del equipo.
Cómo comenzar
Para empezar, conversará por teléfono con un miembro del equipo de Front Desk. Ellos lo ayudarán a elegir un plan que funcione mejor para usted.
A continuación, nos contará acerca de su negocio y nuestro equipo creará un plan con usted para la comunicación con sus clientes. Hemos visto que los clientes han informado una mayor satisfacción al trabajar con profesionales que utilizan Front Desk y estamos emocionados de ayudarlo a comenzar.
¿Listo para facilitar la comunicación por mensajes?
[Button: Inscríbase ahora]
Preguntas frecuentes
¿Cuánto cuesta Front Desk?
Front Desk es una suscripción mensual. El costo varía de $60 a $500 al mes, según el plan que elija. Cuando se registre, nuestro equipo le ayudará a elegir el plan que mejor se adapte a sus necesidades de mensajería. Para obtener más información sobre costos y lo que está incluido, programe una llamada con un miembro del equipo.
¿Puedo realizar cambios en mi plan?
Sí, puede realizar cambios en su plan. Para realizar cambios, complete este formulario. Los cambios tardan dos días hábiles en entrar en vigencia.
¿Puedo realizar cambios en los mensajes que configure?
Sí, complete este formulario y le ayudaremos a actualizar sus mensajes.
¿Cuándo se renovará mi suscripción cada mes?
Su suscripción se renueva automáticamente el mismo día en que se inscribió en Front Desk. Y el día en que se inscribió también será el día en que se le facturará cada mes.
Por ejemplo, digamos que se inscribió en Front Desk el 15 de abril. Se le cobrará el 15 de abril y su próximo cobro será el 15 de mayo, y así sucesivamente (a menos que realice algún cambio en su plan).
¿Llamarán a los clientes a mi nombre?
No, Front Desk no realizará llamadas telefónicas a su nombre. Nuestro equipo utiliza el mensajero de Thumbtack para chatear con sus nuevos clientes.

articles.fullText:
Troubleshooting pro account issues
[Image: Pill Pro]
Having issues logging into your Thumbtack account? Here are a few common reasons why this could be happening:
Username or password issues
You have multiple or duplicate accounts
There’s a hold on your account
Let’s dive into each of these topics so we can get you using your account again.
Username or password issues
If you’re running into problems with logging in to your account, first check that you’re using your correct username and password.
Username
Confirm your email address. Your username will be an email address. To confirm which email address is associated with your Thumbtack account, check which email inbox receives your lead notifications.
Check for possible duplicate accounts. If you’re receiving lead notifications to multiple email addresses, you may have created duplicate accounts. Learn more in the Multiple or duplicate accounts section below.
Try logging in without an email address. If entering your email address isn’t working (and you’ve tried your other email addresses), it’s possible that you actually signed up using your Facebook, Google, or Apple account. If so, give that a try instead to see if you’re able to log in.
Change your email address. If you need to change the email address associated with your Thumbtack account (and you have access to your current email’s inbox), you can go to your account settings to update it. If you can't access your email inbox, submit the Account information and licensing form with a photo of your government-issued ID to request the change.
Password
If you forgot your password, reset it here. We’ll send you an email to finish the process. If you don’t see the email, check your spam folder.
If you still don’t see the password reset email after checking your spam folder, check your other email inboxes for it. It’s possible that your Thumbtack account may be registered under a different one. If this is the case, you’ll need to use that other email address as your username.
Other tips:
The most common and direct fix for many issues is to log out of your Thumbtack account and then log back in.
There are two different Thumbtack apps: one for customers (blue logo) and one for pros (black logo). So make sure you’re using the right app for you.
If none of the above resolves the issue, try these basic troubleshooting steps.
Multiple or duplicate accounts
If you’re receiving notifications for leads, but you don’t see those same leads when you log into your Thumbtack account, it could mean there’s an issue with duplicate accounts. You may be logged into a different account than the one associated with the notifications.
Tip
To check which email address is on file in your Thumbtack account you’re currently logged into, go to your account settings and select Email.
Signs of a duplicate account
Here are some signs that you have duplicate accounts:
Missing leads: You receive notifications for leads but can’t find those leads in your Thumbtack account.
Email mismatch: You get notifications at one email address but you’re logged into an account under a different email.
"Another pro" error: If you log in and see messages indicating that "another pro has the lead," this may confirm the existence of a duplicate account.
Troubleshooting steps
Before making changes, verify your login details to ensure you’re accessing the correct profile.
Check Notification Source: Confirm if the issue occurs with push notifications from the app or when trying to log in through an email notification. That way you can confirm if there’s an issue with your account in the pro app, web, or both. For example, if you’re only running into issues with accessing your leads from the app’s push notifications but not email, it could mean you’re logged into a different account than you expected in the Thumbtack app specifically.
Verify login: Ensure you’re logged into the account associated with the lead notifications causing you issues. If you have multiple accounts, you might be logged in to the wrong one. Here’s how to check: Go to your account settings and confirm which email is entered into the Email address option.Log out of your Thumbtack account, then manually enter your email and password at our Login page.
Test alternate emails: If you have multiple email addresses, attempt to log in with other emails you may have used to create an account to see if they lead to a different profile.
How to resolve duplicate accounts
Once you’ve identified that multiple accounts exist, you’ll want to deactivate one of the accounts in order to avoid issues in the future. Here’s how to do that:
Decide which account you want to keep. Choose the account that has all your reviews, messages, and customer interactions.
Deactivate the account you don’t need (if you can access it). Make sure you’re logged into the specific account you want to deactivate and then follow the steps to deactivate your account. Keep in mind that deactivating an account will result in the loss of access to reviews, profile information, and your account balance for that specific account.
If you can’t log into the account you want to deactivate, or need help deciding, contact us so we can help.
Account holds
An account hold means there’s an issue with your account related to our Thumbtack user guidelines and Terms of Use. You won’t appear in search results or be able to contact new customers until you resolve the hold on your account.
You should have received an email from us about the issue with your account. You’ll also see a banner at the top of your Thumbtack account, letting you know what actions you need to take in order to resolve the issue.
There are multiple reasons why your account could be on hold. Learn more about some common hold reasons below and how to correct the issue.
Account hold due to general profile issues
Look for an email we sent you explaining why your profile was placed on hold. It should also provide your next steps to get this issue resolved.
This account hold is used for reasons, such as:
Content violation: You may need to resolve any content entered into your profile that isn’t permitted on Thumbtack (like providing your direct contact information on your profile). You can resolve this type of hold by updating your profile to remove any violating content and, if there are no other concerns, the hold on your account should be automatically lifted in about 15 minutes.
License issues: We may need to verify your license. Follow any steps provided in the email sent to you. Learn more about managing your license.
Take a background check: You may need to take and pass a background check before you can use Thumbtack. Follow any steps provided in the email sent to you. Learn more about taking a background check.
Account hold due to payment failures or past due balance
A hold on your account may be placed due to a payment failure causing a negative or past due balance. This could possibly be caused by insufficient funds, or an expired or invalid card in your account.
To resolve this hold:
Update your payment method.
Go to your balance and pay off your owed balance.
Tip
If you still have payment issues (even after you made sure the card in your Thumbtack account is the correct one), sometimes you can correct the issue by simply removing the card from your account and adding it back in.
The hold on your account should automatically be lifted in about 15 minutes once the balance has cleared. If not, contact us so we can take a look.
Account hold due to disputed charges (chargebacks)
Disputing charges with your bank can lead to temporary account holds or permanent account closure on Thumbtack.
To resolve an account hold for disputed charges:
Check for the email we sent you about the disputed charge(s) with your Thumbtack account and follow the steps in the email.
Contact your bank to resolve the dispute.
Repay Thumbtack the funds owed.
If these steps have been completed and your account is still on hold, contact us. And in the future, request a refund through Thumbtack, rather than disputing the charge(s) with your bank.
Tip
Learn more about how charges on Thumbtack work and our refund policy.
Account hold due to an open dispute with a customer
This type of account hold is placed when a customer files a dispute against you, and our team needs to hear back from you.
To lift this type of hold, look for an email we sent you (e.g. from support@thumbtack.com, no-reply-tsc@thumbtack.com, or do-not-reply@thumbtack.com) and follow the steps to get started.
If you still have questions or concerns about the open dispute, respond to the email from our Trust and Safety specialist. This is the agent handling your case and is the best person to speak with.
There may be other reasons why your account is on hold. Check the email we sent you for more information and next steps. You may have been instructed to provide more information or it’s possible that your account has been removed. The email should also explain if the account removal was a permanent decision and will not be considered.
Frequently asked questions
What if I can’t reset my password because I can’t access my email associated with my Thumbtack account?
Here are a few troubleshooting steps you can try if you can't access the email associated with your Thumbtack account:
Contact your email provider: Reach out to your email provider to regain access to your email account. If you’re not able to access that email still, then proceed to the next step.
Change your email on Thumbtack: Fill out the Account information and licensing form and select Account information update. Follow the steps to verify your identity and request the email update.
How do I verify which email address is associated with my Thumbtack account once I’m logged in?
To check the email associated with your account, check your Account settings:
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Select Profile (from the main menu below).
Tap the gear icon (in the top right corner).
Select Account Details.
Tap Email.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Click your profile photo (in the top right corner).
Select Settings from the drop-down menu.
Select Account.
Select Email.
Will you notify me if there are issues with my account?
Yes, we’ll email you from either do-not-reply@thumbtack.com, support@thumbtack.com, or no-reply-tsc@thumbtack.com. We’ll send it to the email address associated with your Thumbtack account.
If you can’t find the email, try searching your spam folder. In the meantime, you can fill out the Account information and licensing form to get the process started, if applicable. We’ll reach out with any updates.
My account was deactivated. Can I reactivate it again?
If you voluntarily deactivated your account, you can complete the reactivation form. We’ll review your request and follow up with an update.
However, if we removed your account due to a policy or terms violation, or a Trust and Safety issue, refer to the email we sent you for details. Note that the decision may not be reconsidered.
My account was deactivated for being linked to another account. What should I do? 
If your account was removed for being linked to another Thumbtack account that was removed for a policy violation, check the email we sent you about your account’s status for more details. Your account's status won’t change until the issues with the original linked account are resolved first.
In many situations, this linked account may belong to a family member, friend, or colleague. If so, here’s what you can do:
Encourage the account owner of the linked account to resolve the issues on their account.
Once their account issue is resolved, contact us so we can reconsider your account's status.

articles.fullText:
How to manage my business insurance
[Image: Pill Pro]
Having insurance shows that you’re serious about your business and you’re ready for premium opportunities with our trusted partners.
How it works
After you submit your insurance information, we use a third-party tool (Docsumo) to process your Certificate of Insurance (COI). Once uploaded, we'll save your insurance details to your profile and send you a confirmation email to let you know if it was successfully submitted.
How to add your insurance
Follow these steps to submit your insurance information:
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Profile (from the main menu below).
Scroll down to Credentials.
Find the “Business Insurance” section and tap Add.
Tap Choose file.
Choose between Select from library, Take a photo, or Choose file.
Upload the image or document.
Select a form type (ACORD 25 or Other).
Tap Submit.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Profile.
Scroll down to Credentials.
Find the “Business Insurance” section and select Add.
Drag and drop your document, or select Choose file to upload it from your device.
Select a form type (ACORD 25 or Other).
Select Submit.
You can only upload one file at a time, but you can add multiple insurance documents by repeating the steps above.
Tip
If you get an error when trying to upload your insurance file, it may be because it's an unsupported file type or the image was too blurry.
Document requirements
To make sure the verification process goes smoothly, check that your document meets these requirements:
You can only upload and submit one file at a time. You can add multiple documents, just not all at once. You’ll need to upload and submit one document at a time.
The file format must be supported. You can upload a PDF, JPG, or PNG file up to 10 MB.
It must be a Certificate of Insurance (COI). We can’t accept quotes, invoices, or policy declaration pages.
It must be clear and easy to read. We won’t be able to use any blurry or unreadable documents.
The business name must match your profile. The business name on the document needs to be the same as the business name on your Thumbtack profile.
It must be an active policy. The document must show a valid expiration date of when the COI expires.
Managing your insurance
You can add or remove your insurance information at any time in the Credentials section of your profile. Here you’ll see the status of your insurance.
Here’s how to manage your insurance information:
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Profile (from the main menu below).
Scroll down to Credentials.
Find the “Business Insurance” section and tap Edit.
Under “Manage insurance,” tap the trash icon to delete an insurance or tap Add additional insurance to add a new one.
Tap Done.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Profile.
Scroll down to Credentials.
Find the “Business Insurance” section and select Edit.
Under “Manage insurance,” tap the trash icon to delete an insurance or tap Add additional insurance to add a new one.
Tap Done.
Frequently asked questions
What kind of insurance do you accept?
Currently we accept all business Certificates of Insurance (COIs), and we are primarily focused on General Liability Insurance. Other types, like Commercial Auto Liability, Workers’ Compensation, or Umbrella, are also accepted, as long as it’s listed on a COI.
What should I do when my insurance is about to expire? 
Your insurance information on Thumbtack is not automatically extended when you renew it. So, when you renew your policy, be sure to come back to your Thumbtack profile and manually upload your new insurance document to keep your insurance current.
Otherwise, when your insurance expires, you’ll see an “expired” status next to it. You’ll want to manually remove your expired insurance and upload your insurance again with the new expiration date.
What kind of exclusive jobs are unlocked from Thumbtack’s partners?
Some of our trusted partners prefer pros to be insured. Licensed and insured pros can get exclusive access to work with those partners, connecting directly with their customers to complete installation and maintenance jobs. Uploading your insurance can improve your chances of landing exclusive job opportunities from these partners. For example, you can unlock:
Plumbing jobs with Moen
Appliance Repair jobs with Midea (or Samsung)
Future opportunities coming soon in categories like HVAC jobs, Electrical work, and more!
What does the “Processing error” status mean?
If your COI processing failed, it means we couldn’t confirm the required information. This is usually because the file was blurry, the expiration date was missing, or it was an unsupported file type. Check the specific requirements and try submitting it again.
Will my insurance details be public?
No. We won’t share sensitive information, such as your specific policy number, insurer details, or other personal information with customers. We only save the key data required to confirm your active status and eligibility for partner jobs.

articles.summary: This guide explains how to automate lead management by connecting Thumbtack to third-party applications using Zapier webhooks for seamless data transfer.
articles.concepts: Zapier integration, webhook setup, lead automation, CRM integration, third-party apps, lead management
articles.fullText:
How to set up a Zapier webhook
Zapier allows you to link with many other applications so your Thumbtack leads can flow through to that app. Many pros use Zapier to automate their workflows, but it’s just one of many services available.
While it’s a popular choice, keep in mind that Zapier is an independent tool and isn’t a Thumbtack partner tool. This is a good option if you’re already familiar with Zapier and prefer it over our current partner tools.
Tip
Before setting up Zapier, make sure it works with your app by searching for it here. If it's not compatible, or if you'd like to explore the other options, you can search online for Zapier alternatives.
To set up Zapier, you create a webhook URL, create the webhook on Thumbtack, and create a Zap to complete the integration. We’ll walk you through how to do that with the following steps.
First, create your webhook URL
Log in to your Zapier account.
Select Create a Zap (in the top left corner).
In the upper left corner, name your Zap “Thumbtack Incoming Lead.”
Select the Webhook option to create a trigger.
Under “Choose Trigger Event,” click Catch Hook. Make sure you select Catch Hook (and not “Catch Raw Hook”).
Select Continue.
Leave the section “Pick off a Child Key” blank and select Continue.
Tip
Copy your webhook URL by finding the “Test” section in Zapier and clicking Copy.
Second, create the webhook on Thumbtack
Once you have your webhook URL ready, you can create the new webhook in your Thumbtack account.
Third, test the webhook
Once your webhook is set up, it’s a good idea to make sure your information is landing in the right place. Follow these steps on desktop to send a test lead and verify that your connection is working correctly.
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Tap your profile photo (at the top right).
Select Integrations from the drop-down menu.
Select Manage webhooks.
If you have multiple business profiles, choose the right profile from the drop-down menu.
Select Test this webhook.
Select which webhook you want to manage.
Select the Recent deliveries tab (at the top of this page) to see if the “test lead” was delivered.
Fourth, test a lead from Thumbtack
Set up the details of the lead in Zapier by following these steps:
Log in to your Zapier account.
Select the Thumbtack Incoming Lead Zap.
Select 1. Catch Hook in Webhooks by Zapier.
Select Test.
Select a recent request and click Continue with Selected Record.
Lastly, finish the setup by following these steps
Log in to your Zapier account.
Select the Thumbtack Incoming Lead Zap.
Select Action.
Search for the app you’d like to link.
Select Set up Action.
Select the inputs you’d like to include (for example, Customer Name, Customer Phone, City, State, and Zip). If you need to separate the first and last names, follow these steps from Zapier.
Click Close.
In the upper right corner, use the on/off toggle to turn on the Zap.
Once you’ve completed these steps, your Thumbtack leads will start flowing through Zapier.
When you set up an integration, you’ll have access to all the data fields included in our leads. You can see which fields are available here.
Tip
We provide you with the customer’s name and phone number on all leads (we do not provide email addresses). You can message or call customers to get additional contact information as needed.
Frequently asked questions
Can I connect my business to multiple tools?
Yes, you can integrate your business with multiple tools.
You can either create multiple zaps or create a complex workflow. If you create multiple zaps, you’ll need to set up a separate webhook for each of them.

articles.concepts: API integration, webhooks, automation, developer tools, software connection, endpoint setup
articles.aliases: URL = Uniform Resource Locator; FAQ = Frequently Asked Questions
articles.fullText:
How to create a webhook
[Image: Pill Pro]
Some pros use an extra tool to manage their leads, messages, and reviews on Thumbtack. If you want to have your Thumbtack leads flow into another tool (and that tool doesn’t already integrate with Thumbtack), try our free webhook.
Before you begin
Setting up a webhook is a technical process. If you're not comfortable with technical setups or handling raw data, this might not be the right fit for you. For a simpler experience, try one of our partner tools instead.
To get started with setting up a webhook, make sure:
You use a third-party tool that supports webhooks (that’s not a current partner tool).
You can create a URL for the webhook to connect to.
Tip
Many pros use Zapier to generate their webhook URL. While it’s a popular choice, keep in mind that Zapier is an independent tool and isn't a Thumbtack partner. Learn how to set up a webhook URL in Zapier.
Important things to know:
Each webhook setup is tied to the business profile: If you have more than one business profile, you’ll need to set up a separate webhook for each one.
It’s a one-way connection: Thumbtack sends information to your tool, but your tool can’t send information back. You’ll still need to log in to Thumbtack to respond to messages or reviews.
You choose what you’ll receive: You can choose to receive data for leads (including customer names and phone numbers), messages, and customer reviews.
You can use it with other tools: If you already use a partner tool (like Housecall Pro) but want to receive extra data like reviews, you can set up a webhook to fill that gap.
You can test your setup: When you test your connection, any test data will be clearly tagged as a "test lead" in your delivery log so you can easily spot it.
How to create a webhook
You can send your lead details, messages, and customer reviews directly to your favorite business apps. We recommend setting up the webhook in your other service first (like Zapier) so you have your URL ready to go.
Once you have your URL ready, you can create the new webhook in your Thumbtack account. If you have more than one business profile, you’ll need to set up a separate webhook for each one. Follow these steps on desktop:
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Tap your profile photo (at the top right).
Select Integrations from the drop-down menu.
Select Manage webhooks.
If you have multiple business profiles, choose the right profile from the drop-down menu.
Select Create webhook.
Fill out the information.
Click Create webhook.
Tip
We provide you with the customer’s name and phone number on all leads (we do not provide email addresses). You can message or call customers to get additional contact information as needed.
How to manage a webhook
You can update your webhook settings (like your URL or the types of data you receive) at any time. Follow these steps on desktop to edit an existing connection:
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Tap your profile photo (at the top right).
Select Integrations from the drop-down menu.
Select Manage webhooks.
If you have multiple business profiles, choose the right profile from the drop-down menu.
Select which webhook you want to manage.
Make your change.
Select Save changes.
How to test a webhook
Once your webhook is set up, it’s a good idea to make sure your information is landing in the right place. Follow these steps to send a test lead and verify that your connection is working correctly.
Every enabled webhook in your selected business profile receives the test lead. If you have multiple webhooks set up in a single business profile, they’ll all receive the test data. Follow these steps on desktop to test a webhook:
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Tap your profile photo (at the top right).
Select Integrations from the drop-down menu.
Select Manage webhooks.
If you have multiple business profiles, choose the right profile from the drop-down menu.
Select Test this webhook.
Select which webhook you want to manage.
Select the Recent deliveries tab (at the top of this page) to see if the “test lead” was delivered.
Troubleshooting a webhook
Learn how to fix common setup errors, find error codes in your delivery log, and get extra help if you still need it.
Tip
If your webhook isn’t working, try this common fix: toggle it off and back on. Then, send another test lead to see if that resets the connection.
Common reasons for webhook failures
If your webhook isn’t delivering (tagged with “Failure” status), it’s usually due to one of these common setup errors:
The URL is incomplete. A valid webhook URL must include its unique ID (the series of numbers and letters at the end). Here’s an example: Correct: https://hooks.zapier.com/hooks/catch/1234567/abcde/Incorrect: https://hooks.zapier.com/hooks/catch/
The URL was edited. If even one character is accidentally changed, deleted, or added, the connection will fail. We recommend copying and pasting the URL directly without making any changes.
How to check error details
If you’ve verified your URL and it’s still failing, you can find the specific error code in your delivery log. Follow these steps on desktop to find the error code:
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Tap your profile photo (at the top right).
Select Integrations from the drop-down menu.
Select Manage webhooks.
If you have multiple business profiles, choose the right profile from the drop-down menu.
Select which webhook you want to manage.
Go to the Recent deliveries tab.
Click a delivery with a “Failure” status.
In the popup screen, go to the Responses tab.
Look for the status code and explanation in your webhook delivery details to see what went wrong.
Still having trouble? If your setup is correct and it’s still resulting in an error, contact us.
How to delete a webhook
If you stop using a service or want to end a connection, you can delete your webhook at any time. Once it’s deleted, Thumbtack will immediately stop sending your information to that address. Follow these steps on desktop to delete a webhook:
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Tap your profile photo (at the top right).
Select Integrations from the drop-down menu.
Select Manage webhooks.
If you have multiple business profiles, choose the right profile from the drop-down menu.
Select which webhook you want to manage.
Select Delete webhook (at the bottom left).
Frequently asked questions
What do the different webhook statuses mean?
Let’s break down what the different statuses mean:
Enabled: The webhook is on and is actively sending the relevant information.
Disabled: The webhook is off and is not sending information.
Error: There is something wrong with how the webhook was set up, so the information wasn’t successfully sent.
What is an endpoint URL?
An endpoint URL is like a digital mailing address for your leads. It allows Thumbtack to automatically send lead info to your other tools so you don't have to copy and paste the details manually.
Should I add an authorization type?
It’s best to add an “Authorization type” only if you already understand what it does. Otherwise, we recommend leaving it as “None.”
Can I respond to messages through my other tool?
No. Webhook connections are one-way. Thumbtack sends information to your tool, but your tool can’t send information back. To reply to a customer, you still need to log in to your Thumbtack account.
What happens once my webhook is set up?
We’ll automatically send data to your URL whenever a selected event happens on your designated business profile (like getting a new lead). You can track everything we’ve sent in your “Recent deliveries” tab.

articles.summary: This guide explains how service providers can adjust their advertising spend limits on Thumbtack to better manage lead volume and business costs.
articles.concepts: weekly budget, lead pricing, spending limit, lead volume, pro settings
articles.fullText:
How to edit my budget
[Image: Pill Pro]
You control your spending on Thumbtack by setting both your lead prices and your weekly budget.
Lead prices: This is the exact amount you pay per lead. You can set different prices for each of your services.
Budget: This is the most you'll spend in a week for leads across all your services.
Whenever you get a new lead, you'll pay your set lead price. This cost comes out of your budget.
Pro Tip 
Looking to pick up extra jobs? Check out Opportunities. If a customer responds, the cost is separate from your budget. That way, you don’t have to worry about how it factors into your budget.
How to edit your budget
You’ll set up your budget when you add a new service. After that, you can change your budget at any time. The amount you choose covers leads for all your services.
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Services (from the main menu below).
Tap Manage your budget. (You must have job preferences turned on to see this option.)
Select the budget that’s right for you. You can choose a recommended budget, keep your current budget, select an unlimited budget, or set a custom budget amount.
Tap Save weekly budget.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Services.
Select Manage your budget. (You must have job preferences turned on to see this option.)
Select the budget that’s right for you. You can choose a recommended budget, keep your current budget, select an unlimited budget, or set a custom budget amount.
Select Save weekly budget.
Pro Tip 
Want to meet as many customers as possible? Choose the Set to unlimited option to skip setting a limit. This lets you get leads without worrying about a weekly limit.
Hitting your limit
You might not reach your budget every week — it depends on how many customers contact you from search results.
If you do hit your budget, you have two options:
Increase your budget. This takes effect right away, so you don't miss out on new customers.
Keep your budget as it is. You won’t appear in search results until your budget resets the following Monday.
Note: Once you reach your limit, you can only set a custom budget one more time for the rest of that week. You can still switch between other budget options or wait for the Monday reset.
Adjusting your prices to get more leads
If you aren't hitting your budget and want more leads, try increasing your lead prices for your top services. This makes you more competitive for the jobs you want most.
And if you hit your budget every week and want more customers, try increasing your weekly budget. You might have set your budget too low for the demand in your area.
Your lead price is one of several factors that determine how many leads you get. It’s also impacted by things like:
Your profile
Your star rating and reviews
How quickly you respond to new leads
Local demand for your services

articles.concepts: availability, business hours, calendar, hide business, scheduling, pause work
articles.fullText:
How to manage my availability
[Image: Pill Pro]
Your availability settings are a powerful tool for running your business on your own terms. Keeping your schedule updated helps you get more of the jobs you want when you want them.
There are three main ways to manage your schedule on Thumbtack:
Calendar: Block off the days you’re unavailable. This is the most effective way to prevent getting leads for dates you can't work.
Business hours: Set your typical weekly work hours to let customers know when you prefer to work.
Lead time: Control how much notice you need before a job, and how far in advance customers can schedule you.
Pro Tip 
If you’re getting leads for dates you've blocked off, check out the section below: Getting leads for unavailable times?
Use your calendar to block off dates
When you block off a day, we won't match you with customers who need to hire someone on that specific day. An out-of-date calendar is the main reason pros get leads for days they can't work.
Be sure to block off days for:
Jobs you book outside of Thumbtack
Personal appointments and events
Vacations or holidays
Tip
Since customers can request a single date or a range of dates for their jobs, marking yourself unavailable applies to the entire day. You can’t currently block off specific hours or mid-day appointments.
Keep in mind: Since external calendars are currently not able to sync with your Thumbtack account, it’s essential to treat your Thumbtack calendar as the single source of truth for your availability.
Here’s how to block off dates on your Thumbtack calendar:
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Profile (from the main menu below).
Tap the calendar icon (in the top corner).
Tap Block time for a day you're unavailable.
Select the start and end days you’re unavailable.
Tap Mark as unavailable.
Note: You may still receive leads from customers who are flexible with scheduling.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Calendar.
Select Block time next to any day you’re unavailable.
Select the start and end days you’re unavailable.
Click Mark as unavailable.
Note: You may still receive leads from customers who are flexible with scheduling.
If your schedule opens up, you can always unblock a day. Just click the date on your calendar and select Unblock this time.
[Video: How to block time on your calendar (48)]
Set your weekly business hours
Your business hours show customers your ideal work schedule and when you're most likely to respond.
Since customers can search and message you at any time, your business hours don't stop new leads from coming in. To stop leads for a specific day, you can either mark your business "Closed" in your hours or mark yourself unavailable on your calendar. Marking a day "Closed" makes it a recurring change for that day every week.
Tip
We calculate your response time during 8am – 8pm in your local time, regardless of your set business hours.
Here’s how to set your weekly business hours:
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Profile (from the main menu below).
Tap the calendar icon (in the top right corner).
Tap the three-dot menu (in the top right corner).
Tap Edit availability settings.
Select Use any open day or time if you’re always available, or select Define specific business hours to adjust your weekly business hours.
Save your changes.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Calendar.
Click Edit availability settings (at the bottom left).
Select Use any open day or time if you’re always available, or select Define specific business hours to adjust your weekly business hours.
Click Save.
Control your lead time
With lead time, you control:
How much notice you need before a job begins. This determines how quickly a customer can schedule you. This can be same-day notice or up to 7-day notice. For example, if you choose “2 days,” a customer could contact you Monday for a job that starts Wednesday.
How far in advance customers can send job requests. This determines the window customers are able to schedule you. You can set your scheduling window from 14 days ahead of the job, up to no limit.
You can adjust your lead time settings any time from your Calendar. Here’s how:
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Profile (from the main menu below).
Tap the calendar icon (in the top right corner).
Tap the three-dot menu (in the top right corner).
Tap Edit availability settings.
Under "Lead time," choose how much notice you need for a job, and how far in advance customers can schedule you.
Tap Save business hours.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Calendar.
Select Edit availability settings.
Under "Lead time," choose how much notice you need for a job, and how far in advance customers can schedule you.
Click Save.
Getting leads for unavailable days?
You may occasionally get a lead for a day you've marked as unavailable. This happens when a customer indicates their availability is flexible. We send you these leads because the customer is open to adapting to your schedule, giving you a chance to fill an open spot.
If this happens but the customer’s schedule is actually not flexible, we’re here to help. You can request a refund if the lead meets these conditions:
For jobs with a firm date (like a wedding): You can request a refund if the customer's firm date was already blocked off on your calendar and marked as unavailable in your business hours.
For jobs with a flexible date: First, message the customer to see if you can find a time that works. If the customer is not actually flexible and you can't find a time that works for you both, you can then request a refund.
Tip
Your profile introduction is valuable real estate — it’s a great place to give customers a clear picture of your business hours. This helps educate potential customers before they contact you, meaning fewer leads for times you can’t accommodate.
Taking a break?
If you’re unavailable for an extended period, the easiest way to stop receiving all new leads is to temporarily hide your business. While you’re away, you won’t have to worry about updating your calendar or responding to new customers.
Tip
Your availability is about more than just your time. A lead is only a good fit if the day, location, and job type all match your preferences. Regularly review your job preferences to make sure you're also getting leads for work you want to do, in the areas you want to work.
By keeping your calendar precise and communicating your business hours clearly in your profile, you can significantly improve the quality of the leads you receive.
Ready to take control of your schedule?
[Button: Update your calendar]

articles.summary: Explains the pilot where AI learns a pro's preferred jobs to personalize their lead preferences.
articles.concepts: personalized preferences, AI preferences, smart preferences, job matching, pilot program
articles.fullText:
What are personalized preferences?
Thumbtack preferences just got smarter, and we want you to join our pilot to try them out. In this program, our artificial intelligence (AI) will learn the types of jobs you want based on your Thumbtack activity to create personalized preferences for you (that you can review). We'll also provide you with stronger protections with the goal of connecting you with more of the jobs you want.
How it works
Here are the key details of how personalized preferences work:
Review your trades and preferences: Based on your profile, settings, and past jobs, we'll recommend the trades that best describe what you do and show you the personalized preferences we’ve learned about you. You can delete any preferences that don't feel right.
We aren’t starting from scratch: Our AI learns from your past preferences and job history. You’ll see this reflected in your new personalized preferences.
Smarter matching over time: You may see a wider variety of jobs at first as our AI learns. If you decline a lead because you can’t do the job, we’ll refund you and use that feedback to update your preferences.
Your feedback matters: The more feedback you give, the better we can match you with the right jobs. You can give feedback by selecting Can’t do it on a new lead or by liking, disliking, and deleting preferences that have been learned.
We’re here to help: You can always schedule time with us if you have any questions as you’re using personalized preferences.
Tip
When you’re a part of our personalized preferences pilot, you set a max lead price to control the most you’ll pay for each lead. Higher prices help you stay competitive for the jobs you want most.
How to opt in to personalized preferences
We're excited for you to see what it's all about. To opt in to personalized preferences, follow these steps:
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Jobs (from the main menu below).
In the Leads tab, tap Learn more (look for the banner introducing AI-generated preferences).
Tap Get your preferences.
Tap Edit trades to make changes or tap Looks good to confirm your trades.
Review your preferences, and remove any that don’t apply.
Tap Apply to leads.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Jobs.
In the Leads tab, click Learn more (look for the banner introducing AI-generated preferences).
Select Get your preferences.
Click Edit trades to make changes or select Looks good to confirm your trades.
Review your preferences, and remove any that don’t apply.
Select Apply to leads.
How to improve my personalized preferences
With each new lead, you can either reply to the customer or decline it.
When you decline a lead because you can’t do the job, we’ll refund you and use this feedback to update your personalized preferences. Our AI will build smarter matches for you as we learn your preferences.
If you can’t do the job, here’s how to let us know:
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Jobs (from the main menu below).
Open the lead.
Select Can’t do it.
Tap Yes, decline.
Let us know why you declined the job by selecting Not what I do and explain why.
Answer a few clarifying questions to help us understand the types of jobs you want.
Confirm if the new preference is correct.
We’ll apply this new preference to your future leads and refund the one you just declined.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Jobs.
Open the lead.
Select Can’t do it.
Click Yes, decline.
Let us know why you declined the job by selecting Not what I do and explain why.
Answer a few clarifying questions to help us understand the types of jobs you want.
Confirm if the new preference is correct.
We’ll apply this new preference to your future leads and refund the one you just declined.
Tip
The Can’t do it option is available only if you haven’t already chosen to reply to the customer. If you already replied to the customer but realize it’s a job you can’t do, request a refund through the typical process instead.
To adjust older preferences, follow these steps:
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Services (from the main menu below).
Scroll down to the trade you want to edit and select the option to review your preferences.
Tap the thumbs up icon to confirm a new learned preference. Or tap thumbs down to remove the preference. (Or tap the trash icon to remove any previously confirmed preferences.)
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Services.
Scroll down to the trade you want to edit and select the option to review your preferences.
Tap the thumbs up icon to confirm a new learned preference. Or tap thumbs down to remove the preference. (Or tap the trash icon to remove any previously confirmed preferences.)
Tip
If you want to remove a preference that was learned from a refund request, you’ll need to wait 45 days before you can remove it or contact us.
Enhanced protections
You get extra protections to support you through this pilot.
Skill mismatch refund: If a job doesn't match your skills, let us know by declining the new lead and selecting Not what I do. We'll make it right by refunding you.
Duplicate customer refund: If the same customer contacts you, you can request a refund (regardless of whether it's for the same job or not).
Competition limit: To improve your chances of being hired, we're limiting the number of pros a customer can contact to only two other pros (three total) within the first 24-hours.
What to expect once you opt in
Here’s what you’ll want to do after opting in to this pilot:
Check your max lead prices: With personalized preferences, your max lead prices are set to a default amount. Review and update your new max lead prices in your Services.
Continue providing feedback: The more feedback you give on leads and job preferences, the more accurate they’ll become.
Adjust your travel areas: Travel areas now apply to all of your trades and you’ll now find the option to edit them on your business profile instead.
Frequently asked questions
Can I add or remove any trades I was enrolled in?
Yes. To update the trades you're enrolled in, follow these steps:
App
Open the Thumbtack pro app.
Tap Services (from the main menu below).
Tap the three-dot menu in the top right corner.
Select Add a trade or Remove a trade.
Select which occupation you’d like to add or remove.
Confirm your changes.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Services.
Click the three-dot menu in the top right corner.
Select Add a trade or Remove a trade.
Select which occupation you’d like to add or remove.
Confirm your changes.
If you still need help with the leads you’re receiving, book a call with our team — we’re happy to help.
Can I opt out of this pilot?
Yes. You can opt-out of this pilot at any time by following these steps:
Go to your Services.
Scroll down and tap final feedback (look for the message “Not loving this pilot?”).
Let us know why you’re opting out.
Select Continue.
Confirm that you’d like to opt out.
After sharing your feedback, your account returns to the previous targeting preferences experience.
How do max lead prices work? And how do I edit them? 
Your max lead price is the most you’re willing to pay for one lead. Setting a higher price helps you stay competitive for the jobs you want most, though you’ll often pay less than your max.
While this price controls the cost of each lead, your weekly budget still limits your total spending for the week. Once you reach your weekly limit, you’ll stop getting new leads until the next week.
Follow these steps to edit your max lead prices:
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Services (from the main menu below).
Tap Manage lead prices. (At least one service must have job preferences turned on to see this option.)
Move the slider to adjust your lead prices.
Save your changes.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to Services.
Click Manage lead prices. (At least one service must have job preferences turned on to see this option.)
Move the slider to adjust your lead prices.
Save your changes.

articles.fullText:
What are leads, preset jobs, and opportunities?
[Image: Pill Pro]
There are a few ways to connect with new customers on Thumbtack. Understanding how to use these different methods to connect helps you find the right balance of work for your team while growing your business.
[Video: Access your leads (1:52)]
Leads
Leads are your primary way to connect with customers and grow your business on Thumbtack.
How they work: Leads are from customers who found you in their search results and chose to contact you directly. You receive these leads based on the job preferences you’ve set. With smart matching, you may also receive leads outside your usual preferences when our AI predicts they're a strong fit for your business.
What’s your strategic advantage: These are your most efficient path to a hire because the customer already saw your profile in their search results and are interested in working with you.
When you pay: When you receive a new lead, you pay for it automatically based on your lead prices. Your lead prices tell us how much you’re willing to spend per lead, but your budget controls your total weekly spending.
Where to find them: Go to the For you tab on your Jobs page.
Preset Jobs
Preset jobs are pre-scheduled, unassigned jobs that match your job preferences. The customer has already chosen a date and time, so you just need to claim the job to add it to your schedule.
How they work: These are available to pros who offer specific services and meet certain criteria (like having three or more reviews).
What’s your strategic advantage: Use these to instantly fill gaps in your calendar with confirmed work.
When you pay: Presest jobs have no upfront cost. Instead, a percentage of the job price is kept as a fee. You can always see your exact take-home earnings before you choose to claim the job.
Where to find them: Look below your leads in the For you tab on your Jobs page.
Opportunities (Open leads)
Check your Opportunities (also called "Open leads") for customers who’ve reached out to other pros but haven’t hired anyone yet.
How they work: Unlike other leads, Opportunities are not based on your job preferences. Browse these additional jobs and send a quote for any that look like a good fit.
What’s your strategic advantage: Grow your business by using these to pick up extra work or branch out into new types of jobs.
When you pay: It’s free to send a quote to an opportunity you’re interested in. You’re only charged if the customer responds to your quote. Learn more about paying for Opportunities.
Where to find them: Check the Opportunities tab on your Jobs page. If the customer responds to your quote, the conversation moves to your Messages.
Tip
You receive notifications for Opportunities by default. But if you’re not interested in Opportunities, you can turn those notifications off in your notification settings.

articles.fullText:
How to resolve issues with a customer
[Image: Pill Pro]
You may encounter a difficult situation with a customer. If you encounter an issue, here’s what you can do:
Feeling unsafe, threatened, or harassed
Your safety is our top priority. If you feel unsafe, threatened, or harassed, contact your local law enforcement and then contact us. Please make sure to have any information regarding the situation (emails, texts, police reports, etc.). Once we have all the details, we’ll investigate and take appropriate action.
Difficulty in receiving payment
If you’re having difficulty receiving payment from a customer after a job, please continue to request payment in a professional manner. Be understanding of potentially challenging situations that might prevent the customer from responding immediately (for example, traveling or being ill). If the customer still refuses to pay, let us know by sending us a report (see “Reporting a scam or dispute” below).
Tip
If anything else happens with a customer that makes you feel uncomfortable, let us know by sending us a report (see “Reporting a scam or dispute” below).
Reporting a scam or dispute
Reports are an important part of our trust and safety efforts and help us keep track of behavior that isn’t allowed on Thumbtack.
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Messages (from the main menu below).
Open the customer’s message.
Tap the three-dot menu (at the top).
Select Report.
In the pop-up window, select Report a scam or dispute.
Follow the prompts to let us know why you’re reporting the customer.
Tap Submit.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Messages.
Open the customer’s message.
Click the three-dot menu (above your messages).
Click Report.
In the pop-up window, select Report a scam or dispute.
Follow the prompts to let us know why you’re reporting the customer.
Click Submit.
We’ll review your report and follow up in 2–3 business days. If you need help in the meantime, contact us.

How to message customers

You’ll find new leads in your Jobs page. But once you respond to a lead, you’ll find that customer in your Messages. From there, you can reply or send a new message to keep the conversation going.

articles.title: Here’s a guide to how customers find you.
articles.fileName: Here’s a guide to how customers find you. - external - pro - EN
articles.headings: Here’s a guide to how customers find you. | Every customer has a to-do list. | Here’s how customers find you on Thumbtack. | This is what a customer sees. | Get featured as a top match | This is your business card. | Now it’s your turn.

articles.fullText:
Here’s a guide to how customers find you.
[Image: Pill Pro]
Perspective matters. See how Thumbtack works for customers — it’ll help you understand what they’re looking for and how to grab their attention.
Every customer has a to-do list.
Customers are looking for pros to help them fix, learn, make, or do something.
[Image: Home page categories]
Every customer is different. Some customers:
Know exactly what they want (and come prepared with a plan)
Look to you for the ideas and advice — you’re the expert, after all
Are somewhere in between
No matter what stage a customer is at, they come to Thumbtack to find, compare, and hire pros for their project.
Here’s how customers find you on Thumbtack.
Customers describe their project in their own words (in the app, they can even use photos). We ask a few quick questions to pin down the details, then show them pros who may fit.
[Image: Search by voice]
This is what a customer sees.
After searching for what they need, customers get a list of pros that can look something like this:
[Image: SR Phone 8-26]
You'll only show up in search results after setting your preferences. The closer you are to the top, the more likely customers will see you.
In the app, customers narrow their results by answering questions about their project before they see the list. The details they give (and the details in your profile) are what make you show up as a strong match. Filters help customers narrow down their results. The filters should look familiar: they match your job preferences. As customers pick different options, the list updates to show pros who match the job.
Get featured as a top match
To make it easier for customers to hire a pro, we sometimes feature the customer’s three “best matches” at the top of their results. Customers also see why you’re a match. Getting featured here gives you better visibility with customers who are a great fit for you.
To be featured as a best match for customers, you need to:
Have at least a 4.5-star rating,
Have at least three reviews, and
Respond to new customers in four hours or less, on average.
This is your business card.
When a customer sees you in search results, it’s like you and all your competitors are handing them business cards. The customer isn’t going to make a decision based on that alone, but it does need to get their attention.
[Image: Business card in search results]
This pro has a great card and would probably get a customer’s first click. Here are tips on how you can have a great card, too:
Great profile photo: Good lighting, solid background, professional clothing. It makes a difference.
Great reviews: The key is a large number of good quality reviews. That’s the first thing a customer checks before making their decision.
The right pro: Set your job preferences so you show up in search results for the right jobs.
Top Pro badge: Pros who reach the Platinum tier of our Thumbtack Pro Rewards program receive a Top Pro badge on their profile – so customers know they’re one of the best. Don’t worry if you haven't reached Platinum yet. Keep working towards it.
Now it’s your turn.
See how you rank in search results to see what your customers see. In your list of results, which pros stand out? If it's not you, take notes and step up your game.
Next, learn how to capture the customer's attention with a strong profile.
[Button: Guide to your profile ]
