articles.headings: How to refer a pro | How to refer a pro | App | Desktop | Frequently asked questions | Which markets are in high demand and qualify for $100? | Why do only some services and cities qualify for $100? | How long will it take for us to get the referral credit? | Can I get updates on the progress of the new pro I've referred? | How many pros can I refer to Thumbtack?
articles.summary: Explains the pro referral program where pros earn rewards for referring new pros who get their first lead.
articles.concepts: refer a pro, pro referral, referral program, referral credits, referral link, earn rewards
articles.fullText:
How to refer a pro
[Image: Pill Pro]
Know a great pro? Takes one to know one. Thumbtack is growing every day and we’re seeing a high demand for certain markets. So each pro you refer in these markets can earn you (and them) up to $100 in lead credit.
If your referral isn’t in a high demand market and doesn’t qualify for the full $100, then we’ll still add $50 to your Thumbtack balance when your referral gets their first lead.
You can earn referral credit for up to 10 pros per year — with the possibility of earning up to $1,000 in credit.
How to refer a pro
The easiest way to refer a pro to Thumbtack is to share your unique referral link. Here’s how to find it:
App
Open theThumbtack Pro app.
Tap Profile (from the main menu below).
Tap the gear icon (in the top right corner).
Tap Get up to $100.
Choose how you’d like to refer a pro.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Click your profile photo (in the top right corner).
In the drop-down menu, click Refer pros. Get up to $100.
Choose how you’d like to refer a pro.
For you to receive your referral credit, the pro you refer must sign up using your referral link and get their first lead.
Your referral must comply with our Referral Program Terms of Use. Referral credit added to your Thumbtack balance doesn’t expire, has no cash value, and is subject to Thumbtack Referral Program Terms of Use and Thumbtack’s Terms of Use.
Have a pro in mind?
[Button: Refer a pro]
Frequently asked questions
Which markets are in high demand and qualify for $100?
Market demand can change frequently. You can always check which markets are currently in high demand on your referral page.
Why do only some services and cities qualify for $100?
We’re focusing on markets where demand is currently the highest. So the credit offer amount is also higher.
If the pro you refer doesn't meet the service and location criteria for $100, you both still qualify for the $50 referral amount.
How long will it take for us to get the referral credit?
After the pro you refer signs up and gets their first lead on Thumbtack, the referral credit will be added to your Thumbtack balance.
The pro you refer receives their referral credit after they sign up on Thumbtack.
Can I get updates on the progress of the new pro I've referred?
We’ll email you when the pro you’ve referred signs up on Thumbtack and when the referral credit has been added to your Thumbtack balance.
How many pros can I refer to Thumbtack?
You can earn referral credit for up to 10 pros per calendar year. But if you know more pros who would love Thumbtack, you can always refer more.

articles.summary: Explains what a service is on Thumbtack and how pros add or remove services to reach more customers.
articles.concepts: services, add a service, remove a service, service categories, what is a service, profile services
articles.fullText:
What is a service on Thumbtack?
[Image: Pill Pro]
Set up shop
Depending on what skills you have, your service could be anything from pet sitting to house cleaning (or even both). On Thumbtack, you choose the type of jobs you can do in your Services tab.
You can add as many services as you want. When you add a new service, it requires some set up. Take a few minutes to set up your job preferences. They include:
Travel areas: It’s where you work. You decide if customers travel to you or if you travel to them. There’s an option to work remotely too.
Job types: It’s how you tell us what you do. You decide the type of customers you work with and the type of jobs you do and don’t do.
Availability: It’s when you work. Maybe your regular hours are from 9am to 5pm, or maybe you don’t have a set schedule. You choose.
Whenever a customer contacts you about a job matching all these things — your travel area, job types, and availability — you autopay for it.
Pro Tip 
You should also set up a budget and pricing (if you can) for the services you offer too.
Your activity
You can find a summary of your activity on your Services page. You’ll see an overview of your weekly spending, lead count, and profile views. For more details, check out your Performance dashboard. This interactive dashboard shows insights about your activity and how you compare to other Thumbtack pros – so you can make informed decisions about your business’ growth.

articles.summary: This article provides strategies for service professionals to optimize their business profiles and attract more customers through effective presentation and reputation building.

articles.fullText:
Cómo mejorar mi perfil
[Image: Pill Pro]
Crear un perfil excelente lleva tiempo, pero vale la pena. Su perfil lo diferencia de la competencia y ayuda a los clientes a decidir si usted es el profesional adecuado para el trabajo.
Primera impresión
"La primera impresión es muy importante, sobre todo cuando compite en línea con cientos de profesionales."
Baron L. Top Tier Fitness, Concord CA
[Video: Como crear un perfil fuerte en Thumbtack (2:19)]
Preséntese
A los clientes les gusta saber con quién están trabajando y su foto de perfil es el lugar perfecto para mostrárselo.
Muéstreles quién es usted. Coloque una foto clara y amigable de usted mismo para representar su negocio.
Encuentre una excelente imagen. Una foto de calidad vale la inversión.
Manténga un imagen nítida. Apunte a una resolución de 400x400 píxeles para obtener la mejor calidad.
La sección de introducción en su perfil es donde usted le da a los clientes muchas razones para contratarlo. Una gran introducción explica sus cualidades, lo que lo hace único y muestra su personalidad.
Consejo profesional
Hablando de la longitud, le recomendamos que haga una introducción breve. Si tiene más que añadir, agregue otros datos en la sección de Preguntas y Respuestas de su perfil.
Construya su reputación
Los clientes antes de tomar decisiones leen reseñas. Para empezar, intente obtener al menos 10 reseñas de sus clientes anteriores (en Thumbtack y en otros lugares) para generar confianza y credibilidad.
Consejo profesional
Consulte su Panel de Rendimiento para comparar sus reseñas con las de otros profesionales en su mercado. Tener más reseñas (con calificaciones altas) le ayuda a destacarse de la competencia.
Incluso después de haber obtenido algunas reseñas, aún hay más cosas que puede hacer para impresionar a los clientes. Responda a las reseñas en su perfil para que los clientes puedan ver de primera mano que usted escucha y toma en cuenta sus comentarios.
Para obtener más consejos, lea nuestro artículo de ayuda sobre cómo responder a las reseñas.
Presuma un poco
Ahora es el momento de mostrar sus habilidades, y la mejor manera de hacerlo es añadiendo fotos a su perfil. Mostrar es mejor que contar, así que tenga en cuenta estos consejos cuando se trata de fotos:
Suba imágenes o videos que hablen por sí solos. Tal vez sean imágenes de antes y después, o algunas fotos suyas (o de su equipo) en realizando una actividad.
Muestre y cuente con subtítulos en sus fotos. De esta manera los clientes sabrán lo que están viendo (y por qué usted considera que es importante).
Todo está en los detalles
Compartir detalles específicos hace que su perfil resalte. Si usted es un profesional en area de mantenimiento, no se limite a decirles a los clientes que es excelente reparando cosas. Mencione lo bueno que es colgando fotos o reparando trabajos de azulejos. ¿Es paseador de perros o profesor de yoga? Nombre su parque favorito en la ciudad, o su postura de yoga preferida.
Ya captó la idea. Son los pequeños detalles los que te hacen ser quien es.
Aprenda de otros profesionales
¿Está interesado en ver qué están incluyendo otros profesionales en sus perfiles? Obtenga más ideas para su perfil en la Comunidad de Profesionales. Una vez que haya descubierto qué funciona mejor para usted, comparta su consejo en la comunidad.
Vamos a recapitular
Muestre a los clientes quién es con una excelente foto de perfil, y una introducción.
Desarrolle su reputación con reseñas de clientes.
Agregue fotos que lo muestren su trabajo.
Comparta pequeños detalles sobre qué le gusta de lo que hace.
Aprenda de otros profesionales de la comunidad.

¿Necesita ayuda? ¡Estamos aquí para usted!
¿Necesita ayuda? Contáctenos a través de nuestra página de soporte. ¡Únase a nuestra comunidad! Conéctese con otros profesionales en la comunidad de Thumbtack en español. Comparta sus experiencias, haga preguntas y encuentre consejos útiles.

articles.fullText:
How to improve my profile
[Image: Pill Pro]
Creating a great profile takes time, but it’s worth it. Your profile sets you apart from your competition and helps customers decide if you’re the right pro for the job.
"First impressions matter a lot, especially when you’re competing with hundreds of other professionals online."
Baron L. Top Tier Fitness, Concord CA
Introduce yourself
Customers like to see who they’re working with and your profile picture is the perfect place to show them.
Show them who you are. Put a face to your business by uploading a clear, friendly shot of yourself.
Find a great picture. A quality headshot is worth the investment.
Keep it sharp. Aim for 400x400 pixels to get the best resolution.
The introduction section of your profile is where you give customers plenty of reasons to hire you. A great introduction explains your qualifications — what makes you unique — and shows your personality.
Pro Tip
When it comes to length, keep your intro short and sweet. If you have more to say, add more detail in the Frequently asked questions section of your profile.
Build your reputation
Customers read reviews before making decisions. To start, try to get at least 10 reviews from your past customers (on Thumbtack and off) to build trust and credibility.
Pro Tip 
Check your Insights to compare your reviews to other pros in your market. Having more reviews (with high ratings) helps you stand out from the competition.
Even after you’ve gotten a few reviews under your belt, there’s still more you can do to impress customers. Reply to the reviews on your profile so customers can see first-hand that you listen and take feedback. For more tips, read our help article about responding to reviews.
Show off a little
Now’s the time to show off your skills. And the best way is to add photos to your profile. Showing is better than telling, so keep these tips in mind when it comes to photos:
Upload pictures or videos that speak for themselves. Maybe it’s before and after shots or a few pictures of you (or your team) in action.
Show and tell with captions on your photos. That way customers know what they’re looking at (and why you think it’s important).
It’s all in the details
Sharing specifics makes your profile shine. If you’re a handyman, don’t just tell customers you’re great at fixing things. Mention how great you are at hanging photos or fixing tile work. Dog walker or yoga teacher? Name your go-to park in the city or your favorite yoga pose.
You get the idea. It’s the little things that make you who you are.
Learn from other pros
Interested in what other pros are putting on their profiles? Get more profile ideas in the Pro Community. Once you’ve figured out what works for you, share your profile advice in the Community too.
Let’s review

articles.fullText:
How Thumbtack works
[Image: Pill Pro]
We show customers your business, for free.
Thousands of customers come to Thumbtack each day to find pros like you. Customers describe their project in their own words (or by sharing a photo in the app) and answer a few quick questions. We show them the pros who fit their project best, and why each one is a good match.
Before customers can see you in their search results, you’ll need to finish setting up your pro account. That includes things like finishing your profile, setting up your job preferences, and adding your payment method.
Customers choose pros they like.
Stand out to customers in their search results by building an engaging profile. You can start by:
Adding helpful details about your business.
Showing impressive photos of your work.
Getting reviews from your past customers.
When a customer thinks you might be a good fit for a job, they’ll reach out. Learn more about getting leads.
Pro Tip 
Look yourself up on Thumbtack to learn how customers find you. Notice how you compare to other pros in search results – what else could you add to your profile to stand out better?
You choose your customers, too.
By setting your job preferences, you tell us the types of jobs you want. Your preferences also let us know where and when you want to work.
We'll send you leads that match your job preferences and you seal the deal with the customer. Because these leads match your preferences, you pay for them automatically.
Your business doesn't show in search results until you've set your job preferences, so it's important to start right away.
Opportunities to meet more customers.
You can also browse Opportunities on Thumbtack (it’s a section of your Jobs page). If you see an opportunity you’re interested in, send the customer a message. You only pay if they respond. The price, if they respond, is shown upfront.
Pro Tip 
Respond to leads first (since you autopay for those). Check out Opportunities when you’re looking to pick up extra jobs.
Respond quickly and get hired.
After you get a lead and the customer starts a conversation with you, it’s up to you to win the job. Review the job details and reply quickly. The faster you respond, the better your chances of getting hired.
Learn more about how to respond to leads. Also, check out our guide to responding to customers for other messaging tips.

Here’s a guide to why you should choose Thumbtack.
[Image: Pill Pro]
Want to meet customers with to-do lists? You’re in the right place.
On Thumbtack, customers find pros to help them with hundreds of types of jobs — from finishing a basement to tiling a shower to painting a nursery. And our talented pros have helped customers start over 50 million of those jobs to date.
[Image: Customer search demo]
If you’re interested in connecting with some of those customers, here’s a closer look at the how (and why) of partnering with Thumbtack.
Sign up with no stress.
We know time is a precious resource for business owners. So we’ve made the signup process as efficient as possible. To put your best foot forward on Thumbtack, follow the steps for setting up your pro account.
And that’s it. You’re ready to start hearing from customers.
Meet customers where they are.
There are thousands of customers on Thumbtack each day. And they’re here to get jobs done.
You set job preferences to tell us which jobs you want to work on and to make sure you show up in search results.
[Image: Job preferences]
Then, when a customer starts a project, they answer some basic questions about what they need done. As they add job details, their search results adjust to show pros looking for that type of job. If your preferences match what they need, they can reach out to you to take the next step.
Pay only when a customer reaches out.
The only thing you pay for is leads, which are customers who reach out to learn more about working with you. So every cent you spend here is an investment in your business.
[Image: Direct leads tab]
With other types of advertising, you have to invest up front and hope your business gets seen by the right people. On Thumbtack, you pay after a customer reaches out. That means they saw your business and liked what they saw before contacting you.
Measure your success with our tools.
You need market data to continue growing your business – and that’s where Thumbtack comes in. We have built-in tools to help you track how you’re doing. Check your Performance dashboard to get an insider’s view of your activity and market, including how you compare to other Thumbtack pros and what you can do to continue to grow.
If you’re not seeing the numbers you want, shake things up. Change your preferences to see if that affects how many leads you get. You pick where you want to work, which jobs you want, and when you’re open for business. Just remember: good things take time.
[Video: Video: Advice for new pros (1:31)]
Now it’s your turn.
With a bit of time and effort, Thumbtack can work for you. And because you can add multiple services and profiles, it can keep working — now and in the future.
Take the first step toward finding the right customers today.

articles.fullText:
How to match with a pro who fits your schedule
[Image: Pill Customer]
Finding the right pro is about more than just skills and price — it’s also about finding someone whose schedule works with yours. You may need a pro on a certain day, or maybe there’s some flexibility. Here’s how to get the best results.
Step 1: Review pro profiles for scheduling details
First, you tell us a little bit about your project, and we’ll show you a list of qualified pros. Before you contact a pro, take a moment to review their profile to get a sense of their schedule.
Look for:
Business hours: Many pros list their typical hours of operation.
Availability details: Check their introduction or bio for any mentions of their schedule (for example, "I specialize in weekend projects" or "Available for morning appointments").
This initial check can help you narrow down your list to pros who are most likely to be a good fit.
Step 2: Give clear details when you contact a pro
While you’re describing your project early in your search, we may ask about your timeline. This is the most important step for finding a great scheduling match. You'll see several options, from general timeframes like "Within a week" to "Specific dates."
Tip
Be as specific as you can when you answer. The more precise you are, the better a pro can determine if they're available for your job.
If your project has a firm date, always choose the “Specific dates” option and select the exact date(s) from the calendar.
Step 3: Decide if your schedule is flexible
When you’re asked about your timeline, you may also see a toggle that says, "I can work with the pro’s schedule if they aren't available in the time I chose."
Leave this toggle on if your timing is flexible. This is a great choice for projects that aren't time-sensitive. It tells the pro you’re open to their availability, which can lead to more matches and faster replies.
Turn this toggle off if your timing is firm. For events that must happen on a specific day (like a wedding, party, or move) turning this off is essential. It ensures you match with the right pro and the pro knows your schedule cannot be changed.
Step 4: Confirm the details in your message
Before submitting your project details, you’ll have a chance to send a message to the pro. This is a great place to confirm your scheduling needs before getting into other details.
For example:
"Hi, I'm hoping to get my TV mounted on Tuesday, September 23rd, in the afternoon. Before we discuss the project, can you confirm if that timing works for you? If not, when is your next availability in the afternoon?"
This simple step ensures everyone is on the same page from the start.
What to do if your schedules don't align
If a pro you contact isn't available at your preferred time, you still have options:
Ask about other openings. Message the pro to see if another time might work for the both of you. Their schedule may have opened up since you first connected or you may have matching availability coming up in the next week or two.
Check other pros. Take another look at the list of pros we matched you with to see if another pro is a good fit.
Know what your schedule looks like?
[Button: Find a pro]

What is a profile?
[Image: Pill Pro]
Think of your profile as your chance to make a great first impression and show customers your best work. We’ll help you set up a profile that tells your business story so you can start winning more jobs.
Nice to meet you
When you set your job preferences, customers see you in search results along with other pros. So your profile is all about making a memorable first impression. Think of your profile as your storefront on a busy street. What can you do to stand out?
Introduce yourself, tell customers why you’re right for the job, capture their attention with photos and videos, and share reviews to show how happy your customers are. A great profile can make all the difference.
Complete your profile
Your profile helps customers get to know you. And before you can meet them on Thumbtack, you need to add your name and address (both should match your ID to help us verify you’re you).
A complete profile is important, so make sure to include:
The basics. Share your business name, a profile picture (required), your phone number, and more.
Credentials. Build trust by completing a background check and listing professional licenses.
Photos and videos. Add at least five examples of your best work.
Reviews. Get reviews from past customers — the more the better. Reviews are important, so before you get started you’ll be prompted to ask for at least one review.
And that's just the start. Keep adding details like your location, accepted payment methods, featured projects, and more until it's complete.
Pro tip
Let customers know which payment types you accept by editing the Payment methods accepted section on your profile.
Sabrina J. Quote
"Seeing photos on Thumbtack profiles and talking through it with pros was really helpful."
Sabrina J. Thumbtack customer

articles.fullText:
How much do I pay for leads and opportunities?
[Image: Pill Pro]
On Thumbtack, you pay for leads — new customers who reach out to you directly.
What determines the cost of leads
Our goal is to make the cost match how valuable the job is. Prices will vary since a job’s value can change based on things like the type and size of the job, how many pros are available, and your market.
How to set your lead prices
When a customer reaches out to you directly from search results and their job matches your job preferences, you auto-pay for the lead.
You’re in control. You choose how competitive you want to be by setting your lead prices. This is the exact amount you’ll pay for each lead. Here’s how:
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Services (from the main menu below).
Tap Manage lead prices. (At least one service must have job preferences turned on to see this option.)
Move the slider to adjust your lead prices.
Save your changes.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to Services.
Click Manage lead prices. (At least one service must have job preferences turned on to see this option.)
Move the slider to adjust your lead prices.
Save your changes.
Check the cost of Opportunities
All Opportunities (also called "Open leads") show prices upfront. For Opportunities, you reach out to the customer first if you're interested in their job. You only pay the price shown if the customer responds to you.
You can check the cost of an opportunity by following these steps:
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Jobs (from the main menu below).
Tap Opportunities.
Tap View details for an open lead you’re interested in.
Find the lead fee in the banner below the customer’s name and location.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Jobs tab.
Select Opportunities (on the left-hand side).
Select View details for an open lead you're interested in.
Find the lead fee in the banner below the customer’s name and location.
Track how much you’ve paid for each lead
You can see how much you’ve paid for past leads in two places — your payment history and your Messages tab.
Your payment history will show a detailed record of every lead and Opportunity you’ve paid for over time.
Your Messages tab will show you how much you paid for a specific lead.
See how much you paid for a specific lead in your Messages tab:
App
Open theThumbtack Pro app.
Tap Messages (from the main menu below).
Tap the lead you want to check.
Tap the section that shows the lead's details (like the type of service and location), found just below the customer's name.
Look for where it says ”Paid” to see the cost.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Messages tab.
Select the lead you want to check.
Below the customer’s job details, look for where it says ”Paid” to see the cost.
Learn how to make the most of each dollar.
[Button: Guide to spending on Thumbtack]

articles.fullText:
Thumbtack x Cinch rebate terms and conditions
Thumbtack customers who also have an account with Cinch, are eligible for a rebate. This rebate comes in the form of two separate $15 rebates per 12-month calendar year.
How to redeem your rebate:
Hire a pro through Thumbtack and agree on a payment method with them. (You can pay the pro through Thumbtack or use a payment method outside of Thumbtack if you prefer.)
Get a receipt from your pro, as you’ll need a receipt to claim your rebate.
Go to the rebate request form within 30 days of payment and fill in the required information.
Thumbtack will review your rebate request within one week of submission. If eligible, you’ll receive an email from our partner Hyperwallet indicating your rebate funds are ready to be redeemed. Hyperwallet will guide you through the next steps from there.
The following terms and conditions apply to this rebate:
Your Thumbtack account must be in good standing.
Each rebate can only be redeemed on a single project. You cannot use both $15 rebates on the same project.
The total cost of the project must be greater than the rebate value (for each rebate, the project must be over $16).
The Thumbtack pro who completes this project must have an active profile on Thumbtack and must have been contacted by you through Thumbtack.
You must submit your rebate request form (following the steps above) and attach your receipt within 30 days of paying for the project.
This rebate can’t be stacked with another discount. Only one discount can be used per project.
Thumbtack reserves the right to end or revoke a discount, rebate, or promotion at our discretion.
This rebate is subject to Thumbtack’s Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.

articles.fullText:
Thumbtack Referral Program Terms of Use
[Image: Pill Pro]
Last updated March 11, 2026
Summary
When you share your referral link with someone who signs up as a new pro on Thumbtack, and that new pro gets their first lead, you’ll receive promotional Thumbtack credit, as further described below. Violating these terms may subject your account to review and removal.
Details
The Thumbtack Referral Program permits registered Thumbtack Service Professional to earn credit to use on Thumbtack for referring new professionals to Thumbtack. Except where provided explicitly herein, the Thumbtack Terms of Use and Thumbtack Privacy Policy apply fully and completely. Undefined capitalized terms used here have the definitions set forth in the Thumbtack Terms of Use. Where these Referral Terms of Service conflict with the Thumbtack Terms of Use or Thumbtack Privacy Policy, these Referral Terms of Service apply.
Sharing Referral Links
To refer a new professional, a Service Professional should share their referral link with a personal connection, who should then follow that link in order to sign up as a Service Professional on Thumbtack. Referral links may only be shared with personal connections. Referral links may not be published or distributed where there is no reasonable basis for believing that all or most of the recipients are personal connections (such as on coupon websites or public forums, or through spam).
Earning Credit
A referring Service Professional will receive promotional credit to use on Thumbtack within two weeks of a referred Service Professional who gets their first lead on Thumbtack. The credit has no cash value. The amount of promotional Thumbtack credit the referring Service Professional will receive will be specified in the communication from Thumbtack making the referral link available to a referring Service Professional.
The referred Service Professional may not be a current or former Thumbtack Service Professional. Referrals of professionals with an existing Thumbtack account, even under another name, will not qualify. Service Professionals may earn a maximum of 10 referrals per account or account owner per year.
Multiple Referrals
A referred Service Professional may use only one referral link. If they receive multiple referral links, only the Service Professional whose link was used to sign up is eligible for the promotional Thumbtack credit.
Termination and Change; Fraud or Abuse
Thumbtack may suspend, modify, or terminate this program or any Service Professional's eligibility to participate for any reason, at any time, at its sole discretion, without notice to Service Professional. In any such case, referrals initiated, but not yet completed, will not qualify for a referral credit, or will qualify under the modified program, at Thumbtack’s discretion. The most recent communication from Thumbtack making the referral link available to a referring Service Professional and the Thumbtack Referral Program Terms of Use in effect at the time a referred Service Professional creates a Thumbtack Service Professional account will govern the amount of credit a referring Service Professional receives. Thumbtack also reserves the right at its sole discretion to retract any awarded credit if a referring Service Professional is suspected of fraud, abuse, misconduct or other violations of these or the main Thumbtack Terms of Use or Privacy Policy.
Check this page frequently to ensure that you understand the Thumbtack Referral Program terms then in effect.

articles.fullText:
How to manage my featured projects
[Image: Pill Pro]
Win more jobs by showcasing your best work with featured projects. They help customers understand what you do, how long a job takes, and what it might cost.
Why featured projects matter
Your profile is a customer’s first impression of your business. Featured projects help you stand out and give customers the confidence to hire you.
Show results: Sharing photos of your best work shows customers exactly what you're capable of before they contact you.
Build trust: Highlight multiple projects to show you deliver quality work consistently.
Offer transparency: Share estimated prices to help customers understand the value of your work.
Add a featured project
Add projects you’re proud of to show customers the quality of your work. You can create featured projects for jobs you’ve completed both on and off Thumbtack.
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Profile (from the main menu below).
Under "Featured Projects," tap Add project.
Fill out the details.
Tap Save.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Profile.
Under "Featured projects," select Add new Project.
Fill out the details.
Click Save.
Pro Tip
You can also turn a review into a featured project. Go to your Reviews and select Feature this project to highlight it on your profile.
Remove a featured project
If you no longer want to showcase a specific project, follow these steps to remove it from your profile:
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Profile (from the main menu below).
Under "Featured Projects," tap the project you want to delete.
Tap Delete project (at the bottom of the page).
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Profile.
Under "Featured projects," select the project you want to delete.
Fill out the details.
Click Delete project (at the bottom of the page).
Tip
Changes to your profile can take up to 24 hours to appear to customers.
Featured project details
Show customers the full value of your work by adding these details to your featured projects:
Add a project title: Provide a clear, descriptive name so customers know exactly what they’re looking at.
Pick strong photos: Show customers more of your work by adding photos that aren’t already on your profile. Before and after photos are especially helpful for winning new jobs. You can add up to 20 photos (at least one is required). To remove a photo, select the trash icon in the corner of the image.
List the approximate price: Include an estimate so customers know what to expect. This is a required field, but we’ll let customers know this is an approximate total price.
Provide optional details: Give customers the full story by adding the location (city and state), duration, year, and a short description to your project.

articles.fullText:
How to view my Performance dashboard
[Image: Pill Pro]
Intro to your Performance dashboard
Our interactive dashboard gives you powerful data about local markets so you can make informed decisions for growing your business. You get an insider’s view of your activity and market, including how you compare to other Thumbtack pros.
Using your Performance dashboard
Your Performance dashboard is updated every Monday and provides you with the following insights:
Customer search data. See which services customers are searching for and where your business shows up so you can tailor your offerings and business profile.
Lead insights and average price. See how much you spent on leads, and learn which months of the year have heavier competition.
High opportunity areas. Find markets with less competition (more customer searches, lower saturation of pros).
Search improvement recommendations. Get tailored recommendations to improve your search ranking and get more leads.
Downloadable lead data. Download a report with comprehensive lead insights, details about the job, the customer, and performance metrics.
We want to hear from you. Share your feedback about which of these features are most important to you, and what you’d like us to add to this Performance dashboard. To share your feedback about the Performance dashboard, tap Let us know at the bottom of the dashboard.
How to view your Performance dashboard
App
Open the Thumbtack pro app.
Tap Services (from the main menu below).
Tap View business insights.
Use the drop-down menu at the top to select which services and business you want to view (if you have more than one).
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Select the Performance tab (at the top).
Use the drop-down menu at the top to select which services and business you want to view (if you have more than one).
How to download your lead performance data
Downloading your lead data makes it easier to track performance and build a workflow that fits your business. You can download a CSV file containing up to 12 months of lead information at a time.
Having this data on hand makes it easy to:
Import customers: Some invoicing and customer management software allows you to upload CSV files. So you may be able to add your Thumbtack leads, depending on your tools
Track return on investment: Compare lead costs to the revenue earned from those jobs.
Follow up with past leads: Reach out to previous customers for reviews or future work.
Optimize service areas: See where most requests come from to help strategize on travel areas and opportunities.
Simplify bookkeeping: Track lead expenses and refunds for tax season.
To download your lead performance data, follow these steps from a desktop browser.
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Select the Performance tab (at the top).
Click Download lead details in the top right corner.
Choose a business (or All my businesses) from the dropdown.
Select the time range (either Calendar year for annual data, or Date range and select specific dates).
Select Download CSV file.
Tip
Your downloaded file will include details for each lead in your defined timeframe, including the customer’s name, number, the amount you paid for each lead (including taxes, discounts, etc.), and any refunds.

articles.title: What are preset service calls
articles.fileName: What are preset service calls - external - pro - EN
articles.headings: What are preset service calls? | Tip | How it works | How to receive a payment | Pro tip | Frequently asked questions | What if I usually waive service call fees? | Am I getting hired for the repair job? | What happens if the customer’s payment is declined by their bank, do I still get paid?
articles.summary: Explains claimable jobs and service calls, which are prescheduled jobs trusted pros can claim with no lead fees.
articles.concepts: claimable jobs, claimable service calls, no lead fees, prescheduled jobs, getting paid, job claiming
articles.fullText:
What are preset service calls?
Preset service calls are a type of preset job. Like other preset jobs, they're pre-scheduled but unassigned, available to pros to claim if they would like, with no lead fees. Plus, the customer already confirmed the date and time, so there’s no need to work out any scheduling details.
Preset service calls are first-come, first-serve, and sent to our most trusted pros who:
Have 3+ reviews from Thumbtack customers (these show as "Hired on Thumbtack" on your profile)
Have at least a 4.5-star review rating
Turned on job preferences (claimable service calls are only available in certain areas right now)
Passed a background check
If you fit that description, we’ll send claimable jobs that match your preferences to the For you tab on your Jobs page where you can claim the jobs you want.
Tip
The service call fee and project details can't be changed. Learn about canceling a claimed job in our Preset Jobs Policy.
How it works
Receiving a service call
Keep an eye out and claim the jobs you’d like in the For you tab on your Jobs page. We'll also notify you when jobs are available if you have notifications turned on. View the job details for more information and to see what you’d earn for it upfront — that way you know before you accept.
During the service call
You'll inspect the customer's appliance and then provide them with your diagnosis and a quote for necessary parts and repairs. You determine your own pricing and repair costs in your quote. If the appliance is fixable, the customer can choose to hire you for the quoted work and you can work directly with the customer to figure out payment details. If you need to order parts, work with the customer to schedule your follow-up visit.
When you're done with the service call
Mark it as done in the Thumbtack app even if the repair work wasn’t completed (you only need to diagnose the issue and provide a quote). Learn more below.
How to receive a payment
Before you can get paid for a claimed service call, you need to set up direct deposit in your Thumbtack account. Once that's set up, let us know each time you complete a service call so you can receive payment. We'll also remind you to do this using your notification preferences.
Here's how you can mark a service call as done and receive payment:
Go to your Messages.
Select the customer you’re working with.
Tap the job status (found above your messages).
If you've completed the service call, mark it as done by selecting Yes, service call done.
We'll ask for more details, like whether the repair work was completed. You'll get paid for the service call even if you didn't complete any repairs. This information helps us understand job outcomes, and create better booking opportunities in the future.
Once you let us know the job is done, we’ll begin transferring your earnings to your direct deposit account. It can take 3 - 4 business days to show up in your bank account (or, for a 1% fee, earnings can be deposited instantly). We’ll send a confirmation email when the payment is deposited.
Pro tip
Use your Earnings tab to check the status of customer payments, track expected deposit dates, and troubleshoot payment issues.
Frequently asked questions
What if I usually waive service call fees?
With preset service calls, the customer has already paid to receive a diagnosis and quote for repairs, and additional payment for quoted repairs is handled outside of Thumbtack. Your pricing is unique — how much you charge for your service and how to handle service call fees is up to you.
Am I getting hired for the repair job?
The preset job in Thumbtack is a service call only. By claiming one of these jobs, you're getting hired to diagnose the customer's appliance and provide a quote for repairs. After reviewing the quote with the customer, they might choose not to move forward — however, you'll still get paid for the service call, even if you don't complete any additional repairs.
What happens if the customer’s payment is declined by their bank, do I still get paid?
Yes. We value our pros and believe you deserve to be paid regardless of a customer’s declined payment. We will cover the payment and you’ll be paid by Thumbtack.

articles.fullText:
How to add or remove a business profile
[Image: Pill Pro]
Thinking about expanding to another area or offering services that aren't related to your current profile? Adding another business profile to your Thumbtack account lets you reach all the right customers. Or if you need to remove one of your business profiles, you’re in the right place.
Tip
New to Thumbtack? Learn how to sign up as a pro to create your first business profile.
How to add another business profile
To add another business profile to your existing Thumbtack account, follow these steps:
App
Open theThumbtack Pro app.
Tap Profile (from the main menu below).
Tap the gear icon (in the top right corner).
Select Account details.
Under “Business profiles,” tap Add another business profile.
Add your service and location.
Tap Next.
Follow the prompts to create your new profile.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Account settings.
Under “Business profiles,” click Add another business profile.
Add your service and location.
Click Sign up for free.
Follow the prompts to create your new profile.
How to remove a business profile
If you need to remove one of your business profiles from your Thumbtack account, follow these steps:
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Profile (from the main menu below).
Tap the gear icon (in the top right corner).
Select Account details.
Under “Business profiles,” tap delete next to the business profile you want to remove.
Confirm that you want to permanently delete your business profile.
Tap Delete my business profile.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Account settings.
Under “Business profiles,” click delete next to the business profile you want to remove.
Confirm that you want to permanently delete your business profile.
Click Delete my business profile.
Managing multiple business profiles
When you have multiple business profiles, you’ll be able to manage everything conveniently in your Thumbtack account. Here are some things to keep in mind:
What’s shared between your business profiles:
Jobs page: Find leads and preset jobs in the For you tab, and see other open leads in the Opportunities tab.
Messages page: Conversations with your customers for all your businesses will be found here. This keeps your conversations in one convenient location so you can stay organized and respond quickly.
Profile photo: Your profile photo is shared among your profiles, so it’s best to use a profile photo that works for all your businesses, like a professional headshot.
Background check: If you've completed a background check, it automatically applies to all your business profiles in your Thumbtack account.
Payments: Your payment methods, balance, payment activity, and earnings can be viewed and managed together for all your businesses.
Quick replies: These saved messages you create can be sent to customers for all your businesses.
What’s not shared between your business profiles:
Profile page and reviews: You can switch between businesses to view and edit your profile details for each. Any reviews you receive are displayed on the business profile they’re submitted for, they can’t be transferred between business profiles.
Services page: Everything on this page will be separate for each of your businesses. This is where you’ll find the services you offer, business insights, pro rewards, availability, weekly budget, and lead prices. To see these details for a specific business, select the business name at the top of the screen.
Calendar page: You can switch between your businesses on this page to adjust your availability separately for each business.
Quote templates: These are saved messages you can quickly send to new Opportunities. Creating separate quote templates for each business lets you tailor your messages to the services you offer.
Notifications: Select a business at the top of the Notifications page to choose how you receive alerts for each one.
Tip
Need to pause leads? You can hide your business for one or all of your businesses at a time.

articles.fullText:
How to respond to leads
[Image: Pill Pro]
Focus on new leads first
What's so important about responding quickly to leads? It’s good for customers (who want to hear back from you) and it’s good for business. It helps your rank in customers' search results, so you can be seen more often. So make a habit of checking your new leads first every time you log in to Thumbtack.
Where to find your leads
To see leads where the customer reached out to you directly, check the For you tab on your Jobs page. You can also find preset jobs here.
To browse additional jobs, check out the Opportunities tab on your Jobs page. If you reach out to an opportunity and the customer responds, the conversation moves to your Messages.
Leads are labeled to highlight important details. Here are some labels to look for:
New: A lead you haven’t seen yet
Exact match: The lead matches all of your job preferences
Smart Match: The lead falls slightly outside your job preferences, but our AI predicts it's a strong fit for your business
Paid: You already paid for the lead
Only picked you: The customer hasn’t contacted any other pros yet (which means it’s a good chance for you!)
Take the next step
To learn more about a lead you received, click View details. Acting on each lead impacts your response time (even if you’re not interested), so it’s worth your time. Here’s how you can respond to a lead:
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Jobs (from the main menu below).
Select the lead you’re interested in.
Tap Reply.
Write your message, or personalize the reply we've already started for you. (You can also use a quick reply or add attachments.)
Tap Send.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Jobs.
Select the lead you’re interested in.
Select Reply.
Write your message, or personalize the reply we've already started for you. (You can also use a quick reply or add attachments.)
Click Send.
Pro tip
When you tap Reply on a new lead, we'll have a message ready to go — using details from the customer's request to give you a personalized starting point. Send it as-is, or edit it to add more personalized and detail. If you prefer to write your own message from the start, simply toggle off the AI draft anytime (in the top right corner of your reply screen). Your choice applies across all your leads until you switch it back.
If you’re not interested, don’t make the customer wait. Select Can't do it.
Pro tip
You pay automatically for leads that match your job preferences. So it's especially important to adjust your preferences from time to time to make sure you're always getting the right kinds of leads.
Once you respond to a lead, you’ll find it along with your other conversations in your Messages tab.

Can I get my balance refunded? | Is there a minimum amount I can choose to preload?
articles.summary: Explains how pros preload a balance to pay for leads and opportunities and simplify billing.
articles.concepts: preload balance, prepaid balance, simplify billing, pay for leads, balance management
articles.fullText:
How to preload my balance
[Image: Pill Pro]
Better manage your Thumbtack expenses by paying for both leads and opportunities with a preloaded balance. It simplifies billing — no more charges to your card every time you pay for a lead.
How does it work?
​​You preload your Thumbtack balance with an amount that works for you.
As leads come in, you'll pay for them using your balance until it runs out (see how much leads cost by opening your messages with the customer). If you leave auto-refill turned on, we’ll automatically reload your balance when it reaches $0, so customers can always find you.
If you turn off auto-refill and your balance runs out, you'll be charged for the leads individually until you meet your budget, or manually refill your balance.
Pro tip
Reloads aren’t on set days of the month – you’re charged when you spend your entire balance.
How to preload your balance
Follow these steps when you’re ready to preload your balance:
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Profile (from the main menu below).
Tap the gear icon (in the top right corner).
Select Payments.
Select View your balance and charges.
Next to “Thumbtack balance,” tap Add funds.
Select the amount you'd like to add. (Auto-refill is on by default, but you can turn it off by tapping the slider.)
Select Add Funds to confirm your payment.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Click your profile photo (in the top right corner).
SelectPayments from the drop-down menu.
Next to “Thumbtack balance,” click Add funds.
Select an amount to add. (Auto-refill is on by default, but you can turn it off by tapping the slider.)
Click Add Funds to confirm your payment.
Pro tip
Preloaded and auto-refilled balances are non-refundable, and they never expire. So if you have a balance, you can use it whenever you want.
How to turn auto-refill off
If you don’t want your balance to automatically refill once you hit a $0 balance, follow these steps on desktop to turn auto-refill off:
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Click your profile photo (in the top right corner).
Select Payments from the drop-down menu.
Under “Thumbtack balance,” click Edit.
Next to "Auto-refill," tap the slider (it turns gray when it's off).
Click Save.
When auto-refill is turned off, you'll use any remaining balance on leads. Then, once your balance reaches $0, your card will be charged per lead.
Pro tip
Need to update your payment method? Check out how to add or remove a credit card.
Frequently asked questions
How does this work with my weekly budget?
Your weekly budget and balance are two separate features that work together. Your budget controls how many leads you auto-pay for each week, and your balance pays for leads.
Your balance is automatically reloaded when you reach $0 if you have auto-refill on. Your budget controls how much of the preloaded balance you want to spend each week. That means if you’ve met your budget for the week, you won’t get new leads (even if you have money in your balance).
Will my balance be auto-refilled on a set schedule?
No, your balance will reload automatically whenever it reaches $0. This doesn’t happen on set days of the month.
Can I change the amount I want to preload? 
Yes. You can change the amount by editing your Billing settings. You can choose from the suggested options ($150, $200, $300) or a custom amount by selecting “other.” The next time you hit $0 on your balance, it will refill to the new amount.
I accidentally left my auto-refill on. Can I get my balance refunded?
No, once auto-refill has been preloaded, your balance is non-refundable. However, this balance never expires, so you can use it for any future leads.
You can turn auto-refill off any time by editing your Billing settings.
Is there a minimum amount I can choose to preload?
Yes. The minimum preload amount is $150 (even if you choose to enter a custom amount).

articles.fullText:
What is Front Desk?
[Image: Pill Pro]
As a business owner, a lot of your time is spent responding to customers' questions and scheduling appointments. Front Desk takes some of that work off your plate and gives you back your time.
How it works
[Video: Your Intro to Front Desk (1:58)]
Front Desk is Thumbtack’s automated lead response service. It’s designed to help you manage your messaging, so your first message to your customers is fast and automatic.
You decide how you want your business represented by customizing your first message to your customers. That first message is what Front Desk will send every time you get a lead. You can start by asking them for more details about their project, highlighting promotions you’ve got going on, or outlining their next steps. Whatever you choose, this first message is the introduction to your business. As you learn more about your customers’ needs you can adjust your message whenever you want.
Customers prefer a quick response. On average, Front Desk responds within two minutes. Day or night, your customers get fast responses — every time.
Choose from two different plans, depending on which option meets your needs. To learn more about cost and what’s included, schedule a call with a team member.
How to get started
To start, you’ll chat on the phone with a Front Desk team member. They’ll help you choose a plan that works best for you.
Next, you’ll tell us about your business and our team will create a plan with you for messaging your customers. We’ve seen that customers have reported higher satisfaction when working with pros who use Front Desk and we’re excited to help you get started.
Ready to make messaging easier?
[Button: Let's get you enrolled]
Frequently asked questions
What does Front Desk cost?
Front Desk is a monthly subscription. The cost ranges from $60 to $500 per month depending on which plan you choose. When you sign up, our team will help you pick the plan that best suits your messaging needs.
To learn more about cost and what’s included, schedule a call with a team member.
Can I make changes to my plan?
Yes, you can make changes to your plan. To make changes, fill out this form. Changes take two business days to go into effect.
Can I make changes to the messages I set up?
Yes, fill out this form and we’ll help you update your messages.
When will my subscription renew each month?
Your subscription renews automatically on the same day you signed up for Front Desk. And the day you signed up will also be the day you’ll be billed every month.
For example, let’s say you signed up for Front Desk on April 15th. You’ll be charged on April 15th and your next charge will be on May 15th, and so on (unless you make any changes to your plan).
Will you call customers for me?
No, Front Desk won't make phone calls on your behalf. Our team uses the Thumbtack messenger to chat with your new customers.

articles.summary: This article explains how Thumbtack pros can use the Opportunities feature to find and proactively reach out to potential new customers.
articles.concepts: leads, job opportunities, customer outreach, lead pricing, client acquisition
articles.fullText:
What are Opportunities?
[Image: Pill Pro]
Opportunities (also called “Open leads”) are customers who have started conversations with other pros but haven't hired anyone yet — they're still looking. While they didn't contact you directly, you may still be a great fit, so you have the opportunity to reach out to them. That's why we call them Opportunities.
Before you reach out to Opportunities, make sure you’ve finished setting up your pro account. That includes things like finishing your profile, setting up your job preferences, and adding your payment method.
Tip: Learn how to reach out to Opportunities
See an Opportunity you're interested in? Learn how to reach out to opportunities.
Understanding Opportunities
There are a few basics to understanding Opportunities and how they can benefit your business. Things like:
What's the difference between leads and Opportunities?
How much do Opportunities cost?
How do I know how many pros have contacted this customer?
Which Opportunity is the right fit for me?
Let's break it down.
What’s the difference between leads and Opportunities?
Leads are from customers who saw you in their search results and decided to reach out to you directly. You get these by setting your job preferences and telling us the types of jobs you want. You can use quick replies when messaging these customers.
Opportunities are your chance to get in front of more customers. These customers have already contacted other pros, but they haven't chosen anyone yet. You could be the one they're looking for. You can use quote templates when messaging these customers.
How much do Opportunities cost?
Opportunities have separate pricing from other leads. You’ll see the cost of the Opportunity upfront, and you’re only charged if you decide to reach out and the customer responds to your message. Learn more about paying for leads.
Your weekly budget won’t be used for Opportunities. Instead, you’ll pay for the Opportunity using your payment method when you reach out to the customer.
Has the customer already been in contact with other pros?
Each Opportunity will show how many pros the customer has contacted and how many pros have already responded to them. You can find this information by clicking View details.
How long is an Opportunity available for?
An Opportunity is no longer available to quote on if:
48 hours have passed.
Five pros have already expressed interest in the job.
The customer cancels the job.
Which Opportunity is the best fit for me?
Opportunities showing at the top of the list are likely the best fit for you — usually, they’re the most relevant and close by. The further down the list, the less relevant they become.
We may show you jobs from outside of your preferences (just in case you need more jobs to browse). You're able to adjust the distance and relevance filters from your Opportunities tab.

articles.fullText:
How to manage my travel areas
[Image: Pill Pro]
Choose my commute
Your travel area is part of your job preferences (also called "targeting"). With your travel area, you tell us exactly where you want to work.
When a customer reaches out to you about a job that matches all your job preferences (your travel area, job types, and availability), you auto-pay for the lead.
You can set up your travel area in three ways. You can:
Travel to customers
Have customers travel to you
Work remotely (depending on your service)
Pro tip
Getting leads from other states? For some services (like computer repair), you can get leads from all over the country since it can be done remotely (over the phone or the internet only). If you only want local leads for those services, you can turn the remote option off.
Travel to customers
You can set your travel distances by selecting a mile radius, counties, cities, or even zip codes.
Here's how to adjust how far you’re able to travel to your customers:
App 
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Services (from the main menu below).
Choose which service you want to edit.
Scroll down to "Job preferences."
Under "Travel areas," tap Travel to customers.
Choose how you want to adjust your travel areas: by distance or by area list.
Tap Save.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Services.
Choose which service you want to edit.
Scroll down to "Job preferences."
Under "Travel areas," select Travel to customers.
Select how you’ll adjust your travel area: Select by distance: Use the slider to adjust how far you’re willing to travel within 1 - 150 miles.Select by area and zip code: Use the drop-down menu to select cities and zip codes.Advanced: Upload a .csv of up to 1,000 zip codes. When formatting your .csv file, put all zip codes in one column, and don’t use any headings. Once uploaded, these zip codes will override any previous travel preferences you had set.
Click Save.
Pro Tip 
If you set your travel area by distance, your business address is the center of your travel radius. (You can update your address in the “Business Info” section of your profile.)
Customers travel to me
You can decide how far customers travel to work with you. This is set by distance only (you can’t pick specific areas).
Here’s how to adjust how far customers can travel to you:
App 
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Services (from the main menu below).
Choose a service.
Scroll down to "Job preferences."
Under "Travel areas," select Customers travel to me.
Using the slider, select a distance.
Tap Save.
Desktop 
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Services.
Choose a service.
Scroll down to "Job preferences."
Under "Travel areas," select Customers travel to me.
Using the slider, select a distance.
Click Save travel area.
Work remotely
If your service can be offered over the internet or phone, you’ll see the option to work remotely. This means you can get leads from customers from all over the country.
Since there are only certain types of jobs that can be done over the phone or internet (like computer repair or singing lessons), this option isn’t available for all services. So, if you don’t see this option when you’re setting up your travel area, it means remote work isn’t available for your service.
Here’s how to turn remote work on or off for eligible services:
App
Open theThumbtack Pro app.
Tap Services (from the main menu below).
Tap the service you want to edit.
Scroll down to "Job preferences."
To the right of "Travel areas," tap the three-dot menu.
Tap Edit your travel type from the menu.
A checkmark next to I work remotely (phone or internet) means remote jobs are enabled. Or, tap to remove the checkmark if you want to turn this off.
Tap Save.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to yourServices.
Select the service you want to edit.
Scroll down to "Job preferences."
To the right of "Travel areas," select the three-dot menu.
Select Edit your travel type from the menu.
A checkmark next to I work remotely (phone or internet) means remote jobs are enabled. Or, click to remove the checkmark if you want to turn this off.
Click Save.
Ready to find the right customers?
[Button: Set up job preferences]

articles.summary: Shows new pros how to sign up and set up their account to start reaching customers.
articles.concepts: sign up, register as a pro, create account, pro onboarding, join Thumbtack, getting started
articles.fullText:
How to sign up as a pro
[Image: Pill Pro]
Join our community of pros and start reaching new customers in your area. We’ll help you set up your account so you can build a profile that helps you get hired.
How to get started
Create your pro account and tell us about your services so customers can find you when they need help with a project.
App
Download the Thumbtack app.
Tap Sign up.
Tell us the service you provide and where you work.
Tap Next.
From there, we’ll walk you through how to set up each part of your account.
Desktop
Go to our pro sign up page.
Tell us the service you provide and where you work.
Click Sign up for free.
Follow the prompts to finish signing up.
From there, we’ll walk you through how to set up each part of your account.
Finish your account setup
Use the setup checklist in your account and follow the steps below to finish your profile. These steps ensure you're ready so customers can find you in search results and start reaching out about jobs.
1. Add your profile basics
Customers use your profile to decide who to hire, so it’s important to make a strong first impression.
Make sure you have:
A clear profile photo or business logo.
A short intro that explains what you do and where you work.
Basic business details, like your business name, year started, team size, and city and state.
You can learn more in our profile guide.
2. Turn on your job preferences
Your job preferences (also called "targeting") tell Thumbtack which jobs you want and how you work with customers. When your job preferences are on, customers can see your profile and choose you for jobs that match your settings.
You’ll choose:
The services you offer.
How you work with customers, like if customers travel to you, you travel to customers, or you work remotely.
Where you work, by choosing a travel area or ZIP codes.
When you work, by setting the days you’re available.
You can learn more in this guide to your job preferences.
Tip
You can check that your Job preferences are on by opening a service and making sure “Job preferences" shows as On.
3. Set your weekly budget
Your budget is the weekly spending limit for leads across all of your services. This helps you stay in control while you grow your business.
You’ll:
Choose a budget amount that fits your goals.
See if your amount meets the minimum required for your services.
If your budget’s too low for a service, we’ll let you know and guide you to choose a higher amount that works.
You can learn more about budgets or spending on Thumbtack.
4. Add a credit or debit card
You’ll need a credit or debit card on file to pay for leads.
You’ll:
Add a card in Payments.
Keep it up to date so charges don’t fail.
Learn more about payment methods.
5. Submit your background check
A background check helps build trust with customers and keeps the marketplace safe.
You’ll:
Start your background check from your account.
Submit your information through our background check partner.
It’s free to submit. If it passes, you can keep using your account as usual. If it doesn’t pass, your account will be placed on hold, and you won’t be able to get new leads or reach out to Opportunities.
You can learn more about background checks.
6. Ask for reviews
Customers read reviews to find the right pro for their job, it’s another great way to build trust with customers.
You’ll:
Send your unique review link to past customers so they can add a review to Thumbtack, or
Import reviews you’ve already collected from Google.
Learn more about using your review link or importing Google reviews.
Tip
In some markets, you’ll need at least one review before you appear in customer search results and can start getting leads.
Get ready to meet customers
Double-check your account to make sure you're visible to customers in search results. Once you check off these requirements, you’ll be live and ready to start winning jobs.
Your profile basics are complete.
Your job preferences are turned on.
Your weekly budget meets the minimum for your services.
You have a credit or debit card on file.
You’ve submitted your background check.
And, in some markets, you have at least one review.
Ready to learn more? Continue reading about how Thumbtack works.
Frequently asked questions
After I sign up, can I start meeting customers immediately? 
Before you start meeting customers, you need to tell us which jobs you’re interested in. You’ll do that by setting job preferences. You’ll also need to add a few things to your profile (like a profile photo and a review). Once your job preferences and profile are set up, you can start meeting customers.
Why do you ask me to verify my identity? 
Building trust is a critical part of running a business. This step ensures that all pros who join Thumbtack are real people ready to meet new customers. You can only enter this information once, so we recommend confirming your information when you’re signing up.
I want to become a pro on Thumbtack, but I already have an account. How do I sign up? 
If you already have a Thumbtack account, log in and follow the steps above to start meeting customers. When you’re asked to verify your email address during setup, enter the email address linked to your current account. If you don’t remember your password, or need to set one, click here.
I'm part of a larger business or franchise. Whose name and informations should be on the account? 
To help keep your account secure, the owner of the business or franchise should sign up and be listed on the account.
Do pros work for Thumbtack? 
No. We help customers find pros for their projects, but pros don’t work for Thumbtack. Instead, pros on Thumbtack set their own prices for their services and contract directly with their customers.

articles.summary: Explains how pros set service pricing, including quote sheets, base prices, and price ranges.
articles.concepts: price services, pricing, quote sheets, base price, price ranges, showing prices
articles.fullText:
How to price my services
[Image: Pill Pro]
Your pricing is unique, just like the experience you give customers. And how much you charge for your service is up to you. Not all pros price the same, but it’s worth adding prices. They help us match you with the right jobs.
What’s in your price
Your price is more than just cost. It shows how much you think your work is worth. Depending on the kind of services you offer, you can provide a base price or a price range.
Base price
Your base price is the standard amount you charge. It’s usually an hourly rate, flat fee or something similar, depending on your service. Some services have add-ons too, which are extras or optional services you provide. Let’s look at some examples:
A DJ might set an hourly fee as a base price, and could offer add-ons like a fog machine at an extra cost.
Or a housecleaner might have one flat fee for 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom homes and charge a higher flat fee for larger homes with three or more bedrooms.
Minimum price
For eligible services, you can set the minimum amount you require to do a job. You’ll have three options to choose from:
Number of hours (at your standard rate): The minimum hours you require, priced using your usual base price.
Number of hours (at a different rate): The minimum hours you require, and priced at a different hourly rate than your base price.
Specific dollar amount: The minimum dollar amount you charge.
Tip
If the service is eligible for minimum pricing, you’ll see a Minimum required toggle at the bottom of your service’s price page.
Price range
For services that are complicated to price without visiting the job site, you’ll set a price range.
For example, a roof repair pro might set a minimum and a maximum price per square foot (allowing some wiggle room for things like the cost of materials).
How customers learn your pricing
Customers will talk about pricing with you after they reach out and share their project details. You can also share your pricing in the Business FAQs section of your profile.
Why pricing is important
Your pricing helps you get matched with the right jobs.
Pro Tip
If you need to talk to the customer or see their project in person, suggest an in-person estimate as a next step.
Adding prices helps you get matched with the right jobs.
Set or update your prices
Ready to set or update your prices? Follow these steps:
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Services (from the main menu below).
Select the service you’d like to update.
Tap What customers pay.
Fill out your price information.
Tap Post Prices or Update prices.
Desktop 
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to Services.
Click the service you’d like to update.
Click What customers pay.
Fill out your price information.
Click Post Prices or Update prices.
Select Hide Prices to remove your prices from your profile. Any changes you make to your pricing will be updated immediately.
Let us know if the price is right. Follow the steps above to set your prices, then select Give us feedback at the bottom of the page.
You know what you're worth.

How to add or remove a service
[Image: Pill Pro]
Do it all (and more)
Many pros on Thumbtack have many talents. To help you meet more customers, you can add more than one service to your profile to show off all your skills.
For example, if you already offer piano lessons, you can add piano tuning as a service too. When a customer sees your profile, they’ll see reviews and hiring info for both services.
Pro Tip 
Do you want to add a new service, but don’t want it on the same profile as your other services? Add a new business profile to keep unrelated services on separate profiles.
Add a service
When you add a new service, we’ll walk you through setting up job preferences for it. You’ll auto-pay for leads that match your preferences, so set it up for the types of jobs you always want. You can adjust your preferences anytime in the Services tab. Learn more about how job preferences works.
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Services (from the main menu below).
Select + Add service (at the bottom of the page).
In the search bar, type the service you want to provide (we’ll suggest a few based on what you enter).
Choose the service you want to add from the drop-down menu.
Follow the prompts to finish adding the service.
Desktop 
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Services.
Select + Add Service (at the bottom of the page).
In the search bar, type the service you want to provide (we’ll suggest a few based on what you enter).
Choose the service you want to add from the drop-down menu.
Click Next below.
Follow the prompts to finish adding the service.
As you’re adding a new service, you’ll be asked to set up a few things like job types, travel areas, availability, lead prices, and a budget. We’ll guide you through everything you need to do to get started.
Tip
Looking for more jobs? Learn about improving your rank to get more leads.
Remove a service
If you just need to take time off, you can either turn off job preferences or pause your leads anytime you need to. But, if you’ve decided to stop offering a service, follow these steps:
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Services (from the main menu below).
Select the service you want to remove.
Tap Deactivate this service (at the bottom of the page).
In the pop-up, tap Remove.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Services.
Select the service you want to remove.
Click Remove this service (at the bottom of the page).
In the pop-up window, select Remove.

articles.concepts: ranking, improve rank, search position, visibility, ranking factors, get seen
articles.fullText:
How to improve my rank in search results
[Image: Pill Pro]
Your rank
You show up in search results after you finish setting up your pro account. And where you show up in the results is determined by what we call your rank. Your rank matters because customers are more likely to view your profile if you’re near the top of their results.
Pro Tip
You can see how you rank in search results.
Increase your visibility
If you’re looking to improve your rank, focus on providing a great customer experience. As you provide great customer experiences, you’ll find you rank better too.
Not sure where to start? Focus on these things:
Be responsive. Communicating quickly and helpfully with customers can help your rank. As you consistently accept and respond to new leads, we’ll take the hint. You’re telling us you’re available and looking for more work. And a fast response rate also helps — you up your odds of getting hired by responding quickly.
Get reviews. Your review rating and the number of reviews on your profile are factored into your ranking. But remember, great reviews follow great service. Don’t focus too much on the numbers. Learn how to ask customers for reviews.
Build an engaging profile. Your profile is the first impression you make on customers. Introduce yourself, describe what you do, and catch their attention with high-quality photos and videos (including a profile picture). Over time, you rank better in results as customers engage with your profile.
Adjust your lead prices. Your lead prices are the exact amount you’ll pay per lead. Setting competitive prices helps you show up higher in search results and get more of the jobs you want.
Pro Tip 
Your rank is influenced by other pros in your market. Check your Performance dashboard to see how you compare to other Thumbtack pros and what you can do to stay competitive.
To make it easier for customers to hire a pro, we may feature a special “three best matches” section at the top of their search results. Getting featured here is a great way to increase your visibility. To be eligible for this section, focus on these key areas of the customer experience:
Have at least a 4.5-star rating,
Have at least three reviews, and
Respond to new customers in four hours or less, on average.
And remember, your rank is just one part of finding success on Thumbtack. It can take time to improve, but it comes along with offering great service — and that’s something you control.

articles.fullText:
Here’s a guide to spending on Thumbtack.
[Image: Pill Pro]
Every dollar counts. So how do you make the most out of what you spend on Thumbtack?
Invest in the jobs you want.
Think about your ideal job — not just the jobs you can do, but the jobs that add the right value to your business. Those are the types of jobs you should include in your job preferences. That way, your money goes to finding the best customers for your business. And remember, all leads are eligible for our Thumbtack Quality Commitment.
[Image: Job preferences]
Learn how you’re covered.
All leads are backed by Thumbtack’s Quality Commitment. That means:
Phone Number Guarantee on all leads you've paid for — so you’re always able to get in touch with the customer.
A competition limit that keeps you from competing with an unlimited number of pros for leads.
Want to learn more? See how our Quality Commitment works and all the ways it benefits you.
Lead with your business goals.
Are you trying to grow your business or just looking for a few customers to fill in your books?
Think about how many customers you want to find your business each week on Thumbtack. Use that to set your lead price. As you adjust how much you want to spend, we’ll tell you how far that amount could go and recommend a good budget for you.
Remember, your lead price is the exact amount you’ll pay for a lead. And your weekly budget is the most you’ll spend in a single week.
[Image: Weekly budget slider]
Tip
Our goal is to make the cost match the job’s value. Learn more about how much you pay for leads.
Add your payment method.
Add your credit or debit card and we’ll remember it for future payments. You can add multiple cards, but we’ll charge the card marked as your “default.”
[Image: Add credit card screen]
Track your progress.
Take a look at your spending patterns and see if they line up with your business goals. Are you meeting enough customers, or should you rethink your lead prices or budget? Do you get enough value from your jobs, or should you adjust your job preferences?
You’ll find the information you need to answer these questions in your payment history.
Pro Tip 
To print or download your receipts on desktop, go to your Payments and select the Receipts tab. Click any charge to save and download the detailed receipt. Or click Download at the top of the list to download your receipts for a specific year or date range.
Now it’s your turn.
Grab a pen and paper, and write out your business goals and how much you're willing to spend. Then put them into action with your job preferences, lead prices, and budget.
Target the best jobs to get the most for your money.
[Button: Guide to job preferences]
