articles.fullText:
What is the Thumbtack Pro Rewards program?
[Image: Pill Pro]
We’re proud of our pros on Thumbtack. You provide a great experience for your customers and we want you to know your effort doesn’t go unnoticed – we see you.
Thumbtack Pro Rewards recognizes your hard work, helps you grow your business the way you want, and lets you earn rewards and access exclusive resources as you go.
How it works
Pro Rewards is made of three tiers: Silver, Gold, and Platinum.
You qualify for these tiers by meeting the quality requirements and by earning points as you accept jobs and respond to new leads. We’ll go over how to do that later in this article.
Not only do these tiers recognize your great service but they also come with rewards! Here are some examples of the rewards you can receive:
Success workshops and events.
A Top Pro badge on your profile once you reach Platinum.
Thumbtack swag (if you’re celebrating a one-year anniversary with Thumbtack during a qualifying period).
Marketing support.
How to check your current Pro Rewards progress
You can check on your progress any time by following these steps:
App
Open the Thumbtack pro app.
Tap Services (from the main menu below).
Tap Pro rewards.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to your Services.
Select Pro rewards.
Tip
You can also check your Pro Rewards status from your profile by selecting View details in the “Your path to Top Pro” banner.
On your Pro Rewards page, you can select Silver, Gold, or Platinum to explore the requirements and rewards for each tier.
Qualifying periods
There are four qualifying periods per year: December to February, March to May, June to August, and September to November.
Once you qualify for Silver, Gold, or Platinum status, you get those rewards for the rest of that qualifying period as well as the next one (each period lasts three months). For example, let’s say you qualified for Platinum at the end of July. You’d then have Platinum rewards through November.
To maintain your status, you need to continue to meet the points and quality requirements associated with that tier. If you haven’t met the requirements to stay in that tier, your status will be adjusted after the next period. We’ll notify you if you qualify or if there are any adjustments to your Pro Rewards status.
How to earn points
You earn 100 points for every lead or Opportunity you respond to after the customer messages you.
You can also earn 600 points for adding an integration (linking your Thumbtack account with one of our partner platforms). These partners provide a variety of services, from managing your contacts to responding more quickly and optimizing your daily operations.
Depending on how many points you’ve earned, you can qualify for a Pro Rewards tier:
300 points for Silver.
1,200 points for Gold.
2,400 points for Platinum.
Points earned across multiple services are counted collectively, and may take up to 8 hours to post to your account. At the start of each qualification period (every three months), they reset to 0.
How to meet the quality requirements
You also need to meet the quality requirements in order to qualify for Pro Rewards. Put simply, quality requirements are met by providing a positive experience for your customers. Select each option below to see how we’ve defined these requirements:
Complete a background check
Taking a background check not only helps you earn rewards, but it can also improve your chances of getting hired by building trust and confidence for your customers.
Include at least one photo on your profile
Photos are a great way to show off your best work so customers can visualize what their projects can look like with your help. If you have more than one profile on Thumbtack, you need at least one photo on each. Learn more about adding photos and videos to your profile.
Respond to customers within one hour
Your response rate shows the percentage of leads you respond to within an hour (between 8am - 8pm local time). That means if you get a lead at 10 pm, you have until 9am the next day to respond for it to count toward your response rate. If you have more than one service on Thumbtack, your response rate includes how quickly you respond across all services.
For Pro Rewards, we look at your response rate for the three previous months. You can check out your response rate and how you compare to your market in your Performance dashboard.
These are the response rates needed to qualify for each tier:
Silver: No requirement
Gold: 65% response rate
Platinum: 75% response rate
(Note that it may take up to 8 hours after responding to a lead for it to impact your response rate.)
Maintain a high star rating
Your rating is calculated on a three-month rolling period, using verified reviews you’ve received from Thumbtack customers from the past 12 months. These reviews are marked as "Hired on Thumbtack". These are the star ratings needed to qualify:
4.5 for Silver
4.6 for Gold
4.7 for Platinum
Rewards
Each tier comes with rewards to celebrate your hard work. And each tier receives the rewards of the tier below it, as well! Click through the tabs below to explore what you can receive.
Silver
Meet the quality requirements and get at least 300 points to qualify for the Silver tier and earn the following rewards:
Success workshops
Once a period, join a Success Workshop and learn best practices from experienced success coaches, like how to make your targeting preferences work for you, how to respond to customers effectively, and more.
Go to your rewards page to see if you’re eligible to sign up. You should also receive an email with a link to sign up and reserve your spot. If the workshop has already passed, watch for the next one.
Thumbtack Swag
Pros celebrating their one-year anniversary on Thumbtack are eligible to receive swag when they reach Silver, Gold or Platinum status.
Gold
Meet the quality requirements and get at least 1,200 points to qualify for the Gold tier. You’ll receive all of the Silver rewards, plus these rewards:
Priority Support
Go to the front of the line when you reach out to support agents by chat or text. Contact us.
Partnership Committee
Help shape Thumbtack’s future by participating in things like quarterly surveys, focus groups, and more.
Marketing Courses
Each period you can take courses from experienced marketing experts to help you grow your business. Cover topics like digital marketing strategy, social media, and more.
If you’re eligible, you’ll see the registration link in your rewards page. You should also receive an email with a link to sign up and reserve your spot. If the course has already passed, watch for the next one.
Platinum
Meet the quality requirements and get at least 2,400 points to qualify for the Platinum tier. You’ll receive all of the Silver and Gold rewards, plus:
Featured Expert
As a Top Pro, you have the chance to be featured in Thumbtack marketing materials. Let us know if you’re interested.
Top Pro Badge
Show off all your hard work with a Top Pro badge.
The Top Pro badge is a trusted symbol of reliability that's displayed on your profile and in search results. Customers look for it as a symbol of high-quality service and great customer service.
Your Top Pro status
When you qualify for the Platinum tier, customers will see your Top Pro badge in their search results and in your profile.
You can also earn a Top Pro badge for the year if you’ve earned Platinum status in at least two of the four periods of that year.
[Image: Top Pro status for the year]
Join the Pro Community to learn more about Thumbtack Pro Rewards and tell us what you think.
Frequently asked questions
What does “member status” mean?
You’re enrolled in Thumbtack Pro Rewards, but you haven’t met the requirements for one of the rewards tiers yet.
Keep responding to leads and providing quality service to customers and you could qualify for Silver, Gold, or Platinum status.
If I choose to hide my business, what will that do to my status?
If you hide your business, you won’t appear to customers in search results, which may limit your ability to qualify. However, you will still have access to the rewards you’ve already earned.
What do customers see?
For pros who’ve reached Platinum, customers will see a Top Pro badge on their profile. For Silver and Gold, the status will only be visible to you.
How do I get Thumbtack swag?
Swag is sent through Adcentives West, our third-party swag partner.
Only pros celebrating their one-year anniversary on Thumbtack are eligible to receive swag when they reach Silver, Gold or Platinum status. When you’re eligible for swag you’ll receive an email with instructions on how to order the item that you want. This will need to be done within the program period you are celebrating your one-year anniversary.
Note: Your email address will be shared with Adcentives West when you select your gift and you may receive promotional emails from them. And, you are limited to one swag item.
Anything else I need to know?
In order to qualify for the Pro Rewards program, you must remain in compliance with Thumbtack’s Terms of Use. Any attempt to circumvent or otherwise manipulate your qualification (in Thumbtack’s sole discretion) will disqualify you.
Thumbtack may change the terms and conditions of the Thumbtack Pro Rewards program at any time and for any reason, with or without notifying you. None of Silver, Gold, or Platinum status have any cash value.

articles.fullText:
What is the Thumbtack Guarantee?
[Image: Pill Customer]
We share our pros’ commitment to delivering exceptional customer experiences. That’s why with the Thumbtack Guarantee, we offer Money-Back and Property Damage protection. Search for and hire pros on Thumbtack knowing you’re covered by our Thumbtack Guarantee.
The Thumbtack Guarantee provides coverage if your project wasn’t finished as expected (up to $2,500) and coverage for accidental property damage.
If you’re a pro, learn what the Thumbtack Guarantee means for you.
Eligibility
Money-Back Guarantee
If your project was completed in a way that’s considerably different than the outlined agreement, you’ll need to meet the following requirements to be covered by the Guarantee. Terms apply:
You placed the request and hired the pro through Thumbtack.
You have a contract or document showing the terms of the agreement.
You hired the pro within 30 days of placing their request.
You discovered the problem within 6 months of the pro being hired and notified us within 45 days of noticing the issue.
Property Damage Guarantee
In order for your damaged property to be covered by the Guarantee, you’ll need to meet the following requirements. Terms apply:
You must provide proof that you hired the pro no later than 30 days after you submitted your request and before the work begins.
You must file your Guarantee request within 14 days of discovering the damage.
The damage must be a result of services rendered based on your original Thumbtack request (i.e. it must fall within the scope of the project).
Damages cannot have occurred or been reported more than six months after the Proof of Hire.
The claim must consist of physical property damage, not faulty installation or unsatisfactory work.
How to begin a Guarantee request
If you have a dispute with a professional that meets the requirements above, please report your concern here. We’ll put you in contact with the professional so you can work towards a resolution.
What to expect after submitting a Guarantee request
1. Thumbtack will reach out to you within two business days to connect you and the professional in a monitored, neutral environment so you can try to resolve the issue before going further. This can be especially effective in cases where the original dispute stemmed from a misunderstanding. 2. If this is unsuccessful, we’ll review your eligibility for the Thumbtack Guarantee. If you’re eligible, you’ll be invited to submit an official Guarantee request with some additional documentation regarding your dispute. (Note: depending on the nature of requests involving property damage, Thumbtack may ask a third-party partner to conduct an on-site evaluation of the damages.) 3. We’ll notify you if the Guarantee request is approved and request your payment information so we can send your payout. You should receive your payment within 30 days after your request is approved.

articles.fullText:
What is instant deposit?
[Image: Pill Pro]
Instant deposit allows you to have more control over your finances. Access your earnings within 30 minutes or less — even on weekends and holidays.
How does instant deposit work?
Eligible pros with direct deposit set up can choose to receive their earnings within 3 - 4 business days for free. Or, for a 1% fee, they can choose to deposit their earnings instantly. We’ll always let you know in advance if prices or fees change.
Instant deposit can be used for any job equal to $50 or more.
How to become eligible for instant deposit:
Complete and pass a background check
Background checks are free and easy, and we handle everything for you. All you need is your Social Security number (SSN) or a photo ID, like a passport or driver’s license.
Have one verified Thumbtack customer review
You can schedule review requests for any Thumbtack customer you’re working with. Reviews from Thumbtack customers are labeled as “Hired on Thumbtack” and you can have an unlimited number.
Learn how to ask for reviews.
Receive three successful direct deposit payouts
To qualify for instant deposit, you must have had at least three successful payouts with direct deposit. It’s possible to receive multiple transactions batched together in one payout from Stripe, our payments partner. If your payments were batched together, it counts as a single payout.
Receive at least $1,000 in payments through direct deposit
You can receive the $1000 from one job or from multiple jobs.
Once you’ve successfully reached these milestones, you can begin using instant deposits.
How to get started
Once you’ve completed these three requirements, we’ll let you know when you’re eligible for instant deposit. Follow these steps to get set up:
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Profile (from the main menu below).
Tap the gear icon (in the top right corner).
Tap Earnings.
Tap Update (next to “Deposit accounts”).
Add your debit card information.
Tap Save debit card.
Standard payouts will be sent directly to your bank account. A debit card is required for instant deposits.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Click your profile photo (in the top right corner).
Select Earnings from the drop-down menu.
Click Update (next to “Deposit accounts”).
Add your debit card information.
Click Save debit card.
Standard payouts will be sent directly to your bank account. A debit card is required for instant deposits.
How to cash out
Once you initiate your instant deposit, your earnings will be sent to the bank account associated with your debit card within 30 minutes.
Here are a few things to remember:
There is a 1% fee per transaction taken from your payout, automatically.
You must have direct deposit set up on your account to receive your earnings.
There is a $5,000 daily limit for instant deposits.
To initiate a payout, follow these steps:
App
Open the Thumbtack Pro app.
Tap Profile (from the main menu below).
Tap the gear icon (in the top right corner).
Tap Earnings.
Tap Deposit (next to “Available for instant deposit”).
Tap Deposit.
Desktop
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Click your profile photo (in the top right corner).
Select Earnings from the drop-down menu.
Click Deposit (next to “Available for instant deposit”).
Click Deposit.
Earnings are only available to instantly deposit within the first 24 hours of the customer paying you, so initiate them quickly. If there aren’t any funds available, you can check back the next time you get paid to initiate the deposit.
Frequently asked questions
Why don’t I have any available funds to instantly deposit?
Once you have direct deposit set up, your earnings are deposited into your bank account automatically after a standard processing time (usually 3 - 4 business days). Once your bank starts processing your payout (24 hours after the customer pays you), that payout is no longer eligible to instantly deposit.
If you want to deposit your earnings instantly, make sure to check your Earnings page and initiate your payout quickly.
What debit cards can I use to instant deposit?
We use Stripe to process payouts. Here are the current banks that support instant deposits through Stripe.
Are there fees for depositing earnings instantly?
Fees will never be hidden. We try to minimize fees wherever we can, and today our standard payouts cost nothing — we’ll always let you know if this changes. For instant deposits, there is a 1% processing fee for each instant deposit.

What is a verified business?
[Image: Pill Pro]
[Image: Pill Customer]
Last updated: September 29th, 2021
What is a verified business?
Have you noticed some profiles say “Verified business?” We use these profile badges to help customers identify when a business or franchisor is verified. The verified business badge is only available to a select group of pros.
A business or franchise can become verified when certain qualifications are met, like years in business, financial history, and whether the business is incorporated.
Pro tip
Once a business name is verified, it can’t be changed. If you’re a Thumbtack pro who needs to update their verified business, please fill out this form.
Qualifications
Verified businesses on Thumbtack must meet the following criteria at the time they are checked:
Business name and address verified by our third-party vendor’s database
Incorporated for 2 or more years
No bankruptcies within the last 5 years
No unsatisfied liens or judgments of more than $100
No liens greater than $5,000 within the last 5 years
The parameters above apply to small- and medium-sized businesses only. Thumbtack may verify larger corporations under alternative standards that are more appropriate for businesses of their size.
Lien information for all businesses is based only on publicly filed information located by our third-party vendor at the time of verification.

articles.fullText:
Understanding sales tax charges
[Image: Pill Pro]
[Image: Pill Customer]
Thumbtack is required to apply sales tax according to local laws. Taxes are based on location and type of service.
Here's how sales tax impacts you:
If you’re a pro: When you pay for a lead or an opportunity, you may also pay sales tax on that transaction. The tax you pay is based on the location of your business associated with your account.
If you’re a customer: When you pay a pro through Thumbtack, we’ll automatically apply any applicable local sales tax to your total. The sales tax you pay is based on the location where the Thumbtack pro provided services (often this is your home).
For both pros and customers: Sales tax is an additional charge and doesn't affect what the pro earns for the job. Thumbtack handles reporting and sending the tax collected, so you don't need to take any action.
Frequently asked questions
Pro and customer
Why am I getting charged sales tax?
Sales tax is required on applicable transactions in certain jurisdictions.
How do I know if sales tax applies to me?
Sales tax regulations vary by location and the services being performed. Check with your local government to understand how you may be affected.
Does Thumbtack keep the sales tax I pay?
No. Thumbtack doesn’t keep any portion of the sales tax collected. All tax collected is sent to the local tax authorities in compliance with local tax laws.
What should I do if I think the sales tax has been added by mistake?
Some services aren't required to pay a sales tax, depending on specific job details. If you think sales tax has been added by mistake, contact us for help.
Pro
Does sales tax affect my job earnings?
No. Any applicable taxes are automatically added to the amount you charge for the service, so your earnings are not affected.
Which address is used to determine sales tax?
Sales tax on lead fees is based on your business address.
Is sales tax included in the cost of lead fees?
No. Sales tax is calculated and added separately from the lead fee, where applicable. This approach helps you to understand exactly what you’re paying for.
Customer
Which address is used to determine sales tax?
Sales tax regulations are based on the address where the job is completed, or where the pro performs work for you. Usually, this is the location of your home.
Is sales tax included in the amount quoted by the pro?
No. Sales tax is a separate charge.

articles.fullText:
Thumbtack user guidelines
[Image: Pill Pro]
[Image: Pill Customer]
Thumbtack is a melting pot of people coming together to accomplish their goals. While you use Thumbtack, remember we’re all human. Treat others with respect and follow the guidelines below.
Guidelines for both pros and customers
As you create your account, make sure you:
Are at least 18 years old.
Are located in the United States.
Are providing real and accurate information when filling out your account (i.e. name and/or contact information).
Don’t barter or exchange a service for another service.
Don’t create a test account.
Make or receive payments in U.S. dollars.
If you have any questions about these guidelines, see our Terms of Use.
Guidelines for customers
When putting a job on Thumbtack, please respect our pros. Make sure you:
Don’t use profane or sexually suggestive language in your job request.
Are providing real and accurate information about your job request (no fake or fraudulent information).
Don’t submit job requests: Asking for sexual services.Asking for illegal services or involving illegal activitiesFor full-time jobs or internship positions.Advertising or offering your own service.For services that aren't on Thumbtack.
Guidelines for pros
When building your business on Thumbtack, make sure you:
Don’t use profane or sexually suggestive language in your messages or on your profile.
Don’t offer fraudulent, sexual, illegal, or otherwise inappropriate services.
Are providing real and accurate information when filling out your account (i.e. name and/or contact information).
Fill out your account and business details primarily in English.
Offer your service in the United States or in a U.S. territory
Are qualified, as required by law, to perform the services you’re offering on Thumbtack (this can vary from state to state).
Provide services, not products (although products accompanying services are permitted).
Don’t offer lending services.
Offer a service currently listed on Thumbtack. Check out our Events, Home, Lessons, Wellness, and More categories to see what services are available.
Work directly with the customer (no referral or third-party services).
Don’t ask customers to download additional apps or complete duplicate request forms outside of Thumbtack.
Don’t offer duplicate services.
Understand and take full responsibility of how Thumbtack charges work.

Opting Out of Thumbtack Text Messages

articles.fullText:
Thumbtack Earnings Chargeback Protection Terms and Conditions
[Image: Pill Pro]
With Thumbtack Earnings Chargeback Protection, we have your back. When you complete a job receive earnings through Thumbtack, we’ll protect you from unsupported credit card chargebacks.
What is an “unsupported chargeback”?
A chargeback happens when a customer asks their bank to reverse or cancel a payment. For example, if a customer pays with a stolen credit card and the card owner disputes the charge, that’s a chargeback.
Click below to learn about each type of chargeback
Unsupported chargebacks
An unsupported chargeback is when the customer doesn’t provide Thumbtack with any supporting documentation as to why the payout should be reversed or canceled.
Supported chargebacks
A supported chargeback is when the customer provides Thumbtack with supporting documentation as to why the payout should be reversed or canceled.
Chargebacks are different from refund requests. A refund request is when a customer contacts Thumbtack directly with information and documentation as to why a refund is warranted. A refund request is not covered under the Thumbtack Earnings Chargeback Protection.

Thumbtack Guarantee Terms and Conditions
[Image: Pill Pro]
[Image: Pill Customer]
Last Updated: February 28, 2025
THE THUMBTACK GUARANTEE
The Thumbtack Guarantee (“Guarantee”) includes two parts, each of which are subject to the limitations, exclusions, and conditions of these Guarantee Terms, including the Limit:
(1) Money-Back Guarantee: When a Responsible Service Professional materially deviates from the material terms of the Thumbtack Scope of Work Agreement, if such deviation is not corrected by the Responsible Service Professional within a reasonable time following formal notification of the deficiency from the Consumer, Thumbtack, in its sole discretion, agrees to pay the Consumer the lesser of:
(a) the total amount paid to the Responsible Service Professional by the Consumer; or
(b) the amount reasonably required to remedy the material deviation from the Scope of Work Agreement;
(2) Property Damage Guarantee: Thumbtack agrees to pay Consumers when a Responsible Service Professional fails to do so to repair or replace Covered Property subject to a Covered Property Loss.
RELATIONSHIP TO THUMBTACK TERMS OF USE AND PRIVACY POLICY
All capitalized terms used but not defined in these Guarantee Terms shall have the same meanings as in Thumbtack’s Terms of Use and Privacy Policy. Except as may be explicitly provided herein, nothing in these Guarantee Terms shall be construed to invalidate any part of the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy, which shall remain in full force and effect.
IN PARTICULAR, THE THUMBTACK TERMS OF USE CONTAIN A BINDING ARBITRATION PROVISION AND CLASS ACTION WAIVER. IT AFFECTS YOUR LEGAL RIGHTS AS DETAILED IN THE ARBITRATION AND CLASS ACTION WAIVER SECTION. PLEASE READ THE TERMS OF USE CAREFULLY.
You acknowledge and agree that by using the Platform, you indicate you have read, and that you understand and agree to be bound by, these Guarantee Terms.
NATURE OF THE THUMBTACK GUARANTEE
THE THUMBTACK GUARANTEE IS NOT INSURANCE. NO USER, CONSUMER, SERVICE PROFESSIONAL, OR OTHER THIRD PARTY IS AN INSURED OR OTHER THIRD PARTY BENEFICIARY UNDER THESE TERMS OR ANY INSURANCE POLICY. TO THE EXTENT ANY SUCH PARTIES DESIRE PROTECTION BEYOND THE SCOPE OF THE THUMBTACK GUARANTEE, THEY MUST PURCHASE INSURANCE THAT WILL PROVIDE SUFFICIENT COVERAGE.
PLEASE REVIEW THIS DOCUMENT CAREFULLY. CONSUMERS MUST COMPLY WITH ALL OF THE REQUIREMENTS AND CONDITIONS OF THE GUARANTEE TERMS TO BE ELIGIBLE TO RECEIVE ANY PAYMENTS. FAILURE TO FULLY COMPLY WILL PREVENT RECOVERY FOR ANY COVERED LOSSES.
NO CONSUMER, SERVICE PROFESSIONAL, OR OTHER PERSON, OTHER THAN THE CONSUMER WHO MEETS THE CONDITIONS OF THESE GUARANTEE TERMS WITH RESPECT TO THE CORRESPONDING COVERED LOSS, HAS ANY RIGHTS UNDER THESE GUARANTEE TERMS OR ANY OTHER MATERIALS OR REPRESENTATIONS REGARDING THE THUMBTACK GUARANTEE. THERE ARE NO THIRD PARTY BENEFICIARIES TO THESE GUARANTEE TERMS OR ANY OTHER MATERIALS OR REPRESENTATIONS REGARDING THE THUMBTACK GUARANTEE.
DEFINITIONS
In addition to terms defined within the text of these Guarantee Terms, the following capitalized terms shall have the following meanings:
“Covered Losses” means and is limited to the following:
(a) For the Money-Back Guarantee: The lesser of the total amount paid to the Responsible Service Professional by the Consumer or the amount reasonably required to remedy the material deviation from the Scope of Work Agreement;
(b) For the Property Damage Guarantee: Only Covered Property Losses;
“Covered Property Loss” or “Covered Property Losses” means and is limited to direct physical loss or physical damage incurred to Covered Property as a direct and primary result of the negligence of a Service Professional in providing Pro Services to a Consumer, or to another recipient at the request of a Consumer, in the Territory. It does not include loss or physical damage incurred to property owned, leased or otherwise in the direct care and oversight of the Service Professional or his or her agents, employees, or subcontractors.
“Covered Property” means and is limited to real property or personal property located at the fixed site or sites in the Territory where a Service Professional provided Pro Services to a Consumer or to another recipient at the request of a Consumer, or within 100 feet of such site, to the extent of such person’s interest in such property, and excluding all Excluded Property.
“Electronic Data,” means films, records, manuscripts, drawings or photographs, data, information, audio or video recordings, files, facts, programs or other materials stored as or on, created or used on, or transmitted to or from, computer software, including systems and applications software, hard or floppy disks, CD-ROMs, tapes, drives, cells, data processing devices, cloud storage, or any other media which are used with electronically-controlled equipment.
“Excluded Property” means any of the following:
(1) automobiles, except through an auto-service project request category, or other transportation vehicles or forms; watercraft (including, but not limited to, boats, yachts, jet skis, and similar craft), aircraft, spacecraft, satellites, and drones; (2) currency, money, precious metal, notes, or securities; (3) Animals; (4) commercial crops or timber, mines, dams, dikes, and levees; (5) property in transit; (6) Fine Arts; and (7) Electronic Data, other than as provided below.
“Fine Arts,” means paintings, etchings, printed photos, pictures, tapestries, rare or art glass, art glass windows, valuable rugs, statuary, sculptures, antique furniture, antique jewelry, bric-a-brac, porcelains, antique automobiles, coins, stamps, other collectibles, collections, furs, jewelry, precious stones, precious metals, and similar property of rarity and/or historical value. “Fine Arts” also includes exposed films, negatives, records, manuscripts, drawings, and audio or video recordings in other than digital format that would not constitute Electronic Data.
“Incident” means all events or occurrences arising from a common nucleus of operative fact.
“Limit” means the following:
(a) For the Money-Back Guarantee: (1) For any qualifying initial request for Pro Services made before 11:59 PM, December 31, 2024: One Thousand Dollars (US $1,000) per Incident for Covered Losses;(2) For any qualifying initial request for Pro Services made on or after 12:00 AM January 1, 2025; Two Thousand Five Hundred United States Dollars (US $2,500) per Incident for Covered Losses;
(b) For the Property Damage Guarantee: (1) For any qualifying initial request for Pro Services made on or after 12:00 AM May 8, 2020; One Hundred Thousand Dollars (US$100,000) per Incident for Covered Losses;
“Ordinary Wear and Tear” means the deterioration in condition of property that occurs under normal use and conditions.
“Project” is limited to necessary work by a Responsible Service Professional for the Responsible Service Professional to fulfill its duties under the Scope of Work Agreement.
“Reimbursement Amount” means the following:
(a) For the Money-Back Guarantee: Covered Losses computed as of the date of the loss not to exceed the Limit. Any Reimbursement Amount payable under the Money-Back Guarantee will be reduced by the amount already paid by others for all or any portion of a Covered Loss, including but not limited to payments made to Consumers directly by or on behalf of a Service Professional or other source (such as another responsible party);
(b) For the Property Damage Guarantee: The lesser of the Repair Value or Replacement Value of a Consumer’s Covered Property as calculated by Thumbtack in its discretion not to exceed the Limit, computed as of the date of the loss and subject to the following: (i) For devices that store Electronic Data, the Reimbursement Amount will be limited to the blank value of the data storage device plus the reasonable cost of copying information from backup or from originals of a previous generation, if any backup exists. The Property Damage Guarantee does not cover Electronic Data, so costs of research, engineering, or restoring or recreating lost information will not be paid.(ii) Any Reimbursement Amount payable under the Property Damage Guarantee will be reduced by the amount already paid by others for all or any portion of a Covered Loss, including but not limited to payments made to Consumers directly by or on behalf of a Service Professional or other source (such as another responsible party).
“Repair Value” means the amount it would cost to repair damaged or destroyed Covered Property as a result of a Covered Loss, measured on the date of occurrence of such Covered Loss, with material of like kind and quality, with proper deduction for obsolescence and physical depreciation and less any amount already paid or payable by any insurance policies.
“Replacement Value” means the amount it would cost to replace damaged or destroyed Covered Property as a result of a Covered Loss, measured on the date of occurrence of such Covered Loss, with material of like kind and quality, with proper deduction for obsolescence and physical depreciation and less any amount already paid or payable by any insurance policies.
“Responsible Service Professional” means the following:
(a) For the Money-Back Guarantee: a Service Professional (1) with whom a Consumer directly connected on the Platform, (2) who is the direct and primary cause of Covered Losses;
(b) For the Property Damage Guarantee: a Service Professional (1) with whom a Consumer directly connected on the Platform, (2) whose negligence is the direct and primary cause of Covered Losses.
“Scope of Work Agreement” means a written agreement in any form, including but not limited to messaging or email correspondence, entered into by a Consumer and a Responsible Service Professional prior to commencement of any work on a Project that memorializes the material terms of the Project.
“Thumbtack Guarantee Payment Request Form” means Thumbtack’s form to request payment under this Thumbtack Guarantee.
“Territory” means the United States of America, including territories.
THE MONEY-BACK GUARANTEE
(1) The Money-Back Guarantee is limited to the Limit, and it applies only to Consumers. This means that project costs, repair costs, or other costs or losses in excess of these amounts per Project will not be covered, and Thumbtack will accept reimbursement requests only from the person who, using the Platform as a Consumer, requested work and hired the Service Professional through Thumbtack. (2) The Money-Back Guarantee covers only the lesser of the total amount paid to the Responsible Service Professional by the Consumer or the amount reasonably required to remedy the material deviation from the Scope of Work Agreement. (3) To be covered by the Money-Back Guarantee, Consumer must provide Proof of Hire. This Proof of Hire must include the original request on Thumbtack and the quote provided by the Service Professional as well as any one of the following:
(a) On-platform messaging and documentation confirming, as determined in Thumbtack’s sole discretion, that the Consumer agreed to hire the Service Professional for a project.
(b) Off-platform communications between the Consumer and Service Professional confirming, as determined in Thumbtack’s sole discretion, that the Consumer agreed to hire the Service Professional for a project.
(c) A copy of a contract, invoice or other project document agreed to by Service Professional and Consumer demonstrating, in Thumbtack’s sole discretion, that the Consumer agreed to hire the Service Professional.
(d) Any other information that Thumbtack, in its sole discretion, determines is sufficient to show a Consumer agreed to hire the Service Professional.
This Proof of Hire must demonstrate that the Consumer hired the Service Professional no later than 30 days after the Consumer submitted their initial request for Pro Services and prior to work actually commencing.
(4) The Consumer must have completed a Scope of Work Agreement listing material components of the project prior to any work commencing. (5) The Money-Back Guarantee covers costs for projects scoped through the Thumbtack platform only. This means that add-on projects or other projects outside the bounds of the job originally requested on Thumbtack are not covered. (6) Thumbtack will first require Consumers to make a good faith attempt to resolve any claims of damages with the Service Professional. Most covered issues can be resolved amicably, and we are here to help. Before the Money-Back Guarantee applies, we will first try to help Consumers resolve problems with Service Professionals directly. (7) Other conditions apply. Please read this document carefully to understand how the Money-Back Guarantee works. In particular, please review sections addressing MB Excluded Losses and Conditions and Eligibility.
While the above restrictions are important, you should also review this entire document to understand how the Thumbtack Guarantee applies to Consumers and how it works.
Money-Back Guarantee Limitations and Exclusions
The Money-Back Guarantee does not pay for losses to property or bodily injury. Nor does it pay for losses arising from or in any way related to any of the following (“MB Excluded Losses”):
(1) losses that are a normal, usual, or natural part of the work undertaken; (2) Acts of nature, including but not limited to earthquakes and weather-related events (3) losses not directly caused by a Service Professional, including but not limited to consequential damages, special damages, interruption of business, opportunity costs, loss of market, loss of use, and losses or damages associated with the unauthorized acquisition of or access to Electronic Data; (4) theft or other intentional acts and mysterious disappearance, loss, or shortage disclosed on taking inventory, or any unexplained loss of inventory; (5) enforcement of any law or ordinance; (6) animals, including injuries to animals, veterinary care, boarding, medications, and all other services associated with animals; (7) losses, damages, costs or expenses of whatsoever nature, directly or indirectly, caused or partially caused by war or terrorism; (8) lack of electricity, fuel, water, gas, steam, refrigerant, sewerage, telephone or internet services due to external factors; (9) the following conditions:
(a) previous faulty workmanship, material, construction or design from any cause;
(b) deterioration, depletion, rust, corrosion or erosion, inherent vice, or latent defect;
(c) Ordinary Wear and Tear;
(d) damage caused by insects, animals, or vermin (including pets);
(10) losses, damages, costs or expenses of any nature that are incurred or reported more than six months after the Proof of Hire demonstrates that the Service Professional was hired; (11) any fraudulent, deceptive, collusive, or otherwise illegal activity by, between or among Consumer and/or Service Professional, as determined in Thumbtack’s sole discretion.
Losses arising from or in any way related to work undertaken outside of the Scope of Work Agreement shall also be an MB Excluded Loss. Money-Back Guarantee Conditions and Eligibility

THE PROPERTY DAMAGE GUARANTEE
(1) The Property Damage Guarantee is generally limited to the Limit, as defined herein, and it applies only to Consumers. This means that losses in excess of this amount per Incident will not be covered, and Thumbtack will accept reimbursement requests only from the person who, using the Platform as a Consumer, requested work and hired the Service Professional through Thumbtack. (4) Losses must be incurred as a direct result of work requested on Thumbtack and must be caused by the negligence of a Service Professional. This means the Property Damage Guarantee covers property damage directly and primarily caused by the negligence of a Service Professional in the course of performing the work requested by the Consumer on the Platform. (5) Thumbtack will first require Consumers to make a good faith attempt to resolve any claims of damages with the Service Professional. (6) Before making a payment under the Property Damage Guarantee, Thumbtack will first require Consumers to obtain payment from any applicable insurance policy or policies, seek and fail to obtain payment from any applicable insurance policy or policies, or certify that no applicable insurance policy exists. Property Damage Guarantee Limitations and Exclusions
The Property Damage Guarantee pays Covered Losses only and does not pay for losses to property arising from or in any way related to any of the following (“PD Excluded Losses”):
(1) work undertaken outside the scope of the work specifically provided by the Consumer on the Platform at the time of the job request; (2) losses that are a normal, usual, or natural part of the work undertaken; (3) Excluded Property; (4) acts of nature, including, but not limited to, earthquakes and weather-related events, unless the Service Professional's negligence was the sole and immediate cause of the vulnerability responsible for a weather-related loss to property and the Consumer did not fail to take reasonable steps to remediate the vulnerability prior to the weather-related loss to property; (5) losses not directly caused by a Service Professional, including but not limited to consequential damages, special damages, interruption of business, opportunity costs, loss of market, loss of use, and losses or damages associated with the unauthorized acquisition of or access to Electronic Data; (6) losses or damages other than straight Repair Value or Replacement Value related to sentimental items such as family heirlooms or photographs; (7) losses, damages, or deterioration arising from any delay; (8) theft or other intentional acts, and mysterious disappearance, loss, or shortage disclosed on taking inventory, or any unexplained loss of inventory; (9) enforcement of any law or ordinance; (10) animals, including injuries to animals, veterinary care, boarding, medications, and all other services associated with animals; (11) identity theft or identity fraud; (12) losses, damages, costs or expenses of whatsoever nature, directly or indirectly, caused or partially caused by war or terrorism; (13) lack of electricity, fuel, water, gas, steam, refrigerant, sewerage, telephone or internet services due to external factors: (14) the following conditions:
(a) previous faulty workmanship, material, construction or design from any cause;
(b) deterioration, depletion, rust, corrosion or erosion, inherent vice, or latent defect;

(d) damage caused by insects, animals, or vermin (including pets);
(15) losses, damages, costs, or expenses of whatsoever nature directly or indirectly arising out of or relating to mold, mildew, fungus, spores, or other microorganism of any type, nature, or description, including but not limited to any substance whose presence poses an actual or potential threat to human health. (16) losses, damages, costs, or expenses of any nature directly or indirectly arising out of the consumption, serving or furnishing of alcohol or other controlled substances, even if foreseeable. IN ORDER TO BE ELIGIBLE TO OBTAIN PAYMENT UNDER THE PROPERTY DAMAGE GUARANTEE, CONSUMERS MUST FULLY COMPLY WITH EACH OF THE FOLLOWING CONDITIONS. articles.fullText:
Thumbtack Code of Conduct 
[Image: Pill Customer]
[Image: Pill Pro]
At Thumbtack we pride ourselves on helping customers get their projects done and helping pros grow their businesses. In order to provide the best experience for everyone on Thumbtack, we have a few simple guidelines that we expect our users to follow.
Pro Code of Conduct
Treat customers with respect. Respond to calls and emails, show up on time, and conduct yourself professionally. If a problem arises, be calm and respectful, and try to work it out. Do good work. Take pride in your work and make sure you’re qualified to do the work you’re offering. Price fairly. Set prices for your work and materials fairly. Be honest. Respect the integrity of the Thumbtack platform. Return deposits for work you didn’t complete. Be honest with customers when something goes wrong. Be a good community member. Do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, disability or other inappropriate discriminatory factors.
Customer Code of Conduct
Treat pros with respect. Respond to calls and emails, and respect your pro's time. If a problem arises, be calm and respectful, and try to work it out. Be fair in how you review work. Before criticizing a pro’s work, take a step back and consider whether your expectations were clear at the outset. Pay what you owe. Pay what you owe, period. Be honest. Don’t waste a pro’s time if you have no intention of doing a project. Be honest with pros when something goes wrong. Deal with pros in good faith. Be a good community member. Do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, disability or other inappropriate discriminatory factors.

articles.concepts: profile optimization, customer communication, getting reviews, business success, photo uploads, pro tips
articles.fullText:
Start off on the right foot
[Image: Pill Pro]
You’re getting everything pulled together to build a great profile, so now’s a good time to learn about these three ways to get started on the right foot.
Respond to your customers quickly
You caught the customer’s eye, and they reached out. Now what? Show them you’re the best by responding quickly and helpfully — from the very first message until the job’s done.
Here are the four things you need to know about responding to customers:
Respond quickly — sooner is better. On average, pros who respond within one hour are twice as likely to be hired.
Keep up on new messages with push notifications from the app.
Make a habit of responding to new leads first.
Write customized messages that make a clear path forward for the customer.
Pro tip
Learn more about these four messaging tips for responding quickly.
Improve your profile
There’s more you can do to increase your chances of getting hired, like getting reviews and adding photos to your profile.
Get Reviews
Reviews are often the first thing customers look for on your profile. That’s why when you first sign up on Thumbtack, you’re asked to get at least one review before you can start meeting customers.
There are three ways to ask customers for reviews: scheduling a review request and sharing your review link.
Add photos
Photos and videos help customers visualize what they can achieve, with your help. And they’re also a great way to show customers your skills. Try to add a good mix of photos and videos that show you (or your team) and your best work.
You’re on your way to a winning profile and we’re here to help. To watch tutorials and get more tips, check out our video library — starting with the Make the most of your profile section.

Screening on Thumbtack
[Image: Pill Pro]
Thumbtack pros who are available through Local Services by Google have been subject to Thumbtack’s screening process.
That means that a person associated with that pro account has:
Submitted personal information to one of Thumbtack’s national vendors.
Had their identity verified.
Taken and passed a criminal background check.
If Thumbtack finds an individual has a serious conviction or is a registered sex offender, they are not permitted to use the Thumbtack platform. Learn more about smart hiring on our Safety page.

Safety tips for paying a pro
[Image: Pill Customer]
As you plan your project and payment, keep these tips in mind:
Put it in writing. Talk to the pro about writing out a contract before they start the work. This is especially helpful for large or expensive projects. A contract sets expectations and keeps you and the pro on the same page.
Keep track of each payment. If you paid a deposit, or if you’re making several payments, keep your receipts in case you need them later.
Communicate with the pro regularly. Check-in with the pro at different stages of the job so you know about any updates or changes to the cost.
Contact us if there are problems. For example, if a pro asks you to overpay so they can give you a cash refund, that’s usually a red flag.
If you run into any problems with a pro, let us know. Learn more about resolving issues with a project.

articles.fullText:
Refund policy for customers
[Image: Pill Customer]
Cancellations and refunds for On-Demand bookings
For On-Demand bookings, you enter your payment information upfront, but you’re not charged until the work is done. The following sections explain whether you’re not charged or if you’ll need to request a refund. Here’s what you need to know:
Cancellations
You cancel the booking:
If you cancel more than 24 hours before the project start time, you won’t be charged for the booking or cancellation fee.
If you cancel less than 24 hours before the project start time, you’ll be charged a nonrefundable $15 cancellation fee, but you won’t be charged for the booking itself.
The pro cancels the booking:
If the pro cancels more than 48 hours before the project start time, we’ll automatically look for another pro for you. If no one is available for your original time and day, we’ll cancel the booking and you won’t be charged.
If the pro cancels less than 48 hours before the project start time, we’ll cancel the booking and you won’t be charged. Then you can go ahead and create a new booking by choosing a different pro to complete your project if you’d like.
Tip
If your plans have changed, learn how to reschedule or cancel a booking.
No-shows
If the project start time has passed and the pro didn’t show up, contact us. If the pro hasn't shown up by one hour after the project start time, we recommend reaching out to the pro but you can also reach out to us for help.
If the project start time has passed and the pro indicated that you didn’t show up, then you’ll be charged a $15 nonrefundable no-show fee. We might have already charged you for the booking, if we did then we’ll refund you. If we haven’t charged you yet, then you won't be charged.
If you were charged for the booking but you and the pro have decided not to move forward, contact us. Depending on the circumstances, we may be able to send you a refund.
Tip
If you’re concerned about safety or work quality issues, please report a problem or contact us.
Frequently asked questions for On-Demand booking refunds
Will I be charged if I don’t get matched with a pro?
No. If we can’t match you with a pro, we’ll let you know and you won’t be charged.
Why was I charged a cancellation fee?
You’re charged a $15 cancellation fee if you’re a no-show or if you cancel a booking less than 24 hours before the project is scheduled to start. It's often difficult for pros to replace your canceled booking with a new booking if you cancel late, so we use this fee to compensate the pro for their time.

articles.fullText:
Ranking 101 
[Image: Pill Pro]
[Image: Pro Goals Course Header]
About this lesson
Learn what rank is on Thumbtack and ways you can improve it for added customer visibility.
Section 1: The basics
Section 2: Get seen
Section 3: Ranking factors
Section 4: Review
⏱️ Estimated course length: 20 minutes
[Image: Ranking the basics]
Section 1: The basics
Part 1: What is rank 
Put simply, your rank is where you appear in Thumbtack search results.
For example, take this search for a handyman. The pros who appear at the top have the best rank.
[Image: Handyman search results]
Part 2: Why rank is important 
It’s all about visibility. The more customers who see your business, the more potential jobs you can get.
Even if every customer just scrolls past your business, you're getting free advertising — and that’s great for building brand recognition.
🗒️  Try it 
Activity: Look up your rank in search results. Are you one of the first pros a customer sees? Take note of which businesses appear near the top and why they might be coming up first.
[Image: Get Seen]
Section 2: Get seen
Part 1: When you appear
Before you can appear in search results, there are a few things you need to do.
🔎  Zoom in
Set targeting preferences. They help you get seen by the right customers in search results.
Decide how much to spend. It's based on how many customers you want to hear from each week.
Get a review. Customers not only rely on reviews, they expect them. You need at least one to appear in search results.
🗒️  Try it  
Activity: Review your targeting preferences.
When your travel area matches the customer’s, you appear higher in their search results.
Your job types correlate to the filters customers use to narrow search results.
Keep your available times open to match with more customers.
Part 2: When you don't appear 
There might be a few reasons why you’re not appearing.
🔎  Zoom in
Is targeting on? If you’re actively looking for more customers, make sure targeting is on so you appear in search results.
Is your budget maxed out? If you reach your budget before the week is over, you’ll stop appearing in search results.
Are you available? When your availability is limited, you show up in fewer search results. Only mark off the times you know you aren’t free.
💡 More ideas
Sometimes you need a break. Hide your business from search results if you want to hit pause for a bit.
Mark your calendar. Keep your day-to-day business hours open. Use your calendar to block off busy days.
Measure your views. Check your Insights to see how often your business appeared in search results (shown as “Listing Views”).
Part 3: Ups and downs 
Your rank changes all the time, based on a number of factors. Some are in your control and some aren’t. For now, let’s focus on what the customer controls.
🔎  Zoom in
You’re eligible to appear in a customer's search results when your business matches:
The job. You can appear in a customer’s search results if they’re looking for a service you offer.
And the location. You can appear in a customer’s search results if they’re in your area.
🗒️  Try it
Activity: Look up your rank in search results again. But this time, pay attention to whether your rank varies when you change your zip code, service, and add filters.
What the customer searches for and where the job is located aren’t in your control. In the next section of this lesson, we’ll explain what you do control.
[Image: How to improve]
Section 3: How to improve
Part 1: Offer a great experience 
Rank ultimately comes down to one thing: the experience you provide.
🔎  Zoom in 
We try to measure the experience you provide a number of ways. Ranking factors include your:
Reviews
Responsiveness
Pricing
Customer engagement
Profile
📖  Let’s go deeper
The key is using these ranking factors to your advantage. Because we can’t be there on the job with you, we rely on these measurements to understand what it’s like working with you.
Part 2: On the rise
Let’s level set. There’s no perfect formula for a better rank, but knowing how rank is determined helps you focus on what's important.
You may rank higher than another pro when:
You have more reviews. And your review rating is high ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ — five stars or close to it.
You’re quick to respond. Respond to new customers within four hours, but try to be even faster.
You have prices and they don’t. Adding prices helps us match you with the right jobs.
Your profile and business gets more engagement. The more engagement, the better.
Part 3: Competitive markets 
In areas where there are many highly-rated pros, it’s difficult to snag a top spot in search results. That’s okay, it means the demand in your area is high.
🗒️  Try it 
Activity: Go to the “How you compare” section of your Insights and compare yourself to other pros. Pay particular attention to popular pros in your market and look for ways you can improve.
Tip: Use the “By Service” drop-down menu to view reports for all your services.
🔎  Zoom in
Keep up with the competition. The goal isn’t necessarily the top spot, but you should try to keep up with other pros in your market.
Take it one spot at a time. Focus on the pro just ahead of you in search results. Then, show customers (and us) you offer a better customer experience. Your hard work will pay off.
[Image: Lets review]
Section 4: Let's review
Part 1: What you just learned 
Way to go, you’re a rank expert! Now you know how to make your rank work for you to get the most visibility for your business.
[Image: Ranking Checklist gif]
Part 2: What's next 
That’s a wrap! Thanks for taking the time to complete this course. We hope it helped you reach your goals. And remember, you can keep learning by visiting:
Thumbtack Help: A library full of help articles to browse at your pace.
Pro Resources: If you prefer to watch videos, this is the place to go.
Pro Community: Get your questions answered by other pros and start conversations, too.

Pro guide to the Thumbtack Guarantee
[Image: Pill Pro]
To help Thumbtack customers feel confident when using Thumbtack we created The Thumbtack Guarantee.
The Thumbtack Guarantee includes our Money-Back and Property Damage guarantees. The Money-Back Guarantee covers up to $2,500 if the customer’s project wasn’t finished as expected, and the Property Damage Guarantee covers damage to customers’ eligible property – giving them peace of mind when hiring a pro on Thumbtack. Increased customer confidence will result in more projects submitted on Thumbtack and more business for pros like you.
Frequently asked questions
If I can't finish a job, you'll step in and pay the customer for me? 
The goal of the Thumbtack Guarantee is to give customers peace of mind if something goes wrong. As a pro, you should do everything you can to work with the customers who hire you on Thumbtack. Pros who don’t do their part to complete projects and refuse to work with customers when problems arise may be removed from our site.
What does the Thumbtack Guarantee mean for pros? 
The Thumbtack Guarantee means more customers will come to Thumbtack to complete their projects, bringing you even more business. Customers have told us it makes them feel more confident and they will be more likely to hire a pro on Thumbtack than ever before.
I have insurance that covers my business. Where does the Thumbtack Guarantee come in? 
The Thumbtack Guarantee doesn’t replace your insurance or change any legal insurance requirements. More generally, the Thumbtack Guarantee doesn’t replace your insurance. As part of the Guarantee process, we’ll always encourage customers to work out their issues directly with professionals. If an issue arises, we hope that you’ll be able to resolve things with the customer without drawing on your insurance. If you and the customer cannot reach a resolution, the customer may file a Thumbtack Guarantee request.

Personal information rights requests
[Image: Pill Pro]
[Image: Pill Customer]
You can learn about how your personal information is collected, stored, and shared in our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.
At a high level, Thumbtack’s pros and customers may have the right to:
Request to know what personal information we have about them.
Request to delete personal information that we have about them.
Request to opt out of having their personal information sold and shared for targeted advertising purposes.
What does this mean for you?
You’ll be able to submit a request to access or delete your personal information, or to opt out of Thumbtack selling or sharing your information. The requests available to you may vary by state, so we’ll fulfill these requests as determined by your state of residence. It may take up to 45 days from receipt for us to process your request to access or delete your personal information. It’s important to understand that honored deletion requests will result in the deletion of your Thumbtack account.
Note for customers Opting out of allowing Thumbtack to sell or share your information means that we won’t disclose your project details to anyone outside of the pros that you specifically choose. You can still use Thumbtack, but since we won’t be able to share your project, it may be more difficult to find pros.
Note for pros Since it may take up to 45 days for us to process your deletion request, you can manually deactivate your account to prevent receiving and getting charged for leads on Thumbtack in the meantime.
Submit a request to know or delete your personal info
If you want access to your personal information or if you want to delete your personal information, fill out the Data Retrieval or Deletion Request. The requests available to you may vary by state, so we’ll fulfill these requests as determined by your state of residence.
Submit a request to opt out of Thumbtack selling or sharing your personal information
If you want to opt out of Thumbtack either selling or sharing your personal information for targeted advertising purposes, submit your request here. The requests available to you may vary by state, so we’ll fulfill these requests as determined by your state of residence.
Frequently asked questions
How can I update or correct my personal information?
You can update your personal information as a pro, like your password, profile photo, phone number, email address, and address. Or you can update your personal information as a customer, like your password, profile picture, phone number, and email address.
If you need to update your legal name or any other personal or business information, complete this form.
Can someone else submit a rights request on my behalf?
Yes. You can designate an authorized agent to make a request on your behalf. To do so, you must provide us with written authorization or a power of attorney, signed by you, for the agent to act on your behalf. You may still need to verify your identity directly with us.
Can the deletion be reversed? 
That can depend on a few factors. You can contact us if you want to see if the deletion is able to be reversed.
Can I create a new account?
Yes, however, it cannot be created with the same email address as the original account.

articles.fullText:
On-Demand Bookings Terms and Conditions
[Image: Pill Customer]
Last updated: Sept 13, 2022
You’ve read about getting matched with vetted pros, now let’s go over the fine print. These terms and conditions supplement Thumbtack’s Terms of Use and Privacy Policy, both of which fully apply.
Independent Service Professional
When you book a job, you’re booking with an independent service professional. Thumbtack does not provide the booked service and disclaims any warranties or liabilities other than those expressly set for in the Thumbtack Guarantee. Thumbtack is simply facilitating your direct contractual relationship with the independent service professional you are matched with.
Payments
You’ll be charged as indicated on the Payment page. Payments are nonrefundable except for properly processed cancellations more than 24 hours prior to the job start time. Read below for more information on changes and refunds. Learn more about stored payments terms and conditions.
Changes
We get it, sometimes plans change. Here’s what you need to know for different scenarios.
You want to reschedule or change the details of your project. You have the option to reschedule a project once up until the job start time. We’ll match you with a new pro if you reschedule your booking. Learn how to reschedule your booking.
The pro asks for more money, even though the project details didn’t change. When a pro accepts your booking, they agree to the price you paid through Thumbtack. That means the pro can’t charge you more to complete the requested project. If the pro disagrees with the price, contact us and we’ll help you work through it. It is your responsibility to ensure the scope of your project properly matches the description of the project when you booked it on Thumbtack. Improper descriptions could result in a cancellation, including cancellation fees.
You and the pro agree on additional services. If you’ve met with the pro and you want to work with them even more or expand the original project — that’s great! You and the pro will work together to decide on pricing and a plan that works for both of you. Even though you paid the pro through Thumbtack initially, you’ll work out a way to take payment outside of Thumbtack for any additional services. THE THUMBTACK GUARANTEE MAY NOT COVER ANY SUCH ADDITIONAL SERVICES.
Cancellations
Depending on who cancels and how much notice was given, you could receive a refund. Learn more about each scenario.
You need to cancel your booking. If you need to cancel your booking, your timing matters. So be sure to cancel the appointment as soon as you can.
If you cancel at least 24 hours before your project's scheduled start time, you get a full refund.
If you cancel within 24 hours your project's scheduled start time, you'll be charged a nonrefundable $15 cancellation fee, but you'll be refunded the rest of your payment.
The pro cancels. If the pro cancels, we’re here to help you figure out your next steps.
If the pro cancels at least 48 hours before the scheduled job time, we’ll match you with a different pro. If we can’t find another vetted pro that’s available, we’ll cancel the booking and refund the full amount back to your card.
If the pro cancels within 48 hours of the scheduled job time, you’ll get a full refund. Since most pros need more than 48 hours notice to take on a project, we won’t be able to find you a replacement. But you can book your project with a new pro for a later date.
We cancel the appointment. In rare cases, Thumbtack may cancel the booking if we can’t find the right pro for your project within the first 24 hours. If that happens, we’ll let you know and refund the full amount back to your card.
The pro can’t do the job. If the pro decides they’re unable to do the project after seeing the jobsite, you’ll get a refund. Contact our support team to get help with your refund.
The pro doesn’t show up. We’ll do everything we can to prevent this from happening, but if it does, you’ll get a full refund. Contact our support team to get help with your refund.
Tip
Our vetted pros meet specific standards, and all account owners must take and pass a criminal background check. But if something goes wrong, or you’re unhappy with the work, report the issue and we’ll be in touch.

articles.fullText:
What are On-Demand bookings?
[Image: Pill Customer]
Sometimes it’s easier and quicker to have someone else match you with a pro. For those moments, Thumbtack can match you with a vetted, independent pro at a set price and schedule that works for you.
How it works
First, you tell us about your project. We’ll ask you everything we need to know to get you the right pro — things like the size of the project, the skills needed, a start date, and the location. Then, you'll see a set price for the project upfront.
Using those details, we’ll find you the right pro. Do they have the right experience? Check. Are they available? Check, check. Have they been vetted? Triple check.
Tip
On-Demand bookings are covered by our Thumbtack Guarantee.
What is a vetted pro?
Our vetted pros are some of the best. For a pro to participate in On-Demand bookings, they must meet these requirements:
All account owners must take and pass a criminal background check.
They must maintain a 4.5 review rating or higher.
The pro needs to have at least three reviews from Thumbtack customers.
Who provides the service I book?
When you book a project, you’re booking with an independent service professional. Thumbtack does not provide the booked service and is not responsible for the service (except for coverage based on the terms of the Thumbtack Guarantee). Thumbtack is simply facilitating your direct contractual relationship with the independent service professional you are matched with.
Start a booking
Ready to be matched with a pro? Follow these steps:
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Go to the Fixed Price Projects page.
Select which type of service you want.
Add your project details.
Click Continue to schedule.
Select a date and time that works for you.
Click Continue to address.
Provide your contact information.
Click Next.
Confirm your booking details and enter your card information.
Click Complete booking.
We'll match you with a vetted, independent pro in about 24 hours. Once your project is booked, we’ll email you to let you know you’re ready to go. You can manage your booking if you need to reschedule or cancel.
If you cancel at least 24 hours before your project start time, you’ll get a full refund. Read the terms and conditions to learn more about refunds and cancellations.

Non-Discrimination Policy

At Thumbtack, our goal is to enable anyone to find the right professional to accomplish any project, anywhere, at any time. Thumbtack therefore prohibits discrimination against professionals or customers based on age, disability, gender identity, marital status, medical condition, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or other improper basis. Prohibited discrimination includes refusing to provide or accept pro services offered through the platform because of any of these characteristics, offering different pricing based on any of these characteristics, or any other conduct that improperly takes into account any of these characteristics. Along with our Content and Review Policy, this prohibition also applies to the posting of content, such as reviews or profiles, on Thumbtack.
Any pro or customer who believes they have been discriminated against in violation of this policy should report their concern here. A pro or customer found to have violated this prohibition may lose access to Thumbtack.

articles.fullText:
How to verify a pro’s insurance
[Image: Pill Customer]
Hiring a pro with insurance gives you peace of mind with a big project. Here are two things you can do when it comes to insurance:
Check your own insurance. A great place to start is reviewing your homeowner’s or renter’s insurance policy. Ask your provider if your policy covers your property during projects (for example, a remodel).
Confirm a pro’s insurance. Before hiring a pro, ask them if they have insurance. Talk with them if you’re concerned about any gaps in their coverage and what might happen if an incident occurs.
Coverage checklist:
Ask the pro to see a copy of their proof of insurance, bonding, and license.
Research local requirements for insurance, bonding, and licensing. Confirm the pro meets each one.
Call the pro’s insurance provider to verify the policy is current and to learn what it does and doesn’t cover.
Request the pro’s bond number and certification and contact the surety company to confirm it’s valid.
Make sure anyone who works on the project has the appropriate insurance (such as liability insurance or workers’ compensation).
Pro tip
Save copies of all records, contracts, and receipts.

[Image: Pill Pro]
The Thumbtack Community
The Thumbtack Community is a place for pros to connect and grow as business owners. Built by pros for pros, it’s a place to network, share resources, and exchange ideas and advice.
The community has these main categories:
Live Feed: See all of the conversations happening in the community in real time.
Explore: Anything from Business Resources to Thumbtack Resources, and much more can be found here.
Network: Join a group and connect with other Thumbtack pros in your industry and area.

Join the community

Mobile
Go to community.thumbtack.com.

Use your regular Thumbtack username and password to sign in.

Once you’re logged in, dive in and be a part of the community! Tap any post to join the conversation. Or you can offer kudos to show your support and appreciation.
Tip
Explore our On-demand Webinars — whether you're an experienced pro or just starting on Thumbtack, these webinars will empower you with the knowledge and resources you need to thrive.

Quick replies help you respond to customers quickly and professionally, whether you’re starting a new conversation or sealing the deal. Instead of typing out the same response again and again, you can write a message, save it and then reuse it as often as you need to. Customers want to hear back from you soon, so the time you save by reusing messages could give you a competitive edge. And that means even more time to build your business.

App

What makes a great profile photo
Your profile photo is the first photo customers see. Stand out to customers by sticking to photos that:
Show you (or your team). That way, customers put a face to your business and know who they’re working with.
Flash that smile. You’re more likely to create a connection and leave a positive impression.
Use natural light. Instead of using a filter or flash, keep it bright with photos taken outside, by a window, or with professional lighting.
Keep it simple. Use a headshot with a solid or neutral background. Avoid a distracting or cluttered background.

How to update my personal information
Keeping your personal information updated helps us keep your account secure. Follow the instructions below to update information like your email, password, profile photo, phone number, and address.
App

Select Profile (from the main menu below).

Enter your information and save your changes.
Desktop

If you need to update your legal name or any other personal or business information, complete this form. We’ll review the details and contact you within 2 - 3 business days to confirm the update.

Need to update your personal information?
[Button: Go to Account Settings]
Frequently asked questions
Why do you need my legal name? 
To help us build trust and credibility with customers, we require all account owners to use their legal name and to take and pass a criminal background check. It also helps us verify you’re a real person, and that’s important when you’re working with someone online.
If you need to update your legal name, complete this form. We’ll follow up with you within 2 - 3 business days.
Whose personal information should we use if there are multiple people managing the account for the business?
The business owner should be the person listed on your account. If your occupation requires a professional license, we recommend that the account holder and license holder match. Contact us if you still have questions.
How do I update my timezone?
Follow the desktop steps above to get to your Account Settings. Once there, select the option to update either your name or email. On this page, you’ll also find the option to adjust your timezone.

articles.summary: This article explains how customers can modify, update, or delete a service review they previously submitted for a Thumbtack professional.
articles.concepts: edit review, customer feedback, ratings, delete review, pro reviews
articles.fullText:
How to update my review 
[Image: Pill Customer]
The review you submitted for a pro can’t be changed or removed (unless it violates our Content and Review Policy or other Thumbtack policies).
However, if your review is verified (meaning you contacted the pro through Thumbtack), you can submit an updated review to explain what changed. An updated review will show up by default on the pro’s profile. However, your original review can still be seen if someone selects the option to view it.
You can make an update to your verified review only once, so make sure to read it over for accuracy and typos before submitting it.
Tip 
Not sure if your review is verified? If you contacted the pro through Thumbtack, your review is considered verified and will automatically be listed on the pro's profile as "Verified" or "Hired on Thumbtack."
Steps to update a review
Right now reviews can’t be updated through the app — you’ll need to use a web browser or mobile browser instead. Go to your customer profile to see the option to update your review or follow these steps on a desktop browser:
Log in to your Thumbtack account.
Click your profile photo (at the top right).
Select Profile from the drop-down menu.
Find the review you want to update.
Under the review, select Update.
Edit your review.
Select Submit.
If you don’t see an option to update your review
If there’s no option to update your review when you follow the steps above, it could either mean you’ve already made an update to your original review, your review isn’t verified, or you’re using the Thumbtack app.
Reviews can only be updated once. If you’ve already updated the review, you won’t be able to make any other changes to the review.
Only verified reviews can be updated. Verified reviews are from customers who connected with the pro through Thumbtack. If your review isn’t verified and you think it should be, contact us.
You can’t update reviews on the Thumbtack app. You’ll want to log into your Thumbtack account using a mobile or web browser instead.
Frequently asked questions
Why can I only update my review one time?
We understand that your experience may change again after you’ve written an updated review. However, updates are limited for the benefit of both customers and pros. Your review is a valid representation of your perspective and experience at the time it happened, and we believe that’s important for an honest review. Reviews shouldn’t be used as leverage or incentive which may happen if we allowed more than one update to a review.
If you’ve already updated your review once, you won’t be able to make any more changes to the review.
Why can only verified reviews be updated? 
Since customers who connected with a pro through Thumbtack create an account with their personal information, verified reviews are the only way we can make sure the original review and the updated review both came from the same person. We can’t verify the information that comes from reviews from customers outside of Thumbtack.
Can I delete my review?
To promote the integrity and honesty of reviews on Thumbtack, reviews won’t be deleted or removed unless they violate our policies. Check out our Content and Review Policy and other policies to learn more.
If you haven’t already made an update to your review, then we recommend updating your review if you have additional or different information to add.

articles.summary: Helps customers resolve login issues, often caused by having accounts under multiple email addresses.

articles.fullText:
How to troubleshoot login issues
Have you logged in to your customer account, but you can't find your messages and projects? We find that customers sometimes have accounts under multiple email addresses without realizing it. That's because logging in to an account and creating a new one are similar processes.
Here are some tips for making sure you're logged in to the right account.
If you signed up using an email address
Go to the inbox for the email you believe is linked to your Thumbtack account.
Search for emails from Thumbtack related to the project or pro you're looking for. If they're not in your inbox, try your spam folder.If you still can't find the email from Thumbtack, try searching other email accounts you have.
Once you've found the email address that's linked to your project, make sure you're logged in to Thumbtack with that account.
Tip
Not sure which email address you've logged in with? Go to your Thumbtack profile. You'll find the email address listed under your name.
If you signed up through Apple, Facebook or Google
If you signed up for Thumbtack through a secondary account (like Apple, Facebook or Google), try logging in again using that same method. If that doesn’t work, try to log in using the email address linked to the secondary account.
