articles.summary: Professionals can transfer their available account balance or refunds back to their original payment card rather than keeping it as credit.
articles.concepts: refunds, cashable balance, payment methods, account credit, fund transfer, pro payments
articles.fullText:
Transfer cashable balance back to card (pro)

Contents 
Overview
Cashable balance principles 
Eligibility requirements for refunds back to the original payment method
Other scenarios for refunding back to the original payment method
Do's and dont's
Process
Steps: How to process an eligible lead refund back to the original payment method (Rep)
Steps: How to process a cashable balance back to a pros original payment method (Rep)
Steps: How to help a pro with a cashable balance when their bank account is closed. (Rep)
Talking points
Resources
1. Overview
By default, refunds are returned to a pros Thumbtack balance, not to their original form of payment. If a pro requests that their Thumbtack balance be refunded to their original payment method, Frontline reps will refund their eligible lead refunds or any auto-refunds in their cashable balance.
Eligible lead refunds: These are in-policy lead refunds requested by the pro through the in-product refund (IPR) process. They can be refunded directly to the pro's card as individual amounts without affecting their full cashable balance. 
For information on various refund types and the overall refund policy, reps can refer to the internal Lead Refunds (Pro) KA.
Cashable balance: This is the Thumbtack balance after deducting promotional credits and courtesy refunds (PBIs). Promo credits and courtesy refunds remain on the pro's Thumbtack balance and do not expire.
For a refund to be returned to a pro’s original payment method, it must first align with the Cashable balance principles and then meet the specific eligibility requirements outlined below or be due to an accident or bug. Card registration is not required for the pro to receive these funds; the system automatically identifies the original payment method. Approved refunds back to the pro's card are typically available within 5-7 business days, depending on their financial institution. If the pro does not receive the refund within this window, they should contact their financial institution directly.
Cashable Balance Principles
These principles outline how different types of payments and balances are considered when processing a refund to a pro's original payment method.
Credit card payments: 
A lead is eligible for a refund to a credit card only if it was original paid for by a credit card. 
Only the portion of the lead paid for by a credit card is eligible for a credit card refund.
Any outstanding balance will be covered first, and only the remaining amount can be refunded to the original payment method.
Fraud exception: For fraud-related refunds, the full paid amount can be returned to the credit card regardless of any outstanding balance. 
Prepaid packages and preloaded balances: 
Refunds for leads purchased with a prepaid package will be returned to the prepaid package balance. 
Refunds for preloaded balances will be returned to the paid balance.
Eligibility requirements for direct refunds back to a pro's original payment method
This section includes internal information only and should not to be proactively shared with pros.
Before a refund can be returned to a pro's original payment method, specific conditions related to the refund type, timing, and balance status must be met. For a pro to be eligible for a refund back to their original form of payment, they need to meet the following:
The original refund is: 
An in-policy refund (not a courtesy refund / PBI  or promotional credit) AND
Is requested within 10 business days of returning to their Thumbtack balance. 
The pro is requesting a refund to the original payment method (funds cannot be returned to a different card).
The pro has at least one approved in-policy refund request OR auto-refund that was processed within 10 business days. 
The pro's Thumbtack balance is positive (not zero or negative).
The pro does not have any balance from prepaid packages. Prepaid packages are for use on Thumbtack only and have no cash value. 
Leads purchased from a package or other promotional credit are not eligible. The pro must purchase the lead directly to be eligible for a payment method refund. 
▶ One way to look at it is:Think of their purchases like a gift card; it has no actual cash value other than to the merchant it was purchased from. You wouldn't be able to purchase an Amazon gift card and then walk into Walmart and expect them to honor it.
Other scenarios for refunds to a pro's original payment method
This section includes internal information only and should not to be shared with pros. 

The list below provides examples of other situations where a refund back to the original payment method may be approved. Only in-policy refunds will be processed back to the original form of payment (these scenarios do not include courtesy refunds).
Pro turned on targeting but didn’t log in or view leads: If a pro activated targeting more than 30 days ago but hasn't logged in or viewed leads within the last 30 days, Frontline reps may process a credit back to the card if the pro requests it. Any refunds issued in this scenario must only apply to leads received within the last 30 days.
New pro received unexpected charges (within 7 days of completing activation): If a new pro states they were unprepared for leads and were unexpectedly charged, they may be eligible for a refund for contacts received within the first 7 days of completing their activation requirements.
This policy applies only to unexpected charges for new pros within this initial 7-day period post-signup and activation (or EMR) completion. If it falls within 7 days of the pro receiving the contacts, Refund Ops will approve an in-policy refund under ‘Approved Extraordinary Circumstances’ with "new pro, unexpected" in their notes.
Pro received charges due to a bug: If a pro incurred charges due to a Thumbtack bug, Frontline reps can issue a refund back to a credit card if the pro requests it.
Trust & Safety (T&S) related exceptions: If a pro has been deactivated and/or blocklisted due to a Trust and Safety issue (e.g., failed a background check), Frontline reps may refund the card for any remaining balance. However, before promising this type of refund, frontline reps must reach out in #ts-incident-ops-questions.
For these exceptions (#1-3), reps will follow the “Unsure if lead qualifies for refund” steps in the internal Lead Refunds KA.
Do’s and Don’ts

When helping pros with refunds to their original payment method, frontline reps must follow these guidelines:
Do use the term "refunds back to the original payment method." 
Do not use terms like "cash refunds" or "courtesy returns.
Do set the expectation that approved refunds back to the pro's card are typically available within 5-7 business days.
Do not proactively share the Eligibility requirements or Other scenarios for refunds sections with pros (as they are marked as internal information).
Do not process a refund back to a card if the pro still has an active balance from a prepaid package.
Do not process a refund if the amount is $200 or more; instead, reach out to Advanced Support. 
Do not tell the pro the full Thumbtack Balance amount. This is because the full balance may include non-cashable amounts like promotional credits and courtesy refunds (PBIs). The only amount that can be transferred back to their card is the cashable balance, which is the total balance after deducting these non-cashable components.
Do refer to the internal Lead Refunds KA for information on various refund types and the overall refund policy.
Do refer to the internal Prepaid Package Refunds (Pro) KA for information about refund eligible for packages.
Do  follow the Steps: How to process an eligible lead refund back to the original payment method (Rep)
 when the pro is requesting a refund for a specific, approved in-policy lead within 10 business days.
Do follow the Steps: How to process a cashable balance back to a pros original payment method (Rep) when the pro is requesting a refund of their entire remaining cashable Thumbtack balance.
2. Process

Steps: How to process an eligible lead refund back to the original payment method (Rep)
This section details the process for Support reps to directly refund eligible in-product lead refunds to a pro's original payment method. This process is applicable only when the refund request is made within a 10 business day timeframe. Eligible lead refunds are defined as in-policy lead refunds initiated by the pro through the in-product refund (IPR) process.
To confirm a lead's refund eligibility and process refunds back to a pro's account, frontline reps should follow these steps:
Confirm approved in-product refund request:
Ask the pro if they have submitted and received approval for an in-product refund request.
If not, guide the pro through how to request a refund and explain Thumbtack’s refund policy.
▶ Thumbtack Help resources.
How to request a refund – Thumbtack Help
Refund policy for pros – Thumbtack Help
▶ Talking point:

English talking point 
"Before we can move any funds back to your card, we first need to get a refund approval, which you can only do in the product. I'd be happy to show you how now, or you can use the help center if you prefer to do it later. You'll usually get an answer within 1-2 business days, but it could take up to 5 business days if further review is needed."
Verify a positive account balance:
From the main users page in Admin, scroll up to the "Credits" field to check the pro's Thumbtack Balance.
▶ What the Credits field looks like:

[Image: rtaImage]

Important: Do not tell the pro this balance amount, as it is not the amount that can be put back on the card.
Negative balance: If the balance is negative, there's no balance to be returned. Let the pro know that there’s no fund that can be transferred back to the original form of payment.
▶ Talking point:

English talking point 
It looks like the funds were already used on new leads, so there is no refund balance that I can put back on your card at this time. I can look into a refund to your payment method when you have a positive balance. Is there something else I can do for you?"

Positive balance: If the balance is positive, continue to the next steps.
Access credit logs and find the lead:
In the “Credits” field, click on the Thumbtack balance, then select "Credit logs" under Legacy Admin Actions.
▶ What it looks like:

[Image: rtaImage]
 

Find the lead using the customer name provided by the pro (use Command + F to search the page and use the Next button in the top left corner if needed).
Click the related "Refund Request" under the Bid Refund column.
▶ What the Bid Refund column looks like

[Image: rtaImage]

Review Refund Request Details:
On the Refund Request Details page, scroll down to the Decision box.
Look at the “Currently Refundable to Credit Card” field to see the amount the pro is eligible to have refunded.
▶ What it looks like

[Image: rtaImage]


If there is a positive balance in this field, move to step 6.
▶ If the amount is $0.00, or the blue Refund to Credit Card button is absent, they are not eligible for a refund through this method. Possible reasons include:
Already refunded to credit card: Check the Refunded to Credit Card field to confirm if the lead has already been refunded. The refunded amount will show here.
Prepaid Package: If the lead was purchased using the balance from the prepaid package, the refund is not eligible for refunding back to card. All the leads purchased from a prepaid package have to go back to the prepaid package balance.
▶ Talking point
English talking point
Because this lead was purchased from a non-refundable prepaid package, we cannot put the money back on your card. Your balance will remain as credit for future leads.
Refund is too old: If the Resolved date is over 10 business days, it's no longer eligible.
▶ Talking point
English talking point
The refund was approved more than 10 business days ago, which means it's no longer eligible to be returned to your original payment method.
Set expectations and get pro approval:
Set clear expectations with the pro about their Thumbtack balance by going over the following and then move to step 7.    
The refund amount in the “Currently Refundable to Credit Card” field. That is what will be returned.
That funds will be available in 5-7 business days, depending on their financial institution.
▶ Talking point:

English talking point 
Before I process this refund, I need to confirm a few things. The amount of [$x] will go back to your original payment method. Funds will be available in 5-7 business days, depending on your financial institution. Are you okay with me moving forward? 
▶ NOTE: If the 'Total Refunded Amount' and the "Currently Refundable to Credit Card” don't match:
Explain to the pro that the difference was spent on new leads and only the 'Currently Refundable' amount can be processed. 
Get their approval for the partial refund.
Example: If the refunded lead was $10 and a new lead was $5, the new lead used that $5, leaving only $5 to be returned to the pro. 
▶ Talking point

English talking point 
It looks like part of the funds were already used on new leads. With your remaining balance, we can still return a partial refund of [$x]. Would you like to continue with this new amount?
Confirm pro agreement and troubleshoot (if needed):
Confirm the pro understands and agrees to proceed.
If yes, move to step 8.
If the pro doesn’t agree or has concerns, troubleshoot:
▶ i. Pro wants the refund to go back to another card:
Explain that for security, funds can only be returned to the original payment method. 
▶ Talking point
English talking point
For security, we can only return the amount back to the original payment.
▶ ii. Pro wants the whole balance refunded, not just the eligible amount (balance has courtesy credits):
Ask the pro to pull up their Thumbtack balance from their payments page and explain what makes up the balance and why only the eligible amount can be transferred.
▶ Talking point

English talking point 
The only funds we can return to your card are refunds that fall within our refund policy. If refunds were given as an exception to our policy, those can’t be returned to your card but are available on your account for future leads.
Transfer the funds:
Click Refund to Credit Card, then OK, to process the refund.
A "Refund to credit card processed successfully" message will appear.
Inform pro of processed refund:
No notification is sent from Admin, so communicate to the pro that the refund has been processed.
Complete the case:
Complete the conversation as normal.
Add notes and close the case accordingly.
Steps: How to process a cashable balance back to a pros original payment method (Rep)
This section details the process for Support reps to refund a pro's cashable balance to their original payment method. This process is applicable when the lead was auto-refunded due to a scam contact, canceled booking, or a manual re-evaluation of a denied In-Product Refund (IPR). 
IMPORTANT: Before initiating this process, steps 1-5 of the process an eligible lead refund process above must be completed.
Check the paid credit balance payout:
On the main user page in Admin, scroll down to the "Credits" section.
In the “Credits” field, click on the Thumbtack balance, then select "Credit logs" under Legacy Admin Actions.
▶ What it looks like:

[Image: rtaImage]
[Image: rtaImage]

From the Credit Logs page, scroll down to the “Paid Credit Balance Payout” to see the amount.
▶ What it looks like:

[Image: rtaImage]

If the balance is negative or zero, there’s no balance to be returned. 
▶ Talking point:

English talking point 
It looks like the funds were already used on new leads, so there is no refund balance that I can put back on your card at this time. I can look into a refund to your payment method when you have a positive balance. Is there something else I can do for you?

If the balance is positive, move to the next step. 
Set expectations and get pro approval:
Set clear expectations with the pro about their Thumbtack balance by going over the following:   
The eligible refund amount in the “Paid Credit Balance Payout” field. That is what will be returned back to the original form of payment
Only the full eligible balance can be transferred back, rather than a portion of the funds. 
That funds will be available in 5-7 business days, depending on their financial institution
▶ Talking point:

English talking point 
Before I process this refund, I need to confirm a few things. The amount of [$x] will go back to your original payment method. Funds will be available in 5-7 business days, depending on your financial institution. Are you ok with me moving forward?”
Confirm pro agreement and troubleshoot (if needed):
Confirm with the pro that they understand and are okay to move forward with the refund to their card. 
If yes, move to step 4. 
If the pro doesn’t agree or has concerns, troubleshoot with the applicable process below: 
▶ i. Pro wants the refund to go back to another card:
Explain that for security, funds can only be returned to the original payment method. 
▶ Talking point

English talking point 
For security, we can only return the amount back to the original payment.
Transfer the funds: 
▶ a. If the amount is $500 or below:
Click “Credit balance payout” to process the refund. 
Click “Okay” when prompted to confirm the transfer of the pros balance. 
▶ b. If the amount is $500-$1000 (or above $100)
Submit a request to the Advanced Service Team using the Atlassian Assist app in Slack.
Navigate to the #service_global_help-and-escalations Slack channel.
Use a keyword like Help refunds or Refunds to trigger the Assist app workflow.
Select the "Global Help Refunds" request type and fill out the form with all necessary details. 
NOTE: If the amount is above $1000, Advanced Service will reach out to Akiko Pace directly for approval. 
Review the transfer for returnable credits: 
Once the transfer is complete, scroll to the top of the page to the “Completed Transactions” table. 
Find the transfer (it should be the top transaction) and look at the “Amount” column on the far right. 
The funds back on the card will show a "-$x Paid."
▶ What it looks like

[Image: rtaImage]

Inform pro of processed refund:
No notification is sent from Admin, so communicate to the pro that the refund has been processed and let the pro know their remaining Thumbtack balance after the transfer.
Complete the case:
Complete the conversation as normal. 
Add notes and close the case accordingly.
Steps: How to help a pro with a cashable balance when their bank account is closed (rep)
If the pro’s bank account is closed, their cashable balance will still be sent to their bank (original payment method). Typically, banks will issue a check to the pro. If the pro doesn’t get their cashable balance returned within 5-7 business days, frontline reps should have them  contact their bank directly.
If the pro still disputes or escalates the issue after contacting their bank, frontline reps should follow the steps below:
Verify bank contact: Confirm the pro has already spoken with their financial institution.
Gather required info: Note the case number, pro PK, and the details of the pro's concern.
Post to Slack: Use the workflow in the #marketplace-pay-support Slack channel to submit a request for next steps. Follow the steps in the internal Support for Payment Related Inquiries KA.

3. Talking points

English talking point
Spanish talking point 
Why can't you refund me back to my card? 
(Outside of 10 business days from refund)
¿Por qué no me pueden reembolsar a mi tarjeta?  
(Después de 10 días hábiles desde el reembolso)

El reembolso fue aprobado hace más de 10 días hábiles, por lo que ya no es elegible para ser devuelto a su método de pago original. 
I want my Thumbtack balance refunded back to my card! 
(Pro hasn’t submitted IPR / Pro needs to submit refund request)
¡Quiero que mi saldo de Thumbtack se reembolse a mi tarjeta!
(El profesional no ha presentado una solicitud de reembolso IPR / El profesional necesita presentar una solicitud de reembolso)
Before we can move any funds back to your card, we first need to get a refund approval, and that can only be done by you, in product. I'd be happy to show you how now, or you can use the help center if you prefer to do it later. You'll usually get an answer within 1-2 business days. However, it could take up to 5 business days if the situation needs further review.
Antes de poder mover cualquier fondo de vuelta a su tarjeta, primero necesitamos obtener una aprobación de reembolso, y esta solo puede ser hecha por usted, en el producto. Me encantaría mostrarle cómo hacerlo en este momenton, o puede usar el centro de ayuda si prefiere hacerlo más tarde. Por lo general, recibirá una respuesta en 1-2 días hábiles. Sin embargo, podría tomar hasta 5 días hábiles si la situación necesita una revisión adicional.
I want my Thumbtack balance refunded back to my card! 
(Pro needs to wait for refund requests to be processes)
¡Quiero que mi saldo de Thumbtack se reembolse a mi tarjeta! 
(El profesional debe esperar a que se procesen las solicitudes de reembolso)
Before we can move any funds back to your card, we first need to get a refund approval. We received your request for a refund. Now we need to wait for the refund to be processed. You can usually get an answer within 1-2 business days. However, it could take up to 5 business days if the situation needs further review.

¡Quiero que mi saldo de Thumbtack se reembolse a mi tarjeta!

Your balance is made of all of your transactions, including payments you have made, charges for leads, credits offered from Thumbtack, and refunds that fall within our policy. You can request refunds back to your card when a refund is made that falls within our refund policy. However, the total balance in your account currently only contains ineligible transactions. These credits are available to you for use on future leads but are only available as a credit.
Su saldo está compuesto por todas sus transacciones, incluyendo pagos que ha realizado, cargos por prospectos, créditos ofrecidos por Thumbtack y reembolsos que cumplen con nuestra política. Puede solicitar reembolsos en su tarjeta cuando se realiza un reembolso que cumple con nuestra política de reembolso. Top Three Pros in Search Results (Customer)

Contents

Overview
How the top 3 matches work
Criteria
When a customer won't see top 3 matches
Updates
Streamlining contacting multiple pros
Talking points (Pro)
Resources
1. Overview
▶ KA Summary
This internal knowledge article provides Frontline reps with an overview of the "Top Three Pros on Search Results" feature. It details the customer experience on the pro list, including the curation module titled "Get [pricing] [quotes] from 3 pros.” Pros are selected for this module if they have at least a 4.5-star rating, at least three reviews, and respond in one hour or less. A single button allows customers to send project details to all three curated pros simultaneously.
The top 3 matches in a customer search result helps them quickly evaluate and connect with the best-fit pros. 

[Image: rtaImage]


How the top 3 matches works
Customers who have answered at least one upfront question will see a curation module at the top of the pro list in search results, titled "Get quotes from your top 3 matches” followed by, "These pros match your project, are highly rated, and respond quickly. Get 3 quotes". 
The "Get 3 quotes" button allows the customer to send their project details to all three curated pros at once, streamlining the contact process. Clicking "Get 3 quotes" on the banner navigates the customer directly to the request form.
To learn more about a pro, the customer will click on the pro card which takes them to the pro’s profile. If a customer only wants to contact one pro, they will do that from the profile 
Below the top three is the remaining pro list, typically below a cost guide. The customer will see the 3 best matches on both web and app. 
▶ What it looks like on web

[Image: rtaImage]

▶ What it looks like on the app

[Image: rtaImage]

 
Criteria 
Customers can click on the information icon next to Our criteria to learn more. It says, “Our pros match your search, have reviews from real customers, and pay for visibility on our site. Learn more.” Clicking learn more takes the customer to the How to find a pro on Thumbtack – Thumbtack Help article. 

When a customer won't see top 3 matches
The curated section will only be shown if there are at least three curated pros available. If there are not enough pros in the area who meet the criteria, the customer will see the standard pro list with the header, "all [trade name] matching your job".
Updates 
Streamlining contacting multiple pro

On April 27, 2026, Thumbtack launched an experiment to streamline the Pro Curation Carousel (PCC) design. Previously, the carousel was considered redundant because it shows the same pro cards as the top 3 ranked pros from the pro list. On May 17, 2026, this experiment shipped to baseline.
When a customer is eligible for the PCC and the top search results match the curated pros, the following changes occur:
New Banner: A blue banner titled "Get quotes from your top 3 matches" replaces the previous header, individual carousel cards, and the old "Get quotes from 3 pros" button.
Banner Messaging: "These pros match your project, are highly rated, and respond quickly. Get 3 quotes".
Primary CTA: Clicking "Get 3 quotes" on the banner navigates the customer directly to the request form.
Request Form Update: The RF will now display the avatars of the specific pros being contacted.
2. Talking points (Pro)
This section provides Frontline Reps with approved talking points for communicating with pros about the pro list on search results. Use these talking points to ensure consistent and accurate messaging.

English talking point
Q: Why am I (a pro) not one of the 3 best matches at the top of search results?
A: Being featured in this best matches section depends on, if they are looking for a service you don’t offer you won’t be featured in their search results. You can reference this How to improve my rank in search results – Thumbtack Help article with more information on how to improve your rank in search results.

articles.fullText:
Thumbtack’s Pro Advisory Board

Contents
Overview
Board members
Thumbtack Pro Advisor profile badge
Board member responsibilities
Board member benefits and perks
What we look for in a pro advisor
Process
How to help these pros
Submit feedback for these pros
Talking points
Resources
1. OVERVIEW
The Thumbtack Pro Advisory Board is a group of Thumbtack pros that aim to enhance the pro experience by offering their valuable expertise. They participate in product feature testing, and meetings with Thumbtack leadership and other pros, provide feedback, and champion the Thumbtack community of pros.
The goal of the Thumbtack Pro Advisors is to amplify the voices of pros, foster community, and improve Thumbtack for pros. 
Picked based on their commitment to sharing their expertise and insights, Thumbtack Pro Advisors are a carefully selected group of top pros from various industries and locations across the country. 
Visit the Pro Advisory Board landing page for more information about the advisors and a video.
BOARD MEMBERS
 
Pros on the advisory board span from coast to coast, have received more than 5,000 5-star reviews, and provide services in over 50 categories. They specialize in various home categories, such as landscaping, HVAC, and plumbing. 
They haven't just created and expanded successful businesses on Thumbtack; they're also community leaders who are driven and eager to assist other small business owners in their growth.
Check out the Pro Advisory Board Landing Page to meet our current Pro Advisors.
THUMBTACK PRO ADVISOR PROFILE BADGE
 
Advisors will display "Thumbtack Pro Advisor" on their profile under the Overview section. PAB members will also have a user flag and banner in tack. See screenshots in the “How to help these pros” section.
[Image: O0YbwbWRzR4nlthmXoDd8YpPPmJXz9nQWdJAgI83hW2ZPXO_-ouG_piWhAOU7w_zCfiQYfQt0ENCErBOOc76DcMkQe_3alvIN1qmD8cbsdv7G-fPnxeSJCUtRaoQJJm-I8jCKzdVbzJpaAbiwdvIORQ]

BOARD MEMBER RESPONSIBILITIES
 
Board members have the following responsibilities.
 
Give features a try – Test new product updates and features prior to launch, sharing feedback on aspects you like or areas for improvement.
Join us for virtual and in-person events – Occasionally participate in Thumbtack events, such as company all-hands meetings or offsites, sharing insights about your business or engaging in Q&As with Thumbtack teams.
Offer their thoughts – Participate in bi-annual surveys on various topics from the future of the trades to your current business outlook and challenges.
Share their story – Work with the PR and Social Media teams to participate in media opportunities and campaigns.
Be a mentor. Pro Advisors will mentor other Thumbtack pros in virtual pro-to-pro mentorship sessions.
Look toward the future – Come together as a group with fellow Thumbtack Pro Advisors to meet with Thumbtack leaders. Share their perspective and feedback on company direction, product vision and roadmap.
Be a Thumbtack champion – Positively represent Thumbtack as an ambassador — for customers, other pros, employees and recruits.
BOARD MEMBER BENEFITS AND PERKS
 
Board members receive the following benefits and perks.
 
Early access to product updates – See and try Thumbtack product updates before wider launch, with the ability to share feedback and advise product development.
Access to Thumbtack leadership – Meet with Thumbtack’s leadership team to learn about company vision — and have the opportunity to ask questions and share feedback.
Make an impact – Their feedback will help amplify pro voices and ultimately improve the Thumbtack experience for them — and for pros everywhere.
Exposure – Drive brand awareness for them and their business with access to potential press and social media opportunities.
Exclusive swag – Receive exclusive Thumbtack swag and goodies throughout the year.
Personalized support – Their personal account manager will expedite support and help them maximize their growth on Thumbtack.
Stand out – Get recognition for their position as a Thumbtack Pro Advisor with a badge on their profile that’s visible to customers. (see profile badge above)
WHAT WE LOOK FOR IN A PRO ADVISOR
 
Members of the advisory board will represent:
 
Top Pros – We want representation from the best of the best, and our most highly engaged pros (while we strive to have exclusively Top Pros on our board, this is not a strict requirement if other criteria are strong)
Top Booking Categories – As Thumbtack works toward a bookings future, feedback from pros in these categories is vital. We’ll focus on pros within our bookings eligible home categories.
Thumbtack’s Biggest Markets – We’ll aim to have representation from pros across several of our larger markets.
Diverse Business Sizes – In order to gather feedback from all business sizes we’ll aim to have representation from pros with small to large national businesses.
Tenured & New Pros – To gain insight into the pro journey, both new and tenured pros will be included in the board.
Demographic Diversity – We’ll keep an eye to diversity as we search for pros and work to amplify their voices.
Trust and Safety-Vetted Pros – All pros invited to participate in the Pro Advisory Board will be MTS vetted and cleared.
Pros Who Use Partner Tools – Where possible, select pros who use partner tools or other CRMs.
2. PROCESS
HOW TO HELP THESE PROS [SUPPORT]
As Support advocates, you are to provide these pros with a white glove experience. When interacting with these pros, we ask that you acknowledge that they are on the board by saying something like:
 “Thanks for being a Thumbtack Pro Advisor!” 
“I see you’re a Thumbtack Pro Advisory Board member!” 

Identify a PAB member 

You can identify a PAB member in tack on their contact page and by the Security Code flag notes in the Thumbtack User field on a case. 
[Image: en9Ji3w-TbiwLUHPR76-7Mrtja-kZheWXSpz8KktwdTIqkwX2MEubyxQ9HaM4AaiIcR5oXQ3IX6xOnG5TahMsjlTPY0o5nPEhfbX3y4HSnqjNQaGxP8I5ZMHKoNNmv3XYQD1wBk6oxgUitFzcX38iVA]

 
[Image: A1Uyq8ffH1lk7U7pL27qYMeK4IIjAiucsb1G37FcOeyr05KnZDQgMF7jndkIzgLUJXGD-X3X7cw6x9fQDJMKSGIbNy_e0rqnJ-vHwRFG2NDw7Y03R27f489O3Sthp_74z6zLfFqQtDaTqscjKz70T7c]
Help a PAB member 
All PAB members are managed accounts and you must follow the below process when helping them. For further questions, refer pros to the Pro Community, where they can post questions about the PAB.
After helping a PAB member, you must inform the account manager by post in #xfnc_depts_help Slack channel with the following details:
Tag the account manager 
Case number related to the interaction
Summary of what was discussed
What actions were taken or made
NOTE: You must CC a pro’s account manager on any emails you send a PAB member. 
 
See Managed Accounts KA for more info.
SUBMIT FEEDBACK FOR THESE PROS
 
When submitting feedback in tack for PAB members, you must include a note in the feedback description field indicating that the pro is a member of the Pro Advisory Board (PAB). Something as simple as "Pro is on PAB" or “PAB member.” This will allow our team to triage the feedback on the backend.
 
See Product Feedback KA for more info. 
3. TALKING POINTS
 
What does it mean to be a Pro Advisor? 
Our Pro Advisors are coming together to help us understand and improve the pro experience. These Pro Advisors are top Thumbtack pros across industries and the country, selected for their dedication to sharing their expertise and insight. Over the course of the next year, this inaugural group of Pro Advisors will test product features, meet with us and other pros, provide feedback, and champion Thumbtack’s amazing community of pros. Together, we’re amplifying pro voices, building community, and making Thumbtack better for pros and customers.
¿Qué significa ser un Asesor Profesional?
Nuestros Asesores Profesionales se están uniendo para ayudarnos a comprender y mejorar la experiencia para los profesionales. Estos Asesores son los mejores profesionales de Thumbtack en todas las industrias y el país, seleccionados por su dedicación a compartir su experiencia y conocimientos. Durante el próximo año, este grupo inaugural de Asesores probará las características del producto, se reunirá con nosotros y otros profesionales, proporcionará comentarios y será defensor de la increíble comunidad de profesionales de Thumbtack. Juntos estamos amplificando las voces de los profesionales, construyendo una comunidad y haciendo que Thumbtack sea mejor para los profesionales y los clientes.

How do I become a Thumbtack Pro Advisor? 
Thumbtack Pro Advisors are selected annually based on several criteria and are meant to represent diversity in location, business size & industry, tenure on Thumbtack, and more. Currently, there is no way to apply to be a Pro Advisor, but that may change in the future. Visit our Pro Community for updates.
¿Cómo me convierto en un Asesor Profesional de Thumbtack?
Los Asesores Profesionales de Thumbtack son seleccionados anualmente según varios criterios y están destinados a representar la diversidad en ubicación, tamaño de la empresa e industria, antigüedad en Thumbtack y más. Actualmente no hay forma de solicitar ser un Asesor, pero eso puede cambiar en el futuro. Visite nuestra Comunidad Profesional para obtener actualizaciones.

Do Thumbtack Pro Advisors get special perks or benefits? 
Our Thumbtack Pro Advisors were selected because of their excitement and dedication to sharing feedback and insights with Thumbtack and for their commitment to helping make Thumbtack even better. Pro Advisors are not compensated for their role as a Pro Advisor, however, they do get perks like exclusive Pro Advisory Board swag, media and PR features, access to an Account Manager, opportunities to meet with Thumbtack leadership, early access to product features, and more.
¿Los Asesores Profesionales de Thumbtack obtienen beneficios especiales?
Nuestros Asesores Profesionales de Thumbtack fueron seleccionados por su entusiasmo y dedicación a compartir comentarios y conocimientos con Thumbtack y por su compromiso de ayudar a que Thumbtack sea aún mejor. Los Asesores no son compensados por su función como Asesor, sin embargo sí obtienen beneficios como artículos exclusivos de la Junta Asesora de Profesionales, actualizaciones en medios y  relaciones públicas, acceso a un Gerente de Cuenta, oportunidades para reunirse con el liderazgo de Thumbtack, acceso temprano a las características del producto y más.
When do new advisors get picked? 
Pro Advisors are committed for one year of service, with the option to be invited to stay on for an additional year.
¿Cuándo se seleccionan nuevos asesores?
Los Asesores están comprometidos por un año de servicio, con la opción de ser invitados a permanecer por un año adicional.
What is the vetting process to become a Pro Advisor? (How do pros qualify) 
Pro Advisors are selected based on several criteria, including their Thumbtack account being in good standing. Pros also go through an interview process with various team members.
[NOTE: See What we look for in a pro advisor for criteria.]
¿Cuál es el proceso de selección para convertirse en un Asesor Profesional? (¿Cómo califican los
profesionales?)
Los Asesores son seleccionados según varios criterios, incluida la cuenta de Thumbtack en buen estado. Los profesionales también pasan por un proceso de entrevista con varios miembros del equipo.

articles.fullText:
Thumbtack’s AI Assistant (Maven) (Rep)

Contents
Overview
Thumbtack’s AI assistant rollout history
Updates 
Maven voice pilot
Verification and name mismatch
Chat verification
Key points
How users start a conversations with the AI assistant
When Thumbtack’s AI assistant transfers to a rep
How Maven voice works 
How to identify a Maven voice transfer
How account verification works with the AI assistant
For chat and sms interactions
For phone/voice  interactions
Process
Steps: How to handle a case transferred from Thumbtack’s AI Assistant (Rep)
Steps: How to take feedback about Thumbtack AI Assistant (Rep)
Talking points
Resources
1. Overview
▶ KA summary
This internal knowledge article (KA) is designed for Frontline Reps to understand and effectively manage interactions involving Thumbtack's AI assistant. It covers the overview of the AI assistant's function, the process for handling escalated cases, and approved talking points for communicating with pros and customers about the AI assistant.
Thumbtack’s AI assistant (known internally as Maven) is designed to provide pros and customers with quick, accurate solutions.
Accuracy & Resolution: The assistant understands a wide range of common service questions, allowing it to resolve issues directly and deflect volume from the support team.
Escalation Logic: If a user’s issue is complex or requires personalized attention, the AI assistant is trained to recognize these needs and will transfer the interaction to a frontline rep for hands-on help.
Internal vs. External Naming:
Externally: When speaking with pros or customers, call this tool Thumbtack’s AI assistant. Do not call it Maven.
Internally: Reps may hear this tool referred to as Maven. In interaction logs, the AI is labeled as “Maven bot” and the user is labeled as “Visitor.”
Thumbtack’s AI assistant rollout history 
Thumbtack's AI assistant has expanded across channels since its initial launch. Here is a summary of all launches to date:
September 3, 2025 — Text support (SMS) launched
January 7, 2026 — Help Center chat launched
March 17, 2026 — SMS verification launched (Verification status available in interaction window)
April 15, 2026 — Chat verification launched ((Verification status available in interaction window)
April 27, 2026 — Name verification update: reps must now confirm the user's name matches the account on all Maven transfers regardless of Verified status
May 1, 2026 — Maven Voice soft launch on phone channel (limited pilot — not yet fully rolled out)
Updates
Maven voice pilot— May 1, 2026

Thumbtack's AI assistant is now being piloted on the phone channel as of May 1, 2026 (soft launch). This is a limited pilot and is not yet fully rolled out — not all calls will be handled by Maven Voice during this phase.
When a pro or customer calls Thumbtack support and is routed through the pilot, Maven will attempt to handle the interaction before transferring to a live rep.
 
Key things to know:
Verification is still required on every Maven Voice transfer — the same as any other inbound phone call. Maven does not verify users on phone calls.
The Script button will appear red in the Genesys widget when a call has been transferred from Maven. Click it to view the Maven summary before or after answering the call.
For full details on how Maven Voice works and how to handle transferred calls, see the How Maven voice works section below.
 
Verification and name mismatch
As of April 27, 2026,  we have updated the process for handling "Verified" interactions from Maven to ensure legal compliance.
Verification is not "One and Done": Even if Maven displays a "Verified: Yes" status, you must still ask for the user's name to address them.
The Name Mismatch Trigger: If the user provides a name that does not match the name on the Thumbtack account, follow the full verification process in the internal Verify Account Information (Pro) (Customer) KA
Chat verification launch 
Thumbtack has updated how Maven handles verification for both chat and SMS interactions to reduce handle time and improve the user experience. 
Chat verification launched April 15, 2026
SMS verification launched March 17, 2026
Here are the key updates: 
Verification Update: For SMS and chat interactions, Maven now attempts to verify the user before transferring to a rep. Below “# VERIFICATION STATUS” reps will either see: 
Verified: If the status is "VERIFIED:”
The user has been verified. 
Reps do not need to re-verify the account. To address the user, you can ask for their name.
Unverified: If the status is "Unverified," (or blank): 
Maven failed two attempts to verify the user. 
Rep action: Follow the usual verification process found in the < Verify Account Information > KA.
24-Hour Persistence: If a user successfully verifies their email and phone during a session, the system will retain that "Verified" status for 24 hours. If the user reaches out again via SMS within this window, they will automatically be flagged as verified.
Conversation summary - Regardless of the verification status, reps must review the conversation summary and full history before speaking to the user. Failure to do so, resulting in asking for information the user already provided to Maven, will result in a QA markdown.

[Image: rtaImage]

Key points
Here are key points for Frontline Reps to remember when helping a pro or customer who escalated from a conversation with Maven: 
Maven's purpose: The AI assistant uses help center knowledge to answer basic service questions and deflect volume from the support team.
External name: Reps should always refer to it externally as "Thumbtack's AI assistant," not "Maven."
Transfer triggers: Specific situations  cause the AI assistant to transfer to a rep (e.g., account cancellation requests, repeated requests for an agent, Trust & Safety concerns).
Verification: Maven will attempt to verify the user for chat and sms interactions before transferring to a rep. 
If it shows “VERIFIED”, reps don’t need to follow the verification process. 
If “Unverified” or blank, reps must verify the user as usual. Steps in internal Verify Account Information (Pro) (Customer) KA.
Current Availability:
Text support — launched September 3, 2025
Help Center chat — launched January 7, 2026
Phone/Voice — soft launch pilot as of May 1, 2026 (limited pilot — not yet fully rolled out)
Receiving feedback about the AI assistant: If reps receive any feedback from pros or customers about Thumbtack’s AI assistant, reps should submit it in Salesforce through the usual feedback process under: 
“[Support] Customer/Pro AI Automated Assistant support experience.” 
Reps can refer to the internal Product Feedback KA for steps. 
How user starts a conversation with Maven
Pros and customers interact with Thumbtack’s AI Assistant (Maven) through specific support channels, which include:
Help Center: Chats from Thumbtack Help (user must be logged in).
Pro Services Page: Web-only chats from the pro’s Services page (pro must be logged in).
Text: SMS messages to Thumbtack Support.
Voice: Calling Thumbtack support (Currently being piloted and not fully turned on)
▶ Maven chats
For chat, the user clicks the “Get help” icon (only visible when logged in). 
The AI assistant greets users with: "👋 I'm Thumbtack's AI assistant. How can I help you today?" Standard Genesys bots start with: "👋 I'm Thumbtack's automated assistant."

[Image: rtaImage]

When Thumbtack’s AI assistant transfers to a rep
▶ 🤖 Background notes
AI Context: This section explains the specific situations in which Thumbtack's AI assistant will escalate a conversation to a Frontline Rep. It outlines the triggers for escalation, ensuring reps understand when they will receive cases from the AI assistant.
These are the situations where the AI assistant transfers  to a rep:
Deactivation requests: The pro or customer asks to cancel their account.
Unresolved issues: The AI assistant wasn’t able to answer the question or provide a helpful resolution.
A customer or pro states that a response was unhelpful, didn't solve their issue, they already tried the proposed resolution without success, or there is no other related information to share that could be helpful.
Repeat request for rep: The user has repeated their request to speak with an agent. 
Sensitive cases: Any Trust & Safety, legal, or sensitive account issues.
How Maven Voice works:
Thumbtack's AI assistant is now available on the phone channel. When a pro or customer calls Thumbtack support, Maven will attempt to handle the interaction before transferring to a live rep. Maven makes two attempts before transferring:
First attempt: Maven tries to resolve the user's issue directly.
Second attempt: If unresolved, Maven asks the caller to provide context to pass to the rep for faster resolution.
Once transferred, the rep receives the call with a Maven summary available via the Script button in the Genesys panel.
How to identify a Maven Voice transfer:
When a call has been transferred from Maven, the Script button in the Genesys panel will appear red. This indicates a Maven summary is available for that call. If no Script button appears or the button is not red, the call was not transferred from Maven. 
The summary can be viewed before or after answering the call.
The summary will include two fields:
Customer Asked — what the user was asking or requesting when they contacted support
AI Response — how Thumbtack's AI assistant responded before transferring to a live rep
▶ Where the script icon can be found

[Image: rtaImage]

▶ What the AI summary from Maven looks look

[Image: rtaImage]

How account verification works with the AI assistant
For Chat and SMS interactions 
The AI assistant attempts to verify the pro or customer before transferring the conversation to a rep. 
Text Support (SMS): The AI assistant checks if the incoming phone number matches a number already listed on the user's account.
Help Center Chat: Users are asked to log in to their account to initiate the chat. The AI assistant attempts to verify the user via their login credentials (email address and password).
Checking Verification Status 
When a case is transferred from the AI assistant, reps must check the verified status in the interaction window under “# VERIFICATION STATUS”:
VERIFIED: The AI assistant successfully verified the user's information. Reps do not need to re-verify the account.
UNVERIFIED (or no status): The AI assistant failed two attempts to verify the user. Reps must follow the full verification process outlined in the internal < Verify Account Information (Pro) (Customer) > KA.

[Image: rtaImage]

For Phone/voice interactions
Unlike chat and SMS, Maven Voice does not perform any verification. No user information is collected or verified by Maven on phone calls. Full verification is required on every Maven Voice transfer, the same as any other inbound phone call.
For full verification steps, see Verify Account Information (Pro) (Customer) KA.
2. Process
▶ 🤖 Background notes
AI Context: This section outlines the process for Frontline Reps to handle cases that have been transferred from Thumbtack's AI Assistant. It details the steps reps should follow and provides information on how to access the conversation summary between the pro or customer and the AI Assistant.
Steps: How to handle a case transferred from Thumbtack’s AI assistant (Rep) 
To handle a case escalated from Thumbtack’s AI assistant, reps will follow these steps:
Answer the transferred case: Respond to the transferred conversation as you would any other incoming conversation. (See what it looks like below.)▶ What it looks like[Image: rtaImage]
Review Conversation Summary: Review the conversation summary displayed for a quick overview, and then scroll up to view the full conversation history to gather all necessary details as needed. 
For chat and SMS: 
“Visitor” is the pro or customer, and “Maven bot” is Thumbtack’s AI assistant. (See what it looks like below.)
Critical Note: Failure to review the summary and asking the user for information they already provided to Maven will result in a QA markdown during Case and Account Review. ▶ What it looks like[Image: rtaImage]
For voice: 
View the AI summary by clicking on the red Script button in the Genesys panel.
Verify the User: Check the AI's verification status.
For chat and SMS: 
If VERIFIED: The user has been verified and no further verification is needed. Reps should ask the user for their name to address them (but not for verification). 
If UNVERIFIED (or no status): The rep must verify the account (same process as usual) upon connecting.  Steps in the internal Verify Account Information (Pro) (Customer) KA. 
For voice: 
Verify the account as usual. Steps in the internal Verify Account Information (Pro) (Customer) KA.
Managers can view the full interaction in Genesys. (See what it looks like below.)
▶ What it looks like

[Image: rtaImage]

Steps: How to take feedback about Thumbtack AI Assistant (Rep)
If reps receive any feedback from pros or customers about Thumbtack’s AI assistant, reps will follow these steps: 
Submit it in Salesforce through the usual feedback process under: 
“[Support] Customer/Pro AI Automated Assistant support experience.” 
Reps can refer to the internal Product Feedback KA for steps. 
3. Talking points
This section provides Frontline Reps with approved talking points for communicating with pros and customers about Thumbtack’s AI assistant. Use these talking points to ensure consistent and accurate messaging.
Concerns about Thumbtack’s AI assistant

English FAQ
Spanish FAQ
Q: Is the AI assistant even going to understand my problem?
Q: ¿El asistente de IA realmente va a entender mi problema?
A: Our AI is designed to understand a wide range of common questions. It can quickly provide you with the most relevant information and solutions. If the issue is complex, Thumbtack’s AI assistant is also trained to recognize when it needs to connect you with an agent who can give you more hands-on help.
A: Nuestro asistente de IA está diseñado para comprender una amplia variedad de preguntas comunes. Puede brindarle rápidamente la información y las soluciones más relevantes. Si el problema es más complejo, el asistente también sabe reconocer cuándo debe conectarlo con un agente para darle una ayuda más personalizada.
Q: Why can't I just talk to a person right away?
 Q: ¿Por qué no puedo hablar con una persona de inmediato?
A: Our goal is to get you the fastest possible solution. Many common issues can be resolved faster by our AI assistant, saving you the time of waiting for a live agent. If it determines you need more specialized help, it will seamlessly transfer you to a support agent with all the details from your conversation, so you won't have to repeat yourself.
 A: Nuestro objetivo es darle la solución más rápida posible. Muchos problemas comunes se pueden resolver más ágilmente con el asistente de IA, lo que le ahorra el tiempo de esperar a un agente en vivo. Si el asistente determina que necesita ayuda más especializada, lo transferirá sin problemas a un agente de soporte con todos los detalles de su conversación, para que no tenga que repetirse.
Q: Is my information safe when I'm talking to the AI assistant?
 Q: ¿Mi información está segura cuando hablo con el asistente de IA?
A: We take your privacy and security very seriously. Thumbtack’s AI assistant operates with the same high security standards as our other support channels. Any information you share is used only to help resolve your issue and is handled in accordance with our privacy policy.
 A: Nos tomamos muy en serio su privacidad y seguridad. El asistente de IA de Thumbtack opera con los mismos altos estándares de seguridad que nuestros otros canales de soporte. La información que comparta se usa únicamente para resolver su problema y se maneja de acuerdo con nuestra política de privacidad.
Q: What if the AI gives me the wrong answer?
 Q: ¿Qué pasa si el asistente de IA me da una respuesta incorrecta?
A: Thumbtack’s AI assistant is built on a large knowledge base that is reliable and continually updated to ensure accuracy. However, if you ever feel that the information provided isn't correct or doesn't solve your problem, you can always ask to be transferred to a live support agent for further assistance.
 A: El asistente de IA de Thumbtack se basa en una amplia base de conocimientos que se actualiza constantemente para garantizar precisión. Sin embargo, si en algún momento siente que la información no es correcta o no resuelve su problema, siempre puede pedir que lo transfieran a un agente de soporte en vivo para recibir más ayuda.
Q: This feels impersonal and frustrating. I'm a person, not a data point.
 Q: Esto se siente impersonal y frustrante. Soy una persona, no un número.
A: We understand that some issues are best handled by a person, and our AI assistant is designed to know when to make that connection. It's a tool to help us answer common questions more efficiently so our support team can focus on providing personalized, in-depth help when you need it most.
 A: Entendemos que algunos problemas se atienden mejor con una persona, y por eso el asistente está diseñado para saber cuándo hacer esa conexión. Es una herramienta que nos ayuda a responder preguntas comunes de manera más eficiente, para que nuestro equipo de soporte pueda enfocarse en brindarle atención personalizada y en profundidad cuando más lo necesite.
4. Resources
Frontline reps will find a collection of valuable resources in this section, including links to internal knowledge articles, external Help Center articles, and other relevant documentation. These resources may be referenced in the article or provide additional, related information.

articles.fullText:
Thumbtack's Quality Commitment (Pro)

Contents
Overview
How the phone number guarantee works
Customer phone number visibility
How the competition limit works
Key points
Dos and Don’ts
Talking Points
How the quality commitment works
How the phone number guarantee works
Phone number verification
Phone number visibility
How the competition limit works
Resources
1. OVERVIEW
Thumbtack’s Quality Commitment is Thumbtack’s pledge to help pros get hired. It’s available for all pros who have targeting preferences turned on. Thumbtack leads will have the following features to give pros the best chance at winning the job:

Protection
What it means
Phone Number Guarantee
Pros will always get the customer’s verified phone number when they pay for a lead
Limited Competition
Customers can contact a maximum of 5 pros within the first 4 hours of their search, giving pros a better shot at winning the job.
To learn more, pros can check out the What is Thumbtack’s Quality Commitment? – Thumbtack Help article.
Internal Note: Reps should not describe the Quality Commitment as a "guarantee," "warranty," or "insurance" when speaking with pros.
How the phone number guarantee works
The Phone Number Guarantee is Thumbtack’s commitment to pros that they’ll always get the customer’s verified phone number when they pay for a lead. Thumbtack has heard from pros that having a customer provide a phone number helps them land the job, confirm job details, and get in touch with customers. 
While Thumbtack may refund for phone numbers identified as invalid or disconnected, Thumbtack can’t guarantee that customers will answer when a pro calls. If a pro believes that they received a disconnected or invalid number, they should request a refund, and Thumbtack will look into it. Reps can refer to the Lead Refunds (Pro) KA to learn more about how refunds for invalid phone numbers are handled.
To help navigate these conversations, reps can refer to the Phone number guarantee talking points below. 
Benefits
By verifying phone numbers and offering refunds for errors, Thumbtack demonstrates a commitment to providing high-quality leads and makes Thumbtack a place where pros feel confident investing their time and resources.
Higher Quality Leads: Pros receive fewer spam leads and more genuine customer inquiries.
Improved Hire Rates: Higher quality leads lead to increased project hires and revenue.
Increased Pro Satisfaction: Pros value the quality of leads and are more likely to remain active on Thumbtack.
Customer phone number visibility 
There are different triggers for a customer's phone number to be made visible or masked on a lead. 

Contact Type
Phone number is masked
Phone number is visible
Leads
Before a pro pays for or replies to the booking or lead
After a pro replies to the lead (and pro is charged).
Opportunities
Before a pro sends a quote
After pro sends quote → customer replies → pro replies to customer's reply (pro is charged)
A customer phone number be either hidden or masked if:
Pro declines the lead
Pro has not paid for the lead or booking
Customer cancels their project
Customer marks another pro as hired
Customer is ghosted or deleted
How the competition limit works 
While a pro wants to be the only pro a customer contacts, some customers want to contact a few pros before deciding who to hire. So, Thumbtack limits the number of pros a customer can contact to five in the first four hours of their search.
Customers usually reach out to fewer pros, but the limit is there for unusual circumstances. In order to make sure customers can find a pro, they can contact additional pros after those first four hours.
By limiting competition, pros have a better shot at getting hired.
Reps can refer to the Competition limit talking points below to navigate these conversations with pros. 
Key Points 
Frontline reps should keep the following in mind when talking to pros about the Quality Commitment:  
Phone Number Guarantee: Pros receive verified phone numbers for paid bookings and leads.
Competition Limit: Customers can contact a maximum of 5 pros in the first 4 hours.
Phone Number Visibility:
Masked: Before payment/reply (Leads, Opportunities) or before booking.
Visible: After payment/reply (Leads), quote reply exchange (Opportunities).
Refunds: Possible for invalid or disconnected numbers, but no guarantee of customer response. Reps can refer to the  Lead Refunds (Pro) KA to learn more. 
No Guarantee of Hire: While the Quality Commitment improves chances, it doesn't ensure the pro will be hired.
Customer unresponsiveness: While pros get contact info, Thumbtack can't guarantee customer responsiveness.
Do's and don'ts 
Frontline reps should follow these do’s and don’ts when talking to pros about the Quality Commitment:  
Do coach pros on how to respond more quickly (by turning on notifications, using the app, etc.) to qualify for The Thumbtack Quality Commitment. Reps can refer to the Messaging Customers: Response Rate, Tools, and Best Practices (Pro) KA. 
Do offer to help pros set their targeting preferences so they can take advantage of The Thumbtack Quality Commitment. Reps can refer to the Targeting: Job Types and Travel Preferences (Pro) KA. 
Don’t describe The Thumbtack Quality Commitment as a "guarantee," a "warranty" or “insurance.”
 2. Talking points
How the quality commitment works

English talking points
Spanish talking points 
What is the Thumbtack Quality Commitment? 
¿Qué es el Compromiso de Calidad de Thumbtack?
The Thumbtack Quality Commitment is our pledge to help you get hired. The Thumbtack Quality Commitment guarantees that all leads and bookings will come with a verified phone number, and that we limit the number of pros a customer can contact to give you the best shot at winning the job. 
El compromiso de calidad de Thumbtack es nuestro compromiso para ayudarlo a ser contratado. El Compromiso de Calidad de Thumbtack le garantiza que todos los prospectos y reservas vendrán con un número de teléfono verificado, y que limitamos el número de profesionales que un cliente puede contactar para darle a usted la mejor oportunidad de obtener el trabajo.
How do I qualify for the Thumbtack Quality Commitment?
¿Cómo califico para el compromiso de calidad de Thumbtack?
You already do — all Thumbtack pros quality for the Quality Commitment. This means you’ll always get the customer’s verified phone number when you pay for a booking or lead, and we’ll limit the number of pros a customer can contact to give you the best chance at getting hired. 
Ya lo hace: todos los profesionales de Thumbtack califican para el Compromiso de calidad. Esto significa que usted siempre obtendrá el número de teléfono verificado del cliente cuando pague por una reserva o prospecto, y limitaremos el número de profesionales que un cliente puede contactar para darle la mejor oportunidad de ser contratado.
How the phone number guarantee works 

English talking points
Spanish talking points 
How will I be protected from unresponsive customers now?
¿Cómo estaré protegido de los clientes que no responden ahora?
You’ll always get the customer’s contact info when you pay for a booking or lead to get in touch if you don’t hear back. Plus, we’ve seen that customers who provide their phone numbers are more serious about getting their job done.
Siempre tendrá la información del contacto cuando paga por una reserva o cliente potencial para ponerse en contacto si no recibe una respuesta. Además, hemos visto que los clientes que proporcionan sus números de teléfono se toman más en serio su trabajo.
Will phone numbers be on all leads?
¿Los números de teléfono estarán en todos los prospectos?
You’ll always get the customer’s contact info when you pay for a booking or lead. The phone number will appear on all leads after you reply. It will also appear on opportunities after the customer replies and you respond to the customer’s reply. 
Siempre tendrá la información del contacto cuando paga por una reserva o cliente potencial. El número de teléfono también aparecerá en las oportunidades después de que el cliente responda y usted responda a la respuesta del cliente. 
Phone number verification

English talking points
Spanish talking points 
Are phone numbers verified?
¿Se verifican los números de teléfono?
Yes, we use an identity-matching process to verify all customers’ phone numbers. But if you get a disconnected or invalid phone number, request a refund and we’ll look into it. 
Sí, utilizamos un proceso de coincidencia de identidad para verificar los números de teléfono de todos los clientes. Pero si usted obtiene un número de teléfono desconectado o inválido, solicite un reembolso y lo investigaremos.
What if a legitimate customer gets flagged incorrectly, and I miss out on a potential job?
¿Qué sucede si un cliente legítimo es marcado incorrectamente y pierdo un trabajo potencial?
We understand this concern. We've designed the system to minimize false positives and ensure that genuine customers can still reach out to pros. The verification steps are primarily triggered when there are discrepancies that indicate a higher risk of spam or fraud. Additionally, if a customer encounters difficulties, our support team is available to assist them. We are also continuously monitoring the process for accuracy and making improvements.
Entendemos esta preocupación. Hemos diseñado el sistema para minimizar los falsos positivos y garantizar que los clientes genuinos aún puedan comunicarse con los profesionales. Los pasos de verificación se activan principalmente cuando hay discrepancias que indican un mayor riesgo de spam o fraude. Además, si un cliente encuentra dificultades, nuestro equipo de soporte está disponible para ayudarlo. También estamos monitoreando continuamente el proceso para garantizar la precisión y realizar mejoras.
I'm glad you're taking steps to improve lead quality. I've definitely received a lot of spam leads in the past.
Me alegra que estén tomando medidas para mejorar la calidad de los prospectos. Definitivamente he recibido muchos prospectos de spam en el pasado.
We appreciate your feedback. This phone number verification process is just one of the ways we're working to enhance lead quality and provide you with more meaningful interactions. We value your partnership with Thumbtack and want to help you succeed on our platform.
Agradecemos sus comentarios. Este proceso de verificación de números de teléfono es solo una de las formas en que estamos trabajando para mejorar la calidad de los prospectos y brindarle interacciones más significativas. Valoramos su colaboración con Thumbtack y queremos ayudarlo a tener éxito en nuestra plataforma.
Phone number visibility 

English talking points
Spanish talking points 
Where will I be able to see the customer’s phone number?
¿Dónde puedo ver el número de teléfono del cliente?
You’ll be able to see the customer’s phone number directly in the messenger after you pay for a lead or booking. The phone number will also appear in the job details.
Puede ver el número de teléfono del cliente directamente en el mensajero después de pagar por la reserva o cliente potencial. El número de teléfono también aparecerá en los detalles del trabajo.
Can I find the customer’s phone number on the Opportunities tab?
¿Puedo encontrar el número de teléfono del cliente en la pestaña Oportunidades?
No, the customer’s phone number will not appear on the Opportunities tab. You’ll only get their phone number if the customer replies to your quote, which is when you’d pay for the lead.
No, el número de teléfono del cliente no aparecerá en la pestaña Oportunidades. Solo obtendrá su número de teléfono si el cliente responde a su estimado y es entonces cuando pagaría por el cliente potencial.

How the competition limit works 

English talking points
Spanish talking points 
What does the Competition Limit do?
¿Qué hace el límite de competencia?
While the best-case scenario is having customers only contact one pro, some customers want to contact several pros before deciding who to hire. The competition limit prevents customers from contacting more than 5 pros within four hours of making their first contact.
Our competition limit prevents excessive competition - We heard feedback that many prefer to cap the number of pros a customer can contact, rather than have a discount. This will help get rid of cases where the customer is just shopping around or not serious about hiring. Our competition limit protects you so that you’re not paying for leads when your likelihood of winning the job is low. Now, customers can only contact up to 5 pros from search results in the first 4 hours of making their first contact.
Si en el mejor de los casos es que los clientes solo se comuniquen con un profesional, algunos clientes quieren contactar a varios profesionales antes de decidir a quién contratar. El límite de competencia impide que los clientes se comuniquen con más de 5 profesionales dentro de las cuatro horas posteriores a su primer contacto.

Nuestro límite de competencia evita la competencia excesiva: escuchamos comentarios de que muchos prefieren limitar la cantidad de profesionales que un cliente puede contactar, en lugar de tener un descuento. Esto ayudará a deshacerse de los casos en los que el cliente solo está comprando o no se toma en serio la contratación. Nuestro límite de competencia lo protege para que no pague por clientes potenciales cuando su probabilidad de ganar el trabajo es baja. Ahora, los clientes solo pueden contactar hasta 5 profesionales de los resultados de búsqueda en las primeras 4 horas de hacer su primer contacto.

1. Overview   
▶ KA Summary
This internal knowledge article provides Frontline Reps with an overview of the Thumbtack Pro Rewards program, outlining its three tiers (Silver, Gold, and Platinum), qualification requirements, how pros earn points, and the associated rewards. Understanding this program will help Frontline Reps effectively communicate with pros about their status and benefits. 

Thumbtack Pro Rewards has three tiers (Silver, Gold, and Platinum) and is based on the pro's overall profile. Pros qualify for these tiers in a few ways:
Earning points as they accept jobs and respond to new leads. 
Continuing to offer excellent customer service on Thumbtack.
These tiers recognize the pro’s great service to their customers and come with rewards.

Pros can refer to the What is the Thumbtack Pro Rewards program? Thumbtack Help article  to learn more.
Key points
Here are a few things rep should keep in mind when help pros with their rewards: 
Status Update Timelines
Points: Points may take up to 8 hours to post to the pros account.
Response rate: It may take up to 8 hours after responding to a lead for it to impact the pro’s response rate
Tier update: It may take 24-48 hours for their tier status (Silver, Gold, or Platinum) to officially update on their account, even if points have been posted. 
Badge apparent (Platinum only): It takes up to 24 hours for the Top Pro badge to appear on a pro's public profile and search results after achieving Platinum status.
Verifying Pro Status and Progress
Always verify a pro's reward status (Pro Loyalty Member Status) and Top Pro Badge status in the Admin tool under the Details section, as Salesforce data is inaccurate.
For past performance, tier history, or point accrual details, reps should utilize the Pro Rewards History section on the main user page.
Pro Status/Progress Page: Pros can see their current tier and their progress toward the next qualifying period on their Pro Rewards page. This page is accessible via the Services tab
Qualification Mechanics
Tiers: The program has three tiers: Silver, Gold, and Platinum (min 2,400 points).
Earn points: Pros earn 100 points for responding to Direct Leads and Opportunities; they earn 600 points for a one-time integration with a Thumbtack-partnered platform. Points are removed if the lead is later refunded.
Points reset to zero (0) every three months at the start of a new qualification period (December 1, March 1, June 1, September 1).
Response Rate Calculation: A pro's response rate is calculated on a three-month rolling period (90 days). It uses the percentage of new leads the pro gets and responds to within one hour (between 8 a.m. and 8 p.m. local time).
Gold requires a 65% response rate; Platinum requires a 75% response rate.
Review Rating Calculation: The review rating is calculated on a three-month rolling period using verified reviews from the past 12 months.
Minimum star ratings needed: 4.5 for Silver, 4.6 for Gold, and 4.7 for Platinum.
Earn points: Pros earn 100 points for responding to Direct Leads and Opportunities; they earn 600 points for a one-time integration with a Thumbtack-partnered platform. Points are removed if the lead is later refunded.
Reward Duration: 
Once a pro qualifies for a tier, they receive those rewards for the remainder of that qualifying period and the entirety of the next one.
Swag and Rewards
Thumbtack Swag is a one-time milestone reward tied to a pro’s one-year Thumbtack anniversary when they reach Silver, Gold, or Platinum status.
Top Pro Badge
The Top Pro Badge is exclusive to pros with Platinum status.
It is awarded at the pro level, meaning if a pro has multiple profiles and only one reaches Platinum, all profiles receive the badge.
Pros must qualify for Platinum status in two of four annual periods to receive the badge for the year.
It takes up to 24 hours for the Top Pro badge to appear on a pro's public profile and search results after achieving Platinum status.
Questions
If you have questions not covered in this Knowledge Article, first reach out to the Advanced Service team. They will tell you if you need to post your question in the #Pro-community Slack channel.
Updates and experiments

Pro Rewards Bonus Points (Pro) (Experiment)
Starting April 29, 2026, Thumbtack will launch an experiment that gives pros additional pro rewards, including bonus points. These new milestone rewards are to incentivize newer pros to take action that will set them up for success.
These new milestone rewards include: 

Getting 5 reviews
Responding to their first five leads within 60 minutes
Turning on push notifications for the app on their phone.
This experiment has two variants.

Variant 1: Earns points
Variant 2: Earns points and lead credit
Experiment details:
Launch date: April 29, 2026
End date: 4–8 weeks
Impacted users: All pros (App and Desktop)
To learn more, reps can refer to the internal Pro Rewards Bonus Points (Pro) (Experiment) KA.

How pros earn points in Pro Rewards
Earning points is a key way for a pro to advance through the Silver, Gold, and Platinum tiers of the Thumbtack Pro Rewards program. Pros earn points for various actions:
Responding to leads: 
Points issued: Upon the pro’s first response to a customer.
Points earned:  100
Responding on an opportunities: 
Points issued: When a pro completes a three-step engagement: quoting on an opportunity, receiving a reply from the customer, and finally, responding back to the customer message. 
Points earned: 100 
Connect account to an integration 
Points issued: When a pro adds an integration with a Thumbtack-partnered platform* to their Thumbtack account. 
Points earned: 600  *This is a one-time incentive.
