Specific actions (experiment)
Internal note: Newer pros may be eligible to earn additional bonus points for reviews and response speed. Before troubleshooting point totals for a newer pro, check the internal Pro Rewards Bonus Points (Pro) (Experiment) KA to see if they are in an active experiment variant.
IMPORTANT: 
Pros do NOT earn points for claimable jobs. 
Points may take up to 8 hours to post to the pros account.
Points reset to every three months as part of the Pro Rewards qualification periods. This means that at the start of a new period, pros will have zero (0) points. 
Lead refunds: If a pro earned points on a lead (or an opportunity) and the lead is later refunded, those points will be removed. 
How to Verify Point Accrual and History (Rep)
If a pro is inquiring about missing points or a drop in their point total, reps can look at the Point History Table in Admin.
To Audit Points Earned: Scroll to the Pro Rewards History section in Admin. Expand the Point History Table for the current period. Review the Point Type and Date to confirm if points for leads (or the one time integration) have been successfully applied.
To Audit Point Deductions (Refunds): If a pro's points have decreased, check the Point History Table for the specific quarter. If a lead or opportunity was refunded, a corresponding deduction will appear here. Cross-reference this with the Credit Log to confirm the refund date.
System Latency: Note that both the Pro Rewards dashboard and the Admin Point History table refresh approximately every 8 hours. If a lead was received or a refund was processed within the last 8 hours, it may not yet be reflected in either view.
Review rating and response rate criteria for Pro Rewards 
▶ 🤖 Background notes
AI Context: This section explains how review ratings and response rates are calculated for pros in the Thumbtack Pro Rewards program. Frontline Reps can use this information to address pro inquiries about their qualification criteria.
Review rating
As a service requirement, a pro must maintain a high star rating. A pros review rating is calculated on a rolling period, using verified* Thumbtack reviews received in the past year (12 months). This means it counts back from the current day and not the next award cycle. For example, if today is March 2, 2023, reviews from March 2, 2022 - March 2, 2023 are counted.
*Verified reviews are from Thumbtack customers and are marked as "Hired on Thumbtack". 
The table below shows the review ratings needed to qualify:

Tier
Review Rating Requirement 
Silver
4.5 rating
Gold
4.6 rating
Platinum
4.7 rating

▶ Pro question: "How is the review rating calculated for Pro Rewards?"
Rep talking point: "To keep the playing field level, the Pro Rewards program calculates your rating using a rolling window of verified reviews from the past 12 months. This focus on recent service, rather than your lifetime average, ensures the rating reflects your current performance. For example: If you received a 5-star review exactly 12 months ago, that review is part of your calculation today. However, tomorrow, that review becomes 12 months and 1 day old, so it 'rolls' out of the window and no longer counts. Because this window moves every day, your rating can change even if you haven’t received a new review recently.
Spanish Talking Point: “Para mantener condiciones justas para todos, el programa Pro Rewards calcula su calificación usando un periodo móvil de reseñas verificadas de los últimos 12 meses. Este enfoque en su servicio reciente, en lugar de su promedio histórico, ayuda a que la calificación refleje su desempeño actual. Por ejemplo: si recibió una reseña de 5 estrellas hace exactamente 12 meses, esa reseña forma parte de su cálculo hoy. Sin embargo, mañana esa reseña tendrá 12 meses y 1 día de antigüedad, por lo que quedará fuera del periodo y ya no contará. Como este periodo se actualiza todos los días, su calificación puede cambiar incluso si no ha recibido una reseña nueva recientemente.”
Track response rate: 
Pros can refer to their Pro Rewards page to see their current star rating.
▶ When a pro clicks on the “Star rating” section, this is an example of what they will see:
The image below shows a pros current star rating at 3.6 with a section for “how ratings work” and “how to reach gold”.”

[Image: rtaImage]

▶ Steps: How to calculate reviews needed for a specific rating (Rep)
To determine how many 5-star reviews a pro needs to reach Silver (4.5), Gold (4.6), or Platinum (4.7), reps must use the Reviews Calculator. Follow these steps: 
Gather review ratings: First, reps will need to find:
The pro's 12-month review counts: Log in as the pro and look at the Rewards Progress page.
Note the counts: You need the specific number of 5-star, 4-star, 3-star, 2-star, and 1-star verified reviews received in the last 12 months only. (Do not count unverified or imported reviews) Check the main users page in Admin, under Reviews Received to manually count these reviews. 
Input & Calculate: Plug the counts into the Pro Rewards Reviews Calculator. The calculator will show the number of consecutive 5-star reviews needed to hit the target.
Apply the Safety Buffer: Because the window is rolling and an old 5-star review might "fall off" tomorrow, always advise the pro to get at least one more than the calculator suggests.
Steps pro can take: Explain how they can request a review or schedule a review request from a customer they met through Thumbtack in the messenger with that customer. 
Pro Question: "How many more five star reviews do I need to get to have/or reach my status back?"
Rep talking Point: "I have calculated your goal. To reach your tier requirement, you need [Number from Calculator] five start reviews before [End of qualifying period] to reach a [4.5/4.6/4.7]. Because old reviews 'fall off' every day, I recommend aiming for [Number + 10%] to make sure you stay above that threshold as your older reviews roll out of the 12-month window."
Spanish Pro Question: “¿Cuántas reseñas más de 5 estrellas necesito para recuperar o alcanzar de nuevo mi estatus?” 
Spanish Rep talking Point: Ya calculé su meta. Para alcanzar el requisito de su nivel, necesita [Number from Calculator] reseñas de 5 estrellas antes de [End of qualifying period] para llegar a una calificación de [4.5/4.6/4.7]. Como las reseñas más antiguas dejan de contar todos los días, le recomiendo apuntar a [Number + 10%] para asegurarse de mantenerse por encima de ese umbral a medida que sus reseñas más antiguas van quedando fuera del periodo móvil de 12 meses.”
Response rate
As a service requirement, a pro must maintain a high response rate.  The response rate is calculated on a three-month (90 days) rolling period using the percentage of new leads the pro gets and responds to within one hour (between 8 am-8 pm local time). For example, if the pro gets a lead at 10 pm, they have until 9 am the next day to respond for it to count toward their response rate. 
The response rate uses the pros response rate from the past 3 months (90 days).  For example, if today is March 2, 2023, a pros response rate from March 2, 2023 - December 2, 2022 are counted. 
The table below shows the percentages needed to qualify:

Tier
Response Rate Requirement 
Silver
No requirement
Gold
65% response rate
Platinum
75% response rate
▶ Pro Question: "How is my response rate calculated?"
Rep talking point:  "To ensure customers get quick service, your response rate is calculated on a 90-day rolling window For example,  you had a late response exactly 90 days ago, it is affecting your rate today. Tomorrow, that response 'rolls' out of the window and no longer counts. Your rate changes daily based on which old leads fall off and how many new leads you are answering quickly."
Spanish Pro Question: “¿Cómo se calcula mi tasa de respuesta?”
Spanish Rep talking Point: “Para ayudar a que los clientes reciban un servicio rápido, su tasa de respuesta se calcula con un periodo móvil de 90 días. Por ejemplo, si tuvo una respuesta tardía hace exactamente 90 días, esa respuesta afecta su tasa hoy. Mañana, esa respuesta quedará fuera del periodo y ya no contará. Su tasa cambia todos los días según cuáles prospectos antiguos dejan de contar y cuántos prospectos nuevos responde rápidamente.”
NOTE: It may take up to 8 hours after responding to a lead for it to impact the pro’s response rate.

▶ Steps: How to calculate leads needed for a specific response rate (Rep)
To determine how many leads a pro needs to respond to within 1 hour to reach Gold (65%) or Platinum (75%), reps can use the Pro Rewards Response Rate Calculator.
Find date: First, reps will need to find:
The pros current response rate by checking the pros Pro Rewards page (follow Steps: How to check a pros current Pro Rewards progress)
The number of leads the pro has received in the last 90 days: In Admin, look at the pro's Journal Entries on the Pro-Payment Summary page in Admin. 
Input & Calculate: Plug the pros response rate and number of leads into the Pro Rewards Response Rate Calculator. The calculator will show the number of consecutive 1-hour responses needed.
The "Safety Buffer": Because the window is rolling, the calculator provides the minimum number. Always tell the pro to aim for 10% more than the result.
Example: If the calculator says 58, tell the pro: "The math says you need 58 leads, but since old leads fall off every day, let's aim for 65 to be safe."
Reset: Clear the input cells after the interaction so the tool is ready for the next rep.
Pro Question: "How many more leads do I need to answer quickly to get my status back?"
Rep Talking Point: "I have calculated your goal. To reach your tier requirement, you need to respond to your next [Number from Calculator] leads within one hour. Because old leads 'fall off' every day, I recommend aiming for [Number + 10%] leads to be safe and ensure you hit that goal."
Spanish Pro Question: “¿A cuántos prospectos más necesito responder rápidamente para recuperar mi estatus?”
Spanish Rep Talking Point: “Ya calculé su meta. Para cumplir con el requisito de su nivel, necesita responder a sus próximos [Number from Calculator] prospectos dentro de una hora. Como los prospectos más antiguos dejan de contar todos los días, le recomiendo apuntar a [Number + 10%] prospectos para irse a la segura y asegurarse de alcanzar esa meta.”
Reps can refer to the internal Responsiveness (Pro) KA to learn more. 
Pro Rewards qualification periods: Points reset and status duration 
Pro Rewards has four quarterly (every three months) qualifying periods per year. Points reset to zero (0) on the 1st day of the start month for each period.
Period 1: December to February (Points reset on December 1)
Period 2: March to May (Points reset on March 1)
Period 3: June to August (Points reset on June 1)
Period 4: September to November (Points reset on September 1)
How it works: 
At the beginning of each period
Points will reset to zero (0) (December 1, March 1, June 1, September 1).
If the pro has not met the requirements to remain in their current tier, their status will be adjusted.
When a pro qualifies for a tier (which can happen at any point during a period):
Thumbtack notifies the pro via email and in their account
The pro receives the rewards associated with that tier for the remainder of that current qualifying period.
The pro also receives those rewards for the entirety of the next qualifying period. For example a pro who qualified for Platinum at the end of June would have Platinum rewards through November. 
To maintain their status
The pro will need to continue to meet the points and service requirements associated with their status. 

▶ Pro question: "My points are at zero! Where did they go?" (start of a new qualifying period)
Rep talking point: "It’s normal to see your points at zero. Points reset at the start of every new qualifying period (March, June, September, and December). Think of it like a new season in sports: the scoreboard resets so you can start earning toward your next tier, but you still keep the status and benefits you earned during the previous period."
Spanish Pro Question: “¡Mis puntos están en cero! ¿Qué pasó con ellos?” (inicio de un nuevo periodo de calificación)
Spanish Rep talking Point: “Es normal que sus puntos aparezcan en cero. Los puntos se reinician al comienzo de cada nuevo periodo de calificación (marzo, junio, septiembre y diciembre). Piénselo como una nueva temporada en los deportes: el marcador se reinicia para que pueda empezar a sumar puntos para su próximo nivel, pero usted conserva el estatus y los beneficios que obtuvo durante el periodo anterior.”
In order to receive the Top Pro badge, the pro must qualify for two of four periods for the year.

Status Update Timelines (Latency)
This section explains the delay between a pro completing an action and seeing the update on their Pro Rewards page: 
Points: Points may take up to 8 hours to post to the pros account.
Response rate: It may take up to 8 hours after responding to a lead for it to impact the pro’s response rate.
Tier update: It may take 24–48 hours for their tier status (Silver, Gold, or Platinum) to officially update on their account (even if points or response or review rating have been updated). 
Tier Qualification Notification & Reward Duration: When a pro qualifies, Thumbtack notifies them via email and in their account. The rewards apply immediately (once tier is updated), lasting for the remainder of the current qualifying period plus the entirety of the next qualifying period (e.g., a pro who qualified for Platinum at the end of June would have Platinum rewards through November).
Badge apparent (Platinum only): It takes up to 24 hours for the Top Pro badge to appear on a pro's public profile and search results after achieving Platinum status.

Success Workshop

[Image: rtaImage]

The success workshop offers pros a valuable opportunity to connect with other successful professionals, network with Community Leaders, and learn best practices directly from Thumbtack's senior success coaches. This workshop is available to all three Pro Rewards tiers: Silver, Gold, and Platinum.
Here's how it works:
Invitations: Eligible pros will receive an email invitation to register for the quarterly success workshop.
Confirmation: Those who register will receive a confirmation email.
Recordings: All registered pros will receive a recording of the session after it concludes.
Thumbtack sway: First Anniversary Milestones 

[Image: rtaImage]

In recognition of a pro's contributions to Thumbtack and in celebration of their 1-year anniversary on the platform, Silver, Gold, and Platinum tier pros get to choose from a selection of premium gifts available to Thumbtack’s most valued pros. Eligibility is tied to their one-year Thumbtack anniversary.
It’s important that reps keep the following in mind when discussing Thumbtack swag from Pro Rewards with pros:
Eligibility: A pro receives anniversary swag only if they qualify for Silver, Gold, or Platinum during the rewards period when their one-year Thumbtack anniversary occurs
For example: A pro's one-year Thumbtack anniversary is on July 15th, which falls within the June to August qualifying period. 
Eligible: If this pro reaches Gold, Silver, or Platinum status on July 5th, they are eligible for swag. They met a qualifying tier (Gold) during the same rewards period (June to August) as their anniversary.
Ineligible: If this pro only reaches Member status during the entire June to August period, they are not eligible for swag. They must qualify for at least Silver, Gold, or Platinum to receive the reward.
Swag redemption: Pros must place their order before the end of the current three-month qualifying period in which their anniversary falls. 
For example, if a pro's one-year anniversary is on July 15th (falling within the June to August period), they must order their swag before August 31st.
Date and Retroactivity: The Pro Rewards program launched in April 2021. Swag is not given for any period before this launch date. If a pro's one-year anniversary was before April 2021, they are ineligible for anniversary swag.
Handling Frustration/Feedback:
If a pro is ineligible for the swag and expresses frustration, acknowledge their feedback and submit it.
Explain that we are taking their feedback into consideration.
Reps must not promise anything that suggests they will receive a specific resolution or swag.

Steps: How to redeem Pro Rewards One-Year Anniversary swag (Pro)

A pro receives anniversary swag only if they have qualified for Silver, Gold, or Platinum during the qualification period that aligns with their one-year Thumbtack anniversary's rewards period.
When a pro is eligible for swag, they receive an email with instructions on how to order the item that they want (limited to one swag item). 
Time Limit for Redemption: Pros must place their swag order before the end of the three-month qualifying period during which their one-year anniversary falls. For instance, a pro whose one-year anniversary is July 15th (within the June to August period) must order their swag no later than August 31st.
Here are the detailed steps for pros to redeem their swag:
Check for Eligibility Email: If you have qualified for a Pro Rewards tier (Silver, Gold, or Platinum) during the rewards period when your one-year Thumbtack anniversary occurs, you will receive an email from Thumbtack. This email is your official notification and contains the necessary link and code.
Access the Storefront: Click the link provided in the email. This link will take you directly to the secure Adcentives West’s storefront, which is the platform used for Thumbtack Pro Rewards swag redemption. 
Locate the Redemption Code Box: Once on the Thumbtack Pro Rewards storefront page, scroll down to find the designated box for entering your unique redemption code. 
Select Your Swag Item: After entering a valid code, the system will grant you access to view and select your desired swag item from the available options (limited to one item).
Complete the Order: Follow the on-screen prompts to confirm your selection and provide the shipping address where you would like your swag delivered.
Shipping Confirmation: Adcentives West will process your order and ship the swag directly to the address you provided. You can expect your item to arrive within approximately 4-6 weeks.
Shipping updates: For questions regarding shipping updates on ordered swag, please reach out to Advcentives West at customerservice@adcentiveswest.com.
Priority support (via chat and text) 

[Image: rtaImage]

Pros in Gold and Platinum tiers receive expedited, priority support. This means they are automatically prioritized when contacting support reps via chat or text. Support reps will acknowledge their Pro Rewards status and thank them for being part of the program.
Marketing Workshops

[Image: rtaImage]

For Gold and Platinum tier pros, the marketing workshops provide an opportunity to learn how to further build their brand. They gain access to quarterly sessions led by industry leaders in marketing. Pros can also pursue additional courses if they wish to dive deeper.
Here's how it works:
The workshop is conducted by Boot Camp Digital.
Pros will receive an email invitation to a quarterly marketing workshop, including a link to the Zoom registration page.
After the workshop, pros can access the recording, along with digital downloads and tools.
Following the workshop, pros will receive a discount code for additional courses with Boot Camp Digital.
Pro Partnership Committee

[Image: rtaImage]

Pros can join an elite group of professionals who will participate in quarterly surveys and roundtable discussions to inform the future Thumbtack product decisions. Engaged pros may also get the chance to be featured in Thumbtack marketing materials, PR stories, and more. The partnership committee is available to Gold and Platinum tier pros. 
Qualified pros will be emailed quarterly surveys and may be invited to join smaller roundtable discussions to deep dive on a topic that they are expert in
Pros who engage in surveys and discussions will receive priority consideration when we are looking for pros to feature in social media posts, PR stories, blog posts and more
Qualified pros will receive a quarterly recap that shares findings from the survey and highlights how pro feedback is being incorporated into plans
Featured Expert

[Image: rtaImage]


Thumbtack is always looking for ways to amplify pro’s voices and stories. If a pro achieves Top Pro (a pro with Platinum rewards status), they’re eligible to become a featured expert. Thumbtack may feature pros in many ways, like:
Highlighting pro stories or quotes in marketing materials or on Thumbtack’s website.
Connecting pros with third party media outlets who are interested in talking to small business owners.
Featuring pro’s expertise in Thumbtack’s Help Center.
And more.
If a Top Pro is interested in being a featured expert, they can comment on the Be a featured expert — Thumbtack Community post. In their comment or message, the pro should explain why they’d be a good pro to feature. Thumbtack may reach out to the pro if an opportunity comes up.
Top Pro Badge (Platinum only)

[Image: rtaImage]

Pros can help their business stand out in search results and demonstrate their consistent, high-quality service to customers with the exclusive Top Pro badge. This badge is exclusively for pros with Platinum status.
Annual Qualification: Pros must qualify for two out of four periods to receive the Top Pro Badge for the year on their customer-facing profile.
Badge Appearance: It takes up to 24 hours for the Top Pro badge to appear on a pro's public profile and search results after achieving Platinum status. (For Silver and Gold, the status will only be visible to the pro).
Badge Duration: The Top Pro badge remains visible as long as the pro maintains Platinum status.
Tier Exclusivity: Only Platinum pros receive the Top Pro badge.
Past Badges: Previous Top Pro badges will be showcased on the profile.
Pro-Level Award: The badge is awarded at the pro level, not the service level. If a pro has multiple profiles and only one reaches Platinum, all profiles will receive the Top Pro badge.
Reps can use the Top Pro Badge Status section in Admin to count how many Platinum quarters a pro has earned in the current year. This allows reps to tell a pro exactly how many more Platinum quarters they need to hit the annual goal.

3. Process
Steps: How to verify a pros rewards status in Admin (Rep)

To verify a pro's reward status (also known internally as ‘loyalty status’), reps will follow these steps:
In the pro's main user page in Admin, navigate to the Details section.
Check the Pro loyalty Member Status to determine their Pro Rewards status:
Silver, Gold, or Platinum: The pro's current Pro Reward status.
Member: The pro has begun receiving leads but has not yet hit the minimum tier for Silver.
Not a member: The pro has not started receiving leads yet.
Also under Details, check Has Active Top Pro Badge:
True indicates that the pro currently has a Top Pro badge.
False indicates the pro doesn’t have the badge.
NOTE: Pros must qualify for two of four periods to receive the Top Pro Badge for the year on their customer-facing profile.

Steps: How to view & troubleshoot Rewards history in Admin (Rep)
Admin Tool: Pro Rewards History
This section in Admin provides a historical view of a pro’s points, tiers, and badges. It can be used to resolve disputes regarding past performance. The data refreshes every ~8 hours. 
History Section Features
Top Pro badge eligibility: There is not currently a dedicated field in Admin for this. If a rep needs to confirm whether a pro qualified, they should review the pro’s Platinum status across the previous year’s qualifying periods to verify whether they met the 2 out of 4 periods requirement.

Status History Table: Shows the specific tier reached for every year and quarter. This table includes the Quarter Guide (specific date ranges like Dec–Feb, Mar–May).
Point History Table: Displays total points earned per quarter and awards given.
Expandable View: Reps can click “Show” to see a line-by-item breakdown.
Data Columns: Shows the Point Type (e.g., Integration, Lead), the Point Value, and the Date issued.

Steps: How to use Pro Rewards History section in Admin (Rep)

Frontline reps can follow these steps when a pro has questions about past tiers, missing points from a previous month, or their progress toward the annual Top Pro badge.
Locate the History Section: In Admin on the main user page, scroll down to the Pro Rewards History section.
Verify Past Tiers: Use the Status History Table to confirm which tier the pro achieved in previous quarters.
Audit Point Events: Use the Point History Table to verify if specific points were awarded or dedicated (due to refunds).
Check Top Pro Progress: Use the Top Pro Badge Status to count how many Platinum quarters the pro has earned in the current year.
Steps: How to use Pro Rewards Page to check pros current progress (Rep)

To check the pro's Pro Rewards progress (including specific requirements met), reps will follow these steps: 
Log in as the pro.
Go to their Services page. 
Click on Pro Rewards.
Check the progress bar at the top. This bar shows the date by which the pro needs to reach the next Pro Rewards tier.
Review the "Requirements" Tab:
This tab shows the requirements the pro has already met for that specific tier and their progress toward fulfilling the remaining ones.
A green checkmark indicates a completed requirement.
Click on each requirement for more details and resources to share with the pro. 
On the Pro Rewards page, reps can see: 
Points: The total points the pro has earned. Note that points reset to zero at the beginning of each three-month qualification period. Reps can also refer to the Pro Rewards History in Admin. 
Response Rate: The percentage of new leads the pro responds to between 8 a.m. and 8 p.m. local time, calculated over a three-month rolling period. This includes all leads received by the pro.
Star Rating: The pro's current star rating, calculated on a twelve-month rolling basis.
Profile Photos: Whether the pro has added photos of past projects to their profile.
NOTE: Reps should not use Salesforce to check a pros status as it is not accurate. Reps should not submit a Help Desk ticket about a loyalty (rewards) program change unless it is incorrect in Admin.
Steps: How to troubleshoot a pro’s Rewards status or tier loss (Rep)
Frontline reps will follow these steps when a pro is contacting Support because they have lost their status, or they are frustrated that they are not reaching a higher tier.
Check for active experiments:
In Admin, go to Experiment assignments.
Search for Pro Rewards Bonus Points.
If the pro is in Variant 1 or 2, refer to the internal Pro Rewards Bonus Points (Pro) (Experiment) KA for specifics that may affect their tier progression.
Verify the current tier in Admin:
Search for the pro in Admin.
Scroll to the Pro Loyalty Member Status field to see their official current tier (Member, Silver, Gold, or Platinum).
Scroll down to the Pro Rewards History section in Admin to:
Check the Top Pro Badge status to see whether the pro is Platinum and if they've met the two quarter requirement for the Top Pro Badge.
Confirm which tier the pro achieved in previous quarters in the Status History table.
Check the Points History table to see the total points earned per quarter. Has the pro had points dedicated from refunds? 
View the pro's progress on their Pro Rewards Page:

Use the "Login as User" feature to view the pro’s account.
Navigate to the Pro Rewards section.
Identify the Blocker: Look for any requirements that don’t have a green check mark. Check the:
Points (Silver 300 points, Gold 1,200 points, Platinum 2,400 points) Can also be found in Admin)
Review Rating (Silver 4.5, Gold 4.6, Platinum 4.7 )
Response Rate: Is their 1-hour response rate at or above the threshold (Gold 65%, Platinum 75%)?
Profile Photos & Background check:  Does the profile actually have 1 (or more) photos on profile and a background check? 
For full steps, follow Steps: How to check the pros Rewards progress (Rep)
Calculate the Recovery Goal:
If the pro is blocked by Response Rate, use the Pro Rewards Response Rate Calculator. Full steps > How to calculate leads needed for a specific response rate
 If the pro is blocked by Review rating, use the e Reviews Calculator. Full steps > How to calculate reviews needed for a specific rating
If the pro is blocked by points, calculate how many points are needed to reach the tier (OR explain why they had points deducted).
Provide the pro with a specific goal (e.g., "You need four 5-star reviews to reach 4.7"). Use the talking points below to help navigate these conversations.

1. Overview
▶ KA Summary
This internal knowledge article provides Frontline Reps with comprehensive information about the Thumbtack Pro Referral Program. It explains how existing pros can refer new pros, how bonuses are earned, and how Frontline Reps can assist pros with referral-related inquiries. Frontline Reps will find details on eligibility, bonus tracking, and how to address common pro questions. 
The Thumbtack Pro Referral Program allows existing pros to refer new pros to the platform using a unique referral link.
When the referral requirements are met:
Both the existing pro and the new pro receive lead credits
Credits are applied to the pro’s Thumbtack balance
Credits cannot be withdrawn or redeemed for cash
This program is a double-sided incentive designed to grow the Thumbtack marketplace by encouraging pros to invite qualified pros.

Credits cannot be applied retroactively

Referral Fraud and Bans 
The Trust and Safety team monitors referral activity for fraud. 
Common reasons for referral bans:
The referral itself is determined to be fraudulent — e.g., both the referrer and referral are the same person or strongly linked
They are linked to an account that has already been granted the referral incentive (e.g., same credit card, email, or phone)
They are linked to a banned or abusive account
Their account shows spammy signals or fraudulent behavior (e.g., fake reviews, scam activity)
When banned:
The pro's referral incentive credits are revoked after the ban is set
Both accounts may be removed from the referral program (banned from the incentives program but account remains active).
Pros will still have a referral page and referral link. However, the referral link is no longer valid and their link will be redirected to the pro landing page (https://www.thumbtack.com/pro).
How to see if pro has been banned 
Reps can check the “Pro Statuses” field in Admin. If they have been banned, the "Ban user from Pro Referral Incentives" box will be checked. Frontline Reps should not make any adjustments to this section.
How to help a pro who has been banned from the pro referral program 
When helping a pro with a referral ban or incentive denial, reps must follow these guidelines:
✅ What reps CAN tell the pro: 
Inform the pro that, after review, they were determined not to qualify for the incentive based on Thumbtack’s Terms of Use.
Reps may say: “After reviewing your account, we determined you do not qualify for the incentive. Incentives are subject to Thumbtack’s Terms of Use.”
Refer the pro to the promotions section of the Terms of Use for more details.
🚫 What reps CANNOT tell the pro:
Do NOT specify that the ban is due to suspected duplicate accounts, fraud, or any similar reason. Do not use the words "fraud," "spam," or "duplicate" when speaking to the pro.
Do NOT disclose specific private information, such as the spending amounts of the referred pro or disclose whether the new pro received their first lead.
Reps can refer to the internal Sensitive Account Information Handling Guidelines (Pro) (Customer) (Rep) KA to learn more. 
Key points
Here are key points for Frontline Reps to remember when helping pros with referrals. Understanding these points will help pros by clarifying how the referral program works:
 Overall Referral Program
Incentive Amounts and Markets: The referral bonus is dynamic, offering $100 for referring a pro in a low supply/high demand market, or $50 in a normal supply market.
Annual Cap: Pros can earn a bonus for a maximum of 10 successful referrals per account per year.
Unique Link Requirement: New pros must use the existing pro's unique referral link to sign up. Thumbtack is unable to manually link accounts or apply credits retroactively if the link was not used.
Referral Eligibility: The referred pro cannot be a current or former Thumbtack pro, even if signing up under another name.
Sharing Restrictions: Referral links should only be shared with personal connections and must not be published or distributed on public platforms such as coupon websites or forums (i.e., spamming).
Credit Timing (Referral): The new pro receives their promotional credit immediately after completing the sign-up flow and activation requirements.
Activation requirements include setting up targeting, profile basics, and a background check. The requirement to get a review is waived for pros in low supply/high demand markets.
New pros must have a card on file to use their referral credit.
Credit Timing (Referrer): The existing pro receives their credit only after the referred pro signs up using the unique link and gets their first lead. The credit may take up to two weeks for processing after the referred pro gets their first lead.
Automatic credit: Pro referrals are handled by an automated system and cannot be manually applied. 
Credit Value and Program Changes: The credit is promotional and has no cash value. Thumbtack reserves the right to suspend, modify, or terminate the program at its sole discretion at any time without notice. Thumbtack can retract any awarded credit if fraud, abuse, or misconduct is suspected.
Program Termination and Modification: Thumbtack reserves the sole discretion to suspend, modify, or terminate the referral program or any pro's eligibility at any time, for any reason, and without notice to the pro.
Credit Retraction: Thumbtack reserves the right to retract any awarded credit if a referring pro is suspected of fraud, abuse, misconduct, or other violations of the Referral Terms of Service, the main Thumbtack Terms of Use, or the Privacy Policy
Pro is missing their referral credit
Unique Link is Mandatory: The most common reason for a missing credit is that the new pro did not use the existing pro's unique referral link to sign up. Thumbtack is unable to manually link accounts or apply credits retroactively if the link was not used.
Referrer Credit Timing: The existing pro (referrer) receives their credit only after the referred pro signs up using the unique link and gets their first lead on Thumbtack.
Processing Delay: After the referred pro gets their first lead, the existing pro's referral credit may take up to two weeks for processing.
Admin Check (Verification): To troubleshoot, reps should check the "Pro Referrals" section in Admin.
If this field is blank ("Pro Referrals (no data)"), it confirms that the new pro did not use the unique referral link.
If the referral shows in Admin, but the existing pro has not received the bonus, the credit is likely pending because the referred pro has not yet received their first lead.
Missing in Admin is Not a Bug: If a pro insists the link was used but the referral does not show in Admin, it is not a bug. It confirms the referral was not completed using the correct link. Always verify the referred pro's Admin to see if they received their bonus, as a missing new pro bonus also confirms the link was not used.
Rep Communication: If the referral is correctly associated, reps may tell the existing pro, "It looks like you’re close to receiving a bonus.". Reps must not disclose specific private information, such as the spending amounts of the referred pro.

How to find and share their referral link to refer a new pro (Pro)
Pros can access and copy their unique referral link by logging into their account on a desktop or the app. They will see “Refer pros. Get up to $100” or “Get up to $100. Get $100 for referring a high demand pro” 
For full steps, pros can follow the steps in the How to refer a pro – Thumbtack Help article.  
For frontline reps helping pros in finding their referral link, here are some things to keep in mind:
Pros can locate their unique referral link by logging into their account via a mobile or desktop browser.
Instruct them to click "Invite Pros" in the main drop-down menu or direct them to www.thumbtack.com/profile/pro_referrals.

Steps: How to troubleshoot missing referral credit for existing pros (Rep) 
The most common reason for a missing credit is that the new pro (referral) did not use the existing pro's (referrer) unique referral link to sign up. 
IMPORTANT: 
No unique link used = No credit
Credits cannot be manually added
Referrals cannot be manually linked to accounts
To determine why a referral credit is missing, frontline reps will follow these steps: 
Step 1: Check the Pro Referrals section in Admin
Ask the pro for the name or email address of the person they referred. 
In Admin, pull up the existing pro’s (referrer) account.
Scroll down to the Pro Referrals section (located above the “Projects” field).
If the section shows “Pro Referrals (no data)”: No one has successfully used this pro’s unique link to sign up. Move to step 2 below. 
▶ If the section shows a table of data: Their link has been used. Move to the next step.[Image: rtaImage]
If the referral is showing in the "Pro Referral" section in Admin but the pro still hasn't received the bonus:
 Check the Last time updated column (the count will start once the new pro receives the 1st lead).
Tell the pro that it can take up to 2 weeks for processing. 
 NOTE: 
Actions column: Do not use the "Associate referral" or "Change status" buttons. These are not to be used by frontline reps.
Program name column: If it says Non_low_supply_market, the referral credit will be the standard $50, even if the pro believes they are in a high-demand area.
Step 2: If the referral is missing from the Pro Referrals table
If the existing pro insists on a referral signed up but you see no data in the Pro Referrals table, the link was not captured by the system. 
This is not a bug. It is a definitive indicator that the unique link was not tracked during the sign-up session. 
DO NOT offer to manually link accounts or "force" a credit. The system does not support retroactive manual associations.
Reps can help the pro by following these steps: 
Search for the referral’s (new pro) account in Admin using the email address the pro provided. 
Check the Credit Log to see if they received a referral credit. If a credit was issued, you will see: 
Transaction type: Promotional Credit (Admin grant)
Admin reason: Referral bonus
Amount: $50.00 or $100 
If the referral credit was received, the referral used another link to sign up. Move to Step 3: Referral already signed up but didn't use pro link below.
If the referral credit was not received, the correct link was not used.
▶ Use the following talking point to guide them toward a more reliable method.Rep talking point:  “I’ve checked your referral dashboard, and I don't see that specific sign-up recorded. If they haven't signed up yet, you can share your unique link with them again. To ensure you get credit moving forward, I highly recommend using the 'Email' invite option on your referral page—this creates a direct record in our system that's much more reliable.”
▶ If the pro pushes for more information, you may offer some of the common reasons a link might not have been captured:Common potential reasons a link is not captured:
The referral opened the link but later signed up directly to Thumbtack.com.
The referral opened the link on a phone but completed the sign-up on a desktop (without clicking the link again on the second device).
Browser extensions (like ad-blockers) or strict "Incognito/Private" settings prevented Thumbtack from tracking the referral.
The referral clicked multiple referral links and another was last (only the last link clicked before sign-up receives the credit).
Step 3: If the referral already signed up but didn’t use pro link
If the referred pro has already signed-up, Thumbtack cannot manually link accounts or apply credits retroactively if the link was not used. To address this, reps can:
Submit a feedback report detailing the situation. For steps, see the internal Product Feedback (Rep) KA.
Suggest that the new pro signs up again using a different email address, ensuring they use the original pro's referral link this time.

4. Internal only FAQs
This section is for frontline reps only and provides answers to frequently asked internal questions regarding the Pro Referral Program, offering clear guidelines and troubleshooting steps for frontline reps. 
I see the pros referral in admin but the pro reports they didn’t receive the bonus. What are the next steps?
Please check the sign-up date and have the pro wait for 2 weeks.
I don’t see the pros referral in admin but the pro is adamant that their referral used the referral link when signing. Is this a bug?
No, this is not a bug. If the new pro used the original pros referral link, the Referrals section would show in the user admin.
Please always check the referral’s admin to see if they received the referral bonus. If the referral did not receive the referral bonus, they did not sign up using the referral link.
How will the pro know what incentive they qualify for? 
They can get info about in-demand categories in the product and will be shown their incentive amount once it is granted from the referral confirmation email.
If the referred new pro gets an incentive when they sign up, but the referrer doesn’t get the incentive until the pro they referred gets their first lead. Should the referring pro know?
This likely won’t come up, but shouldn’t be a secret, so if the referring pro asks about when the pro they referred gets their credit, you can tell them. 
NOTE: If they push back on this for any reason, let them know we give the credit to the new pro right when they sign up so they can have credit to spend towards leads right away, helping them get set up quicker. The referring pro will get their credit as soon as the referred pro gets their first lead.
What is the max amount of referrals for each pro?
A pro can get credit for up to 10 referrals each year but can submit as many referrals as they would like to.

Thumbtack Plus Membership (Customer) (Discontinued)

Contents
Overview
Process
Steps: How to view a customers membership status in Admin (Rep)
1. OVERVIEW
General Inquiry & Program Status

Thumbtack has officially discontinued the Thumbtack Plus Membership program and is no longer accepting new or existing members. The membership sign-up option was been removed, and the program is no longer running. Consequently, all customer memberships and their associated benefits have ended.

About the Discontinued Offering

The Thumbtack Plus Membership was a homeowner subscription designed to provide modern solutions for various home care needs for an annual fee of $49. The program's goal was to simplify homeownership and foster long-term customer relationships.

While now discontinued, the Thumbtack Plus Membership delivered value through a combination of exclusive discounts, strengthened guarantees, and access to expert guidance.

Summary of Key Membership Benefits (No Longer Available):
20% Discount on Select On-Demand Bookings
Applicable Services Included: Carpet Cleaning, Gutter Cleaning & Maintenance, Handyman (up to 2 hours), Home Inspection, House Cleaning, Junk Removal, Lawn Mowing and Trimming, Pressure Washing, Swimming Pool Cleaning, Maintenance and Inspection, TV Mounting, and Window Cleaning.
Note: This discount was not valid for recurring jobs or projects where payment occurred outside of the Thumbtack platform.
Enhanced Guarantee (The Thumbtack Plus Guarantee)
Money-Back Guarantee: $10,000 (significantly higher than the $2,500 offered to non-members).
Property Damage Guarantee: $100,000 (same coverage as for non-members).
Large Project Planning Support
Members could schedule a consultation with a home specialist for assistance with planning, budgeting, and finding the appropriate professionals (similar to a premium virtual home consultation).
Inquiry about Former Benefits and Current Options

Since the program is fully discontinued, the exclusive benefits, such as the 20% discounts and the $10,000 money-back guarantee, are no longer available.
Standard Guarantee: Customers can still use the standard Thumbtack platform and benefit from the $2,500 Thumbtack Guarantee.
On-Demand Bookings: The exclusive benefits and discounts associated with the Thumbtack Plus Membership for fixed-price On-Demand bookings have been discontinued. Customers can still book services with On-Demand projects in eligible categories (like House Cleaning and TV Mounting) at a set price and scheduled date. However, customers must start this booking from the Fixed Price Projects landing page. The 20% membership discount is no longer applied.
2. PROCESS
Steps: How to view a customers membership status in Admin (Rep) 
As the Thumbtack Plus membership has been discontinued and all associated benefits have ended, the expected status for former members in Admin is Terminated. Frontline Reps can view a customer's membership status on the main page in Admin by following these steps:
Access the customer's account in Admin.
Locate the "Membership Status" field on the main page.
Refer to the table below to understand the statuses. For all former members, the status should now reflect "Terminated."
This table outlines the possible membership statuses in Admin for Thumbtack Plus, with the final expected status being Terminated following the program's discontinuation.


Admin Status
What it means
Terminated
The customer has had their membership manually terminated by Thumbtack, with no access to benefits.
Subscribed
The customer still has an active TT+ membership and has auto-renewal turned on. 
Cancelled_unexpired
The customer's membership has been canceled, but the subscription did not expire, so they still have access to the benefits until the renewal date.
Cancel_expired
The customer's membership is canceled and expired, no access to benefits anymore. 
Never subscribed
The customer has never signed up for the membership.

articles.fullText:
Thumbtack Pay (Pro) (Customer) (Sunset Jun 30, 2026)

Contents
Overview
What Thumbtack Pay was (historical reference)
Transition guidance (handling cases after sunset)
▶ Navigating payment logs in Admin
Marketplace Payments
Customer to Thumbtack payments
Thumbtack to pro payments
Resources
1. Overview
▶ KA Summary
This internal knowledge article for Frontline Reps provides a historical overview and sunset details for standalone "Thumbtack Pay" marketplace payments (customer-to-pro payments).
As of June 30, 2026, Thumbtack has sunset the standalone "Request a Payment" feature (customer-to-pro payments). Pros can no longer request or accept payments from customers through Thumbtack, and the related entry points have been removed from the messenger.
Going forward, pros arrange and collect payment from customers outside of Thumbtack (for example, cash, check, or a third-party payment app such as Venmo or Zelle).
[Internal context (do NOT share cost or usage figures with pros or customers): the standalone feature was retired to simplify the platform experience. Usage had declined significantly since 2023, and the feature no longer aligned with platform strategy. Only ~0.5% of active pros were using standalone marketplace payments at sunset, so expected case volume from this change is low.]
What changed
The "Request a Payment" and "Make a payment" entry points are removed from the messenger.
Pros can't request or accept new customer payments through Thumbtack.
Customers no longer see "Pay this Pro" or payment-request prompts..
What is NOT affected
Claimable jobs / On-Demand bookings (TToD): Customers still pay through Thumbtack for these. The underlying payments infrastructure that powers them remains fully active.
Direct deposit: Still available from the Earnings page for claimable-job earnings (https://thumbtack.com/profile/earnings).
Instant deposits: Still available for eligible earnings (1% fee per transfer).
Earnings tab & 1099-K: Pros keep their payment history, and Thumbtack still issues a 1099-K to pros who meet the income threshold.
Notification sent to affected pros (June 25, 2026)
For reps' reference, pros using the feature received this email ahead of the sunset:
Subject: Customer payments on Thumbtack are going away
Preheader: Collect outstanding payments before June 30th
Starting on June 30, 2026, you will no longer be able to request or accept payments from customers through Thumbtack. You'll need to collect payment from customers outside of Thumbtack going forward.
Here's what this means for you:
Request any outstanding payments from customers before June 30th.
Payments for claimable jobs aren't affected.
Direct deposits from your earnings page will still be available after June 30th.
 — The Thumbtack team
2. What Thumbtack Pay was (historical reference)
Thumbtack Pay let customers pay pros in-product instead of paying by cash, check, or apps like Venmo or Square. Only pros could initiate a request; customers completed payment requests with a credit card, Apple Pay, or Google Pay. 
Key facts reps may need for context on past transactions:
$3,000 monthly cap per project, with up to 2 transactions per day per customer's project; multiple payments per project were allowed.
Direct deposit was required to request or receive any payment.
Chargeback protection covered pros against unsupported credit card chargebacks on completed jobs paid through Thumbtack Pay.
Pros could opt out / opt back in to receiving customer payments from the Earnings tab.
Earlier change: customer-initiated payments removed (January 30, 2024)
Before the full sunset, customer-initiated payments were rolled back. Effective January 30, 2024, customers could no longer initiate payments — only pros could send payment requests, "until further notice." From that point, customers no longer saw the "Pay this Pro" option in the messenger and could not start a payment on their own, though they could still complete payment requests sent to them by a pro. This is why, in the final period before sunset, the flow was pro-initiated only.
3. Transition guidance (handling cases after sunset)
These are the scenarios most likely to come up after June 30, 2026. Anything involving job quality, disputes, or safety still goes to Trust & Safety as usual.
Why did the Request a Payment button disappear?
Explain that Thumbtack has retired in-product customer payments. 
The pro and customer should now arrange payment directly. 
Reassure them that claimable-job payments and direct deposit are unchanged.
Talking point: Thumbtack has removed the option to request and accept customer payments through the app as of June 30. You'll arrange payment with your customers directly going forward. Your direct deposit and any payments for claimable jobs aren't affected.
Pro has unclaimed earnings from before June 30 (no direct deposit set up). 
Funds already in the system can still be released. Direct the pro to set up direct deposit at https://thumbtack.com/profile/earnings to receive the payout. If the pro can't or won't set up direct deposit, the balance can be converted to Thumbtack credit by Advanced Service.For steps, see internal Requesting Help from the Advanced Service Team (Rep) KA.  
Talking point: Any payments you received before the change can still be claimed Set up direct deposit on your Earnings page and they’ll be deposited into your bank account. If you'd rather not set up direct deposit, we can apply the funds as credits to your Thumbtack balance. 
A refund is requested (by the customer or the pro). 
A refund returns the payment to the customer, and only Advanced Service or T&S can process it. Two non-T&S reasons qualify:
The job didn’t happen (i.e. no work has been done) and the pro has confirmed this and warranted the refund to the customer. (Includes confirmed cancellations, rescheduling or no shows initiated by either party)
The job started (and or finished) without any issues but the pro does not want to get paid through Thumbtack. The customer also clearly communicated that they are okay with getting refunded and paying the pros outside of Thumbtack. This can include refusing to set up direct deposit, opting out from in-product payment, or the pro preferring other payment methods (such as Venmo or Zelle) for quicker transaction time.
Either way, confirm a documented mutual agreement, then submit the request to Advanced Service. For steps, see internal Requesting Help from the Advanced Service Team (Rep)  KA. If the pro already received the payout, the funds are clawed back from the pro as part of the refund. Anything involving job quality or safety → escalate to T&S. For escalation steps, see internal Trust and Safety Incidents (Pro) (Customer) KA. 
"How do I get paid now?" (pro) 
Payment is arranged directly between the pro and customer, outside Thumbtack. Thumbtack no longer facilitates these payments.
Note to rep: For pros who want guidance on collecting payment, you can share the Help Center article Tips for taking payments (https://help.thumbtack.com/article/tips-for-taking-payments).

4. Navigating payment logs in Admin
The Transaction Log is created when a pro sends a payment request to a customer or a customer sends a payment to a pro. This log and other information can be found on the Quotes page between a pro and customer.
The Marketplace Payments section log shows payments linked to quoted prices for a bid and is connected to Stripe to process payments.
The Customer to Thumbtack payments section populates when the customer initiates Thumbtack pay by replying to a payment request from a pro.
The Thumbtack to pro payments section populates when Thumbtack transfers funds from the Thumbtack platform account on Stripe to the pro's connected account on Stripe.
▶ Marketplace payments log
The Marketplace Payments section displays all payments linked to any quoted prices for a bid. These records are linked to Stripe, the payment processing service Thumbtack uses, to move money between bank accounts. Quoted prices are created in these scenarios:
A pro requests payment from a customer
A customer makes a payment to a pro without a request.
NOTE:  TToD payments* will not show up here. See the internal Claimable Jobs (Pro) KA  > Check payment status in Admin.  *Where Thumbtack accepts payment from the customer up front, then transfers payment to the pro later
The Marketplace payments sections provides the following:
Customer To Pro Payment Transaction Logs
Item type – This is Thumbtack’s internal reference for the type of payment event stored in this record. Here are the item types that can be seen here:
JOB
TAX  
TAX_REFUND 
TRANSFER 
JOB_REFUND 
TRANSFER_REVERSAL 
DISCOUNT
Item Amount - The amount associated with the event (e.g., $ paid or refunded for a job, tax, discount, etc)
Item metadata - Internal details associated with the event, mainly helpful for engineers who are debugging issues
Delete time - Only set if the item has been deleted. Currently this only happens when a payment is edited (the previous payment records are voided and deleted) or when an unfinished transfer is voided due to cancellation or other exceptional circumstances.
Payer PK – PK of the user making the payment. Could be the customer, Thumbtack (PK 1), or the Pro depending on the type of event.
Payee PK – PK of the user receiving the payment. Could be the customer, Thumbtack (PK 1), or the Pro depending on the type of event.
Transaction PK -  The PK of the record in the database representing an external (Stripe) transaction for this event
Transaction type – The type of the external (Stripe) transaction for this event. Here are the possible transaction types:
PAYMENT_INTENT
TRANSFER
REFUND
DISPUTE
SETUP_INTENT
TRANSFER_REVERSAL
Transaction amount - The amount associated with the external transaction. May differ from the item amount if fees were deducted before sending it to Stripe (e.g. the 1% Instant Deposit fee, see ID KA)
Transaction update time - Timestamp when this transaction was most recently updated in the database.
Transaction status – The status of the transaction as reported by external gateway (Stripe) at the time of the most recent update.
▶ Customer to Thumbtack payments
The Customer to Thumbtack Payments Section populates when the customer initiates Thumbtack pay by replying to a payment request from a pro
The Customer to Thumbtack Payments Section provides the following: 
Quoted Price Data 
Draft state - Quoted price's internal status for the draft payment. Potential values are: 
NEW
IN_PROGRESS
FINAL
Status - Quoted price's internal status for the bid. Potential values are: 
PRIVATE
QUOTE
INVOICE
PAYMENT_PENDING
CANCELED_BY_PRO
PAID
TRANSFER_FAILED
PAYMENT_DRAFTED
PAYOUT_FAILED
PAID_THRU_CREDIT
CUSTOMER_REFUNDED
CHARGEBACK_ACCEPTED
PAID_TO_THUMBTACK
Updates at - Timestamp of the most recent update to the quoted price row in the database
Amount value - Details on the amounts requested / sent in the payment request
Line items - Breakdown of the requested amount into line items (e.g.,. price, tax, discount)
Market Payment Data:
Total amount value - Amount of the payment from the customer to the Thumbtack platform account on Stripe
Payment status - Status of the payment transaction as reported by Stripe. Potential values are: 
SENT_TO_GATEWAY
GATEWAY_NONRECEIPT
GATEWAY_FAILED
TRANSACTION_CREATED
TRANSACTION_SUCCESS
TRANSACTION_FAILED
TRANSACTION_VOID
Payment updates at - Timestamp of the last time this payment record was updated in Thumbtack's database
Refund value  - Value refunded to the customer, if any
Refund link - Link to a page that allows an admin to initiate a refund to the customer (and optionally a reversal of the pro's earnings as well)
▶ Thumbtack to pro payments

The Thumbtack to Pro Payments Section populates when the Thumbtack back-end systems transfer funds from the Thumbtack platform account on Stripe to the pro's connected account on Stripe. From there, the funds will either be (1) paid out automatically to the pro's bank account within 2-3 days or (2) paid out instantly if the pro initiates an Instant Deposit.
The Thumbtack to Pro Payments Section provides the following:
Transfer Payment to Pro:
Transaction type - This will always be TRANSFER since this section provides information about the Stripe transaction that transfers earnings from the Thumbtack platform account to the pro's connected account
Transaction amount - Amount transferred to the pro's connected account
Transaction update time - Timestamp of the most recent update to the transfer record in our database
Transaction status - Status of the transfer transaction as reported by Stripe. Potential values are: 
SENT_TO_GATEWAY
GATEWAY_NONRECEIPT
GATEWAY_FAILED
TRANSACTION_CREATED
TRANSACTION_SUCCESS
TRANSACTION_FAILED
TRANSACTION_VOID
Transfer amount to transfer - A button that can be used to initiate a manual transfer of funds to the pro's connected account by an admin
Convert Customer Payment to Credit - this section can be used for pros who have received one or more customer-to-pro payments but, for some reason, can't set up Direct Deposit (and therefore have funds stuck in Stripe that the pro can't use). The balance can be converted into Thumbtack credit.
Amount to be credited - Balance available to be converted to credit
Existing credit amount - Amount of any existing credits on the pro's account
Admin note - Note from admin about the conversion
Credit update time - Timestamp of the conversion
Reason for convert - Category for why the pro couldn't set up Direct Deposit.
NO_TAXPAYER_ID 
BLOCKLIST
Convert payment to credit -  A button that grants the pro an admin granted credit in place of a customer payment that a pro cannot accept through direct deposit.
6. Resources
Resources for PROS 
Thumbtack Help articles 
How to set up direct deposit 
Direct links
Earnings tab
Resources for FRONTLINE REPS
Related internal knowledge articles

articles.fullText:
Thumbtack Partner Integrations: Activation and Troubleshooting (Pro)

Contents
Overview
How integrations connect to Thumbtack
Self-Serve Partner Integrations (OAuth / SSO)
Admin partner integrations
Webhooks
When Frontline Reps use this article
Key points
Process
Steps: How to identify the integration type and guide pro through activation (Rep)
How to setup and manage a Single sign-on (OAuth/SSO) integration (Pro)
How to setup Admin integration (Pro)
Steps: How to transfer to the Partnership Support team (Rep)
Steps: How to help a pro requesting $100 promotional credit from a partner tool (Rep)
Internal FAQ
Resources
1. Overview
▶ KA Summary
This internal knowledge article (KA) provides guidance for Support reps on Thumbtack's partner integrations. It explains what Thumbtack’s API does, how different integration types work, and provides step-by-step instructions for reps on how to assist pros with common integration tasks and issues.
It's common for pros to use more than one platform to find business. However, managing multiple platforms can create a poor user experience for pros and their customers. Thumbtack solves this by offering a connection tool that lets these different platforms work together.
This connection allows a pro to link their Thumbtack account with many partner tools at the same time, giving pros more freedom, letting them manage their work using the tools they like best. For example, a pro could use a tool like Front Desk along with other tools for managing customer data (CRM), tracking new leads, and sending messages. Pros can use several of these connected tools at once to handle leads, communicate with customers, and manage reviews.
Important Note: This KA is focused exclusively on official Thumbtack partner integrations. Note that these integrations work differently from webhooks, which are covered in the internal Webhooks (Pro) KA. 
How Integrations Connect to Thumbtack

Understanding the different connection types will help reps know what pros can manage themselves and when reps need to get involved.
There are three main ways integrations connect:
▶ Self-Serve Partner Integrations (OAuth / SSO)
How it works: The pro signs into a partner platform with their Thumbtack account.
What’s happening behind the scenes: OAuth securely gives the partner access to Thumbtack leads or, messages— without sharing the pro’s password.
Who manages it: The pro turns this integration on or off themselves directly in the partner platform.
NOTE: These integrations cannot be manually turned on or off for a pro in Admin. 
▶ These partners include:
ContractorPlus
GoSite
Hatch
Housecall Pro
Jobber
Podium.
Scorpion
Serviceminder
ServiceTitan
Signpost
Workiz
Jobber
ServiceTitan
ContractorPlus
Toolsey
Rep’s role: Direct pros to the setup guide in the How to link your Thumbtack account with partner platforms Thumbtack Help article.. Troubleshoot if data isn’t flowing after connection.
▶ Admin Integrations
How it works: Some partner software connects to Thumbtack as a partner webhook that is the same for each business and needs to be enabled  in Admin. 
What’s happening behind the scenes:
Setup: For these tools, pros contact their support team (or account manager) and then email Thumbtack to complete the integration. Steps in: How to link your Thumbtack account with partner platforms
Turn on and off: a switch in Admin to allow data to flow between Thumbtack and the partner software.
Who manages it: For setup or managing these, reps will transfer to the partnerships team.
▶ These integrations include:
Alivo
Network Leads
Contractor Foreman
Joinowners
LeadPerfection
ClientTether
MovingCRM
Pronexis
Smith.ai
Rep’s role: For setup or managing these, reps will transfer to the partnerships team.
▶ Webhooks
How it works: If a tool is not an official Thumbtack partner, leads can still flow into it using a custom webhook or through an automation tool such as Zapier.
What’s happening behind the scenes: Thumbtack sends lead data (via an API call) to a custom URL the pro or their vendor provides, or Zapier listens for that lead data and sends it into another app.
Who manages it: Webhooks are 100% self-serve. Pros manage endpoints, authorization, and troubleshooting (recent deliveries) directly in their Thumbtack account.
Examples: Google Sheets (via Zapier), a non-partner CRM (via webhook).
Rep’s role:
Always explain webhooks as best for tech-savvy pros and may take time to set up. 
Refer to the internal Webhooks (Pro) KA for details like setup and troubleshooting.

▶ When to use this article
This article provides Sales, Partnership, and Support teams with steps to help pros manage their Thumbtack partner integrations.
Recommend partners: Recommend official Thumbtack integration partners based on a pro's business needs.
Refer pros to the Thumbtack Partner Marketplace and the How to link your Thumbtack account with partner platforms article.
NOTE: Do not push partnerships on pros.
Activate/Manage Integrations: Use the process steps below to help pros enable, disable, or switch integrations.
Webhooks: For all information on self-serve webhooks, refer to the internal Webhooks (Pro) KA.
Key points
Frontline Reps should remember these key points when helping pros with integrations:
Integrations are managed at the business profile level.
Pros can self-serve on most integrations.
Partner tool sign up: How to sign up for our partner tools and services – Thumbtack Help article
Partner tool setup and management: How to link your Thumbtack account with partner platforms – Thumbtack Help article
Webhooks: How to create a custom lead integration – Thumbtack Help article
Troubleshooting: 
For Self-Serve Partner Integrations (OAuth / SSO): If a pro encounters issues connecting the integration after following the SSO instructions, res should have them to first contact the integration partner's support team. Support resources for specific partners can be found on the internal Thumbtack Partner Integrations KA.
For Admin integrations: Reps will transfer to the partnerships team.
For webhooks: Reps should refer to the internal Webhooks (Pro) KA. 
2. Process
Steps: How to identify the Integration Type and Guide the Pro Through Activation (Rep)
This section outlines steps for helping pros enable these integrations, whether they are self-serve (OAuth/SSO) or require Thumbtack support (Admin Integrations). 
To help a pro integrate with the Thumbtack API, determine which type of integration best suits their needs:
Ask the pro what software they want to integrate with. This will help determine the correct integration steps.
Identify the integration type: Check the How to link your Thumbtack account with partner platforms – Thumbtack Help article to see if the integration is listed and what kind of integration setup it has. 
Is it a partner integration using Self-Serve Single Sign-On (OAuth/SSO)? (Listed on the above article)
If yes, follow the How to setup and manage a Single sign-on (OAuth/SSO) integration (Pro) below. 
Is it an Admin Integration?  
If yes, follow the How to setup Admin integration (Pro) below. 
Is it a webhook?
If yes, reps will refer to the internal Webhooks (Pro) KA.
Internal Only: If you are unsure about an integration based on its name, reach out to the #partnerships-global Slack channel for help.
How to setup and manage a single sign-on (OAUTH/SSO) integration (Pro)
This section explains how pros can enable self-serve (OAuth/SSO) integrations. 
SSO integrations are a self-service process for pros. They can connect or disconnect these integrations themselves directly within the partner platform.
Support rep will follow these steps when helping a pro setup or manage their single sign on integration: 
Setup: Direct the pro to the Help Center article. Provide the pro with the direct link to the SSO integration steps in the How to link your Thumbtack account with partner platforms Help Center article.
Troubleshooting: If a pro encounters issues connecting the integration after following the SSO instructions, res should have them to first contact the integration partner's support team. Support resources for specific partners can be found on the internal Thumbtack Partner Integrations KA.

How to setup and manage an Admin integration (Pro)
Some partner software connects to Thumbtack as a partner webhook. These webhooks are the same for each business and needs to be enabled in Admin. 
For these tools, pros will: 
Contact their support team or their account manager.  
Email Thumbtack at teampartnerships@thumbtack.com to complete the integration. 

For troubleshooting help, reps will follow Steps: How to transfer to the Partnership Support team (Rep) below. 
Steps: How to transfer to the Partnership Support Team (Rep)

If a pro is having issues with a Thumbtack partner integration OR if they have a question not covered in this KA, support reps will transfer the case to the Partnership Support queue.
To transfer a case to the Partnership Support team, reps will follow these steps: 
BEFORE transferring to the Support team: 
Add notes to the outcome box that includes the following:
Business/service_pk impacted 
What the core issue is
Error code(s) if provided 
What software tool the pro is using
IMPORTANT: If the following items are not included in case notes, the case will be transferred back to the rep to gather further information from the pro. 
Transfer case to team: 
To transfer the case, click Next in the case flow.
Select A Team (Queue).
Choose Partnership Support from the dropdown.
Click Next.
Let the pro know that Partnership Support will follow up via email within 1-3 business days for the initial response.
Steps: How to help a pro requesting promotional credit from a partner tool (Rep)
This section outlines the process for frontline support reps to help pros who are inquiring about or requesting promotional credit from Thumbtack's partner tools.
Pros from strategic partners are eligible for a $100 promo credit if they activate their account. Once a pro integrates their Thumbtack account with partner services, promo credits are added on Fridays at the end of each week. 
If a pro contacts support to ask about their promotional credit from a partner tool before they've been added (on Fridays), frontline reps will follow these steps.
Fill out the Credit Grant Request Form (Supply Partnership) to request a credit grant for a pro who signed up for a Partnership Promotion.
The form will ask for the following: Partner name, Pro PK ID, Date of Request, and Channel.
Once submitted, let the pro know that they should see the credit in their Thumbtack balance within 24 hours.
Note: The form should be submitted, instead of posting requests in the #partnerships-global Slack channel 
How to Check if a Pro Has Received Credit 
To check if a pro has received the credit, go to their credit log and look for a promotional credit entry.
3. Internal FAQs
This section provides answers to our reps’  frequently asked questions about partner integrations for Frontline Reps. These are meant to answer the reps’ questions, and are not written to be shared with pros.

What integrations do we currently have?
To find the most up-to-date information on our partners, you can check out our Marketplace landing page and the How to link your Thumbtack account with partner platforms – Thumbtack Help article. If you don't see a specific partner listed there, pros may be able to integrate with them through webhooks (see internal Webhooks (Pro) KA).
The internal Thumbtack Partner Integrations  KA also provides a breakdown of our current integrations, discounts tied to them, links you can send pros to, and overall value propositions.

I have a pro that’s trying to connect their Thumbtack account with a large integration, where do they need to go? How do I turn on an integration?
For pros who already have an account with an integration partner, direct them to follow the integration process related to said partner found here: How to link your Thumbtack account with partner platforms – Thumbtack Help article.

How do I help a developer with an integration?

1. Overview
NOTE: The title of this internal KA as been updated from "Supply API Integration Partnerships" to Thumbtack Partner Integrations (Pro).
▶ KA Summary
This internal knowledge article (KA) details Thumbtack's supply API integration partnerships, outlining available integrations (leads and messaging), setup processes, and ideal pro profiles for each partner. It also provides guidance for Thumbtack reps on how to help pros with these integrations, identify pros from partner platforms, and manage promotional credit requests. The KA serves as a resource for understanding and leveraging Thumbtack's partnerships with various business management software.
Many pros use dedicated software to manage their business. Thumbtack is focusing on integrating our platform with other customer management tools to make it easier for them to manage their thumbtack leads and messages in the software they use to run their business.
Currently, we have the following endpoints for partner tools:
Leads: Automatically send their lead to another platform. Pros can get their customers’ contact information and details about the job in your partner platform each time you get a lead.
Messaging: Pros can message back and forth with customers from a partner platform.

NOTE: Pros can integrate with multiple leads and messaging integrations simultaneously. Front Desk can also be used with other CRMs, giving pros the power to manage their workflow more efficiently.
How to use this article
This article outlines information on partner integrations and the additional offers provided by Thumbtack to our pros, which are acquired from specific partners. The article also includes landing pages and referral links for partnerships. 
Some of the information mentioned in this article is intended for Sales and Partnerships teams only. 
Support reps:
Use this article to gather basic information on a partnership to help navigate conversations with pros. 
Support reps should not sell or push a pro on any specific partnership, but they can recommend integration partners based on their business needs.
If a pro wants to know where they credit is, refer to the Thumbtack Partner Integrations: Activation and Troubleshooting (Pro) KA for steps. 
Sales or Partnership rep:
For any questions regarding the eligibility of a pro for an offer, they can ask in the #partnerships-global channel.
If a specific partner is not listed, a webhook may still be possible.
