RESOURCES
1. Overview
▶ KA summary
This internal knowledge article (KA) informs Frontline reps about Thumbtack numbers, rolling out nationwide in two phases: the first 50% of markets starting May 26, 2026, with the remaining markets targeted for early June 2026, with all eligible leads expected to include a Thumbtack number by June 8, 2026. The KA details the Thumbtack numbers system, which replaces direct phone numbers with unique, non-expiring numbers for calling and texting to enhance customer privacy and build trust. Reps will find information on key features like SMS Mirroring, Access Codes for connecting from unregistered numbers, and how pros can register multiple business numbers for team communication. Additionally, the KA provides Do's and Don'ts for support interactions, talking points and process steps for managing phone number requests and explaining call and text recordings to both pros and customers.
What Thumbtack numbers are
Thumbtack numbers gives each pro-customer connection a permanent, dedicated Thumbtack number for calls and texts. Instead of seeing a customer’s personal phone number, a pro receives a dedicated Thumbtack number routed to the customer’s verified phone. The same applies in reverse — customers see a Thumbtack number when a pro calls or texts them. All calls and texts made through Thumbtack numbers are recorded for quality assurance. 
IMPORTANT: Not all leads come with a Thumbtack number. Certain services are excluded — leads in these categories are not assigned a Thumbtack number, are not recorded, and are not eligible for the Thumbtack numbers refund policy. For the full list of excluded services, see the Excluded services section below.
When speaking with pros, frontline reps should refer to these as Thumbtack numbers, not masked or temporary numbers.


How Thumbtack numbers work
When pros and customers connect, their actual phone numbers are replaced with an assigned Thumbtack number from Twilio. Instead of seeing the customer or pro’s personal phone number, they are given a unique Thumbtack number for texting and calling each other. A Thumbtack number is tied to a specific pro–customer connection — it is lead-specific, not account-level. There is no single business-level Thumbtack number assigned to a pro. All calls and texts made through these Thumbtack Numbers are recorded for quality assurance.
For  PROS
When a pro receives a new lead, they'll be able to text or call the customer using an assigned Thumbtack phone number. 
Pros can call or text the customer using the customer's assigned Thumbtack number once they've responded to the lead from any registered number.
Phone numbers: Pros won't be able to see the customer’s actual phone number unless the customer chooses to disclose it to them directly. 
Connecting the call or text: When the pro calls or texts the customer from their assigned Thumbtack number, the text or call is routed to the customer’s verified phone number listed in their Thumbtack account. 
Recorded interactions: All texts and calls are recorded to ensure a safe and trustworthy experience for everyone.
SMS mirroring: Messages sent through the Thumbtack messenger are also delivered to the customer as a text message. Note: Starting August 24, 2026, Thumbtack is turning on SMS Mirroring for a subset of pros using messaging integrations. Until a pro's integration is flipped on, SMS Mirroring stays disabled and they continue using their integration's messaging system.
NOTE: The webinar from earlier this June is available to view on demand for any pros who were unable to attend. Pros can access the session by visiting the Pro Community here: Questions about Thumbtack phone numbers? We’re here to help.
For CUSTOMERS
Submitting a project: When a customer submits a project, they agree to let the pros they choose contact them. Thumbtack informs customers upfront that: 
by submitting their project, they agree to be contacted by pros they select, AND
that calls and texts may be recorded for quality assurance and training purposes. 
Start talking: After a pro responds to their project, customers can initiate a text or call with the pro using the Thumbtack Number, or receive a text or call from the pro. 
Share personal contact info: The customer decides when they’d like to disclose their personal contact information.
For a closer look at each experience, refer to the pro experience and customer experience sections below.
Value props for pros
When speaking with pros who have questions about the value of Thumbtack numbers or the associated lead price changes, frontline reps can use the following approved value propositions to navigate the conversation.
Only pay when you have a fair shot. If a customer doesn’t reply to any pro they contacted for their project within 72 hours, we’ll automatically refund the lead — pros only pay when a customer is serious about hiring a pro on our platform.
Deeper insights on every lead. Pros can see how many pros a customer reached out to and whether the customer responded. Pros can use that insight to help them decide where to focus and how to follow up.
Hear back from more customers. Every message a pro sends through the app is delivered to customers as a text message, so they can respond directly from their phone — increasing a pros chances of hearing back.
Keep the connection. Each customer comes with a dedicated number that doesn’t expire, so pros can stay connected with their customers over time.
For info about refund protection and competition insights, see the Completely unresponsive customer refunds (Pro) KA
How numbers stay consistent (or don't)
A Thumbtack number is tied to each pro–customer connection and never expires. The same pro (or customer) will have a different number for every connection — so there's no single, account-level Thumbtack number a pro can hand out. A pro finds the number for a given connection in that project's details; it's the number they use to call or text that customer.


Stays the same
Can differ
The number a pro uses to reach a given customer
Consistent forever for that pro–customer connection. This means, if a customer contacts the same pro on a new project, the numbers stay the same.
A different pro contacting the same customer may see a different number
The number a customer uses to reach a given pro
Consistent for that customer–pro connection (reaches that specific pro or team member)
A different customer may reach the same pro on a different number
Teams: Each team member who contacts a customer does so from a different Thumbtack number, so the customer sees a separate number for each one. A customer working with a multi-person team will have separate call and text logs per team member's number, and reaching back on a given number (calling it or replying to its text) connects to that specific team member. Note: only texts on the pro's primary business number appear in the Thumbtack messenger — texts on a team member's number stay as regular texts on that team member's phone and don't mirror into the messenger. To see these separate per-member conversations for a specific contact, use Thumbtack Numbers FYI → Listen in - review calls + texts between users.
Rep note (multi-business pros): A pro can register the same number to more than one of their Thumbtack businesses. Doing so tells Thumbtack the businesses are related, so calls from that number route consistently to the same customer.

Certain services are not assigned Thumbtack numbers for legal or regulatory reasons.
Pros in these categories will not have access to:
Thumbtack numbers for calling and texting customers
Enhance competition insights — customer engagement tracking, last activity, and refund eligibility alerts require Thumbtack numbers to function

Note for reps: Calls and texts for these services are not recorded and transcripts will not be available in Admin. This is expected behavior, not a bug.

Updates

▶ Call recordings + SMS mirroring for integrated pros (August–October 2026)
Starting August 24, 2026, Thumbtack will begin turning on call recording and SMS mirroring for pros using a CRM or third-party integration— features that were previously disabled for these pros to avoid duplicate pre-roll recording notices and duplicate SMS messages to customers.
Why this change matters:
Internal-facing why: Without call recordings, reps couldn't reliably tell whether an unanswered call was picked up by a human or went to voicemail, which caused some integrated pros to be inaccurately disqualified from the completely unresponsive customer refund. Turning on call recording for integrated pros fixes that. Some pros also reported, lower response rates because messages they sent to customers weren't being delivered as a text — which is where many customers are most likely to see and reply — putting integrated pros at a disadvantage compared to. non-integrated pros. 
External-facing why: These changes help Thumbtack better support pros if a dispute arises, and help more leads qualify for automatic refund protection when a customer doesn't respond to any pro within 72 hours
Rollout is in two phases:
Phase 1 — August 24, 2026 (forced flip): All integrations not named in Phase 2 below (most are singular businesses that built their own custom webhook/API connection) (e.g., NZ Leads INC, IZY Digital Agency, Cohen Marketing)
▶ Email comms sent to pros (phase 1):[Image: rtaImage]
Phase 2 — by October 15, 2026: The following larger integrations flip on their own schedule, no later than October 15, 2026: Chiirp, ClientTether, Contractor Plus, FieldPulse, Free Agency, Go Site, Hatch, Housecall Pro, Jobber, Leadperfection, Podium, Pronexis, Scorpion, Service Titan, Serviceminder, Signpost, Workiz
How it works for pros
No action is required from pros. Once a pro's flip date passes: 
calls made through that integration are recorded by Thumbtack and transcripts + summaries become available
messages sent from the pro's CRM or the Thumbtack messenger are also delivered to the customer as SMS (and incoming texts mirror into the messenger). 
A pro's first reply from either their CRM or Thumbtack counts toward response rate, response time, and search ranking — they don't need to reply in both places.
Important notes + limitations:
Before a pro's flip date, existing behavior continues: no call recording, transcript or summary, and SMS mirroring stays disabled for that pro.
Exact flip dates per integration are tracked in the Integrated Partners — Thumbtack Numbers sheet. Confirm a specific pro's status there.
A pro who's been manually sending a duplicate text after their CRM autoresponder no longer needs to once SMS Mirroring is active for them — sending both is redundant now, and could overwhelm customers

How this impacts reps: 
Reps may hear from integrated pros confused about why call recordings or SMS Mirroring did or didn't work as expected. Check the pro's specific integration and flip date before troubleshooting. The 3rd party integrations  and Call recordings, transcripts and AI-generated summaries+ ) talking-points sections in this KA have been updated to reflect the phased rollout.
▶ Nationwide Launch

User feedback about Thumbtack numbers

 
Sharing User Feedback about Thumbtack numbers
Reps should use the following feedback theme when submitting all feedback related to Thumbtack numbers
[Communications] Feedback related to Thumbtack Numbers (All Markets)

REMINDER: Do not submit blank or vague feedback (e.g., "Pro hates masked numbers"). Reps must populate the feedback fields with these specific data points to ensure Product Ops can act on it:
Specific tool/friction point (e.g., Housecall Pro SMS block, Access Code entry failure, AT&T Caller ID omission).
The 'Why' behind the sentiment (e.g., Pro has a 5-person dispatch team using landlines, pro feels they lose 'ownership' of the client long-term).
Comprehension level (e.g., Did the pro understand that an automatic refund occurs at 72 hours, or were they completely unaware of the protection?)
For details on how to write impactful feedback and steps on submission, refer to the Product Feedback (Rep) KA. 
Key points 


These are helpful points that Frontline reps can reference when it comes to the Thumbtack numbers:
 
Consistent and permanent: Thumbtack phone numbers do NOT expire. A given pro–customer number never changes (it's the same even on a new project together) and never expires, so they can stay connected over time. Privacy: The customer's real number stays private until they choose to share it.
Recording notification: Calls and texts through Thumbtack numbers are recorded; callers and recipients receive a notification that the conversation may be recorded.
Pro contacting customer: A pro can call or text the customer only after they respond to the lead.
Customer reaching the pro: After the pro responds, the customer can use the call button in the messenger, reply to the pro's text, or return a missed call. The customer decides when to share their personal number.
No account-level number: A Thumbtack number is assigned per pro–customer connection, not per account. There's no single business number a pro can hand out and a customer has a different number with each pro.
Different per pro: The same customer has a different Thumbtack number with each pro they contact.
Separate number per team member: Each team member on a single business who reaches out to a customer has a separate number (and call log or text thread)
Access code: Each business has one 7-digit access code that lets a pro or team member connect from an unregistered number — entered via the IVR for calls, or replied to the automated text for texts. Found on the job's View or share number screen.
Mirroring is primary-only: Only texts on the pro's primary number appear in the Thumbtack messenger. Texts on a team member's registered number stay on that phone and don't mirror in.
Automatic refund: Pros only pay when they have a fair shot — a lead auto-refunds if the pro replies within 4 business hours, keeps the conversation on Thumbtack, and the customer stays completely unresponsive to every pro for 72 hours. Refer to internal Unresponsiveness Customer Refund Pilot KA to learn more. 
Do’s and don’ts

This section provides clear guidelines for support reps regarding Thumbtack numbers, outlining essential actions to take and practices to avoid when helping pros with phone number management and communication. 
Do:
Refer to the numbers as "Thumbtack numbers."
Educate pros that adding all business numbers to their account removes barriers and manual access code prompts. See Pro benefits of registering numbers
Help pros add multiple registered phone numbers to their settings to ensure their entire team can call and text leads seamlessly. See Steps: How to register phone numbers in bulk for pro (Rep)
Ensure that any request to register additional business lines or bulk-upload a team phone list comes directly from the verified account owner. 
Actively gather a pro's detailed feedback if they express a desire to opt out, ensuring it is shared with our team to help continue improving the Thumbtack experience for both pros and customers. See Sharing user feedback about Thumbtack numbers
Don't:
Refer to the numbers as "masked numbers" or "temporary numbers."
Change a pro's primary phone number on their behalf (pros must update this themselves).
2. COMPLETELY UNRESPONSIVE CUSTOMER REFUNDS

How eligibility is determined


Refund eligibility is determined using engagement data collected through Thumbtack numbers. This protection only applies to eligible leads and qualifies for an automatic refund only if:
The pro responded within 4 business hours of the customer’s request
The customer did not reply to any pro on the project within 72 hours of project creation
The pro kept communication on Thumbtack (no personal phone number or email shared)
If all criteria are met, the refund is issued automatically.

To check eligibility in the pros account, refer to the Completely unresponsive customer refunds (Pro) KA. 
How pros track eligibility


The competition insights page includes enhanced engagement tracking and refund alerts for eligible leads. Pros with excluded service categories will see standard competition insights for those services and will not see refund eligibility alerts for those leads.
Competition Insights allows pros to:
See how quickly they responded compared to other pros
Monitor whether the customer has responded
View the last activity on the project
Track refund eligibility status
Alerts:

If the 72-hour window is still active and the customer has not responded, the pro will see a “Refund eligible” alert.
If the pro shares personal contact information, the lead becomes ineligible and a refund ineligibility alert will appear.
If the customer remains completely unresponsive after 72 hours and all eligibility criteria are met, the refund is issued automatically and the pro will see a “We refunded you” notification in the messenger.
For full details on policy details, edge cases, and user interface behavior, reps should refer to the Completely unresponsive customer refunds (Pro) KA.

Phone number types

To help pros and their teams connect with customers securely, Thumbtack uses two types of phone numbers: a primary number and registered numbers. It's important to understand the role of each.
Primary phone number

The primary number is the main phone number listed on a pro's Thumbtack profile. It serves several key functions:
Account Security: It is used for account verification and login.
Thumbtack Communications: It's the number Thumbtack uses to send important account-related text messages and notifications to the pro.
Call/text routing: The primary number is where customer calls and texts are forwarded. When a pro updates their primary number from the Registered Phone Numbers age, they see "Use the primary number you communicate with customers on. All calls and texts from customers will be forwarded to this number."
Pro-Managed: For security reasons, support reps cannot change this number for a pro. The pro must update it themselves directly in their business profile settings or from the registered phone numbers page.
Registered Numbers page: A pro’s primary phone number on the registered phone numbers page will say “Your primary number." 
Registered phone numbers


Registered numbers are additional business phone numbers that a pro can add to their account for their team members.
Purpose: Their sole function is to authorize team members to contact customers through Thumbtack phone numbers. When a team member uses a registered number, their call or text will go through to the customer's Thumbtack Number.
No Account Permissions: These numbers are used for communication only. They cannot be used to log in, verify the account, or make any changes to the pro's account.
Team Member Experience: When a pro adds a team member's number, the team member is not notified. The pro must share the customer's specific Thumbtack Number with them to enable contact.
Support Help: As an exception, if a pro has a large list of numbers to add, a support rep can help. This request must come from the verified account owner. Follow the Steps: How to register phone numbers in bulk for pro (Rep)
Manage number: Pros will manage these numbers from the Registered phone numbers. Pros can add a new number, update or remove an existing number. See Steps: How to manage registered phone numbers from settings (Pro)
Unregistered phone numbers (Access Codes)

Pros must contact customers from their preferred business number, a registered number, or an unregistered number using an access code. A 7-digit access code (PIN) provides an alternative, allowing a pro or team member to contact a customer from an unregistered phone number.
One per business: Each business has a single access code (a pro who manages more than one business has one code per business).
How to find the access code: On a job's details page, tap View or share number (View phone number on web). The access code is shown there, and it's also included automatically in the prewritten message when the pro taps Share or Send text to send a customer's number to a team member.
When to use an access code
Calling): When calling a customer's Thumbtack number from an unregistered phone, an automated IVR system will prompt the caller to enter the 7-digit access code before connecting the call.
(Texting): When texting from an unregistered number, the pro will receive an automated text reply asking for the access code. The pro must reply with the code, and their original message will then be delivered.
Verification: After a new number successfully uses the code, the Thumbtack account owner will receive an email. They can then go to their settings to formally Confirm or Decline that number for future use.
Pro benefits of registering numbers

Use this table to explain the benefits of registering numbers to pros. Registration is the primary solution for reducing daily workflow friction.

If Number is NOT Registered
Standard Phone Calls

Standard Texting
Seamless: SMS is delivered directly to the customer.
Friction: Pro receives an automated text asking for their access code. The original message is only sent after they reply with the code.
Third-party integration automations
Works Perfectly: Automated messages bypass security checks and reach the customer.
FAILS: Automated systems cannot "type in" an access code. Messages will be blocked. Pro should registered their integrations phone number. 
Third-party Integrations: If a pro reports that their integration automated texts aren't reaching customers, the only fix is to register the phone number the CRM uses to send those texts.
Bulk Support: If a pro finds registering multiple team members cumbersome, offer to help. Ask them to email a list of business numbers and follow the Steps: How to register a list of phone numbers for a pro (Rep) below to register them on their behalf.
Access Codes as a "Backup": Remind pros that access codes are intended as a backup for when they are away from their primary business phones, not as a standard daily workflow.
Connecting with customers: Registered vs. Unregistered number


Pros and their teams must contact customers using either a registered phone number or an access code (for unregistered numbers).
If a pro or a member of their team attempts to call or text a customer from a number that is not registered in their Thumbtack account, they’ll be prompted to enter the access code. If the code isn’t entered correctly, the communication won’t go through.
Using a Registered Number: Communication (calls or texts) will go through seamlessly
Using an Unregistered Number: 
To connect a call, an automated system will prompt the pro to enter the 7-digit access code. If the code is not entered correctly, the communication will not go through
For a text message, the pro must reply with the access code to an automated text before their original message is delivered.

NOTE: If a returning customer calls a pro's direct business number, the call will go through as usual. However, to qualify for the 72-hour refund protection on new leads, all initial communication must happen through the dedicated Thumbtack number or the Thumbtack Messenger.

When to bulk register phone numbers for a pro (Rep)

Support reps have many reasons to help a pro upload phone numbers in bulk, such as: 
Efficiency for Large Accounts: It is used for pros who have a large number of business lines or team members to register.
Reducing Workflow Friction: Registration allows pros to bypass the 7-digit access code barrier when calling or texting through Thumbtack Numbers.
Active Problem Solving: Rather than just noting pro frustration with manual registration, reps can proactively ask for a list of numbers via email and upload them on the pro's behalf.
CSV formatting guidelines for bulk upload
To bulk register phone numbers, reps must use a CSV file that follows these formatting requirements:
File Type: Must be a .CSV file.
Header Row: Must include two columns named Name and Phone_number.
Phone Number Column: Must be valid US phone numbers (10 or 11 digits). Numbers don't follow a specific format. Standard formats like (801) 234-5678 or +12223334444 are accepted.
Name Column: Required for all entries. Names don't follow a specific format. Use general labels if specific names aren't provided (e.g., Team member A, . Pros can update these later.

Steps: How to register phone numbers for a pro in bulk (Rep)
To help a pro register multiple phone numbers, a Support rep will follow these steps:
First, verify the pro's identity and confirm the request is coming from the account owner before proceeding.
Follow the verification steps in the Verify Account Information (Pro) (Customer) KA.

Pro with multiple businesses:

If uploading for a specific business: Uncheck “ Upload to all businesses owned by this user” and select the business(es) from the dropdown.

▶ To create a CSV:

4. SMS (PRO) (CUSTOMER)

How app and text messaging stay in sync (SMS Mirroring)

To improve responsiveness, messages and media type attachments are "mirrored." This means messages and photos sent from the Thumbtack messenger are delivered as an SMS text, and those sent via SMS appear in the Thumbtack messenger.
The first SMS message a customer or pro receives from one another includes instructions on how to manage SMS preferences, followed by the actual message as a second SMS:
Pro → customer: "[pro business name] replied to you on Thumbtack. View the full conversation here: [link] or use this number to communicate with them directly. Reply STOP to opt out or HELP for help."
Customer → pro: "[customer name] sent you a message on Thumbtack. View the full conversation here: [link] or use this number to communicate with them directly. Reply STOP to opt out or HELP for help."
How it works: 
The entire conversation (via app or text) is maintained in one place within the Thumbtack messenger
App to text: When a pro sends a message (or media) to a customer using the Thumbtack messenger, it’s sent as a text to the customer’s phone.  The messenger will show: “Your reply was also sent as a text message to the customer's phone.”
Text to the app: When a customer texts a pro, the message (or photo) is delivered to the pros default business phone number and also appears in their Thumbtack messenger.
Opt-Out/In: Pros and customers can unsubscribe from SMS messages for a specific thread. Refer to the  SMS Opt-out and Opt-In Experience section below. 
UPDATE: Integration exception (rolling out Aug–Oct 2026): SMS Mirroring has historically been disabled for pros using messaging integrations (e.g., Housecall Pro, Service Titan) to avoid delivering duplicate messages to customers. Thumbtack is now turning this on for integrated pros in two phases — see Call recordings + SMS mirroring for integrated pros in Updates for dates. Until a pro's integration is flipped on, they continue using their integration's messaging system as usual; this applies to webhooks as well.
Benefits of SMS mirroring: 
Text messaging often leads to quicker responses and reduces the chance of missed messages. By sending messages from the Thumbtack messenger as an SMS, both the pro and the customer can use the pros preferred communication method, while keeping a full conversation record in the pros Thumbtack messenger.
SMS Opt-Out and Opt-In Experience (pro and customer)

This section explains the process for pros and customers to manage their text messaging preferences for a specific conversation, and what happens when they opt in or out.
Opt out: 
Action: To opt out of receiving texts for that conversation, the pro or customer will reply with the keyword "STOP."Confirmation: The user will receive a confirmation message: "You've opted out of receiving messages from this pro. Reply START to opt back in".
When a user opts out:
Replying STOP turns off SMS forwarding for that thread. The other party's messages stop arriving as texts, and any text the opted-out user sends on that thread isn't forwarded to the other party. Calls still connect.
It does not block anyone. Messages still appear in the Thumbtack app (messenger) with a push notification — they're just not delivered as texts. Opt-out applies only to the SMS layer of that one conversation.
Opt-In Process
Action: To resume receiving text messages, the pro or customer will reply with the keyword "START."
Getting Help
Action: If a user replies with "HELP," they will receive a message that includes instructions on how to opt out.
5. INTEGRATIONS (PRO)

How app integrations impact Thumbtack numbers experience 

Pros can use 3rd party integrations with Thumbtack numbers, however they may impact how certain features function:
Partner integrations: Many partners (like Housecall Pro or Service Titan) will automatically register the pro's business phone numbers.
Webhooks: Some pros use a custom setup or automation (their own, not one of our partner integrations) to text customers automatically. Unlike partner integrations, these don't register the pro's phone number for them.
Access Code: Pros can still find and use their 7-digit access code for any numbers that are not automatically registered.
SMS Mirroring: Historically disabled for pros with messaging integrations. Thumbtack is turning this on for integrated pros in two phases starting August 19, 2026. Before a pro's flip date, they continue communicating through their integration's messaging system as usual.  
Call recordings: Historically, calls made through an integration weren't recorded by Thumbtack. As of a pro's flip date — August 24, 2026 for most integrations, by October 15, 2026 for the larger named integrations listed in Updates — calls made through that integration are recorded, and transcripts + summaries become available. If a rep looks for a call recording in Admin for an integrated pro and finds nothing, first check whether that pro's integration has been flipped on yet. If not, this is still expected behavior, not a bug.
To learn more about the two phase rollout, see Call recordings + SMS mirroring for integrated pros in Updates.
Issues a pro may encounter
Automated texts not received by customer
If a pro reports that their app or integrations automated texts aren't reaching customers, this is likely due to the tools phone number not being automatically registered.  The only fix is to register the phone number the tool uses to send those texts. 
Automated systems cannot "type in" an access code which results in messages being blocked. This only works if the pro knows the number their system sends from and it stays the same. If they don't know it, or it changes each time, registering won't fix it — escalate instead of telling the pro it'll work.
Disqualified from refund
Pro’s with auto-responder apps may be disqualified from completely unresponsive customer refunds if their message contains their phone number. Pros can update their message to remove contact information. For steps on helping pros, reps can refer to the Completely unresponsive customer refunds (Pro) KA
To see Thumbtack partners that have messaging integrations, Frontline reps can refer to the internal Thumbtack Partner Integrations (Pro) KA.  
6. USER EXPERIENCE

Pro experience: How to enable calls and view the customers Thumbtack number 

The pro's ability to call the customer is enabled only after the pro sends their first message on a lead. The customer's personal phone number is not revealed; instead, a  pro can reach customers directly on a Thumbtack number. On opportunities, the customer's Thumbtack number becomes visible to the pro only after the customer replies.
Initial view (Before Replying): On the job details and in the messenger thread, the pro initially sees, "You can call the customer after you reply."
Sending initial message: When sending their first message on a lead, the pro will see a disclaimer: "By hitting Send, you agree to receive calls and texts from this customer. Calls and texts may be recorded by Thumbtack and its agents for quality assurance and training purposes...".
Call option appears: After sending their first message to the customer, a "Customer phone" section appears. 
▶ On the Thumbtack App
In the messenger thread and on the job details page, the pro sees the option to "Call" and "View or share number" .
Clicking "Call" will immediately initiate a call to the customer.
Clicking View or share number opens a screen showing the customer's name and Thumbtack number, the pro's 7-digit access code, and Share and Call buttons. Below that is a "Share customer's number" section with an Add new button and a list of registered numbers, each with Send text.
Share opens the device's native share sheet
Send text opens the messaging app with a prewritten message.
▶ On Desktop and Mobile Web
A View phone number button appears in the messenger. Clicking it opens a modal showing the customer's name and Thumbtack number, with the access code displayed below it.
A Copy to clipboard button copies a prewritten message containing the business name, customer name, service category, customer's Thumbtack number, and access code.
The modal includes a QR code to start the call from a mobile device. (Note: the prior "Manage your business phones" link is now the "Allow other team members…by registering their phone numbers" line.)
On mobile web, the modal includes a prominent "Call" button that, when tapped, initiates the call through the device's native phone application.

This section outlines how customers interact with Thumbtack numbers when connecting with pros. Here is the end-to-end customer journey:

"To keep your real number private, we'll use a Thumbtack number to contact this pro. They'll be able to call or text your phone anytime using this Thumbtack number." (see image in "call confirmation" step below)

Caller ID and receiving calls 
This section outlines how incoming calls through Thumbtack numbers appear on Caller ID for both pros and customers, along with carrier-specific behaviors. 
When a customer calls a pro
Caller ID display: When a customer calls a pro using the assigned Thumbtack number, the pro's caller ID will display "Thumbtack customer" or “Thumbtack”.
Carrier specifics: For users on AT&T, the screen will show a local number but will not display the caller ID. All other carriers will show a local number and display the caller ID.
In-call experience: Upon answering, the pro will hear a mandatory pre-roll audio message notifying them that the call is from a Thumbtack customer and

This KA was previously titled “Partnership Marketplace & Business Tools (Pro)” and has since been updated to “Thumbtack Marketplace: Partner Integrations & Business Tools (Pro)."
1. Overview
▶ KA Summary
This internal knowledge article outlines the Thumbtack Partner Marketplace, a resource for pros to access tools and services for customer management and business operations. It details the benefits of integrating Thumbtack with partner tools, such as streamlining leads and messages, and specifies the types of integrations available. For Frontline Reps, the article emphasizes directing pros to self-serve through the Marketplace for offers and general information, advising against quoting specifics due to frequent changes. It also provides talking points for common pro questions and links to relevant resources.
The Thumbtack Partner Marketplace is Thumbtack’s hub for partner tools and services that help pros manage and grow their businesses. Partners provide solutions ranging from customer management to business operations. These partners are known internally as “partner integrations.”
The  Thumbtack Marketplace landing page has the tools and services split into a few sections: 
Customer management: Pros can streamline how they work with customers using these all-in-one solutions making it easier for them to respond and close leads quickly.
Business operations: Pros can optimize their day-to-day operations with services and tools for everything from simplifying taxes to offering financing.
The partners and offers featured on the Marketplace will change as time passes and Thumbtack’s partnerships grow and evolve. To see what offers Thumbtack has for each partner, refer to the Marketplace.  
Partner Categories: At-a-Glance
This section provides an overview of Thumbtack's partner categories, distinguishing between Customer Management integrations and Business Operations affiliates, with examples and relevant resources for each.
▶ Customer Management (Integrations)

Manage Thumbtack leads and customer communications from one platform
Partners include: 
Housecall Pro
Jobber
ServiceTitan,
Workiz
Podium
Signpost
ClientTether
Scorpion
GoSite
Hatch
Oncue
Toolsey
Reps can refer to the internal Thumbtack Partner Integrations KA
▶ Business Operations (Affiliates)
Streamline business admin and finances 
Partners include: 
Simply Business
Wisetack
Everlance
This KA (partner summaries below)
Benefits of linking an integration to Thumbtack account
When a pro links their Thumbtack account to a partner tool, it can help them: 
Increase hires + seamless customer experience: Signing up with partner tools and services can help increase pros chances of getting hired and provide seamless experiences for their customers.
Streamline managing leads + messages: Connecting their Thumbtack account with partner services, pros can streamline and optimize the way they manage customer messages and/or leads.
Key points
Here are key points for Frontline Reps to remember when helping pros interested in using a partner integration for their business: 
Pros can self-serve through the Marketplace.
Discounts and offers change frequently — reps should not quote specifics. Always direct pros to the Marketplace.
Offers are only available to Thumbtack pros who sign up through the Marketplace.
If a pro has issues with a partner software, follow the troubleshooting steps on the internal Thumbtack Partner Integrations: Activation and Troubleshooting (Pro) KA
Do’s and Dont’s
When talking to pros, frontline reps should be consistent in the framing of the Marketplace. To achieve this, reps should adhere to the following guidelines regarding what to do and what not to do:

Do
Explain that Thumbtack has a marketplace because we want to help pros build and scale their business.
Direct pros directly to the marketplace if they want to learn more about specific partners and offers.
Direct pros to information that will help them set up the API integration between partners software and Thumbtack. 
Mention that we have exclusive deals that are only for Thumbtack pros (one of the benefits of being a Thumbtack pro). 
Share the applicable article with pros for them to self-serve:
How to sign up for our partner tools and services 
How to link your Thumbtack account with partner platforms
How to create a custom lead integration
Don’t
Push partnerships to pros. However, do recommend integration partners based on their business needs.
Explain the offers and specific features of the partners in detail - these may change over time.
Business Operations Partners (Marketplace only)
This section provides an overview of business operations partners featured on the Thumbtack Partner Marketplace. Each partner summary includes their primary benefit for pros, available offers, and relevant links for further information and support.
▶ Everlance
Everlance is an app that helps Thumbtack pros track their business mileage and expenses. Thumbtack pros can get discounts on Everlance Premium or a free trial of Everlance Business.
Best for: Pros needing to track mileage for tax and reimbursement purposes.
Affiliate offer: Available on Marketplace.
Links: 
Partner Landing Page: https://www.everlance.com/thumbtack/main 
Everlane website: https://www.everlance.com/ 
Everlance Help Center: https://help.everlance.com/hc/en-us 
Everlance Support: https://www.everlance.com/contact-us 
▶ Simply Business
Simply Business is a tool that helps Thumbtack pros find and compare quotes for business insurance from various insurers, making it easier to get affordable coverage.
Best for: Pros across a wide range of industries (e.g., contracting, house cleaning, handyman, landscaping, photography, etc) who need to compare and buy business insurance. 
Affiliate offer: Available on Marketplace.
Links: 
Partner Landing Page: https://get.simplybusiness.com/thumbtack-sb/ 
SimplyBusiness website: https://www.simplybusiness.com/ 
SimplyBusiness Help Center: https://www.simplybusiness.com/help-center/ 
SimplyBusiness Support: https://www.simplybusiness.com/contact-us/ 
Businesses We Insure: https://www.simplybusiness.com/business-insurance/businesses/  
▶ Wisetack
Wisetack enables Thumbtack pros to offer flexible financing options to their customers, making it easier for customers to afford services. Pros get paid upfront for the work, while customers can pay over time.
Best for: Pros working on higher-value jobs ($500+).
Affiliate offer: Available on Marketplace.
Links: 
Partner Landing Page: https://www.wisetack.com/partner/thumbtack
Wisetack website: https://www.wisetack.com 
Wisetack Help Center: https://www.wisetack.com 
Wisetack Support: https://www.wisetack.com/contact-us 
Customers notified if pro has Wisetack: 
Thumbtack is currently running a test where we automatically email customers who contact a pro that has signed up with Wisetack. The email lets thumbtack customers know the pro offers financing through Wisetack. A pro can stop these email notifications by contacting support. If a Support reps receives a request to stop or start these emails, they will post the request and the pro_user_pk in #partnerships-global channel.
3. Pro Experience
This section details the pro's journey within the Thumbtack Partner Marketplace, from understanding eligibility and finding suitable tools to signing up, integrating, and requesting custom solutions. It also covers how pros can suggest or become partners.
Partners and offers eligibility
The partners and offers featured on the Marketplace will change as time passes and Thumbtack’s partnerships grow and evolve. To see what offers Thumbtack has for each partner, pros can refer to the Marketplace. Offers are only available for Thumbtack pros who sign up through the Marketplace. They are not applied retroactively.
Finding a Thumbtack partner tool
Pros can identify official Thumbtack partners on the Marketplace and in that Help Center article: How to link your Thumbtack account with partner platforms. If the tool a pro wants to connect to their Thumbtack account is a Thumbtack partner, pros can follow the applicable partner’s steps on the How to link your Thumbtack account with partner platforms article. 
Sign up with a partner tool
Pros browse the Marketplace, click “Sign up” on the partner of interest, and complete registration on the partner’s site. Pros can also refer to the How to sign up for our partner tools and services – Thumbtack Help article. 
Integrate partner tool with Thumbtack account
For steps on how to integrate their integration with their Thumbtack account, pros can follow the applicable partner steps in the How to link your Thumbtack account with partner platforms Thumbtack Help article. Pros will need to integrate each business, one at a time.
Webhooks
If the tool a pro wants to connect to their Thumbtack account isn’t listed on How to link your Thumbtack account with partner platforms article, they can set up webhooks for any integration tool that provides an endpoint URL and supports webhooks. Pros can follow the steps in the How to create a custom lead integration – Thumbtack Help article.

Reps can refer to the internal Webhooks (Pro) KA. 
Suggest or become a partner

Pros can send Thumbtack an email and learn more about becoming a Thumbtack partner at teampartnerships@thumbtack.com 

4. Talking points 
This section provides Frontline Reps with talking points as guidance for common questions and scenarios related to the Thumbtack Partner Marketplace. It covers topics such as choosing an integration, eligibility for offers, benefits of linking accounts, and where to direct pros for partner support, including resources in Spanish.
Choosing a partner integration
This section provides Frontline Reps with talking points to answer common pro questions related to selecting a partner integration. It includes responses for inquiries about recommended partners, currently supported integrations, and the possibility of custom integrations for unlisted tools.

Q: Which partner do you recommend I use OR Which partner should I use? 
Q: ¿Cuál socio me recomienda usar?
A: What works for one business may not work for another. I can share the main differences between our partners with you. You can also explore the Marketplace to compare tools and decide which option is best for you. 
A: Lo que funciona para un/a profesional puede no funcionar para otro/a. Para que pueda tomar la mejor decisión para su negocio puedo brindarle las principales diferencias entre nuestros socios. Visite nuestro Marketplace para obtener detalles actualizados sobre las asociaciones que ofrecemos actualmente y los enlaces de registro.
Q: What integrations does Thumbtack currently support?
Q: ¿Qué integraciones tienen actualmente?
A: You can find the most up-to-date list of integrations in our Marketplace and the How to link your Thumbtack account with partner platforms article.
A: Puede consultar nuestras integraciones con socios actuales aquí: Cómo vincular su cuenta de Thumbtack con plataformas de socios
Q: The tool I want isn’t listed as a Thumbtack partner. Can I still integrate it?
Q: Qué sucede si mi integración no es un socio actual de Thumbtack?
A: Possibly. If the tool you want to connect to your Thumbtack account isn’t listed on our How to link your Thumbtack account with partner platforms article,, but provides an endpoint URL and supports webhooks, you can set up a webhook through your Thumbtack account. For more information, please review the How to create a custom lead integration article.


Marketplace Offers: Eligibility and Claiming Offers
This section equips Frontline Reps with talking points to address pro questions concerning the eligibility for and claiming of Marketplace offers. It covers how pros can obtain offers, whether offers are available to non-Thumbtack pros, policies for existing partner users, and the nature of discounts provided by partners.

English talking point
Spanish talking point 
Q: How do I claim a Thumbtack partner offer, and what happens once I choose a partner?
Q: ¿Cómo obtengo la oferta de Thumbtack con un socio?
A: To take advantage of a partner offer for Thumbtack pros, you must sign up through the Marketplace:

Go to the Marketplace and click “Sign up” on the partner you’re interested in.
You’ll be redirected to the partner’s website to complete the signup process.
Once signed up through that page, the offer (if available) will apply automatically.
A: Para aprovechar una oferta para los profesionales de Thumbtack, debe registrarse con un socio a través de nuestro mercado.  Es todo!
Q: Are Marketplace offers available to non-Thumbtack pros? Can I share this with non-thumbtack pros?

A: Currently, these offers are exclusive to Thumbtack pros. 

Q: I already use a partner tool. Can I still get the new offer? 
Q: Ya me he registrado con unos de los socios. Todavía podré obtener la nueva oferta?
A: No, offers are only available to Thumbtack pros who sign up with the partner while the offer is available.
A: No. Está oferta solamente está disponible para profesionales de Thumbtack que se registren cuando la oferta esté disponible.
Q: Why don’t I see an offer for a specific partner?
Q: No veo la oferta para un determinado socio.
A: Not all partners have discounts. We’ve also included partners that offer integrations with Thumbtack software or are features we believe can add value to our Pros.
A: No todos los socios tienen descuentos. También hemos incluido socios que ofrecen integraciones con el software de Thumbtack o son características que creemos que pueden agregar valor a nuestros profesionales.
Q: Does every Marketplace partner offer a discount?
Q: Hay un descuento disponible para cada socio en el mercado?
A: No. Only some partners are offering discounts at this time. Every partner on our marketplace offers a service or tool we believe could be valuable to our pros, but not every partner has a special offer for Thumbtack pros.
No. Solo algunos socios ofrecen descuentos en este momento. Cada socio en nuestro mercado ofrece un servicio o herramienta que creemos que podría ser valioso para nuestros profesionales, pero no todos los socios ofrecen una oferta especial para los profesionales de Thumbtack.
Q: Is Thumbtack making these offers?
Q: Thumbtack está ofreciendo estas ofertas?
No, Thumbtack is connecting you with our partners, but each partner runs their own business independently. Once you sign up or create an account with a partner, you’ll be dealing with them directly, including for customer service inquiries related to the products.
A: No. Thumbtack los está conectando con nuestros socios, pero cada socio maneja su propio negocio de forma independiente. Una vez que se registre o cree una cuenta con su socio, tratara con él directamente, incluso para consultas de servicio al cliente relacionadas con los productos.

Benefits of linking an integration
This section offers Frontline Reps a concise explanation of the advantages for pros who link their Thumbtack account with a partner integration. It outlines how integrations can lead to increased hires, a seamless customer experience, and streamlined management of leads and messages, detailing the types of integrations available.

English talking point
Spanish talking point 
Q: What are the benefits of linking my Thumbtack account with an integration?
¿Cuáles son los beneficios de vincular mi cuenta con una integración?
A: Signing up with partner tools and services can help increase your chances of getting hired and provide seamless experiences for your customers. When you connect your Thumbtack account with a partner service, you can streamline and optimize the way you manage customer messages and/or leads. 

Our partners offer different types of integrations. We currently partner with platforms that link up with your:

Leads: Get your customers’ contact information and details about the job in your partner platform each time you get a lead.
Messaging: Message back and forth with customers from a partner platform.
Inscribirse en las herramientas y servicios de los socios puede ayudarlo a aumentar sus posibilidades de ser contratado y brindar experiencias fluidas a sus clientes. Al conectar su cuenta de Thumbtack con un servicio asociado, puede optimizar y agilizar la forma en que administra los mensajes y/o prospectos de los clientes.

Nuestros socios ofrecen diferentes tipos de integraciones. Actualmente, nos asociamos con plataformas que se vinculan con sus:

Prospectos: Obtenga la información de contacto de sus clientes y los detalles sobre el trabajo en su plataforma asociada cada vez que obtenga un prospecto.
Mensajería: Envíe y reciba mensajes de los clientes desde una plataforma asociada.
Contact Partner Support With Questions 

This section provides Frontline Reps with clear instructions on how to guide pros when they have questions or issues related to a specific partner's product, service, or billing. It emphasizes directing pros to contact the partner's support team directly and explains how to locate their contact information.

English talking point
Spanish talking point 
Q: If I have questions about one of the partners, who should I reach out to?

A: Each partner manages their own product, service, and customer support. If you have questions about features, setup, or billing with a partner, you’ll contact the partner’s support team directly. Here’s how to find partner support info:

Go to the Marketplace.
Click Sign up on the partner card.
On the partner’s site, look for Support or Contact Us options.


Thumbtack Partners Resources in Spanish 
This section informs Frontline Reps about available resources for Spanish-speaking pros regarding Thumbtack's partners. It highlights translated Help Center articles that cover signing up for partner services and linking Thumbtack accounts with partner platforms, ensuring accessibility for a broader pro audience.

English talking point
Spanish talking point 
Q: Does Thumbtack provide partnership resources for Spanish-speaking pros? 
Q: ¿Thumbtack cuenta con socios que trabajen con profesionales que hablan español?
A: Yes. Our Spanish-speaking pros can access translated Help Center articles for both signing up for partner services and linking their Thumbtack account with partner platforms.

Cómo suscribirse a nuestras herramientas y servicios para socios (How to sign up for partner tools and services)
Cómo vincular su cuenta de Thumbtack con las plataformas asociadas (How to link your Thumbtack account with partner platforms)
If you still have questions, you can reach out to our support team or contact the partner of interest directly for more information.
¡Por supuesto! Contamos con una versión en español del artículo del Centro de Ayuda del Marketplace. Si aún tiene preguntas, puede comunicarse con nuestro equipo de soporte o ponerse en contacto directamente con el socio de interés para obtener más información.

articles.fullText:
Thumbtack Home Repair Estimate Tool (Customer)

Contents
 
1. Overview
a. How it works
b. Customer experience 
i. Upload home inspection report
ii. Access home repair estimates
ii. Book Thumbtack pro directly from their report
2. Talking points
a. General
b. Estimates accuracy
c. Inspection types
d. Make updates or updates made to report
e. Order and use report
3. Resources
1. OVERVIEW
 
April 3, 2023, Thumbtack launched the Home Repair Pricing tool, which helps customers easily identify home repairs they should prioritize and give them estimates for each repair.
To continue helping customers tackle their home improvement projects and maintenance needs, Thumbtack customers can take advantage of the following tools: 
 
(Click images to expand)
Repair estimates by zip code 
Repair estimates are based on the customer's zip code and are broken down by materials and labor. 
Prioritized repairs 
The estimates are prioritized by severity and urgency. We will tell customers which repairs need to happen, prioritize them, estimate costs, and identify the type of pros who could do the work. 
Request list 
Customers can build a custom request list of repair requests, credit amounts, and items accepted as-is.
[Image: Zb-kjfi3o3rMTA14ynlCxsJOM-xK1aOmfaZaRgcn_jIbA78AFzdnYY0pg_cWHCaqWcvMOTJAPR2o43zuZ7yL2HvSVviCaEyWSlCwiQswpv93o5Yrp8MtRtKMy_pq9YshiwVhWFSM6nlASOcvwzjWa80]
[Image: j5pcQMzdW62N-lcRwh71TBWK4-nK53ygOtUJOLoYNV90klLvRMI-lrtDyh5SLLDIsdKvNOitohhM975Bdfuo5ZmFWAEjFA_7SpfTE6VeRhRU8JuMQ3VvqEJX7DhOunVtg90cYnuUFK-3EVbO2b7_2-E]
[Image: PhFNHuRO8xWjXnVqw7IHYXfZKj8oadEPnq0qicUj8riiOXB3fX90rM7yxbmZSXv3V4EyEPTfdO4dvN5wnuceSi1jiyBmL3O94MqL7iKmMyo6k9vqgVqkC-IWvTcJ9sHp7glMKRiCHmzuzlol7YpGgtU]
 
Thumbtack Home Repair Estimates' new tool is a great way for customers to know which projects will improve their home, but it may cause some confusion. 
 
You are not expected to be an expert in how to use this tool, but please help customers with basic troubleshooting. 
HOW IT WORKS
Thumbtack customers can access their Home Repair Estimate securely anytime on desktop or mobile, and share access to collaborate with their family or real estate agent. 
 
Customers can access a repair estimates within 24 hours by following the below steps: 
 
From the Thumbtack landing page, customers will upload their home inspection.
Customers will have access to their Home Repair Estimate with repair estimates within 24 hours.
NOTE: A customer's Home Repair Estimate login credentials are separate from their Thumbtack credentials. 
Customers can then book Thumbtack pros directly from their report.
 
NOTE: Customers will have a separate log-in and account for the "Repair Pricing" tool versus the core Thumbtack experience. Long-term we will solve this, but in the short term they're still hosted on separate domains. 
CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE
When customers are ready to get their repair estimates they will begin the process on the Home Repair Estimates landing page. Review the sections below to see how customers will navigate the Home Repair Estimate Tool. 
UPLOAD HOME INSPECTION REPORT 
To see how customers will upload their home inspection, follow the below steps:
 
On the landing page customers will select Get your repair estimates.

[Image: f2sKUYDVY3YSYlrRoJrVkQNoKsStlAqTtsmVkt9TCDRVMjogIJor-MoJZmQq5zYD6MFNZbzTbAiMTV_i1JKmQtBn1sWneXeJrWX3cdbZxwOC6E0WX1l2G_GaMMknFXP0owMmG6EkLw6Xl_VuqycBi0w]

They will upload a copy of their inspection report (the report must be in PDF format).
Customers will also enter the property address from the inspection and any additional property details they would like us to address.

[Image: RJ_hrXXY--lI1sp4qhuYpF0C8OKZ-AW1NTsDRHia8GteFkaxj3IVT0tqBrlgEC4KSk1DbX4gpHYPvzgB6gi_caKfiDHiVdgxaUxNWIwdBlc96f1Izb06Vlv2k0Yir1iXUGLGNwnolVjLhO5maKeFXjc]

Once the file has been uploaded, a green check and pill will appear. 

[Image: V-B7hjh1JqmU-RD63Y3kw1Csb2I57lxo8GQbW7gx2E-pksJ4AbbrskdUPk2YUSeQESrQIU9uIoGeu_1UdADBD7A6XGl89hjn6v0a7cJGXt6vKasGx3YMzoW5F4W53LjgE3S_ZKd1H93lEOyb4fLewPA]

Click Order Report to submit. 
 
NOTE: The landing page URL above, dev.majordomo.com, will soon be changed to https://repair.thumbtack.com/. We have kept the link to the majordomo link so you can see the page. We have updated the link when the change went through. 
ACCESS HOME REPAIR ESTIMATES 
 
To see how customers will access their Home Repair Estimates, follow the below steps:
 
Account creation - Customers will need to create an account to access their Home Repair Estimates within 24 hours. If the customer has previously created an account they can select Login to sign in with their account credentials. 
NOTE: This account is separate from the customer's Thumbtack account.

[Image: yMlxSJrXGtBQDr60WSnjz7WuG5LoruChA8WIq1T0l2lTfHygvKKD_mvG8VCErmD-hCA_g-noa31XMaX-FL-6yrxCr89CADObAXu_MQlSPFo_9762jIXjJKAt_Q8_-pkGajkflmY7M7aq7ZedXxFfxX0]

Order report - After the customer creates an account or signs-in they will select Order Report.  

[Image: LZYnpiekiaOei4PA41poMC6fmI-RwyaIELxXDJ5kZSCXM9WmvkP1Ea1icuiPWCE-bmdg7SAUiybspgLoP5Mt2Oh3IkD3LD_pWJphwMXZ2PLeySYPrseNMM9wjWvUZYMT40uSoV2qGM8l4Rxt8jzB3lo]

Confirmation - Customers will receive confirmation of their order and receive their report within 24 hours.

[Image: UGgCdAWk7ajPN8BZ6gRt3HScO2htwnNPThjRXlHG2Xhbi9XDqHvCKDDpIRPm8Sa-JcRTspCFiz8kwVS4PP_E16wDq8Gfa61RtqeCim8KxBnYILef6AqdRfq1UUSpaeUFizsfFD3d6yDWMbzIV5Mt4UY]

BOOK THUMBTACK PROS DIRECTLY FROM THEIR REPORT
​​​​​​​​​​​​​​
 
To see how customers can book a pro from their report, follow the below steps:
 
Link on report - Customers who have ordered a report will be emailed when their report is ready to review. Clicking the View Thumbtack Home Repair Estimate button will take them to their report. 

[Image: QBFGFvtrgiSF8NtUduA9r5PR6pRx9VSUYsbdElATf1AGp0rNoP_eBnz9MG9yh63oqqCNuxxgMsYTR3muELDW_aDj2kWzcEi4PCT6Nn-hx1iZ_b0_HcB0Ylg_kvjTN5NLYt99WcDvSsAR28WSQLHWhps]

Report dashboard - C​​ustomers are taken to their report dashboard. If they have multiple reports, they will be listed in the left column. The Repair Estimate tab contains the results of the report.

[Image: 8rMTlcU_2gp1zYFnITc1N4OOhfiEAekJz_Em-38dj3qYY6_28aztYSMTqCNh0NEeLiDaJCweBIamRPmvABbEkwft1IgUmEVOTda1UaqWMDN70DvsClVAHNjl9SjBN-CGV-BWb-9v7TQ0bMPFRB2_GGc]

Repairs summary -  Scrolling down, customers can see the Repairs Summary. It show all repairs and also categorizes them into one of three groups:
Urgent: Features that need attention right away. Usually, they're related to health and safety concerns, structural issues, or mechanical failures.
Pressing: Features that should receive attention soon because they're close to causing an issue that could affect your health and safety.
Cosmetic: Features that do not present any potential harm to you or the building. They're still impacting the value of the home or your level of comfort.

[Image: 6tDG4g7lySqD5PVmOiPHJttFNf4zf7betmhATYfpaMTZODAb2CMnxaktUQ1jVMEVs9XpHriMv8Csl5-PSG9egCDiab5ZMEkxJOowyRBGrW_VMwLmEHA2zzzHBwmWjMKajnJorIN7_iyQjqtwuw4JLaI]

Repair details – Scrolling down past the Repairs Summary, customers will see the Repair Details section. It lists out the repairs individually. They can click a repair to see more details.

2. TALKING POINTS
 
GENERAL
 
What is the Thumbtack Home Repair Estimate Report?
This is your quick, easy, and detailed property condition report based on a third-party, neutral, and professional review of your home inspection report. Know exactly what needs to be repaired in your home and the best time to do it based on the condition of each feature of your home.
The report includes project details, repair estimates, an estimating calculator, project priorities, a to-do list, and more. 

How long does it take to create the Report?
24 hours or less for a single-family home. After you upload your inspection, we go to work researching and verifying your property's condition and the issues called out in the inspection.
How much does a Thumbtack Home Repair Estimate Report cost?
All reports are free of charge.
ESTIMATES ACCURACY 
 
Do you guarantee the work will be done for the estimated project price?
No. We are providing estimates, not quotes. To get a quote, contact a Thumbtack home service professional and they'll give you their price. Our research and experience suggest that on average, our estimates are accurate.
 
Do the Thumbtack Home Repair Estimate Report provide project estimates or quotes?
The Report provides project estimates based on a review of the projects identified in your home inspection report. The estimates are calculated based on decades of pricing data from neighborhoods across the US.
In contrast, a quote comes from a single home service professional for a specific job. This is what you would pay if you hired them to do the work.
The Report’s estimates, and analytics behind the estimates, are deemed reliable but are not guaranteed, as we have not visited the property.
 
How accurate are the project estimates?
While we can't guarantee the estimates, as there are many variables, the Report will give you the confidence to make more empowered decisions during this time-sensitive, crucial point of your home-purchasing process.
 Our process for providing repair estimate pricing includes:
 
Reviewing and understanding the time and material costs (a bottom-up method) by price surveying local wages, material, and equipment needed to perform the work.
Surveying project costs (a top-down method) from local subcontractors and service providers.
Reviewing estimate and invoice pricing of recent jobs performed in your area for the exact same repairs.
We provide an estimated range because it's actually more realistic. Most contractor's quotes include disclaimers regarding the final pricing being contingent on materials not increasing and no additional materials or labor required - which is in effect a +/- estimate. Our estimate range provides for unknown elements of the repair that can't be assessed until the work actually begins. The range is a result of extensive research for the exact job as it's been estimated and invoiced in your specific market. If a quote falls outside of our range, either we don't have enough information from the inspector or there may be some extraordinary circumstances and you should be asking the contractor a lot more questions.
Our pricing partner's team performs industry surveys on both time and material and project costs with more than 50,000 industry suppliers, contractors and service providers across the continent. Each month nearly 20,000 market surveys of randomly selected contractors, suppliers, and service providers are analyzed. In addition, each month more than 400,000 estimates from 500 markets across all 50 states are also analyzed. We care so much about providing clarity to you, that our repair projects are broken down into materials, labor, equipment, minimum trip charges, quantity, measurement, and quality level.
The pricing experts include individuals with experience in the construction and restoration industries, monitored by an economist. While each team member has a background in one or more of the construction trades, together they have more than 575 years of combined construction experience. Their specific experiences cover the full spectrum of construction trades. Several are also licensed general contractors. A brief summary of the members of the pricing team is as follows:
5 Licensed General Contractors
1 Certified Master Inspector (CMI)
1 Certified LEED Accredited Professional (LEED AP)
7 IICRC Certified Carpet Cleaning Technician (CCT)
4 IICRC Certified Carpet Repair & Reinstallation Technician (RRT)
2 IICRC Certified Master Fire & Smoke Restorer (MSR)
4 IICRC Certified Fire & Smoke Damage Technician (SRT)
1 IICRC Certified Journeyman Fire & Smoke Restorer (JSR)
4 IICRC Certified Health & Safety Technician (HST)
3 IICRC Certified Odor Control Technician (OCT)
5 IICRC Certified Upholstery Cleaning Technician (UFT)
4 IICRC Certified Journeyman Textile Cleaner (JTC)
11 IICRC Certified Water Restoration Damage Technician (WRT)
3 IICRC Certified Journeyman Water Restorer (JWR)
4 Lead Safety for Renovation, Repair & Painting (RRP) Training Course
4 OSHA 10 Hour General Industry Safety & Health
As you can see, we have invested significant time and resources into assuring we provide the best cost estimates possible for your local area.
 
Where do you get your project estimates?
Our process for providing repair estimate pricing includes:
Reviewing and understanding the time and material costs (a bottom-up method) by price surveying local wages, material, and equipment needed to perform the work.
Surveying project costs (a top-down method) from local subcontractors and service providers.
Reviewing estimate and invoice pricing of recent jobs performed in your area for the exact same repairs.

Our pricing partner's team performs industry surveys on both time and material and project costs with more than 50,000 industry suppliers, contractors and service providers across the continent. Each month nearly 20,000 market surveys of randomly selected contractors, suppliers, and service providers are analyzed. In addition, each month more than 400,000 estimates from 500 markets across all 50 states are also analyzed. We care so much about providing clarity to you, that our repair projects are broken down into materials, labor, equipment, minimum trip charges, quantity, measurement, and quality level.
INSPECTION TYPES 
 
Do you create Reports for multi-family properties?
Yes we do, but our pricing and timing is different based on the number of units. 
[NOTE: If a customer has a multi-family inspection, reach out to #partnerships_global and we'll help discuss the cost and timing for the customer's particular needs.]
 
Do you handle evaluating and estimating pool, septic, and well inspections?
Not right now.
 
Do you handle mold, radon, and lead-based paint inspections?
We can help you estimate repairing these issues if they turn out to be problems with your home. Currently, we only allow a single inspection document uploaded on the site. You can either:
 
Merge all reports into a single document before uploading your inspection
After ordering your Report, you can upload additional inspections in Documents. Please contact us to let us know you did that so we know to look for them.
 
We'll then take a look and include this extra inspection information in your Report.
MAKE UPDATES OR UPDATES MADE TO REPORT
 
What if I don’t agree with some of the estimates on my Report?
While we work diligently to be as accurate as possible we also understand a house is dynamic. We are not on-site and don't always have the specific details of your project. 
For the first 30-days you can contact us and we will modify the quantity and quality of materials for the repair.
You can also click on any repair to open a new window. At the bottom of this window is a button where you can request an estimate change.

[Image: UJmzSeNshS5t8HoP-dont%2520agree%2520with%2520estimate%2520report%2520image.png]

 
What if my home inspector missed some items? They're not included in the report I sent Thumbtack, and I would like them added.
We understand this happens. Contact us within 30 days of receipt of your Report with your information and we will update your Report for you.
 
Why are my total costs updated?
The total costs are updated because of two reasons:
Cost savings by requesting multiple repairs and replacements from the same contactor type. Instead of charging two separate trip charges for a small job, they can be combined into a single trip and save you money. 
You uploaded a quote from a specific contractor that we prioritized over the range estimate.
ORDER AND USE REPORT 
 
Can anyone book jobs from the report or only certain roles (owner vs contributor vs viewer)?
Every role sees and can click on Thumbtack pro CTAs.
 
Can I use my report for negotiations during my purchase?
Yes. The Report was created to help you understand the condition of the home you are purchasing, prioritize your concerns, and contact Thumbtack pros for repairs.
 
Can you sort projects on the Thumbtack Home Repair Estimate Report?
Yes. At the top of the table, you can sort by area - project, cost estimates, contractor type, the inspection page number, or priority. Review the Report in whatever order is most useful for you.
 

[Image: zZWQHjt7BqeKR51U-sort%2520projects%2520image.png]

 
How do I order a Report?
Start the process of ordering a Domoreport by uploading your inspection.
Starting on the homepage, click on “Get your repair estimates”
The first thing you’ll do is upload your home inspection file. You can upload a PDF by dragging it into the square area, or by browsing.
If your file isn’t a PDF, or you have multiple files, contact support and we’ll help you.
Next, enter your property’s address. Our system should find it, but if not, you’ll see an option to manually add an address.
After that, there’s an optional section where you can tell us anything you want about this inspection. For example, if you want to make sure we address a tree in the front yard, tell us.
Then, create an account. We need your contact information for two reasons:
First, we know your purchase is time-sensitive, so we may email or call you to resolve any issues quickly.
Second, we’ll send you an email and text message when the Thumbtack Home Repair Estimate Report is ready so you can look at it right away.
You can also share your Report with other people. Simply add their email and level of access you want to provide.
Owners can manage sharing, upload documents, and make other changes.
Contributors can also upload and manage documents, but not manage sharing.
And Viewers can simply see everything.
There’s a button at the top of the Report to manage sharing if you want to do this later.
Click on “Order Report”.
That’s it! We’ll email you a receipt and we’ll get to work on your Report right away.
 
How long can I access my data?
Your report will be available forever. You can export a PDF version of the report for your own files. 
If you previously had a Domoreport, that report has been deleted on XX/XX/XXXX day for your privacy. You can upload your home inspection PDF for free and receive a Thumbtack Home Repair Estimate report. 
 
What if I never received my Thumbtack Home Repair Estimate Report?
Let's get that resolved. You should receive an email within 24-hours of ordering with a link to your Report. If you didn't get an email, it could be for a few reasons:
 
Did you get your emailed order confirmation? If not, we may have the wrong contact information for you.
Did you check your spam/junk folder? While we hope to never end up there, it happens.
Check your voicemail as we may need more information.
Visit thumbtack.com/repair-estimate/report and see if it's ready. Though, if it is, and you didn't receive an email about it, we'd really like to know!
 
What if my inspection is more than one file?
Currently, we only allow a single inspection PDF document uploaded on the site. You can either:
​​​​​​​
Merge all reports into a single document before uploading your inspection
After ordering your Report, you can upload additional inspections in Documents. Please contact us to let us know you did that, so we know to look for them.
We'll then take a look and include this extra inspection information in your Report.
 
What if my inspection is not a PDF?
Currently, we only allow a single inspection PDF document uploaded on the site. Here are a couple of things you can do:
If it's a Microsoft Word document, you can "Save as..." and select the PDF file format. Here's a video tutorial.
If it's a different file type search for "Convert [document type] to PDF" and there are various websites that'll do it for you or show you how to do it.
Contact us! We're happy to accept it in an email and go from there.

What is the “Documents” section?
When you buy a home, there are many documents to sign and review. Keeping track of all of them, and remember where they are for later can be difficult. That's where Documents comes in. We automatically add your home inspection, and you can add any other documents that you'd like saved. These documents are shared with everyone who has access to the Thumbtack Home Repair Estimate Report.

What’s the difference between Urgent, Pressing, and Cosmetic repairs?
Urgent: These are features that need attention right away because of their poor condition. Usually, they're related to health and safety concerns, structural issues, or mechanical failures.
Pressing: These features should receive attention soon because they're close to causing an issue that could affect your health and safety.
Cosmetic: These are items that, although in potentially poor condition, do not present any potential harm to you or the building. Still, they're worth fixing because it could be affecting the value of the home or your level of comfort.
 
Where does the “Contact Us” module in the Report send to? Thumbtack’s customer service center or Majordomos?
All “Contact Us” CTAs on the site or in emails will link to https://help.thumbtack.com/contact-thumbtack
 
Who sees my inspection and Thumbtack Home Repair Estimate report?
This is your personal report. Nobody else sees it unless you share it with them. Your inspection is also saved within Documents on your account at Thumbtack for safekeeping.
Thumbtack will never share your personal information and inspection with anyone without your permission.

1. Overview
The Thumbtack Community is a place for pros to connect and grow as small business owners. Built by pros for pros, it’s a place to network, share resources, and exchange ideas and advice. 
The community has these main categories:
Live Feed: See all of the conversations happening in the community in real-time.
Explore: Anything from Business Resources to Thumbtack Resources and more can be found here. 
Network: Join a group and connect with other Thumbtack pros in your industry and area.
Events: Find (or share) upcoming events.
On-Demand Webinars: Explore our library of on-demand webinars. (See Webinars (Pro) KA to learn more)
Member Directory: Find other pros in the community by searching with their username or email.Live Feed: See all of the conversations happening in the community in real-time.

[Image: FhSIgGzkZDgDpACk_iuTgwERYoXqKCaWBsRb7YvnOeZJ53_fD-iB6O_MntlyrOdyThBrBWnIEjai6Ni8I51rd8dJm4nK2KkELeWrcKt5vyK_KCA6_gROFN4u-CX5I1p_A_ho538S]

NOTE: Anyone can take a look around the Pro Community, but only Thumbtack pros can join.

Join #pro-community Slack. The place to discuss, ask questions about and hear stories from our Pro Community
Pro Events
Pros can find (or share) upcoming and past community events by visiting community.thumbtack.com and going to the Events tab. 
Pros can RSVP to an event by selecting: “going”, “maybe,” or “not going.” 
Pro Contests
Thumbtack sometimes hold contests to encourage pros to engage with each other in the Community. These contests are opportunities for pros to be rewarded for sharing their thoughts and learnings about Thumbtack. They happen roughly every month, so pros have plenty of chances to participate.
2. PROCESS
(PRO) STEPS: HOW TO JOIN THE THUMBTACK COMMUNITY
The Thumbtack Community is under construction, and we'll be inviting pros to join in phases. Pros can keep an eye on their email for future invites. 

If a pro is interested in helping build our community, they can fill out our "Help build your Thumbtack Pro Community" form. This form lets pros share their thoughts on what "community" means to them and why they would like to be a part of this phase.
Once they get an email, here’s how they sign up:
Go to community.thumbtack.com.
Select Sign in
Pros should use their regular Thumbtack username and password to sign in.
Create a username for the community 
NOTE: Pros can only set it once so make sure it fits.

Tip to rep: Use the email template “Thumbtack Community | Pro Community intro”  to explain the community and how to sign up. 

After logging in, pros can engage with the community by joining conversations or showing support through kudos. 
(PRO) STEPS: HOW TO START A DISCUSSION
Follow these steps to make a post:
Go to the community homepage and choose a board to jump into.
Select New Discussion.
[Image: km5EU1yVAOLyHlvzQalYbd7eduga_dnico15YLUxTAawfmKhbCd5nA6ESJCApmzyZBkiPVM5lQbStXI_DzfiN7RLYqcvwJ35U8aQqbachWZPiG-YZbkbsJINZ8944P9bXe6r7au6IuSPiV1kd-ch0AE]
Type your question, tip, story or idea.
[Image: cuHQoBCcdaHIm2W2xEEJjV9bbVaCWqhb88tYyvrakC5oxKeiIteSjnn-s3tFaC91fwbQ82_GjoeS60t-CQZnBma1wLcL-lpBiizX3sU9XnPGWL88yBmLLLFPnRVlWxRt-xljH1vj3cP7L4U1EZFijXc]
Select Post discussion.
2. Talking points
Do I have to sign up in the Thumbtack Community to post and comment?
Yes. Anyone can read posts, but you need to sign in if you want to post and comment. To learn more, check out this video about the Pro Community.
¿Tengo que registrarme en la comunidad Thumbtack para publicar y comentar?
Sí. Cualquiera puede leer publicaciones, pero debe iniciar sesión si desea publicar y comentar. Para obtener más información, consulte este video sobre la Comunidad Pro.
Is there a search function in the Thumbtack Community?
Yes. You can search the Community by discussion title, and you can also search for specific users.
¿Existe una función de búsqueda en la comunidad Thumbtack?
Sí. Puede buscar en la Comunidad por título de discusión y también puede buscar usuarios específicos.
I was removed from Thumbtack. Will you remove my posts and comments in the Community?No. The only
time a post is removed from the Community is if it violates our Community Code of Conduct.
Me quitaron de Thumbtack. ¿Eliminarán mis publicaciones y comentarios en la comunidad?
No. La única vez que se elimina una publicación de la comunidad es si infringe nuestro Código de Conducta Comunitario.

Thumbtack Chat Support (Customer) (Pro)

Contents
Overview
Thumbtack's AI Assistant
Thumbtack's automated assistant 
 Key points
Chat Transcript Interaction Logs, Queues, and Routing
Chat Routing and queues
Handling Transferred Chats from Sales: Non-Sellable Home Pros
