Customer reports a pro did a bad job on their On-Demand Booking
Customer wants to know why their payment failed
Resource

This KA is for the customer experience. See Claimable Jobs (Pro) for the pro experience. 
1. Overview
On-demand bookings allows customers the option to have Thumbtack match them with a high-quality pro, instead of choosing the pro themselves. The customer pays Thumbtack, and then Thumbtack pays the pro. Customers will see the price upfront and input their payment information, but they won’t be charged until after the job is completed. 
This feature is accessible to both customers and pros nationwide (all 50 states).  Customers will only be able to book an on-demand job by going to the Fixed Price Projects landing page. Customers won’t see the option to book an On-Demand job from search results.
Customers have the latest app version for this feature to work correctly.
NOTE for reps: When speaking with customers, refer to these as on-demand bookings. Don’t refer to these as claimable jobs when speaking with customers.  
Updates
On-Demand Booking Changes for Customers (Effective January 17, 2023)
Customers will only be able to book an on-demand job by going to the Fixed Price Projects landing page. Customers will no longer see the option to book an On-Demand job from search results. 
Why can’t I start an On Demand request on the pro list (search results) anymore? 
We’re currently working on improvements to the On Demand experience. While we are doing this, you won't be able to start an On Demand request from the pro list. You will still be able to start On Demand requests from other areas on Thumbtack.
On-Demand Booking Categories 

Customers can book pros in all 50 states in the below categories. If there are not at least 6 eligible pros in a zip code, the customer won’t see the On-demand booking option. 
Handyman (When booking a Handyman using On-Demand, the job cannot be more than 2 hours of work)
House Cleaning
Junk Removal
TV Mounting
Benefits of On-Demand Bookings 
On-demand bookings offer a streamlined and secure experience for customers looking to hire a high-quality professional quickly. By choosing this option, customers gain several key advantages designed to simplify the hiring process and provide peace of mind, including: 
Customers are covered by Thumbtack’s Thumbtack Guarantee. See Guarantee – Thumbtack 
Customers don’t have to hunt for a pro. 
The price is fixed based on their job details. 

Sales tax for On-Demand bookings
Thumbtack automatically collects sales tax from customers who reside in states and cities that charge it. This sales tax is applied when a customer is charged for the on-demand booking. Customers will input their payment information, but they won’t be charged until after the job is completed.
At this time, customers won’t receive a detailed invoice for any payments exchanges. However, they do receive a receipt of payment via email to see how much they’re charged in sales tax. Sales tax is applied to the subtotal amount.
Reps can refer to the internal Charges on Thumbtack: Payment methods (Customer) KA to learn more. 
▶ Sales tax view on an On-Demand booking:

[Image: AD_4nXeUgv3iJgLCcsLCqnlJtaVVkhOP2J77qc2zdkez--2zt_syH131Z769KkiD9PNI7mGoOxNysJCMBwZiWYQRvvnAGwqS7yX14lM8KKm7oFoqeaRbt2nDgRpia8biJBBiuMZlAE5V]

NOTE: If contacted by a customer who has questions about sales tax, frontline reps can let them know that Thumbtack determines sales tax based on applicable local county/state restrictions.
Customer experience: On-Demand Bookings  
Customers can book On-Demand jobs directly through Thumbtack. They will see the price upfront and input their payment information, but will only be charged after the job is completed
The only way for customers to book an On-Demand job is by visiting the Fixed Price Projects landing page. The option to book an On-Demand job won’t appear in search results.
Customers can book On-Demand jobs with less than 48 hours. However, jobs requested with less than 48 hours' notice (but no less than 8 hours) are subject to a 15% surcharge.
▶ What customers see when booking with less than 48 hours notice

[Image: rtaImage]

Customers can check out the What are On-Demand bookings? – Thumbtack Help article to learn more.
How a Customer Books an On-Demand Job:
Customers can initiate a booking by clicking “Book a vetted pro” from the Fixed Price Projects landing page.
The booking process involves the following steps:
Confirm job details.
Select the desired date and time.
Provide their address and phone number.
The customer is notified of their assigned pro within approximately 24 hours.
The customer's card is authorized but not immediately charged.
▶ An email confirmation of the booking is sent to the customer.[Image: rtaImage]

When the Customer is Charged:
Thumbtack attempts to charge the customer's card when one of the following occurs (whichever is sooner):
The pro marks the job as complete.
24 hours after the scheduled job start time.
Reschedule On-Demand Bookings 
Customers can reschedule On-Demand bookings. If the set date and time no longer works, direct the customer to reschedule the booking themselves in-product. After rescheduling we stop giving them the option to reschedule (i.e. there will be no CTA / ‘reschedule button’ after the first rescheduling). 
NOTE: If the customer reschedules with less than 48 hours (no less than 8) from the job, they will be charged a 15% surcharge ​​since it's considered an urgent request. 
Pros cannot reschedule claimed jobs. If the set date and time no longer works, the pro should cancel the booking themselves in-product. 
Cancellations for On-Demand Bookings 
Customers and pros are able to cancel these jobs. Depending on how far in advance the job is canceled, there may be a cancellation fee charged. 
AT A GLANCE CANCELLATION INFO

Pro cancels less than 48 hours before the job start time.
The booking will be canceled.
The pro will be charged a $15 fee. 
The customer will be notified of the canceled booking.
The customer will be granted a full refund.
Pro cancel greater than 48 hours before the job
The request is put into manual fulfillment. 
The customer will be notified that Thumbtack is looking for another pro. 
The pro will not be charged a cancellation fee.
Customers cancel greater than 24 hours before a job 
The customer will not be charged a cancellation fee. 
The customer will be granted a full refund.
Customer cancels less than 24 hours before the job 
The customer will be charged a nonrefundable $15 cancellation fee, but they'll be refunded the rest of their payment.
The $15.00 cancellation fee will be automatically credited to the pro's Thumbtack Credit balance for their time. 
NOTE: See the no-show section for no-show fees. 
Key points
Frontline reps should keep the following points in mind when helping customers with on-demand bookings:
Terminology: Always refer to these as on-demand bookings when speaking with customers. Do not refer to them as "claimable jobs."
Pro Status: DO tell customers that the pros are independent service providers, and DON’T tell them they are pros employed by Thumbtack.
Payment Timing: Customers are not charged until after the job is completed (when the pro marks the job as done or 24 hours after the job start time, whichever comes sooner). Their card information is input and authorized beforehand.
Sales Tax Inquiries: If a customer has questions about sales tax, inform them that Thumbtack determines the sales tax based on applicable local county/state restrictions.
Reschedule Surcharge: If a customer reschedules with less than 48 hours (but no less than 8 hours) from the job time, they will be charged a 15% surcharge.
Payment Failure (Job Completed): If a customer's payment fails for a completed job, they must pay the pro outside Thumbtack, as Thumbtack cannot collect repayment in this situation. Assure the customer that the canceled payment authorization will drop off their statement in a few days.
2. Process 
Steps: How to check the payment status of an on-demand booking in Admin (Rep)
To view a customer's payment history for their on-demand booking,, frontline reps should follow these steps:
Navigate to the customer's project page within Admin.
Under the "Fulfillment payment info" section, click “View Full Transaction History.”
On the Request Payment Activity page, refer to the Transaction Type and Transaction Status columns to understand the payment activity.
▶ What it looks like

[Image: 2iIJprsQaeApJHIbl_sBPAXjhNUJEKK3Nthd-ZfjryZ8QHR6ULpA4pS4z746xsanwtAF2-DYWXnqK72wzGKrRES6FT5DoCS790OAa1MyKhy7rvvGlw3p3lfgznO-9juTmL6UgC6HkX-ld3kfEAb6K0b8X5SPbYXwT1tNS0VbLcpMTYAMlJ2MoWBzWg3Jkw]

Use the tables below for definitions of the values in these columns:
Transaction Type
What it means
PAYMENT_INTENT
Look at the “Transaction Status” column to verify if the customer was charged.
REFUND
The customer payment has been refunded
TRANSFER
The pro has been paid. 
TRANSFER_REVERSAL
The pro’s earnings are reversed

Transaction Status
What it means
GATEWAY_FAILED
The payment transfer to the pro failed.
TRANSACTION_CREATED
The customer’s payment has been authorized but hasn’t been charged yet. 
TRANSACTION_SUCCESS
The customer has been charged for the job (either 24 hours has passed or the pro marked the job as done). 
TRANSACTION_VOID
The customer's authorization expired (typically within 7 days from the job start time) or the payment authorization was manually cancelled by an agent to prevent future payment.
NOTE: If you encounter a Transaction Type not listed here, refer to the internal Support for Payment Related Inquiries to request help.
Steps: How to handle situations where the customer payment fails (Rep)
There's an ongoing issue where if the customer’s authorization expires , we're unable to pay the pro at that point since the transfer will fail. This usually happens when the pro has not marked the job as done within 48 hours after completing the booked job.
How to Identify a Failed Payment:
On the "Full transaction history" page, look for the following transaction statuses:
TRANSACTION_VOID: The payment transfer will fail, and we are unable to pay the pro via Thumbtack.
GATEWAY_FAILED: The payment transfer failed.

Action to Take When Customer Payment Fails and the Job is Complete:
If a customer reaches out because their payment failed for a completed job, reps will: 
Advise them to pay the pro outside of the Thumbtack platform.
If the customer claims they were still charged: Reassure them that the payment has been canceled and will drop off their bank statement within a few days.
▶ Use the provided talking points to guide these conversationQ: Why didn’t my payment go through? / Why is the pro asking me to still pay them for the job? A: We found that the payment authorization placed on your card for your on-demand job has already been canceled. You will expect it to drop off from your statement in a few days. Because the payment was unsuccessful, we encourage you to work with the pro on payment.We apologize for the inconvenience and are working on improving the payment experience for on-demand bookings. 
Note: Thumbtack cannot process the repayment from the customer.
If a pro reaches out about a failed payment, Thumbtack allows the pro to request payment from the customer outside Thumbtack. Reps should follow the steps outlined int he internal Claimable Jobs (Pro) KA. 
Steps: How to reschedule an On-Demand Booking (Customer) 
If a customer needs to reschedule an On-Demand booking, they can follow these steps:
In the app, tap Projects.
Click “Reschedule” on the project you want to reschedule.
Select a new date and a new time that works for you.
Re-input their credit card information to complete the booking.
We notify the customer in about 24 hours with details of the new pro.

If the customer selects to reschedule and they’ve already been matched with a pro, Thumbtack will let them know that they’ll be matched with a new pro if they continue. To the original pro, it will appear as if the customer has canceled, since they’re not eligible to claim the rescheduled job.
▶ CUSTOMER RESCHEDULES IN-PRODUCT FLOW
Currently the number of times a customer can reschedule is limited to 1. 
Customers can see the option to reschedule directly from their projects page.
▶ What it looks like
[Image: OYz5Y78i7igRpyLWXQVBeVV2QPZjbFJVO05QRj8iXwZ0RDlYNImqZcVaaT2-V5ERG08Xa_PDj3JhsTeX_03VR3N34J59VK8JStft-dQx-gHkgzxsA5pr5O99lsyfwHJi3QVGFxyRpDWmpQqrBAhqX09bTX7ohAeE6TlzaqvvjnTK5w0HITfEtAbJ8ZLzBQ]
Customers can reschedule after they complete the request up until the job start time.
▶ What it looks like
[Image: vUAI04z68MDzjySkcmAHQ95ubKKLdKTnY6U1L0lIccE4bK41jzRYDiMsBK4b_P2abZbYxusuzdUJV8YmNOd3kuvx-ytHh8UFG9B-JquboKm-zNreVQ7gm8zSN6VVvS0c_XRHTPEjuADY_R7BBr7BUox2qcTKa_tYKaPkXrwU6K3ml94RCCd1tU_OzoIg6A]
To begin the process, they’ll click the “reschedule” button.
If the customer selects to reschedule and they’ve already been matched with a pro, we’ll let them know that they’ll be matched with a new pro if they continue.
▶ What it looks like
[Image: NmHJT7Ep3r0x_yxg3l_ODPe-1_qYlb697-myFaabfBuOVKOSQcltRKVTiJVCBTL5sAj0pj0hQRnSjCVnF8TlW0Wfy1OUDiNvPuIvc52JDUSZY8tgwyofVcFHho6ckfURkEoQc5qMg8FZ8f0SBoeqgWp6D9t8-P4UYLZVZKsfysq-tRUjoeZAq9pNLGhxjw]
The customer will then select a new date and a new time that works for them.
▶ What it looks like

[Image: rtaImage]
[Image: rtaImage]

Customers will need to re-input their credit card information to complete the booking.
▶ What it looks like

[Image: rtaImage]
[Image: rtaImage]

Finally, customers will see a success screen that notifies them that their booking has been rescheduled.
▶ What it looks like

[Image: rtaImage]

If the customer has already been matched with a pro, we’ll send the original pro cancellation comms, letting them know that the customer has canceled. 
▶ What it looks like

[Image: rtaImage]

We’ll also indicate to the original pro that the request has been canceled in-product and the messenger.
NOTE: The original pro will not be eligible to claim the rescheduled job.
▶ What it looks like

[Image: rtaImage]
[Image: rtaImage]

After the customer reschedules, the original request will be canceled and a new one will be created. The new request will be sent to automatic fulfillment.
NOTE: The customer won’t be aware that the request was canceled but will just see that it has been rescheduled and we’re finding a new pro.

Steps: How to cancel an On-Demand Booking (Customer) 
Customers can cancel an On-Demand Booking and receive a full refund, with no cancellation fee, if the cancellation occurs more than 24 hours before the scheduled job start time.
Cancellation Fee:
A $15.00 cancellation fee is applied if the customer cancels less than 24 hours before the job start time. This $15.00 fee is automatically credited to the pro's Thumbtack balance as compensation for their time.
To cancel: 
Customers must use the Thumbtack app to cancel a project.
Open the Thumbtack app.
Tap Projects from the main menu at the bottom.
Select the project you wish to cancel.
Tap the three-dot menu (top right).
Tap Cancel project.
Tap Yes, cancel project to confirm.
Select a cancellation reason.
(Note: Cancellations can only be made via the Thumbtack app.)
▶ Screenshots of what the cancellation flow looks like

[Image: gykJ2rzVP-iFVyk8nA9HdA0RyRR4wLysyjEfcaZc_yxnn49We1Le_BXqBx5BM2L7WZelpYsCPuK3ob-ZK2Pf9cyeDvGk2srAhXMNWNCw59kBb_vjcoRL5JL8OlMYp-P6xIFx6WM2BiU65uAHrr-BTQGlEqKmtI5Dl3gixf2I4qUU2UytdONiFzwU]

Pro Credit for Late Customer Cancellation:
Pros can verify this $15.00 credit by visiting their Payments page and checking under "Credits and refunds." The credit will appear as 'promotional credit' and will not indicate which customer the credit originated from. When helping pros, reps can refer to the internal Claimable Jobs (Pro) KA. 
NO-SHOWS
Service and Support agents handle no-show situations reported by customers and pros when the pro wasn’t paid(e.g., the job didn’t happen and the pro wasn’t paid).
No-shows could include:
Customer and pro are talking to each other, but the date/time of the job passed and they are trying to reschedule or cancel. 
Customer or pro decided they weren't the right fit for the job. 
The project didn't happen and the pro wasn’t paid (pro no show, customer no show, rescheduling issues, etc.)
Any other reason why the job didn't happen.
NOTE: Any safety or project quality issues should still be escalated whether or not the pro was paid yet. See Marketplace Trust & Safety > Issues to Escalate for more information. 
When a pro or customer reports a no show, you’ll need to: 
Identify if a refund can be issued. 
You can refund a customer’s payment if all three apply: 
The job has not been marked as complete. 
The pro or customer didn’t show up for the job (job didn’t happen).
There is no dispute about the quality of work.
Identify the status of the payment (e.g., has customer been charged, has pro received payment).
Cancel the project in Admin.
Prevent charges or refund the customer.
BREAKDOWN
No-show type
Definition
What happens
Cancellation reason
Refund reason
Pros reports the customer was a no-show 
Pro reached out to report the customer can’t be contacted or didn’t show up on the date the job is scheduled.
Cancel the project.
The customer will be charged a $15 penalty.
The pro will receive a $15 Thumbtack credit. 
Prevent charges or refund the customer. 
The pro reported a customer no-show
CUSTOMER NO SHOW
Customer reports the pro was a no-show
Customers reached out to report that the pro can’t be contacted or didn’t show up on the date the job is scheduled.
Cancel the project. 
The pro will be charged a $15 no-show fee.
Prevent charges or refund the customer.
The customer reported a pro no-show
PRO NO SHOW
Pro canceled with less than 48 hours until booking time.
Pro canceled within 48 hours of the project start time and didn’t cancel in-product.
Cancel the project. 
The pro will be charged a $15 penalty.
The customer will be notified of the canceled booking.
Prevent charges.
The pro canceled with less than 48 hours until the booking time. 
PRO LATE CANCEL
Steps: How to identity payment status in Admin (Rep) 
In order to effectively process a refund, you need to see if the customer has been charged and if the pro has been paid. The payment status will determine what you’ll need to do to help the customer.
From the customer admin, open the project Request PK page.

[Image: 6c-PztdKrFOAvDDYZG9PcANU9JK6g7pZkTVQ70_7ZIVxQIAaXNLdP-sZK1d6uHNQb3196XADTJc4-2YKccoGu_ywp52fb6dOvc7Mb0Ew0JHaUCPNQWRdTPsFj5mtRfCtV3XCZ64hgw3pWEcju8zUo7rwbuuaWteSaCZgnD8wqcgjVucUZAO5Ey7SvPw9]

Under “Fulfillment payment info” pane, select View Full Transaction History

[Image: Vm979vMgymTBTGx0XucjsnBjXIvO8etyaynT0X0MGdMrzQDRAUBaSQ2a68LC0Nqp_gXUZfPT2zHUMW_Xa5s87cNFKrsz9yBr59y_Fxd_d58ojaySnqnUe1b0zICPiV5LxgL62VNcPhOeRnEyGZGxMCcT2LOvDT4qnzFrHda5-rgEALe7Pyh8RyDro4v6]

Look at the “Transaction Type” column to verify if the pro was paid. If it says:
TRANSFER –  Escalate to Marketplace Trust & Safety. The pro has already been paid. 
PAYMENT_INTENT  - Look at the “Transaction Status” column to verify if the customer was charged.
TRANSACTION_CREATED – The customer’s payment has been authorized but hasn’t been charged yet. 
You need to cancel the project and prevent the charge.
TRANSACTION_SUCCESS – The customer has been charged for the job (either 24 hours has passed or the pro marked the job as done). 
You need to cancel the project and process a refund.
NOTE: If you see a transaction type not listed above, post in #tod-service-and-support for guidance. 

[Image: dokGGiNFTG7IoLZVl2mwhctlRT1fGunExNARNiaxr0af_6ATXLZaiErig5KP1N4y50a0f2LEJW3xQEpImagBzkbqt22cyyoyfug1afAo7opadYhjbN-0EGeKZHlrgRW0wBBjK1M3yb7num98ICBfWPURWCBg7fEODU6jXu1yWCqFK5OEKjp97LiR5L3h]

Steps: How to cancel the On-Demand Booking for the customer (Rep) 
Cancel the project in Admin when preventing a charge or refunding the customer’s payment. Always cancel the project before preventing payment or refunding.
From the project Request PK page, locate the “cancel request” drop-down menu and select the applicable option:
The pro canceled with less than 48 hours until booking time: Pro canceled within 48 hours of the project start time and failed to cancel in product. 
This will automatically charge the pro a $15 penalty.
Customer reported a pro no-show: Customer reporting the pro was a no show. 
This will automatically charge the pro a $15 penalty.
Pro reported a customer no-show: Only use when a pro is reporting the customer was a no show or when the customer has requested a late cancellation within 24 hours of the job start time. 
This will automatically cancel the job, but not charge the customer or pro. 

[Image: OIKVq3_mjJwWh8X_BP7QKPanFZRR3PULPsepNLZsy0UFTRuyapWSca8-OTB1_I_idZrejTsaHCP0bFNQVar7UWZ0PRuKi-y8s4jH0BIuyzqyKtO2Tx-7ceaXaKxQMeS1M-LtLuK4FxnnHuS73aC2tkvl8UBCdd2S2t_JpT_Ni4ZQSg9TzY9rVt_U8plZ]

Finalize the cancellation by clicking Cancel request.
You have canceled the request and are ready to either prevent or refund the payment. 
Steps: How to prevent charges (Rep) 
After you cancel the project and if the customer hasn’t been charged (the transaction status  says TRANSACTION_CREATED), you’ll need to prevent future payment by following these steps:
From the Request PK page, locate the “Fulfillment payment info” pane.
Check the Charge cancellation fee box only when:
Pro reporting a customer no-show.
Customer is requesting the late cancellation.
Click “Cancel authorization” to prevent the customer from being charged.
To confirm that the cancellation was successful, the payment status should now say TRANSACTION_VOID

[Image: G5eIDy97yeADOjgd7CCNBWBCgxjZjyXQOLLGZhGqMi-Ea1AReXHlzvBbAL0ayLvzEWReEOKGJD-c_TlT4lkJXThVMCVViv-50_OE0tfMC5VpA-C1gvolIRbfooUElL5ZI1NFJi_EwlMjw_8m-3v7Lq7EfGk55ganizfE08yROu4Ihu8SNIVJ-MoH75WKIA]

Steps: How to refund the customer for their On-Demand Booking (Rep) 
After you cancel the project, if the customer has been charged (Transaction status says TRANSACTION_SUCCESS), you’ll need to refund the customer by following these steps:
From the Request PK page, locate the “Fulfillment payment info” pane.
Click Refund The Payment link.

[Image: bwhrae-wdkk7cIfjy6GShWzujgGNbzmlfYTGUSeTTg263pvqmK26F5bcNBGUjEVUnfOjKG75ZT1-k9fbw__v2vgj6LODXSMKW9al5Sp0aUbluMiwwNfKQ43peAJNBA-dJCURzZNEuQfn63TQ606lXc5ypL07CXDpaJZymSKLlSC5BZt1Rn20TFqsl5sk]

Select the appropriate Refund Type from the dropdown:
Job Refund – When refunding the customer. 
Cancellation Fee Refund – When a customer has been charged a cancellation fee and you’ve sought approval from your manager or in  #tod-for-service-and-support Slack. 
Select appropriate Refund Reason (pairs with the cancellation reason):
Pro No Show – Customer reached out to report that the pro can’t be contacted or didn’t show up on the date the job is scheduled. 
Cancellation reason – The customer reported a pro no-show 
Pro Late Cancel: Used when the pro cancels within 48 hours.
Cancellation reason: The pro canceled with less than 48 hours until booking time 
Customer No Show – Pro reached out to report the customer can’t be contacted or didn’t show up on the date the job is scheduled. 
Cancellation reason: Pro reported a customer no-show (this triggers the cancellation fee charge).
Enter the amount to be refunded.
Only enter the job amount before tax.
If a discount is provided, deduct the discount from the job amount.
NOTE: Refunding more than the customer paid will give you an error message and will not allow the refund to be processed.
Select the appropriate option whether to Trigger reversal for the pro
No - Customer is refunded
Yes - The pro’s earnings will be reversed and will be used to to refund the customer (currently only for MTS use)  
Finalize the refund by clicking Refund.
NOTE: If it’s unclear which party is responsible for the cancellation, post in #tod-for-service-and-support for assistance.

Steps: How to handle common On-Demand Booking Scenarios (Rep)  
If a customer contacts support regarding any of the following situations, support reps should provide help as instructed below.
Cancellation Request (Customer or Pro)
Customer: Walk the customer through canceling the job in-product, provided the cancellation is made more than 48 hours before the scheduled job time.
Rescheduling a Job
Pro: Pros cannot reschedule claimable jobs. If the scheduled date/time is no longer viable, the pro must cancel the booking themselves in-product.
Customer: Customers can reschedule On-Demand bookings in-product, but this will result in a new pro being assigned, not the original one. Direct the customer to reschedule themselves in-product.
Changes to Job Details: The job cost and project details cannot be modified after the customer has booked.
Drastic Changes: If a customer's project details change significantly, they must cancel the existing project and submit a new request.
Additional Work/Services: If there is additional work or services the customer wants that are outside the original job details, payment should be arranged and made directly between the customer and pro, outside of Thumbtack.
Pro Unable to Complete Job (Scope Change): If the pro cannot perform the job because the scope is completely different, or for any other reason, they must contact support.
Opting Out of Text Notifications
Instruct the user to reply "stop" to the text message they received from us.
Alternatively, they can go to Settings > Notifications and switch the “New claimable jobs” toggle off.
Reps can refer to the internal Notifications (Customers) KA for details. 
Steps: When to contact Payments team for help (Rep) 
If a customer contacts support for a reason not covered in the scenarios above, refer to the internal Support for Payment Related Inquiries KA for steps on how to request help.
Reasons to contact the pay team for support:
Questions regarding Thumbtack service fees and cancellation fees, particularly when it's unclear which party is responsible for the cancellation fee ($15).
If it is unclear whether the request is still in manual fulfillment.
Any other issues not explicitly addressed in this guide.
Additional Resources:
For questions related to payment, charges, and cancellations, refer the customer to the On-Demand Bookings Terms and Conditions – Thumbtack Help article.  

3. TALKING POINTS
 
What On-Demand Bookings and how they work 
This section provides frontline reps with talking points for general inquiries about the On-Demand Bookings feature, including how pros are vetted, how customers are matched, and when they’re charged 

English talking point 
Spanish talking point 
Q: Why can’t I start an On Demand request on the pro list (search results) anymore? 

We’re currently working on improvements to the On Demand experience. While we are doing this, you wont not be able to start an On Demand request from the pro list. You will still be able to start On Demand requests from other areas on Thumbtack.

How does it work to have Thumbtack book a pro for me?
¿Cómo funciona cuando Thumbtack reserva un pro para mí?
For select categories, you’ll now have the option for Thumbtack to match you with a trusted, independent pro. All you need to do is choose the service, give us the job details, pick a date and time and put in your credit card details. We won’t charge your card until after the job is done. After that, we’ll follow up in about 24 hours with details of your pro. 
Para determinadas categorías, ahora tendrá la opción de que Thumbtack lo conecte con un profesional independiente y de confianza. Todo lo que necesita hacer es elegir el servicio, darnos los detalles del trabajo, elegir una fecha, hora y pagar por adelantado. Después de eso haremos un seguimiento en unas 24 horas con los detalles de su profesional.
I didn’t get matched with a pro. Will I get a refund?
No me conectaron con un profesional. ¿Recibiré un reembolso?
Yes, if we can’t match you with a pro, we’ll issue you a full refund.
Si no podemos igualarlo con un profesional, le enviaremos un reembolso completo. 
What is the pro vetting process? 
¿Cuál es el proceso de elegir al profesional?
All pros eligible for this service must have at least 3 verified reviews, a 4.5+ star rating, and the Thumbtack account owner must be background checked. 
Todos los profesionales elegibles para este servicio deben tener al menos 3 evaluaciones verificadas, una calificación de 4.5+ estrellas y el propietario de la cuenta Thumbtack debe completar una verificación de antecedentes.
How long should I expect to wait to hear from a pro? 
¿Cuánto tiempo debo esperar para que me responda un profesional?
We’ll email you with details of your pro about 24 hours after booking. In some cases, it may take longer depending on pro supply in your area. 
Le enviaremos un correo electrónico unas 24 horas después de la reserva con los detalles de su profesional. En algunos casos, puede tomar más tiempo dependiendo de los profesionales disponibles en su área.
What’s included in my booking?
¿Qué incluye mi reserva?
You can specify what’s included in your booking by telling us about your job. After you give us the details, we’ll show you the fixed price for the job. You’ll always be able to review the job details before you book.
Puede especificar lo que está incluido en su reserva contándonos sobre su trabajo. Después de darnos los detalles, le mostraremos el precio fijo para el trabajo. Siempre podrá revisar los detalles del trabajo antes de reservar.
Is the pro I hire employed by Thumbtack?
¿El profesional que contrate es empleado de Thumbtack?
No, when you book a job through this service, you’re booking with an independent service professional. Thumbtack does not provide the booked service and is simply facilitating your relationship with the independent service professional you are matched with.
No, cuando reserva un trabajo a través de este servicio está reservando con un profesional de servicio independiente. Thumbtack no proporciona el servicio reservado y simplemente está facilitando su relación con el profesional de servicio independiente con el que se le empareja.
When am I charged for the job? Who do I pay? 
¿Cuándo me cobran por el trabajo? ¿A quién le pago?
Thumbtack charges you for the job when the job is done.
Thumbtack le cobra por el trabajo en el momento de la reserva.

 
 Cancellations, no-shows and rescheduling for On-Demand Bookings 
This section provides frontline reps with talking points to address customer questions regarding the policies and potential fees associated with canceling, rescheduling, or a pro no-show for an On-Demand booking, such as the cancellation fee and the urgent reschedule surcharge.

English talking point 
Spanish talking point 
Why am I being charged a cancellation fee?

You’re only charged a cancellation fee if you cancel less than 24 hours before the job start time. This is credited to a pro’s account to compensate them for their time, as they may be unable to fill the slot with a new customer.

What if I need to cancel? Is there a fee?
¿Qué pasa si necesito cancelar? ¿Hay una tarifa?
You can cancel your project in-product or by contacting support.
Cancellation occurs greater than 24 hours before scheduled job time: You’ll get a full refund and won’t be charged anything additional.
Cancellation occurs less than 24 hours before scheduled job time: You’ll be charged a $15 cancellation fee, and you’ll be refunded the rest of your payment.
Puede cancelar el proyecto en la plataforma o contactando al Equipo de Apoyo de Thumbtack.
Si la cancelación ocurre con más de 24 horas antes de la hora programada del trabajo: Recibirá un reembolso completo y no se le cobrará nada adicional.
Si la cancelación ocurre con menos 24 horas antes de la hora programada del trabajo: Se le cobrará una tarifa de cancelación de $15, y se le reembolsará el resto de su pago.
What if the pro cancels the job?
¿Qué pasa si el profesional cancela el trabajo?
Cancellation occurs greater than 48 hours before the scheduled job time: We’ll work to find another pro to do your job. If no one else is available to do the job, we’ll issue you a full refund.
Cancellation occurs less than 48  hours before the scheduled job time: Unfortunately at this time we won’t be able to find another pro to do your job. We’ll issue you a full refund.
Si la cancelación ocurre con más de 48 horas antes de la hora programada del trabajo: Trabajaremos para encontrar otro profesional para hacer su trabajo. Si no hay nadie más disponible para hacer el trabajo, le emitiremos un reembolso completo.
Si la cancelación ocurre con menos 48 horas antes de la hora programada del trabajo: Lamentablemente, en este momento no podremos encontrar a otro profesional para hacer su trabajo. Le enviaremos un reembolso completo.
What if the pro doesn’t show up? 
¿Qué pasa si el profesional no se presenta?
If the pro doesn’t show up, let us know by contact support. We’ll issue a full refund. 
Si el profesional no se presenta, póngase en contacto con el Equipo de Apoyo de Thumbtack para informarnos. Le enviaremos un reembolso completo.
What if I need to reschedule?

Life happens. If the set date and time no longer works, you can reschedule by going to your projects page and clicking “Reschedule” on the project you want to reschedule.

Can I change my project details after I book?
¿Puedo cambiar los detalles de mi proyecto después de reservar?
Unfortunately, you won’t be able to change the project details after you book. However, if you’d like additional services outside of the job details, you can discuss that with the pro on-site and payment should be made separately, outside of Thumbtack. If your project details change drastically, please cancel your project and create another request.
Lamentablemente, no podrás cambiar los detalles del proyecto después de reservar, debido a que ya se realizó el pago. Sin embargo, si desea servicios adicionales fuera de los detalles del trabajo, puede comunicarse con el pro en el sitio y el pago debe hacerse por separado, fuera de Thumbtack. Si los detalles del proyecto cambian drásticamente, cancele el proyecto y cree otra solicitud.
Customer reports a pro did a bad job 
 This section provides frontline reps with talking points to address any customer concerns within the On-Demand Bookings experience if a pro did a bad job.

English talking point 
Spanish talking point 
The pro did a bad job. Can I get a refund?
El profesional hizo un mal trabajo. ¿Puedo obtener un reembolso?
I’m sorry you’re unhappy with the job done. Please report a problem or contact support and let us know what happened. We’ll work to make things right.
Lamento que no estés contento con el trabajo realizado. Por favor reporte un problema o póngase en contacto con el Equipo de Apoyo de Thumbtack e infórmenos lo que ocurrió. Trabajaremos para hacer las cosas bien.
What is the Thumbtack Guarantee?
¿Qué es la garantía Thumbtack?
When things go wrong we’re here to help. See our Thumbtack Guarantee to understand if you’re covered.
Cuando las cosas salen mal, estamos aquí para ayudar. Consulta nuestra Garantía de Thumbtack para verificar si estás cubierto.
Customer wants to know why their payment failed 
This section provides frontline reps with talking points for guiding customers through the resolution process when their payment for a completed On-Demand booking has failed and must be resolved outside of Thumbtack's platform.

English talking point 
Spanish talking point 
Why didn’t my payment go through? / Why is the pro asking me to still pay them for the job? 
¿Por qué no se realizó mi pago? / ¿Por qué el profesional me está pidiendo que le pague por el trabajo?
We found that the payment authorization placed on your card for your on-demand job has already been canceled. You will expect it to drop off from your statement in a few days. Because the payment was unsuccessful, we encourage you to work with the pro on payment. 

We apologize for the inconvenience and are working on improving the payment experience for on-demand bookings. 
Hemos detectado que la autorización de pago realizada en su tarjeta para su trabajo bajo demanda ya ha sido cancelada. Esperamos que esta autorización desaparezca de su estado de cuenta en unos días. Dado que el pago no se realizó con éxito, le recomendamos que colabore con el profesional para efectuar el pago.

Lamentamos las molestias y estamos trabajando en mejorar la experiencia de pago para las reservas bajo demanda.

1. Overview 
▶ KA Summary
This internal knowledge article, "Notifications (Pro)," is designed for Frontline Reps to understand how Thumbtack pros receive and manage notifications. It covers various notification types (push, SMS, email), troubleshooting common issues like not receiving alerts, and processes for setting up and unsubscribing from notifications, including Do Not Mail (DNM) and Do Not Call (DNC) lists. The article aims to equip reps with the information needed to assist pros effectively with their notification settings.

Pros can receive SMS (text), email, and push (app) notifications. If a pro has multiple businesses on Thumbtack, they get notifications for each one by selecting the business name at the top of their Notifications page.
Here are a few other ways pros can be contacted by Thumbtack:
Phone calls: Thumbtack may make outbound phone calls to pros for various reasons, such as the Sales team working with a new pro, or Support returning a callback*, etc). 
Physical mail: Thumbtack may mail pros something for various reasons, such as a part of a promotion or Pro Rewards swag.
*Frontline reps can see the internal Phone Call Support Interaction Guide (Rep) KA for guidelines on making outbound calls. 

Why notifications are important for pros:
Customers want to hear back from pros as soon as possible. Notifications help pros respond faster and on the go.
The faster pros respond, the better their rank will be in search results. That’s because Thumbtack wants to show pros who are engaged and are most likely to provide the best customer experience.
Responding quickly is one of the three qualifications for Top Pro.

Key points
Frontline reps should keep the following key points in mind when helping pros with their notifications:
Notification Delivery Time: Let pros that it can take up to 24 hours for notification changes to take effect.
SMS Unsubscribe: Pros can unsubscribe from text messages by replying "Stop" to one of Thumbtack's texts.
SMS Help: Pros can reply "help" to one of Thumbtack's text messages to get a message with support contact information.
Notification Importance: Encourage pros to leave on as many notifications as possible to receive important reminders and information. Emphasize the impact of quick responses on search ranking and Top Pro qualification.
Multiple Businesses: If a pro has multiple businesses, notification settings must be adjusted separately for each one by selecting the business name at the top of the Notification settings page.
Troubleshooting email notifications: If a pro isn’t receiving emails from Thumbtack, they should check their spam/junk folders, and ensure Thumbtack's email address is added to their contacts.
Push Notification Settings: Pros can check their phone's app notification settings to ensure push notifications from the Thumbtack app are allowed.
Workarounds: If a notification issue persists, suggest workarounds like turning on email, push, or text notifications as alternatives.
Notification alerts that pros should keep turned on
Pros can customize how and when they receive Thumbtack notification alerts.
At a bare minimum, pros should keep on email and push notifications for the following:
New leads and messages
Lead reminders
Budget alert
Frontline reps should encourage pros to leave on as many notifications as they can to get important reminders and information. For detailed information about specific notification settings, see the tables below. ↓↓↓

Ways pros can receive alert notifications
▶ 🤖 Background notes
AI Context: This section details the primary methods Thumbtack pros utilize to receive important job and account notifications. It covers push notifications via the Thumbtack app, SMS text messages, and email alerts. Understanding these channels is crucial for Frontline Reps to effectively assist pros with their notification settings and ensure they stay informed.
Push notifications pros receive about jobs
 
Pros can receive push notifications through the Thumbtack app. When pros download the app and turn on push notifications, they will be notified of new jobs that way. Push notifications can only be accessed through the app. 
Download the Thumbtack app from the Google Play Store
Download the Thumbtack app from the Apple Store

Thumbtack sends pros three reminders about a new lead: at the one-hour, three-hour, and 20-hour mark after the customer first contacts the pro.
If the customer hasn’t heard from any pros at the four-hour mark, Thumbtack emails other pros about the customer’s job. This is so pros have a chance to respond beforehand.

Notifications pros may receive about open opportunities

If a pro has been sent the opportunity, the job details of the customer will be automatically assigned to the Opportunities tab on the Leads page (for the pros who aren't contacted). Notifications of the opportunity are sent as soon as the project request is created.

2. Process: Set up and adjust notifications 
▶ 🤖 Background notes
AI Context: This section outlines the process for Thumbtack pros to set up and customize their notification preferences. It details how pros can manage settings via desktop or the app, and provides steps for Frontline Reps to assist pros with these configurations. The goal is to ensure pros receive timely and relevant alerts to effectively manage their businesses.
Steps: How to set up notifications (Pro) 
Pros can customize their notifications by accessing the Notifications page. To manage push notifications, pros should use the app. It's important to note that it may take up to 24 hours for notification changes to take effect.
Pro steps: Pros can set up and update their notifications by following the steps in the How to update notifications – Thumbtack Help article. 
 
Internal note for reps
Frontline reps can change the pro’s notification settings for them: modify the method (email, text, and push) and amount of notifications that pros receive. To help a pro with their notification settings, frontline reps will follow these steps:  
Impersonate the pro and follow the steps in the How to update notifications – Thumbtack Help article. 
If a pro isn't sure which notifications they should leave on, walk them through each setting (see ways pros can receive alert notifications). 
Frontline reps should also follow these guidelines when helping pros with their push notifications: 
Educate the pro on where they can adjust their notifications, even if the rep adjusts the settings for them.

3. Process: Unsubscribe from notifications 
▶ 🤖 Background notes
AI Context: This section details the process for pros to unsubscribe from Thumbtack notifications, covering various methods like adjusting in-app settings or replying to SMS messages. It also outlines steps for Frontline Reps to assist pros with unsubscribing, including handling persistent email issues and managing Do Not Mail (DNM) and Do Not Call (DNC) lists. The overarching goal is to ensure pros can effectively manage their communication preferences with Thumbtack.
Steps: How to unsubscribe from notifications (Pro) 
Pros can unsubscribe from all notifications by following the steps in the How to unsubscribe – Thumbtack Help article. If a pro has trouble unsubscribing, they can complete this unsubscribe form instead.
Pros with multiple businesses will use the drop-down menu at the top to select the business they want to update.
Unsubscribing turns off pros notifications. If pros aren’t interested in using Thumbtack, they can deactivate their account by following the steps in the How to deactivate a pro account – Thumbtack Help article. 
Internal note for reps
If a pro wants to unsubscribe from notifications, and they're asking for the first time, Frontline reps should follow these steps: 
Coach pros on the value of notifications and which ones they should keep active (see notification alerts that pros should keep turned on).
When making changes to an account on behalf of a pro, Frontline reps must adhere to the internal Impersonation Guidelines KA.
Do address the pro's concerns if they no longer want notifications or want to leave Thumbtack.
Do tell pros it can take up to 24 hours for notification changes to take effect.
Steps: How to unsubscribe from SMS (by replying to message) (Pro) 
To unsubscribe from SMS notifications, pros can reply to a Thumbtack SMS with STOP, END, CANCEL, QUIT, or UNSUBSCRIBE at any time. Afterward, pros receive a confirmation of their opt-out via text message.
If pros want to re-enroll in text messages, pros can turn the notifications back on in their Notification settings in their Thumbtack account.
Tip: Pros can also reply "help” to one of Thumbtack’s texts to receive Thumbtack’s support phone number and operating hours.
Steps: How to help a pro who is receiving emails after unsubscribing (Rep)
  
If a pro unsubscribed from communications (or deleted their account) and is still receiving emails, Frontline reps should follow these steps:
Apologize for the frustration the pro might have experienced from continuing to receive emails.
Verify that the email address on the account matches the one where the pro is receiving the emails (in case they have another account under a different email).
Verify that the pro has already turned off notifications for all their businesses. 
Note: Notifications have to be adjusted separately for each business on their account. 
If a Frontline rep makes any changes, let the pro know that they will be unsubscribed within 24 hours, and ask the pro to contact us again if they continue to receive notifications after 24 hours.
When making changes to an account on behalf of a pro, Frontline reps must adhere to the internal Impersonation Guidelines KA.
If a Frontline rep follows these steps and the issue isn’t resolved, collect information from the pro about what notifications they’re still receiving, and submit a bug report.
Steps: How to help a pro be added to the Do Not Mail (DNM) list (Rep) 
If a pro doesn’t want to receive any mail from Thumbtack, they can be added to our internal do not mail (DNM) list. Pros are added to the do not mail (DNM) list while working with a Thumbtack rep and requesting DNM. 
Frontline reps will follow these steps to add the pro or customer to the Do Not Mail (DNM) list: 
Open the Direct Mail - Do Not Mail spreadsheet.
Add their first and last name, mailing address, and email address.
Add the case number and date of the removal request.
Internal Note: Do not mail (DNM) only applies to physical and does not apply to electronic notifications, SMS, phone calls, or emails.

If a pro or customer doesn’t want to be contacted by Thumbtack via phone, they can be added to our internal do not call (DNC) list. Pros and customers on Thumbtack's internal DNC list and public DNC lists will have a "Do not call" or "Internal Do not call" flag on their Salesforce account. (See table below for more details.)

4. Process: Troubleshoot notifications 
▶ 🤖 Background notes
AI Context: This section provides Frontline Reps with a comprehensive guide to troubleshooting common issues pros face when not receiving Thumbtack notifications. It outlines steps to diagnose problems with email, push, and SMS notifications, helping reps determine if messages are not being sent or received. The goal is to equip reps with the necessary information to effectively resolve notification delivery issues for pros.
Steps: Email troubleshooting (Rep)
Frontline reps will follow these steps to help a pro who needs help troubleshooting their email notifications: 
First, narrow down which emails the pro isn’t getting. For example, the pro might still be receiving marketing or support emails, depending on their settings. 
Ways to ask the pro: 
Is there a specific lead or message you didn’t get an email for?
Are you receiving significantly fewer emails than you used to?
Then, determine whether the emails aren't being received or if the emails aren't being sent by Thumbtack in the first place. And follow the applicable steps below.  
Internal Note: Thumbtack doesn't notify pros of all opportunities, only the opportunities that the pros may be particularly suited for. Frontline reps can see the internal Opportunities (Pro) KA to learn more. 
Steps: How to determine if emails for a pro aren’t being received or sent (Rep)
To determine if emails for pros aren’t being received or if they're not being sent in the first place, Frontline reps will cross reference the pro’s email log within Salesforce with the relevant section in Admin (e.g. “Reviews received,” etc.). To do this, reps will: 
To look at the pro’s email logs in Salesforce, go to the pros contact page.
Click the Related tab and scroll down to “becquerel__sms_send_event”.
Find the type of email (new lead, new message, etc.) and see if the timestamp is the same as the creation time of the action.
“invite-brand.html” = new request invite
“message-notification-v2.html” = new customer message
"new-lead-experience.html" = new lead
If the timestamps are the same, the emails are being sent, the problem is with the pro not receiving them. Follow Steps: Emails not being received below. 
If the timestamp of the event is after the timestamp of the email, the emails are not being sent at all. Follow Steps: Emails not being sent. 
Internal Note: If the emails are newer (sent less than 24 hours ago), pros might not be appearing in Salesforce yet. 
Steps: How to help a pro who isn’t receiving emails (Rep)
 
Frontline reps will help a pro who isn’t receiving emails by following these steps:
Verify the pro’s email address is correct by asking the pro to confirm their email address. If it's incorrect, help the pro update their email address. See the internal Account information (Pro) KA for steps. 
Ask the pro to check their spam or junk folder for Thumbtack emails. If they find any, have them click into the email, then click “Not spam”
Ask the pro to add the following email address to their contacts: 
do-not-reply@pro.thumbtack.com (account and marketing notifications for pros)
do-not-reply@customer.thumbtack.com (account and marketing notifications for customers)
support@thumbtack.com (for English support)
ayuda@thumbtack.com (for Spanish support)
refunddisputes@thumbtack.com (for refund dispute support)
Internal Note: Do this even if they don’t find any emails in their spam or junk mail folder.
If the pro uses Gmail, ask them to check their “Promotions” folder.
They can do this either by selecting the “Promotions” tab above their messages. If there's not a tab above their messages, have them select it from the labels on the side.
If they find any Thumbtack emails in that folder, have them drag the email to their inbox. They will be asked if they want emails from that sender to always go to their primary inbox; they should click Yes.
If the rep or the pro changed anything as part of these steps, wait 24 hours. 
If the Frontline rep has completed all the steps and the pro still isn’t receiving emails, the rep should submit a bug report and provide the pro with a workaround for getting notifications in the meantime (like using push or text notifications). The pro can also log into the Thumbtack app or website to see new leads, opportunities, messages, and more.
Steps: How to help a pro when emails aren't being sent (Rep)

 
To help a pro when emails aren’t being sent, Frontline reps should follow these steps:
Check that the pro’s email notification preferences are turned on by impersonating the pro. Frontline reps can see the internal Impersonation Guidelines KA to learn more.
If notifications for emails are turned off (grayed out), Frontline reps should ask for the pro’s permission to turn on the notifications. If approved, click the slider to turn it on (it should turn blue when on).
Wait 24 hours to see if the issue is resolved. In the meantime, pros can use text or push notifications as a workaround.
If after that 24 hour timeframe has passed and emails are still not being sent to the pro, submit a bug report and provide the pro with a workaround for getting notifications in the meantime (like using push or text notifications). The pro can also log into the Thumbtack app or website to see new leads, opportunities, messages, and more.
If the pro isn’t getting email notifications when their preferences were already turned on, then Frontline reps can check the pro’s Contact page in Salesforce next to verify if emails are being sent:
Go to the Contact page in Salesforce.
Navigate to the Related tab. 
Find the 'becquerel__email_send_event' to verify it shows as sent.
Frontline reps can use the "None of the email troubleshooting steps worked and I'm still not getting emails" email template to respond to the pro as needed.
Pro steps: Pros can follow the steps found in the How to update notifications — Thumbtack Help article to turn notifications on or off themselves at any time in their own Thumbtack account.
Steps: How to help a pro who isn’t receiving push notifications (Rep)
 
Frontline reps will follow these steps when helping a pro who isn’t receiving push notifications:
Find out which push notifications the pro isn’t receiving. And, if applicable, educate the pro about which kind of push notifications can actually be sent.
Check that all the right push notifications are turned on in the pro’s Notification settings in their Thumbtack account (gray slider means it’s turned off, blue slider means it’s turned on). If the pro was missing notifications because they had a slider turned off, coach them on their notification settings.
Have pros check in their phone settings that Thumbtack app notifications are set to “allowed.” 
Walk the pro through any applicable troubleshooting steps for their device found in the internal Basic Troubleshooting KA.
If a Frontline rep makes any changes, let the pro know they should start seeing notifications within 24 hours. See the internal Impersonation Guidelines KA to learn more about making changes on a pro or customer’s behalf. 
Ask the pro to contact Thumbtack again if they still aren’t receiving push notifications after 24 hours.
If a Frontline rep has followed these steps and the issue isn’t resolved, collect detailed information from the pro about what notifications they’re not receiving and submit a bug report.
Frontline reps can suggest these workarounds to a pro who isn’t receiving push notifications:
Turn on email notifications
Turn on text notifications
Open the app regularly to check for new messages, leads, or other notifications
Steps: How to help a pro who isn’t receiving SMS notifications (Rep)
If a pro calls in about not receiving text notifications, Frontline reps follow the steps below before filing a bug report. 
Find out what kind of notifications the pro is referring to. 
New leads? 
Messages from existing customers? 
Opportunities? 
Make sure the pro has the right expectations about what they should be receiving. Remember, Thumbtack doesn't notify pros about all opportunities — just the ones Thumbtack thinks they’re especially suited for or might be interested in.
If the pro really is supposed to be getting texts and isn’t, check if:
The pro has received a recent notification
The pro’s correct phone number is listed on notification page (no typos)
Text message notifications are turned on in the pro’s Notification settings in their Thumbtack account
In Salesforce, verify that Thumbtack is sending text messages to the pro. 
Click on the pro's contact name in Salesforce.
Click on the Related tab and scroll down to "becquerel__sms_send_event". This section will show reps all the text messages Thumbtack has sent to that pro. 
Note: It’s possible for pros to be unsubscribed from text messages even if text message notifications are enabled (due to too many failed delivery attempts). 
Make sure the pro isn’t referring to “skipped” text messages, which are skipped between 9pm–8am (unless night-time setting is enabled). (See what it looks like below.)▶ What it looks like[Image: vx8U2CLLXIYJ3d7jmhBb9m4V6QzWvcjXivwH8Tg0p_hho3PKVwReYKMCwdFVIqsYr80p-rumEO1RKh7WUOeMzpaYS6e_MVm0zWwHmt11RSff36CSmJ0RTEGg3Y-R1O1TEENWTTWDZorqEpIeikni_w]
Verify that Thumbtack's phone number isn't on the pro’s blocked list on their iOS device by following these steps (or Google the steps on how to unblock a number for other devices):
Tap Settings. 
Go to Apps settings.
Open the Messages app and scroll down to the “Blocked Contacts” section.
Open Blocked Contacts and search for Thumbtack’s phone number. 
Frontline Reps can find Thumbtack’s phone number from the "From_Number" column of the "becquerel__sms_send_event" section of Salesforce and provide it to the pro.
If Thumbtack’s phone number is on the blocked contacts list, have the pro unblock the phone number.
Additional tips: "Filter Unknown Senders" may be enabled on the pro’s device, so Frontline reps should make sure the pro adds Thumbtack to their contacts. If the pro's default message is iMessage, ensure that Thumbtack is included in the pro’s iMessage app.
Check if the pro has received any of Thumbtack’s text message notifications (~last 2 weeks)? 
If yes: instruct the pro to reply to one of the text messages with “GO” (the pro should have a long code phone number from previous text messages).
If no: instruct the pro to send “GO” to their long code phone number. Frontline reps can see the internal Steps: Find a pros long code phone number below.
Submit a bug report if the pro does not receive text messages after sending “GO” (wait for five to ten unreceived messages).
If the pro doesn't want to wait to see if texting "Go" works, they should try contacting their phone provider. Some providers don't allow text messages from unknown numbers, but will allow them per their customer's request.
Internal Note: Thumbtack only uses long-code phone numbers when texting notifications to pros (Thumbtack stopped using short codes in 2017).

5. Talking points
 
 
▶ 🤖 Background notes
AI Context: This section provides Frontline Reps with approved talking points for communicating with pros about notifications. Use these talking points to ensure consistent and accurate messaging. These talking points address common pro questions regarding notification delivery, the benefits of staying informed, and how to manage their communication preferences effectively.
Receiving notifications talking points (Pro)

English FAQ
Spanish FAQ
Q: Will I be notified if a customer reaches out to me?
Q: ¿Recibiré notificación si un cliente se comunica conmigo? 
A: Yes. We notify you when a customer contacts you to learn more or hire you. If you haven’t already, I recommend downloading the Thumbtack app and turning on push notifications so you can respond to customers quickly.
A: Si. Le notificamos cuando un cliente se comunica con usted para obtener más información o contratarlo. Si aún no lo ha hecho, le recomiendo que descargue la aplicación Thumbtack y active las notificaciones automáticas para que pueda responder a los clientes rápidamente.
Q: Will I be notified if I appear in a customer’s search results?
Q: ¿Recibiré una notificación si aparezco en los resultados de búsqueda de un cliente?
A: No. If the customer sees your business in their search results but doesn’t contact you, you won’t be notified. But if they reach out to you (by messaging you or checking to see when you’re available), you’ll see a notification.
A: No. Si el cliente ve su empresa en sus resultados de búsqueda, pero no se comunica con usted, no se le notificará. Pero si se comunican con usted (enviándole un mensaje o para preguntar sobre su disponibilidad), verá una notificación.
Q: What are push notifications?
Q: ¿Qué son las notificaciones push?
A: Push notifications are messages from the app that tell you there’s activity on your Thumbtack account, like a new lead. Make sure you never miss activity on your account by turning on your push notifications. If you have the app, I can walk you through the steps to turn these notifications on.
A: Las notificaciones push son mensajes de la aplicación que le informan que hay actividad en su cuenta Thumbtack, como un nuevo prospecto. Asegúrese de no perderse ninguna actividad en su cuenta activando las notificaciones automáticas. Si tiene la aplicación, puedo guiarle para activar estas notificaciones.
Q: What are the benefits of downloading the Thumbtack app?
 Q: ¿Cuáles son los beneficios de descargar la aplicación de Thumbtack?
A: We think that the app offers the best experience for both pros and customers. With the app, you always have your messages, job details, and calendar right at your fingertips. The app experience is streamlined to fit right into your busy life, letting you manage your business easily on the go.
A: Creemos que la aplicación ofrece la mejor experiencia tanto para los profesionales como para los clientes. Con ella, usted siempre tendrá sus mensajes, los detalles del trabajo y el calendario al alcance de la mano. La experiencia en la aplicación está diseñada para adaptarse a su ajetreada vida, permitiéndole administrar su negocio fácilmente desde cualquier lugar.
Q: What are the benefits of receiving SMS notifications from Thumbtack?
Q: ¿Cuáles son los beneficios de recibir notificaciones por SMS de Thumbtack?
A: You can receive job requests directly to your phone through text message. A link in the message will direct you to the job on Thumbtack through your mobile phone internet browser.
A: Puede recibir solicitudes de trabajo directamente en su teléfono a través de un mensaje de texto. Un enlace en el mensaje lo dirigirá al trabajo en Thumbtack a través del navegador de Internet de su teléfono móvil.
Q: Why don’t you notify me when an opportunity matches my targeting preferences?
Q: ¿Por qué no me notifica cuando una oportunidad coincide con mis preferencias de enfoque?
A: If an open opportunity matches your preferences exactly, there’s a good chance the customer already saw you in their search results. Since they didn’t reach out to you in their initial search, they might not think you’re the right fit for their job. Rather than email you about these uninterested customers, we’ll email you when you get a new lead, or send you opportunities where the customer might not have seen you in their first search.
A: Si una oportunidad abierta coincide exactamente con sus preferencias, es muy probable que el cliente ya lo había visto en los resultados de búsqueda. Dado que no se comunicaron con usted en su búsqueda inicial, es posible que pensaron que no es la persona indicada para este proyecto. En lugar de enviarle un correo electrónico sobre estos clientes desinteresados, le enviaremos un correo electrónico cuando obtiene un nuevo prospecto o le enviaremos oportunidades en las que el cliente podría no haberlo visto en su primera búsqueda.

1. OVERVIEW
KA Summary
This internal knowledge article provides Frontline Reps with guidance on managing customer notifications, including types of notifications (push, SMS, email), how to adjust settings, and how to assist customers with unsubscribing. It outlines key points for reps to remember when assisting customers with notifications.
Types of notifications customers can receive
Customers can receive text, email and push (if they’re using the app) notifications. 
 
Notification alert type
Details

PUSH (APP)
With Thumbtack’s all-in-one app, customers will be on top of their to-do list. The Thumbtack app puts hundreds of local professionals right at customers' fingertips. 
If Frontline reps need to help customers with how to download the customer app, follow the steps in the How to download the customer app – Thumbtack Help article.
See internal Thumbtack App (Customer) KA to learn more and internal New Customer App Experience  Experience KA. 

SMS
Customers can sign up to receive text (SMS) message notifications through Thumbtack. By signing up to receive text messages, customers agree to Thumbtack's SMS Terms, Thumbtack's Terms of Use, and Thumbtack's Privacy Policy. 

EMAIL
Thumbtack uses the following domains to send emails to customers:
@thumbtack.com
@pro.thumbtack.com
@customer.thumbtack.com
Customers can connect with Support reps through email by emailing support@thumbtack.com or ayuda@thumbtack.com
Frontline reps should note that the following email addresses were previously used by Thumbtack but are no longer active as of December 2019:
email@go.thumbtack.com
instant-match@go.thumbtack.com
mentors@go.thumbtack.com
opportunities@selfmade.thumbtack.com
proassist@go.thumbtack.com
professionals@go.thumbtack.com
professionals@selfmade.thumbtack.com
thumbtack@go.thumbtack.com
Customers can also receive notifications or contacts from Thumbtack in the following ways: 
Email: If a pro requests a payment from a customer, and the customer has not completed the payment request within 48 hours after the request was sent, Thumbtack will automatically send the customer an email and push notification at 9am (local standard time for the customer).
Phone calls: 
Customers can request help through the platform and provide their phone number to Thumbtack. The Boost team will contact the customer to help with their project. The Boost team reaches out to the customer within 20-40 minutes of the customer submitting help.
The Boost team may contact customers if they don't receive a prompt response from a pro.
Key points

Here are key points for Frontline Reps to remember when helping customers with notification alerts:
Do tell customers it can take up to 24 hours for notification changes to take effect.
Do address concerns if customers no longer want notifications or if they want to leave Thumbtack.
Do encourage downloading the Thumbtack customer app (if they haven’t already).
Do educate on where customers can adjust their notifications, even if the Frontline rep adjusts the settings for the customer.
2. Process
This section outlines the specific steps Frontline Reps should follow to manage customer notification settings, assist customers with unsubscribing, and understand the various notification scenarios, with pointers to additional resources for more complex situations.
Note: Frontline reps should follow the applicable processes in the internal Notifications (Pro) KA for the following topics:
The customer wants to unsubscribe from notifications
The customer wants to be added to Thumbtack's Do Not Mail list (DNM) or Do Not Call list (DNC).
The customer is not receiving email, push, or SMS notifications
A customer is still receiving emails after unsubscribing
Frontline rep needs to find a customer's long code phone number
(Rep) Steps: How to set up and update customer notifications
This section guides Frontline Reps through the process of adjusting customer notification settings on their behalf, outlining the steps to modify notification methods (email, text, and push) and frequency to best meet each customer's preferences.

Note: Frontline reps can change the customer's notifications settings for them. Frontline reps can modify the method (email, text, and push) and amount of notifications that customers receive by following the steps in the How to update notifications – Thumbtack Help article.
If a customer isn't sure which notifications they should leave on, Frontline reps can walk them through each setting. Frontline reps should educate the customer on where to adjust their notifications, even if the Frontline rep adjusts the settings for the customer.
Customers can set their notification settings themselves by following the steps in the How to update notifications – Thumbtack Help article.
(Rep) Steps: How to help a customer unsubscribe from notifications
This section details the steps Frontline Reps should take when a customer requests to unsubscribe from all notifications, including coaching the customer on the benefits of staying informed and directing them to the appropriate resources for managing their notification preferences.
If a customer wants to unsubscribe from all notifications, and they're asking for the first time, Frontline Reps should coach customers on the value of notifications, and which ones are best to keep active.
If the customer still wants to unsubscribe, Frontline reps (or the customer) should follow the steps in the How to update notifications – Thumbtack Help article.
3. Talking Points
This section provides Frontline Reps with approved talking points for communicating with customers about notification preferences. Use these talking points to ensure consistent and accurate messaging.
Push notifications
English
Spanish
What are push notifications?
Push notifications are messages from the app that tell you there’s activity on your Thumbtack account, like a new lead. Make sure you never miss activity on your account by turning on your push notifications. If you have the app, I can walk you through the steps to turn these notifications on
¿Qué son las notificaciones push?
Las notificaciones push son mensajes de la aplicación que le informan que hay actividad en su cuenta Thumbtack. Asegúrese de no perderse ninguna actividad en su cuenta activando las notificaciones automáticas. Si tiene la aplicación, puedo guiarle para activar estas notificaciones.
Are there any key differences in how push notifications work on Android versus iOS?
Currently, if you get a notification with the app open in iOS, a pop-up will trigger in the app. On Android, the notifications will always show up in the notification bar at the top (unless you disable app notifications entirely).
¿Existen diferencias clave en el funcionamiento de las notificaciones push en Android frente a iOS?
Actualmente, si receibe una notificación con la aplicación abierta en iOS, se activará una ventana emergente en la aplicación. En Android, las notificaciones siempre aparecerán en la barra de notificaciones en la parte superior (a menos que desactive las notificaciones de la aplicación por completo).
Too many notifications
English
Spanish
I get too many notifications from the Thumbtack app.
We hear you. It's easy to manage your notifications so that only the most important ones come through. Can I walk you through how to do that?
Recibo demasiadas notificaciones de la aplicación Thumbtack.
Entendemos. Es fácil administrar sus notificaciones para que solo se reciban las más importantes. ¿Me permite explicarle cómo hacerlo?
