All items completed: Pro selects all items → sees "Payment is on its way!" and the payout process begins.
Some items completed: Pro selects only the items they installed → sees a message that additional information is needed to process payment. The pro is prompted to call (628) 266-0562. 
How to help a pro: If a pro calls about a partially completed multi-product job or says they only installed some items, warm transfer to the Third Party Leads queue.

2. Customer experience
Request creation and account access
When a customer purchases an installation service at Lowe’s, Thumbtack automatically creates a customer account using the email they provided to Lowe's. A scheduling link is sent to the customer via email so they can select their preferred date and arrival window. The project request is not created until the customer completes scheduling — before that point, the job will not appear in the customer's account in Admin.
Rep note: If a customer reports their job is not visible in their account, confirm whether they have completed the scheduling step. The project request is only created once the customer selects a date and arrival window. If they haven't scheduled yet, direct them to their email or text from Thumbtack to find the scheduling link.
New Thumbtack Customers Only
Customers new to Thumbtack will receive two emails after purchase:
Account creation email: Prompts the customer to create a password to finish setting up and access their account. The setup link expires in 24 hours.
Schedule installation email: Notes that creating a password is optional — the customer can still access and manage their installation without one.
While a password is technically optional, creating one is in the customer's best interest. A password gives them full access to Thumbtack messenger to communicate with their pro, and full account management including rescheduling directly in the app.
Rep guidance for new customers
If a new customer reports they cannot message their pro or access their account, direct them to thumbtack.com/reset-password to set up their password.
If their account creation link has expired, direct them to thumbtack.com to sign in and follow the prompts to create a password.
If a customer cannot find their scheduling link, direct them to check their email or text from Thumbtack. If they still need help, check the related Maintain record in Salesforce to locate and resend the scheduling link
How customers schedule their Lowe’s installation 
The scheduling process is self-serve for customers on simple jobs.
When the customer purchases an eligible item and installation service at Lowe's (online or in-store), Thumbtack automatically sends the customer an email with a scheduling link.  If the customer does not engage with the email, a text is sent 24 hours later.
To schedule the installation, the customer selects Schedule your service from the email (or text). 
They select a date and a 3-hour arrival window and click Next. 
They will review their selection and click Complete booking.
The customer sees a confirmation screen and also receives an email confirming their booking. 
After scheduling, the project request is created and the job is sent out for eligible pros to claim. Once a pro claims the job, the customer receives an email with their pro's details at least 24 hours before the job start time.

Payment and add-on fees

If the pro discovers that additional parts or labor are needed once on-site, they will contact Lowe's to get the customer's approval before starting any extra work. Rescheduling policy and what to expect
Customers can reschedule their installation once directly in product — either through the reschedule link in their booking confirmation or pro details email, or via the app under Projects. Rescheduling is available up until the scheduled job start time.
Here’s what happens when a customer reschedules their booking: 
Thumbtack will notify them that they will be matched with a new pro. 
The original pro's job will appear as cancelled on their end. 
The original pro may be eligible to claim the rescheduled job depending on availability and matching logic, though this is not guaranteed.
Customers receive a confirmation email when a pro claims their rescheduled job.
Rescheduling limitations 
After rescheduling, the reschedule button is removed — customers cannot reschedule a second time.
Once the arrival window has begun, rescheduling is locked in-product. The customer must call Thumbtack Support at (628) 266-0562 for help.
Policy: 
Rescheduling within 24 hours of the job start time is discouraged. While a late rescheduling fee is not currently enforced, this may change in the future.
The pro will still receive a $15 courtesy credit if the customer reschedules within 24 hours.
How customers reschedule their Lowe’s installation 

If a customer needs to reschedule their installation service, they can follow these steps:
How to reschedule via the app:
Go to the Plans tab
Under Booked, select the project they want to reschedule.
Tap Reschedule.
Select a new date and arrival window.
Tap Complete booking.
How to reschedule via email:
Open the booking confirmation or pro details email.
Tap Reschedule.
Under the date and time section, select Reschedule.
Select a new date and arrival window.
Tap Reschedule project.
Review the details and tap Complete booking.
Customer receives a booking reschedule confirmation email with the new installation time, letting them know Thumbtack is matching them with a pro and will send their details at least 24 hours before the job start time
Cancellations or refunds 

Customers must call Lowe's at (888) 516-1010 to cancel or request a refund. If the customer cancels within 24 hours of the job, Thumbtack credits the pro $15. Thumbtack doesn’t charge the customers a cancellation fee.
Pro cancels or doesn't show up
Pro cancels before the arrival window: If the pro cancels before the appointment window, the customer can reschedule in product.
Pro cancels or doesn't show up during the arrival window: If the pro cancels or doesn't arrive during the appointment window, rescheduling is locked in-product. The customer should call Thumbtack Support at (628) 266-0562 and the specialized team will work to get their installation back on track and connect them with a new pro.
Pro arrived late or didn't arrive: The customer's appointment is scheduled as a 3-hour arrival window — the pro can arrive any time within that window, not necessarily at the start time.
If the customer is still within their window, they should reach out to the pro through the Thumbtack messenger to check their status or confirm their ETA.
If the window has passed and the pro hasn't arrived or responded, the customer should call Thumbtack Support at (628) 266-0562.

Background check requirements
Lowe's requires a passed background check for every individual who appears on-site for an installation.
Account owners can complete a background check on Thumbtack for free
Pros are responsible for screening their own employees and contractors via third-party providers (e.g. Checkr, GoodHire)
Thumbtack is not responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable laws and regulations regarding background checks completed on team members
Background check process by job stage
At claim: When claiming a job, the pro checks a box confirming: "I confirm that all team members included in this job will have background checks completed before the job begins."
Before the job: After claiming, the pro must add background check details and confirm which team members will be on-site for that specific job. This is required before payment can be processed. Each confirmed team member receives a confirmation email 12 hours before the job starts — they should have this available on-site if asked. Customers are instructed to verify the technician's identity against their BGC details.
After the job: When marking the job as done, if the pro has not already confirmed their on-site team, they will be prompted to do so before the job can be marked as complete.
Details needed to add team member 
Pros can add team members at any time from their profile, or during the claim flow when prompted. When adding a new team member, the pro provides:
 
Legal name (exactly as it appears on a government-issued ID)
Background check provider (e.g. Checkr, GoodHire)
Completion date of background check
Role on team (Owner, Manager, Employee, Contractor, Other)
Team member email address — a confirmation email is sent to this address before the job as proof of BGC
A clear headshot — full face visible, well lit, not covered by hats or sunglasses
The pro reviews and saves the record. By saving, the pro confirms the information is accurate and complete. Thumbtack is not responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable laws and regulations regarding background checks completed on team members.

Checks the box next to each team member who will be on-site for that specific job
Tap Add another team member if a new background check profile is needed. 
Taps Confirm team members for this job.

Payout and earnings 
Payout overview
Most Lowe's installation jobs pay between $50–$500 per installation, depending on scope
There are no lead fees for claiming Lowe's jobs
To receive payment, pros must have direct deposit set up on their Thumbtack account. Pros can set this up at thumbtack.com/profile/earnings

How job pricing is determined
Pricing for Lowe's jobs is set by Lowe's based on the type of service and the pro's specific market. While Thumbtack makes these jobs available to eligible pros, the rates reflect Lowe's installation models rather than standard Thumbtack pricing. The payout is a fixed flat rate and cannot be adjusted in the product.
Marking the job as done and receiving payment
After completing the installation, the pro marks the job as done in the Thumbtack app. The job cannot be marked as done before the scheduled start time.
Single-item jobs: The pro taps "Job done" and is asked: "Did you finish the job?"
Yes → Prompted to add background check details (see below) → Earnings sent!
No → Dismisses the sheet and returns the pro to Thumbtack Messenger. The job status is not updated. The pro can return to mark the job as done once the installation is complete.
Multi-product jobs: The pro taps "Job done" and is asked: "Which installations did you complete?" and selects from the list.
All items selected → Prompted to add background check details  → Earnings sent!
Some items selected → Prompted to add background check details → Pro sees:
"We need a few more details. Since only some items were installed, we'll need a bit more information to process your payment. Please call Thumbtack support at (628) 266-0562."
Background check prompt — all jobs: 
Regardless of job type or completion status, after selecting their installations the pro is prompted to add background check details and confirm their on-site teams in order to get paid. Pros can't mark the job as done until this is complete.
The pro taps Add background check details which opens the in-app BGC flow.
The pro taps Next to complete the BGC submission.
Add-on fees and adjustments
If a pro discovers extra work or additional parts are needed once on-site, they must contact Lowe's Support at (888) 516-1010 before starting that work. Lowe's handles the additional payment with the customer directly. Once approved, the job total is updated in Thumbtack's system and the pro's payout is adjusted accordingly.
Payments for any work outside the original job scope that is unrelated to the installation must be handled independently between the pro and customer, outside the Thumbtack platform.
Cancellation & No-Show Rules
Pro late cancellation: The pro is charged a $15 fee if they cancel within 48 hours of the job start time. Charged to the default card on file.
Pro no-show: The pro is charged a $15 fee if they fail to arrive within the installation window. Charged to the default card on file. 
Rescheduling: Lowe's jobs cannot be rescheduled by the pro. If the date or time no longer works, the pro must call Thumbtack Support at (628) 266-0562 to cancel.
Customer no-show: If the customer is not present when the pro arrives, the pro should wait at least 15 minutes then call Thumbtack Support at (628) 266-0562. Thumbtack provides a $15 courtesy credit to the pro. The credit is added to the pro's Thumbtack balance.
Customer late cancellation or reschedule: If the customer cancels or reschedules within 24 hours of the job start time, the pro receives a $15 courtesy credit.

Verify credits: Pros can verify the $15.00 courtesy credit by visiting their Payments page and checking under "Credits and refunds." The credit will not indicate which customer the credit originated from

This section provides Support reps with approved language for common Lowe's partnership questions.

Customer talking points 

How the installation service works (Customer)


English talking point
Spanish talking point 
Q: How does Lowe's installations through Thumbtack work?
Q: ¿Cómo funcionan las instalaciones de Lowe’s a través de Thumbtack?
A: Lowe’s has teamed up with Thumbtack to provide professional installation for your home projects. You purchase the product and service together at Lowe’s, and Thumbtack matches you with a qualified, independent local pro to complete the work.
A: Lowe’s se ha asociado con Thumbtack para ofrecer instalaciones profesionales para sus proyectos del hogar. Usted compra el producto y el servicio juntos en Lowe’s, y Thumbtack le asigna un profesional local, independiente y calificado para completar el trabajo.
Q: What happens after I buy a Lowe’s product with installation? 
Q: ¿Qué sucede después de comprar un producto de Lowe’s con instalación?
A: After your Lowe’s purchase, you’ll receive a confirmation email from Lowe’s. Shortly after, Thumbtack will send you an email with a link to schedule your installation.  From there, you'll choose a date and a 3-hour arrival window that works for you. Once you complete the booking, we'll start matching you with a qualified pro and will send you their details at least 24 hours before your appointment. Once a pro is confirmed, you can message them directly from the email or through your Thumbtack account.
A: Después de su compra en Lowe’s, recibirá un correo electrónico de confirmación de parte de Lowe’s. Poco después, Thumbtack le enviará un correo electrónico con un enlace para programar su instalación. Desde allí, elegirá una fecha y un horario de llegada de 3 horas que le convenga. Una vez que complete la reserva, comenzaremos a buscarle un profesional calificado y le enviaremos sus detalles al menos 24 horas antes de su cita. Una vez que se confirme un profesional, puede enviarle un mensaje directamente desde el correo electrónico o a través de su cuenta de Thumbtack.
Q: Why does my installation date depend on product delivery? 
Q: ¿Por qué mi fecha de instalación depende de la entrega del producto?
A: To ensure a smooth experience, your installation is scheduled at least 72 hours after your order is placed and at least one day after your product’s estimated arrival. This ensures the items are on-site and ready for the pro when they arrive.
A: Para garantizar que todo salga bien, su instalación se programa al menos 72 horas después de realizar su pedido y por lo menos un día después de la fecha estimada de entrega de su producto. Esto asegura que los artículos estén en el lugar y listos para el profesional cuando llegue.
Q: What makes a Lowe’s approved pro? 
Q: ¿Qué hace que un profesional sea aprobado por Lowe’s?
A: We hold our pros to a high standard to ensure a quality experience. Every pro matches with a Lowe’s job must meet these requirements: 

Verified local licensing: In areas where it’s legally required for plumbing and electrical work, we verify the pro’s license is active and in good stand. 
Screening: All pros and their on-site technicians must pass a background check. 
Proven quality: We only select pros who maintain high performance ratings and positive reviews on Thumbtack. 
A: Exigimos estándares altos a nuestros profesionales

1. Overview
▶ KA Summary
This internal Knowledge Article (KA) for frontline reps details pro license credentials, including which licenses Thumbtack verifies and state-specific requirements (e.g., CA/FL General Contracting, FL Attorney Bar Numbers). It outlines processes for pros to manage licenses and for reps to help with verification, renewals, and troubleshooting. It also covers a shipped update that makes license visibility more prominent for pros with verified licenses in some categories. The article also provides talking points for various pro inquiries and relevant resources.
Pros can highlight their professional or occupational licenses* on their Thumbtack profile. Adding a license is an opportunity for pros to showcase and differentiate themselves with their training and credentials. In some categories, customers may see a “Licensed” pill on the pro’s profile and in search results when their license is verified.
▶ At this time, Thumbtack only verifies the following professional licenses:
Accounting or tax professions
Architecture
**Attorney
Carpentry
Car towing
Concrete and foundation work
Drywall
Electrical work
Engineers
Financial professions
Flooring and carpet
**General contracting
Home improvement and home building
HVAC work
Insulation
Landscaping
Law
Masonry
Metalworking
Moving
Painting
Paving
Plumbing
Pool and spa
Roofing
Tiling
Licenses vary from state to state, so if it’s not listed in the drop-down menu (when they go to add it to their profile), Thumbtack can’t verify it — even if they’re in one of the categories above. The pro’s license must also be government-issued (or listed in a public database for verification).
Internal Information Only: Thumbtack uses the customer’s responses in the request form to determine how risky a job may be. For certain answer combinations, we will only route to pros who have uploaded and verified their license. See the internal New risk assessment request form questions doc
* NOTE: A business license is NOT the same thing as an occupational license. 
A business license generally just means the pro is registered to do business in a city or state. It doesn’t authorize the pro to do any specific kind of project. 
An occupational license is what authorizes a pro to do certain kinds of work—for instance, as a plumber or an electrician. Thumbtack’s policy allows only occupational licenses to qualify for a license badge.
**Licenses required on Thumbtack: General contracting licenses are required for pros in California and Florida. Additionally, all attorneys in Florida must verify their bar number.
Updates and experiments
Licenses required on Thumbtack
Both the laws in the pros city and state and the type of project the customer is hiring them for will determine if a license (or permit) is required. Sometimes, there may also be federal licensing requirements.
Depending on the pro's location and service, they may be required to add a license to their Thumbtack profile prior to receiving leads or sending quotes. Pros will know via a pop-up in their account
Before Thumbtack shows certain pros in specific states in search results, Thumbtack requires them to upload a license. Pros required to upload a license are:

General contracting license | California + Florida
This section outlines the specific general contracting license requirements for pros working in California and Florida.

Thumbtack requires pros in California and Florida to upload an approved general contracting license for verification before getting these types of jobs on Thumbtack.

Do’s and don’ts for Support reps helping these pros 
Don't say Thumbtack didn't previously require licenses for contractors, or that we're just starting to require licenses now.
Don't say Thumbtack will be making this change in all states. Not all markets have statewide regulations so we may not create this restriction there. Pros can research their state license regulations to find out if this will apply to them.
Don't say Thumbtack will respond to all requests or emails to consider a license type as an "acceptable license type
▶ Ways to say it: If a pro asks why an uploaded license is only required for general contracting jobs in CA/FL
General Contracting jobs are some of the largest and most complex projects requested and completed on Thumbtack. We're asking pros to upload a license before they're displayed in search results to help create confidence in hiring for customers.
[California/Florida] is a starting point for learning and improving on this customer experience, and Thumbtack will soon extend this change to additional markets where state licensing is required.
Steps: How to handle license verification failures or unaccepted General Contractor License Types (Rep)  

If the pro has the right license, Thumbtack  should be able to find them in the state database by the California Contractors State License Board.

If the first verification fails, OR the pro doesn’t have one of the accepted license types (listed above), reps will follow these steps: 

Tell the pro to fill out the ID Help Intake Form. This should not be sent to any other support channels. 
Let the pro know they can expect a response within 2 - 3 business days.
NOTE: If the rep is working on an email case,  use the email template “Ask pro to send info to ID Help.”

Rep can reference the internal ID Help Reference Guide KA for more details. 

Attorneys Bar Number | Florida
This section details the specific requirements for attorneys in Florida to verify their bar number to use Thumbtack.
License regulations vary from state to state. In 2018, Florida updated their licensing requirements for attorneys. To improve safety on our site and keep up with this change, we adjusted our license verification requirements.
Thumbtack requires all attorneys in Florida to verify their bar number. If a pro doesn’t verify their bar number, they’ll be blocked from getting any attorney services jobs in Florida. Once they upload that information, they’ll be able to get Florida attorney jobs on Thumbtack.

Do’s and don’ts for the Support rep when helping these pros 
Don’t give any legal advice.
Do escalate abusive pros to the Trust and Safety Escalation team. (tag @escalations in #ts-incident-ops-questions if needed). For escalation steps, refer to the internal Trust and Safety Incidents KA. 

How to look up a pro's credentials 
This section provides information on how to verify a pro's license and where customers can find license information on Thumbtack.
Customers can easily spot pros with verified licenses by looking for the purple Licensed pill in search results or on their Thumbtack profile. This means Thumbtack used a public database to verify the license number they provided.
Additionally, customers can use external online resources and contact state or local governments about specific licensing questions. Customers can find links to state government websites for licensing information in Thumbtack’s Your Safety guide. Reps can refer to the internal Home Care and Routine Maintenance Resources (Customer) KA for more information on available resources to customers. 
Pro Profile Credential Display
The pro's profile features a prominent Credentials section that displays verified information.
Pro profile: Customers can look at the pro's profile to see if they have a license pill, which appears at the top of the profile. A pro with a license pill means Thumbtack used a public database to verify the license number they provided. For specific license details, customers should look under the Credentials section of the profile. Here, they will find the license information marked as “License verified,” which includes the license type and license number. Customers can click “See more details”  to view the full information, like the license holder, type, state, number, and the dates it was verified and is valid through. Additionally, any completed background check information will also be clearly displayed in the Credentials section.
▶ What the credential details on a pro's profile look like:

[Image: rtaImage]

Image Description: Pro profiles display license details, background check status. Access by clicking 'Credentials' on the pro's profile.
▶ What the Licensed badge looks like at the top of the pro’s profile

[Image: rtaImage]

Search Results Pro List
Customers can easily spot pros with verified licenses because they will have the purple Licensed pill on the pro list in search results.
▶ What the licensed pill on a pro list looks like

[Image: rtaImage]

Image description: Search results list showing the purple “Licensed” pill in the pro card. 
Important Note on Business Name Changes: If a pro with a verified license changes their business name via the ID Help form, their existing license credentials (profile badges) will be removed upon approval of the name change. The pro will then need to resubmit their license under the new business name to regain these credentials. For a complete list of required documentation, reps can refer to the internal ID Help Guide KA.
Key points
Support reps should keep the following in mind when helping pros with licensing questions or concerns: 
The license verification process itself typically takes 1 - 2 business days, but the overall process can take an additional 2 - 3 business days if there are ID Help issues.
The pro’s license must be government-issued (or listed in a public database for verification)
Thumbtack requires pros to operate within their local laws and regulations, or the services they are performing.
Pros are responsible for managing their licenses.
Pros aren’t required* to upload their licenses, and customers should be verifying licenses on their own. In some categories, customers may also see a “Licensed” pill when a pro’s license is verified.
*Unless they are a general contracting pro in California or Florida, or an attorney in Florida. To receive leads or send quotes, these pros must upload their license.
A maximum of two licenses will be displayed on a pros profile. If the pro has more than two, we recommend they upload the two most relevant to their services. Pros can mention the other licenses in their business introduction or in messages to customers.
Pros who don't see their license type in the drop-down can share their license information on their profile in their photos, introduction, or FAQ's.
License credentials (profile badges) are removed if a pro with a verified license changes their business name. They must resubmit their license under the new business name to regain credentials.

2. Process
(Pro) Steps: How to add a license
At this time, Thumbtack only verifies government-issued licenses.
To verify a pro's license, the license name and business name on their license must match the information they use on Thumbtack. (If they are authorized to use another license, see (Pro) Steps: How to add an authorized license user.) 
Pro Steps:  To upload and have their license verified, pros will follow the steps on How to manage my license article. Pros will get an email with the results of their license verification request. If their license is verified, a license badge will be added to their profile within 24 hours. 
NOTE: Pros should not submit their license for verification multiple times. This may result in processing delays. Also, database maintenance may delay results in some cases.
(Pro) Steps: How to add an authorized license user
More and more businesses with employees are joining Thumbtack. In some cases, employees sign up for their own account and display their employer's license as their own credential. This is legal, and we want to give these pros an opportunity to display this credential.
If a pro contacts Thumbtack to let us know they’re working under someone else’s license, or they are an employee authorized to use a business license, follow the steps below. 
Using this talking point, reps can explain to the pro that: 
"If the name or business name you listed on Thumbtack doesn’t match what’s on your license or you’re authorized to work under someone else’s license, fill out this form to update your Thumbtack account details. Keep in mind, your license will take longer to process since we’ll need additional documents. We’ll follow up with you within 2 - 3 business days."
Tell them to fill out the ID Help Intake Form with the license holders:
Name
Phone number
Email address, and;
An explanation for submitting this request
Let the pro know we’ll reach out to the license holder to verify the information they provide, and that the pro can expect a response from Thumbtack within 2 - 3 business days.
▶ Reps can also use the following email template:

Subject line: 
Steps to verify a license your authorized to work under
Email body: 
Hi {{{Case.ContactFirstName__c}}},

My name is {{{Sender.FirstName}}} with Thumbtack Support. I understand you would like to add a license to your Thumbtack account that has a different name on the license than what's on your Thumbtack account. 

If you're authorized to work under someone else’s license, fill out this form so we can review further. We’ll reach out to the license holder to verify the information provided on the above form. We may follow up with you via email if we need more information.

Keep in mind, your license will take longer to process since we’ll need additional documents. We’ll follow up with you within 3 to 5 business days.

Just remember, we only verify state-issued licenses at this time and must be searchable on the state licensing board’s public databases (which is what allows us to verify your information).

If you’re curious which professional licenses we do verify, you can find a list in our help center article about managing licenses.

{{{Sender.FirstName}}}
The Thumbtack Support Team
To learn more about the ID Help process, reps can refer to the internal ID Help Guide (Pro) (Customer) KA
How Trust and Safety handles authorized license user situations
Once the T&S team reviews the information, two things will happen:
The T&S team will follow up with the pro via email if more information is needed or their request is declined.
If the license holder approves the usage of their license, Thumbtack will send both parties a DocuSign.
If a pro has provided the correct documentation to verify that they are properly operating under a valid license, Thumbtack may list the associate's license as "verified" on the pro's profile.
(Pro) Steps: How to update a license for license renewal or expiration 
Two months before a license expires, Thumbtack notifies the professional by email and prompts the pro to update or renew their license. Unless the expired license is renewed, the license badge will be removed from their profile.
View your Profile (if you have more than one business on Thumbtack, select the one you’d like to update).
Scroll down to the Credentials section and click Edit.
Click Add another license.
In the next window, re-enter the state, type, and number of your updated license.
Click Submit.
(Rep) Steps: How to help a pro with questions about license renewals or expirations
If a pro calls in unsure what to do about their license, follow these steps:
Check Admin to see if the pro already entered (or re-entered) their license to their profile. Any licenses that the pro has submitted for verification will be under the “Licenses” section of the Businesses page.
If the pro has NOT entered their license information, follow the “(Pro) Steps: How to update a license for renewals or expirations“ to walk them through the process.
If the pro already entered their license information, the verification request is in queue. Inform the pro that the license verification process typically takes 1 - 2 business days.
If there’s a mistake in the license and it's not supposed to be expired, or there are other license problems not relating to reinstating an expired license, have the pro fill out the ID Help Intake Form with:
a link to the license or verification website, 
their full name, 
the email address that's on their Thumbtack account, 
a description of the issue, 
and a photocopy of a government official ID.
Let the pro know they can expect a response within 2 - 3  business days.
To learn more about the ID Help process, reps can refer to the internal ID Help Guide KA

(Rep) Steps: How to identify a pro with a missing required license in Salesforce (required and recommended)

​​This section outlines the steps for frontline reps to identify and address instances where pros on Thumbtack have either a missing required license or a missing recommended license,  as indicated in Salesforce.

Reps can see if a pro is missing a required or recommended license on the pro’s contact in Salesforce.

Missing Required License: "License Required" 

▶ On a pro’s contact in Salesforce, reps may see a “License Required” banner highlighting that a required license is missing. (Expand for image)

[Image: rtaImage]


The "License Required" banner in Salesforce indicates that for certain types of service categories, a license is mandatory to use Thumbtack (refer to the "Licenses required on Thumbtack" section of this article for more details). This is in place to ensure pros operate within local laws and regulations and to build customer confidence.

If a rep sees a “License Required” banner in Salesforce, they should: 

Identify which type of license is required and inform the pro.
Use the following talking points, depending on the type of license required:
General contracting talking points 
Attorney bar number talking points


Missing Recommended License: “License Strongly Recommended” 
▶ On a pro’s contact in Salesforce, reps may see a “License Strongly Recommended” banner highlighting that a recommended license is missing. This means that the license isn’t required to use Thumbtack, but it’s strongly recommended. (expand for image)

[Image: rtaImage]

If a rep sees the “License Strongly Recommended” banner, they should:
Investigate the pro’s service type and recommend the pro add a license. 
The banner is based on the pro’s “Assigned Category” or “Most Quoted Category” on the Salesforce Contact. Reps should share the role licenses play in staying competitive on Thumbtack.
▶ Talking point:We recommend adding a license for your [category type] service. Customers like to see licenses when hiring pros for this type of work. It helps you build instant trust with the customer, and can give you the competitive edge you need to win the lead.
(Rep) Steps: How to help pro with license showing on profile or unable to verify
If the pro submitted their license, waited at least two business days (plus an additional five business days if they needed to also submit the ID Help form), and the license has not yet been verified, it may be because Thumbtack is unable to verify it. Support reps will follow these steps:  
Ask the pro to email us at support@thumbtack.com with a link to the public listing of their license.
If the pro's license does not appear in the drop-down menu when they try to add it, the pro should not email us because we won't be able to verify the license. In this situation, support reps will follow these steps: 
You can let the pro know we're working on improving the license verification process and have them check back at a later date.
Or send email template: “Why isn’t my license listed?” 
▶ Or copy this email template:
Subject line: We weren't able to verify your business license
Email body: Hi {{{Case.ContactFirstName__c}}},My name is {{{Sender.FirstName}}} with Thumbtack Support. We weren't able to verify your business license.Building trust with customers is a big factor in getting hired. So we encourage you to let customers know about your business license in other ways. A few ideas:
Take a photo of your business license and display it in the media section of your profile.
Mention it in other sections of your profile (like the introduction or frequently asked questions). 
If you’re curious which professional licenses we do verify, you can find a list in our help center article about managing licenses.{{{Sender.FirstName}}}The Thumbtack Support Team
Reminder: Pros who don't see their license type in the drop-down can share their license information on their profile in their photos, introduction, or FAQ's.
(Rep) Steps: How to handle reports of a pro not properly licensed


Thumbtack requires pros to operate within their local laws and regulations or the services they are performing. Pros are responsible for managing their licenses. Pros aren’t required* to upload their licenses and customers should be verifying licenses on their own.
If contacted by a user who’s reporting that a  pro is not properly licensed, the support rep will follow these steps: 
Explain to the reporting user that we’ll reach out to the pro to inform them of our licensing policies.
For email cases, send them the email template “Licensing: Response to Missing/Invalid License Report”
▶ Or copy this email template:
Subject line: Business license report follow up 
Email body: Hi {{{Case.ContactFirstName__c}}},My name is {{{Sender.FirstName}}} with Thumbtack Support. Thanks for making us aware of your concerns with [PRO'S NAME/BUSINESS NAMEnot being properly licensed.  We expect every business on Thumbtack to be qualified for the projects they quote on, and to abide by our Terms of Use and the licensing laws in their area.Based on your report, we'll reach out to [PRO'S NAME/BUSINESS NAME] to resolve any potential issues.We want you to succeed, so check out Thumbtack Help for more resources to grow your business.{{{Sender.FirstName}}}The Thumbtack Support Team
If the customer wants your opinion on whether they should hire the pro, remind them that this is their decision but that they can continue looking for pros if they feel uncomfortable with the pro’s license status.
Reps can refer to the internal Home Care and Routine Maintenance Resources (Customer) KA for more info and resources on helping customers navigate licensing. 
Email the pro the “Licensing: Request to Update License Info” email template.
▶ Or copy this email template:
Subject line: Action requested regarding your business license on your Thumbtack profile 
Email body: Hi {{{Case.ContactFirstName__c}}},My name is {{{Sender.FirstName}}} with Thumbtack Support.  We received a report regarding your licensing for [PRO'S SERVICE TYPE]. As we state in our Terms of Use, pros on Thumbtack must be properly and fully qualified and experienced, and licensed, certified, bonded, and insured, as required by applicable laws or regulationsWe recommend you upload any professional licenses to your Thumbtack profile. This is an excellent way to share your experience and credentials with customers and increase your chances of getting hired.Steps for how to add a license to your profile can be found in our help center article explaining how to add a license.Currently our system is only able to verify state-issued licenses. If you don’t see your license type listed, we won’t be able to verify it. But you can still add your license information to another place on your profile.We want you to succeed, so check out Thumbtack Help for more resources to grow your business.{{{Sender.FirstName}}}The Thumbtack Support Team
If the pro replies that they aren’t licensed or don’t want to add their license, remind them that they agree in our Terms of Use to abide by licensing laws, so can check local licensing laws for more information.
At this point, you’ve completed the process and can close the case.
*Unless they are a general contracting pro in California or Florida, or an attorney in Florida. To receive leads or send quotes, these pros must upload their license. 

3. Talking points
Pro has more than one license 
This section provides frontline reps with talking points to address common questions from pros who have multiple licenses.

English FAQ
Spanish FAQ
What if I have more than one license?
¿Qué pasa si tengo más de una licencia?
A maximum of two licenses will be displayed on your profile, so we recommend uploading the two most relevant to your services. However, you can mention the other licenses in your business introduction or in your messages to customers.
En su perfil se mostrarán un máximo de dos licencias, por lo que le recomendamos que cargue las dos más relevantes para sus servicios. Sin embargo, puede mencionar las otras licencias en la introducción de su negocio o en sus mensajes a los clientes.
License verification concerns
This section provides frontline reps with talking points to answer frequently asked questions regarding Thumbtack's license verification process and why not all licenses are verified.

English FAQ
Spanish FAQ
Why don’t you verify all pro licenses?
¿Por qué no verifica todas las licencias profesionales?
Because professional licenses vary from state to state and from occupation to occupation, it’s hard to consistently verify every license or certification a pro may have. Until we’re better able to confirm the majority of pro licenses, we decided to take a step back. We hope to develop a better process for more licenses in the future.
We recognize that being licensed in your field shows customers you’re skilled and experienced, so we hope you’re able to let customers know about your license in other ways (like adding a photo of your certificate to your profile).
Debido a que las licencias profesionales varían de un estado a otro y de una ocupación a otra, es difícil verificar constantemente cada licencia o certificación que pueda tener un profesional. Hasta que podamos confirmar mejor la mayoría de las licencias profesionales, decidimos tomar una breve pausa. Esperamos desarrollar un mejor proceso para más licencias en el futuro.
Reconocemos que tener una licencia en su campo les demuestra a los clientes que es hábil y experimentado, por lo que esperamos que pueda informar a los clientes sobre su licencia de otras formas (como agregar una foto de su certificado a su perfil).
Why isn’t my license an option in the drop-down menu?
¿Por qué mi licencia no es una opción en el menú desplegable?
That means your license is not a type we’re currently able to verify. Instead, I recommend adding your license information to another place on your profile.
Reminder to support reps: Don’t direct pros to idHelp if their license type isn’t included in the drop-down menu. Submit their feedback (see Product Feedback KA for steps). 
Eso significa que su licencia no es un tipo que podamos verificar actualmente. A cambio, le recomiendo agregar la información de su licencia en otro lugar de su perfil.
What should I do if my profession doesn't require a license?
¿Qué debo hacer si mi profesión no requiere una licencia?
Certain professions don't have or require specific licenses or certifications. You can showcase your talents and skills with detailed descriptions about your business, and through photos and videos in the media section of your profile.

Algunas profesiones no tienen ni requieren licencias o certificaciones específicas. Puede mostrar sus talentos y habilidades con descripciones detalladas sobre su negocio y mediante fotos y videos en la sección de medios bajo su perfil.
Reps can refer to the internal ID Help Guide KA to learn more
Authorized license user 
This section provides frontline reps with talking points to clarify the process for pros who are working under someone else's license or are authorized to use a business license.

English FAQ
Spanish FAQ
What if my name or business name on Thumbtack doesn’t match my license?
¿Qué pasa si mi nombre o el nombre de mi negocio en Thumbtack no coincide con mi licencia?
If the name or business name you listed on Thumbtack doesn’t match what’s on your license or you’re authorized to work under someone else’s license, fill out this form to update your Thumbtack account details.

Keep in mind, your license will take longer to process since we’ll need additional documents. We’ll follow up with you within 2 - 3 business days.
Si el nombre o nombre de negocio que aparece en Thumbtack no coincide con el de su licencia o está autorizado a trabajar bajo la licencia de otra persona, complete este formulario para actualizar los detalles de su cuenta en Thumbtack.

Tenga en cuenta que su licencia tardará más tiempo en procesarse ya que necesitaremos documentos adicionales. Nos pondremos en contacto con usted dentro de 2 a 3 días hábiles.
Reps can refer to the internal ID Help Guide KA to learn more
Business licenses 
This section provides frontline reps with talking points to explain why business licenses are not displayed on Thumbtack profiles and to differentiate them from occupational licenses.

English FAQ
Spanish FAQ
Why don’t you show my business license on my Thumbtack profile?
¿Por qué no muestra mi licencia comercial en mi perfil de Thumbtack?
Business licenses typically only require payment of a fee, while professional and occupational licenses must be earned with special skills or experience. Certain types of work require or recommend specific occupational licenses, and we want to make it easy for customers to tell whether a pro has one of these licenses without confusing them with a business license.
Las licencias comerciales generalmente sólo requieren el pago de una tarifa, mientras que las licencias profesionales y ocupacionales deben obtenerse con habilidades o experiencia especiales. Ciertos tipos de trabajo requieren o recomiendan licencias ocupacionales específicas, y queremos que sea fácil para los clientes saber si un profesional tiene una de estas licencias sin confundirlo con una licencia comercial.
Why can’t I see my business license on my profile?
¿Por qué no puedo ver mi licencia de negocio en mi perfil?
We don’t list business licenses on profiles because they don’t indicate specific skills or knowledge. However, we do share how long you’ve been in business to help customers get a better sense of your experience.

No enumeramos las licencias comerciales en los perfiles porque no indican conocimientos o habilidades específicas. Sin embargo, sí compartimos cuánto tiempo lleva en el negocio para ayudar a los clientes a tener una mejor idea de su experiencia.
Verification failed
This section provides frontline reps with talking points to guide pros whose license verification has failed and to outline the next steps.

English FAQ
Spanish FAQ
Why weren’t you able to verify my license?
¿Por qué no pudiste verificar mi licencia?
It looks like our license team wasn’t able to verify your license with the information you provided. Sometimes this happens if they weren’t able to find a public database or website to verify your information against, or if the name or business name on the license doesn’t match the name on your Thumbtack account.

I want to make sure we're able to add your license information to your profile. The easiest way to do this is on our Help Center at ID Help Intake Form.
Parece que nuestro equipo de licencias no pudo verificar su licencia con la información que proporcionó. A veces, esto sucede si no pudieron encontrar una base de datos pública o un sitio web para verificar su información, o si su nombre o el de la empresa en la licencia no coincide con el nombre de su cuenta en Thumbtack.
Reconocemos que tener una licencia en su campo les demuestra a los clientes que es hábil y experimentado, por lo que esperamos que pueda informar a los clientes sobre su licencia de otras formas (como agregar una foto de su certificado a su perfil).
Reps can refer to the internal ID Help Guide KA to learn more
Expired license 
This section provides frontline reps with talking points to explain what happens when a pro's license expires and the process for renewal.

English FAQ
Spanish FAQ
What happens when my license expires?
¿Qué sucede cuando vence mi licencia?
We’ll send you an email reminder when your license is about to expire. When your license expires, your license will be deleted from your profile on the expiration date, and we will attempt to re-verify it once. If we can re-verify it, then we’ll add your license to your profile again with the updated verification date.

If your license doesn’t have an expiration date, we’ll email you every two years to renew your license information. You can renew your license information by following the steps above.
Le enviaremos un correo electrónico de recordatorio cuando su licencia esté a punto de vencer. Cuando su licencia venza, su licencia se eliminará de su perfil en la fecha de vencimiento e intentaremos volver a verificarla una vez. Si podemos volver a verificarlo, volveremos a agregar su licencia a su perfil con la fecha de verificación actualizada.

Si su licencia no tiene fecha de vencimiento, le enviaremos un correo electrónico cada dos años para renovar la información de su licencia. Puede renovar la información de su licencia siguiendo los pasos anteriores.
General contracting license required 
This section provides frontline reps with talking points to address questions about the requirement for general contracting licenses in specific states.

English Talking Point
Spanish Talking Point
Why is Thumbtack requiring us to upload general contracting licenses now? 
¿Por qué ahora Thumbtack nos exige que descarguemos licencias de contratación general? 
Thumbtack has long since required pros to have all licenses required for the work they do. To improve the customer experience and confidence in hiring on Thumbtack for large, complex, or expensive projects, we’ll display license credentials more clearly to customers. 
 This will also improve the pro experience. You worked hard for your license, and we believe you deserve to have that hard work recognized by Thumbtack customers.
Hace tiempo que Thumbtack requiere que los profesionales tengan todas las licencias necesarias para el trabajo que realizan. Para mejorar la experiencia del cliente y la confianza al contratar en Thumbtack para proyectos grandes, complejos o costosos, mostraremos las credenciales de licencia con mayor claridad a los clientes. 
 Esto también mejorará la experiencia profesional. Trabajó duro para obtener su licencia y creemos que se merece que los clientes de Thumbtack reconozcan ese esfuerzo.
Why is an uploaded license upload only required for general contracting jobs in [California/Florida?] 
¿Por qué solo se requiere la descarga de una licencia para trabajos de contratación general en [California / Florida?] 
General Contracting jobs are some of the largest and most complex projects requested and completed on Thumbtack. We're asking pros to upload a license before they're displayed in search results to help create confidence in hiring for customers.
[California/Florida] is a starting point for learning and improving on this customer experience, and Thumbtack will soon extend this change to additional markets where state licensing is required.
Los trabajos de contratación general son algunos de los proyectos más grandes y complejos solicitados y completados en Thumbtack. Pedimos a los profesionales que descarguen una licencia antes de que se muestren en los resultados de búsqueda para ayudar a generar confianza entre los clientes al contratar a un profesional. 

[California/Florida] es un punto de partida para aprender y mejorar esta experiencia del cliente, y Thumbtack pronto extenderá este cambio a mercados adicionales donde se requiere licencia estatal.
Why are some general contracting jobs in California or Florida not required to have licenses? 
¿Por qué algunos trabajos de contratación general en California o Florida no requieren tener licencias?
While most jobs in General Contracting categories will require licenses, there are some categories that cover a wide range of project scopes. For these categories, we’ve lifted license requirements for the smallest jobs that are generally scoped to superficial or minor changes. This gives customers a wider selection of pros to work with, and it allows pros capable of completing smaller jobs to meet these customers.
Si bien la mayoría de los trabajos en las categorías de Contratación General requerirán licencias, hay algunas categorías que cubren una amplia gama de alcances de proyectos. Para estas categorías, hemos eliminado los requisitos de licencia para los trabajos más pequeños que generalmente están sujetos a cambios superficiales o menores. Esto brinda a los clientes una selección más amplia de profesionales con los que pueden trabajar, y permite a los profesionales capaces de realizar trabajos más pequeños cumplir con estos clientes.
I'm not located in [California/Florida], but I work on general contracting jobs in that state. Do I still need to upload a license?
No estoy ubicado en [California / Florida], pero realizo trabajos de contratación general en ese estado. ¿Todavía necesito descargar una licencia?
For General Contracting jobs originating in [California/Florida], yes. Regardless of your location, an approved license type needs to be uploaded and verified before quoting on California General Contracting jobs. 

[Backup answer] This is already required by state law, and the Thumbtack Terms of Use you agreed to when you signed up.
Para trabajos de contratación general que se originan en [California/Florida] , sí. Independientemente de su ubicación, se debe descargar y verificar el tipo de licencia aprobada antes de cotizar trabajos de Contratación General en California. 

[Respuesta alternativa] Esto ya lo exige la ley estatal y los Términos de Uso de Thumbtack que aceptó cuando se inscribió.
Why are these the only Florida general contracting license types accepted?
¿Por qué solo aceptan estos tipos de licencias de contratación general de Florida? 
These license classifications are broad enough to handle the wide variety of general contracting jobs on Thumbtack. Other Florida Contracting license types were too specific to cover this wide variety of jobs types.
Estas clasificaciones de licencias son lo suficientemente amplias como para manejar la amplia variedad de trabajos de contratación general en Thumbtack. Otros tipos de licencias de contratación de Florida eran demasiado específicas para cubrir esta amplia variedad de tipos de trabajos.
Why are these the only California general contracting license types accepted?
¿Por qué solo aceptan estos tipos de licencias de contratación general de California? 
Only these license classifications will be accepted because they’re either broad enough to handle the wide variety of jobs from General Contracting categories on Thumbtack, or are applicable to a specific set of General Contracting categories.
Solo se aceptarán estas clasificaciones de licencia porque son lo suficientemente amplias para manejar la amplia variedad de trabajos de las categorías de Contratación General en Thumbtack, o son aplicables a un conjunto específico de categorías de Contratación General.
What happens if I don't add my license? 
¿Qué pasa si no agrego mi licencia? 
If you don't upload an approved license, you won't see General Contracting jobs subject to license requirements. Once an approved license type is uploaded and verified, you can start getting these jobs again.
Si no descarga una licencia aprobada, no verá los trabajos de Contratación general sujetos a los requisitos de licencia. Una vez que se descarga y se verifica el tipo de licencia aprobada, puede comenzar a recibir estos trabajos nuevamente.
Attorney bar number | Florida 
This section provides frontline reps with talking points to address questions about the requirement for attorney bar numbers in Florida.

English FAQ
Spanish FAQ
What updated Florida rule requires a bar number for attorneys?
¿Qué regla actualizada de Florida requiere un número de barra para los abogados?
The rule is 4-7.22, the “Qualifying Provider” rule.
La regla es 4-7.22, la regla de "Proveedor Calificado".
Can I upload a bar form a different state other than Florida?
¿Puedo descargar una barra de otro estado que no sea Florida?
You’re welcome to add as many bar numbers as you have — including the patent bar — but you cannot quote on attorney services in Florida without a Florida state bar number.
Puede agregar tantos números de barra como tenga, incluida la barra de patentes, pero no puede cotizar servicios de abogados en Florida sin un número de barra del estado de Florida.
If I've been using Thumbtack without adding a Florida bar number since the rule change, am I going to get in legal trouble?
Si he estado usando Thumbtack sin agregar un número de barra de Florida desde el cambio de regla, ¿me voy a meter en problemas legales?
It’s up to the pros using our platform to make sure they follow the rules and regulations of their state. You can reach out to the Florida state bar to determine if you need to take any additional steps.
Unfortunately, we can’t provide legal advice.
Depende de los profesionales que utilizan nuestra plataforma asegurarse de seguir las reglas y regulaciones de su estado. Puede comunicarse con la barra de abogados del estado de Florida para determinar si necesita tomar medidas adicionales.
Lamentablemente, no podemos brindar asesoramiento legal.
If I've added my Florida bar number on Thumbtack, is there anything else I need to do?
Si agregué mi número de barra de Florida en Thumbtack, ¿hay algo más que deba hacer?
If you’ve added your bar number, there’s nothing else you need to do on Thumbtack, but we can’t give legal advice. I’d recommend reaching out to the Florida state bar to see if there’s anything else you need to do for your business.
Si agregó su número de barra, no hay nada más que deba hacer en Thumbtack, pero no podemos brindarle asesoramiento legal. Le recomiendo que se comunique con la barra de abogados del estado de Florida para ver si hay algo más que deba hacer por su negocio.

License Credential Incentive (Pro) (ENDED)

Contents

Overview

Resources
1. Overview
On December 15, 2025, Thumbtack launched a nationwide incentive to encourage eligible pros to credential their profile by uploading a valid license. Pros who completed the requirements received a $100 promotional credit to their Thumbtack balance. The promotional incentive ended on June 9, 2026. Pros were given an end date in all email comms and in app recommendation cards.
Incentive and eligibility details (ENDED June 9, 2026)
This section provides details about the $100 promotional credit and the incentive timeline.
Incentive Details
Amount: $100 promotional credit to the pros Thumbtack balance
Promo timeline: Started December 15, 2026 and ended on June 9, 2026. 
Credit issued timeline: The credit would have be issued within 7 business days after completing the requirements
Eligibility requirements for the $100 promotional credit
Pros must have met all the following requirements:
Be in the Plumbing, HVAC or Electrical categories.
Have a completed background check on their account.
Have a valid professional license uploaded and verified.*  (e.g., plumbing or electrical license).
* Internal Note on license verification process: 
The license must have been uploaded AND approved to qualify for the incentive.
All licenses were subject to a manual verification process to prevent fraud (e.g., pros uploading random documents).
Approximately 40% of licenses may have required additional verification because the pro's name on Thumbtack did not match the name/business name on the license.
A pro could typically expect to hear back within 3 business days regarding their license status (approved, needs additional steps, or rejected).
2. Process
Steps: How to confirm pro received their $100 incentive credit (Rep)
Pros did NOT receive an in-app or email notification when the credit was added to their account. Since the pro was not notified, they may not realize the credit was applied. The promotional credit is automatically used for charges for leads before their card on file is charged. If the pro has frequent leads, they may not have notice the credit.
To confirm the pro received their incentive credit, reps will follow these steps: 
In Admin, go to the pro’s credit log. 
Scroll down until you find a row with:
Transaction type: Promotional Credit (Admin grant)
Admin Reason: Promotional (Special Projects/Marketing) Note: $100 License Upload Incentive 
Amount: $100 

[Image: rtaImage]

To confirm the credit has been used (and what leads it was used on), reps will follow these steps: 
Navigate to the pro’s credit log in Admin
Find the row where the promotional credit was granted (the steps above). 
Then, look for the next row above this grant that has a "Payment [receipt link]" in the transaction type column. 
Reps can then click "Rebuild receipt" to see the receipt. This will show the leads that used the credit before they were charged again.
3. Resources
