1. Overview
▶ KA Summary
This internal knowledge article (KA) provides Frontline Reps with information about lead pricing on Thumbtack. It explains the transition to exact lead prices, where the price a pro sets is the exact amount they pay for a lead. This KA covers how pros manage their spending using lead prices and weekly budgets, how to use the competitiveness slider, and how to help pros who have questions about their lead costs.
Important note: Pros enrolled in smarter lead matching have lead price ranges. Refer to the Smarter lead matching (New deal for pros) (Pro) KA when helping these pros.
What lead pricing is on Thumbtack
Lead pricing is how Thumbtack charges pros for customer leads — when a customer reaches out to a pro to ask about a job. Each lead has a price, and pros pay that price when they receive the lead.
Pros set lead prices for each service they offer. These prices determine:
How much a pro will pay for a lead
How competitive the pro is compared to others in their market
How frequently they may receive leads
With exact lead prices, the price a pro sets is the exact amount they will pay for a lead. There is no longer an “up to” or maximum amount — the price shown is the price charged.
Note to reps: when speaking with pros:
Do say: “lead prices”
Do not say: “first price auction” or “FPA” (internal-only term)
What are Exact Lead Prices?
Exact lead prices is the lead pricing model used on Thumbtack where pros set the exact amount they are willing to pay for a lead, and that is the amount they are charged when they receive one.
This replaces the previous “max lead prices” experience, where pros set a maximum amount and the final price could vary based on competition and other factors.
With exact lead prices:
The price shown is the price paid
There is no “up to” language
Pros always know the cost of a lead before they receive it
For example,  if a pro sets a lead price of $15, they pay exactly $15 for that lead
Updates
Frontline Reps can use this section to track recent platform changes, timeline updates, and rollout phases for exact lead pricing on Thumbtack.  

Benefits of lead prices
When speaking with pros, especially skeptical ones, it’s important for frontline reps to anchor on control and clarity, not revenue.
▶ Transparency: Pros no longer have to guess what a lead might cost.
The price they set is the price they pay
No more “up to” pricing
No surprises after the lead comes in
Rep framing: “You always know exactly what you’ll pay before you get the lead.”
▶ Predictability: Exact prices make it easier for pros to plan their spending.
The price they set is the price they pay
No more “up to” pricing
No surprises after the lead comes in
Rep framing: “You always know exactly what you’ll pay before you get the lead.”
▶ Control: Pros decide what each lead is worth to their business.
Prices are set by the pro, not Thumbtack
Pros can raise or lower prices at any time
Lead prices can be adjusted per service
Rep framing: “You’re in full control of what you pay — if a lead isn’t worth that price, you can change it.”
▶ Flexibility across services: Pros don’t have to value every service the same way.
Higher prices for services they want more of
Lower prices for services they want less of
Different prices for different job sizes (where applicable)
This lets pros prioritize the work that best fits their goals, schedule, and profit margins.Rep framing: “You can spend more on the work that matters most to you, and less on the rest.”
Lead prices page: Price tables, performance metrics, and recommendations 
This section describes the layout and functionality of the lead prices page, including pricing tables and performance insights.
The lead prices page is where pros control their spending per lead. It is broken down by service and includes: 
How you’ll compare: This section shows a pro's current competitiveness level (e.g., "Most competitive," "Less competitive"). 
Estimated leads: This provides an estimate of how many leads the pro might receive per month based on their settings
Your lead prices: The table displays the exact amount the pro will pay for a lead in each service category (e.g., "$30" instead of "Up to $30.62"). 
Performance: Below the lead prices table, pros will see their performance metrics for the past 30 days, including:
Leads: The number of leads they've received.
Avg. price paid: The average amount they've paid per lead.
For more insights, pros can visit their performance dashboard. Reps can refer to the internal Performance Dashboard: Market Level Insights (Pro) KA.
Recommendations: On each service, pros will see personalized recommendations on how to get more leads based on their current quality score and lead prices. Pros may need to click the “How to get more customers” to see these recommendations.

[Image: rtaImage]


Lead price tables 
A pro’s lead prices page is the central place where they control how much they invest per lead. It's important to frame their cost as an investment tied to potential job value.
Not all leads are equal. The value of a lead can vary based on several factors, including:
The size or scope of the job
The type of service requested
The customer’s location
Local demand and competition
The likelihood that the lead will turn into a booked job or repeat customer
Thumbtack's pricing structure is set up so that the cost of a lead reflects the job's potential value; higher-value jobs generally cost more, and smaller or lower-scope jobs cost less. This alignment ensures lead prices are both fair and reasonable.
For some services, Thumbtack uses Answer-Based Pricing (ABP)*, which allows pros to set prices based on the job size. This allows pros to pay less for smaller jobs and more for larger or more valuable ones.
Ultimately, lead pricing helps pros decide:
Which jobs are worth pursuing
How to prioritize certain services over others
How much they are willing to invest to grow their business on Thumbtack
*Reminder to reps:  "Answer-Based Pricing" (ABP) is an internal term. When speaking with pros, frontline reps should refer to these as "lead prices" as usual.
▶ Lead price tables with answer based pricing
For services that have ABP,  the pro's pricing table is structured with different rows to account for specific job factors, such as the scope of a project (e.g., number of rooms for cleaning, square footage for pressure washing).
Pros adjust these prices across all job types using the competitiveness slider, which changes the prices for all displayed line items. Pros cannot set prices for each individual line item separately.
For pros who haven't selected certain job types, these will be visible but greyed out on the price tables, along with a clear "Add" option. This allows pros to easily add unselected job types directly from the lead price page. It also offers a better visual understanding of their current job preferences and highlights potential missed opportunities. Hovering over the ‘i’ icon will display the message: “These types of jobs are not part of your current settings. To appear in customer search results for these jobs, you can add them anytime.”
▶ What a lead pricing table for Architectural services looks like

[Image: rtaImage]

The image above shows a lead pricing table for Architectural services. Pricing varies based on the square footage of the project.
This specific example shows a yellow "less competitive" pill, and a blue banner with the message: "You're setting the lowest prices possible. These prices may adjust over time." This message reflects the system's dynamic minimum pricing. It also shows the "Add" button to add additional job types they aren’t currently targeting.
▶ What a lead pricing table for Outdoor Landscaping and Design looks like

[Image: rtaImage]

The image above shows a lead pricing table for Outdoor Landscaping and Design services.  Pricing varies based on the scope of the project (e.g., smaller versus larger landscape changes) For this specific example, the pro is shown as having an estimated 3 leads per month and is categorized as "More competitive" in the "How you’ll compare" column (indicated by the purple pill). It also shows the "Add" button to add additional job types they aren’t currently targeting.
▶ Lead price tables without answer based pricing
For services that do NOT have ABP,  the pro's pricing table will show one price for all leads within that category.
▶ What a lead pricing table looks like for TV Mounting

[Image: rtaImage]

This specific example shows a purple "More competitive" pill, and the pro can set an exact price for these jobs using the competitiveness slider. 
▶ What the lead prices table looks like for Wedding Officiant

[Image: rtaImage]
This specific example shows a blue "Competitive" pill, and the pro can set an exact price for these jobs using the competitiveness slider. 

Note: A pro's budget and competitiveness level remains the same after any price updates. Pros can adjust their competition level and lead prices at any time if they prefer different prices after an update.
How you'll compare + competitiveness slider (how competitive a pro is)
The competitiveness slider on the lead prices page helps pros understand how they stack up against competitors at their existing quality at a specific lead price. As they move the slider, pros can see how the updated lead price impacts their competitiveness and the price for that category.

[Image: AD_4nXdIjTDy_voB4D1QOqzIHxmDk6fpXLXqL27NeRNBn5QtJpvp39Gn9ibpLmzEmvUOMwccXhcehgx-nYd_lYBMm9LRLbT5JtbebrxRUs7VLXZTkYlyqJfQ_2Cs3vS0Tq0JdKt0qj7IzyL7VfDGQu82Wa4A14Oc]

The “How you’ll compare” section indicates how competitive a pro is at their current quality level within a specific price range compared to other pros in their market. There are four competitive thresholds (levels). However, some pros might not see them all.*
Less competitive
Competitive
More competitive
Most competitive
*Some pros might not see all the competitiveness levels on the slider. For example, if the pro needs to set their prices higher than the maximum allowed to reach a certain level of competitiveness at their current quality level, they won’t see some competitiveness levels.

To reach the highest levels of competitiveness, Thumbtack considers the lead prices the pro is willing to set and their quality (profile completeness, response time, rate, number of reviews, and review rating). Improving in all areas increases the likelihood of seeing the full range of competitiveness levels (and getting hired).
Pros competitiveness status falls: 
When a pro’s competitiveness status falls, they’ll receive an email or a push notification encouraging them to increase their lead prices. If they don’t take action, another message will be sent in a few days.
How competitiveness is determined (Bid + overall quality) 
Competitiveness is determined by how other pros set their prices and a pro’s overall quality. Since each market is unique, a pros' competitiveness level will likely change as their market landscape changes. 
Competition from other pros in their market:
Whether a pro's services are priced competitively is influenced by how other pros in their market price their services. 
"Most competitive" will place them higher than average." "Less competitive will place them lower than average.
These settings should be set to where the pro feels makes the most sense for them and their business and can be adjusted at any time to control lead volume.
Overall quality: 
A pros quality includes many factors like:
Responsiveness
Review ratings/number of reviews
Profile
Responsiveness and 
Job preferences (targeting). 
Improving all of these things will help pros be considered higher quality. 
Higher-quality pros will be able to be more competitive at similar prices than pros whose quality isn’t as high. 
NOTE: A pros lead prices will influence where they show up in search results. Reps can refer to the internal Search Results And Rank KA to learn more. 
Estimated customers
The “Estimated customers” section of the lead prices page indicates the estimated customers a pro may see based on their competitiveness and current market conditions.
As a pro adjusts their lead prices (by moving the competitiveness slider), Thumbtack will show them an estimate of how many leads they’ll get for that service. Over time, they’ll see how their lead prices impact the amount of leads they get. 
Pro’s can always adjust their lead price to get the number of leads they want. If a pro isn't getting the results they want, they can change their lead prices until they're getting the right number of leads for each of their services.
▶ Example: adjusting lead prices to achieve the desired number of customers

Let’s say an interior designer also offers home staging services to keep busy. But they prefer interior design jobs because the jobs are larger and pay better. This pro would set:
A higher lead price for their interior design service to get more of those leads. 
A lower lead price for home staging.
This way, if they only have the budget for one lead, the interior design lead takes priority

How and why lead prices may change 

While pros are always in control of the lead prices they set, there are situations where Thumbtack adjusts pricing boundaries to reflect market conditions and keep the marketplace healthy. This is done periodically and varies depending on market/location. 
These changes fall into two categories:
▶ Minimum lead price adjustments (price floors)Minimum lead prices (known internally as dynamic minimums) are the lowest amounts a pro can set and still be eligible to receive leads in their targeted markets. Thumbtack periodically adjusts these minimums based on:
Local demand and competition
Service type
Geographic markets the pro is targeting
Minimum lead prices help ensure that:
Pros don’t set prices so low that they no longer appear in search results
Customers see available, responsive pros
Lead pricing remains aligned with market conditions
Without minimums, some pros could unknowingly price themselves out of visibility.Pros whose lead prices are at or near the minimum amount: 
may occasionally see price increases when the minimums are adjusted. 
will receive an email notification and an alert on their lead prices page.
Alert on lead prices page: "You're setting the lowest prices possible. These prices may change over time. Learn more about pricing changes." 
Reps will refer to the internal Lead Price Minimums Adjusted (Dynamic Minimums) (Pro) for talking points and additional details on adjusted minimums.
▶ Maximum lead price adjustments (price ceilings)Maximum lead price levels define the upper limit of how high lead prices can be set for a given service in a market.Unlike minimums, maximum price levels do not automatically change what a pro is paying, but they can affect:
How high a pro can increase their lead price
Where the top of the competitiveness range sits
Thumbtack periodically reviews maximum price levels to:
Prevent lead prices from becoming unreasonably high
Encourage fair, competitive bidding
Give most pros more flexibility to fine-tune their pricing
Align pricing with current market demand and supply
On June 10, 2025, Thumbtack adjusted maximum lead prices across all markets. Thumbtack emailed pros whose maximums were decreased on the day the update took effect. This update:
Lowered maximums in some services where prices were previously too high
Increased maximums in other services to allow more bidding flexibility
Balanced protecting pros with maintaining a healthy marketplace
Understanding the difference helps reps quickly identify why a pro’s prices changed and how to explain it.
Lead price recommendations to remain competitive 
Lead price recommendations are personalized suggestions shown to some pros to help them remain competitive or increase lead volume based on current market conditions.
These recommendations are designed to highlight small, targeted adjustments that are likely to have a meaningful impact, rather than asking pros to make large or risky pricing changes.

[Image: rtaImage]

Eligibility: 
Not all pros will see lead price recommendations at all times. 
A pro may be eligible to see a recommendation if:
They have at least one service where a relatively small price adjustment could significantly increase visibility or lead volume
Market conditions suggest they are currently under-competitive for that service
The recommended change aligns with their existing quality level and performance
Comms: Lead price recommendations are seen in the recommendations carousel, along with email and push notifications.
▶ What accepting a recommendation means
When a pro accepts a lead price recommendation:
It gives them the best chance of seeing an increase in volume
Their lead price is updated to the suggested amount
Their competitiveness may increase for that service
Accepting a recommendation:
Does not lock the pro into those prices long term
Does not automatically increase their budget
Can be undone or adjusted at any time
In some cases, after accepting a price recommendation, the pro may be prompted to review or adjust their budget to support the increased lead volume.
▶ Why lead estimates may vary
Lead volume estimates are based on:
Recent performance
Current market demand
Competition from other pros
Customer behavior, which can fluctuate
Because demand and competition change over time:
Pros may not see results immediately
Actual lead volume may differ from estimates
Results may vary week to week
Accepting a recommendation gives the pro the best chance to see an increase, but it is not a guarantee.
reps can use the Lead price recommendations to remain competitive talking points below to help navigate these conversations. 
How to control spending on Thumbtack (lead prices + budget)
Pros on Thumbtack have two main tools for controlling their spending: 
▶ Lead priceA lead price is the exact amount a pro will pay for a single lead.
Limits the amount a pro is willing to pay for a lead (the highest amount a pro is willing to pay for a single lead)
Set individually for each service the pro offers
Determines how competitive the pro is compared to others in their market
Directly impacts how often a pro may receive lead
With exact lead prices:
The price shown is the price charged
There is no maximum or “up to” amount
Pros can update their lead prices at any time
Setting a higher lead price can:
Setting a lower lead price can:
Increase competitiveness
Increase visibility in search results
Increase lead volume
Reduce costs per lead
Lower competitiveness
Reduce lead volume
Pro resource: How to set my lead prices – Thumbtack Help article. 
▶ BudgetA budget is the total amount a pro is willing to spend on Thumbtack in a week.
One weekly budget applies across all services
Once the budget is reached, the pro stops receiving new leads until the next week
Budgets can be changed at any time (note: limits apply to custom budgets after the weekly spending cap is reached)*.
Pro resources:  How to edit my budget – Thumbtack Help*Reps can learn more in the Weekly Budget (Pro)  KA.  
▶ Example: How lead price and budget work together
If a pro sets a lead price of $15 and a weekly budget of $90
Then:
They will pay exactly $15 for each lead 
They can receive up to 6 leads that week ($15 x 6 = $90)
Once they hit $90 in charges, they stop receiving leads and appearing in search results for the week.
If the pro wants more leads, they can:
Increase their budget
Increase their lead price to be more competitive*
Or adjust both
*NOTE: Increasing only the lead price will not increase lead volume if the current budget has not been fully spent. For example, if a pro has a $90 budget and is only getting 1-2 leads at $15, increasing the lead price may help them be more competitive. However, if the pro has already spent the full $90 and wants more leads that week, they would need to increase their budget.
How to find lead prices
Pros have the ability to check the price they will pay for a lead so they can make informed decisions about their spending. To find lead prices, pros can refer to the follow areas of their Thumbtack account: 
Lead prices page:
Pros can choose how much they're willing to pay for each lead.
The lead prices page is where they set their lead prices
Pro resource: How to set my lead prices – Thumbtack Help
Payment History:
See a detailed record of every lead the pro has paid for overtime — including exact match leads and opportunities (and whether it's a paid or pending charge). 
The pro’s payment history shows a record of every lead they've paid for.
Reps can refer to Payment Methods (Pro) KA.
Messenger:
In the messenger with a customer, the pro can look at the job details to see the price of the lead.
Additionally, pros can click on an individual lead in the Leads tab to see the lead price.
Pro resource: How much do I pay for leads and opportunities? – Thumbtack Help 
Key points
Frontline reps should keep the following key points in mind when help pros with lead prices:
Pros need to set their lead prices for every service they offer. 
Setting lead prices for each category allows pros to get more leads for the jobs they want, and less of the ones they don't.
Pros can update their prices at any time. 
Pros should know that market changes will impact how competitive their lead prices are. 
Pros should review their lead prices regularly to stay competitive. 
Thumbtack adjusts the minimum amounts that pros can pay periodically. 
If a pro's prices are set to the lowest or close to the lowest amounts, they may see occasional price increases when minimums are adjusted.
Reps should refer to the internal Lead Price Minimums Adjusted (Dynamic Minimums) (Pro) KA to learn more.
Pros are required to add a credit or debit card to their account to pay for leads.
They may also see grouped weekly charges on their card (instead of individual charges per lead). 
Reps should refer to the internal Charges on Thumbtack: Payment Methods and Billing (Pro) KA to learn more.
Eligible pros may see Lead price recommendations to remain competitive and to bid higher to increase their lead volume.
2. Process
 Steps: How to set or edit lead prices (Pro)
Pro steps: To set or adjust their lead prices, pros can refer to the How to set my lead prices – Thumbtack Help article for steps. 
Pros choose how much they pay for each lead by setting their lead prices. To set them, pros will go to the Services and tap lead prices in the activity this week box. If the pro has  more than one service, they will scroll down to the service they want to update.
Pros will move the slider to adjust their lead price. Thumbtack will tell them how competitive their lead price is compared to other pros in their area. 
They will repeat these steps for each service they offer. 
Once a pro sets their lead prices, it’s a good idea for them to also adjust their budget to make sure they can get enough leads for their business.

Note: Pros who had targeting turned on when they removed a service will be prompted to set their lead prices for that service if they add it back. This step will appear after they set their travel preferences and before the budget page. If the service had job preferences (targeting) paused when removed, it would be added back as paused, skipping the targeting setup altogether.
Steps: How to accept a lead price recommendation (Pro)
Lead price recommendations are personalized suggestions offered to eligible pros.  These recommendations focus on minor, impactful changes, avoiding large or risky pricing shifts. 
Pros will see recommendations tailored to their specific market and current price.
The experience of a pro accepting a recommendation is as follows: 
Click the call to action to be taken to the lead prices page.
▶ In-product view[Image: AD_4nXdzSzvd3Sb4FKvU82k36mnWoU2hht1-kq2d-43lV_JPfyWYDFSSrym_yCagnpGxYK_F7cgWjR-kU0lYvmhd08QoD4TEGLS7LvikBqm927Qvd2q0N1FBnRq3efaadp_I7WDttPbS08qOehqhLEzl8bZihjE5]
Select the recommendations they want to apply.
Click “Update prices” to save their changes, or “not now.” 
▶ In-product view[Image: AD_4nXclMll0sGUtEgk32Z09Gtd8ZjsmyfKM4gpPtrqCByGRD04lojmJg-F08ktsULiTqACpWe3kG961CV8xVnVDZ6AR9poiJWPmKWOu3sbYc0gsk_nk4JLp65EyHrIYsft4779bb26alaEb-jie0fVebcvgwGuO]
Based on the changes to their lead price, the pro may need to adjust their budget to be able to reach the estimated lead volume. If Thumbtack recommends a change to their budget, the pro will see that after successfully setting their new prices. 
▶ In-product view[Image: AD_4nXdhBkd3Fnz5lAp89bSJqhb-iNebpUMEP4cRDZQ5ckuVvWK8YJAP6-tEXgbSO5cs4vHGfhcRb6-zraN_KbWgzHqr7wroyKHcIvdjFjdl8eFr0tbyeWmRhtsxIMYYQaDofmHc_QHZSCLMLFEeJlza5IULs9c]
Use the Lead price recommendations to remain competitive talking points to help navigate these conversations. 
Steps: How to capture pro feedback on exact lead prices (Rep)
This process ensures that all pro feedback (concerns, questions, positive sentiment) related to the shift from max lead prices to exact lead prices (First Price Auction) is correctly routed and tracked.
To accurately capture the specific lead prices conversations with pros, Frontline reps will follow these steps during their interactions:
Submit the feedback report using the existing item
Action: When submitting feedback on the Exact Lead Price transition, associate your report with the existing feedback theme in Salesforce.
Feedback theme: [Pricing] Exact lead pricing transition feedback (FPA) 
This item captures pro feedback on price transparency, predictability, perceived price changes, and trust in the new pricing model.
Complete the feedback details
Action: In the Feedback Report fields, provide the necessary details:
Feedback Details: Capture the pro's feedback on the transition verbatim. Include the context and impact on their business.
Agent Sense of Urgency: Select the urgency level (High, Medium, or Low) based on Thumbtack's viewpoint of the issue's business impact.
Job Category: Add the job category tied to the pro’s account.
Reps can refer to the internal Product Feedback KA for more information on product feedback.

3. Talking points 
How lead prices work
This section provides frontline reps with talking points that explain to pros that the Lead Price feature gives them control over lead costs, allowing them to adjust prices and manage total spending with a weekly budget.



English talking point
Spanish talking point
Do I set a price for every service? 
¿Debo establecer un precio para cada servicio?
Yes, you will need to set your price for every service. 
Sí, deberá establecer un precio para cada uno de sus servicios.
What happens if I only set a price for some of my services but not for all of them?
¿Qué sucede si solo establezco un precio para algunos de mis servicios, pero no para todos?
You will be required to set a price for all categories -- if you exit out, you will be asked to re-set for all your categories.
Deberá establecer un precio para todas las categorías. Si sale del proceso antes de completarlo, se le pedirá que configure nuevamente los precios para todas sus categorías.
Q: How do exact lead prices work (I’m confused about exact lead prices!)?
Q: ¿Cómo funcionan los precios exactos por prospecto? (¡No entiendo los precios exactos por prospecto!)
Simply put, this feature puts pros in control of how much they pay for lead prices.
You set the price: On your 'Lead Prices' page, you set the exact price you are willing to pay for a lead for each of your services.
What you set is what you pay: If you get a lead, you will pay that exact price. It gives you full transparency and makes your costs predictable.
You're in control: You can go to your 'Lead Prices' page at any time to see how your prices compare to other pros and adjust them to meet your business goals
En pocas palabras, esta nueva función les otorga a los profesionales el control sobre cuánto pagan por los prospectos. 
Usted fija el precio: En su página Lead Prices (“Precios por prospecto”), establece el precio exacto que está dispuesto a pagar por un prospecto para cada uno de sus servicios.
Lo que fija es lo que paga: Si recibe un prospecto, pagará ese precio exacto. Esto le brinda total transparencia y hace que sus costos sean predecibles.
Usted tiene el control: Puede ir a su página Lead Prices (“Precios por prospecto”) en cualquier momento para ver cómo se comparan sus precios con los de otros profesionales y ajustarlos según los objetivos de su negocio.
Where can I learn more about lead prices and being competitive? 
Q: ¿Dónde puedo obtener más información sobre los precios por prospecto y cómo ser competitivo?
A: Your 'Lead Prices' page is the best place to learn more. It shows the exact price you'll pay for different jobs and has a slider that shows how your price compares to what other pros are setting, which helps you see how competitive you are.

We also have a help article that walks through how to set your prices.
A: Su página Lead Prices (“Precios por prospecto”) es el mejor lugar para obtener más información. Muestra el precio exacto que pagará por diferentes trabajos y tiene un control deslizante que le indica cómo se comparan sus precios con los de otros profesionales, lo que le ayuda a ver qué tan competitivo es.

También contamos con un artículo útil que explica paso a paso cómo establecer sus precios.
Q: This is just a cash grab from Thumbtack! 
Q: ¡Esto solo es una forma de que Thumbtack gane más dinero!
A: We made this change based on feedback from pros like you who told us the old 'max price' system was confusing. Pros said it was hard to budget when they didn't know the exact price they'd pay. This new system gives you more predictability and transparency. You are in complete control of what you pay and you can increase or decrease your lead prices to make sure they make sense for you and your business at any time
A: Hicimos este cambio basándonos en los comentarios de profesionales como usted, quienes nos dijeron que el sistema anterior de “precio máximo” resultaba confuso. Muchos mencionaron que era difícil planificar el presupuesto cuando no sabían el precio exacto que pagarían.
Este nuevo sistema le ofrece mayor previsibilidad y transparencia. Usted tiene control total sobre lo que paga y puede aumentar o reducir sus precios por prospecto en cualquier momento, según lo que tenga más sentido para su negocio.
Lead prices and ranking 

English talking point
Spanish talking point
Q: Are lead prices the only thing that impacts how many leads I get? 
Q: ¿Los precios por prospecto son el único factor que influye en cuántos prospectos recibo?
A: Your lead price is one of several factors that determine how many leads you get. It’s also impacted by things like:

Your profile
Your star rating and reviews
How quickly you respond to new leads 
Local demand for your services
No. Su precio por prospecto es uno de varios factores que determinan cuántos prospectos recibe. También influyen aspectos como:

Su perfil.
Su calificación de estrellas y reseñas.
Qué tan rápido responde a los nuevos prospectos.
La demanda local de sus servicios.
How do I get the lead over others? Will leads just go to whoever bids the most? 
¿Cómo puedo obtener el prospecto antes que otros? ¿Los prospectos se asignan solo a quien paga más?
A: Your price is a key factor, but it's not the only one. Being competitive with your lead price is important, but Thumbtack also considers your responsiveness, your profile quality, and your reviews determine where you show up in search results. Setting a higher price can make you more competitive for a lead, but you should balance that with what a lead is worth to your business. The new system just makes it clear exactly what that lead will cost you if you get it.
A: Su precio es un factor clave, pero no es el único. Ser competitivo con su precio por prospecto es importante, pero Thumbtack también considera qué tan rápido responde, la calidad de su perfil y sus reseñas para determinar dónde aparece en los resultados de búsqueda. Establecer un precio más alto puede hacerlo más competitivo para un prospecto, pero debe equilibrarlo con el valor que ese prospecto tiene para su negocio. El nuevo sistema simplemente deja claro cuánto le costará exactamente ese prospecto si lo recibe.
Benefits of lead prices
This section provides frontline reps with talking points that highlight the benefits of Lead Prices, such as giving pros control over their spending and lead volume, enabling business growth, and providing transparency in price setting.



English talking point
Spanish talking point
Q: How does this lead price system actually benefit me, especially if I'm already a top pro?
Q: ¿Cómo me beneficia realmente este sistema de precios por prospecto, especialmente si ya soy un profesional destacado?
A: For a top pro, the biggest benefit is predictability. The price you set is the price you pay, every time. This makes it much easier to plan your budget, understand your customer acquisition cost, and calculate your return on investment (ROI) for every job. It gives you more direct control over your spending and removes the guesswork of the old auction system. We also still consider your overall quality when it comes to competitiveness, so being a high quality pro will still have a significant impact on your competitiveness. 
A: Para un profesional destacado, el mayor beneficio es la previsibilidad. El precio que establece es el precio que paga, siempre. Esto facilita planificar su presupuesto, entender su costo de adquisición de clientes y calcular su retorno de inversión (ROI) para cada trabajo. Le da un control más directo sobre su gasto y elimina la incertidumbre del sistema anterior de subastas.
Además, seguimos considerando su calidad general al evaluar su competitividad, por lo que ser un profesional de alta calidad seguirá teniendo un impacto significativo.
Q: How do exact lead prices benefit me as a pro?
Q: ¿Cómo me benefician los precios exactos por prospecto como profesional?
Transparency and clarity: You have transparency and clarity into your pricing, since the lead prices that you set will be exactly what you’ll pay.
Predictability and consistency: No more guessing. You’ll always know how much you’ll pay for leads so that you can easily plan, budget, and understand your return.
Control: You are in control of what you set your bid at, and that will be exactly what you pay.
Transparencia y claridad: Tendrá total transparencia y claridad sobre sus precios, ya que los precios por prospecto que establezca serán exactamente los que pagará.
Previsibilidad y consistencia: Ya no tendrá que adivinar. Siempre sabrá cuánto pagará por los prospectos, lo que le permitirá planificar, presupuestar y entender su retorno con facilidad.
Control: Usted controla el precio que establece para su oferta, y eso será exactamente lo que pagará.
How to control spending (bid and budget)

This section provides frontline reps with talking points that clarify the difference between Lead Price (a cap on the cost per individual lead) and budget (a cap on total weekly spending), explaining how these two tools work together to control a pro's costs.


English talking point
Spanish talking point
Q: What’s the difference between my budget and lead price?
Q: ¿Cuál es la diferencia entre mi presupuesto y el precio por prospecto?
A: Your Budget is the total amount you're willing to spend in a week; it controls how many leads you can get. Your Lead Price is the exact price you'll pay for one lead. Think of it as your lead price being the price of a single item, and your budget being your total weekly shopping allowance.
A: Su presupuesto es el monto total que está dispuesto a gastar en una semana; controla cuántos prospectos puede recibir.
Su precio por prospecto es el precio exacto que pagará por un solo prospecto.
Piense en el precio por prospecto como el costo de un solo artículo, y en su presupuesto como su gasto total semanal.
Do pros need to pay more for leads now?
¿Los profesionales necesitan pagar más por los prospectos ahora?
Not necessarily. Pros are in control of how much they pay for leads and how much lead volume they would like to have. In some cases, especially with high quality pros, they will often pay less because their quality score (reviews, response time, profile quality, etc.) will help them rank higher with a lower lead price.
No necesariamente. Los profesionales controlan cuánto pagan por los prospectos y cuántos quieren recibir. En algunos casos, especialmente los profesionales con alta calidad, pueden pagar menos porque su puntuación de calidad (reseñas, tiempo de respuesta, calidad del perfil, etc.) les ayuda a aparecer más arriba con un precio por prospecto más bajo.
How competitive levels work (how competitive a pro is)

This section provides frontline reps with talking points that guide pros on using the competitiveness slider to see how their Lead Price compares to competitors, and explains that quality factors also determine their overall competitiveness.


English talking point
Spanish talking point
How can I see how competitive I am? 
¿Cómo puedo ver qué tan competitivo soy?
On the lead prices page, you can see the competitiveness level slider. You can track your average price per lead in the performance module below the lead prices table on each service. This module will also give you personalized recommendations on how to get more leads based on your current quality score and lead prices. 
En la página de precios de los prospectos, puede ver el control deslizante de nivel de competitividad. También puede ver su precio promedio por prospecto en el módulo de rendimiento, debajo de la tabla de precios de los prospectos en cada servicio. Este módulo también le dará recomendaciones personalizadas para obtener más prospectos según su puntuación de calidad actual y sus precios de los prospectos.
How are competitiveness thresholds determined?
¿Cómo se determinan los niveles de competitividad?
Thresholds are determined by a number of factors.
One factor is the competition from other pros in your market. Where other pros in your market set their prices will have an impact on whether the prices you set will comparatively be more or less competitive. 
Another factor is your overall quality. Being a higher quality pro means that you will be able to be more competitive at lower prices than pros who’s quality isn’t as high. When considering quality we look at things like profile completeness, response time and rate, number of reviews and review rating. Improving all of these things will help you be considered higher quality.
Los niveles se determinan según varios factores.
Uno de ellos es la competencia de otros profesionales en su mercado. Los precios que establecen otros profesionales influyen en si los precios que usted fija son más o menos competitivos en comparación.
Otro factor es su calidad general. Tener una mayor calidad le permite ser más competitivo con precios más bajos que los profesionales con menor calidad. Para evaluar la calidad, consideramos aspectos como la integridad del perfil, el tiempo y la tasa de respuesta, la cantidad de reseñas y la calificación. Mejorar estos elementos le ayudará a ser considerado un profesional de mayor calidad.
Does ‘competitive’ mean that my prices are seen as competitive to the customer?
¿“Competitivo” significa que mis precios se ven competitivos para el cliente?
The competitiveness level of your lead prices is only referring to what you will pay for leads. Being competitive here is solely related to where your profile will show up in the pro list compared to other pros in your market, and does not apply to the prices that you charge customers for your services. 
No. El nivel de competitividad de sus precios de los prospectos solo se refiere a lo que usted pagará por los prospectos. Ser competitivo aquí se relaciona únicamente con dónde aparece su perfil en la lista de profesionales, en comparación con otros profesionales en su mercado, y no se aplica a los precios que usted cobra a los clientes por sus servicios.
How often does competitiveness change? How often should I update my prices? 
¿Con qué frecuencia cambia la competitividad? ¿Con qué frecuencia debo actualizar mis precios?
Competitiveness is determined by the other pros in your market, so each market is unique as far as when competitiveness levels might change. We recommend using your lead volume as an indicator of when you may need to update your competitiveness level. The competitiveness slider is a great way to control lead volume by adjusting how competitive you want to be.
La competitividad está determinada por los otros profesionales en su mercado, por lo que cada mercado es único en cuanto en que momento podrían cambiar los niveles de competitividad. Le recomendamos utilizar su volumen de prospectos como indicador de cuándo puede ser necesario actualizar su nivel de competitividad. El deslizador de competitividad es una excelente manera de controlar el volumen de prospectos ajustando cuán competitivo desea ser.
Will I be alerted if my competitiveness level falls? 
¿Recibiré una alerta si mi nivel de competitividad disminuye?
Yes, we will notify you when your competitiveness level falls from “competitive” to “less competitive.” 
Sí, le notificaremos cuando su nivel de competitividad descienda de "competitivo" a "menos competitivo".
Why isn’t the full range of competitiveness levels visible on the slider for some pros?
¿Por qué no es visible el rango completo de niveles de competitividad en el deslizador para algunos profesionales?
The reason you may not be seeing the full range of competitiveness levels may have to do with your overall quality. In order to reach the highest competitiveness levels we don’t only consider the prices you are willing to set, but we also consider pro quality, which includes factors like profile completeness, response time and rate, number of reviews and review rating. Improving in these areas will likely allow you to see the full range of competitiveness levels. Improving your quality will not only help you be more competitive in search results, but it will also improve your likelihood of getting hired.   
La razón por la que podría no estar viendo el rango completo de niveles de competitividad puede estar relacionada con su calidad general. Para alcanzar los niveles más altos de competitividad, no solo consideramos los precios que está dispuesto a establecer, sino que también tomamos en cuenta la calidad del profesional, lo que incluye factores como la completitud del perfil, el tiempo y tasa de respuesta, el número de reseñas y la calificación de las reseñas. Mejorar en estas áreas probablemente le permitirá ver el rango completo de niveles de competitividad. Mejorar su calidad no solo le ayudará a ser más competitivo en los resultados de búsqueda, sino que también aumentará su probabilidad de ser contratado.
Lead price recommendations to remain competitive
This section provides frontline reps with talking points that inform pros about the personalized, dynamic recommendations available on the Lead Prices page to help them adjust their pricing and improve performance to remain competitive.


English talking point
Spanish talking point
Why am I seeing these recommendations to increase my prices? 
¿Por qué veo estas recomendaciones para aumentar mis precios?
You are seeing these recommendations because based on your market and your prices, making a relatively small adjustment to your prices could have a significant impact on the number of leads/bookings you receive. 
Ve estas recomendaciones porque, según su mercado y sus precios actuales, hacer un ajuste relativamente pequeño en sus precios podría tener un impacto significativo en la cantidad de prospectos o reservas que recibe.
Why do I only see lead price recommendations for some services, but not all? 
¿Por qué solo veo recomendaciones de precios por prospecto para algunos servicios y no para todos?
You will only see recommendations for increases that will have a significant impact on your leads/booking volume with a relatively small increase in your lead prices. You can adjust your prices for other services you offer at any time, but the recommendations we show are the ones we think will have the biggest impact based on your market. 
Solo mostramos recomendaciones cuando un aumento relativamente pequeño en sus precios podría tener un impacto significativo en el volumen de prospectos o reservas para ese servicio. Puede ajustar los precios de sus otros servicios en cualquier momento, pero las recomendaciones que ve son las que creemos tendrán mayor efecto según su mercado.
Can I change my prices back after accepting a lead price recommendation? 
¿Puedo cambiar mis precios después de aceptar una recomendación?
Yes, you can change your prices at any time, even after accepting a recommendation. 
Sí, puede cambiar sus precios en cualquier momento, incluso después de aceptar una recomendación.
I accepted the recommendation to increase my lead prices, but I haven’t been seeing the estimated increase in leads/bookings. Why is that? 
Acepté la recomendación de aumentar mis precios de los prospectos, pero no he visto el aumento previsto en prospectos/reservas. ¿Por qué?
These estimates are created based on current performance and market conditions and accepting these recommendations gives you the best chance at seeing an increase in volume. That being said, customer demand can fluctuate so you may not immediately see the estimated impact and actual results may vary based on demand fluctuations.
Estas proyecciones se basan en su rendimiento actual y en las condiciones del mercado, y aceptar estas recomendaciones le da la mejor oportunidad de aumentar el volumen. Sin embargo, la demanda de clientes puede fluctuar, por lo que quizá no vea el impacto previsto de inmediato y los resultados reales pueden variar según esos cambios.
Will I need to update my budget in addition to my lead prices (for lead price recommendations)? 
¿Necesito actualizar mi presupuesto además de mis precios de los prospectos (para las recomendaciones de precios)?
Based on the changes you make to your lead prices you may need to adjust your budget to be able to reach the estimated lead volume. If we recommend a change you will see that after successfully setting your new prices. You can also visit the budget page for your services to see your recommended budget at any time. 
Según los cambios que haga en sus precios de los prospectos, es posible que también deba ajustar su presupuesto para alcanzar el volumen de prospectos proyectado. Si le recomendamos un cambio, lo verá después de guardar correctamente sus nuevos precios. También puede visitar en cualquier momento la página de presupuesto de sus servicios para ver su presupuesto recomendado.
Lead cost and wha

articles.summary: This article explains how the minimum price of leads automatically adjusts when professionals change their service areas or remove markets.
articles.concepts: lead pricing, dynamic pricing, service areas, pro settings, lead costs, targeting preferences
articles.fullText:
Lead Price Minimums Adjusted (Dynamic Minimums) (Pro)

▶ Contents.
Overview
Updates: Minimums adjusted
Benefits of lead price minimums for pros
Pro experience 
Pro has minimums adjusted up
How a pro's lead prices change when they add or remove a service market
Email comms for pros regarding lead price adjustments (increases / decreases)
Thumbtack adjusted minimums: Pro had lead prices increase 
Thumbtack adjusted minimums: Pro had lead prices decreased
Lead price increase: Pro adds new market with higher minimum
Talking points
Understanding of lead price minimums (and price changes)
Thumbtack adjusted minimums: Pro had lead prices increase
Pros did not get lead prices increased but noticed an increased price
Thumbtack adjusted minimums: Pro had lead prices decrease
Glossary of key terms
Resources
1. Overview
▶ KA summary
This internal knowledge article explains "Lead Price Minimums Adjusted (Dynamic Minimums)" for Thumbtack pros. It covers:
The concept of dynamic minimums: How Thumbtack periodically adjusts minimum lead prices based on market conditions and location.
Impacts on pros: How these adjustments may increase or decrease a pro's bid prices and when they will receive email notifications.
How adding or removing a service market influences minimum pricing.
Thumbtack will periodically adjust the minimum amount that pros can pay depending on the locations they are targeting. This is known internally as dynamic minimums. 
Additionally, when a pro adds or removes a market (service area) a pro's lead prices can also change automatically. This is a pro-initiated change, distinct from Thumbtack's periodic adjustments.
Why lead price minimums are adjusted
Setting a lead price too low prevents a pro from appearing in search results. Adjusting minimums ensures pros are able to:
Get leads from customers.
Prevent their low lead prices from stopping them from being seen.
What happens when lead prices are adjusted up
The adjustment is based on what other pros are charging for similar services in the area. When Thumbtack increases the minimum lead price:
Pros below the new minimum: These pros will experience a price increase. Their price is automatically adjusted to the new minimum, and they will be notified of the change.
Pros at or above the new minimum:These pros will NOT experience any changes in prices. 
Thumbtack will always notify the impacted pro when prices increase, although it's hard to predict the exact amount of the increase. Pros can check their current prices and make adjustments in the app at any time. 
Note on maximum lead prices: Thumbtack also periodically adjusts maximum lead price levels periodically. For details on Maximum adjustments, reps should refer to the internal Lead Pricing (Pro) KA to learn more. 

Updates: Lead price minimums adjusted 
Thumbtack has implemented periodic adjustments to minimum lead prices, which are distinct from changes a pro makes to their own service areas (adding or removing markets).
This mechanism, known internally as dynamic minimums, was initially introduced in November 2023. Since then, the following key adjustments to minimum lead prices have occurred:
January 2024: The first minimum lead price increase was conducted as a test.
March 2024: Reserve tuning (minimum lead price increase) was rolled out in waves to 50% of markets, with a subsequent correction for pros who were initially missed.
May 2024/2025: Minimum lead prices were adjusted in select markets, including the expected ship date for the remaining 50% of markets from the Q1 2024 experiment (May 20, 2024).
July 2024 (H2 Reserve Tuning): A new experiment was launched that raised minimum lead prices in a different set of markets.
September 2024: Rollout for the H2 Reserve Tuning experiment.
March 2025: Thumbtack implemented optimized lead prices in certain markets to encourage more competitive bidding and increase revenue.

Key Distinction: These are all changes initiated by Thumbtack to ensure pros are competitive and visible in search results. They are separate from a pro's lead price automatically changing when a pro currently bidding the minimums updates their job preferences by adding or removing a service area with a different minimum price.

Benefits of lead price minimums for pros
There are benefits to pros when lead price minimums are adjusted:
Visibility: A pros previous lead prices may have been so low that customers weren’t able to find them. Setting competitive prices makes the pro more visible in search results so that new customers can find them.
Control: The pro is in control of where they set their lead prices and can adjust them at any time. 
Pro Experience 
Pro has minimums adjusted up
Pros will see an alert on their lead prices page if their prices are set to (or adjusted to) minimums.
Definition: The minimum price a pro can set for a lead to show up in all of their targeted markets
The alert is in a blue banner at the top of the lead prices page and says: 
“You’re setting the lowest prices possible. These prices may adjust over time. Learn more about pricing changes” 
Clicking on the learn more hyperlink shows a pop up model that explains: “If you set lower prices, your prices may change over time. When you choose to pay the lowest prices possible, these prices may occasionally adjust automatically. You’ll always see the most up-to-date pricing reflected on the pricing table shown.”
Additionally, pros will always see the most up-to-date pricing reflected on their pricing tables on their lead prices page. They can always adjust their lead prices using the competitiveness slider to make sure they align with what makes sense for their business. 

[Image: rtaImage]


[Image: rtaImage]
 

How a pro's lead prices change when they add or remove a service market
Every market is different, and the cost of doing business varies by location. This means the minimum price a pro needs to set to stay competitive changes from city to city.
When a pro updates their job preferences (job types or travel areas) by adding or removing a service area (market), their lead prices may automatically adjust to ensure they remain visible in all the areas they have selected. 
NOTE: These are changes made by the pro themselves, which cause a subsequent price adjustment. This process is separate from and should not be confused with the periodic adjustments Thumbtack makes to minimum lead prices in select markets.
Scenarios: Adding a Service Area
Pro adds a market with a LOWER minimum:
Result: No change to lead prices. They’ll pay lower prices in other markets.
Why: The pro’s current lead price is already high enough to cover the new, cheaper market. The current lead price is maintained to ensure they continue showing up in their existing, more expensive markets.
Pro adds a market with a HIGHER minimum:
Result: The dynamic minimum will automatically adjust up.
Why: The new market requires a higher lead price to appear in search results. The pro’s lead price must increase to account for this expensive area.
Impact on other markets: For the less expensive markets they were already targeting, the pro will continue to pay similar prices to what they paid before (because they only pay enough to beat the competition in that specific auction).
Communication: The pro will receive an email notifying them that their prices have changed based on updates they made to their targeting preferences (travel preferences). See
Scenario 2: Pro REMOVES a Market
Pro removes a market with a LOWER minimum
Result: No change to lead prices. They’ll pay lower prices in other markets.
Why: The pro is still targeting other, more expensive markets. Their lead price needs to stay at its current level to maintain visibility in those remaining areas.
Pro removes a market with a HIGHER minimum
Result: The lead price will decrease.
Why: Since the pro is no longer targeting the expensive area that was keeping the price high, the system automatically lowers their lead price to match the highest minimum of their remaining markets.
Example: Utah County vs. Park City
To help explain this to a pro, you can use this analogy:
Imagine a pro targets Utah County, where prices are lower.
The pro decides to add Park City to their travel area (a new market).
Park City is a highly competitive, expensive market.
Outcome: The pro's minimum lead price must increase.
Reason: If the price stayed at the "Utah County" level, the pro would never be seen by customers in Park City. The price adjusts up specifically to get them into the auction for the new area they requested.

Email comms for pros regarding lead price adjustments (increases / decreases)
Pros are notified via email when their lead prices are automatically adjusted in two primary scenarios:
Thumbtack-Initiated Periodic Adjustments: When Thumbtack periodically increases the minimum lead price in a market (Dynamic Minimums), pros whose current bid falls below that new minimum will have their bid automatically adjusted up and will be sent a notification.
Pro-Initiated Market Changes: When a pro adds a new market (service area) that has a higher minimum lead price than their current areas, the system automatically raises their bid to ensure they can appear in search results for that new, more competitive area.
In both cases, the communication is to inform the pro of the automatic change to their lead price settings.
▶ Thumbtack adjusted minimums: Pro had lead prices increase
This email is sent to pros whose current lead price was below a new, increased market minimum set by Thumbtack, resulting in their price being automatically adjusted up.
Subject line: Your lead prices have changed.
Preheader: View the most up-to-date pricing in the app.
Email summary:  The screenshot below shows an email notification sent to pros informing them that their lead prices have been adjusted (increased) to the minimum amount permitted in their area. The notification also reminds pros that they can change their prices at any time using the app.

[Image: XvQj8k3egNi9wSySHz5jPl9EBljFY_5ckedknGMae9uH8E-ZHfMsDSYZxqilQ153i_mofnihLeswxwkyeY_veHIJ5biuHAYP8Rmr6uMZe_AixjpS8lslWL4GwwH_9yW1sKbyHB6nVyjnmG2CG_xIZGM]

▶ Thumbtack adjusted minimums: Pro had lead prices decrease
This email is sent to pros when Thumbtack has periodically lowered the minimum lead price in their market, and their price is automatically adjusted down to the new minimum.
Subject line: Your lead prices have changed.
Preheader: View the most up-to-date pricing in the app.
Email summary: The screenshot below shows an email notification sent to pros informing them that their lead prices have been adjusted (decreased) to the minimum amount permitted in their area. The notification also reminds pros that they can change their prices at any time using the app.

[Image: AD_4nXepljh6DLNmXIxj9AFl4jO-4073T49vnXVwv4uiiFKu-bfmVyfhxud81-9hUazXOrBy9QfOMJLaPIQwB4A5Hxlra_-Pu6zRdkw1zlnjx8wKNjtS1HFshwMy_hF6nhQ3hk2cWZVubQ]

▶ Lead prices increased: Pro adds new market with higher minimum
Reps may receive contacts from pros confused by an email stating: "Based on updates you’ve made to your targeting preferences, lead prices for certain service(s) you offer have increased."
The pro will receive an email notification letting them know their prices have changed based on the updates they made to their targeting preferences.
The Cause: The pro added a new market (service area) that has a higher minimum than the areas they were previously targeting.
The Fix: To ensure the pro appears in search results for this new, competitive area, the system automatically raises their lead price to meet that market's minimum requirement.
Use case: Email sent when pros add a new market with a higher minimum that causes their prices to increase.
Subject line: Your lead prices have changed.
Preheader: View the most up-to-date pricing in the app.
Email summary: The email explains that the pro's lead prices have changed because of updates they made to their targeting preferences. It specifically notes that the pro added a new market that had a higher minimum bid, which automatically caused their overall lead price minimums to increase. The email also encourages the pro to view the most up-to-date pricing in the app.

[Image: ZCqR1VjgmuelRS8aCYOfUrM56LzRP9AkiEZYfneq_xh-adNK75DUMDRfCdfZ_3uBGta_N76sLkm_V-hgJpK6jjIj6DqN1Qcjh-lamru7PPQtXZmLqbaewLAxBQ2I5jiIvBktIBlQ1_V9wWGT4o_i4HU]

2. Talking points 
Understanding of lead price minimums (and price changes)


English FAQs
Spanish FAQs
Will my lead price settings ever change? 
¿Alguna vez pueden cambiar mis ajustes de precio de prospectos?
Thumbtack occasionally adjusts the minimum amounts that pros can pay, which varies depending on the locations that you’re targeting. If your lead prices are set to the lowest amounts, or close to the lowest amounts, you may see occasional price increases when we adjust our minimums. 
Thumbtack a veces ajusta los montos mínimos que los profesionales pueden pagar, y estos varían según las ubicaciones a las que se dirige. Si sus precios de prospectos están en los montos más bajos, o cerca de los más bajos, es posible que vea aumentos ocasionales cuando ajustemos esos mínimos.
How much will my lead prices change? 
¿Cuánto cambiarán los precios de mis prospectos?
These changes are based on the market for the individual services you target. Because these changes vary by market it is difficult to say exactly how much they will increase, but we will always notify you when they increase and you can always see what prices you currently pay and make adjustments accordingly in the app.
Estos cambios se basan en el mercado de los servicios individuales a los que se dirige. Debido a que estos cambios varían según el mercado, es difícil decir exactamente cuánto aumentarán, pero siempre le notificaremos cuando aumenten y siempre podrá ver los precios que paga actualmente y realizar los ajustes correspondientes en la aplicación.
Is increasing my lead prices the only thing I can do to stay competitive? 
Aumentar el precio de los prospectos, ¿Es la única opción para ser competitivo?
No, your lead price is one of several factors that determine how competitive you are on Thumbtack. Your competitiveness is also impacted by things like:

your profile,
your star rating and number of reviews,
and how quickly you respond to new leads.

Improving these other quality factors can result in paying less on average for the same lead volume. 
Aumentar el precio por prospecto no es la única opción. Su competitividad en Thumbtack también se ve influenciada por:

Su perfil.
Su calificación por estrellas y la cantidad de reseñas.
La rapidez con la la que responde a nuevos prospectos.

Centrarse en mejorar estos factores de calidad puede permitirle obtener el mismo volumen de prospectos a un costo promedio menor.
Thumbtack adjusted minimums: Pro had lead prices increase
These talking points are here to help reps in explaining to pros that their lead price has been automatically increased. This adjustment occurred because their previous price fell below a new, higher market minimum established by Thumbtack.

English FAQs
Spanish FAQs
Why did my lead price increase? I didn't change it.
¿Por qué aumentó el precio de mis prospectos? Yo no lo cambié.
The lead price you set was so low that you were not showing up in search results. We have adjusted to lowest lead prices in your markets to ensure that you are able to get leads. We will adjust the lowest lead prices possible from time to time based on the market to make sure that the bids pros are setting are not preventing them from being seen by customers.
El precio de prospecto que estableció era tan bajo que ya no aparecía en los resultados de búsqueda. Ajustamos los precios mínimos de prospectos en sus mercados para ayudarle a recibir prospectos. De vez en cuando, ajustaremos esos precios mínimos según el mercado para asegurarnos de que los precios que establecen los profesionales no les impidan ser vistos por los clientes.
Pro did not have lead prices raised but noticed increase in prices

My lead prices increased compared to what they were previously, why is that? 
Mis precios de los prospectos aumentaron en comparación con antes. ¿Por qué?
Prices are primarily based on the market conditions you work in. Increased competition in your market can cause these prices to change. 

Thumbtack also occasionally adjusts the minimum amounts that pros can pay, which varies depending on the locations that you’re targeting, to ensure that pros aren’t setting prices that are too low and would cause them to no longer show up in search results. You can always adjust your lead prices to make sure they align with what makes sense for you and your business. 
Los precios dependen principalmente de las condiciones del mercado donde usted trabaja. Un aumento de la competencia en su mercado puede hacer que estos precios cambien.
Thumbtack también ajusta ocasionalmente los montos mínimos que los profesionales pueden pagar, lo cual varía según las ubicaciones a las que se dirige, para evitar que los profesionales establezcan precios tan bajos que dejen de aparecer en los resultados de búsqueda. Usted siempre puede ajustar sus precios de prospectos para que se alineen con lo que tiene sentido para usted y su negocio.
Thumbtack adjusted minimums: Pro had lead prices decrease
These talking points are designed to help professionals explain to other pros that Thumbtack has occasionally lowered the minimum lead price in their specific market, resulting in their individual price being automatically adjusted down to the new minimum.

English FAQs
Spanish FAQs
Why did my lead price decrease? I didn't change it.
¿Por qué disminuyó mi precio de los prospecto? Yo no lo cambié.
Thumbtack occasionally adjusts the minimum amounts that pros can pay, which varies depending on the locations that you’re targeting. If your prices are set to the lowest amounts, or close to the lowest amounts, you may see occasional price increases when we adjust our minimums. In this case, we’ve adjusted the lowest bids in your markets to ensure that you are able to get leads.
Thumbtack ajusta ocasionalmente los montos mínimos que los profesionales pueden pagar, lo cual varía según las ubicaciones a las que se dirige. Si sus precios están establecidos en los montos más bajos, o cerca de los más bajos, es posible que vea aumentos ocasionales cuando ajustemos nuestros mínimos. En este caso, ajustamos las ofertas más bajas en sus mercados para ayudarle a recibir prospectos.
Glossary of key terms 
The following key terms are essential for frontline reps to understand dynamic minimums:
Lead price (formerly bid / max lead price) The amount a pro is willing to pay for a lead.
Default (internal term only): The lead price set when signing up if no active bid was ever set. Pros with lower than default bids likely won’t show up in higher priced markets because their competitiveness will be too low
Dynamic Minimums (internal term only): The new minimum amount pros can pay in order to show up in all of their targeted markets. Unlike the default price of the past, these new dynamic minimum prices can change over time. 
Reserve price (internal term only): The baseline amounts a pro can pay, as determined by the markets they’re targeting. If a pro targets multiple markets with different reserve prices, they’ll have a range of reserve prices. Bidding below the highest reserve can filter pros out of higher-priced markets.
Reserve tuning or reserve increase (internal terms only): The process of adjusting the minimum bid amount per market.
