*For details on the BOSUP Discount Offers section, see the Budget Increase Incentive (BOSUP & SOBU) (Pro) KA. ** For details on Business-level Budget and Business Budget History sections, see the Weekly Targeting Budget (Pro) KA. 

2: Incentive offers: Free leads and discounts

▶ Free leads

Special promotions that offer free leads
Use this table to quickly identify what type of offer a pro has and what triggered it. This is the starting point when a pro asks about a free lead offer — once you know the program type, you can use the dedicated KA for full details.
Program
Type
What Triggers It
BOSUP
Budget incentive
Pro has spent their budget but is still showing in search results due to low supply in their category + zip code
SOBU
Budget incentive
An anticipated peak season with high customer demand is approaching
Seasonal category 
Recommendation
Add new, in-demand seasonal services category during peak season
Targeting Expansion
Recommendation
High demand and low competition for a geo or job type the pro doesn't currently target
Respond Quickly
Recommendation
Pro's response rate or speed is below platform benchmarks
Get Reviews
Recommendation
Pro has few or no reviews on their profile
For full details and talking points on budget incentives, see the Budget Increase Incentive (BOSUP & SOBU) (Pro) KA. For recommendation offers, see the Incentivized Recommendation Cards (Pro) KA.
Tracking and using free leads
Once a pro has accepted an offer, this section covers what happens next — how leads are applied, how the pro tracks their progress, and how to confirm a lead was free. This is also the place to start when a pro says they expected a free lead but were charged.
Free lead expirations
 
Reps can check the Expires field in the Discounts section (User Admin) to see exactly when a pro's free leads will expire. This is the most reliable place to confirm expiration, especially if a pro is disputing a charge after their balance ran out.
Here is a table of expiration dates for free leads commonly granted: 
Program
Free lead expiration
BOSUP
90 days from the date leads are issued (after the 2-week period)
SOBU
90 days from the date leads are issued (after the 6-week period)
Seasonal Category*
30 days from when leads are granted
Targeting Expansion*
30 days from when leads are granted
Respond Quickly
30 days from when leads are granted
Get Reviews
30 days from when leads are granted

*Free leads can only be used in the specific category for free leads from this offer.
How pros track their offer progress
Offer Type
Progress Tracking Method
BOSUP and SOBU offers
A progress banner appears on the Budget page.  For example: 
"Keep this budget until [Date] at [Time] and your next [X] leads will be free."
"Maintain a weekly budget of at least $[X]. As a reward, your next [X] leads after [Date] will be free."
Seasonal category and targeting expansion recommendation cards
After accepting the offer, the card displays a counter showing X of Y free leads redeemed.
Respond Quickly and Get Reviews cards
After activating the offer, a progress bar appears at the bottom of the card showing progress toward completing the required action.
Pros have no designated place to view their overall free lead balance in-product. There is no notification when free leads are running low or have been fully used. If a pro contacts support because they were charged after expecting a free lead, reps should check the Discounts section in User Admin to confirm balance and expiration status (see Steps: How to check a pro's incentive status in Admin (Discounts section)), and direct the pro to their messenger to verify whether individual leads were free (see How pros can confirm a lead was free).
How pros can confirm a lead was free
Free leads do not appear on the pro's Payments page under activity or receipts because no charge was made. If a pro is looking for confirmation that a lead was free, they should check their messenger under the job details. Free leads are marked with: "Free. It's on us! You weren't charged for this lead."
▶ What a pro see

[Image: rtaImage]

This is important context to give pros proactively — if they're only checking their Payments page and not seeing the lead listed, that is expected and actually confirms it was free, not that something went wrong.
How free leads are applied

[Image: rtaImage]

▶ Breakdown of how free leads are applied
Free leads are credited automatically once the maintenance period or required action is completed. The next new lead the pro receives will be free, and this continues until all earned free leads are used.* Free leads are always applied before the pro's budget is used.
* Category restrictions
Free leads from seasonal categories and targeting expansion offers are category-restricted. 
They can only be applied to leads in the specific category that was added or the preference that was expanded. Leads received in other categories are charged normally.
Pros cannot choose which lead will be free. The free lead is applied automatically to the next qualifying lead they receive in the relevant expanded preference. This happens instantly — for example, if a pro expanded their targeting and received a new lead in that preference five minutes later, that lead would be free.
Lead types
Free leads from all programs apply to auto-charged leads only.** They do not apply to opt-in leads, opportunities, fixed-price jobs, or other lead types.
** Exception — BOSUP only: When a pro has an active BOSUP free lead balance and is out of budget, any lead they would normally receive as an opt-in is instead automatically granted as a free lead. The opt-in step is bypassed entirely, and the lead draws from the pro's free lead balance as if they had been charged normally. This continues until the free lead balance is used up.
When leads are generated
Free leads are only generated when a customer chooses to contact the pro. Completing a required action or finishing a maintenance period does not create leads — it only means the next leads the pro naturally receives will be free. If a pro asks why they haven't seen free leads after accepting an offer or completing an action, this is the most common explanation.
NOTE: Accepting an offer does not guarantee more leads or improve search ranking. The free leads apply to leads the pro would have received anyway, based on their existing visibility and how customers engage with their profile.
Free lead refunds and complimentary credits
Free leads have no cash value and cannot be refunded. Free leads cannot be re-issued or reinstated once used.
Free leads created through promotional discounts should be treated like paid leads when evaluating refund eligibility. Because no charge occurred, a complimentary credit might be issued instead of a refund. 
Common scenarios
Scenario
Policy
Pro used a free lead and wants it back
Free leads cannot be re-issued or reinstated once used
Pro wants a courtesy replacement for a “bad” lead
Free leads cannot be manually issued by reps — they are system-generated only. However, a courtesy credit may be applicable (see below)
Pro disputes that a lead used their free credit
Check the Discounts section (User Admin) and use the Applied_contact_pks from the Lead Incentives Query to identify exactly which leads the free credit was applied to.
KA: Investigating Lead Incentives in BigQuery (Pro) 
Pro was charged after free leads ran out
Charges after free lead balance is depleted or expired are valid. Confirm the balance and expiration date from the Discounts section in Admin, and direct the pro to check their messenger for confirmation that prior leads were marked free.
Pro wasn't notified that free leads ran out
There is currently no in-product notification when a free lead balance is exhausted. Acknowledge the frustration, confirm the balance and expiration details from Admin, and direct the pro to their messenger going forward to track free leads in real time.
Complimentary credits for promotional free leads

When a free lead was earned through a promotional discount and would otherwise have qualified for a refund under standard policy, a complimentary credit can be issued equal to the pre-discount lead price. This is a gap-fill solution since free leads cannot be re-issued.
This only applies to leads that were free due to a promotional discount. It does not apply to leads that were free for other reasons (e.g., inherently free syndication type, unintentful customer, expired contact). 

[Image: rtaImage]
▶ Guidelines

✅  When a complimentary credit applies
When a complimentary  credit applies — both of the following must be true:
The lead was free due to a promotional discount, AND 
The lead meets one of these criteria:
Standard refund eligibility. E.g., Service mismatch ("not what I do"), clearly outside the pro's scope of work, and so on
Invalid lead. E.g. Spam, duplicate, lead flagged by Trust & Safety (typically for TOU or User Guideline violation)
Refer to the Lead Refunds (Pro)  KA for standard refund eligibility. 
❌ When a complimentary credit does not apply:
A complimentary credit does NOT apply when: 
Lead was free for a non-promotional reason: Policy only covers promo discount free leads. (e.g., inherently free syndication type, unintentful customer, expired contact).
Lead is valid but pro is unhappy with the outcome: Not being hired or chosen is not a refund-eligible reason.
▶ Discounts on leads
Pros may receive a discount on leads for various reasons. The most common discounts appear in the Discounts section on the User Admin page. This section covers those offer-based discounts. 
Types of discounts

This section covers some of the ways a pro may receive a discount on leads. 
Unlimited budget discount

Eligible pros in underserved markets receive an ongoing percentage discount on leads for maintaining an unlimited weekly budget. The discount appears in the Discounts section as "Unlimited Budget 10% Off" and is revoked immediately if the pro switches back to a fixed budget.
For full details on how the discount works, how pros accept it, and talking points, see the Weekly Targeting Budget (Pro) KA.
New pro discounts 
All new pros signing up on or after May 11, 2026 automatically receive 25% off their first 12 leads, as long as those leads arrive within four weeks of their signup date. The discount appears in the Discounts section as "New Pro Incentive 25% Off".
For full details and talking points, see the Welcome Discount for New Pros KA.
General campaign and promotional discounts
Thumbtack periodically offers promotional discounts on leads tied to specific campaigns, partnerships, or business initiatives. These are time-limited and not always available. 
Common examples include:
Percentage-off campaigns — Pros may occasionally see offers for a percentage discount on leads up to a certain amount (e.g., 25% off leads up to $250). These are campaign-specific and not tied to budget or targeting behavior.
Important: The availability of these offers can change at any time. If a pro asks about a specific promotional offer that is no longer visible in their account, it may have expired or been removed. Reps should not promise specific promotional discounts will return.
How discounts are applied when a pro has multiple offers
Pros may hold more than one valid discount at a time — for example, a free lead balance from BOSUP and an Unlimited Budget Discount simultaneously. 
When a single contact qualifies for more than one discount, only one discount will be applied — the one with the highest discount value and the earliest expiration date.
This means free leads (100% off) will typically take priority over a percentage discount. Reps do not need to calculate this manually — the system applies it automatically.
If a pro questions which discount was used on a specific lead, reps can verify in the Discounts section (User Admin) or via the applied_contact_pks in the Lead Incentives Query. Steps in the Investigating Lead Incentives in BigQuery (Pro) KA. 
Reasons an Offer Is Voided (Free leads and discounts)

This section covers the specific actions that void a free lead offer before the pro earns their leads. Use this when a pro's offer shows as Not Completed in Admin and you need to explain why they didn't receive their free leads.

Budget incentive offers for free leads


Disqualification factor
Detail
Budget lowered before maintenance period ends
Applies even if lowered by $1. Most common reason*
Targeting turned off or paused
Includes hiding the business
Payment failure
Includes:
A declined card
An expired card being automatically removed
Removing the only card on file
Invalid card details

These three disqualification factors can be interconnected in ways that aren't always obvious to a pro. (e.g., A pro who has targeting turned on removes their only card on file to use their free leads but in order to remove the card they must hide their business). 
* The offer is immediately voided if the budget is decreased during the maintenance period. Pros who increase their budget must maintain that higher level throughout the remaining period. For instance, if a pro starts at $100 for a BOSUP offer but raises it to $150 after selecting "Accept & adjusts" for an overserved opt-in lead, lowering the budget back to $100 will disqualify them from the offer.
Refer to the internal Budget Increase Incentive (BOSUP & SOBU) (Pro) KA to learn more. 

▶ Talking points for void BOSUP offers:
General opening (use before explaining the specific reason):  "I took a look at your account and can see that your promotional offer was voided before the required maintenance period was completed. This means the free leads won't be issued. Let me explain what happened."
Pro lowered their budget:  "To earn the free leads, your budget needed to stay at or above $[X] for the full [2/3]-week period. Our records show your budget was lowered to $[X] on [date], which is before the [date] deadline. Because of that change, the offer was voided and the free leads weren't issued."
Pro turned off or paused targeting:  "To earn the free leads, your targeting preferences needed to stay on for the full maintenance period. Our records show that targeting was turned off on [date], which is before the [date] deadline. Because targeting was paused, the offer was voided and the free leads weren't issued."
Pro hid their business:  "To earn the free leads, your business needed to remain visible and active for the full maintenance period. Our records show your business was hidden on [date], which is before the [date] deadline. Because of that change, the offer was voided and the free leads weren't issued."

Recommendation offers for free leads:


Disqualification factor
Detail
Offer not completed within 30 days
Offer window closes and is no longer available
Refer to the internal Incentivized Recommendation Cards (Pro) KA to learn more. 

Unlimited Budget Discount

The unlimited budget discount is a long-term term discount, meaning pros keep the discount as long as they keep their budget set to unlimited. 


Disqualification factor
Detail
Pro switches back to a fixed budget
Discount is revoked immediately upon switching to a recommended or custom budget amount. Unlike BOSUP, there is no maintenance period — the discount is active only while the pro remains on unlimited and ends the moment they change

Important: If a pro switches back to a custom or fixed budget, the discount may not be offered again in the future. The pro will see a warning before confirming the change: "You'll lose your X% discount if you switch back to a fixed budget."
Refer to the internal Weekly Targeting Budget (Pro) KA to learn more. 

3. Processes
Steps: How to check a pro’s incentive status in Admin (“Discounts” in Admin)
Support reps will follow this process when a pro asks any of the following:
"Where are my free leads?"
"How many free leads do I have left?"
"When do my free leads expire?"
"Why was I charged — I thought I had free leads?"
Start here before checking the BOSUP Discount Offers table or running the lead incentives query.
Use this to view all active and past free lead and discount offers awarded to a pro. This section covers both free lead programs and percentage-based discounts.
Go to the pro's User Admin page
Scroll down to the Discounts section (below the account details)
Check the Recommendation type column to identify what type of offer the pro has — this determines what to look for next.
▶ Common types include:
Recommendation type
What it is
What to check next
Budget Incentive 100% Off
BOSUP free leads
Status, Free leads balance, Expires
[Category Name] 100% (e.g., "Local Moving 100% Off")
Targeting expansion or seasonal category offer (incentivized recommendations)
Status, Free leads balance, Expires, Category PK restriction
Unlimited Budget 10% Off
Unlimited Budget Discount
Status, Expires
New Pro Incentive 25% Off
New pro welcome discount — 25% off first 12 leads
Status, Free leads balance, Expires
Check the Status column for the relevant offer. 
Active: Offer is available — free leads or discount is currently applied
Depleted: All free leads have been used
Expired: Time limit for redemption has passed
If the offer has free leads: 
Check the Free leads (total / redeemed) column to find the remaining balance
Subtract the redeemed number from the total (e.g., 5 / 2 = 3 remaining)
Check the Expires column to confirm when the offer ends. This field is read-only and cannot be manually extended.
If the offer is a targeting expansion or seasonal category offer — check the Category PK restriction column. If a value is listed, free leads only apply to leads in that specific category.
Share the relevant details with the pro such as: 
Remaining balance
Expiration date
Offer type
Additional notes:
If the redeemed count didn't update: There may be a slight delay in the Admin UI — refresh the page. If it still hasn't updated and the offer is a category or targeting expansion offer, verify the lead matches the Category PK restriction.
To view contact IDs for awarded leads: Run the lead incentives query and refer to the applied_contact_pks column. All other columns from the query are already reflected in the Discounts section. For steps, see the Investigating Lead Incentives in BigQuery (Pro) KA.
Nothing appears in the Discounts section: The pro may be in the earning phase of a BOSUP or SOBU offer — free leads won't appear here until after the maintenance period is completed. Follow Steps: How to check a pro's BOSUP offer status in Admin.
Steps: How to check a pro’s BOSUP offer status in Admin (BOSUP Discount Offers)

Follow this process when a pro asks any of the following:
"I accepted a budget offer — when do I get my free leads?"
"I'm maintaining my budget but haven't received my free leads yet"
"Did I qualify for the free leads from my offer?"
"Why didn't I get my free leads after increasing my budget?"

The BOSUP Discount Offers section in Admin is useful to check whether a pro successfully met the requirements for a budget incentive offer and when their free leads will or did become available. This table only shows BOSUP and SOBU offers — recommendation and discount offers are not shown here.
Note: BOSUP offers currently in the earning phase reside in this table and only move to the Discounts section once the maintenance period is finalized. 
Go to the pro's Business Admin page
In Admin, navigate to the Models section in the left-hand navigation menu
Select the Businesses tab
Enter the pro's Business PK or business name and click Search Businesses
If needed, locate the Business PK from the pro's main User Admin page under the Businesses / Services field
Scroll down to the BOSUP Discount Offers table
Find the relevant offer in the table
Check the Offer Status column
Available: Offer is active but the pro hasn't accepted it yet. Let them know the offer is waiting for them
Accepted and Pending: Pro accepted and is in their maintenance period — free leads not yet awarded. Tell them to maintain their budget until the date in the "Free leads grant date" column
Completed: Pro met the requirements and leads have been issued.
Check the Discounts section in User Admin for redemption details
Not Completed: Pro accepted but didn't meet the requirements: 
See Steps: How to investigate a pro's missing free leads after accepting a budget incentive offer in the Budget Increase Incentive (BOSUP & SOBU) (Pro) KA
Expired: Pro didn't accept the offer before the deadline. Offer is no longer available
If the status is Accepted and Pending: Direct the pro to their Budget page where a progress banner shows the exact date and time they need to maintain their budget until, and how many free leads they will receive. For example: "Keep this budget until [Date] at [Time] and your next [X] leads will be free."
If the status is Completed: Go to the Discounts section on the User Admin page to check redemption status and remaining balance. Follow the Steps: How to check a pro’s incentive status in Admin (“Discounts” in Admin).

Note: The BOSUP Discount Offers table has additional columns beyond Offer Status — including Type of Offer, Accepted Time, Free Lead Count, and Accepted Budget Limit — that are useful when investigating a specific offer in detail. For a full breakdown of every column, see the Budget Increase Incentive (BOSUP & SOBU) (Pro) KA.
Steps: How to view a pro's free lead balance in Admin (Rep)
Follow this process when a pro asks any of the following:
"How many free leads do I have left?"
"When do my free leads expire?"
"Have I used any of my free leads?"

Support reps should start here before running the lead incentives query — this information is available directly in Admin without needing to run a query. The Discounts section shows how many free leads a pro has left, and when they expire.
From the pro’s main User page, scroll down to the Discounts section (below the account details).
Find the relevant offer using the Recommendation type column to identify the offer type.
Check the Status column.
Active: Pro has free leads remaining. 
Depleted: Pro used all their free leads. 
Expired: Free leads expired before being used.
If the status is Active, look at the Free leads (total / redeemed) column and subtract the redeemed number from the total to find the remaining balance.
Example: 5 / 2 means the pro was given 5 leads, used 2, and has 3 remaining
Check the Expires column to confirm when the remaining leads expire.
Share the remaining balance and expiration date with the pro.
Steps: How to help a pro who reports missing free leads (Rep)

Follow this process when a pro asks any of the following:
"Where did my free leads go?"
"I had free leads but now they're gone"
"I accepted an offer but never received my free leads"
"I completed the action but didn't get my free leads"
This process helps support reps identify what happened with the pro's offer — whether they used their leads, their leads expired, they're still in the earning phase, or their offer was voided before leads were granted.
Check the Discounts section (User Admin) 
Go to the pro's User Admin page.
Scroll to the Discounts section. 
Check the Recommendation type field first to identify what type of offer the pro has, then check the Status column.
Budget Incentive 100% Off: BOSUP free leads
[Category Name] 100% (e.g., "Local Moving 100% Off"): Targeting expansion or seasonal category offer
Unlimited Budget 10% Off: Unlimited Budget Discount
New Pro Incentive 25% Off: New pro welcome discount
Then check the Status:
Active: Pro has free leads remaining. 
Check the Free leads (total / redeemed) column. 
Subtract redeemed from total to find the remaining balance. 
Guide the pro on how free leads are applied (next qualifying lead is automatically free).
Depleted: Pro used all their free leads. 
Confirm how many were granted and when they were used using the Free leads (total / redeemed) column. 
Share the details with the pro.
Expired: Free leads expired before being used.
Confirm the expiration date from the Expires column and share it with the pro.
Nothing appears: No free leads have been awarded yet. The pro may be in their earning phase or their offer may have been voided before leads were granted. Move to Step 2.
Check the BOSUP Discount Offers table (Business Admin): If the Discounts section shows nothing, the pro may have a budget incentive offer that is still in the earning phase — free leads won't appear in the Discounts section until after the maintenance period is successfully completed
Go to the pro's Business Admin page.
Scroll to the BOSUP Discount Offers table.
Check the Offer Status column
Accepted and Pending – Pro accepted a budget incentive offer and is in their maintenance period. Free leads haven't been awarded yet — this is expected.
Tell the pro to maintain their budget until the date in the "Free leads grant date" column. 
Direct them to their Budget page to track progress.
Not Completed – Pro accepted but didn't meet the requirements. Free leads were not awarded.
See Steps: How to investigate a pro's missing free leads after accepting a budget incentive offer in the Investigating Lead Incentives in BigQuery (Pro) KA for full investigation steps.
Expired – Pro didn't accept the offer before the deadline.
Let the pro know the offer is no longer available.
Nothing appears – No BOSUP or SOBU offer exists for this pro. The pro may be referring to a recommendation offer that was never completed or expired before they took action. 
Check the offer expiration with the pro. If the lead appears eligible but wasn't free, move to Step 3.
If the pro believes a specific lead should have been free but was charged: Follow  Steps: How to troubleshoot why a lead wasn't free in this KA.
If you suspect a product issue: Follow Steps: How to report an issue with free leads (Rep) in this KA.
Steps: How to help pro who disputes using their free leads (Rep)
Follow this process when a pro asks any of the following:
"I don't think I used that many free leads"
"Which leads were free?"
"I was charged for a lead but I should have had free leads"
"Can you show me proof that my free leads were used?"

Support rep should start with the Discounts section in Admin — most disputes can be resolved by sharing the details already available there. The lead incentives query is only needed if the pro needs to know which specific leads their free credit was applied to.
This process is useful when a pro disagrees with how their free leads were applied or believes a lead was charged that should have been free.
Go to the pro's User Admin page and scroll to the Discounts section
Find the relevant offer and review the following fields to share with the pro:
Free leads (total / redeemed) — how many were granted and how many have been used
Awarded — when the free leads were added to their account
Expires — when unused leads will be removed
Recommendation type — which offer the leads came from
Share these details with the pro — all information in the Discounts section can be shared upon request
If the pro still disputes which specific leads their free credit was applied to, you'll need the contact PKs — go to the Investigating Lead Incentives in BigQuery (Pro) KA and run the lead incentives query.
In the query results, refer to the applied_contact_pks column to identify the exact leads the discount was applied to.
All data from the query results can be shared with the pro upon request — do not share screenshots of the query tool
If after reviewing the details the lead appears eligible but wasn't discounted, follow Steps: How to troubleshoot why a lead wasn't free in this KA
Steps: How to troubleshoot why a lead wasn't free (Rep)
Follow this process when a pro asks any of the following:
"I have free leads but I was still charged for this lead"
"Why wasn't this lead free?"
"I have an active offer but the lead wasn't discounted"
Work through each step in order before moving to the next — in most cases the answer will be found before reaching the end.
If a pro believes a lead should have been free but was charged, use these steps in order to identify the reason. Work through each step before moving to the next.
Confirm the lead type. Free leads apply to auto-charged leads only. 
Opt-in contacts, opportunity leads, fixed-price jobs, and other lead types are not covered by any free lead or discount offer. 
If the lead was one of these types, the charge is valid.
NOTE: See BOSUP exception above. 
Confirm the offer was active at the time of the lead. Check the Discounts section (User Admin). 
Look at the Status column and the Expires date for the relevant offer. 
If the status shows DEPLETED or EXPIRED, the free lead balance was either fully used or had already lapsed when the lead came in — the charge is valid.
Check whether the lead matched the category restriction. Look at the Category PK restriction field in the Discounts section. 
If a value is listed, the offer is restricted to that specific category. 
If the lead the pro received was in a different category, it would not have been covered by the free lead balance and the charge is valid. This is the most common reason a lead isn't free for targeting expansion and seasonal category offers.
Check whether multiple discounts were in play. If the pro held more than one active offer, only one discount would have been applied — the one with the highest value and earliest expiration. 
To confirm which offer was applied to a specific lead, run the lead incentives query and check the applied_contact_pks column against the lead in question. (For steps, see Investigating Lead Incentives in BigQuery (Pro) KA)
If the lead appears eligible but was still charged. If the lead was an auto-charged lead in the correct category, the offer was active and not depleted or expired, and the charge still appears valid — this may be a product issue. 
Follow Steps: How to report an issue with free leads (Rep) in this KA.
Steps: How to request a complimentary credit on a free lead (Rep)
Follow this process when all of the following are true:
The pro received a lead that was free due to a promotional discount
The lead would have qualified for a refund under standard refund policy (e.g., service mismatch, spam, duplicate)
The pro is asking for compensation since the lead cannot be re-issued
Reps cannot issue complimentary credits directly. Before contacting AST, reps must confirm eligibiity conditions and calculate the credit amount themselves. AST will verify the lead qualifies and that the credit amount is correct before issuing it.
Confirm the lead was free due to a promotional discount 
Go to the Discounts section in User Admin. If nothing appears here, the lead was free for a non-promotional reason (for example, an inherently free syndication type, unintentful customer, or expired contact) — the complimentary credit policy does not apply. Stop here.
If an offer appears in the Discounts section, run the Lead Incentives Query in BigQuery and check the applied_contact_pks column to confirm the specific lead PK was covered by that promotional discount offer. Steps on Investigating Lead Incentives in BigQuery (Pro) KA
Confirm the lead meets refund eligibility criteria" Evaluate the lead using standard refund eligibility logic. The lead must meet at least one of the following:
Standard refund eligible (e.g., service mismatch, clearly outside the pro's scope of work)
Invalid lead (e.g., spam, duplicate, flagged by Trust & Safety)
If the lead does not meet either criteria, stop here — a courtesy credit does not apply.
Calculate the credit amount 
Navigate to the Negotiations page.
Scroll down to the Contact section. 
Under Contact Price Details, locate the price_multiplier field. 
The value is in cents — divide by 100 to get the dollar amount (e.g., 2310 → $23.10).
Note this amount before contacting AST.
Contact AST to issue the credit: Reach out to the Advanced Support Team via #service_global_help-and-escalations with the following information:
Action: "Providing complimentary credits for free lead"
Reasoning: Why the lead is eligible (e.g., in-policy refund eligible, spam, duplicate)
Bid: Bid_pk
Credit amount: Dollar amount calculated in Step 3
Credit grant reason: Courtesy grant
AST will confirm the lead qualifies and that the credit amount is correct before issuing it. Do not contact AST solely to ask for approval if eligibility criteria are clearly met — complete Steps 1 through 3 first.
General talking point for re-issuance requests: 
"Free leads can't be re-issued once they've been used — they're applied automatically and can't be manually reinstated. However, if the lead itself falls under our refund policy, I can look into whether a credit can be added to your Thumbtack balance. Let me check the details of the lead and I'll let you know what we can do."
Steps: How to report an issue with free leads (Rep)
Follow this process when any of the following apply:
A pro's lead appears eligible for a free lead or discount but was still charged and none of the troubleshooting steps resolved it
The Admin tool is showing unexpected or incorrect information about a pro's offer
You believe the behavior is a product bug rather than a user error
Do not reach out to the #budget-over-serving-upsell channel for questions. Use the steps below to route the issue correctly.
Review the KAs available for the specific offer the pro was provided. Here is a list of common KAs with special offers: 
Budget Increase Incentive (BOSUP & SOBU) (Pro) KA
Incentivized Recommendation Cards (Pro) KA
Welcome Discount for New Pros KA
Confirm whether the behavior is a bug or feedback.
Follow the standard bug reporting process to troubleshoot if it’s a bug (For steps, see Bugs and Bug Reports (Rep) KA)
Follow the standard process for submitting feedback. (for steps, see Product Feedback (Rep) KA. )
For urgent or escalated issues, contact the Advanced Support Team via #service_global_help-and-escalations. For steps, refer to the internal Requesting Help from the Advanced Service Team (Rep) KA.

Benefits of uploading insurance

How to upload insurance and verification
What customers see
Insurance upload failed 
Insurance expiration
Resources
1. Overview
▶ KA summary
This internal knowledge article (KA) details the launch of the new Credentials Insurance feature. This feature provides a "Business Insurance" section in the pro's Credentials profile, allowing them to upload a Certificate of Insurance (COI). At this time, the insurance information is not visible to customers on the pro's public profile. Thumbtack uses this information internally to verify the pro's eligibility for exclusive jobs from top demand partners.
On November 24, 2025, Thumbtack launched the new insurance credential feature, giving all pros the option to upload their Certificate of Insurance (COI). A Certificate of Insurance (or COI) is a document issued by an insurance company that provides proof of insurance coverage.
All pros can navigate to the Credentials section of their profile and upload their Certificate of Insurance (COI) using the new "Business Insurance" option.

[Image: rtaImage]

The immediate benefit of uploading their COI is that it is required to be eligible for exclusive job opportunities from Thumbtack’s top demand partners (e.g., Samsung, Moen, and Midea). This allows established, insured pros to access a new source of high-value demand.
At this time, customers will not see any information about the pro's insurance at this time (no credentials section with insurance info or an insurance badge) on the public profile.
For a closer look at the process, reps can refer to the Pro experience section. Reps can learn more about some of Thumbtack’s demand partners by referring to the following internal knowledge articles: 
Moen Smart Filter Partnership (Customer) (Pro) (Pilot)|
Samsung TToD Partnership (Reps) (Pros) (Customer) (Pilot) 
Midea air conditioning recall repair program (timed partnership) (Pro)
Why
The goal of the Credentials Insurance feature is to enable pros to upload their insurance information. The primary driver for this feature is to make pros eligible for exclusive job opportunities from top demand partners (e.g., Samsung, Moen, Midea, Weber) who require pros to be insured.
Benefits of uploading insurance
When pros upload their insurance to their profile, they typically see the following benefits 
Unlock Exclusive, High-Value Jobs: Uploading their Certificate of Insurance (COI) is required to be eligible for exclusive job opportunities from Thumbtack’s top demand partners (e.g., Samsung, Moen, Midea, Weber). This allows established, insured pros to access a new source of demand and gain a competitive edge.
Accepted certificates of insurance
Thumbtack allows pros to upload various certificates of business insurance (COIs). While all valid COIs listed on the certificate are accepted, Thumbtack's primary area of focus is general liability insurance. Pros can upload multiple certificates of insurance, but each one must be uploaded individually.
This section briefly outlines the common types of insurance a pro might upload.  

Insurance Type
Description (What it typically covers)
General Liability
Confirms coverage for third-party bodily injury and property damage that may occur on a business's premises or due to its operations.
Workers' Compensation
Provides proof of coverage for employees who suffer job-related injuries or illnesses.
Commercial Auto
Shows coverage for vehicles used for business purposes, including owned, leased, or hired vehicles.
Umbrella
Shows that the policyholder has an extra layer of liability coverage beyond the limits of their primary policies (like general liability and auto).
Professional Liability
Verifies coverage for claims of negligence, errors, or omissions in the professional services provided. This is also known as Errors & Omissions (E&O) insurance.
Business Owners Policy (BOP)
A single certificate that can show both general liability and commercial property insurance are in place.
Pros can typically obtain an insurance certificate by contacting their insurance company directly, working with an insurance agent or broker, or using their insurer's online portal if available. Most insurers can provide the certificate via email or post upon request.
Insurance requirements 
A pro's Certificate of Insurance (COI) must meet these requirements for submission:
Document type: Upload only a Certificate of Insurance (COI). This is usually in the format of ACORD 25. Quotes, invoices, or policy declaration pages are not accepted.
Date Format: Dates must use a 4-digit year (e.g., "02/27/2025"). Documents using a 2-digit year (e.g., "02/27/25") are unsupported and will cause an upload error.
Single Dates Only: The "Policy Effective" and "Policy Expiration" fields must contain only one date each. Multiple dates or date ranges in a single field will cause the document to process as expired or fail.
Content: The COI must include the insurance type, the insurance policy number, and the coverage amount.
Standard Policy Types: The "Type of Insurance" section on the COI should use standard ACORD 25 labels (e.g., General Liability). Handwritten or "Custom" policy types written into the form may fail automated data extraction.
Clarity: The document must be clear and easy to read.
Business name: The business name on the COI must match the pro's business name on their Thumbtack profile.
Expiration: The document must include a valid expiration date (if applicable).
File format: The upload must be a PDF, JPG, or PNG file up to 10 MB.
Insurance upload process and statuses
This section describes what the pro sees after uploading an insurance document.

▶ What some of the statuses look like under the Business Insurance field

[Image: rtaImage]

Failed insurance upload and error messages

An insurance upload can fail for several reasons:
Document type: The document was not a Certificate of Insurance (COI) or is missing key information (e.g., insurance type or policy number).
Clarity: The uploaded image was blurry, dark, or illegible.
Business name: The business name on the COI does not match the pro's Thumbtack business name.
Expiration:  The expiration date was missing. The policy has expired.
File format: The file is not a supported format (PDF, JPG, PNG) or is larger than 10 MB.
▶ Error messages:
General failure: "Something went wrong – please try again.”
Incorrect file type: “This file type isn’t supported. Try again with a PDF, JPG, or PNG.”
Desktop error: “Document upload failed. Try again.”
If an upload fails, the pro will receive an email instructing them to try uploading the document again, ensuring it meets all requirements. Encourage pros to resubmit after waiting a couple of minutes. 
Troubleshooting: Common Valid-Document Failures
If a pro's document appears clear and valid but continues to fail, reps can check for these specific formatting triggers:
2-Digit Years: Check the Expiration Date column. If the year is written as two digits (e.g., "25"), the system cannot read it. 
Action: Advise the pro to request a COI from their broker with the full 4-digit year (e.g., "2025").
Multiple Dates: Check the Effective/Expiration date boxes. Are there multiple dates listed for a single policy? 
Action: Advise the pro to ensure only one specific date is listed in these fields.
Custom Policy Types: Check the "Type of Insurance" column. Is there a custom or handwritten policy type (e.g., "Special Event Coverage") that doesn't match standard checkboxes?
Action: The system likely cannot extract this non-standard text. Advise the pro to upload a document highlighting standard General Liability or Workers' Comp coverage.
Missing Policy Details: Ensure the policy number field is not blank. A COI without a specific policy number (or labeled "TBD") will fail.
Insurance expiration and renewal process
This section details the process for handling expired insurance.
Expiration: When the insurance expires, the pro will see a red (Expired) pill. 
Partner Job Eligibility: When a pro’s insurance expires, their eligibility for partner jobs that require insurance will be paused.
Renewal: A pro's insurance information is not automatically updated. They must manually upload their new, valid COI to their profile to reinstate the credential and partner job eligibility.
Pro experience 
This section outlines the differences in the pro experience for the 50/50 onboarding prompt experiment.
All pros will see the new 'Business Insurance' feature in their profile's 'Credentials' section. Here’s an overview of the insurance upload flow.
Entry Point: Pros navigate to the Credentials section of their profile (available on web and iOS, and Android) and select the new "Business Insurance" option.
▶ What the Credentials section of a pros profile looks like

[Image: rtaImage]

Document Upload: Pros are prompted to upload their Certificate of Insurance (COI) document. The upload flow requires the pro to upload their COI document and select a "Form type" (e.g., ACORD 25 or Other). 
▶ What the "add your business insurance" screen looks like

[Image: rtaImage]
[Image: rtaImage]

Document Requirements: On the backend, Thumbtack uses a system (DocSumi) to extract key details (e.g., insurance type, policy number, expiration date).The document must meet key requirements for the system to process it successfully. Reps can refer to the + Insurance requirements + section above. 
IMPORTANT: Thumbtack only saves the necessary data required to determine eligibility for partner jobs (like insurance type and expiration date). Sensitive information like the full policy number and insurer details are NOT shared with customers or saved beyond what is needed for eligibility checks. 
Upload Statuses: Once uploaded, the pro will see one of the following internal statuses next to their insurance credential:
Processing: We’re processing [file name])
Successful upload: Valid until mm/dd/yyyy) 
For other status, reps can refer to the Insurance upload process and statuses section. 
Failure: If the upload fails, the pro will see an error message and receive an email prompting them to try again, ensuring the document meets all requirements. Common reasons for failure include the document being too blurry or the wrong file type.
Customer experience
At this time, customers will not see any information about the pro's insurance at this time (no credentials section with insurance info or an insurance badge) on the public profile.
2. Process
Steps: How to upload insurance (Pro)
To upload their Certificate of Insurance, pros will follow these steps:
Navigate to your profile.
Scroll down to the Credentials section.
Select "Add" in the Business Insurance section. 
If adding additional insurance, pros will click “Edit” and then “Add additional insurance.” 
On the "Add your business insurance" screen, review the document requirements. (Accepted files: PDF, JPG, PNG, up to 10 MB).
Select "Choose file" to upload the COI document. 
Select the "Form type" from the dropdown menu (e.g., ACORD 25 or Other)
Click “Submit.” 
The system will process the document and the pro will see a "Processing..." state in their Credentials section. 
If successful: The pro will receive a success message and email. 
If rejected: The pro will receive an error message and an email prompting them to try again.
Frontline rep can share the How to add my business insurance – Thumbtack Help article with pros for steps and additional information.
Steps: How to edit or delete insurance (Pro)
To manage existing insurance documents, pros will follow these steps:
Navigate to your profile.
Scroll down to the Credentials section.
Click Edit.
To delete an insurance: Click the trash can icon next to the insurance you want to remove. Click "Delete" to confirm.
To add a new insurance: Click "Add additional insurance".
Frontline rep can share the How to add my business insurance – Thumbtack Help article with pros for steps on how to manage their insurance.  
▶ What the credentials section looks like when in “edit”

[Image: rtaImage]

Steps: How to view insurance in Admin (Rep)
When a pro contacts support regarding a failed insurance upload or claims their valid document is being rejected, frontline reps will follow these steps: 
By navigating to the Insurance section in Admin, you can view the actual file image the pro uploaded. This allows reps to visually inspect the document for formatting triggers (such as 2-digit years or unclear text) that cause the automated system to fail.
Navigate to the User's page in Admin.
Scroll down to the Insurance field (located directly below the Licenses section).
Review the summary table. 
Here you can see high-level details including:
Policy #
Insurance Type
Insurer
Effective & Expiration Dates
Created Date
▶ What the “Insurance” section in Admin looks like

[Image: rtaImage]

View Expanded Details: 
Click “Show” in the Details column to open an expanded table containing technical info such as Policy ID, Business ID, and deletion logs (Deleted At, Delete Reason).
View Uploaded Documents: 
Click View docs to see file metadata.
Info visible: File Name, Upload Date, and Verification Time.
Note on Verification: You will likely see "Not verified." We are not verifying insurance at this time; this status is expected.
See the actual file: Scroll to the bottom of this view to see the image or PDF the pro uploaded.
Troubleshoot & Diagnose: (Crucial Step)
With the file image open, compare it against the Troubleshooting: Common valid document failures section above).
Look specifically for 2-digit years (e.g., '25), multiple dates in a single field, or handwritten policy types.. These are the most common causes of rejection for valid-looking documents.
Advise the pro on the specific format change needed based on your visual review.
NOTE: Reps should not delete a pro's insurance. While a "Trash Can" icon is visible under the Actions column, reps should not use this feature.
3. Talking points

This section provides Frontline Reps with approved talking points for communicating with pros about the feature to upload their certificate of insurance. Use these talking points to ensure consistent and accurate messaging.

Benefits of uploading insurance
This section provides frontline reps with talking points to explain the advantages pros receive by uploading their Certificate of Insurance (COI), primarily focusing on eligibility for exclusive job opportunities from Thumbtack's demand partners.



English talking point
Spanish talking point 
Q: Why should I add my business insurance?
Q: ¿Por qué debo agregar el seguro de mi negocio?
A: Adding your insurance helps you unlock exclusive job opportunities from top partners who require pros to be insured. 
A: Agregar su seguro le ayuda a obtener acceso a oportunidades de trabajo exclusivas con socios importantes que requieren que los profesionales tengan seguro.
Q: What kind of exclusive jobs are unlocked from Thumbtack's partners? 
Q: ¿Qué tipo de trabajos exclusivos se desbloquean con los socios de Thumbtack?
A: Some of our trusted partners require pros to be insured. Pros who are insured can gain exclusive access to work with these partners, which allows them to connect directly with the partners' customers for installation and maintenance jobs. Uploading your insurance can improve your chances of getting these exclusive job opportunities from our partners. For example, you can unlock:
Plumbing jobs with Moen
Appliance Repair jobs with Midea (or Samsung)
Future opportunities coming soon in categories like HVAC jobs, Electrical work, and more.
A: Algunos de nuestros socios de confianza requieren que los profesionales tengan seguro. Los profesionales asegurados pueden acceder a oportunidades exclusivas para trabajar con estos socios, lo que les permite conectarse directamente con sus clientes para realizar trabajos de instalación y mantenimiento. Subir su póliza de seguro puede aumentar sus posibilidades de obtener estas oportunidades exclusivas. Por ejemplo, puede desbloquear:
Trabajos de plomería con Moen
Trabajos de reparación de electrodomésticos con Midea (o Samsung)
Futuras oportunidades en categorías como HVAC, trabajos eléctricos y más.

Insurance types accepted
This section provides frontline reps with talking points about the types of business insurance certificates (COIs) Thumbtack accepts and which types are the primary focus for the platform.



English talking point
Spanish talking point 
Q: What types of insurance can I upload? 
Q: ¿Qué tipos de seguros puedo subir?
A: You can upload your Certificate of Insurance (COI). We are currently focusing on general liability insurance, but partners may also have requirements for commercial auto liability, workers' compensation, or umbrella insurance. We accept common file types like PDF, JPG, and PNG, up to 10 MB. Please ensure the document is clear and easy to read.
A: Puede subir su certificado de seguro (COI). Actualmente nos enfocamos en el seguro de responsabilidad civil general, pero algunos socios también pueden requerir seguro de responsabilidad civil comercial por vehículos de trabajo, compensación laboral o seguro general adicional (umbrella).
Aceptamos tipos de archivo comunes como PDF, JPG y PNG, de hasta 10 MB, y el documento debe ser claro y fácil de leer.
Q: What if I have more than one certificate of insurance? Can I upload multiple?
Q: ¿Qué pasa si tengo más de un certificado de seguro? ¿Puedo subir varios?
A: Yes. You can add multiple types of business insurance, such as General Liability and Workers Compensation to your profile. You can upload each document one at a time by selecting "Add additional insurance" in the "Edit" menu.
A: Sí. Puede agregar varios tipos de seguros comerciales, como responsabilidad civil general y compensación laboral, a su perfil. Puede subir cada documento uno por uno seleccionando Add additional insurance (“Agregar otro seguro”) en el menú Edit (“Editar”).
Q: What if my insurance type isn't in the "Form type" drop-down menu?
Q: ¿Qué pasa si el tipo de seguro que tengo no aparece en el menú desplegable “Form type”?
A: We are launching this feature by focusing on the insurance types most commonly required by our partners, such as General Liability, Workers' Compensation, and Commercial Auto. If your specific insurance type isn't listed, it means it's not one we are set up to upload at this time as we expand this new feature. You can still share that information on your profile in your photos, introduction, or FAQs as usual.

[Reps should submit the pros Product Feedback ]
A: Estamos lanzando esta función concentrándonos primero en los tipos de seguro más solicitados por nuestros socios, como responsabilidad civil general, compensación laboral y responsabilidad civil comercial por vehículos de trabajo.
Si su tipo de seguro no aparece, significa que aún no lo aceptamos en esta fase. Aun así, puede incluir esa información en su perfil dentro de las secciones de fotos, introducción o preguntas frecuentes.

[Reps should submit the pros Product Feedback ]
Q: What if my business name on Thumbtack doesn’t match my certificate of insurance?
¿Qué pasa si el nombre de mi negocio en Thumbtack no coincide con el de mi certificado de seguro?
A: The business name on your Certificate of Insurance must match the business name listed on your Thumbtack profile. If your business name recently changed, please update your Thumbtack profile first before uploading the document. 
El nombre de su negocio en el certificado de seguro (COI) debe coincidir con el nombre que aparece en su perfil de Thumbtack. Si cambió recientemente el nombre de su negocio, actualice primero su perfil antes de subir el documento.

How to upload insurance 
This section provides frontline reps with talking points to guide pros through the process of uploading their Certificate of Insurance (COI) and to explain the necessary document requirements for successful processing.


English talking point
Spanish talking point 
Q: Is uploading my insurance required? 
Q: ¿Es obligatorio subir mi seguro?
A: Uploading insurance is not mandatory. However, we highly recommend it if you are in a category where our partners require it. Uploading your COI makes you eligible for those exclusive jobs, which you would not receive otherwise. If you do not have insurance, you can simply skip this optional step.
A: No es obligatorio. Sin embargo, lo recomendamos si pertenece a una categoría en la que nuestros socios lo solicitan. Subir su COI lo hace elegible para trabajos exclusivos que de otro modo no recibiría. Si no tiene seguro, puede omitir este paso opcional.
Q: How do I upload my insurance? 
Q: ¿Cómo subo mi seguro?
A: You can upload your Certificate of Insurance (COI) through the credentials section of your profile.

For information about document requirements and managing your insurance, check out our Help Center article on business insurance. 
A:  Puede subir su certificado de seguro (COI) desde la sección de credenciales en su perfil.
Para obtener más información sobre los requisitos del documento y cómo administrar su seguro, consulte nuestro artículo del Centro de ayuda sobre seguro comercial.
Q: What happens after I upload my insurance document? 
Q: ¿Qué sucede después de subir mi documento de seguro?
A: Once you upload your document, our system will process it, and you'll see a "Processing..." state on the screen. 

If it's successful, you’ll receive a message and an email of successful upload once the upload is complete. If it's rejected (e.g., the image was blurry), you'll receive an error message and be prompted to try again. We recommend waiting a couple of minutes before attempting to re-upload the document. 
A: Una vez que suba el documento, nuestro sistema lo procesará y verá el estado “Processing…” (“Procesando…”) en la pantalla.
Si la carga es exitosa, recibirá un mensaje y un correo electrónico de confirmación. Si es rechazada (por ejemplo, si la imagen está borrosa), recibirá un mensaje de error y una solicitud para intentarlo de nuevo. Le recomendamos esperar unos minutos antes de volver a subir el documento.

What customers see
This section provides frontline reps with talking points to clarify what insurance information, if any, is visible to customers on the pro's public profile.



English talking point
Spanish talking point 
Q: Do I get an "Insured" badge in search results, like the "Licensed" badge?
Q: ¿Recibo una insignia de “Asegurado” en los resultados de búsqueda, como la de “Licenciado”?
A: That's a great question. At this time, no information about your insurance is visible to customers on your public profile or in search results. The immediate benefit of uploading your Certificate of Insurance (COI) is that it is required to be eligible for exclusive job opportunities from Thumbtack’s top demand partners.
A: Por ahora, no se muestra ninguna información sobre su seguro en su perfil público ni en los resultados de búsqueda.
El beneficio inmediato de subir su certificado de seguro (COI) es que es requisito para acceder a trabajos exclusivos de los socios con mayor demanda en Thumbtack.

Insurance upload failed 
This section provides frontline reps with talking points to address common reasons why an insurance upload may fail, and the corresponding error messages or follow-up instructions the pro will receive.



English talking point
Spanish talking point 
Q: Why weren’t you able to upload my certificate of insurance?
Q: ¿Por qué no se pudo subir mi certificado de seguro?
A: An upload can fail for several common reasons. The most common are: 

Image Quality: The uploaded image was blurry, dark, or illegible.
Wrong Document: The document was not a Certificate of Insurance (COI).
Missing Date: The expiration date was missing from the document.
Unsupported Date Format: The date used a 2-digit year (e.g., '25) instead of the required 4-digit year (e.g., 2025).
Confusing Dates: The ‘Effective’ or ‘Expiration’ fields listed a range or multiple dates instead of a single, specific date.
Please review your document to ensure it meets these criteria and try uploading a clear, new image
A: Una carga puede fallar por varias razones comunes. Las más frecuentes son:
Calidad de la imagen: La imagen cargada estaba borrosa, oscura o no se podía leer.
Documento incorrecto: El documento no era un Certificado de Seguro (COI, por sus siglas en inglés).
Falta la fecha: Faltaba la fecha de vencimiento.
Formato de fecha no compatible: La fecha usaba un año de 2 dígitos (por ejemplo, “25”) en lugar del año de 4 dígitos requerido (por ejemplo, 2025).
Fechas confusas: Los campos “Effective” o “Expiration” mostraban un rango o varias fechas en lugar de una sola fecha específica.
Revise su documento para confirmar que cumple con estos criterios e intente cargar una imagen nueva y clara del documento correcto y vigente.

Insurance expiration
This section provides frontline reps with talking points to explain the process for insurance expiration, including when pros are notified and what happens to their eligibility for partner jobs.



English talking point
Spanish talking point 
Q: What happens when my certificate of insurance expires?
Q: ¿Qué pasa cuando vence mi certificado de seguro?
A: When your insurance expires, you will see the expired status next to your uploaded insurance. Importantly, your eligibility for partner jobs that require insurance will be paused. To fix this, you will need to manually upload your new, valid Certificate of Insurance to your Credentials section.
A: Cuando su seguro venza, verá el estado “Expirado” junto al documento subido.
Su elegibilidad para trabajos con socios que requieren seguro se pausará.
Para solucionarlo, deberá subir manualmente su nuevo certificado de seguro válido en la sección de credenciales de su perfil.
4. Resources
Frontline Reps will find a collection of valuable resources in this section, including links to internal knowledge articles, external Help Center articles, and other relevant documentation. These resources may be referenced in the article or provide additional, related information.
