articles.fullText:
Instant Deposits (Pro)

Contents
Overview
Eligibility requirements for instant deposits
Instant payout timeframe
Standard payout deposit schedule (multiple transactions in single deposit)
Benefits
Pro experience
Key points
Process
(Pro) Steps: How to initiate an instant payout 
(Sales team) Value props for eligible pros
(Rep) Steps: How to override payout verification
Talking points
Instant deposit eligibility requirements
Fees
Payout window (instant vs standard)
Debit card type
Pro doesn’t see instant deposit option (passed 24 hours window)
Pro had multiple transactions grouped together as single deposit
Resources

1. Overview
Pros can receive customer payments in 30 minutes instead of the normal 3-4 business days with instant deposits, even on weekends and bank holidays, for a 1% fee. 
Before pros can use instant deposits, they must meet a few requirements first. Only instant deposits are sent to a debit card while standard payouts will be sent to their regular bank account. 
Pros are required to set up direct deposit for Instant Deposits. Additionally, both Claimable Jobs and in product payments (using Thumbtack Pay) are eligible for instant deposits. 
IMPORTANT: Before any Frontline reps post any payment-related questions in Slack channels, frontline reps must first follow the steps on the Support for Payment Related Inquiries KA.

Eligibility requirements for instant deposit 
Pros must meet the following requirements before they’re eligible to set up instant payouts:
Complete and pass a background check (with or without SSN)
1 verified Thumbtack customer review 
Receive at least $1,000 in payment transactions through Thumbtack pay
Have at least three successful standard payout deposits (through Stripe) 
See Standard payout deposit schedule (multiple transactions in single deposit) section below
Have a debit card on their Thumbtack account
Once eligible, pros must add a debit card to receive instant deposits. A pro’s debit card must be a non-prepaid Visa, Mastercard, or Discover card issued by a bank in the United States. Only instant deposits will be sent to the debit card and have a 1% fee. Standard payouts will be sent to their regular bank account. 
NOTE: Having direct deposit set up is a requirement for Instant Deposits. Reps can refer to Direct Deposit and Stripe KA to learn more. 
Thumbtack uses Stripe to process payouts. Pros can learn about the current banks that support instant deposits through Stripe by referring to the Institution support for Instant Payouts | Stripe Documentation 
Reps can refer to the "Instant deposit eligibility requirements" talking points below to help navigate these conversations. 
Instant payout timeframe
 
Pros can cash out soon after a customer pays them and should check their Earnings tab to see what funds are available for instant deposit. 
Earnings are only available to instantly deposit within the first 24 hours of the customer paying pros, so pros should initiate them quickly. If a pro is unable to or chooses not to claim their funds instantly, it will default to a standard payout using their direct deposit. 
If there aren’t any funds available, pros can check back the next time they get paid to initiate the deposit. 
Instant deposits are usually immediately available but may take up to 30 minutes to become available, depending on their bank. 
Pros can only cash out their entire available balance (not partial amounts), with a daily payout limit of $5,000. The instant payout amount must be greater than $50 (if less than, pros aren’t given the option for Instant Deposit). 
Reps can refer to the "Payout window (instant vs standard)" talking points below to help navigate these conversations. 
Standard payout deposit schedule (multiple transactions in single deposit)
 
After Thumbtack sends the earnings to the pro's Stripe account, Stripe should typically deposit the balance to the pro's direct deposit within 24 hours. 
Stripe groups together several transactions from earnings and pays them out in a single standard deposit, usually on a daily rolling basis. 
However, Stripe may take more than 24 hours to complete the payout, resulting in a single deposit of multiple pro earnings transferred over a few days. Pros may receive more payments than payouts in this case. 
Thumbtack is still investigating why Stripe waits more than 24 hours in these cases.
Thumbtack doesn't determine Stripe's payout schedules, but Thumbtack does require pros to have a history of receiving three separate payouts (deposits) as a fraud prevention measure. 
▶ Example of a standard payout deposit schedule
A pro set up direct deposit on October 3rd and received four payments totaling $1,635 between October 3rd and 4th, along with another payment of $1,425 on October 7th. Although Thumbtack transferred the earnings to the pro's connected Stripe account within 24 hours of the customer payments, Stripe waited until October 9th to create a payout for the combined amount of $3,060. (Five payment transactions with one payout deposit).  
Reps can refer to the "Pro had multiple transactions grouped together as single deposit" talking points below to help navigate these conversations.
Benefits of instant deposit 
Frontline reps can use instant deposits as a stronger value prop for pros to get paid quickly and securely through Thumbtack. Reps can use the following benefits about instant deposit when working with pros: 
Quick one-time setup with debit card. It’s easy to enable. All the pro needs to do is link their debit card to Thumbtack. 
Same-day payments from customers. After a pro initiates an instant deposit, earnings within 30 minutes of a customer sending it, even on weekends.
Pick and Choose. Pros can decide when to instantly deposit earnings and which earnings to transfer instantly as long as they initiate the transfer within 24 hrs of receiving the payment.
Pro experience: Setting up Instant Deposits and Depositing Funds
This section guides Frontline Reps through the pro's experience with instant deposits, including setting up and managing their funds within the Thumbtack app.
Here is an overview of the pro experience around instant deposits with screenshots of what it looks like in product.
▶ Pro Experience: Setting Up Instant Deposits (or "Initial Setup")
This section details the initial steps a pro takes to enable instant deposits on their Thumbtack account.
Introducing Instant Deposits: A pro will enter their Earnings tab and see a banner that says “Set up Instant deposits” with a “set up” button. They will then be led to an informative screen explaining Instant Deposits and a “Add a debit card” button.
▶ Screenshots of what this looks like in productA[Image: AD_4nXclWQpVGVUimErTUlMBUh9pjx2E9GCtX04gGSeAgN7pCwydEnqt0utTW4Y1MS1llTywFgT7LSTm9j16BL65bo-D97hBGw1E0L_uQr6A45r-llpd-CHVJ6WPkc07iBqyvGN277RRce67iCCDvTHcbnyJv8FI]
Adding a debit card: Pros will then add their debit card information and click save. It may take a few days after saving their card info for them to see the Instant Deposits option. Pros must add a debit card to use the Instant Deposit feature.
▶ Screenshots of what this looks like in product[Image: AD_4nXepdCiQwVrUUQuX_XGrFPbugXOHCM6s42KGA-9HXRRyOYhqOQySo1WKxp4tfBqLIn2zWRPIXUzIyGmtjQqL4mTDYVzd94VQxezybP9mJdVH-o5pwnNlpNypWi8N-N0r7NorBHCeZg]
Payout Information Verification (Includes Direct Deposit Setup): Before a pro can save any payout information (including setting up direct deposit or changing a payout method), they will go through a verification process.
Identity Verification: The pro will receive an email from Thumbtack with a verification code. This verification email is sent automatically to the email address on their Thumbtack account and cannot be sent to a different address.
Entering the Code: A pop-up window will prompt the pro to enter the verification code. If the code is correct, a green checkmark will appear, and the process will move to the next step.
▶ Image Description: Shows the verification window after the correct code has been entered.[Image: AD_4nXd7hHqhCG94k5OCSt34JSTO6oBSShYHGIL4b3EYH1vijy8fn79OIitDaEVokZp0LZAUCWcZIN6vagDmWUihQtaWst1X4FjVnoQZF8zfVmj5WxfQIrju11TZXB2FVIDnholimCMOMQ]
Incorrect Code Attempts: If the code is incorrect, an error will appear, and the pro can attempt to enter it again. The pro has only 3 attempts to enter the correct code.
If all attempts are unsuccessful, an error will state, “Max possible verification attempts reached. Please contact support.” The account will then enter a “Cooldown” mode, and verification cannot be attempted again for 48 hours.
If a pro contacts support due to this error, frontline reps should follow the steps outlined in the (Rep) Steps: How to override payout verification section below.
Requesting a New Code: If the pro didn’t receive a code, they can request a new one by selecting “Didn’t get a code?”
Debit Card Details Display: Once a pro has successfully added their debit card and completed verification, they will see their debit card details under the “Deposit accounts” field. This is where they can make updates to their debit card as needed.
▶ Pro Experience: Using Instant Deposits (or "Claiming Funds")
Once a pro has successfully set up instant deposits (added their debit card and completed verification), this section describes how they can claim their eligible earnings.
Notifications for Available Funds: Pros will receive email and push notifications when they have funds available for instant deposit. Pros will also see a green “Available for instant deposit” banner in their Earnings tab. The banner shows the amount available for instant deposit with a “Deposit” button, allowing them to initiate instant deposits for a 1% fee. 
▶ Screenshots of what this looks like in product[Image: AD_4nXeqysSzDx3oYWxdsS_0stp4SCF8XbCyzil7mG97DqKsdhcC8xVAuweBr3_AouySN8_V8Sl4OMSxF8VdE0TUJeo8dWFxzyCn4y0B3u7TjNfX3iPehG9qMgfVH4r_q2k0Lr6mL1S61Q]The image above depicts the green banner that says “Available for instant deposit. Get paid in minutes for a 1% fee” with a “Deposit” button.
Completing Instant Deposit Payout: The pro will follow the on-screen prompts to confirm and initiate the instant deposit. This screen will show the instant deposit fee (1%) and the total amount that will be deposited to their debit card. They will click “Deposits $X” to complete the payout.
Payout Window for Instant Deposits: Pros can request instant deposits soon after a customer pays them. They have a 24-hour window to select this option. 
Once the pro's bank starts processing the payment (typically after 24 hours), instant deposits are no longer available for that specific payment. 
The green banner will be replaced with a grey one saying “No earnings available for instant deposits”, informing them that funds cannot be instantly deposited.
Receiving Funds: After a pro initiates an instant deposit, they will see a confirmation screen that explains their earnings are minutes away. The earnings will likely appear immediately but may take up to 30 minutes to show in their account, depending on their bank.
▶ Screenshots of what this looks like in product[Image: AD_4nXfVPD8Guepb8UljaPSGnR4oUgQNXnloWDE4xCWIKijCiDvOgYYG6eolPuq4I3Pn-AjuYbsxlJLtuMIRnwjHFeRnwAcxR0J1-pbs3My0U7mq6-mlzewNFUKGDwUSTqJ5VP4FFzqz]
Key points 
Frontline reps should keep the following key points in mind when helping pros with instant deposits:
Instant deposits have a 1% fee.  
Pros must meet the requirements before they’re eligible to set up instant deposits. Once eligible, pros must add a debit card to receive instant deposits. 
Only instant deposits will be sent to the debit card. Standard payouts will be sent to their regular bank account. 
Pros can cash out soon after a customer pays them and should check their earnings tab to see what funds are available for instant deposit. 
Once a pro’s bank starts processing a payment after 24 hours, it won’t be eligible for instant deposit.
Instant deposits are usually immediately available but may take up to 30 minutes to become available, depending on the pro’s bank. 
Pros can only cash out their entire available balance (not partial amounts), with a daily payout limit of $5,000. Earnings must total to a minimum of $50 to be eligible for instant deposit.
2. Process
 
(Pro) Steps: How to initiate an instant payout
 
Pro steps: For pros to initiate a payout, they can follow the steps in the What is instant deposit  – Thumbtack Help article under the “How to cash out” section. 
Before a pro can initiate an instant payout, they must meet the requirements. Once eligible, pros must add a debit card to receive instant deposits. It may take a few days after entering their debit card for the option to claim Instant Deposits to appear.
Once a pro has added their debit card, a banner in their Earnings tab will appear, allowing them to get set up to collect their funds more quickly for a 1% fee. 
Pros can request instant deposits soon after a customer pays them, and they have 24 hours to select an instant deposit. Once the pros bank starts processing the payment, instant deposits are no longer available. The green banner on their Earnings tab will be replaced with a grey one informing them that funds can't be instantly deposited.
(Sales team) Value props for eligible pros  
Here are some value props that the Sales team can use when working with pros: 
No hidden fees. Get paid in 3-4 business days or less for free [during our beta period], or get paid instantly for a 1% fee.
Build customer trust. Getting paid through Thumbtack can build your credibility since customers feel more secure paying through the app.
Attract more business. The more payment options you offer, the more customers you can attract — especially those with Thumbtack discounts who can only redeem them by paying through the app
(Rep) Steps: How to override payout verification 
Pros must verify their identity before saving payout information for instant deposit or changing their payout method, which includes setting up direct deposit. This involves receiving a verification code via email.
Occasionally, pros may not have access to the email address used for verification or have already failed their three attempts to enter the code and are in the 48-hour “cooldown period. In these cases, Frontline reps can override the verification requirement. However, reps MUST complete the standard account verification steps first.
In admin, pull up the pros account.
In the Actions column on the right-hand side, under “Payments” select View Payout Eligibility.
Find the section titled Payment Method Cooldown, and click the Override Cooldown button.
▶ Screenshot of Admin page[Image: AD_4nXdP3vorJVLsBAUwk_nWcnPTVlWQBa3Qk0VnBD1zpyOwfrqszgQQ6fUSy4QGwPd0qJn5iYDtUDoV_yJD5jpQtZ_3GZZc37a10m3idao9JrzJJkSe0jW2HYwut9u9f2ZTBHK48sb0bA]
Selecting “Override Cooldown” will remove the verification requirement for the pros account until the original 48-hour period has been completed. Once that time is up, any attempt to update payout methods will trigger the verification process. 

3. Talking points
▶ Instant deposit eligibility requirements
What do I need to do to cash out my earnings instantly?
In addition to having direct deposit set up, in order to take advantage of instant deposits, you must meet a few requirements: 
Complete and pass a background check
Have one verified Thumbtack customer review
Receive at least $1,000 in payments through Thumbtack Pay
Have three successful standard payouts 
Once you have done that, you simply add a debit card and you are ready to grab your funds as soon as they come through.
¿Qué debo hacer para retirar mis ganancias al instante?
Además de configurar el depósito directo, para aprovechar los depósitos instantáneos, debe cumplir con tres requisitos:
Completar una verificación de antecedentes.
Tener una reseña verificada.
Reciba al menos $1,000 en pagos a través de Thumbtack Pay
Tener tres pagos estándar exitosos
Una vez que haya hecho eso, simplemente agregue una tarjeta de débito y estará listo para obtener sus fondos tan pronto como se reciban.
Can I only take instant deposits and remove my direct deposit set up?
Having your direct deposit set up is a requirement for Instant Deposits. If you are unable or choose not to claim your funds instantly, it will default to a standard payment using your direct deposit.
¿Puedo solo tomar depósitos instantáneos y eliminar mi configuración de depósito directo?
Tener su depósito directo configurado es un requisito para los depósitos instantáneos. Si no puede o no elige reclamar sus fondos al instante, se convertirá en un pago estándar utilizando su depósito directo.
▶ Fees
Are there fees for depositing earnings instantly?
We try to minimize fees wherever we can, and standard payouts cost nothing. For instant deposits, there is a 1% processing fee for each instant deposit.
¿Hay cargos por depositar ganancias de forma instantánea?
Intentamos minimizar las tarifas en la medida de lo posible, y los pagos estándar no cuestan nad. Para los depósitos instantáneos, hay una tarifa de procesamiento del 1% por cada depósito instantáneo.
▶ Payout window (instant vs standard)
How long is the window before it becomes a standard payment?
Stripe currently manages the timing window before a payment becomes a standard deposit. Once your bank starts processing the payment (typically 24 hours after the customer pays you), you won’t be eligible for instant deposit. If your payment is no longer eligible for instant deposit, you won’t see the option to deposit instantly.

¿Cuánto tiempo hay antes de que se convierta en un pago estándar?
En la actualidad, Stripe gestiona el período de tiempo antes de que un pago se convierta en un depósito estándar. Una vez que su banco comience a procesar el pago (por lo general, 24 horas después de que el cliente le pague), ya no será elegible para un depósito instantáneo. Si su pago ya no es elegible para un depósito instantáneo, no verá la opción de depositar al instante.
▶ Debit card type
What debit cards are eligible? 
Your debit card must be a non-prepaid Visa, Mastercard, or Discover card issued by a bank in the United States.
¿Qué tarjetas de débito son elegibles?
Su tarjeta de débito debe ser una tarjeta visa no prepagada, Mastercard o Discover emitida por un banco en los Estados Unidos.
What debit cards can I use to instant deposit?
We use Stripe to process payouts. Here are the current banks that support instant deposits through Stripe.
¿Qué tarjetas de débito puedo usar para depósito instantáneo?
Nosotros utilizamos Stripe para procesar los pagos. Aquí están los bancos actuales que admiten depósitos instantáneos a través de Stripe.
▶ Pro doesn’t see instant deposit option (passed 24 hours window)
Why don’t I not see the option to instantly deposit my earnings??
You might not see the option because the funds have passed that 24 hour instant deposit window and will now process in a standard way. Once your bank starts processing your payout (typically 24 hours after the customer pays you), that payout is no longer eligible to instantly deposit. We recommend acting quickly and checking your earnings tab shortly after you receive a customer's payment to see what funds are available for instant deposit. 

¿Por qué no veo la opción para depositar mis ganancias al instante?
Es posible que no vea la opción porque los fondos han superado la ventana de depósito instantáneo de 24 horas y ahora se procesarán de manera estándar. Una vez que su banco comienza a procesar su pago (por lo general, 24 horas después de que el cliente le pague), ese pago ya no es elegible para el depósito instantáneo. Recomendamos actuar con rapidez y verificar su pestaña de ganancias poco después de recibir el pago de un cliente para ver qué fondos están disponibles para el depósito instantáneo.
▶ Pro had multiple transactions grouped together as single deposit
I have been paid 3+ times through Thumbtack. Why am I not eligible for Instant Deposit? (multiple transactions grouped together as a single deposit)
To qualify for instant deposits, you need a history of receiving at least three separate payouts, along with the other requirements. Stripe, our payment processing partner, tends to batch payouts on a daily basis, resulting in some payments being batched as a single payment. Looking at your deposit history, you have received [ENTER AMOUNT]/3 of the payouts required to be eligible for instant deposits. You're almost there! To track the number of payouts you've received, navigate to the "deposits" tab on the Earnings page.
He recibido pagos más de 3 veces a través de Thumbtack. ¿Por qué no soy elegible para la Reservas Instantánea? (múltiples transacciones agrupadas en un solo depósito)
Para calificar para los depósitos instantáneos, es necesario tener un historial de recibir al menos tres pagos separados, junto con los demás requisitos. Stripe, nuestro socio de procesamiento de pagos, tiende a agrupar los pagos diariamente, lo que resulta en que algunos pagos se agrupen como un único pago. Al observar su historial de depósitos, ha recibido [INGRESE LA CANTIDAD]/3 de los pagos necesarios para ser elegible para los depósitos instantáneos. ¡Está casi allí! Para hacer un seguimiento del número de pagos que ha recibido, vaya a la pestaña "depósitos" en la página de Ganancias.

articles.fullText:
Instant Book Rollback

Contents

Overview
Key points
Rollback details
Pro comms
Pro experience | What's changing
Customer experience | What’s changing
Process
(Rep) Steps: Help an IB pro prepare for rollback changes 
Talking points
Resources
1. Overview

Update: Instant Book was turned off on November 4, 2024. Any Instant Bookings made before November 4, 2024 remained. 
WHAT is happening 
On November 4, 2024, Thumbtack removed Instant Book from the platform indefinitely. This means all pros will stop receiving bookings, and all customers can no longer instantly book a pro. This is being communicated to pros as a full sunset. If a future version of upfront booking returns, it will work differently and won’t be called Instant Book. 
WHY Thumbtack is making this change now
While we have worked hard to improve the quality of Instant Book, we recognize there’s still work that needs to be done to improve the experience. After gathering pro feedback and working to improve the quality of bookings since the nationwide launch, it has become clear that the current product isn’t delivering the outcomes we intended. 
HOW to explain what’s happening to a pro
Thumbtack has decided to remove Instant Book from the platform after deep consideration of pro feedback and where we believe we can deliver the best experience for pros and customers. While we made improvements over the past year, we know that more needs to be done to help pros and customers with different needs to get to a booked job. This decision will allow us to dedicate more resources towards developing new hiring experiences that better meet the evolving needs of pros and customers, such as with booking inquiries. 
WHAT this means for the greater Thumbtack vision
Thumbtack still believes bookings are the strongest form of commitment to get to a job done. We will continue to explore ways to get pros and customers to book jobs in fast and seamless ways in the future, However, the future booking experience may look and feel different than the current Instant Book experience. 
Key points 
When launching Instant Book, we had confidence that it would provide delightful hiring experiences for both pros and customers. 
After gathering pro feedback and working to improve the quality of bookings since the nationwide launch, it has become clear that the current product isn’t delivering the outcomes we intended. For this reason, we are removing the Instant Book experience from our product on November 4th.
Thumbtack still strives to provide the best hiring experiences to get customers’ jobs done while delivering strong ROI to pros. Our objective hasn’t changed, and we will continue to develop experiences that connect pros with committed customers.
For example, we are testing a first-of-its-kind way to connect pros with customers, where they can discuss job details with customers before committing to booking a time. (See Booking Inquiries (Connect To Book) to learn more. 
Thank pros for their trust, patience, and feedback that has helped Thumbtack improve and build better products.
What does this mean for pros?
Starting on 11/4, pros will stop receiving instant bookings. 
Frontline reps should recommend pros review their max lead prices, which will be updated to only show the price of direct leads, Pros should also revisit your targeting preferences.
Rollback details
Oct 21, 2024 – National Accounts/PAB announcement
Oct 25, 2024 – New Thumbtack help article
Oct 28, 2024 – Internal education 
Oct 28, 2024 and Nov 4, 2024 – Pro Comms go out
Nov 4, 2024 Product Rollback begins, Help center content removals/updates, along with internal KA removals/updates 
Pro comms

All pros actively using Instant Book will receive comms. Email and push comms about the rollback of Instant Book will be sent to pros on October 28, 2024, and again on November 4, 2024. This update will also be shared in the Pro Community.

[Image: Screenshot 2024-10-28 at 10.33.50 AM.png]
 


Pro experience | What's changing 
Effective November 4, 2024, the following changes will be made to the pro experience: 
Pros will stop receiving instant bookings. 
Instant Book will be removed from pro onboarding and any other set up entry points in availability or service page settings.
Pricing tables will only have pricing for leads.
What's not changing (Pro)
Team capacity and travel time, along with basic availability settings like business hours and lead time will stay (and are still used for direct leads).
If a customer or pro needs to reschedule a booking, the experience will be the same with the ability to reschedule. 
Pros who were required to publish their fees for OSE and SC categories before December 12, 2023, and did publish them still can’t hide them.
Customer experience | What’s changing 
Effective November 4, 2024, the following changes will be made to the customer experience: 
Customers can no longer instantly book a pro
2. Process 
(Rep) Steps: Helping an IB pro prepare for rollback changes
Frontline reps can use the talking points below and in this article to help navigate conversations with pros about the Instant Book rollback. Reps can also share the FAQs: Removing Instant Book on Nov 4  article with them.
How to explain to a pro that Instant Book is being removed
Ways to say it: Thumbtack has decided to remove Instant Book effective November 4. We still believe bookings are the strongest form of commitment to get to a job done, but understand that Instant Book did not deliver on that for all pros and customers. We will continue to explore ways to get pros and customers to book jobs in fast and seamless ways in the future, but future booking experiences may look and feel different than the current Instant Book experience. 
Cómo explicar a un profesional que se eliminará la reserva instantánea:
Formas de decirlo: Thumbtack ha decidido eliminar la reserva instantánea a partir del 4 de noviembre. Seguimos creyendo que las reservas son la forma más sólida de compromiso para completar un trabajo, pero entendemos que la reserva instantánea no cumplió con esa expectativa para todos los profesionales y clientes. Continuaremos explorando maneras de que los profesionales y clientes reserven trabajos de forma rápida y fluida en el futuro, aunque las experiencias de reserva futuras podrían diferir de la actual experiencia de reserva instantánea.
How to thank a pro for their trust, patience, and feedback
Ways to say it: We want to thank you for your trust, patience, and feedback that has helped guide Thumbtack to this point, where we can make Thumbtack better for pros and customers. Thumbtack is committed to building new and improved ways for pros to communicate with customers and get booked jobs. Guided by pro feedback, we’re testing an experience where pros and customers can message about job details before being booked.
Cómo agradecer a un profesional por su confianza, paciencia y comentarios
Formas de decirlo: Queremos agradecerle por su confianza, paciencia y comentarios, que han ayudado a guiar a Thumbtack hasta este punto, donde podemos mejorar la plataforma para los profesionales y clientes. Thumbtack se compromete a construir nuevas y mejores maneras para que los profesionales se comuniquen con los clientes y logren que se reserven trabajos. Guiados por los comentarios de los profesionales, estamos probando una experiencia en la que profesionales y clientes puedan intercambiar mensajes sobre los detalles del trabajo antes de ser reservados.
How to help a pro prepare for these change 
Ways to say it: Once the change is implemented on November 4th, you will only see direct lead prices in your budget and price tables. Given that direct leads are more competitive than Instant Bookings, we recommend reviewing your budget and max lead prices to ensure they reflect any changes in the maximum amount you’re willing to pay. We also recommend revisiting your targeting and availability preferences. 
Cómo ayudar a un profesional a prepararse para estos cambios
Formas de decirlo: Una vez que se implemente el cambio el 4 de noviembre, solo verá precios de prospectos directos en su presupuesto y en las tablas de precios. Dado que los prospectos directos son más competitivos que las reservas instantáneas, le recomendamos revisar su presupuesto y precios máximos de prospectos para asegurarse de que reflejan cualquier ajuste en el monto máximo que está dispuesto a pagar. También le sugerimos revisar sus preferencias de enfoque y disponibilidad.
3. Talking points
Why is Thumbtack rolling back Instant Book now? 
Thumbtack has decided to remove Instant Book from the platform after deep consideration of pro feedback and where we believe we can deliver the best experience for pros and customers. While we made improvements over the past year, we know that more needs to be done to help pros and customers with different needs get to a booked job. This decision will allow us to dedicate more resources towards developing new hiring experiences that better meet the evolving needs of pros and customers, such as with booking inquiries. 
¿Por qué Thumbtack está retirando ahora la reserva instantánea?
Thumbtack ha decidido eliminar la reserva instantánea de la plataforma tras una profunda consideración de los comentarios de los profesionales y de cómo creemos que podemos brindar la mejor experiencia tanto para los profesionales como para los clientes. Aunque realizamos mejoras durante el último año, sabemos que aún hay trabajo por hacer para ayudar a profesionales y clientes con diferentes necesidades a lograr reservar un trabajo. Esta decisión nos permitirá dedicar más recursos al desarrollo de nuevas experiencias de contratación que satisfagan mejor las necesidades cambiantes de profesionales y clientes, como las consultas de reserva.
Will Instant Book come back?
No. Instant Book will not come back in its current state. However, we still believe bookings are the strongest form of commitment and do plan to explore future direct booking experiences that will look and feel different than the current Instant Book experience.
¿Volverá la reserva instantánea?
No. La reserva instantánea no volverá en su estado actual. Sin embargo, seguimos creyendo que las reservas son la forma más sólida de compromiso y planeamos explorar futuras experiencias de reserva directa que serán distintas a la experiencia actual de reserva instantánea.

Will my lead volume be impacted? 
No. However, with the removal of Instant Book, you will now only see direct lead prices in your budget and price tables. Given that direct leads are more competitive than Instant Bookings (customers can reach out to 5 pros in the first 4 hours), be sure to review your weekly budget and bid prices to stay ahead of the game.

¿Mi volumen de prospectos se verá afectado?
No. Sin embargo, con la eliminación de la reserva instantánea, ahora solo verá los precios de prospectos directos en su presupuesto y tablas de precios. Dado que los prospectos directos son más competitivos que las reservas instantáneas (los clientes pueden contactar hasta 5 profesionales en las primeras 4 horas), asegúrese de revisar su presupuesto semanal y los precios de puja para mantenerse competitivo.
Will this impact lead pricing? 
Direct leads will cost the same as they do now, but pros will no longer pay the multiplier price for instant bookings once it has been removed.
For booking inquiries: Pros will pay the same or similar prices after being booked from a booking inquiry as they did for Instant Book. Pros will be able to see this in their price tables if they are opted into booking inquiries in eligible markets
¿Este cambio afectará el precio de los prospectos?
Los prospectos directos tendrán el mismo costo que ahora, pero los profesionales ya no pagarán el precio multiplicador de las reservas instantáneas una vez que estas sean eliminadas.
Para las consultas de reserva: Los profesionales pagarán precios iguales o similares después de ser reservados desde una consulta de reserva, tal como lo hacían con la reserva instantánea. Los profesionales podrán ver esto en sus tablas de precios si están inscritos en las consultas de reserva en los mercados eligibles.
Should I do anything to prepare for this change?
Once the change is implemented, we recommend reviewing your budget and max lead prices to ensure they reflect any changes in the maximum amount you’re willing to pay. We also recommend revisiting your targeting and availability preferences. 
¿Debo hacer algo para prepararme para este cambio?
Una vez implementado el cambio, le recomendamos revisar su presupuesto y los precios máximos de prospectos para asegurarse de que reflejan cualquier ajuste en el monto máximo que está dispuesto a pagar. También le sugerimos revisar sus preferencias de enfoque y disponibilidad.
What is booking inquiries and when will it be available to me? 
Booking inquiries enable customers and pros to connect through the Thumbtack messenger and discuss job details before moving forward to making a booking. This helps pros and customers to build confidence in working together before committing to booking a job or consultation.
Currently booking inquiries is in early testing, and not yet broadly available. We’ll let you know when you can try out this product.
¿Qué son las consultas de reserva y cuándo estarán disponibles para mí?
Las consultas de reserva permiten que los clientes y los profesionales se conecten a través del chat de Thumbtack y discutan los detalles del trabajo antes de avanzar hacia una reserva. Esto ayuda a que los profesionales y clientes generen confianza en trabajar juntos antes de comprometerse a reservar un trabajo o consult.
Actualmente, las consultas de reserva están en una fase inicial de pruebas y aún no están ampliamente disponibles. Le informaremos cuando pueda probar este product.
Can I have early access to booking inquiries?
Booking inquiries are in early testing and are not yet broadly available. We are taking time to build the right experiences before expanding access to this feature so we can set pros and customers up for success. We will inform you through email communication and in-product when this feature is available to you. 
¿Puedo tener acceso anticipado a las consultas de reserva?
Las consultas de reserva están en una fase temprana de prueba y aún no están disponibles de manera generalizada. Nos estamos tomando el tiempo necesario para desarrollar las experiencias adecuadas antes de expandir el acceso a esta función para garantizar el éxito de los profesionales y clientes. Le informaremos a través de comunicación por correo electrónico y en la plataforma cuando esta función esté disponible para usted.

Inquiries: Employment, Law Enforcement, Legal, Marketing, Press, Sales

Contents
Overview

1. Overview


This Knowledge Article serves as a comprehensive guide for Frontline Reps on how to appropriately manage diverse types of inquiries received by Thumbtack. It provides detailed instructions and guidelines for handling various external and internal contacts.
Key Inquiry Types Covered:
Law Enforcement Inquiries: Guidance on directing government representatives to the Kodex portal for requests.
Legal Inquiries: Instructions for providing Thumbtack's legal department address to pros or customers.
Marketing and Partnership Inquiries: Steps for responding to individuals or companies inquiring about affiliate programs, partnerships, or selling services/products to Thumbtack.
Press Inquiries: Procedures for connecting journalists, news reporters, and media affiliates with the Communications team.
Requests to Visit Thumbtack Office: Protocols for handling unannounced visits and planned visit inquiries from pros and customers.
Sales Inquiries: Directions for managing offers for services, software, or physical goods, and responding to such solicitations.
Thumbtack Employment Inquiries: Guidelines for verifying employment and assisting job applicants, including appropriate contact information and communication methods.
Thumbtack Logo Usage Inquiries: Information for pros and customers regarding the appropriate use of Thumbtack's name and logo on marketing materials and merchandise.
2. Process

Law enforcement inquiries
This section lays out the steps frontline reps will use when contacted by law enforcement. 
Steps: How to help when law enforcement inquiries (Reps)
When communicating with government representatives, Frontline Reps should not answer any questions for them. Instead, Frontline Reps will follow this process:
Refrain from answering any questions.
Let the law enforcement officer know that requests need to be submitted directly through our Government Request Portal, Kodex.
Link: https://app.kodexglobal.com/thumbtack/signin
If the law enforcement officer hasn’t used Kodex before, they can sign up using the Government Employee Signup link.
Link: https://app.kodexglobal.com/thumbtack/signup
If the law enforcement officer has any questions, Frontline Reps can direct them to the Guidelines for law enforcement information requests – Thumbtack Help article.
Once Frontline Reps have provided this response, they will escalate the case and notes directly to Lisa Ronquillo.
▶ Talking point:
You’ll need to submit your request to our Government Request Portal through Kodex. If you haven’t used Kodex before, you’ll need to sign up through the Government Employee Signup link. If you have further questions, you can check out the help center article, Guidelines for law enforcement information requests.
Internal only: Frontline reps should not provide a timeline for when they will receive a response to their inquiry.
Legal inquiries  

This section gives frontline reps the steps for handling inquiries about Thumbtack's legal department.
Steps: How to help users requesting information about Thumbtack Legal departments (Reps)
If Frontline Reps need to share the information for Thumbtack's legal department, they can use the following address: 
Thumbtack Inc.
Attn: Legal Department
415 Natoma St, Suite 1300
San Francisco, CA 94103
Internal only: All mail must include the suite number (#1300). Mail without a suite number will not be delivered.
Marketing and partnership inquiries
When an individual or company contacts Thumbtack to:
Ask about Thumbtack’s affiliate program
Create a partnership to work with Thumbtack
Sell Thumbtack something
Below are examples of marketing inquiries:
"I am Raghunath. Akki, from Sparsh Communications Pvt Ltd. I am here to focus on acquiring and understanding your business needs and nurturing you with the outstanding talent we have which will generate and sustain significant and beneficial growth to your organization." 
“Hi, I was wondering if you have an affiliate program. I am interested in promoting your service. Please let me know.”
"I work for Web Hosting HUB, and I see a great opportunity to help you further monetize your marketing efforts. If you’re interested, we’re prepared to start you at a very attractive commission. I look forward to speaking with you soon."

Dos and Don'ts
When handling marketing inquiries, Frontline Reps should consider the following:
Do check the person's title (usually listed in their email signature) for particular words that might identify what the person's inquiry is.
Do look for words like “Business Development" or "affiliate relations," which likely indicate that the request is an affiliate program or partnership inquiry.
Do look for words like "export sales manager" or "e-commerce specialist" for any offers Thumbtack receives to purchase goods.
Do look for titles like "Software developer" or "SEO specialist" that are usually linked to sales (along with any titles that actually include the word "sales").
Do google the requester's company to identify what they might be selling, offering, or why they might be interested in partnering with Thumbtack.
Steps: How to respond to marketing and partnership requests (Reps)
To respond to a marketing inquiry, Frontline Reps will follow these steps:
Respond to each call or email, depending on whether it seems legitimate or not:
If it does not seem legitimate, let the requestor know that Thumbtack is not interested in their offer at this time.
Send email template: “Marketing Inquiry: How to reach marketing team.”
Submit the ticket as Solved.
If it does feel legitimate (which doesn't happen often), pass along the information to our marketing department.
Send email template: “Marketing Inquiry: How to reach marketing team.”
Using your Thumbtack Gmail, send a copy of the marketing inquiry to partnerships@thumbtack.com.
Include the contact's email and contact info.
In the subject line, include the person's name, company, and request in the subject line.
Internal only: If the frontline rep is unsure whether a marketing request is legitimate, they should check with their manager before forwarding.
Press inquiries
Whenever Frontline Reps receive a phone or email contact from someone from the press, they should direct them to the right person. The press includes any of the following (but does not include those looking to create a partnership for Services or Sales):
Journalists
News reporters
Anyone affiliated with news sources looking to write/create a piece about Thumbtack
Internal note: Frontline reps should not comment about the business or answer questions from the press. Instead, Frontline Reps will connect them to the Communications team (follow applicable steps below).
Steps: How to handle press inquiries on the phone (Reps)
When handling press inquiries on the phone, Frontline Reps will follow these steps:
Identify that they are talking to someone from the press. Generally, the person will tell you at the beginning of the call.
Once you are aware they are speaking to someone from the press, let them know that you’ll pass their inquiry along to the right person at Thumbtack.
Do not promise a response (Thumbtacks' press team responds to inquiries at their own discretion).
Using your Thumbtack Gmail account, send a copy of the press inquiry to press@thumbtack.com.
Include the contact's email and contact info.
In the subject line, include the person's name, publication, and request in the subject line.
▶ Example:Diane Sawyer, from ABCNews would like a call back.
NOTE: If the contact is about Thumbtack layoffs, frontline reps should refer them to press@thumbtack.com.  
Steps: How to handle email press inquiries (Reps)
When handling press inquiries through email, Frontline Reps will follow these steps:
Identify that the email is a press inquiry.
Using your Thumbtack Gmail account, send a copy of the press inquiry to press@thumbtack.com.
Include the contact's email and contact info.
In the subject line, include the person's name, publication, and request in the subject line.
▶ ExampleDiane Sawyer from ABCNews would like an email back.
Sales inquiries 
General Sales inquiries
Sales inquiries include any offers for things that are not physical objects, like:
Any services (or companies that provide services for a fee/price)
Software
Computer programs
Below are examples of sales inquiries:
“I can help you increase your SEO by using my program SEO Improvements Ltd., which I can exclusively offer to you for a discounted price for only a limited time."
"We are a technology company utilizing skilled talent from our development center with a wide variety of skills, and a 5-day standard work week. If you sign up and utilize our company's services, we can offer over 100+ developers to use at your disposal whenever you'd like to help grow your company.”
Internal only: All marketing emails related to sales inquiries should be forwarded to whitney@thumbtack.com.
Offers to purchase goods
Sales inquiries can also include offers to purchase goods. That means that the sender is offering the sale of a physical object and wants to discuss prices with Thumbtack.
Below are examples of offers to purchase goods:
“Full Front Assembly with Frame for iphone 5C, Black, $86.6; iPhone 6/5/4S full front assembly, high quality, Black $42.38”
"Hi Thumbtack marketing, I run the best premiums company and would love to help you with any logoed shirts, mint tins, pens, magnets, apparel, etc. I served one of the first and best-known wedding sites and will be happy to assist you as well. Please see my site: www.corporateimpressions.NET."
Steps: How to respond to sales inquiries (Reps)
To respond to sales inquiries, Frontline Reps will follow these steps:
Let the inquirer know that Thumbtack does not purchase products through customer support.
If appropriate, send the email template titled: Who should I contact with my marketing request?
Submit the case as solved.

Inquiries about the Thumbtack offices
Sometimes, pros and customers express interest in visiting the Thumbtack offices to get a question answered, solve a problem, or speak with a manager in person.
If there are Threats to Thumbtack property or employees involved, frontline reps should reference internal Threats (Rep) KA for more information.
Internal note: Thumbtack may have libraries across the US, the Philippines, and Canada. To learn more about Thumbtack libraries, reps can refer to our internal Library Security Policy Google docs.
Steps: How to handle unannounced visits to Thumbtack locations (Reps)
There are very few occasions when Thumbtack has uninvited visitors. If a pro or customer comes to the office unexpectedly, Frontline Reps should know the following:
The front desk should get the person's contact info and send them on their way.
No issues should be handled in person. Instead, visitors should be directed to support channels for help.
Steps: How to handle witnessing an unexpected visit (Reps)
If Frontline Reps witness an unexpected visit, they will follow these steps:
Notify the entire Workplace Experience (WPX) team and the Trust and Safety Escalation team of the incident.
If needed, tag @ts_escalations in the #ts-incident-ops-questions Slack Channel.
An escalations case manager will confirm if the case is for Trust and Safety or for Service and Support.
Wait for next steps.
If the pro or customer refuses to leave:
Slack the WPX team to notify them about the situation.
You can let the pro know if they don't leave, Thumbtack will call the authorities.
Steps: How to handle when a pro or customer says they plan on visiting an office (Reps) 
If a pro or customer tells the frontline rep that they plan to visit one of the Thumbtack offices for any reason, Frontline Reps will follow these steps:
Tell the customer or pro that visitors won’t be able to enter the building.
If the customer or pro says they’re already on their way, immediately reach out to a manager.
Managers will notify the WPX team and the Trust and Safety Critical Escalations team and share the details of the interaction.
Inquiries about using the Thumbtack logo
When a pro or customer asks for Thumbtack merchandise, swag, stickers or other materials with our logo, Frontline Reps should encourage them to download one of our widgets and badges.
If a pro says they’re going to make their own marketing materials or merchandise using the Thumbtack name or logo, frontline reps should let the pro know:
Thumbtack does not allow pros to use the Thumbtack logo or name on their own merchandise, marketing materials, or business cards. 
Pros can still use any merchandise Thumbtack has given them (usually at a Thumbtack event or as a thank you for being a Top Pro), as long as it’s for personal use. 
Frontline pros should ask the pro if they have any more questions about how to share the news about their business being on Thumbtack.
Frontline reps can share the Use of the Thumbtack logo help center article for further help.
Requests for Thumbtack materials 
When a pro (or customer) asks for Thumbtack merchandise, swag, stickers or other materials with our logo, encourage them to download one of our widgets and badges.
Pros can use these widgets on their website to advertise their Thumbtack pro status.
▶ Internal only:
Thumbtack widgets and badges are icons that pros can add to their website. They direct the customer directly back to the pro's Thumbtack profile or reviews.
For more help with questions about widgets, frontline reps can reference the “Widgets” section on the internal  Profile (Pro) KA..
Inquiries about Thumbtack employment
Frontline Reps can use the following guidelines to help Thumbtack job applicants:
Dos and Donts
When helping job applicants, Frontline Reps should follow these guidelines:
Do thank them for their interest in joining Thumbtack and direct them to our Jobs page (https://www.thumbtack.com/jobs#join).
Don't give out any recruiters' personal information (names, cell phone numbers, email addresses) under any circumstances.
This includes giving additional information to someone who's already been contacted by Thumbtack.
Do encourage the candidate to contact the person who contacted them (if they've already been contacted by a recruiter and are following up).
Don't offer to forward the potential candidate's contact information to the recruiting team.
Don't offer a callback from the recruiting team (the requester should follow up directly by emailing slcjobs@thumbtack.com).
Steps: How to help job applicants on a call (Reps)
To help job applicants who call, Frontline Reps will follow these steps:
Thank the caller for their interest in joining Thumbtack.
Find out more about their situation.
If the caller is interested in applying to work at Thumbtack, direct them to our jobs page: https://www.thumbtack.com/jobs.
If the caller works at a recruiting firm, let them know that interested candidates can apply on our jobs page: https://www.thumbtack.com/jobs.
▶ Internal content:At this time, Thumbtack recruits internally and does not partner with recruiting firms.
Let them know that Thumbtack updates its job listings often, so they can check regularly if they don't see a current position that interests them.
Ask if they have any support-related (or general Thumbtack) questions that reps can answer.
Steps: How to help job applicants through email (Reps)
To help job applicants who email, Frontline Reps will follow these steps:
Let the person know that all applicants need to apply at www.thumbtack.com/careers.
If they meet the job requirements, Thumbtack recruiters will contact them after they've applied.
Steps: How to verify employment at Thumbtack (Reps)
To verify someone's employment at Thumbtack, or if an ex-employee contacts Thumbtack asking to reach the HR department, Frontline Reps will follow these steps:
Direct them to call or email the People Operations Team at (415) 316-0817 or people@thumbtack.com.
The phone number will take them to a voicemail where they can leave a verification of their employment request.
▶ Internal only:
If you have questions this article doesn’t answer, you can post them in #people in Slack.
3. Talking points
Frontline Reps can use the following externally approved talking points when navigating conversations with customers and pros about visiting the Thumback office.

English talking points
Spanish talking points
Q: How do I make an appointment to visit Thumbtack?
Q: ¿Cómo hago una cita para visitar Thumbtack?
A: We don't take visitors at Thumbtack, but I’m happy to help you find the support channel that works best for you. The options available are chat, text, phone, email, and Thumbtack Help articles. 
A; No recibimos visitantes en Thumbtack, pero me complace ayudarlo a encontrar el canal de soporte que mejor se adapte a sus necesidades. Las opciones disponibles son chat, texto, teléfono, correo electrónico y artículos de ayuda de Thumbtack.
Q: Can I visit the Thumbtack office to answer my question?
@: ¿Puedo visitar la oficina de Thumbtack para responder a mi pregunta?
A: Only Thumbtack employees have access to enter the building, but I can help find an answer to your question.
A: Solo los empleados de Thumbtack tienen acceso para ingresar al edificio, pero puedo ayudarlo a encontrar una respuesta a su pregunta.

Incentivized Recommendation Cards (Pro)

Contents

How free leads from recommendation cards work 
Active offers
How pros see if they have an active offer
How reps view a pro's incentivized recommendation offer history and status
Talking points
Recommendation card offer expiration
Free leads: Targeting Expansion (geo, categories, preferences)
Resources
1. Overview
▶ KA Summary
This internal KA provides support reps with information about incentivized recommendations offered to pros. It covers different types of recommendations and details how pros can view these offers and how reps can view offer history and status.
Note on targeting terminology: You may see "Targeting" and "Job preferences" terms used interchangeably throughout our internal KA resources or in-product.
Thumbtack surfaces personalized recommendations to pros through a recommendations carousel — a set of cards that suggest actions to help them grow their business, stay competitive, and manage their account. Recommendations are driven by Thumbtack's algorithms, which analyze market trends, pro activity, and category demand to identify the most relevant actions for each pro.
Some cards come with an incentive like free leads. Others are non-incentivized nudges — for example, showing a pro how many customers in their area are searching for their services. Which type a pro sees depends on current supply gaps in their market.
Thumbtack does want to Support reps to explain incentivized recommendations and help them understand promotional offers so that they can improve their quality.
Note: Pros can receive free leads through various programs on Thumbtack. This article covers free leads tied specifically to recommendation cards. For free leads from other programs, refer to the relevant program KAs.
Seasonal recommendation cards
To help pros capitalize on peak demand, Thumbtack offers seasonal recommendations that encourage them to add specific services or expand their targeting preferences (also known as "Job preferences"). This section explains how these recommendations work.
The recommendations are driven by Thumbtack's algorithms, which analyze market trends, pro activity, and category demand to identify pros who would benefit most from adding or expanding in specific seasonal categories. 
Eligible pros may see recommendations to add a new seasonal category or  expand their job  preferences (job types and travel areas). 
These offers can be incentivized with free leads or presented as non-incentivized suggestions to capture seasonal demand.
Updates and experiments
N/A
Key points

Here are some key points frontline reps should keep in mind when helping a pro with recommendations:
Recommendations are based on market supply gaps.
Eligible pros may be encouraged to complete an action for an incentive like free leads or non-incentive like being told how many customers are looking for pros in their area. 
There are different types of recommendation cards, including new category recommendations and expand travel preferences.
Pros can see if they have an active offer by checking their recommendations carousel. 
Incentivized offers expire after 30 days. 
Pros will see an expiration date on the recommendation card. 
The free leads that come with the offer will expire after 30 days.
Reps can view a pro's incentivized recommendation offer history and status using the Discounts section on the User admin page or the lead incentive query. See the internal Lead Incentives Query (Pro) KA for more information. 
About the recommendations carousel
Pros will see the recommendations carousel on the Jobs tab and the Services page — specifically under the "For you" and "Opportunities" tabs on the Jobs tab, and on the main Services page.
Pros can close any individual recommendation card by tapping the X in the top right corner of the card. Dismissing a card removes it from their carousel but does not cancel any active offer associated with it.
Cards can cover a wide range of actions and may come with an incentive like free leads, or no incentive — for example, being told how many customers in their area are looking for pros like them.  
When a pro taps a card, they're taken to one of three places: a page in their account (e.g. their lead prices page), a help center article, or a dedicated recommendation flow — a special page only accessible from the card itself, used for actions like accepting a free leads offer or completing a targeting expansion.
2. Recommendation card type and incentive
Depending on the pro's market and eligibility, a card will either come with an incentive (free leads) or a non-incentivized nudge (market data or an encouraging statistic). The type a pro sees is determined by Thumbtack's algorithm based on current supply gaps in their market.
Incentivized cards (free leads)

Incentivized cards offer the pro free leads in exchange for completing a specific action. Not every pro will see an incentivized version of a card — eligibility depends on market conditions at the time.

Important notes for reps:
Free leads from seasonal cards can only be used for jobs in the specific category the offer was tied to. For example, 7 free leads earned by adding "Exterior Painting" can only be applied to Exterior Painting jobs.
Free leads from expand targeting cards vary per pro. The number is based on an average of the pro's past unutilized budget. Reps can look up the exact offer amount in the Discounts section of the User admin page.
Non-incentivized cards
Non-incentivized cards don't offer free leads. Instead, they show the pro relevant market data or an encouraging statistic to motivate them to take action. The underlying action is the same as the incentivized version — the difference is that there is no reward attached.

Card type

Why the same card type can appear as incentivized or non-incentivized
When a pro sees an incentivized vs. non-incentivized version of a card comes down to Thumbtack's algorithm — specifically, the current supply and demand conditions in the pro's market. If there is high customer demand and low pro supply in a given area or category, Thumbtack is more likely to offer free leads to encourage the pro to act. If the gap isn't as significant, the pro may see the same card without an incentive attached.
This means two pros in different markets offering the same service may see very different versions of the same recommendation card. Reps should avoid promising a pro that they will or won't receive an incentive for a given action.
3. How free leads from recommendation cards work

Offer and lead expiration
Pros will see an expiration date displayed on their recommendation card. The expiration timelines are:
Time to complete the required action: 30 days from when the card is generated
Time to use free leads: 30 days after leads are granted

When the pro receives the free leaders 
The timing of when free leads are granted depends on the card type:

Card type
When leads are granted
Expand targeting / Seasonal
Instantly and automatically once the pro completes the required action
Restrictions on using free leads: 
Seasonal category and targeting expansion leads can only be used for jobs in the specific category the offer was tied to. For example, 7 free leads earned by adding "Exterior Painting" can only be applied to Exterior Painting jobs.
4. Active offers 

How pros see if they have an active offer
There is no standalone free lead balance screen for pros. The best way for a pro to see if they have an active offer is to check their recommendations carousel, where active cards with offers will be displayed along with an expiration date.
Once a pro completes the required action, they will automatically receive their next lead for free. If a pro says they completed the action and aren't sure whether it worked, they can check whether their next incoming lead was charged — if it wasn't, the free lead was applied.
Rep note: Frontline reps can view a pro's remaining free lead balance and redemption status in the Discounts section of the User admin page. Pros cannot see this view themselves.
Timeframe for Incentivized Recommendations
For incentivized recommendations, pros have 30 days to complete the action from when the recommendation card is generated, and then once they have received the free leads, they have 30 days to use those free leads before they expire. 
How to check a pro's offer status (Rep) 
To see incentives offered to pros, frontline reps can use the Discounts section on the User admin page. This section shows all incentives and free leads awarded to a pro, including targeting expansion offers.
Specifically for incentivized recommendation offers, the Discounts section shows these details:

Admin Field
What it shows
Discount ID
Unique identifier for the lead grant or discount
Status
ACTIVE, DEPLETED, or EXPIRED
Free leads (total / redeemed)
A counter showing usage
e.g. "5 / 2" = 5 awarded, 2 used
Awarded & Expires
Timestamps for when leads were added and when they expire
Recommendation type
Campaign type — targeting expansion offers display as "Category Name + 100%" (e.g. "House Cleaning 100%")
▶ What the Discounts section looks like

[Image: rtaImage]

For contact PKs or more detail, run the Lead Incentives Query in BigQuery. See the Lead Incentives Query (Pro) KA for steps.
3. Talking points 
Recommendation card offer expiration
To effectively address pro inquiries about offer timelines for recommendations in the recommendations carousel, frontline reps can use these talking points to explain recommendation card expiration details.

English FAQs
Spanish FAQs
When does the offer expire?
¿Cuándo vence la oferta?
Incentivized offers expire after 30 days. You will see an expiration date on the recommendation card. The free leads that come with the offer will expire after 30 days.
Las ofertas incentivadas caducan después de 30 días. Verá una fecha de vencimiento en la tarjeta de recomendación. Los prospectos gratuitos que vienen con la oferta caducarán después de 30 días.
Free leads: Targeting expansion
When pros ask about why they're receiving free leads for expanding their targeting preferences via recommendations in the recommendations carousel, frontline reps can use these talking points to provide a clear explanation.
For additional talking points about targeting, reps can refer to the internal Targeting Preferences KA.  

English FAQs
Spanish FAQs
Why is Thumbtack giving out free leads for expanding targeting preferences? 
¿Por qué Thumbtack ofrece prospectos gratuitos por ampliar las preferencias de enfoque?
We are offering free leads as a thank you for your commitment to Thumbtack and our customers. There is high customer demand and low competition for these geos, categories and/or preferences. 
Le agradecemos su compromiso con Thumbtack y con nuestros clientes, por lo que le ofrecemos prospectos gratuitos. Existe una alta demanda de clientes y una baja competencia para estas ubicaciones, categorías y/o preferencias.
Which leads are free? (Targeting expansion recommendations)

The free leads offered are specifically for the category you added from the recommendation. They can only be used for jobs within that specific category.
