Note on Budget increase offers: Pros who have accepted an incentive offer for free leads should be aware that hiding their business will result in disqualification from receiving those free leads. Frontline reps can find more detailed information in the internal Budget Increase Incentive (BOSUP & SOBU) (Pro) Knowledge Article.
Once hidden
Pros won’t appear in search results or receive any new leads. Customers who navigate directly to a pro’s profile who has their business hidden will see that the business is not accepting new customers.  Pros can still message current customers and respond to Opportunities when they hide their business. If a pro wants to turn off Opportunities while their business is hidden, they can do that in their Notifications.
Pros can keep hiding their business until they’re ready to receive leads. If a pro wants to hide their business for another 30 days, they can either:
Wait until their business goes live OR 
Go to Services and select “Go live now” and then immediately hide their business again for up to another 30 days.
NOTE: Pros in an experiment can edit the dates while hidden. See Hide my business UX experiment above.  
Unhide business
The pros business will reappear in search results at 8 am local time on the date they choose. Pros can unhide their business before the date they set by clicking “Go live now”  from their services page. As of now, there’s no way to schedule a business to hide at a later date. Pros have to turn each business off individually. 

2. Process

Pro guidance: How to update business hours
Pros can share their typical weekly work schedule by updating their business hours. Changes to their business hours only apply to the selected individual business profile (if they have more than 1 business profile). 
Pro guidance: Pros can follow the “How to update your business hour” steps on the How to manage my availability – Thumbtack Help article. 
Important things to note: 
These hours appear on the pro's business profile so customers know when they typically work. They do not impact lead matching or filter search results.
Customers select broad timelines for their projects in daily increments (not hours) —such as Within 48 hours (3 days), Within a week, or Flexible—instead of choosing a specific time of day. Because of this, pros must schedule the specific start time directly with the customer after a request is sent.
Pro guidance: How to update calendar 
Pros can select the days they’re unavailable. To unblock a day, they’ll click the date on the calendar and select Unblock this time. 
Pro guidance: To block time off their Calendar,  pros will follow the How to update your calendar steps on the How to manage my availability – Thumbtack Help article.  
(Pro) Steps: How to hide their business


Pros can hide their business(es) for up to 30 days from their Services page. Pro can keep hiding their business until they’re ready to receive leads.  The pro’s business will be hidden immediately and will reappear in search results at 8 am local time on the date they choose.
Pro Steps:  To hide their business, pros will follow the steps on How to pause leads by hiding your business article. 

3. Talking points

Pro availability and customer project timeline



English FAQs
Spanish FAQs
How does my availability match with customers' project timelines?
¿Cómo coincide mi disponibilidad con los plazos de los proyectos de los clientes?
When a customer submits their project, they specify their desired timeline in broad terms, rather than selecting specific hours or viewing your individual calendar.

Here is how your availability is used to match you with a customer's project timeline:

Customers are asked for a project timeline on the request form, where they choose general options like "Within 48 hours," "Within a week," "Specific dates" (up to seven), or "Flexible on timeline." They do not select specific hours (like 2:00 PM).
If a customer chooses a set timeline or specific dates, the search results are filtered to only show pros who have marked themselves as available on those days.
If a customer selects a flexible option—such as "Flexible on timeline" or toggles on the option to "work with the pro’s schedule" (which is the default)—your calendar availability will not filter the search results, and you may still receive a lead even for a day you have blocked off.

Since customers only choose a general day or date range, you must coordinate the exact start time directly with the customer through messenger once you receive the lead.
Cuando un cliente envía su proyecto, indica el plazo que desea en términos generales, en lugar de seleccionar horas específicas o ver su calendario personal.

Así es como se usa su disponibilidad para conectarlo con el plazo del proyecto de un cliente:

En el formulario de solicitud, se les pide a los clientes un plazo para el proyecto. Allí eligen opciones generales como "En menos de 48 horas", "En menos de una semana", "Fechas específicas" (hasta siete) o "Plazo flexible". Ellos no seleccionan horas específicas (como las 2:00 p. m.).
Si un cliente elige un plazo fijo o fechas específicas, los resultados de búsqueda se filtran para mostrar solo a los profesionales que marcaron que están disponibles esos días.
Si un cliente selecciona una opción flexible, como "Plazo flexible", o activa la opción de "trabajar con el horario del profesional" (que es la opción predeterminada), la disponibilidad de su calendario no filtrará los resultados de búsqueda. Es posible que reciba un prospecto incluso en un día que usted haya marcado como bloqueado.

Como los clientes solo eligen un día general o un rango de fechas, usted debe coordinar la hora exacta de inicio directamente con el cliente a través de los mensajes una vez que reciba el prospecto.
What if a customer says they’re flexible or not sure about their project details?
¿Qué pasa si un cliente dice que tiene flexibilidad o que no está seguro de los detalles de su proyecto?
These flexible preferences indicate that the customer is open to options or would like your advice. We recommend that you communicate with these customers and help them decide on the job details. And if the project turns out to be a mismatch after finalizing the details, request a refund and we’ll look into it.
Estas preferencias flexibles indican que el cliente está abierto a opciones o que le gustaría recibir su consejo. Le recomendamos comunicarse con estos clientes para ayudarlos a decidir los detalles del trabajo. Si después de finalizar los detalles el proyecto no es lo que usted busca, solicite un reembolso y nosotros lo revisaremos. Usted puede solicitar un reembolso.
What if a customer says their project date is flexible?
¿Qué pasa si un cliente dice que la fecha de su proyecto es flexible?
Your unavailable dates only apply to jobs that include a specific date. So you’ll still see jobs that:

List a flexible date
Begin on an available day, but end on your unavailable date
When customer does not specify a date needed

If a customer selects multiple dates , you do not have to be available for all of them to receive the lead.
Sus fechas no disponibles solo se aplican a trabajos que incluyen una fecha específica. Por lo tanto, usted seguirá viendo trabajos que:

Incluyan una fecha flexible
Comienzan en un día en que usted está disponible, pero terminan en una fecha en la que no lo está.
Cuando el cliente no especifica la fecha necesaria.
Si un cliente selecciona varias fechas, usted no tiene que estar disponible para todas ellas para recibir el prospecto.

How business hours work 



English FAQs
Spanish FAQs
How do business hours work? 
¿Cómo funciona el horario comercial? 
Your business hours are where you set your typical weekly work schedule.

You have two options. The default, "Use any open day or time," means customers can request jobs on any day you are available. If you choose to "Define specific business hours," your weekly schedule is displayed on your profile and lets customers know when you are typically available. 

An important thing to note is your business hours generally do not block you from receiving new leads because customers select broad timelines (like "Within a week"), not specific hours. However, if you 'Define specific business hours,' you can mark a recurring day as 'Closed' to stop receiving leads for that specific day every week.

Lastly, you must have a minimum of 12 hours of total availability per week to appear in search results and receive leads. Additionally, your hours are set at the business profile level, meaning they apply to all service categories you offer simultaneously under that profile.
El horario comercial es donde usted establece su horario de trabajo semanal habitual.

Tiene dos opciones. La opción predeterminada, Use any open day or time "Usar cualquier día u hora disponible", significa que los clientes pueden solicitar trabajos en cualquier día que usted esté disponible. Si elige Define specific business hours "Definir un horario comercial específico", su horario semanal se mostrará en su perfil para que los clientes sepan cuándo suele estar disponible. 

Es importante tener en cuenta que su horario comercial generalmente no le impide recibir nuevos prospectos, ya que los clientes eligen plazos amplios (como "Dentro de una semana") y no horas específicas. Sin embargo, si elige "Definir un horario comercial específico", puede marcar un día recurrente como "Cerrado" para dejar de recibir prospectos ese día específico todas las semanas.

Por último, debe tener un mínimo de 12 horas de disponibilidad total por semana para aparecer en los resultados de búsqueda y recibir prospectos. Además, su horario se establece a nivel de su perfil de negocio, lo que significa que se aplica a todas las categorías de servicios que ofrece al mismo tiempo en ese perfil.
What do my business hours do if they don’t block me from receiving leads?

Your business hours on your profile let customers know when you typically work, but they don’t block you from receiving new leads. Because customers choose broad timelines (like 'Within a week') instead of specific times, we send you leads whenever you're not marked as 'Unavailable' for the day. You can then message the customer to schedule a start time that works for you. Marking the day as ‘closed’ will block you from receiving leads for that day.


How lead times work 

This section provides talking points frontline reps can use to address common questions from pros about setting their lead time, including how much notice they need before a job and how far in advance customers can schedule them.

English FAQs
Spanish FAQs
Can I select the timelines or time slots that customers see?
¿Puedo seleccionar los plazos o intervalos de tiempo que ven los clientes?
No, you cannot select the specific timelines or duration of time slots that customers see. Customers do not select specific hours (like 2:00 PM) when looking for a pro. They select broader timelines, such as "Within a week" or "Within 48 hours."

Because customers only select days, setting hourly availability does not impact matching or your visibility in search results. If you need to limit your overall availability, ensure your business hours are updated, as these are the primary settings customers see. You can coordinate the exact start time directly with the customer once you receive the lead.
No, usted no puede seleccionar los plazos específicos ni la duración de los intervalos de tiempo que ven los clientes. Los clientes no eligen horas específicas (como las 2:00 p. m.) cuando buscan a un profesional. Ellos eligen plazos más amplios, como "En una semana" o "En 48 horas".

Como los clientes solo eligen días, configurar su disponibilidad por hora no afecta sus coincidencias ni su visibilidad en los resultados de búsqueda. Si necesita limitar su disponibilidad general, asegúrese de actualizar su horario comercial, ya que estas son las configuraciones principales que ven los clientes. Usted puede coordinar la hora exacta de inicio directamente con el cliente una vez que reciba el prospecto.
How much notice do you need before a job begins?
¿Con cuánta anticipación necesita que le avisen antes de empezar un trabajo?
How much notice you need before starting a job is personal to your business. By selecting one to seven days notice, you decide how quickly you can be scheduled for.  

For example, if you choose “2 days notice”, a customer could reach out to you on Monday for a job that starts Wednesday. If you’re a pro who doesn’t need much notice before starting a job, you can choose “same-day” and receive  jobs with as little as four hours notice.

Please note that the maximum amount of notice you require before starting a job cannot exceed 7 days. 
El tiempo de anticipación que usted necesita antes de empezar un trabajo depende de su negocio. Al seleccionar de uno a siete días de aviso, usted decide con qué rapidez lo pueden programar.  

Por ejemplo, si elige "2 días de anticipación", un cliente podría contactarlo un lunes para un trabajo que comienza el miércoles. Si usted es un profesional que no necesita mucho aviso previo para empezar, puede elegir "el mismo día" y recibir trabajos con solo cuatro horas de anticipación.

Tenga en cuenta que el tiempo máximo de aviso que puede pedir antes de empezar un trabajo no puede ser mayor a 7 días.
How far in advance can customers schedule me for a job?
¿Con cuánta anticipación pueden los clientes programarme para un trabajo?
You can adjust your settings to allow customers to schedule you anywhere from 2 weeks to 30 months out. You can update these settings anytime. 

For example, if you want to be able to fill your calendar with jobs up to two weeks out, you can choose “2 weeks.” If you’re fine with customers scheduling you further out than that, you can adjust that timeframe further.

Please note that customers must be able to schedule you up to 14 days in advance. You can also set how much notice you’d like before being scheduled, with a max of 7 days.
Usted puede ajustar su configuración para permitir que los clientes lo programen desde 2 semanas hasta 30 meses antes del trabajo. Puede actualizar esta configuración en cualquier momento. 

Por ejemplo, si quiere llenar su calendario con trabajos con hasta dos semanas de anticipación, puede elegir "2 semanas". Si no tiene problema con que los clientes lo programen con más tiempo de anticipación, puede ampliar ese plazo.

Tenga en cuenta que los clientes deben poder programarlo con al menos 14 días de anticipación. También puede establecer cuánta anticipación desea antes de que lo programen, con un máximo de 7 días.
Thumbtack calendar and blocking time off
This section provides talking points frontline reps can use to address common questions from pros about managing their calendar, specifically focusing on how frequently they should update it to ensure accuracy. 

English talking points 
Spanish talking points 
How often should I update my calendar?
¿Con qué frecuencia debo actualizar mi calendario?
It’s a good idea to update your calendar regularly to make sure your availability is accurate. For example, you can set a regular reminder on your phone every month to make sure you’ve blocked off any days you’re not available 
Es recomendable actualizar su calendario con frecuencia para asegurarse de que su disponibilidad sea exacta. Por ejemplo, puede poner un recordatorio mensual en su teléfono para asegurarse de bloquear los días en los que no estará disponible.
How do I stop getting leads for a specific day?
¿Cómo dejo de recibir prospectos para un día específico?
To stop receiving leads for a specific day, you have two options depending on whether it is a one-time event or a recurring schedule change:

For a one-time event: Block that specific date on your Thumbtack calendar. Since the system is day-based, you can not block off specific hours. If you are busy for any part of a day, we recommend blocking the full day to avoid being matched with jobs you can’t take.
For a recurring schedule change: If you want to stop getting leads for the same day every week (for example, if you never work Tuesdays), mark that day as "Closed" in your Business Hours settings.

Note: Keeping your availability updated in both places ensures you only receive leads when you are actually able to work.
Para dejar de recibir prospectos en un día específico, tiene dos opciones según si se trata de un evento de una sola vez o un cambio de horario recurrente:

Para un evento de una sola vez: Bloquee esa fecha específica en su calendario de Thumbtack. Como el sistema se basa en días completos, no puede bloquear horas específicas. Si está ocupado durante cualquier parte del día, le recomendamos bloquear el día completo para evitar recibir trabajos que no pueda realizar.
Para un cambio de horario recurrente: Si quiere dejar de recibir prospectos el mismo día todas las semanas (por ejemplo, si nunca trabaja los martes), marque ese día como "Cerrado" en la configuración de su Horario Comercial.

Nota:  Mantener su disponibilidad actualizada en ambos lugares asegura que solo reciba prospectos cuando realmente pueda trabajar.
How do I block time off on my calendar?
¿Cómo bloqueo tiempo en mi calendario?
The process is now faster because you no longer have to toggle an "All Day" switch or click through time increments. Here is how you do it:

Go to the Availability tab (formerly titled "Calendar").
Tap the Block time button to open the "When are you unavailable?" screen.
Enter a Title (like "Vacation" or "Personal Day") and any helpful Details.
Select your Start and End dates. (The system will automatically mark these full days as unavailable).
Tap Save.

Reminder: Even if a day is blocked, you may still receive leads if a customer says they are flexible on their timeline. This allows you to see the job and potentially schedule it for a day when you are free.
El proceso ahora es más rápido porque ya no tiene que activar la opción de "Todo el día" ni seleccionar horarios específicos. Así es como se hace:

Vaya a la pestaña Availability (“Disponibilidad”) antes llamada "Calendar".
Seleccione el botón Block time (“Bloquear Tiempo”) para abrir la pantalla "¿Cuándo no está disponible?".
Ingrese un título (como "Vacaciones" o "Día personal") y cualquier detalle útil.
Seleccione sus fechas de Inicio y Fin. (El sistema marcará automáticamente estos días completos como no disponibles).
Seleccione Save (“Guardar”).

Recordatorio: Aunque un día esté bloqueado, es posible que reciba prospectos si un cliente indica que tiene un horario flexible. Esto le permite ver el trabajo y programarlo para un día en que usted esté libre.
If I block a day on my calendar, will I still get 'Flexible' leads?
¿Recibiré prospectos "flexibles" si bloqueo un día en mi calendario?
Yes, you may still receive leads if a customer indicates they are flexible on their timeline.' This allows you to see the job and coordinate a different day that works for both of you.
Sí, es posible que reciba prospectos si un cliente indica que tiene un horario flexible. Esto le permite ver el trabajo y acordar un día diferente que les funcione a ambos.
When I block off a date, does that mean I won't see any leads for jobs that day? 
¿Bloquear una fecha significa que no veré ningún prospecto para trabajos ese día?
You still may see leads that don’t match your availability if a customer is interested in your business and reaches out. Sometimes, a customer may be so determined to work with you, that they are willing to adjust their schedule to yours. If they select they are flexible or unsure you may still see a lead come in for those requests, even if it includes those blocked dates as well. If the customer decides not to accept your suggestion for scheduling, request a refund and we’ll look into it.
Usted podría ver prospectos que no coinciden con su disponibilidad si un cliente tiene interés en su negocio y lo contacta. A veces, un cliente tiene tanto interés en trabajar con usted que está dispuesto a ajustar su horario al suyo. Si el cliente selecciona que es flexible o que no está seguro, es posible que reciba un prospecto para esas solicitudes, incluso si incluyen las fechas bloqueadas. Si el cliente decide no aceptar su sugerencia para programar el trabajo, solicite un reembolso y nosotros lo revisaremos.
What "hide my business" means and when to use it 
This section provides talking points frontline reps can use to address common questions from pros about the "hide my business" feature, explaining what it means and when they should use it.

English talking points 
Spanish talking points 
What does it mean to ‘hide my business’?
¿Qué significa ocultar mi negocio “hide my business”?
When you hide your business, your profile won’t appear in customer search results. But you can continue to interact with any customers who have already reached out to you. When you tell us you’re not available by hiding your business, you won’t have to respond to new leads or worry about things that affect your ranking in search results (like declining leads, response time, or updating your calendar).
Cuando oculta su negocio, su perfil no aparecerá en los resultados de búsqueda de clientes. Pero puede seguir interactuando con cualquier cliente que ya se haya comunicado con usted. Cuando nos dice que no está disponible por medio de ocultar su negocio, no tendrá que responder a nuevos prospectos ni preocuparse por cosas que afecten su clasificación en los resultados de búsqueda (como declinar prospectos, el tiempo de respuesta o la actualización de su calendario).
When should I ‘hide my business’?
¿Cuándo debo "ocultar mi negocio"?
You should hide your business when you’re not available to respond to new leads or take on new jobs. When you hide your business, we won’t show you in customer search results. By letting us know you’re not available ahead of time, we can help prevent customers from reaching out when you’re not available to respond.
Debe ocultar su negocio cuando no esté disponible para responder a nuevos prospectos o asumir nuevos trabajos. Cuando oculte su negocio, no aparecerá en los resultados de búsqueda de clientes. Si nos informa que no está disponible con anticipación, podemos ayudar a evitar que los clientes se comuniquen con usted cuando no esté disponible para responder.

articles.fullText:
Auto Services Categories (Pros) (Customers)

Contents

Overview
Auto services categories
Pro experience
Impact of launch to pro experience
Lead prices for auto services
Pro incentives with launch of auto services
Customer experience
Resources
1. Overview

Thumbtack expanded into Auto Services, offering categories like mobile auto mechanic, roadside assistance, auto detailing, and more. Initially, the focus will be on services where pros come to the customer's location, known as ‘mobile-only services.’
Auto Services represents a significant market opportunity and aligns with Thumbtack's goal of offering comprehensive services to homeowners. Additionally, customers were already searching for these services on our platform.  
For pros: The auto services categories launched on May 20, 2025, allowing pros to sign up and specify their job type preferences. 
For customers: The auto services request forms launched on May 27, 2025, enabling customers to submit job requests.
Update as of Oct 29, 2025: We made small updates to the request forms in five Auto Services categories to make choices clearer and improve matching for customers and pros. See the detailed changes in Pro experience and Customer experience below.

Auto Services Categories

The table below provides a breakdown of all current  Auto Services categories offered by Thumbtack.

Occupation
Service Category Name
Service Description
Automotive Mechanic
Mobile Auto Mechanic
Pros travel to the customer's location to diagnose and repair issues with the customer's vehicle. If replacement car parts are needed, customers are asked who will provide them.
Automotive Mechanic
Roadside Assistance
Pros provide on-location help to drivers experiencing vehicle breakdowns or emergencies.
Automotive Mechanic
Mobile Oil Change
Pros travel to the customer's location to perform oil changes and filter replacements.
Automotive Mechanic
Mobile Tire Services
Pros travel to the customer's location to repair, replace, or rotate tires. If replacement tires are needed, customers are asked who will provide them.
Automotive Mechanic
Mobile Auto Brake Services
Pros travel to the customer's location to inspect, repair, or replace brake components. If replacement brake parts are needed, customers are asked who will provide them.
Automotive Mechanic
Mobile Auto Battery Services
Pros travel to the customer's location to test, replace, or jump-start batteries. If a replacement battery is needed, customers are asked who will provide it.
Automotive Body Technician
Mobile Paintless Dent Repair (PDR)
Pros use specialized tools to remove minor dents and dings without affecting the vehicle's paint finish.
Automotive Body Technician
Mobile Auto Glass Repair or Replacement
Pros travel to the customer's location to repair or replace damaged windshields or other auto glass. If a replacement windshield or glass is needed, customers are asked who will provide it.
Automotive Detailer
Mobile Auto Detailing
Pros travel to the customer's location to clean, polish, and protect the interior and exterior of vehicles.
Automotive Detailer
Mobile Auto Paint Protection and Repair
Pros apply protective coatings or films to the vehicle's paint and perform minor paint repairs.
Automotive Detailer
Mobile Auto Window Tinting
Pros install window tint film to reduce glare, heat, and UV exposure.
Tow Truck Driver
Vehicle Towing
Pros transport vehicles using a tow truck to a location specified by the customer.
Pro experience with auto services
Impact of launch to pro experience 
Auto services launched nationwide to all pros. Here’s how the pro experience is impacted: 
Sign up: On May 20, 2025, pros could sign up for the Auto Service service categories and specify their job type preferences. Pros can find more details by visiting the Thumbtack Auto Services Offer Details page.
Receive leads: Customers could start submitting auto services projects starting May 27, 2025. That’s when pros could start receiving leads for mobile-only auto services, where they travel to the customer's location.
Lead pricing:  Pro lead pricing for auto services follows the existing Thumbtack lead pricing model, with some categories using Answer-Based Pricing (ABP) and others having a single lead price.
Targeting: Pros can set whether they purchase replacement parts for certain jobs (brakes, tires, batteries, glass, and general mechanic). This helps match the right jobs to the right pros. (Applies to all pros.)
▶ Lead Prices for Auto Services
When pros offer auto services on Thumbtack, the lead pricing follows the existing Thumbtack lead pricing model. However, some auto service categories utilize Answer-Based Pricing (ABP), which means the lead price can vary based on specific job details provided by the customer in the request form.
Here's a breakdown of how pricing options will appear for pros in the new auto service categories:
Auto Service Categories Without Answer-Based Pricing:
For these categories, pros will see a single lead price for leads within that service.
Mobile Auto Mechanic
Roadside Assistance
Mobile Auto Battery Services
Mobile Oil Change
Auto Service Categories that Utilize Answer-Based Pricing (ABP):
For these categories, pros may see multiple lead prices within the same service, with variations based on the customer's answers to request form questions. This helps align the lead cost more closely with the estimated value of the job.
Mobile Tire Services
Mobile Auto Brake Services
Mobile Paintless Dent Repair (PDR)
Mobile Auto Glass Repair or Replacement
Mobile Auto Detailing
Mobile Auto Paint Protection and Repair
Mobile Auto Window Tinting
Vehicle Towing
For more information on how Lead Prices work and how pros can control their spending, reps can refer to the internal Lead Prices (Pro) KA . 
Pro incentives with launch of auto services service categories
To encourage adoption of the new auto services categories, both existing and new pros who add any auto category to their targeting preferences by September 20, 2025, were offered specific incentives.
Existing (and dormant) pros: 
Pros were eligible to receive their first 10 leads free per auto service category they added before September 20, 2025. 
Offer details:  First 10 free leads were limited to Auto Services where targeting was added before September 20, 2025. 
New pros signing up on Thumbtack
New pros were eligible to receive 50% off their first 20 leads when they add auto services categories before September 20, 2025. 
Offer details:  50% off the first 20 leads was limited to Auto Services where targeting was added before September 20, 2025.
Additional offer details: 
No transfer, assignment, cash redemption, or substitution of the leads is permitted. 
Free leads expired June 20, 2026.
Customer experience
May 27, 2025, is when customers could start submitting project requests for mobile-only auto services (which means the pro comes to the customer's location). These auto services include the following occupations:
Automotive Mechanic
Automotive Body Technician
Automotive Detailer
Tow Truck Driver
For a breakdown of the service categories customers can submit, reps can refer to the ‘Auto services categories included in launch ’ section above.

articles.fullText:
Assured exact match (Pro experiment) + New customer experience (Customer)

Contents

Overview
Experiment details
Updates
New Customer Experience (NCX)
How to identify assured exact match leads
Pro experience
Baseline
Experiment
New customer experience
Process
Steps: How to help a pro who was auto-charged for a lead that didn't match their preferences
Talking points
Resources
1. Overview
▶ KA Summary
This internal knowledge article (KA) provides Frontline Reps with details regarding the Assured Exact Match experiment launching in the Miami, Florida CBSA. It outlines changes to auto-charge logic for pros—specifically using AI matching and broad targeting—and the Dynamic Questions flow for customers.

Status
Launch date
End date
Feature priority
Impacted user
Live
February 3, 2026
TBD
P2 — low impact and medium priority
50% native customers nationwide; pros nationwide
What
The Assured Exact Match experiment began on February 3, 2026, to test a new way to match customers with pros more accurately using AI.The goal is to make sure that when a pro is auto-charged for a lead, the project details are a perfect fit for their business.
The customer flow uses AI-driven Dynamic Questions instead of the traditional, fixed Request Form (RF). Instead of answering a set of pre-determined questions, customers answer questions generated in real-time by AI to gather project details.
Why
[Internal -facing why: The goal of this experiment is to improve auto-charge coverage for leads generated through this new NHX flow. Currently, these leads often lack specific Request Form (RF) answers (e.g., "How many bathrooms?") needed for exact matching, resulting in leads being sent as Opportunities (Opt-In) rather than auto-charges.
Because this experiment relies on AI inference and broad targeting, matches may not always be perfect. Pros may contact Support if they are auto-charged for a lead they believe does not match their preferences.]
How
Pro Experience: High-Level Automated Matching 
The pro's experience centers on high-quality leads and automated matching.
AI-Assured Matching: We use the detailed data from the customer's flow to match them with a pro, even if the pro has broader targeting settings.
Automatic Charges: Because the AI has confirmed the customer's project is a match for the pro’s services, these leads are auto-charged.
Lead Transparency: Pros receive the detailed answers collected during the customer flow, providing them with more context before they even start the job.
Experiment details
This section provides details about the Assured Exact Match experiment, including assignment, launch and end dates, and expected impact.
Launches: 
V1: February 3, 2026
V2: March 19, 2026
Downfull questions: April 6, 2026
NCX M3 (AEM Target 3) Nationwide Test: April 20, 2026 (Ended)
M4 Nationwide NCX Test:
Ran June 23, 2026 to July 7, 2026 
Launched to baseline July 27, 2026
Who is included:  
Customers nationwide on native only
Pros in Miami, FL
Priority: P2 — low impact and medium priority (See the “Experiments and feature priority levels” section in the Current Running Experiments (Rep) KA to learn more)
Logging feedback 

Feedback Theme Tagging: When logged feedback about assured exact match experiment], reps should use the existing feedback theme titled: 
[Lead Quality] Pro had issue with lead that came from Assured Exact Match
For steps on submitting feedback, refer to the internal Product Feedback (Rep) 
Experiment updates


New Customer Experience 
On June 23, 2026, M4 — a nationwide proactive mismatch prevention experiment launched. Most changes were backend (latency, question refinements, model and match-accuracy improvements); the rest of the flow is the same as M3. The visible changes work to capture the RF details that drive mismatches earlier in the flow. On July 27, 2026 this experience launched to baseline on the app.
Up-funnel (during the request):
Category carousel replaces the quick-start chips on the start/expression screen.
Informed Dynamic Questions
Questions now come with a preselected answer and a short label explaining where it came from: 
"Based on what you shared" (from the query, prior answers, or photos)
"Based on your home / past projects" (Home Profile and Thumbtack memories)
"Popular with neighbors" (aggregate homeowner data). 
A light-bulb card helps with hard-to-answer questions — e.g., for square footage: "Small is roughly a two-car garage; large could fit a tennis court."
New answer options on questions: every question can now offer "None," "Not sure," and "Something else," plus "Skip for now" (replacing "Skip"). 
Selecting "Something else" / "Other" opens a free-text box ("What did you have in mind?") so customers can describe what doesn't fit a preset option. 
On multi-select questions, "None" is mutually exclusive — choosing it clears other selections, and choosing another option clears "None."
Logistics questions moved up funnel and shown when relevant: budget, age range (tutoring/lessons/personal-services categories), travel preferences, and a scheduling question — the scheduling and travel items directly target the ~10% and ~12% mismatch drivers.
Down-funnel (confirm & review):
Customers primarily confirm and review. A question the customer already answered up funnel — including ones they answered "None" or "Not sure" — is not re-asked. We surface only the skipped questions that are required for pros who target specific RF preferences; optional ones the customer skipped don't reappear.
Logistics aren't re-asked: if scheduling or travel were answered up funnel, they don't reappear here.
Minimum RF still asks to add photos, send a message to the pro, and confirm zip and phone.
Pro results (mid-funnel), the confirmation screen, and post-contact are unchanged.
Check out the annotated prototype of the experience or the M4 NCX video walkthrough! 
How to identify an Assured Exact Match lead 
Frontline Reps can identify pros included in the Assured Exact Match experiment by checking the 'Syndication type' section on the Negotiations page within Admin.
The lead is part of the Assured Exact Match experiment if the Syndication Type is one of the following:
ASSURED_EXACT_MATCH_CONTACT_DIRECT: Lead from the Assured Exact Match experiment
ASSURED_EXACT_MATCH_CONTACT_OPT_IN: opt-in contact from the Assured Exact Match experiment
Note for Reps: To compare this pilot with other active matching pilots (Smart Match, Matchmaker Test Expansion, and Personalized Preferences), reps should refer to the internal centralized Active AI Matching Experiments (Rep) KA. 
Pro experience
Baseline Experience (Pro)
The following section details the differences in the baseline experience for pros. 
Currently, when a customer submits a request via the New Hiring Experience (NHX) flow (using Dynamic Questions), the system often cannot gather enough structured data to guarantee an "Exact Match" against a pro’s specific targeting preferences. Because of this, these leads are typically sent as Opportunities, meaning the pro is invited to quote but is not auto-charged.
Experiment Assured Exact Match Experience (Pro)
This section describes the experiment experience for variant pros. 
In this experiment, the system applies new logic to validate matches and auto-charge pros in two specific scenarios:
Broad Targeting (All Job Types selected): 
How it works: If a pro has not unchecked any subcategory preferences (known as Job Types in their targeting settings, e.g., "Install a faucet," "Repair a toilet"), it signals they are open to all leads in that category. 
▶ What it looks like
Image description: A screenshot of the pro job type page showing all checkboxes selected, illustrating "Broad Targeting."

[Image: rtaImage]


Impact: Because they accept all job types, the system considers them an exact match by default and will auto-charge for these NHX leads.
Answer Inference: 
How it works: The system uses AI to infer required job details from the customer's conversation. 
Impact: If these inferred details match the pro’s specific targeting preferences (Job Types), the pro is auto-charged.
NOTE: If a mismatch job happens, the pro will submit a refund request as usual.
New customer experience
Check out the annotated prototype of the experience! 
Navigation & Entry
Home Page Entry: The Home tab is updated: 
The search bar was replaced with a “How can we help?” text box where they can immediately input project details via text, voice, or photo.
▶ What the Home page looks like

[Image: rtaImage]

Search page: A category carousel replaced the quick-start chips (from M3) on the Search screen. 
▶ What it looks like

[Image: rtaImage]

Quick start multi-modal Intake: Customers can type project needs, use Voice, and upload photos. Request form needs at least 4 words or more and can only upload a max of 3 photos)
Predictive Text: As customers type their project, the app provides predictive suggestions to reduce typing effort and educate users to be more specific to help capture the job accurately from the very first step.
NOTE: An experiment is running that removes the Teams tab and renames Plan to Projects. See the Projects tab v0 (Customer) (Experiment) KA to learn more.
▶ What the predictive text looks like

[Image: rtaImage]

The AI Flow (Dynamic Questions)
AI Photo Capture: The AI determines if a photo is needed. If so, customers are prompted to take/upload images. AI analyzes the photo to generate relevant follow-up questions. Customers can upload up to 3 photos. Customers who have already uploaded photos won’t be asked again.
▶ What the AI photo capture question looks like

[Image: rtaImage]

Informed Dynamic Questioning (DQs): Instead of a standard RF, AI asks 8–10 tailored questions based on previous answers and photos.
Answers may be prefilled and "informed" (the four source types  above). Customers also have options like “Not sure,” “None,” "Something else.” Selecting “Something else" opens a free-text box ("What did you have in mind?").
Education is surfaced in a light-bulb card below the question to help customers with hard to answer question.
▶ What a dynamic question looks like

[Image: rtaImage]

Logistics questions: When relevant, customers are asked logistics questions — budget, age range, travel preferences, and scheduling — during the up-funnel flow rather than after choosing a pro. 
Zip code: As usual, the customer confirms their zip code. If it's already on file, it's prefilled from the Express-screen zip and the customer is asked to double-check it.
▶ What the zip code question looks like

[Image: rtaImage]

Confirm project details: The customer will review and confirm the project details the AI has captured. If changes need to be made, customers can click the back arrow (<).
▶ What the project details page looks like

[Image: rtaImage]

Matching & Selection
Personalized "Best Matches":
Top 3 Best Matches: Customers see "[Customer Name]’s best matches," featuring the top 3 pros curated based on experience and data density.
Easy Button (Multiconnect): A Get 3 Quotes button allows contacting all 3 best matches simultaneously.
Customers can still select "View all pros" to see the full list.
▶ What the Best Matches page looks like

[Image: rtaImage]
   

▶ What customers see if they click "Learn how we matched you."

[Image: rtaImage]

Downfunnel Questions:
Before final submission, a "Final details for your pro" module asks 1–3 specific clarification questions (e.g., project timeline, material type or item condition) that are required to move forward. 
Only required skipped questions appear, logistics already answered up funnel are not repeated.
Once all questions are answered, they see “All set, final entails saved!” and can click the Share with pro button. 
▶ What it looks like after all questions have been answered

[Image: rtaImage]

Confirmation: Customers are taken to the project details page that confirms their project has been submitted. This is where customers can contact additional pros: send project details and view profiles. To return to these details, customers can go to their Plans tab and select their project. 
▶ What the confirmation page looks like

[Image: rtaImage]
[Image: rtaImage]

Post contact address collection: Customers without a saved Home Profile address are prompted for their address after they submit their project. The address is then saved to their Home profile and can be updated at any time.
2. Process
Steps: How to help a pro who was auto-charged for a lead that did not match their preferences (Rep)
To help a pro in the Assured Exact Match experiment who says they were auto-charged for a lead that did not match their preferences, Frontline Reps will follow these steps:
▶ Important note:
Because this experiment relies on AI inference and broad targeting, matches may not always be perfect. Pros may contact Support if they are auto-charged for a lead they believe does not match their preferences.
Check the lead’s Syndication Type. 
To determine if it's an Assured Exact Match Lead, go to the Negotiations page of the lead in Admin. 
There are two paths to get there: 
User Admin > Negotiations (fka Quotes/Bids) > Syndication Type
Negotiations Admin > Negotiation > Syndication Type
If the Syndication types, is one of the following, it’s an Assured Exact Match lead:
ASSURED_EXACT_MATCH_CONTACT_DIRECT: Lead from the Assured Exact Match experiment
ASSURED_EXACT_MATCH_CONTACT_OPT_IN: opt-in contact from the Assured Exact Match experiment
Gather feedback: 
Gather specific information about why the lead was not a match.
Log the pro’s feedback using the existing feedback item: 
[Lead Quality] Pro had issue with lead that came from Assured Exact Match 
Reps can refer to the internal Product Feedback (Rep) KA for additional guidance on logging feedback.
Refund request: 
Instruct the pro to submit a formal refund request and include all relevant details explaining why the lead was not a fit.
Pros can refer to the How to request a refund – Thumbtack Help article.
Reps can refer to the internal Lead Refunds (Pro) KA. 
3. Talking points

English talking point
Spanish talking point
Q: Why was I auto-charged for this lead? I usually get these as opportunities (opt-in).
Q: ¿Por qué se me cobró automáticamente este prospecto? Normalmente recibo este tipo de trabajos como oportunidades (opt-in).
A: We’ve updated our matching system in your area. Since your targeting preferences indicate you are open to all Job Types in this category, we were able to confirm this lead is a match for you and sent it automatically so you wouldn't miss out.
A: Hemos actualizado nuestro sistema de coincidencias en su área. Como sus preferencias de trabajo indican que acepta todos los tipos de trabajo en esta categoría, pudimos confirmar que este prospecto era una buena opción para usted y se lo enviamos automáticamente para que no perdiera la oportunidad.
Q: The customer didn't answer the specific question about [XYZ]. How did you match me?
Q: El cliente no respondió la pregunta específica sobre [XYZ]. ¿Cómo determinaron que este prospecto era adecuado para mí?
A: We are using improved technology to better understand the customer's project details from their conversation. Even if they didn't answer a specific detail, our system identified the details from their description to confirm it matched your preferences.
A: Estamos usando tecnología mejorada para comprender mejor los detalles del proyecto del cliente a partir de la conversación. Aunque no respondió esa pregunta específica, nuestro sistema identificó esos detalles en su descripción y confirmó que coincidían con sus preferencias.
Q: This lead isn't a match for me. Why did the system think it was?
Q: Este prospecto no es adecuado para mí. ¿Por qué el sistema pensó que sí lo era?
A: I apologize for the error. We are testing a new way to match you with more customers, and in this case, the system may have incorrectly interpreted the job details. I can help you with a refund request for this specific lead.
A: Le pido disculpas por el error. Estamos probando una nueva forma de conectarlo con más clientes y, en este caso, es posible que el sistema haya interpretado incorrectamente los detalles del trabajo. Puedo ayudarle a solicitar un reembolso por este prospecto en particular.
Q: Why is the customer request form different than usual?

A: We are testing a new way to collect project details. This helps us make sure we only match customers with pros who can definitely do the work.

articles.fullText:
Armis Partnership | Demand

Contents
 
1. Overview
a. How it works
b. Customer experience 
c. Armis account manager experience
d. Pro experience
2. Talking points
a. Customer
b. Pro
3. Resources
I. OVERVIEW
 
Armis, a home warranty company and a sub-brand of HomeSafe, has simplified its customers' process of finding a contractor for their repair claims by directing customers to book a pro on Thumbtack. Their customers will have two options to find a contractor for their claim:
Customers can book a Thumbtack pro themselves from the co-branded landing page. Customers can go to Thumbtack.com/homesafe and select a service from the coverage categories and Thumbtack will provide a list of pros that services the customers zip code. The customer will pick and contact the pro directly. 
Armis can book a Thumbtack pro on behalf of the customer from the co-branded landing page. Armis account managers will find a pro that services the customers zip code and contact them directly. 
 
Armis customers coverage is for the following Thumbtack categories: 
Appliance repair 
HVAC
Plumbers
Electricians
Garage door repair
Pool repair
 
Once the customer or Armis account manager contacts a pro, the pro will receive this as a normal lead. Customers have the option to contact additional pros if they don’t hear back from the first pro. 
You can identify customers who came from Amris after they submit their first project. 
NOTE: If you run into any problems that should be escalated to the Armis team, instruct the customer or pro to contact ahc@armishome.com. (e.g., the customer has questions about paying their Armis deductible).
IDENTIFY THESE CUSTOMERS
 
Customers who come to us from Armis will have an Armis/Homesafe pill added to their account  
NOTE: For now, this pill will not be removed when the Armis job is complete. If you see this pill, it may be for a job that has already taken place. If you have any job-specific questions, and you see this pill, determine if the question is about an Armis job before providing details. 
 

[Image: rtaImage]

HOW IT WORKS
 
An Armis customer contacts Armis to report their repair needs and submit a claim.
Armis will do one of the following: 
Armis contacts a Thumbtack pro for the customer.
An Armis account manager uses the co-branded landing page to find a Thumbtack pro. 
Armis clicks on a service to book, picks a pro, and fills in the request form. 
Armis creates a user account for the customer with a phone number, email address, and password. 
Armis contacts the pro for the customer. 
Armis sends an email to the customer letting them know a pro has been contacted and that they need to set their password and accept the Terms and Conditions of Thumbtack. 
The customer will log in to the new Thumbtack account to update their password and accept Thumbtack Terms and Conditions. 
Armis customer contacts a Thumbtack pro themselves.  
Armis will send the customer an email with the link to the co-branded landing page. 
From the landing page they were sent, the customer will contact a pro the same way as the usual booking experience. 
Customer clicks on a service to book, picks a pro, and fills in the request form. 
Thumbtack will send Armis an email when a pro and customer have connected. 
Pros booked through the Armis landing page will proceed with scheduling an appointment with the customer to perform a diagnosis as usual. However, when the pro visits the customer’s home, the experience will be slightly different. See the Pro Experience section for more details.  
CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE
  
Customers will follow the usual booking experience with on difference, they will book using the co-branded landing page Customer Book a Pro Page w/ How it Works, from there they will:
 
Select a service – Select a service needed into the "What's on your to-do list?" search bar in the top left.
Select a pro – Based on the service needed and zip code the customer will see a list of pros in their area. Select a pro by clicking "view profile".
Fill out the request form – Enter more information like their location (ex: zip code) and the job (ex: repair needs). Thumbtack will ask for more information like their preferred date and time and information about the nature of the repair needed.
Hire a pro – Book the pro at the end of the request flow. Thumbtack will alert Homesafe that a pro has been booked. Communication channels vary by pro and service, but the pro will communicate with the customer via the Thumbtack app, text, or phone to arrange the final details of your booking.
 
Customer questions - If a customer has questions about how to book a pro or how Thumbtack works, our Service and Support advocates will handle those questions. If the customer has questions about how to submit a claim or their Armis coverage, Armis will handle those questions. 
 
If customers need help, they can contact partnerproducts-eng@thumtback.com.
ARMIS ACCOUNT MANAGER
 
Armis account managers will find a pro that services the customers zip code and contact them directly. Account Manager Book a Pro Page w/ How  it Work
 
Select a service – Select a service from the top categories above or type the service needed into the "What's on your to-do list?" search bar in the top left.
Select a pro – Based on the service needed and zip code you will see a list of pros in the customers area. Select a pro by clicking "view profile".
Fill out the request form – Enter more information like the customers location (ex: your zip code) and the job (ex: repair needs). Thumbtack will ask for more information like the customers preferred date and time and information about the nature of the repair needed.
Hire a pro – Book a pro at the end of the request flow. When asked to enter a name, email, and phone number enter the information of the customer with a placeholder password known to only Armis.
Alert the customer – An email will automatically be generated to the customer letting them know that they are booked and need to reset their password to access the Thumbtack platform themselves.
PRO EXPERIENCE 
 
Pros booked through the Armis landing page will proceed with scheduling an appointment with the customer to perform a diagnosis as usual. However, when the pro visits the customer’s home, the experience will be slightly different. Here’s more on how it works: 
Once the pro has determined the failure, they must email a copy of the invoice to customersupport@armishome.com or via fax 303-484-6811.
Invoices should include:
Company name and address,
Customer name and address
Model and serial (if applicable)
Diagnosis and repair costs
If failure is a leak, a picture of the failed component 
Pros shouldn't request full payment from the customer. The customer will pay the pro their Armis deductible fee of $65, which is subtracted from the invoice total.  
If the claim is approved, Armis will pay the remaining amount by credit card upon job completion. 
Armis can pay by check if the pro prefers, but it takes ~ 7-10 business days to arrive. 
If the claim is not eligible for coverage per the terms of Armis' contract, all labor to date would be the homeowner's responsibility.

Pros can contact Armis at customersupport@armishome.com or 855-275-2875 with any questions. 
2. TALKING POINTS
CUSTOMER
What is Thumbtack?
Thumbtack matches you with local pros. You tell us what’s next on your to-do list and we show you a list of nearby pros who fit the job. With the Thumbtack app, you can compare pro profiles and prices, chat with the pros you like, and (last but not least) check availability and hire pros who fit your projects.
¿Qué es Thumbtack? 
Thumbtack le empareja con profesionales locales. Díganos qué sigue en su lista de tareas pendientes y le mostramos una lista de profesionales cercanos que se adaptan al trabajo. Con la aplicación Thumbtack, puede comparar perfiles profesionales y precios, hablar con los profesionales que le gustan y (por último, pero no menos importante) verificar la disponibilidad y contratar profesionales que se adapten a sus proyectos.
How do I find pros?
Once you tell us what service you need (house cleaning, handyman, etc.) and where you need it, you get a list of pros instantly. The list is real-time, so your results change as you use filters or update your zip code. If a certain pro catches your eye, go to their profile to contact them and discuss the details.
¿Cómo encuentro profesionales?
Una vez que nos diga qué servicio necesita (limpieza de la casa, personal de mantenimiento, etc.) y dónde lo necesita, obtendrá una lista de profesionales al instante. La lista es en tiempo real, por lo que sus resultados cambian a medida que usa filtros o actualiza su código postal. Si un profesional le llama la atención, vaya a su perfil para contactarlo y discutir los detalles.
How do I contact a pro?
It’s easy to contact pros on Thumbtack. From your list of results, view the pro’s profile. You’ll see a few different options to contact them. Once you reach out, we’ll let the pro know you’re waiting to hear back from them and notify you when they reply.
¿Cómo me comunico con un profesional?
Es fácil ponerse en contacto con profesionales en Thumbtack. De su lista de resultados, vea el perfil del profesional. Verá algunas opciones diferentes para comunicarse con ellos. Una vez que se comunique con el profesional, le informaremos al profesional que está esperando recibir noticias de él y le notificaremos cuando le responda.
What if the pro I contacted doesn't get back to me?
If you don’t hear back from a pro, you can always go to your Projects to review the list of pros you saw when you started your search. While these pros weren’t your first pick, they could also be a really great fit.
¿Qué pasa si el profesional con el que me comuniqué no me responde?
Si no recibe noticias de un profesional, siempre puede ir a sus Proyectos para revisar la lista de profesionales que vio cuando comenzó su búsqueda. Si bien estos profesionales no fueron su primera elección, también podrían encajar muy bien.
How do I keep messaging a pro I reached out to?
You’ll find all the messages you exchange with pros in your inbox. If you're not hearing back, you can revisit the list of pros you saw in search results by going to your Projects.
¿Cómo sigo enviando mensajes a un profesional con el que me comuniqué?
Encontrará todos los mensajes que intercambia con profesionales en su bandeja de entrada. Si no recibe respuesta, puede volver a visitar la lista de profesionales que vio en los resultados de búsqueda en sus Proyectos.
PRO
 
How does this (Armis) lead differ from my usual Thumbtack leads? 
These leads are only different in how you get paid and how you might need to submit additional pictures (such as if there's a leak, Armis requires a pic). 
If you accept the job, you will send Armis the diagnosis and the cost to complete the job in an estimate via email. If the failure is a leak, Armis will also require a picture of the failed component.

Armis requires a copy of the invoice, which can be sent to customersupport@armishome.com or their fax at 303-484-6811.

¿En qué se diferencia este prospecto de Armis de mis prospectos habituales en Thumbtack?
Estos prospectos solo es difierente en cómo se paga y en la posibilidad de que necesite enviar fotos adicionales (como si hubiera una fuga, Armis requiere una foto).
Si acepta el trabajo, enviará a Armis el diagnóstico y el costo para completar el trabajo en un presupuesto por correo electrónico. Si la falla es una fuga, Armis también requerirá una foto del componente fallido.
Armis requiere una copia de la factura, que se puede enviar a customersupport@armishome.com o por fax al 303-484-6811.
 
How will I get paid?
Your customer should pay you their deductible fee of $65, which will be subtracted from the invoice total. Armis will pay the remaining amount on any covered claim. Please do not request full payment from the customer. Armis pays by credit card upon job completion if the invoice is approved. Armis can pay by check if you would prefer, but it may take 7-10 business days to arrive. 
 
¿Cómo voy a recibir el pago?
Su cliente debería pagarle la tarifa deducible de $65, que se restará del total de la factura. Armis pagará el monto restante de cualquier reclamo cubierto. Por favor, no solicite el pago completo al cliente. Armis paga con tarjeta de crédito al completar el trabajo si la factura es aprobada. Armis puede pagar con cheque si lo prefiere, pero puede tardar de 7 a 10 días hábiles en llegar.
 
What info does Armis require?
Once you have determined the failure, please send Armis the diagnosis, and the cost to complete the job on an estimate via email. If the failure is a leak, Armis will require a picture of the failed component as well. Armis requires a copy of the invoice which can be sent to customersupport@armishome.com or to their fax at 303-484-6811.
 
¿Qué información requiere Armis?
Una vez que haya determinado la falla, por favor envíe el diagnóstico y el costo a Armis para completar el trabajo en un presupuesto por correo electrónico. Si la falla es una fuga, Armis también requerirá una foto del componente que falló. Armis requiere una copia de la factura, que se puede enviar a customersupport@armishome.com o por fax al 303-484-6811.
What info should be included in the invoice?
The invoice should have the company name, address, customer name, model and serial if applicable, customer’s address, diagnosis, and repair costs. 
 
¿Qué información debe incluirse en la factura?
La factura debe tener el nombre de la empresa, dirección, nombre del cliente, modelo y número de serie si corresponde, dirección del cliente, diagnóstico y costo de la reparación.
 
What happens if the claim is not eligible for coverage? 
If the claim is not eligible for coverage per the terms of Armis’ contract, all labor to date would be the responsibility of the homeowner.
 
¿Qué sucede si el reclamo no es elegible para cobertura?Si el reclamo no es elegible para cobertura según los
términos del contrato de Armis, todos los costos de mano de obra hasta la fecha serán responsabilidad del propietario de la vivienda.
 
I have questions about Armis, who do I contact? 
If you have questions, please feel free to reach out to Armis at customersupport@armishome.com or by phone at 855-275-2875. 
Tengo preguntas sobre Armis, ¿a quién puedo contactar?
Si tiene preguntas, no dude en comunicarse con Armis en customersupport@armishome.com o por teléfono al 855-275-2875

1. Overview
(

[Image: Intro to Apps page: "Connect the apps you use to manage your leads"]
 

On April 20, 2026, Thumbtack launched an experiment introducing the new Apps tab for pros. This update moves integration links from disparate locations into a single, high-visibility tab in the main navigation. The experiment shipped to baseline on Friday, June 26, 2026. 
Pros see a "Apps" tab where they can view featured partner integration tools, view any of the integrations they have connected , access Help Center articles, and manage self-serve webhooks. 
Feature Highlights
Centralized Hub: 
Web: Apps tab in the main navigation.
App: Apps & Integrations option in settings. 
Partner Visibility: Highlights Thumbtack partner FSMs for easier connection.
Webhook Management: Self-serve webhooks live in this hub.
Status Tracking: Active integration statuses are viewable directly in the hub.
How to access Apps page
Web
Pros will click Apps in the main navigation at the top of the page
NOTE: On mobile web (mweb), the self-serve webhook page is view-only. Pros will see a prompt to access this specific page via Desktop to make changes.
▶ What it looks like

[Image: Web screen: Apps page]

App: 
Profile > Settings (click gear in to right) > App & Integrations 
NOTE: Clicking the Apps & Integrations tab will redirect the pro to an mobile web view within the app.
▶ What it looks like

[Image: App screen: Settings page showing "Apps & Integrations" option]
[Image: App screen: Apps & Integrations page]
 

Experience details
Experiment run dates: April 20 - June 25, 2026
Shipped to baseline: June 26, 2026 
Impacted users: All pros nationwide 
Platforms: Web, Native (iOS/Android), and Mobile Web (mweb)
Edit webhooks are available on Desktop only.
2. Pro experience

Feature
Prior to App tab
Baseline with App tab
Navigation
No dedicated tab.
Apps Tab: A new top-level navigation item.
Access Point
Links buried in Messages or settings 
Centralized "Hub" experience.
Integration Status
Not visible.
Status View: Active integrations are viewable in the hub.
Setup Process
Self-serve links to 3 featured partner tools.(HouseCall Pro, ServiceTitan, GoSite)
Self-serve links and instructions to 4 top apps (Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan, Jobber, Workiz)
Webhooks
Self-serve webhooks
Self-serve webhooks.
Connecting Apps
Pros can initiate connections to Thumbtack partners directly from the Apps tab.
Connect a Thumbtack partner 

The Apps page has a Your top apps section. These include highlighted Thumbtack partners like Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan, and Workiz.
Learn more: When a pro clicks Learn more on a Thumbtack partner card, they’re taken to Thumbtack Help.
Setup flow: When a pro clicks "Connect” on a Thumbtack partner card, they will be prompted to log in to their FSM account to initiate the setup.
Return experience: Once finished, they return to the Apps page, where the partner will now show a Connected status under “Apps connected to this profile.”
NOTE: If the pro doesn’t have an account and wants to sign up with a partner, they should go to the Thumbtack Partner Marketplace. Some partners have special offers for first-time users. To learn more about Thumbtack partners, see Thumbtack Partner Integrations (Pro) KA.
▶ What the Your top apps section looks like

[Image: Web screen: "Your top apps" with Thumbtack partners listed below]

Connect custom options (webhooks)

The "Don't see an app you use?" section is located at the bottom of the page and provides the following options:
Webhooks: These allow pros to establish a connection for sending leads, messages, and reviews to an external service or application. To begin, pros can select Manage webhooks. Reps can refer to the Webhooks (Pro) KA to learn more.
Developer portal: Designed for developers and partners managing technically complex integrations, this portal allows them to link their own software with Thumbtack. Pros can access more information via the View developer docs button.
▶ What the custom options section looks like

[Image: Web screen: "Don't see an app you use?" section with Webhooks and Developer Portal options]

Manage connected Apps

After connecting their first application, pros will find an "Apps connected" area at the top of the page, displaying all active webhooks and Thumbtack partner tools.
Status and visibility: 
Current Status: Active connections are marked as Connected. Any failures will trigger an Error status.
Pros with a webhook error must resolve the error on a desktop or laptop. 
Thumbtack partners must be addressed directly on the partner's website.
Data Transparency: The specific types of data being shared (such as messages or leads) are listed clearly under the app or webhook. (e.g., "Thumbtack leads and messages are being sent to your account").
Manage apps:
Partner apps: Pros can select Go to partner site to log in to their FSM account and manage or remove the connection. Thumbtack partners must be addressed directly on the partner's website.
Webhooks: The Manage webhooks button opens a dedicated page for creating, editing, monitoring, troubleshooting or deleting webhook configurations. 
The self-serve webhook page is view-only. Pros will see a prompt to access this specific page via Desktop to make changes.
Other apps: Some partners won’t have a button next to them. 
▶ What the Apps connected section looks like

[Image: Web screen: "Apps connected" section of page]

Share feedback
Pros are encouraged to leave feedback on the new Apps page. At the top of the page, pros will see a “Tell us what you think about this page. Let us know.” Pros can click “Let us know” to leave their feedback. 

[Image: rtaImage]

3. Talking points


Scenario
Messaging
Pro asks where to find integrations
You can now find all your business tool connections in one place! Just click on the new 'Apps' tab in your navigation bar to see available integrations and manage your current ones.
Pro asks about active status
One of the benefits of the new Apps tab is that you can see exactly which integrations are currently active. This helps ensure your Thumbtack account is syncing correctly with your other tools.
Pro cannot edit webhooks on mobile
To keep your data secure, the webhook management tool is only editable on a desktop computer. You can view the settings on your phone, but you'll need to log in via a browser on your computer to make changes.
Pro wants to disconnect a partner app (not Webhooks)
You will need to disconnect directly on your active app.

articles.fullText:
AI Messaging Assistance (Pro)

Contents

Overview
Eligibility
Updates
Relaunch + on and off toggle
Experience shipped nationwide
Value props to use when speaking with pros
How AI-written replies work
How the AI handles the initial response
What the pro experience looks like
Steps: How to navigating conversations about AI-written replies
Talking points to navigate pro questions
Resources
1. Overview
▶ KA Summary
This internal knowledge article (KA) provides guidance on the AI messaging assistance, a feature designed to help pros draft high-quality replies to customer leads. 
Pros now have access to a tool powered by AI that drafts their first reply on leads, crafted with research-backed best practices and the pro's tone so every reply is unique. Pros stay in full control throughout: they can send the draft as-is, edit it, swap it for a saved Quick Reply, or turn AI drafting off entirely using the on/off toggle in their reply screen.
AI reply drafts are replies for a pro as soon as they click reply on a new lead. The draft is written in the pro's voice, pulls in specific details from the customer's request, and ends with a single easy question — so pros can respond quickly without starting from a blank page.
Pros stay in full control throughout: they can send the draft as-is, edit it, swap it for a saved Quick Reply, or turn AI drafting off entirely using the toggle in their reply screen.
See the Updates section below for the latest on rollout status, the new toggle on or off option, and platform availability.
Eligibility

AI-drafted replies aren't available to every pro. Currently excluded:
Pros using integrations or auto-responders (e.g., Front Desk) — since these pros already have an automated first-response path.
Pros in sensitive categories that don’t have Thumbtack numbers — see Thumbtack numbers (Pro) (Customer) KA for the current list. 
Value props to use when speaking with pros
This section outlines the value proposition of the AI assistant, providing reps with benefits to highlight when coaching pros on how the tool helps them win more jobs and stay competitive.
Hear back from more customers. AI reply drafts incorporate research-backed best practices that win responses.
Personal replies without extra work. Replies are based on the customer's project details and keep your professional tone.
Respond quickly without sacrificing quality. Reply effectively even while on the job, reaching customers sooner.
Updates
Relaunch + on / off toggle
This experience relaunched nationwide on August 10, 2026, with a new toggle so pros can turn AI-drafted replies on or off themselves, right from the reply screen. The toggle is sticky — a pro's choice applies across all their leads, not just the one they're viewing, until they change it again
A few things to note about how the toggle behaves:
Drafts keep generating even when a pro is opted out. Turning the toggle off doesn't stop draft generation in the background — so if a pro switches it back on, a draft is ready right away instead of making them wait.
Opt-outs from the original experiment carried over. Pros who called Support to opt out during the experiment are automatically in the opted-out state now — they don't need to do anything to keep that preference.
A draft isn't always ready yet. If no draft has been generated for a lead (or generation failed), the toggle shows as grayed out and disabled, and the pro defaults to writing their own reply. The app won't try to load a draft while they're in that state. If they leave and come back once a draft's ready, the toggle re-enables — unless they'd opted out, in which case that preference is still honored.
Experience shipped nationwide

In mid-May, Thumbtack launched a nationwide experience testing the new in-app AI messaging experience for pros on iOS and Android. On July 22, 2026, that experience shipped to baseline and then temporarily paused on July 23, 2026.
In the experiment, this feature was only available on iOS and Android. With the nationwide launch, this feature is now available on web. 
Feedback theme: When submitting pro feedback about AI messaging assistance, use the existing feedback theme 
[Messages] Feedback / Opt Out requests related to AI Messaging Draft Assistance 
2. How AI-drafted replies work
This section details the technical behavior of the AI assistant and how it applies Thumbtack's messaging best practices to initial pro-to-customer interactions.
How the AI handles the initial response
The AI assistant mimics the pro's voice while following Thumbtack's research-backed messaging best practices.
Personalized learning: Responses are trained on the pro's past messages to ensure the tone sounds authentic to their business.
Smart drafting: The AI automatically pulls in project details (e.g., "3bd/2ba," "fridge cleaning") to show the customer the pro has read their request.
The "one-question" rule: Instead of a long list of questions, the AI is designed to end with exactly one low-effort question to make it easy for the customer to respond.
What the AI avoids
No "laundry lists": The AI avoids asking for photos, addresses, and measurements all in the first message, which can overwhelm customers.
Messaging first: The AI prioritizes text over calling, as research shows customers prefer a digital introduction before a phone call.
What the pro experience looks like 
When a pro opens a new lead and taps Reply, what they see depends on the state of their draft and toggle:

[Image: rtaImage]

State 1: AI draft ready, toggle on
The draft animates in word-by-word, using the customer's project details and ending in one easy question. A disclosure appears under the draft — "Drafted by AI. Review before sending." From here, pros can:
Send: Wait for animation to finish, then tap Send.
Edit: Tap the text field and modify the draft.
Use Quick Reply: Tap the Quick Reply (speech bubble) icon to swap in a pre-saved template instead — this overrides the AI draft. Tapping Send on the quick reply will send the message to the customer and bring the pro to the messenger. 
Add attachments: Tap the paperclip icon to add attachments. 
State 2: Toggled off
Turning the toggle off clears the AI draft and gives the pro a blank reply field to write their own message.  
State 3: AI draft unavailable
If a draft hasn't been generated yet for the lead, or generation failed, the toggle appears grayed out and disabled. 
The pro defaults to writing their own reply, and the app won't try to load a draft while they're in this view. 
If they leave and return once a draft becomes available, the toggle re-enables — unless the pro had opted out, in which case that preference is still honored.

How the toggle behaves across leads and sessions
Persists at the business level. Once toggled off, it stays off for every lead until the pro switches it back on — reps don't need to walk a pro through turning it off lead-by-lead.
Drafts keep generating in the background, even while a pro has the feature turned off. When they switch it back on, a draft is ready right away instead of making them wait.
Edits carry over between toggles, whether to the AI draft or the pro's own written reply — as long as the pro stays on that lead's details page. If they navigate away (e.g., back to the leads list) and return later, the in-progress draft isn't persisted, and the reply field resets.
3. Steps: How to navigate conversations about AI messaging assistance (Rep)
Support Reps can use this section to guide pros through their experience with AI messaging assistance and handle opt-out requests when they come up.
To address a pro's concerns and, if needed, submit an opt-out request, Support Reps will follow these steps:
Acknowledge the pro's concern about staying in control of their messages.
▶ Talking point
"I understand wanting to stay in control of the messages you send. Many pros want to make sure every message sounds like them."
Explain what AI messaging assistance does.
▶ Talking point
"AI messaging assistance helps you respond faster with a strong first draft, based on research-backed best practices, and it's designed to sound like you. You can edit the draft as much or as little as you'd like before sending it."
Share the data behind why Thumbtack recommends the feature.
▶ Talking point
 “AI-generated drafts have meaningfully increased overall customer responsiveness — more customers reply to pros who use the drafts. The biggest driver of that success is that the drafts consistently include a clear next step, presented as a simple question, which keeps customers engaged and earns more replies.”
If the pro is worried about editing the draft too much, explain how edits affect performance.
▶ Talking point
“Interestingly, our data shows that pros who make only light edits, or send the draft largely as-is, tend to see better reply rates than pros who completely rewrite the message. The draft is built using patterns we've seen perform well."
Reassure the pro that they're still in control.
▶ Talking point
“You're always able to review and edit every draft before it's sent. Nothing is automatically sent on your behalf.”
Let the pro know they have self-serve opt-out controls.
▶ Talking point
"You have full control over this — there's a toggle right at the top of your reply screen that lets you turn AI-drafted replies on or off anytime. Once you turn it off, you'll get a blank reply field to write on your own, and that choice sticks across all your leads until you switch it back. I'd still recommend giving the drafts a try since you can turn them off anytime with no commitment — but it's completely your call."
If the pro still wants to opt out, collect feedback on what isn't working (e.g., What specifically isn't working well? How could we improve the experience to be more helpful?).
▶ Talking point
"If you'd still prefer not to use AI messaging assistance, I can absolutely show you where to find the toggle in your reply screen — once you switch it off, it'll stay off across all your leads until you turn it back on. Is there anything in particular about the experience you didn't like, or feedback on how we could make this work better for you?"
Submit the pro's feedback using the feedback theme: [Messages] Feedback / Opt Out requests related to AI Messaging Draft Assistance 
Talking points to navigate pro questions
Support reps can use these points to explain what the AI is doing without using technical jargon.

Talking Point
Q: What is this AI-written replies feature?
A: The AI-powered assistant helps you reply to leads faster. It drafts a personalized response based on your previous messages and the customer’s project details so you can stay responsive even when you’re busy on a job.
Q: What does the AI prioritize in its draft?
A: Our data shows that customers are much more likely to hire you if your first message is short, mentions their specific project, and ends with one simple question. The AI drafts the message that way to help you get a faster reply without the extra typing.
Q: Does this just send a generic template?
A: The assistant isn't just sending templates. It actually learns from your past messages and is designed to sound like you. You are still the author—you're in full control to edit the message or toggle it offi  f you'd rather write it yourself or use one of your saved Quick Replies.
Q: Is a bot messaging my customers for me?
A: Not at all. Think of this as a collaborative drafting tool. You are the author of every message; the AI just helps you get a head start. You can review and change the message before the customer ever sees it.
Q: I don't like this. How do I turn it off?
A: You can turn this off yourself anytime — there's a toggle right in your reply screen. Once you turn it off, you'll get a blank reply field, and that preference sticks across all your leads until you turn it back on.
