articles.fullText:
Account Holds (Customer)

Contents
Overview
Key points
Dos and Dont's
Customer Account Hold Reasons and Resolution
How customer account holds work
Process
Steps: How to identify account holds (Rep)
Steps: How to help customers with an account hold (Rep)
Steps: How to help customers with a ghosted account (Rep)
Talking point
Customer Account Hold: Deceptive Practices or spammy behavior
Customer Account Hold: General issues or needs coaching
Customer Account Hold: User being investigated - Payments
Resources
1. Overview
▶ KA Summary
This internal knowledge article for Frontline Reps provides an overview of customer account holds, including how they work, the reasons an account might be placed on hold, and the product update roadmap for this feature. It outlines the process for identifying and assisting customers with account holds, as well as handling ghosted accounts. The article also includes key talking points and resources for support agents.
A customer account hold (CAH) is an account hold is a measure implemented by Trust and Safety (T&S) teams to restrict a customer's access to their Thumbtack account. This is done to address various issues or investigate suspicious activities. It's important to note that these customer account holds are different from pro account holds.
Reasons for an Account Hold:
A customer's account may be placed on hold for several reasons, including:
Investigations:
User being investigated - Deceptive Practices (e.g., spammy project requests)
User being investigated - Payments
User being investigated - General
User Issues:
User has general issues or needs coaching (e.g., possible Terms of Use violation, needing to update or remove content)
User has chargebacks
User needs to verify their information
User has an open dispute
Legacy Holds:
User has been put on hold via legacy CAH (holds placed before V2 logs were enabled)
What a customer can and cannot do with an account hold 
This section outlines the actions customers can and cannot take when their account is on hold, providing clarity on their access and limitations within the Thumbtack platform.
Cannot Do:
Customers with an account hold cannot log in to their accounts.
If a customer with an account hold is also a pro, they will not have access to their pro account either.
Customers will not be directly informed of the reason for the hold; support reps are instructed not to share this information.
Can Do:
Customers will only be alerted to an account hold when they attempt to log in.
If already logged in, they will be forced to log out and will receive a screen pop-up (on web and iOS, not Android) and an email notification.
In some cases, customers may need to resolve an issue on their side (e.g., chargebacks) before the hold is removed. In other cases, they may need to wait while T&S investigates their account.
Key points
Here are key points for Frontline Reps to remember when helping customers with account holds:
Customers with holds have an Admin flag that says “Customer Account Hold.” 
Unlike pros with account holds, customers with an account hold cannot log in to their accounts. 
If a customer with an account hold is also a pro, they won’t have access to their pro account either. 
Don’t share the reason why there's a hold on the customer's account. 
Do follow the talking points based on the hold reason.
Do’s and Don’ts
Here are some "Do and Don't" guidelines for Frontline Reps when helping customers with account holds:
Do's:
Do follow the talking points based on the hold reason.
Do tell customers, "I'll look into your account."
Ghosted accounts: Do let customers know that a technical team will review their account if it is ghosted.
Ghosted accounts: Do direct customers to call support at 866-501-5809 or 800-948-2034 if they are emailing, texting, or on a chat about a ghosted account.
Don'ts:
Don't share the reason why there's a hold on the customer's account.
Ghosted accounts: Don't mention "ghosting" or share details about why they didn't receive any quotes from pros when speaking with customers or pros.
Customer Account Hold Reasons and Resolution 
Customers may be placed on hold for a variety of reasons, which are reflected in the Admin Customer Hold Logs. To see the hold logs, follow the Steps: How to identify account holds (Rep). 
The table below provides a summary of these reasons: 

Account Hold Reason
Reason a customer’s account can be placed on hold 
Account Hold Removal Reason
Reason a customer’s account hold can be removed 
Description
User being investigated - Deceptive Practices
Investigation completed - Deceptive Practices
The user is being investigated for spammy behavior
User being investigated - Payments
Investigation completed - Payments
The use is being investigated for payment issues
User being investigated - General
Investigation completed - General
The use is under general investigation
User has general issues or needs coaching 
User has been coached for given issues 
User was flagged for possible terms of use violation

User is required to update or remove certain content on their account. This may include when a pro needs coaching on an incident, or when they need to be educated on a behavior that is not allowed.
User has chargebacks
User has resolved chargeback issues
User has reported charges to their bank
User needs to verify
User has been verified 
User needs to verify their information
User has open dispute
User has resolved all disputes
User is involved in a T&S dispute
User has been put on hold via legacy CAH
User has been enabled from legacy CAH
User was placed on hold before V2 logs were enabled.
How customer account holds work
This section explains the mechanics of how customer account holds function on the Thumbtack platform.
Here’s how customer account holds work:
Customers will only be alerted to an account hold when they try to access their account by logging in. 
When the customer tries to log in*, they will have the same experience as if they had a deactivated account, and they will not be able to log in. 
If customers are already logged into their Thumbtack account, it will force them to log out. The customer will receive a screen pop-up (varies depending on where they're logged in) and will also receive an email. (See what it looks like below.)▶ What it looks likeWeb:[Image: AD_4nXcwAKEVhfdV-mY3ggd8F6D3O1Q7K03romt_ZMf5iVtyxMmK0FDEQe47zn1DpxoJ8PtBqRHmqVtWy4yUZTsyuLTB0AVcR42iqhZytRLxpNmWY28IMAseMI7bg0RLB5SZ0mGpr7Z6aQqrV-Z50RQyODdDnH7x]iOS app:[Image: AD_4nXfD41uXUA1UYiyxDJHAzYaq4ufWiHFHLsfoA6KpsBCsXpJoIwVMciqThGOzdE-09XDxMOC1l5jj6ZpjKn9lVtW1KxhFFzMg-deWespLvsJIcSGto5F92CGQ8NtBdb6BBmIE8V_Tt5i6TSDK6MrnFNZm46dB]Email:[Image: AD_4nXcy71ehFM1JdNzrKJohIYOD6nGElHI7CRWhJOdlwQsFru1MEYoIxS3R3XWWqd36uRAK9QAVjG7ox73WGBMosxyynFAQgu3OEkj5Y1ebtnHp8w4vfj7FfmbJ1pOvIO2CLp6QRL7nKeBE_WeoDHSRjmuVt_bY]
*NOTE: Android logins will not trigger a pop-up or email.
Trust and Safety will manually add or remove the Customer Account Hold per the above. 
If, after further investigation, T&S confirms the customer's account is actionable, they will ghost/delete and blocklist the customer. 
If, after further investigation, T&S confirms the customer's account is acceptable, they will remove the customer account hold. 
NOTE: If a customer is also a pro and has a customer account hold, they will not be able to access their pro account either. 
2. Process
This section outlines the process for managing customer account holds, from identifying them to assisting customers and categorizing cases.
Steps: How to check if a customers account is on hold and why (Rep)
To efficiently check if a customer has an account hold and understand why their account is on hold, Frontline Reps will follow these steps:
From the main users page, check the flags under the customers name. Customers with an account hold will have a yellow ”Customer Account Hold” flag on their Admin account. (See what it looks like below.) (Customers who have been ghosted will have a yellow "Ghosted" flag).▶ What it looks like[Image: AD_4nXciPyidxneOXl5br-v7-noRysSXW3MgxzHAHwjwh0-12256fflOchoEZDWkCM9_-Zys8Agi_x51fN9HngjccHGWowt-XqotVqOxDkGBi-zgYzFRENC6EzIlsm3HN6_VzHAfd74e3YCG0xW2jesM91TT6_k]
Check the pills in the Customer Account hold flags under the Details section to see why the customer was put on hold. To see what the pills mean, refer to the Customer Account Hold Reasons and Resolution section above  (See what it looks like below.)▶ What it looks like[Image: AD_4nXeZP3GvfNn_8Z8aJuDY51RnbjW-3VUeNnUZMuxb1MWXXdVOSpThcBs2grfKBIHBmFewXuUscgdUt8zlnAUYN80KujhxRx3xfWKJt0H9sh9CucCxhts6kOOp5r2DnX6gW4SCtS2r9tro9-S4V2-nHIpB4mg0]
In the Actions column, click the “Customer Account Holds Log” to determine when the hold was placed. (See what it looks like below.)▶ What it looks like[Image: AD_4nXdnRHCplb09JbRPc-ZmQo_tOH5QjfjpTDYOpRuV14XYTIzjG5xiCKyVfEfebqiDyRXGTaaAPzJN90HTe6jwKzhSafBCQEgPUVbYqmCSSHMmy9ci30FqWzxdtCVR3vy12UHNJoJwcGuPJZZSK_K1w2XTBmDj][Image: AD_4nXfs-kDAy4vypee2hTyEQCgrmQAOozuWv6LyTpOL34fACLH0-aFt7kjkjfwP4d0JtMhimJIed1Ir2oqmz6Xld4aEYMqL1UE1h-UnzZph128ruPtM4-3LgRPApp4KvcOaY_60-OIzKgjJtRXEaYV-gYJwR456]
Steps: How to help customers with an account hold (Rep)
To effectively help customers with account holds, Frontline Reps will follow these guidelines.
Customer holds will need to be manually removed by T&S.
In some cases, the customer will need to resolve an issue on their side before the hold is removed (ex: chargebacks).
In other cases, there is nothing the customer can do but wait as T&S investigates their account for suspicious activity (ex: deceptive practices).
T&S will remove the hold once the customer has resolved their issue or the investigation has been completed.
For “User has general issues or needs coaching” and "Deceptive Practices/spammy behavior” holds, frontline reps can use the talking points below to help navigate these conversations. 
Steps: How to help customers with a ghosted account (Rep)
When a customer contacts support saying they’ve been sending messages to pros but haven't heard back, or that they didn't get any quotes from pros, it's possible their account has been ghosted. This means the customer was flagged for suspicious activity, and Thumbtack is preventing their requests or messages from reaching pros.
(Internal only: DO NOT use the term “ghost” or “ghosted” when speaking with customers or pros.)
To effectively help customers with ghosted accounts, Frontline Reps will follow these guidelines and steps.
What customers with ghosted accounts experience:
They are still able to “send” messages to pros, but these messages won't actually be delivered.
They can access their account, but it will appear as if no pros are available to provide quotes.
They are not informed that their account has been flagged.
If a Frontline Rep confirms a customer is NOT a scammer and is speaking to them on the phone, Frontline Reps can follow the steps below to un-ghost the account. 
Say, “I’ll look into your account.”
Do NOT mention ghosting or share details about why they didn’t receive any quotes from pros.
In Admin, open the account to see if the customer is ghosted. Customers who have been ghosted will have a yellow pill/flag at the top of their main user Admin page that says "Ghosted".
Note that customers who are ghosted won't always have an account hold on their account. However, they will have a "Ghosted" flag below their name, and the "Banned status" will likely be "Blocklisted."
If the customer’s account is ghosted, let the customer know we’re looking into this, and a technical team will review their account. Use the talking point below.
Transfer the case to Trusty and Safety using the reason “Other” and “Inaccurately ghosted.” For steps, reps will follow the internal Trust and Safety KA. 
Click Submit.
If speaking to customer via non-voice channel: A customer’s account cannot be un-ghosted if they’re emailing, texting or chatting in. So, Frontline Reps should direct the customer to call support at 866-501-5809 or 800-948-2034. 
3. Talking points
This section provides Frontline Reps with approved talking points for communicating with customers about their account holds. Use these talking points to ensure consistent and accurate messaging.
Customer Account Hold: Deceptive Practices or spammy behavior
When a customer's account has been flagged for suspicious activity, such as deceptive practices or spammy behavior, use the following talking points to address their questions and explain the review process.

English FAQ
Spanish FAQ
Q: Why is my account on hold? Can you remove it? 
Q: ¿Por qué mi cuenta está suspendida? ¿Puede quitar la suspensión?
A: Your account was flagged for suspicious behavior. Our Trust and Safety team is carefully reviewing your account. They will remove the hold if your account's behavior is cleared. This process should take no longer than 48 hours.
A: Su cuenta fue marcada por comportamiento sospechoso. Nuestro equipo de Confianza y Seguridad está revisando su cuenta cuidadosamente. Ellos quitarán la suspensión si el comportamiento de su cuenta es aprobado. Este proceso no debería tomar más de 48 horas.

Customer Account Hold: General issues or needs coaching

For customers whose accounts are on hold due to general issues or a need for coaching, these talking points will guide Frontline Reps in explaining the situation and the next steps for resolution.


English FAQ
Spanish FAQ
Q: Why is my account on hold? Can you remove it? 
Q: El usuario tiene problemas generales o necesita orientación.
Your account was flagged for a possible Terms of Use violation. Our Trust and Safety team is carefully reviewing your account. They will reach out to you for any additional information needed to have your account cleared. 
A: Su cuenta fue marcada por una posible violación de los Términos de Uso. Nuestro equipo de Confianza y Seguridad está revisando su cuenta cuidadosamente. Ellos se comunicarán con usted si necesitan información adicional para aprobar su cuenta.
Customer Account Hold: User being investigated - Payments
If the customer has concerns about chargebacks, Frontline Reps should refer to the chargeback talking points in the internal Removed or Banned Users (Pro) (Customer) KA.

articles.fullText:
1099-K Tax Forms and Stripe Express (Pro)

Contents
Overview
Key points 
1099-K threshold and state requirements
Communication and timeline for 1099-K Form delivery
Understanding Stripe Express dashboard
Do's and Don'ts
Talking points
Understanding 1099-K forms
Making changes or corrections to 1099-K  
Stripe Express account setup and management
Receiving 1099-K form
Resources
1. Overview
▶ KA Summary
This internal knowledge article (KA) provides Frontline Reps with key information on 1099-K tax forms and the Stripe Express process for Thumbtack Pros. It covers communication timelines, account management, and resources to help Reps effectively answer Pro questions and support their tax filing needs.
Thumbtack is required to inform the US Internal Revenue Service (IRS) of income earned by users through the platform. Thumbtack is also required to inform pros of how much they have earned as they file their taxes. Thumbtack partners with Stripe to file 1099-K tax forms that summarize a pros earnings. 
1099-K forms are federal income tax information forms used to report earnings and proceeds other than wages, salaries and tips (which are reported on the federal W-2 form). The forms are filed with the US Internal Revenue Service (IRS) and, if required, state tax departments.
A few key things that pros and reps should know: 
As an independent contractor, pros are responsible for keeping track of their earnings and accurately reporting them in tax filings. 
Pros who have any questions about what to report on their taxes should consult with a tax professional. 
Thumbtack is not permitted to provide pros with tax advice. 
Stripe nor Thumbtack files taxes on the pros' behalf.
Key Points

Here is a list of key points for Frontline Reps to reference regarding 1099-K and Stripe Express:
1099-K Basics & Thumbtack's Role: 1099-K forms report pro earnings to the IRS; Thumbtack partners with Stripe to issue them.
Pro Responsibility & No Tax Advice: Pros are independent contractors responsible for their taxes; Reps must not provide tax advice and should refer pros to a tax professional or Stripe Support.
Income Threshold: Pros meeting $20,000 and 200+ transactions (US-based/taxpayer) should expect a 1099-K; state requirements may vary.
Communication Timeline: Thumbtack and Stripe will email pros in December to set up Stripe Express and confirm delivery preferences; forms are available by January 31st.
Stripe Express: This platform allows pros to track earnings, manage tax forms, and update information; SSN is required for IRS filing.
Receiving the Form: 1099-K can be delivered electronically via Stripe Express or mailed; Pros need the form by the April 15th IRS tax filing deadline.
Edge Cases: Certain account types are not fully supported by the Stripe Express Dashboard; direct Pros with edge cases to Stripe Support.
Do's and Don'ts: Frontline reps should answer questions using the talking points in the KA and direct pros to resources (found below); do not offer tax advice.
1099-K threshold and state requirements 
Pros should expect to receive a 1099-K if they meet the income threshold of at least $20,000 and have more than 200 transactions in a calendar year and are based in the US or are a US taxpayer. This form may be delivered electronically or via mail. 
While the federal limit is $20,000 USD, some states have different thresholds and deadlines. Pros can check their state's requirements at 1099-K form state requirements | Stripe Documentation or consult a financial advisor. 
Pros can also find more information on File tax forms with states | Stripe Documentation.
Communication and timeline for 1099-K Form Delivery 
To ensure accurate 1099-K form delivery, Thumbtack pros will receive communications from both Thumbtack and Stripe regarding their 1099-K tax forms. Here is a general timeline of what to expect:
December 1, [Year] - Thumbtack Email 1: 
Thumbtack will send an email to pros informing them that Stripe will reach out soon to collect information and delivery preferences for their 1099-K tax form. This email will also notify pros that Stripe will send their 1099-K form between January and February, depending on their delivery preferences. Additional information will also be available in the Help Center.
Around the second week of December [Year] - Stripe Email 1: 
Stripe (express@stripe.com) will email pros meeting the income threshold instructions on how to set up a Stripe Express account. 
Pros will need to create a Stripe Express account and confirm their information is up to date to receive their 1099-K tax form for the tax year. 
Stripe will ask the pro a series of security questions to verify their identity. 
Pros need to complete these steps to access their 1099-K tax form electronically.
In January [Year]: 
Thumbtack strongly suggests that pros ensure all of their tax filing details and delivery preferences are up to date in Stripe Express. 
The pro's name, address, and Taxpayer Identification Number (Social Security Number/Employer Identification Number) are of primary importance.
By January 31, [Year]: 
The pro's 1099-K tax form will be available to download electronically through Stripe Express. 
If a pro has not consented to electronic delivery of their 1099-K tax form through Stripe Express, their 1099-K tax form will be mailed. 
Pros should allow up to 10 additional business days for postal delivery.
April 15, [Year]: 
This is the IRS deadline to file taxes. 
Pros will need their 1099-K tax form to file their taxes. 
Please note that neither Stripe nor Thumbtack file taxes on the pro's behalf. 
Pros will need to file taxes through their preferred institution.
Understanding Stripe Express 
Stripe Express is a way to engage with Thumbtack and Stripe. The Stripe Express dashboard allows pros to track their earnings, manage tax forms, update their business/personal information, and get direct support from Stripe from a web-based portal (Stripe Express) and app (Stripe Express on the App Store).
One of the features of Stripe Express is a seamless view of all of a pros earnings across different platforms. Pros can see their earnings from other platforms that also use Stripe Express for tax purposes in one place.
▶ Stripe Express Dashboard: Edge cases for 1099-K tax reporting
The new Stripe Express Dashboard doesn’t support certain types of accounts, as follows:
Multi-user and multi-currency express accounts: Express accounts that have multiple users or multiple currencies associated with them can’t view the new Express Dashboard and hence do not receive electronic delivery of forms
Five or more connected accounts sharing the same email: When five or more connected accounts for the same platform have the same email, they don’t receive an email from Stripe because of a potentially poor user experience
Rejected and deleted accounts: Accounts that you’ve rejected or deleted no longer have a Stripe relationship and are ineligible to login to Stripe Express
Standalone and Split forms: If a form has been split or is a standalone form (that is, not tied to the active user of a connected account), it’s not eligible for electronic delivery.
If pros have more questions or an edge case, they should reach out to Stripe Support.
Do's and Don'ts
Frontline reps are not expected to know everything about taxes, Stripe or 1099-Ks. However, reps should know just enough to answer high level questions and direct pros to either Stripe or the Help Center article.
When helping pros with any tax questions and 1099-k forms, frontline rep must follow these guidelines: 
Do answer questions the best you can with the below talking points.
Do direct pros to either Stripe (Stripe Express) or the 1099-K Tax Support FAQs – Thumbtack Help article when applicable. Reps should also encourage the pro to check in with Stripe support (Stripe Express) for more detailed questions.  
Thumbtack resources:  Thumbtack articles in the Help Center include: How to use Thumbtack Pay and 1099-K Tax Support FAQs – Thumbtack Help 
Stripe resources : Stripe can help answer more detailed questions about 1099s and tax filings. For these questions, direct pros to reach out to Stripe Support (Stripe Express) since we don't have access to that kind of information. 
Do not offer tax advice to a pro. Thumbtack is not permitted to provide pros with tax advice.
Do recommend that pros consult with a tax professional for their tax questions.

3. Talking points 

[Reminder to frontline reps: Neither Stripe nor Thumbtack file taxes on a pros behalf, so pros will need to file taxes through their preferred institution. Thumbtack does not provide tax, legal, or accounting advice and these FAQs are for informational purposes only. Pros should consult their own tax, legal, or accounting advisors for any such advice.]
This section offers talking points with answers to frequently asked questions from Thumbtack pros about the 1099-K forms and Stripe Express.
Understanding 1099-K forms
This section will help Frontline Reps explain the basic details and general information about the 1099-K tax form to Thumbtack pros.


English Talking Points
Spanish Talking Points
What is a 1099-K form?
¿Qué es un formulario 1099-K?
1099 forms are federal income tax information forms used to report earnings and proceeds other than wages, salaries and tips (which are reported on the federal W-2 form). The forms are filed with the US Internal Revenue Service (IRS) and, if required, state tax departments. On November 21, 2023, the IRS announced that the 1099-K filing threshold will be at 20,000 USD and 200 transactions for tax year 2023. Keep in mind that states may also have earning requirements and separate deadlines for reporting 1099-Ks and filing them. We recommend consulting a tax advisor to determine your state filing requirements. Our tax partner, Stripe, will reach out to you via email for you to set up a Stripe Express account to electronically download your 1099-K or to select if you would like Stripe to mail your 1099-K.
Los formularios 1099 son formularios de información de impuestos federales que se utilizan para reportar ingresos y ganancias que no son salarios, sueldos ni propinas (que se reportan en el formulario federal W-2). Los formularios se presentan ante el Servicio de Impuestos Internos de los Estados Unidos (IRS) y, si es necesario, ante los departamentos de impuestos estatales. Si ha ganado $600 o más de clientes en Thumbtack, recibirá un tipo de formulario 1099 llamado 1099-K. Nuestro socio fiscal, Stripe, se comunicará con usted por correo electrónico para que configure una cuenta Stripe Express para descargar electrónicamente su 1099-K.
How do I know if I need a 1099-K form? 
[Spanish Translation Here]
If you meet the income threshold of at least $20,000 and the total number of such transactions exceeds 200 in a calendar year —and they're based in the US or are a US taxpayer—you should expect to receive a 1099-K, either through paperless delivery or paper mailing. While the federal limit is $20,000 USD, some states have different thresholds and deadlines. You can check your state’s requirements here: View 1099-K state requirements or check with a financial advisor. You can receive your 1099-K in either digital or paper form. Log into your Stripe Express account to select your preferred delivery methods and/or to download your 1099-K electronically. If you don’t create a Stripe Express account and select a preferred delivery method, or Stripe will mail you your 1099-K form.
[Spanish Translation Here]
Making changes or corrections to1099-K 
This section provides talking points to help Frontline Reps with answering questions from Thumbtack pros about editing or correcting information on the 1099-K tax form.

English Talking Points
Spanish Talking Points
My information has changed since I signed up for Thumbtack. How can I edit information?
Mi información ha cambiado desde que me registré en Thumbtack. ¿Cómo puedo editar la información?
Update your account information in the Account tab:

Under Stripe Express Account, you can update the email address and phone number used to log in to Stripe Express. Please note that only one contact method can be updated at a time.
Under Language preference, you can choose your preferred language for Stripe Express.
Under Payout and Professional Details, you can update personal and legal entity information and view your bank account or debit card information for payouts. 

To update your payout details, open the Thumbtack app settings to view your payout method in your Earnings tab.
Actualice su información de cuenta en la pestaña Cuenta:

En la Cuenta de Stripe Express, puede actualizar la dirección de correo electrónico y el número de teléfono que utilizó para iniciar sesión en Stripe Express. Tenga en cuenta que solo se puede actualizar un método de contacto a la vez.
En Preferencias de idioma, puede elegir su idioma preferido para Stripe Express.
En la zona de pago y detalles profesionales, puede actualizar la información personal y de la entidad legal y ver la información de su cuenta bancaria o tarjeta de débito para los pagos.

Para actualizar sus detalles de pago, abra la configuración de la aplicación Thumbtack para ver su método de pago en la pestaña de Ganancias.
If the information on my 1099-K tax form is incorrect, who do I ask for updates - Stripe or Thumbtack?
Si la información en mi formulario de impuestos 1099-K es incorrecta, ¿a quién debo pedir actualizaciones, a Stripe o a Thumbtack?
If you need to correct the information on your tax form after it’s been delivered, you can update your information in your Stripe Express dashboard or reach out to Stripe here. We understand the numbers on your form might be a bit confusing. Those numbers might represent your net take-home pay, include Stripe fees, or represent total gross volume.

If the numbers seem higher than expected, see “Total Gross Volume” on the 1099-K Form to learn more about gross reporting.

Check here to learn more about the particular 1099-K form you were issued.
Si necesita corregir la información en su formulario de impuestos después de que se haya entregado, puede actualizar su información en su panel de control de Stripe Express o comunicarse con Stripe aquí.
Entendemos que los números en su formulario pueden ser un poco confusos. Esos números pueden representar su salario neto, incluir las tarifas de Stripe o representar el volumen bruto total.

Si los números parecen ser más altos de lo esperado, consulte "Volumen bruto total" en el Formulario 1099-K para obtener más información sobre el reporte bruto.

Consulte aquí para obtener más información sobre el formulario 1099-K particular que se le emitió.
Stripe Express account setup and management 
This section offers Frontline Reps talking points on how to discuss the setup and management of the Stripe Express account with Thumbtack pros.

English Talking Points
Spanish Talking Points
What is Stripe Express? 
¿Qué es Stripe Express?
Stripe Express allows you to track your earnings, manage tax forms, update your business/personal information, and get direct support from Stripe from a web-based portal and app.
Stripe Express es un servicio que le permite realizar un seguimiento de sus ingresos, gestionar formularios de impuestos, actualizar su información personal o comercial y obtener soporte directo de Stripe desde un portal web y una aplicación.
Why is Stripe requesting personal information like my Social Security Number? 
¿Por qué Stripe solicita información personal como mi número de Seguro Social?
Your Social Security Number is required to get your 1099-K tax form properly filed with the IRS.

If you have earned enough to qualify for a 1099-K tax form, the IRS requires your full details to be verified ahead of 1099-K filing.

We understand you may have concerns about providing your full Social Security Number/Employer Identification Number when first claiming your account, given the sensitivity of this identifier. We take your privacy seriously and have enabled technical solutions to ensure that your personal information is secure.
Su número de Seguro Social es necesario para que su formulario de impuestos 1099-K se presente correctamente ante el IRS.

Si ha ganado lo suficiente para calificar para un formulario de impuestos 1099-K, el IRS requiere que se verifiquen sus datos completos antes de la presentación del formulario 1099-K.

Entendemos que puede tener inquietudes sobre proporcionar su número de Seguro Social completo o su número de identificación de empleador cuando crea su cuenta por primera vez, dado lo sensible que es este identificador. Nos tomamos su privacidad muy en serio y hemos habilitado soluciones técnicas para garantizar que su información personal sea segura.
Do I have to download an app?
¿Tengo que descargar una aplicación?
You can download the Stripe Express app on iOS. This app is currently not available on Android. But you don’t need to download an app. You can use either the web-based portal or the Stripe Express app to access your account and tax information.
Puede descargar la aplicación Stripe Express en iOS. La aplicación no está disponible actualmente en Android. Pero no es necesario descargar una aplicación. Puede utilizar el portal web o la aplicación Stripe Express para acceder a su cuenta e información fiscal.
Why do I need to verify my information? 
¿Por qué necesito verificar mi información?
We want to ensure that information like your name, address, and Taxpayer Identification Number are up to date so that your 1099-K tax form is accurate and sent to the right place.
Queremos asegurarnos de que su información, como su nombre, dirección e identificación fiscal, estén actualizadas para que su formulario de declaración de impuestos 1099-K sea preciso y se envíe al lugar correcto
Which email address does Stripe use to send Stripe Express invitations?
¿A qué dirección de correo electrónico envía Stripe invitaciones a Stripe Express?
Stripe uses the email information associated with your Thumbtack account to send you an invitation to sign up for Stripe Express. If you haven’t received that email, contact Stripe Support.
Stripe utiliza la información de correo electrónico asociada a su cuenta de Thumbtack para enviarle una invitación para registrarse en Stripe Express. Si no ha recibido ese correo electrónico, póngase en contacto con el soporte de Stripe.
Why can I see my earnings from other platforms?
¿Por qué puedo ver mis ganancias de otras plataformas?
One of the features of Stripe Express is a seamless view of all of your earnings across different platforms. You can see your earnings from other platforms that also use Stripe Express for tax purposes in one place.
Una de las características de Stripe Express es una vista unificada de todos sus ingresos en diferentes plataformas. Puede ver sus ingresos de otras plataformas que también utilizan Stripe Express para fines fiscales en un solo lugar.
Receiving 1099-K form
This section provides talking points for Frontline Reps to explain to Thumbtack pros about when and how they will receive their 1099-K form.

English Talking Points
Spanish Talking Points
How do I know if I need a 1099-K form?

If you meet the income threshold of at least $20,000 and the total number of such transactions exceeds 200 in a calendar year — and they're based in the US or are a US taxpayer — you should expect to receive a 1099-K, either through paperless delivery or paper mailing.

While the federal limit is $20,000 USD, some states have different thresholds and deadlines. You can check your state’s requirements here or check with a financial advisor.

When will I receive my tax form?
¿Cuándo recibiré mi formulario de impuestos?
Your 1099-K tax form will be emailed or mailed by Stripe Express by January 31, 2024 (note: 1099-Ks arriving by mail may take up to 10 additional business days, so they may arrive in early February 2024).

Starting December 4 2023: Stripe will email you instructions on how to set up a Stripe Express account. If you haven’t already, you’ll need to complete these steps to access your 1099-K tax form electronically.
By January 31, 2024:
Your 1099-K tax form will be available to download electronically through Stripe Express.
If you have not consented to electronic delivery of your 1099-K tax form through Stripe Express, your 1099-K tax form will be mailed. Please allow up to 10 additional business days for postal delivery.
April 15, 2024: IRS deadline to file taxes. You’ll need your 1099 tax form to file your taxes. Please note that neither Stripe nor Thumbtack file taxes on your behalf, so you will need to file taxes through your preferred institution

In January, we strongly suggest that you ensure all of your tax filing details and delivery preferences are up to date in Stripe Express. Your name, address and Taxpayer Identification Number (Social Security Number /Employer Identification Number) are of primary importance.
Su formulario de impuestos 1099-K se le enviará por correo electrónico o por correo postal por Stripe Express antes del 31 de enero de 2023 (tenga en cuenta que los 1099-K que llegan por correo postal pueden tardar hasta 10 días hábiles adicionales, por lo que pueden llegar a principios de febrero de 2024).

A partir de noviembre de 2022: Stripe le enviará instrucciones sobre cómo configurar una cuenta de Stripe Express. Si aún no lo ha hecho, deberá completar estos pasos para acceder a su formulario de impuestos 1099-K electrónicamente.
Antes del 31 de enero de 2024:
Su formulario de impuestos 1099-K estará disponible para descargar electrónicamente a través de Stripe Express.
Si no ha dado su consentimiento para la entrega electrónica de su formulario de impuestos 1099-K a través de Stripe Express, su formulario de impuestos 1099-K se le enviará por correo postal. Espere hasta 10 días hábiles adicionales para la entrega postal.
El 15 de abril de 2024: Es la fecha límite del IRS para presentar impuestos. Necesitará su formulario de impuestos 1099 para presentar sus impuestos. Tenga en cuenta que ni Stripe ni Thumbtack presentan impuestos en su nombre, por lo que deberá presentar impuestos a través de su institución preferida.

En enero, le recomendamos encarecidamente que se asegure de que todos sus datos de presentación de impuestos y sus preferencias de entrega estén actualizados en Stripe Express. Su nombre, dirección y número de identificación fiscal (número de la Seguridad Social/número de identificación del empleador) son de suma importancia.
Why haven’t I received a Stripe Express invitation?
¿Por qué no he recibido una invitación de Stripe Express?
Check your spam or junk mail folder in case your invitation landed there.

You might not receive an invitation if Thumbtack doesn’t have your most current email address on file. You need to either update the email address on your account or check the email account corresponding to your Thumbtack account for the Stripe Express invitation.

You may not have received an invitation for other reasons, such as:

You earned less than the threshold for a 1099-K
Your email address on file is incorrect, missing, or unable to receive emailYour specific account is unsupported on Stripe Express (in uncommon situations where multiple users are sharing the same account, or the same email address is being used on more than 20 accounts)
Compruebe su carpeta de spam o correo no deseado por si acaso su invitación ha aterrizado allí.

Es posible que no reciba una invitación si Thumbtack no tiene su dirección de correo electrónico actualizada. Debe actualizar la dirección de correo electrónico de su cuenta o verificar la cuenta de correo electrónico correspondiente a su cuenta de Thumbtack para la invitación de Stripe Express.

Es posible que no haya recibido una invitación por otros motivos, tales como:

Ha ganado menos que el umbral para un 1099-K.
Su dirección de correo electrónico en archivo es incorrecta, falta o no puede recibir correo electrónico.
Su cuenta específica no es compatible con Stripe Express (en situaciones poco comunes en las que varios usuarios comparten la misma cuenta o la misma dirección de correo electrónico se está utilizando en más de 20 cuentas).
How will I know when my 1099 tax form is available?
¿Cómo sabré cuándo estará disponible mi formulario de impuestos 1099?
Once you’ve set up your Stripe Express account and if opted in to e-delivery, Stripe will send an email notification about the availability of your 1099-K tax form to the email associated with your Stripe Express account.

To choose how you would like to receive your 1099 form, log into your Stripe Express account to select your preferred delivery methods.

If you do not set up a Stripe Express account or you do not select a preferred delivery method through Stripe Express, your form will be mailed to the address on file with Thumbtack in late January 2024.
Una vez que haya configurado su cuenta de Stripe Express y haya optado por la entrega electrónica, Stripe le enviará un correo electrónico notificándole que su formulario de impuestos 1099-K está disponible en la dirección de correo electrónico asociada con su cuenta de Stripe Express.

Para elegir cómo desea recibir su formulario 1099, inicie sesión en su cuenta de Stripe Express para seleccionar sus métodos de entrega preferidos.

Si no configura una cuenta de Stripe Express o no selecciona un método de entrega preferido a través de Stripe Express, su formulario se enviará por correo a la dirección que figura en los archivos de Thumbtack a fines de enero de 2024.
4. Resources 
This section lists helpful resources, including links and contact information, for both Thumbtack pros and Frontline Reps regarding 1099-K forms and Stripe Express. Reps can share any external Help Center articles with pros to help them as needed. These resources may be referenced in the article or provide additional, related information.

1. Overview
▶ KA Summary
This internal knowledge article (KA) helps frontline reps support the Thumbtack Neighborhoods V1 pilot. The article covers the new Neighborhood tab on the app, pilot scope, how to identify impacted users, how to log feedback, the pro and customer experiences, processes, talking points, and resources.

Status
Launch date
Expansion date
Feature priority
Impacted user
Live
July 6, 2026
July 31, 2026
P1 — medium impact and priority
Customers on iOS and web in Tampa, FL and Charlotte, NC
What is Neighborhood?
Neighborhood is a new tab in the Thumbtack app, currently in a market pilot in Tampa and Charlotte. It lets customers browse a feed of home services already scheduled to happen soon near them and request to join in on the same pro's visit. 
 
[Image: rtaImage]
 

How it works (overall)
Here is a high level view how Neighborhood works: 
A customer is assigned to (or joins) a neighborhood. 
From the Neighborhood tab (on the app) or the landing page (on web) they see a neighborhood feed of services happening soon in their neighborhood.
They tap a service visit to view a pro's profile.
They tap Join in to join that visit.
They choose the specific service they want and submit a request form. 
The pro receives that request as a normal lead.
Refer to the Customer experience section below for a closer look. 

[Image: Image. Join In from feed]

How a pro lands in the feed
Once a pro is booked for a job in a neighborhood, they appear in the Neighborhood feed for other customers searching for that same service in that same neighborhood. For the v1 launch of Neighborhoods, this placement is automatically generated 10 days in advance of the request.
Key points
Neighborhood is a new tab in the Thumbtack iOS app where customers see home service visits scheduled soon nearby and join in on the same pro's visit (same pro, same day).
The "Neighborhood" tab replaces the Team tab in pilot markets (on the app).
Neighborhoods are mapped areas (subdivision/HOA level), not ZIP codes; a customer belongs to one, based on their address.
Pros are automatically opted in and were not formally briefed. However, the pro experience remains unchanged. 
Don't proactively raise Neighbors with users outside the pilot markets.
A customer can only request a service type the chosen pro actually offers. If they need something that the pro doesn't do, they must exit and select a different pro. 
To see the Neighbors experience the customer must come from one of the neighborhood entry points.  Customers cannot see upcoming services in search results or clicking a pro’s profile from search results. They must come from one of the entry points above. 
Pilot details
This section provides details about the Thumbtack Neighborhood V1 market pilot, including target markets, launch type, and priority level. 
Dates 
Pilot launch date: July 6, 2026
Expansion date:  TBD
User impact 
Launch type: Market pilot (technically a ship, but a test we will expand on)
Who is included: Customers on iOS and web in target markets 
Target markets: Tampa, Florida and Charlotte, North Carolina CBSAs
Platform: iOS and web
Naming 
Customer-facing tab: "Neighbors" (bottom nav: Home · Search · Plan · Neighborhood · Inbox). In the pilot, this tab replaces the Team tab. There is no separate branded marketing name used in general external comms.
Broader initiative: "Thumbtack Neighbors," built on the StreetFair acquisition (see the StreetFair App Acquisition & Thumbtack Neighbors (Rep) KA).
Priority level:
P1 — medium impact and priority (See the “Experiments and feature priority levels” section in the Current Running Experiments (Rep) KA). 
How to identify users in target markets
Customers: Those in the Tampa or Charlotte CBSAs who see the Neighborhoods tab (iOS) or land on the supported web pages (see Entry points). There is no special flag, pill, or banner marking these users.
Pros: There is no way to identify a neighborhood lead. Neighborhood leads arrive as ordinary leads with no flag, so neither the pro nor a rep reviewing the pro's leads can tell which came from Neighborhoods. This is by design for v1.
Logging pro feedback about Neighborhood leads
Feedback Theme Tagging: When logged feedback from pros about neighborhood leads reps should use the existing feedback theme titled: 
 [Lead Quality] Pro had issue with Neighborhoods Lead 
For steps on submitting feedback, refer to the internal Product Feedback (Rep) KA.
How neighborhoods and ZIP codes work

How Thumbtack maps neighborhoods. In each pilot market, Thumbtack has drawn neighborhood boundaries at the subdivision/HOA level — not ZIP codes. Every address rolls up to a neighborhood, which rolls up to a broader ZIP/territory. A customer belongs to one neighborhood at a time, set by their home address — which is why we collect an address on every entry path.
Whether a customer sees a neighborhood name or a ZIP code:
▶ Named neighborhood: Inside a mapped neighborhood → they see the neighborhood name (e.g., "Capitol Hill").[Image: rtaImage]
▶ Umbrella neighborhood (ZIP-named): In a pilot ZIP/territory but outside any mapped neighborhood → they're placed in an umbrella neighborhood named after the ZIP code. (Many addresses won't fall inside a mapped neighborhood, so leftover addresses in a ZIP are grouped together.)[Image: rtaImage]
How a customer gets into a neighborhood:
Known address (assigned): auto-assigned to their neighborhood (using their address saved to their home profile). They confirm their address during the request flow.
Unknown address (joining): they enter their address to join; it's saved to their home profile for next time.
Outside pilot markets: If the address is outside mapped territory entirely, the customer sees: "Your neighborhood isn't ready yet. We're rolling out new neighborhoods every month but don't have one ready for your address yet. We'll email you when your neighborhood is ready. In the meantime, you can still browse standard Thumbtack services."
Refer to the How to join a neighborhood section below for a closer look. 
Changing neighborhoods. Customers can update their address in their home profile on the app.This may reassign them to a different neighborhood, but it's not confirmed for v1. Don't promise a neighborhood change. If a customer needs theirs changed (e.g., after a move), post in the #neighborhoods-support for help.

2. Customer experience

In the pilot markets, the Team tab is replaced by a new "Neighborhood" tab — so the app navigation becomes Home · Search · Plan · Neighborhood · Inbox. Web navigation stays the same (Sign up as a pro · Plan · Team · Inbox). Customers on web will navigate to the landing page to access their Neighborhood feed. 
Entry points— customers can reach Neighborhoods several ways:
Neighborhood tab (iOS app) → opens the Feed
Home tab (iOS app) → "See more" goes to the feed (if address is known) or to address collection (if the address is unknown)
Landing page (web) → Call to action button (e.g., Find my neighborhood) starts address collection; "See more" goes to the feed (if the address is known)
Email or direct mail (web) → a QR code opens a dedicated landing page
NOTE: Customers cannot see upcoming services in search results or clicking a pro’s profile from search results. They must come from one of the entry points above. 
Invite emails & onboarding:
Awareness/invite emails go to a group of existing Thumbtack users in the pilot markets (every eligible user will get an email if they’re in an ACTIVE ZIP)
Net-new users are reached via direct-mail with QR codes. 
▶ Launch announcement email - address is known

[Image: Image: Email "New: see what's happening in [Neighborhood]. Highlights: Pros your neighbors trust, skip the search, and your next project might already be scheduled. See what's happening CTA.]

See the How to join a neighborhood section to see what this looks like. 
How to join a neighborhood 

On web, customers can enter the flow to join a neighborhood a few ways: 
Mailer comms with QR code sent to neighborhood → landing page with “Join my neighborhood”
Customers without an address on their Home profile → landing page with “Find my neighborhood”
After clicking the call to action, the flow is similar to the app experience. Skip to step 2. 
On the app, customers can enter the flow to join a neighborhood by following these steps: 
Open the Thumbtack customer app (iOS only).
▶ On the Home tab, customers will see a "Happening soon" section with upcoming service visits each with a “Join in” button. Clicking a “Join in” will trigger a different flow depending on if their address is known or not[Image: Home page on CX app showing Happening soon section]
▶ If we don't have their address, they will see “Enter your address to join your neighborhood."[Image: App screen - Enter your address to find your neighborhood]
If the address is already on file, the customer was assigned a neighborhood and goes straight into their neighborhood feed. Move to step 6. 
▶ If the customers address is outside the pilot markets, they will get a "Your neighborhood isn’t ready yet" message.[Image: App screen - Your neighborhood isn't ready yet]
▶ Once they have joined a neighborhood, they are taken to the Neighborhood feed (on Neighborhood tab) where they can see upcoming service visits.[Image: App screen - Neighborhood feed (on Neighborhood tab)]

How to join a service visit
This section outlines the flow if the customer has a neighborhood membership. If the customer doesn’t have a neighborhood membership, refer to the + join a neighborhood + steps above. 
▶ Customers can click to join in on a visit from the following entry points:[Image: App screen - Home tab with "Happening soon" section]
Neighborhood tab (iOS app) → opens the feed where they can click “Join in” on a service 
▶ Home tab (iOS app) → "See more" goes to the feed, “Join in” goes to the request form, clicking pro photo goes to the pros profile where they can click “Join in” (or Request estimate).[Image: App screen - pro profile with upcoming service visit "Join in" section]
Landing page (web) → "See more" goes to the feed where they can click “Join in” on a service 
▶ The customer then picks the service they are interested in. (To request something else, they will exit and search for service as usual).[Image: "Select a service" screen before entering request form flow]
After service selection, they will answer the standard request questions (e.g., message to the pro, add photos, etc). (The start-date question is skipped for “ Join in”  from the Neighborhood feed or pro profile. For “Request estimate on the pros profile, they would see the question. )
▶ At the end of the request flow, they will add their address (instead of zip code) and contact info and tap “Submit.”[Image: "Add your address and contact info" screen]
▶ They see a confirmation that their project was submitted and next steps (e.g., expect messages back soon).[Image: Confirmation page with "What's next?" that explains CX can expect message back soon]
Neighborhood feed
The Neighborhood feed lists the upcoming service visits happening soon nearby. It surfaces the top upcoming visits nearby and is capped at the top 6. 
Customers won't see services on their feed that happen to be on the day of the services (e.g., if today is Monday, they would see upcoming services for Tuesday and onward).
Each upcoming service visit shows the date, the neighborhood, a count of how many neighbors have joined, and a Join in button. 
▶ What the feed looks like
Web feed
App feed > Neighborhood tab

[Image: Web screen of Neighborhood feed]


[Image: App screen Neighborhood feed (Neighborhood tab)]

Customer talking points 
This section provides Frontline Reps with approved talking points for communicating with customers about Thumbtack neighborhoods. Use these talking points to ensure consistent and accurate messaging.

English talking point
Q: What is the Neighborhood feature/Neighborhood tab?
A: It shows home services already scheduled near you — you can see what your neighbors are booking and request that same pro to do the same job at your place around the same time. You skip searching for a new pro and get the confidence of a pro your neighbors already use.
Q: Is my personal information visible to my neighbors?
A: No. No personal information — your name, contact info, or address — is shared publicly or visible to neighbors. The only thing shown in the feed is an avatar next to the service that was booked, so you get the benefit of your neighbors' experience without any personal details being exposed.
Q: Why don't I see the Neighborhoods tab? 
A: It's a limited pilot right now, available in select communities. If you're outside those areas you won't see it yet. 

(Rep: Don't promise a specific ZIP code or date.)
Q: I want a different service than this pro offers — can I still join in?
A: Pros typically offer many services, and you can only request a service that pro actually offers. When you join, you'll be asked which service you need. To request something else, you’ll exit and search for it to see pros who offer it.
Q: I got a "your neighborhood isn't ready yet" message.
A: We're adding new neighborhoods every month and yours isn't mapped yet. We'll email you when it's ready, and you can keep using standard Thumbtack in the meantime.

3. Pro experience 
Pros have not been proactively informed about this pilot. There are no changes to the pro experience. Leads and monetization will still flow the same way.
There may be some initial confusion if a customer asks about a hypothetical pre-scheduled upcoming service visit.
Pro talking points 
This section provides Frontline Reps with approved talking points for communicating with pros who ask about Thumbtack neighborhoods. Use these talking points to ensure consistent and accurate messaging.

English talking point
Q: What is Thumbtack Neighborhoods? 
A place where customers can browse a feed of home services happening soon in their neighborhood and request to join in on that visit while the pro is nearby.
Q: What do I need to do differently?
A: Nothing. These are normal leads in your Jobs list.
Q: How does this new neighborhoods feature help me as a pro? 
A: It helps you cluster jobs on the same street, so you can group nearby visits to cut travel time and overhead, with less scheduling back-and-forth since the customer is already aligned on the date. These are quality leads — the customer is reaching out to you specifically, not picking from a list of competitors.
Q: Can I reschedule customer(s) who requested to join a specific job date (USV)?
A: Absolutely. While the customer may have seen a specific date, it’s up to you and the customer to work out a service date that works best. If it turns out it’s the same as their neighbors, that’s ideal for everyone.
Question not answered here?: ping our Slack channel for help: #neighborhoods-support
4. Helpful terms to know 
Neighborhood: A new named, geographically bounded area within Thumbtack’s platform — at the subdivision or HOA level, not a ZIP code — that belongs to one market. 
A customer is assigned to one neighborhood based on their home address, and sees it by name in the app (e.g., "Capitol Hill").  
If the address is in a valid pilot ZIP but outside a mapped neighborhood, the customer is placed in an umbrella neighborhood (below). 
If it's outside mapped territory entirely, they get a "your neighborhood isn't ready yet" message.
Umbrella neighborhood (umbrella hood): Addresses in a valid territory/ZIP but outside any mapped neighborhood. These addresses are aggregated into one large neighborhood named after the ZIP code and displayed as that ZIP instead of a name. 
Neighborhood membership: The link between a customer and their one neighborhood, created when their home address is matched to that neighborhood's area. (Internal note: existing customers in pilot markets are pre-assigned where possible so the feed isn't empty at launch.)
Upcoming service visit (USV):  A scheduled service happening in a neighborhood — the core item in the Neighborhood feed. Customers never see "USV" — to them it's a service listed under "Happening soon," and the action is "Join [date] service." 
Neighborhood feed: The list of upcoming visits shown to a customer. It surfaces the top upcoming visits nearby. (Internal: capped at the top 6, ranked by recency — roughly 3–8 days out — proximity, pro rating, and how many neighbors have joined.)

articles.fullText:
¿Qué son los prospectos de Smart Match?
[Image: Pill Pro (Spanish)]
Con Smart Match, le ayudamos a conseguir más trabajos. Es posible que reciba prospectos fuera de sus preferencias habituales cuando nuestra IA prediga que se adaptan muy bien a su negocio.
Cómo funciona
Emparejamiento más inteligente. Miramos más allá de sus preferencias marcadas para encontrar más trabajos que se sigan adaptando bien a usted.
Reembolsos fáciles. Si recibe un prospecto para un tipo de trabajo que no realiza, rechácelo y cuéntenos el motivo. Cuando nos explique por qué el tipo de trabajo no era el adecuado, le daremos un reembolso.
Mejora con sus comentarios. Usamos sus comentarios para mejorar los futuros emparejamientos. Cuanto más información comparta, mejores serán sus prospectos.
Sin cambios en el presupuesto ni en los precios. Su presupuesto semanal y sus precios máximos por prospecto se mantendrán iguales
Cómo solicitar un reembolso
Si recibe un prospecto para un trabajo que no realiza, no se preocupe. Infórmenos al rechazar el prospecto y decirnos por qué no era el adecuado; nosotros le daremos un reembolso.
App
Abra la aplicación Thumbtack Pro.
Seleccione Jobs ("Trabajos") en el menú principal de abajo.
Abra el prospecto.
Seleccione Decline ("Rechazar").
Seleccione Yes, decline ("Sí, rechazar").
Seleccione Not what I do ("No es lo que hago") y explique por qué.
Responda unas cuantas preguntas para ayudarnos a entender qué trabajos quiere.
Confirme que la nueva preferencia es correcta.
Computadora
Inicie sesión en su cuenta de Thumbtack.
Diríjase a Jobs ("Trabajos").
Abra el prospecto.
Seleccione Decline ("Rechazar").
Seleccione Yes, decline ("Sí, rechazar").
Seleccione Not what I do ("No es lo que hago") y explique por qué.
Responda unas cuantas preguntas para ayudarnos a entender qué trabajos quiere.
Confirme que la nueva preferencia es correcta.
Aplicaremos estos comentarios a sus futuros prospectos y le daremos un reembolso por el que acaba de rechazar.
Tip
Tenga cuidado al rechazar un prospecto: seleccionar Not what I do ("No es lo que hago") afecta los tipos de prospectos que recibirá en el futuro. Si aún desea recibir esos tipos de trabajos más adelante, seleccione otro motivo que sea adecuado, como Location ("Ubicación") o Not available ("No disponible").
Cómo optar por excluirse
Si desea volver a recibir únicamente prospectos que coincidan exactamente con sus preferencias, puede optar por excluirse en cualquier momento desde su página de Servicios.
App
Abra la aplicación Thumbtack Pro.
Seleccione Services ("Servicios") en el menú principal de abajo.
Seleccione el interruptor junto a Smart matching ("Smart matching"). Los Smart Matches están activados cuando el interruptor es azul y desactivados cuando el interruptor es gris.
Computadora
Inicie sesión en su cuenta de Thumbtack.
Diríjase a Services ("Servicios").
Seleccione el interruptor junto a Smart matching ("Smart matching") Los Smart Matches están activados cuando el interruptor es azul y desactivados cuando el interruptor es gris.
Preguntas frecuentes
¿Por qué se me cobra por prospectos fuera de mis preferencias de trabajo?
Usted recibe estos prospectos porque forma parte de nuestro programa Smart Match. Para ayudarle a conseguir más de los trabajos que quiere, nuestra IA mira más allá de sus preferencias de trabajo para encontrar clientes que creemos que todavía se adaptan muy bien a su negocio.
Se le cobra automáticamente por estos prospectos de Smart Match, pero hemos diseñado este programa para que sea de bajo riesgo para usted. Si nos equivocamos en un emparejamiento, rechace el prospecto y díganos por qué. Le daremos un reembolso y usaremos sus comentarios para encontrar los trabajos adecuados para su negocio.
¿Aún puedo solicitar un reembolso por un prospecto que no rechacé?
Sí. Si ya aceptó un prospecto, siga estos pasos para solicitar un reembolso.

articles.fullText:
Cómo funcionan los trabajos de instalación de Moen Flo
[Image: Pill Pro (Spanish)]
Moen y Thumbtack están conectando a profesionales de plomería locales con clientes que necesitan instalar un dispositivo Moen Smart Flo. Este dispositivo monitorea el sistema de agua de la vivienda para detectar fugas y cierra automáticamente el suministro de agua para prevenir daños.
Cuando un cliente compra un dispositivo, puede agendar a un profesional calificado para que se encargue de la instalación. Estos trabajos preestablecidos son una forma garantizada de ganar nuevos clientes y hacer crecer su negocio de plomería.
¿Listo para comenzar? Complete el formulario de inscripción para aplicar.
Beneficios
Estos trabajos son una excelente manera de mantener su agenda llena y conseguir más trabajo en Thumbtack.
Sin ofertas ni cargos por prospectos. Los clientes ya compraron su dispositivo Moen Flo. Solo reclame el trabajo y es suyo.
Ganancias garantizadas. Sepa exactamente cuánto ganará antes de aceptar. Los pagos van de $250 a $400 según el tamaño de la tubería y el tipo de instalación, con ganancias adicionales posibles por trabajo fuera del alcance estándar.
Horario flexible. Reclame únicamente los trabajos que se ajusten a su agenda.
Acerca de estos trabajos
Los trabajos de instalación de Moen Flo consisten en instalar el Moen Flo Smart Water Shutoff en una línea principal de suministro de agua expuesta y accesible, ya sea dentro o fuera de la vivienda. La instalación estándar incluye la mano de obra y los materiales de uso común. Hay dos tipos, ambos prepagados por el cliente:
Instalación regular (en línea): se usa cuando hay suficiente tubería recta y accesible para instalar el dispositivo en línea.
Instalación premium (en bucle): se usa cuando es necesario redirigir la línea de agua para crear un bucle donde quepa el dispositivo.
Usted determinará el tipo de instalación una vez que haya evaluado el sitio. Para revisar las pautas detalladas de instalación, lo que no está incluido y las reglas para tareas personalizadas fuera del alcance, consulte la guía de referencia para instaladores de Thumbtack del programa de instalación de Moen Flo (PDF).
Cómo funciona
1. Verifique su elegibilidad
Antes de poder recibir trabajos de Moen, debe:
Completar el formulario de inscripción. Necesitará los datos de su cuenta de Thumbtack y una copia de su licencia de plomería para aplicar.
Completar la capacitación. Recibirá un correo electrónico con las instrucciones. Debe terminar la capacitación antes de poder recibir trabajos.
Configurar el depósito directo: no necesita depósito directo para reclamar trabajos, pero sí debe configurarlo para recibir su pago una vez terminado el trabajo.
Una vez que envíe el formulario, recibirá de inmediato un correo electrónico con un enlace a los materiales de capacitación.
2. Reclame el trabajo
Cuando haya un trabajo de instalación disponible en su área, le avisaremos (por correo electrónico, mensaje de texto o llamada). Los trabajos de Moen se asignan por orden de llegada: responda al correo para reclamarlo e indique al equipo qué fecha y hora le convienen más. Al reclamar un trabajo, usted acepta nuestras políticas de cancelación y de inasistencia.
3. Prepárese para el trabajo
Una vez que haya reclamado el trabajo:
Coordine con el cliente: comuníquese para presentarse y confirmar los detalles de la instalación. Recuérdele tener a la mano los datos de su red Wi-Fi y acceso a la válvula principal de cierre de agua durante el trabajo.
Revise las guías: repase la guía de instalación antes de llegar para asegurar una instalación sin contratiempos.
4. Complete el trabajo y reciba su pago
Siga estos pasos para completar el trabajo y recibir su pago:
Evalúe el sitio: antes de hacer cualquier cambio, verifique estas cinco condiciones y tome una foto del "antes" del área de instalación; ambas son requisito para recibir el pago:
Configuración de la app: pregunte al cliente si ya descargó la app de Moen y vinculó el dispositivo a su cuenta. Si no lo ha hecho, pídale que lo haga mientras usted completa su evaluación. Si necesita ayuda con la vinculación, indíquele que llame a Moen Smart Home Support al (844) 633-8356.
Suministro eléctrico: confirme que haya un tomacorriente activo a menos de 30 pies del lugar de instalación.
Señal de Wi-Fi: verifique que la ubicación de la tubería esté dentro del alcance de una red Wi-Fi de 2.4 GHz con al menos 2 barras de intensidad de señal.
Presión de agua: pruebe las líneas para verificar que la presión estática del agua sea inferior a 125 PSI (o inferior a 80 PSI si así lo exigen los códigos de construcción locales).
Compatibilidad de la tubería: confirme que la línea principal de agua sea totalmente accesible, tenga un diámetro menor a 1½ pulgadas y sea compatible con el dispositivo Flo.
Complete la instalación: realice la instalación según lo que encuentre en el sitio. Si el trabajo requiere labores más allá de la instalación estándar, consulte la sección "Cómo manejar trabajo adicional o cargos extra" más abajo.
Tome una foto del "después": fotografíe el área de instalación terminada (requisito para recibir el pago).
Marque el trabajo como terminado: actualice el estado del trabajo en Thumbtack tan pronto como termine la instalación. Así sabremos que el trabajo está hecho y podremos procesar sus ganancias.
Envíe su documentación por correo electrónico. Responda a la notificación de confirmación del trabajo o escriba a installations@thumbtack.com. Incluya sus fotos del antes y el después, además de una factura si realizó trabajo fuera del alcance estándar.
Una vez que cumpla con todos los requisitos de pago, sus ganancias llegarán por depósito directo en un plazo de 4 a 5 días hábiles.
Cómo manejar trabajo adicional o cargos extra
La instalación estándar cubre la mayoría de las situaciones, pero a veces se necesita trabajo adicional. Si descubre que un trabajo requiere labores más allá de la instalación estándar regular o premium, el cliente debe pagar esos servicios adicionales.
Antes de comenzar cualquier trabajo adicional, prepare una cotización aproximada por escrito con el alcance del trabajo y el precio, y obtenga la aprobación del cliente.
El trabajo adicional se divide en dos categorías:
Servicios adicionales: son tareas predefinidas que van más allá de la instalación estándar. Cubren escenarios comunes como reemplazar o reubicar una válvula de cierre, una válvula reductora de presión (PRV), una llave de manguera o una válvula de alivio de presión. Nuestra guía para socios incluye precios sugeridos de tarifa fija, pero estas tarifas son solo un punto de partida: usted tiene la flexibilidad de fijar su propio precio.
Trabajos personalizados: son labores complejas o imprevistas que van más allá de los servicios adicionales, como abrir paredes, excavar para encontrar tuberías ocultas o redirigir tuberías de forma importante. Usted determinará el precio según los requisitos específicos del trabajo.
Para todos los detalles sobre los precios de los servicios adicionales y las pautas de trabajos personalizados, consulte la guía de referencia para instaladores de Thumbtack del programa de instalación de Moen Flo.
Cancelaciones y cargos
Como estos son trabajos programados, aplican reglas específicas:
Cancelaciones: si cancela dentro de las 48 horas previas a la hora de inicio del trabajo, se le cobrarán $15.
Inasistencias: si no se presenta a un trabajo que reclamó, se le cobrarán $15.
Inasistencia del cliente: si llega y el cliente no está en casa, espere al menos 15 minutos. Si aun así no aparece, contáctenos al (628) 266-0562. El trabajo se cancelará y usted recibirá un crédito de $15 para usar en prospectos futuros.
Tip
Usted no puede reprogramar los trabajos de instalación de Moen; solo los clientes pueden hacerlo. Si necesita cambiar la hora, coordínelo con el cliente.
Preguntas frecuentes
¿Qué hago cuando termino una instalación?
Después de montar el dispositivo, no guarde sus herramientas de inmediato. Haga una revisión final para asegurarse de que todo funcione perfectamente:
Revise su trabajo: confirme que el dispositivo esté firmemente instalado.
Presurice las líneas: abra lentamente la válvula principal de cierre de agua y revise que no haya fugas antes de abrirla por completo.
Purgue las bolsas de aire: deje correr el agua por las líneas y luego vaya cerrando las llaves abiertas comenzando desde el punto más bajo de la vivienda y avanzando hacia arriba.
Confirme que la app esté vinculada: pida al cliente que abra su app de Moen y vaya a la pantalla Overview ("Resumen"). Confirme que el dispositivo esté correctamente sincronizado y que el caudal, la presión y la temperatura se estén registrando activamente.
Ejecute la prueba MicroLeak: desde esa misma pantalla Overview ("Resumen") en la app, pida al cliente que inicie una prueba MicroLeak. Apague cualquier llave o electrodoméstico que use agua mientras se ejecuta la prueba.
Explique y limpie: dele al cliente una breve explicación sobre cómo usar y resolver problemas de su nuevo dispositivo inteligente. También retire cualquier residuo de la instalación y deje el área de trabajo ordenada.
¿Qué cubre la asignación estándar prepagada de accesorios?
La instalación regular incluye hasta 2 accesorios estándar para colocar la línea del dispositivo. La instalación premium en bucle incluye hasta 3 pies de tubería nueva y una asignación de hasta 8 accesorios estándar (incluidos acoples, codos, adaptadores o reductores). Los artículos especializados, como válvulas de cierre de reemplazo, PRV o tes para líneas de derivación, no forman parte de la asignación estándar.
¿Hay configuraciones del sitio donde no se puede instalar el Moen Flo?
Sí. No instale el dispositivo en líneas de agua galvanizadas, enterradas bajo tierra o que estén directamente en línea con circuitos de supresión de incendios o rociadores. Si la vivienda tiene rociadores contra incendios, debe instalar el dispositivo después de que la tubería se derive hacia el sistema de rociadores para no interferir con las líneas de seguridad de emergencia.
¿Qué debo hacer si la vivienda usa un sistema de agua de pozo?
Puede proceder con la instalación. Sin embargo, las viviendas con sistemas de pozo deben tener un filtro de sedimentos operativo con una clasificación de al menos 150 micrones, o un filtro tipo "Y" de malla 100, ubicado aguas arriba del dispositivo. Si este filtro falta o no cumple con los requisitos del código, agregarlo es un costo de trabajo adicional que paga el cliente.
¿Tengo que corregir violaciones de código preexistentes en la línea?
Sí. Cualquier tubería que viole los códigos locales o represente un peligro inmediato debe actualizarse antes de montar el dispositivo.
Corregir problemas de plomería preexistentes o hacer mejoras estructurales se considera trabajo adicional. Prepare una cotización aproximada del trabajo de corrección de código y obtenga la aprobación del cliente antes de comenzar. Para todos los detalles, consulte la sección "Cómo manejar trabajo adicional o cargos extra" más arriba.
¿Qué pasa si no puedo completar un trabajo o me llaman para una visita de diagnóstico?
Thumbtack le dará un crédito de $30 por gastos de traslado para usar en prospectos futuros en cualquiera de estas situaciones:
Instalación que no se puede completar: recibirá el crédito si llega preparado para trabajar pero la instalación no puede realizarse por circunstancias fuera de su control. Esto incluye:
El cliente se niega a proceder con la instalación.
El cliente no aprueba el trabajo adicional requerido.
Las condiciones del sitio impiden físicamente la instalación.
El cliente pidió el dispositivo de un tamaño incorrecto.
Visitas de diagnóstico posteriores a la instalación: si un cliente o Moen le pide que regrese a investigar un problema reportado, también puede recibir el crédito. Thumbtack emitirá este pago si nuestro equipo de soporte determina que:
No hay ningún problema técnico.
El problema no está relacionado con su trabajo de instalación original.
Para todos los detalles sobre cómo enviar la documentación de un trabajo no completado o un cargo de diagnóstico, consulte la guía de referencia para instaladores de Thumbtack del programa de instalación de Moen Flo (PDF).
Obtenga ayuda
Encuentre respuestas en nuestras guías y videos detallados:
Instrucciones de instalación del dispositivo Moen Smart Flo (PDF)
Instalación guiada del Flo Smart Water Monitor and Shutoff (video)
Guía de referencia para instaladores de Thumbtack del programa de instalación de Moen Flo (PDF)
Si tiene preguntas sobre el programa de instalación o sobre un trabajo específico, contáctenos por correo electrónico o teléfono:
Correo electrónico: installations@thumbtack.com
Teléfono: (628) 266-0562
Para obtener ayuda con el dispositivo Moen, la vinculación de la app o preguntas técnicas sobre el producto, llame a Moen Smart Home Support al (844) 633-8356.

¿Necesita ayuda? ¡Estamos aquí para usted!

1. Overview
▶ KA Summary
This internal knowledge article (KA) provides Frontline Reps with information about the fixed budget discount (Experiment). This experiment introduces a second discount tier — 5% off leads — for pros who increase their weekly budget to a fixed price amount, giving eligible pros a lower-commitment alternative to the existing ten percent unlimited budget discount.
